import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, safeStorage, utilityProcess } from 'electron'
import { startDeliveryRuntime } from '../../../../packages/sidecar/host-electron/src/control-runtime/runtime.ts'

app.setPath('userData', process.env.BLUME_CACHE_TEST_ROOT!)
app.on('window-all-closed', () => {})
process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
  console.error(error)
  app.exit(1)
})
const remote = 'https://evidence-cache.example.invalid/evidence/shot'
let cookie = 'session=synthetic-fixture'
let changed: (() => void) | undefined
void app
  .whenReady()
  .then(async () => {
    const root = process.env.BLUME_CACHE_TEST_ROOT!
    const preload = join(root, 'preload.cjs')
    await writeFile(
      preload,
      "const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron'); contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('cacheTest', { call: (operation) => ipcRenderer.invoke('control:request', 'call', { operation }), open: (url) => ipcRenderer.invoke('control:open', url) });"
    )
    const window = new BrowserWindow({
      show: false,
      webPreferences: { preload, sandbox: true, contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false }
    })
    let viewer: BrowserWindow | undefined
    const runtime = startDeliveryRuntime({
      native: {
        userData: root,
        ipcMain,
        safeStorage,
        fork: (path, args) => utilityProcess.fork(path, args),
        createWindow: (options) => (viewer = new BrowserWindow({ ...options, show: false })),
        openExternal: async () => {},
        workArea: () => ({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 1400, height: 900 }),
        reducedMotion: () => true
      },
      window,
      workerPath: process.env.BLUME_CACHE_TEST_WORKER!,
      icon: '',
      accounts: {
        cookie: () => cookie,
        session: async () => null,
        providers: async () => [],
        signIn: async () => null,
        signUp: async () => null,
        cancelSocialSignIn: async () => true,
        signInSocial: async () => null,
        signOut: async () => {},
        onChanged: (listener) => {
          changed = listener
          return () => {}
        }
      }
    })
    try {
      const html = await readFile(process.env.BLUME_CACHE_TEST_HTML!, 'utf8')
      const policy = /content="(default-src[^"]+)"/.exec(html)![1]
      const page = join(root, 'page.html')
      await writeFile(
        page,
        `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="${policy}"><h1>Evidence cache</h1>`
      )
      await window.loadFile(page)
      const initial = await window.webContents.executeJavaScript("window.cacheTest.call('seed')")
      assert.equal(initial.downloads, 1)
      const draw = () =>
        window.webContents.executeJavaScript(
          `new Promise(resolve => { const image = new Image(); image.onload = () => resolve({ width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight }); image.onerror = () => resolve({ error: true }); image.src = ${JSON.stringify(remote)}; document.body.append(image) })`
        )
      assert.deepEqual(await draw(), { width: 1, height: 1 })
      assert.deepEqual(await draw(), { width: 1, height: 1 })
      await window.webContents.executeJavaScript(`window.cacheTest.open(${JSON.stringify(remote)})`)
      assert.equal(await viewer!.webContents.executeJavaScript('document.querySelector("img")?.naturalWidth'), 1)
      assert.ok(viewer!.webContents.getURL().startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:'))
      assert.equal(
        (await window.webContents.executeJavaScript("window.cacheTest.call('stats')")).downloads,
        1
      )
      cookie = ''
      changed!()
      await window.webContents.session.clearCache()
      // Discard already-decoded pixels from the old account's visible images.
      await window.loadFile(page)
      assert.deepEqual(
        await draw(),
        { error: true },
        'signed out app cannot see the cached private image'
      )
      console.log(
        'PASS: real Electron rendered repeated inline and standalone cache hits with one download; sign-out revoked access'
      )
    } finally {
      await runtime.stop()
      window.destroy()
    }
    // Session hooks still receive requests after the window that installed them is gone.
    // This failed with Object has been destroyed in the onBeforeRequest callback.
    const survivor = new BrowserWindow({ show: false })
    try {
      await survivor.loadFile(join(root, 'page.html'))
      assert.equal(await survivor.webContents.executeJavaScript('document.querySelector("h1")?.textContent'), 'Evidence cache')
      console.log('PASS: another window loads through the retained session hooks after owner destruction')
    } finally {
      survivor.destroy()
    }
    app.exit(0)
  })
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error(error)
    app.exit(1)
  })

<file path="__test/regressions/account-callback-routing.test.ts">
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const authenticate = vi.fn()
  const setupMain = vi.fn()
  return {
    channel: 'stable',
    electronClient: vi.fn(() => ({ id: 'electron' })),
    authenticate,
    setupMain,
    authClient: {
      authenticate,
      getCookie: vi.fn(() => '__Secure-better-auth-release.session_token=stored-session'),
      setupMain,
      requestAuth: vi.fn(),
      getSession: vi.fn(),
      listAccounts: vi.fn()
    }
  }
})

vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  app: {
    getVersion: () => '1.0.69',
    userAgentFallback: 'Blume/1.0.69'
  },
  BrowserWindow: {
    getFocusedWindow: () => null
  }
}))

vi.mock('better-auth/client', () => ({
  createAuthClient: () => mocks.authClient
}))

vi.mock('better-auth/client/plugins', () => ({
  adminClient: () => ({ id: 'admin' })
}))

vi.mock('@better-auth/electron/client', () => ({
  electronClient: mocks.electronClient,
  normalizeUserOutput: (value: unknown) => value
}))

vi.mock('../../src/main/blume-user-host', () => ({
  getOrCreateBlumeDeviceId: vi.fn(),
  getOrCreateBlumeId: vi.fn()
}))

vi.mock('../../src/main/secureStore', () => ({
  getSecret: vi.fn(),
  setSecret: vi.fn()
}))

vi.mock('../../src/main/releaseMetadata', () => ({
  resolveDesktopReleaseMetadata: () => ({
    version: '1.0.69',
    channel: mocks.channel,
    sourceSha: null,
    bundleId: null
  })
}))

describe('desktop account callback routing', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules()
    mocks.channel = 'stable'
    mocks.electronClient.mockClear()
    mocks.authenticate.mockReset()
    mocks.setupMain.mockReset()
    mocks.authenticate.mockResolvedValue({ data: {}, error: null })
    mocks.authClient.requestAuth.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mocks.authClient.getSession.mockReset()
    mocks.authClient.listAccounts.mockReset().mockResolvedValue({ data: [], error: null })
  })

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
    vi.unstubAllGlobals()
  })

  test.each(['stable', 'canary'])(
    'waits for the %s callback and rejects the other app without session polling',
    async (channel) => {
      mocks.channel = channel
      const scheme = channel === 'canary' ? 'codes.blume-canary' : 'codes.blume'
      const otherScheme = channel === 'canary' ? 'codes.blume' : 'codes.blume-canary'
      vi.useFakeTimers()
      let signedIn = false
      mocks.authenticate.mockImplementation(async () => {
        signedIn = true
        return { data: {}, error: null }
      })
      const session = {
        session: { expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000).toISOString() },
        user: { id: 'synthetic', name: 'Preview', email: 'preview@example.invalid' }
      }
      mocks.authClient.getSession.mockImplementation(async ({ fetchOptions }) => {
        const data = signedIn ? session : null
        await fetchOptions.onResponse({ response: Response.json(data) })
        return { data, error: null }
      })
      const { deliveryAccounts, handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
      const pending = deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')
      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(65_000)
      expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(mocks.electronClient).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ protocol: { scheme } })
      )
      expect(mocks.authClient.requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        provider: 'google',
        signal: expect.any(AbortSignal),
        ...(channel === 'canary' ? { additionalData: { callbackScheme: scheme } } : {})
      })
      await expect(
        handleAccountDeepLink(`${otherScheme}://auth/callback#token=wrong-app`)
      ).resolves.toBe(false)
      expect(mocks.authenticate).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      await handleAccountDeepLink(`${scheme}://auth/callback#token=delayed-callback`)
      await expect(pending).resolves.toMatchObject({ user: { id: 'synthetic' } })
      expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
      expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
    }
  )

  test('a cancelled browser flow times out without session reads and allows another attempt', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const { deliveryAccounts } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const first = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('github')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in timed out.'
    )
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(120_000)
    await first
    const second = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in timed out.'
    )
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(120_000)
    await second
    expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.authClient.requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
  })

  test('cancel releases the lock immediately, stops timers, and ignores a late callback', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const { deliveryAccounts, handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const first = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in was cancelled.'
    )
    const firstSignal = mocks.authClient.requestAuth.mock.calls[0][0].signal
    await expect(deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()).resolves.toBe(true)
    expect(firstSignal.aborted).toBe(true)
    await first
    await expect(
      handleAccountDeepLink('codes.blume://auth/callback#token=abandoned')
    ).resolves.toBe(true)
    expect(mocks.authenticate).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
    const second = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('github')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in was cancelled.'
    )
    expect(mocks.authClient.requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    await deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()
    await second
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
  })

  test('cancel while opening the browser does not let old cleanup unlock the next attempt', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    let opened!: () => void
    mocks.authClient.requestAuth.mockImplementationOnce(
      () =>
        new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          opened = resolve
        })
    )
    const { deliveryAccounts } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const first = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow('cancelled')
    await deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()
    const second = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('github')).rejects.toThrow('cancelled')
    opened()
    await first
    await expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow('already in progress')
    await deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()
    await second
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
  })

  test('cancelling an exchange in flight prevents session reads and account change notifications', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    let finish!: () => void
    mocks.authenticate.mockImplementation(
      ({ fetchOptions }) =>
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          finish = () => {
            expect(fetchOptions.signal.aborted).toBe(true)
            resolve({ data: {}, error: null })
          }
        })
    )
    const { deliveryAccounts, handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const changed = vi.fn()
    deliveryAccounts.onChanged!(changed)
    const pending = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow('cancelled')
    const callback = expect(
      handleAccountDeepLink('codes.blume://auth/callback#token=in-flight')
    ).rejects.toThrow('cancelled')
    await deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()
    await pending
    finish()
    await callback
    expect(changed).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(0)
  })

  test('a committed sign-in wins a late Cancel while its session finishes loading', async () => {
    let finish!: () => void
    mocks.authenticate.mockImplementation(async ({ fetchOptions }) => {
      fetchOptions.onSuccess()
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        finish = resolve
      })
      return { data: {}, error: null }
    })
    const data = {
      session: { expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000).toISOString() },
      user: { id: 'committed', name: 'Test', email: 'test@example.invalid' }
    }
    mocks.authClient.getSession.mockImplementation(async ({ fetchOptions }) => {
      await fetchOptions.onResponse({ response: Response.json(data) })
      return { data, error: null }
    })
    const { deliveryAccounts, handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const pending = deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')
    const callback = handleAccountDeepLink('codes.blume://auth/callback#token=committed')
    await expect(deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()).resolves.toBe(false)
    finish()
    await callback
    await expect(pending).resolves.toMatchObject({ user: { id: 'committed' } })
  })

  test('development cancellation closes the local callback server before retry', async () => {
    const original = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'defaultApp')
    Object.defineProperty(process, 'defaultApp', { configurable: true, value: true })
    try {
      const { deliveryAccounts } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
      const pending = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow('cancelled')
      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(mocks.authClient.requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledOnce())
      const callbackUrl = mocks.authClient.requestAuth.mock.calls[0][0].additionalData.callbackUrl
      await deliveryAccounts.cancelSocialSignIn()
      await pending
      await expect(fetch(callbackUrl + '?token=abandoned')).rejects.toThrow()
      expect(mocks.authenticate).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(mocks.authClient.getSession).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    } finally {
      if (original) Object.defineProperty(process, 'defaultApp', original)
      else Reflect.deleteProperty(process, 'defaultApp')
    }
  })

  test('rejects overlapping provider attempts before opening another browser', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const { deliveryAccounts } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const first = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in timed out.'
    )
    await expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('github')).rejects.toThrow(
      'A browser sign-in is already in progress.'
    )
    expect(mocks.authClient.requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(120_000)
    await first
  })

  test('does not load a session after an invalid callback exchange', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    mocks.authenticate.mockResolvedValue({ data: null, error: { message: 'Invalid code' } })
    const { deliveryAccounts, handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')
    const pending = expect(deliveryAccounts.signInSocial('google')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Social sign-in timed out.'
    )
    await expect(
      handleAccountDeepLink('codes.blume://auth/callback#token=invalid')

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(120_000)

  test('cleans up when opening the browser fails', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()

  test.each(['stable', 'canary', 'development'])(
    'exchanges a packaged %s cold-start callback exactly once',

      expect(mocks.authenticate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
      expect(mocks.authenticate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ token: 'cold-start-token' })

  test('shares one authenticate call for concurrent duplicate callback deliveries', async () => {
    let resolveAuthenticate!: (value: { data: unknown; error: null }) => void
    mocks.authenticate.mockImplementation(
      () =>
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          resolveAuthenticate = resolve
        })
    )
    const { handleAccountDeepLink } = await import('../../src/main/accounts')

    const first = handleAccountDeepLink(url)

    expect(mocks.authenticate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)

  test.each(['stable', 'canary'])(
    'acknowledges %s only after authenticate stores the cookie',
    async (channel) => {
      mocks.channel = channel
      const scheme = channel === 'canary' ? 'codes.blume-canary' : 'codes.blume'
      let finish!: (value: { data: unknown; error: null }) => void
      mocks.authenticate.mockImplementation(
        () =>

            finish = resolve
          })

      expect(fetcher).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

  test('leaves non-account launch arguments for native deep-link routing', async () => {

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const ACCOUNTS_MAIN = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/accounts.ts')
const INDEX_MAIN = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/index.ts')

describe('desktop account device sessions', () => {
  test('keeps Blume as the sole owner of production account callback listeners', () => {
    const source = readFileSync(ACCOUNTS_MAIN, 'utf8')

    expect(source).toMatch(/electronAccountClient\.setupMain\(\{[\s\S]*?scheme:\s*false/)
    expect(source).not.toContain('scheme: !process.defaultApp')
  })

  test('filters expected Code verifier not found failures before captureAppError', () => {

      /reportAccountDeepLinkFailure[\s\S]*from '\.\/accountOAuthCallbackFailurePolicy'/
    )

      /\.catch\(\(error\) => void captureAppError\('main\.account-deep-link', error\)\)/
    )
  })

    const source = readFileSync(ACCOUNTS_MAIN, 'utf8')

    )

    )
  })

import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
import { createAuthClient } from 'better-auth/client'
// Exercise the installed, patched SDK rather than the usual desktop-test stub.
import { electronClient } from '../../node_modules/@better-auth/electron/dist/client.mjs'

const native = vi.hoisted(() => ({ openExternal: vi.fn(), send: vi.fn(), fetcher: vi.fn() }))
vi.mock('electron', () => {
  const electron = {
    app: { userAgentFallback: 'Blume Test' },
    shell: { openExternal: native.openExternal },
    safeStorage: {
      isEncryptionAvailable: () => true,
      encryptString: (value: string) => Buffer.from(value),
      decryptString: (value: Buffer) => value.toString()
    },
    webContents: { getFocusedWebContents: () => ({ send: native.send }) }
  }
  return { default: electron, shell: electron.shell }
})

const processType = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'type')
beforeEach(() => {
  Object.defineProperty(process, 'type', { configurable: true, value: 'browser' })
  native.openExternal.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
  native.send.mockReset()
  native.fetcher.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(Response.json({ user: { id: 'current' } }))
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', native.fetcher)
})
afterEach(() => {
  if (processType) Object.defineProperty(process, 'type', processType)
  else Reflect.deleteProperty(process, 'type')
  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
})

function client() {
  const storage = new Map<string, string>()
  const auth = createAuthClient({
    baseURL: 'https://auth.example',
    plugins: [
      electronClient({
        signInURL: 'https://auth.example/login',
        protocol: { scheme: 'codes.blume' },
        storage: {
          getItem: (name) => storage.get(name),
          setItem: (name, value) => {
            storage.set(name, value)
          }
        }
      })
    ]
  })
  return { auth, storage }
}

function callback() {
  const url = new URL(native.openExternal.mock.calls.at(-1)![0])
  expect(url.searchParams.has('signal')).toBe(false)
  return Buffer.from(
    JSON.stringify({ state: url.searchParams.get('state'), identifier: 'test-code' })
  ).toString('base64url')
}

test('cancel removes only the old verifier; its callback cannot consume the new attempt', async () => {
  const { auth } = client()
  const old = new AbortController()
  await auth.requestAuth({ provider: 'google', signal: old.signal })
  const oldToken = callback()
  old.abort()
  const current = new AbortController()
  await auth.requestAuth({ provider: 'github', signal: current.signal })
  const token = callback()
  const fetcher = native.fetcher
  await expect(auth.authenticate({ token: oldToken })).rejects.toThrow('Code verifier not found')
  expect(fetcher).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  await auth.authenticate({ token, fetchOptions: { signal: current.signal } })
  expect(fetcher).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  current.abort()
})

test('an already cancelled attempt never opens the browser', async () => {
  const { auth } = client()
  const controller = new AbortController()
  controller.abort()
  await expect(
    auth.requestAuth({ provider: 'google', signal: controller.signal })
  ).rejects.toThrow()
  expect(native.openExternal).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
})

test('cancel after the response arrives but before its body is read never stores session cookies', async () => {
  const { auth, storage } = client()
  const controller = new AbortController()
  await auth.requestAuth({ provider: 'google', signal: controller.signal })
  const token = callback()
  let body!: ReadableStreamDefaultController<Uint8Array>
  let received!: () => void
  const receivedResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    received = resolve
  })
  native.fetcher.mockResolvedValue(
    new Response(
      new ReadableStream({
        start(value) {
          body = value
        }
      }),
      {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Set-Cookie': 'better-auth.session_token=abandoned; Path=/; HttpOnly'
        }
      }
    )
  )
  const exchange = expect(
    auth.authenticate({
      token,
      fetchOptions: {
        signal: controller.signal,
        onResponse: () => {
          received()
        }
      }
    })
  ).rejects.toThrow()
  await receivedResponse
  controller.abort()
  body.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ user: { id: 'abandoned' } })))
  body.close()
  await exchange
  expect(storage.size).toBe(0)
  expect(native.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
})

<file path="__test/regressions/account-oauth-callback-failure-policy.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import {
  ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CODE_VERIFIER_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE,
  isExpectedAccountOAuthCallbackFailure,
  reportAccountDeepLinkFailure,
  shouldReportAccountDeepLinkAppError
} from '../../src/main/accountOAuthCallbackFailurePolicy'

function betterAuthCodeVerifierError(): Error {
  const error = new Error(ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CODE_VERIFIER_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE)
  error.name = 'BetterAuthError'
  return error
}

describe('account OAuth callback failure policy', () => {
  it('treats explicit social cancellation as normal', () => {
    expect(shouldReportAccountDeepLinkAppError(new Error('Social sign-in was cancelled.'))).toBe(false)
  })
  it('treats BetterAuth Code verifier not found as expected non-reportable noise', () => {
    const error = betterAuthCodeVerifierError()

    expect(isExpectedAccountOAuthCallbackFailure(error)).toBe(true)
    expect(shouldReportAccountDeepLinkAppError(error)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not call captureAppError for Code verifier not found', () => {
    const captureAppError = vi.fn()
    const logInfo = vi.fn()
    const error = betterAuthCodeVerifierError()

    reportAccountDeepLinkFailure(error, { captureAppError, logInfo })

    expect(captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(logInfo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'expected account OAuth callback failure',
      expect.objectContaining({
        error_name: 'BetterAuthError',
        error_message: ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CODE_VERIFIER_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE,
        reporting_action: 'local_log_only'
      })
    )
  })

  it('does not treat a same-message Error without BetterAuthError name as expected', () => {
    const error = new Error(ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CODE_VERIFIER_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE)
    const captureAppError = vi.fn()

    expect(isExpectedAccountOAuthCallbackFailure(error)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportAccountDeepLinkAppError(error)).toBe(true)

    reportAccountDeepLinkFailure(error, {
      captureAppError,
      logInfo: vi.fn()
    })
    expect(captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith('main.account-deep-link', error)
  })

  it('still reports unexpected account callback failures', () => {
    const errors = [
      new Error('Account sign-in callback could not be completed.'),
      Object.assign(new Error('invalid_grant'), { name: 'BetterAuthError' }),
      new Error('Network request failed')
    ]

    for (const error of errors) {
      expect(isExpectedAccountOAuthCallbackFailure(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(shouldReportAccountDeepLinkAppError(error)).toBe(true)

      const captureAppError = vi.fn()
      reportAccountDeepLinkFailure(error, {
        captureAppError,
        logInfo: vi.fn()
      })
      expect(captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith('main.account-deep-link', error)
    }
  })
})

import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'
import type { AccountSessionView } from '@blume/sidecar-host'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'

import { canAccessDevPage, devPageAccess } from '../../src/renderer/src/lib/devAccess'
import { analyticsForPath, ROUTES } from '../../src/renderer/src/lib/routes'
import { mainTabForPath, pathForMainTab } from '@blume/sidecar-ui'

function session(roles: string[]): AccountSessionView {
  return {
    user: {
      id: 'account-1',
      name: 'Blume User',
      email: 'user@blume.test',
      image: null,
      hasPassword: true,
      roles
    },
    expiresAt: Date.now() + 60_000
  }
}

describe('account root navigation', () => {
  test('maps the Account tab to a first-class route', () => {
    expect(pathForMainTab('account')).toBe(ROUTES.account)
    expect(mainTabForPath(ROUTES.account)).toBe('account')
    expect(analyticsForPath(ROUTES.account).app_screen).toBe('account')
  })
})

describe('developer page access', () => {
  test('fails closed without an authenticated admin role', () => {
    expect(canAccessDevPage(null)).toBe(false)
    expect(canAccessDevPage(session([]))).toBe(false)
    expect(canAccessDevPage(session(['user']))).toBe(false)
  })

  test('allows an authenticated account carrying the admin role', () => {
    expect(canAccessDevPage(session(['user', 'admin']))).toBe(true)
  })

  test('power-user role does not unlock the full dev page', () => {
    expect(canAccessDevPage(session(['user', 'power-user']))).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('developer page access levels', () => {
  test('fails closed without an authenticated session or known role', () => {
    expect(devPageAccess(null)).toBe('none')
    expect(devPageAccess(session([]))).toBe('none')
    expect(devPageAccess(session(['user']))).toBe('none')
  })

  test('admin gets full access, with or without power-user', () => {
    expect(devPageAccess(session(['user', 'admin']))).toBe('full')
    expect(devPageAccess(session(['admin', 'power-user']))).toBe('full')
  })

  test('power-user gets the performance view only', () => {
    expect(devPageAccess(session(['user', 'power-user']))).toBe('performance-only')
  })

  test('gates both desktop and Web Lab developer surfaces and preserves header actions', () => {
    const workspaceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../../..')
    // One gate for both shells: BlumeApp's developer route. Web Lab, screenshot captures included,
    // renders BlumeApp, so it has no developer gate of its own.
    const gate = readFileSync(
      resolve(workspaceRoot, 'packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/DevAccessGate.tsx'),
      'utf8'
    )
    const blumeApp = readFileSync(
      resolve(workspaceRoot, 'packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/BlumeApp.tsx'),
      'utf8'
    )
    const webLab = readFileSync(resolve(workspaceRoot, 'apps/web-lab/src/main.tsx'), 'utf8')
    const pageChrome = readFileSync(
      resolve(workspaceRoot, 'packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/PageChrome.tsx'),
      'utf8'
    )

    expect(gate).toMatch(/const access = devPageAccess\(session\.session \?\? null\)/)
    expect(gate).toMatch(/access === 'none' \? <Navigate to="\/account" replace \/>/)
    expect(blumeApp).toMatch(/dev=\{\s*<DevAccessGate>/)
    expect(webLab).toMatch(/<BlumeApp\b/)
    expect(webLab).not.toMatch(/canAccessDevPage|DevAccessGate|SidecarApp/)
    expect(pageChrome).toContain('trailing={trailing}')
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/after-sign-ticket.test.ts">
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import {
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  rmSync,
  writeFileSync
} from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { expect, test } from 'vitest'

const hook = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../build/afterSign.cjs', import.meta.url))

function snapshot(app: string) {
  return readdirSync(app, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
    .map((entry) => {
      const file = join(entry.parentPath, entry.name)
      return [file.slice(app.length), readFileSync(file).toString('hex')]
    })
    .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right))
}

test.each([
  { name: 'signed and stapled app', platform: 'darwin', ticket: true, status: '0' },
  { name: 'failed signature verification', platform: 'darwin', ticket: true, status: '1' },
  { name: 'app without a staple', platform: 'darwin', ticket: false, status: '0' },
  { name: 'non-macOS invocation', platform: 'win32', ticket: true, status: '0' },
  {
    name: 'missing domain grant',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'domain'
  },
  {
    name: 'wrong app identifier',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'identity'
  },
  {
    name: 'missing embedded profile',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'profile'
  },
  {
    name: 'profile names another certificate',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'certificate'
  },
  {
    name: 'profile has no certificates',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'empty-certificates'
  },
  {
    name: 'certificate extraction fails',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'extraction'
  },
  {
    name: 'profile decoding fails',
    platform: 'darwin',
    ticket: true,
    status: '0',
    invalid: 'decode'
  }
])(
  'afterSign preserves all bundle bytes for $name',
  ({ platform, ticket, status, invalid }) => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-after-sign-'))
    try {
      const app = join(root, 'Fixture.app')
      const files = {
        'Contents/Info.plist': Buffer.from('inert plist fixture'),
        'Contents/MacOS/Fixture': Buffer.from('inert executable fixture'),
        'Contents/_CodeSignature/CodeResources': Buffer.from('inert resource seal fixture'),
        ...(invalid !== 'profile'
          ? { 'Contents/embedded.provisionprofile': Buffer.from('inert profile fixture') }
          : {}),
        ...(ticket
          ? { 'Contents/CodeResources': Buffer.from([0x73, 0x38, 0x63, 0x68, 0, 255, 1, 2]) }
          : {})
      }
      for (const [relative, bytes] of Object.entries(files)) {
        const file = join(app, relative)
        mkdirSync(dirname(file), { recursive: true })
        writeFileSync(file, bytes)
      }
      const before = snapshot(app)
      const bin = join(root, 'bin')
      mkdirSync(bin)
      writeFileSync(
        join(bin, 'codesign'),
        '#!/bin/bash\nprintf "%s\\n" "$@" >> "$TRACE"\nif [[ "$2" == --extract-certificates=* ]]; then [ "$INVALID" = "extraction" ] && exit 1; prefix="${2#--extract-certificates=}"; printf "%s" "fixture signed leaf" > "${prefix}0"; elif [ "$2" = "--extract-certificates" ]; then exit 1; elif [ "$1" = "-d" ]; then printf "%s" "fixture plist"; fi\nexit "$SIGN_STATUS"\n',
        { mode: 0o755 }
      )
      // Conversion is an OS boundary; the fixture supplies the signed entitlement projection.
      writeFileSync(
        join(bin, 'plutil'),
        '#!/bin/bash\ncat >/dev/null\nprintf "%s" "$SIGNED_ENTITLEMENTS"\n',
        { mode: 0o755 }
      )
      writeFileSync(join(bin, 'security'), '#!/bin/bash\nprintf "%s" "$PROFILE_PLIST"\n', {
        mode: 0o755
      })
      const trace = join(root, 'trace')
      const result = spawnSync(
        process.execPath,
        [
          '-e',
          `
      require(process.argv[1])({
        electronPlatformName: process.argv[3], appOutDir: process.argv[2],
        packager: { appInfo: { productFilename: 'Fixture', id: 'page.blume.sidecar' } }
      }).catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1 })
    `,
          hook,
          root,
          platform
        ],
        {
          encoding: 'utf8',
          env: {
            ...process.env,
            PATH: `${bin}:${process.env.PATH}`,
            TRACE: trace,
            SIGN_STATUS: status,
            INVALID: invalid ?? '',
            PROFILE_PLIST:
              invalid === 'decode'
                ? 'not a plist'
                : '<?xml version="1.0"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>DeveloperCertificates</key><array>' +
                  (invalid === 'empty-certificates'
                    ? []
                    : invalid === 'certificate'
                      ? ['other leaf']
                      : ['other leaf', 'fixture signed leaf']
                  )
                    .map((cert) => `<data>${Buffer.from(cert).toString('base64')}</data>`)
                    .join('') +
                  '</array></dict></plist>',
            SIGNED_ENTITLEMENTS: JSON.stringify({
              'com.apple.application-identifier':
                invalid === 'identity'
                  ? '5YWNUNABHW.page.blume.sidecar.canary'
                  : '5YWNUNABHW.page.blume.sidecar',
              'com.apple.developer.team-identifier': '5YWNUNABHW',
              'com.apple.developer.associated-domains':
                invalid === 'domain' ? [] : ['applinks:blume.codes']
            })
          }
        }
      )
      expect(result.status).toBe(invalid ? 1 : Number(status))
      expect(snapshot(app)).toEqual(before)
      if (platform === 'darwin') {
        const calls = readFileSync(trace, 'utf8').trim().split('\n')
        const initialCalls = [
          '--verify',
          '--deep',
          '--strict',
          '--verbose=2',
          app,
          ...(status === '0' ? ['-d', '--entitlements', ':-', app] : [])
        ]
        expect(calls.slice(0, initialCalls.length)).toEqual(initialCalls)
        if (status === '0' && !['domain', 'identity', 'profile'].includes(invalid ?? '')) {
          const certificateCalls = calls.slice(initialCalls.length)
          expect(certificateCalls).toEqual([
            '-d',
            expect.stringMatching(/^--extract-certificates=.+/),
            app
          ])
          expect(
            existsSync(dirname(certificateCalls[1].slice('--extract-certificates='.length)))
          ).toBe(false)
        } else expect(calls).toEqual(initialCalls)
        if (status !== '0')
          expect(result.stderr).toContain('macOS app signature verification failed')
        if (['domain', 'identity', 'profile'].includes(invalid ?? ''))
          expect(result.stderr).toContain('Signed app is missing its Universal Links')
        if (['certificate', 'empty-certificates', 'decode'].includes(invalid ?? ''))
          expect(result.stderr).toContain('Signed certificate is not authorized')
        if (invalid === 'extraction')
          expect(result.stderr).toContain('Could not inspect the signed certificate')
      } else {
        expect(existsSync(trace)).toBe(false)
      }
    } finally {
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
    }
  },
  15_000
)

<file path="__test/regressions/agents-list-hydration.test.ts">
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import { createDesktopSqliteStorage, type SqlDatabase } from '@blume/storage-sqlite'

function createConversationViewSchema(db: DatabaseSync): void {
  db.exec(`
    PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

    CREATE TABLE sources (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      path TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_mtime_ms INTEGER,
      last_size INTEGER,
      last_byte_offset INTEGER,
      last_cursor TEXT,
      last_fetched_at INTEGER,
      UNIQUE (kind, path)
    );

    CREATE TABLE projects (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      path TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      git_remote TEXT,
      display_path TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE conversations (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      external_id TEXT,
      project_id INTEGER,
      source_id INTEGER,
      workspace TEXT,
      workspace_kind TEXT,
      cwd TEXT,
      branch TEXT,
      entrypoint TEXT,
      parent_thread_id TEXT,
      thread_source TEXT,
      subagent_kind TEXT,
      title TEXT,
      provider_title TEXT,
      title_source TEXT,
      preview TEXT,
      state TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_kind TEXT,
      started_at INTEGER,
      last_activity_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
      last_activity TEXT,
      dismissed_at INTEGER,
      state_override_turn_position INTEGER,
      ingested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE user_turns (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL,
      prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL,
      started_at INTEGER,
      ended_at INTEGER
    );

    CREATE TABLE tool_calls (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      event_id INTEGER,
      tool_use_id TEXT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      input_json TEXT,
      result_text TEXT,
      is_error INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      started_at_ms INTEGER,
      ended_at_ms INTEGER
    );

    CREATE TABLE todo_lists (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      user_turn_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      source_event_id INTEGER,
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      is_inferred INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE todos (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      list_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      state TEXT NOT NULL
    );
  `)
}

describe('agents list hydration', () => {
  test('shared storage batches list hydration and skips user turns unless requested', async () => {
    const db = new DatabaseSync(':memory:')
    createConversationViewSchema(db)
    const insertConversation = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO conversations (
        id, ref, source, state, last_activity_ts, ingested_at, created_at
      ) VALUES (?, ?, 'claude', 'running', ?, ?, ?)
    `)
    const insertTurn = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO user_turns (
        id, conversation_id, position, prompt, state, started_at
      ) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, 'running', ?)
    `)
    const insertToolCall = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO tool_calls (
        id, conversation_id, tool_use_id, name, input_json, is_error, started_at_ms
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Agent', ?, 0, ?)
    `)

    for (let id = 1; id <= 40; id++) {
      insertConversation.run(id, `claude:${id}`, id, id, id)
      insertTurn.run(id, id, `Prompt ${id}`, id)
      insertToolCall.run(
        id,
        id,
        `agent-${id}`,
        JSON.stringify({ description: `Research ${id}`, prompt: `Research ${id}` }),
        id
      )
    }

    const selectQueries: string[] = []
    const countedDb: SqlDatabase = {
      exec: (sql) => db.exec(sql),
      prepare(sql) {
        if (/^\s*SELECT\b/i.test(sql)) selectQueries.push(sql.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
        return db.prepare(sql)
      }
    }
    const storage = createDesktopSqliteStorage(countedDb, {
      improveNamespace: () => 'legacy-3-step-workflow'
    })

    const leanRows = await storage.desktopConversations.listConversationViewRecords({
      includeDismissed: true
    })

    expect(leanRows).toHaveLength(40)
    expect(leanRows.every((row) => row.userTurns.length === 0)).toBe(true)
    expect(leanRows.every((row) => row.toolCalls.length === 1)).toBe(true)
    expect(selectQueries).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(selectQueries.every((query) => !query.includes('conversation_id = ?'))).toBe(true)

    selectQueries.length = 0
    const fullRows = await storage.desktopConversations.listConversationViewRecords({
      includeDismissed: true,
      includeUserTurns: true
    })

    expect(fullRows.every((row) => row.userTurns.length === 1)).toBe(true)
    expect(selectQueries).toHaveLength(4)
    expect(selectQueries.every((query) => !query.includes('conversation_id = ?'))).toBe(true)
  })
})

import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

import {
  createDesktopAnnouncementsFacade,
  type DesktopAnnouncementsDeps
} from '../../src/main/announcements'

function createHarness(overrides: Partial<DesktopAnnouncementsDeps> = {}) {
  const handlers = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>()
  const copyText = vi.fn()
  const openExternal = vi.fn(async () => {})
  const fetch = vi.fn(async () => ({
    ok: true,
    status: 200,
    async json() {
      return { announcements: [] }
    }
  }))
  const facade = createDesktopAnnouncementsFacade({
    appVersion: () => '1.0.54',
    platform: 'darwin',
    channel: 'stable',
    fetch,
    copyText,
    openExternal,
    ...overrides
  })
  facade.registerIpcHandlers((channel, listener) => {
    handlers.set(channel, listener as (...args: unknown[]) => unknown)
  })
  return { handlers, fetch, copyText, openExternal }
}

describe('desktop announcements facade', () => {
  test('fetches the public auth proxy with the exact desktop target', async () => {
    const fetch = vi.fn(async () => ({
      ok: true,
      status: 200,
      async json() {
        return {
          announcements: [
            {
              id: 'recovery-1',
              title: 'Recovery',
              subtitle: 'Follow the recovery steps.',
              url: 'https://blume.codes/recovery'
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    }))
    const { handlers } = createHarness({ fetch })

    await expect(handlers.get('announcements:listActive')?.({})).resolves.toEqual([
      {
        id: 'recovery-1',
        title: 'Recovery',
        subtitle: 'Follow the recovery steps.',
        url: 'https://blume.codes/recovery'
      }
    ])
    const requestUrl = new URL(fetch.mock.calls[0][0])
    expect(requestUrl.origin).toBe('https://auth.blume.codes')
    expect(requestUrl.pathname).toBe('/v1/announcements/active')
    expect(Object.fromEntries(requestUrl.searchParams)).toEqual({
      platform: 'macos',
      channel: 'stable',
      appVersion: '1.0.54'
    })
    expect(fetch.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({ redirect: 'error' })
  })

  test('fails closed for redirects and malformed JSON', async () => {
    const redirect = createHarness({
      fetch: async () => ({ ok: false, status: 302, json: async () => ({}) })
    })
    await expect(redirect.handlers.get('announcements:listActive')?.({})).rejects.toThrow(
      'announcements request failed (302)'
    )

    const malformed = createHarness({
      fetch: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        json: async () => {
          throw new SyntaxError('not JSON')
        }
      })
    })
    await expect(malformed.handlers.get('announcements:listActive')?.({})).rejects.toThrow(
      'not JSON'
    )
  })

  test('treats an older control plane without the endpoint as no announcements', async () => {
    const missing = createHarness({
      fetch: async () => ({ ok: false, status: 404, json: async () => ({}) })
    })

    await expect(missing.handlers.get('announcements:listActive')?.({})).resolves.toEqual([])
  })

  test('copies prompts without executing them and opens only HTTPS URLs', async () => {
    const { handlers, copyText, openExternal } = createHarness()
    await handlers.get('announcements:copyPrompt')?.({}, 'Inspect these instructions first.')
    expect(copyText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Inspect these instructions first.')

    await handlers.get('announcements:openUrl')?.({}, 'https://blume.codes/recovery')
    expect(openExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://blume.codes/recovery')
    expect(() => handlers.get('announcements:openUrl')?.({}, 'http://example.com')).toThrow(
      'Announcement URLs must use HTTPS'
    )
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/application-menu-commands.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'
import { goMenuItems, menuAccelerator, sanitizeMenuCommands } from '../../src/main/nativeAppBootstrap'

describe('application menu commands', () => {
  test('the menu shows the same keys the app handles', () => {
    expect(menuAccelerator('Mod+1')).toBe('CmdOrCtrl+1')
    expect(menuAccelerator('Mod+Shift+F')).toBe('CmdOrCtrl+Shift+F')
    expect(menuAccelerator('Mod+[')).toBe('CmdOrCtrl+[')
    expect(menuAccelerator('Mod+,')).toBe('CmdOrCtrl+,')
    expect(menuAccelerator(undefined)).toBeUndefined()
    expect(menuAccelerator('Mod+<script>')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  test('a menu key press never runs the command; only a click does, so the app keeps its key rules', () => {
    const ran: string[] = []
    const [item] = goMenuItems([{ id: 'go./deliveries', label: 'Go to Deliveries', keys: 'Mod+1' }], (id) => ran.push(id))
    const click = (triggeredByAccelerator: boolean) =>
      item!.click!(item as never, undefined, { triggeredByAccelerator } as Electron.KeyboardEvent)
    click(true)
    expect(ran).toEqual([])
    click(false)
    expect(ran).toEqual(['go./deliveries'])
    expect(item).toMatchObject({ accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+1', registerAccelerator: false })
  })

  test('commands from the renderer are bounded and plain before they reach the menu', () => {
    expect(
      sanitizeMenuCommands([
        { id: 'go./deliveries', label: 'Go to Deliveries', keys: 'Mod+1', group: 'Go to' },
        { id: '', label: 'no id' },
        { id: 'x', label: 'y'.repeat(200) },
        'not an object',
        { id: 'page.find', label: 'Find on this page', keys: 42 }
      ])
    ).toEqual([
      { id: 'go./deliveries', label: 'Go to Deliveries', keys: 'Mod+1', group: 'Go to' },
      { id: 'page.find', label: 'Find on this page', keys: undefined, group: undefined }
    ])
    expect(sanitizeMenuCommands('nope')).toEqual([])
    expect(
      sanitizeMenuCommands(Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, n) => ({ id: `c${n}`, label: 'C' })))
    ).toHaveLength(60)
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/backend-manifest.test.ts">
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { test } from 'vitest'

import {
  applyStableBackendManifest,
  applyBundledBackendDefaults,
  bundledStableBackendManifest,
  OPTIONAL_STABLE_BACKEND_ENV,
  parseSelectedStableBackendManifest,
  stableBackendResponseError,
  StableVersionRetiredError,
  parseStableBackendManifest,
  STABLE_BACKEND_ENV
} from '../../src/main/backendManifest'
import {
  isStableBackendRetirementTombstone,
  readBackendManifestCacheFile,
  stableBackendRetirementTombstone,
  writeBackendManifestCacheFile
} from '../../src/main/backendManifestCache'

test('explicit development backend overrides survive bundled defaults but packaged defaults win', () => {
  const bundled = {
    BLUME_ROUTER_URL: 'https://signed.example',
    BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://auth.example'
  }
  const dev = { BLUME_ROUTER_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:8787' }
  applyBundledBackendDefaults(bundled, dev, false)
  assert.equal(dev.BLUME_ROUTER_URL, 'http://127.0.0.1:8787')
  assert.equal((dev as Record<string, string>).BLUME_AUTH_URL, 'https://auth.example')
  applyBundledBackendDefaults(bundled, dev, true)
  assert.equal(dev.BLUME_ROUTER_URL, 'https://signed.example')
})

test('selected stable manifest validation is delegated to the shared product contract', () => {
  const source = readFileSync(new URL('../../src/main/backendManifest.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
  assert.match(source, /validateStableBackendSelection[\s\S]*from '@blume\/insights-control'/)
  assert.match(source, /validateStableBackendSelection\(value, version, expectedBundleId\)/)
  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /expectedServices|components\?\.filter/)
})

test('retirement is terminal while unpublished and unavailable manifests remain retriable', () => {
  assert.ok(stableBackendResponseError(426, '1.2.3') instanceof StableVersionRetiredError)
  assert.equal(stableBackendResponseError(404, '1.2.3').message, 'HTTP 404')
})

test('bootstrap checks HTTP status before consuming a manifest response', () => {
  const source = readFileSync(
    new URL('../../src/main/backendManifestBootstrap.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8'
  )
  assert.match(
    source,
    /if \(!response\.ok\) throw stableBackendResponseError\(response\.status, version\)\s+const payload: unknown = await response\.json\(\)/
  )
  for (const status of [400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503]) {
    const error = stableBackendResponseError(status, '1.2.3')
    assert.equal(error.message, `HTTP ${status}`)
    assert.ok(!(error instanceof StableVersionRetiredError))
  }
})

test('persists identity-bound retirement and atomically replaces the desktop cache', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-desktop-backend-cache-'))
  const cachePath = join(directory, 'backend.json')
  try {
    await writeBackendManifestCacheFile(cachePath, { generation: 1 })
    await writeBackendManifestCacheFile(cachePath, { generation: 2 })
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(await readFile(cachePath, 'utf8')), { generation: 2 })
    assert.deepEqual(await readdir(directory), ['backend.json'])

    const tombstone = stableBackendRetirementTombstone('1.2.3', 'bundle-123')
    await writeBackendManifestCacheFile(`${cachePath}.retired`, tombstone)
    const persisted = await readBackendManifestCacheFile(`${cachePath}.retired`)
    assert.equal(isStableBackendRetirementTombstone(persisted, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'), true)
    assert.equal(isStableBackendRetirementTombstone(persisted, '1.2.3', 'other-bundle'), false)
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

function stableServiceUrl(name: string, backendDeploymentId: string): string {
  const worker =
    ({ userAnalytics: 'analytics', artifactSync: 'artifact-sync' } as Record<string, string>)[
      name
    ] ?? name
  const domain = name === 'llm' ? 'agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev' : 'release.blume-codes.com'
  return `https://blume-${worker}-${backendDeploymentId}.${domain}`
}

const canonicalServices: Record<string, string> = {
  auth: 'https://auth.blume-codes.com',
  feedback: 'https://feedback.blume-page.com',
  userAnalytics: 'https://analytics.blume-page.com',
  referrals: 'https://referrals.blume-page.com',
  insights: 'https://blume-insights-control.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev',
  llm: 'https://blume-llm-service.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev',
  router: 'https://router.blume-page.com'
}

function envelope(version = '1.2.3') {
  return {
    version,
    channel: 'stable',
    bundleId: 'bundle-123',
    manifest: {
      services: Object.fromEntries(
        Object.keys(STABLE_BACKEND_ENV).map((name) => [name, { url: canonicalServices[name] }])
      )
    }
  }
}

function selectedEnvelope(
  version = '1.2.3',
  backendDeploymentId = `bd-s-${version.replaceAll('.', '-')}-aaaaaaaaaaaa`
) {
  const value = envelope(version)
  const sourceSha = 'a'.repeat(40)
  const backendBundleId = `backend-${version}`
  value.manifest = {
    ...value.manifest,
    schemaVersion: 1,
    version,
    channel: 'stable',
    bundleId: backendBundleId,
    sourceSha
  }
  value.manifest.services = Object.fromEntries(
    [...Object.keys(STABLE_BACKEND_ENV), 'artifactSync'].map((name) => [
      name,
      { url: stableServiceUrl(name, backendDeploymentId) }
    ])
  )
  return {
    ...value,
    backendDeploymentId,
    backendBundleId,
    sourceSha,
    components: Object.entries(value.manifest.services).map(([name, service]) => ({
      name:
        name === 'userAnalytics'
          ? 'user-analytics'
          : name === 'artifactSync'
            ? 'artifact-sync'
            : name,
      url: service.url
    }))
  }
}

test('accepts only a complete exact-version stable backend manifest', () => {
  assert.equal(parseStableBackendManifest(envelope(), '1.2.3', 'bundle-123').bundleId, 'bundle-123')
  assert.throws(
    () => parseStableBackendManifest(envelope('1.2.4'), '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'),
    /does not match/
  )
  assert.throws(
    () => parseStableBackendManifest(envelope(), '1.2.3', 'different-bundle'),
    /does not match/
  )
  const missing = envelope()
  delete missing.manifest.services.auth
  assert.throws(() => parseStableBackendManifest(missing, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'), /missing auth/)
  const deceptive = envelope()
  deceptive.manifest.services.auth.url = 'http://attacker.test'
  assert.throws(() => parseStableBackendManifest(deceptive, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'), /missing auth/)
})

test('accepts a version-scoped backend hotfix while preserving the signed app bundle identity', () => {
  const hotfix = selectedEnvelope('1.2.3', 'bd-h-123-1')
  hotfix.backendBundleId = 'backend-hotfix-1.2.3-123-1'
  hotfix.manifest.bundleId = hotfix.backendBundleId
  const parsed = parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(hotfix, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123')
  assert.equal(parsed.bundleId, 'bundle-123')
  assert.equal(parsed.backendBundleId, 'backend-hotfix-1.2.3-123-1')
})

test('accepts the set LLM on its release hostname (blume-cloud) and its workers.dev host', () => {
  const id = 'bd-s-1-2-3-aaaaaaaaaaaa'
  for (const url of [
    `https://blume-llm-${id}.release.blume-codes.com`,
    `https://blume-llm-${id}.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev`
  ]) {
    const selected = selectedEnvelope('1.2.3', id)
    selected.manifest.services.llm.url = url
    selected.components.find((component) => component.name === 'llm')!.url = url
    const parsed = parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(selected, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123')
    assert.equal(parsed.manifest.services.llm.url, url)
  }
  for (const url of [
    `https://blume-llm-${id}.canary.blume-codes.com`,
    `https://blume-llm-bd-s-9-9-9-bbbbbbbbbbbb.release.blume-codes.com`,
    `https://blume-auth-${id}.release.blume-codes.com`
  ]) {
    const selected = selectedEnvelope('1.2.3', id)
    selected.manifest.services.llm.url = url
    selected.components.find((component) => component.name === 'llm')!.url = url
    assert.throws(() => parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(selected, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'), url)
  }
})

test('rejects registry payloads without full selected-deployment identity', () => {
  assert.throws(
    () => parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(envelope(), '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'),
    /missing its selected deployment identity/
  )
  const selected = selectedEnvelope()
  const artifactSync = selected.components.find((component) => component.name === 'artifact-sync')
  assert.ok(artifactSync)
  artifactSync.url = 'https://different.example.test'
  assert.throws(
    () => parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(selected, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'),
    /does not match artifact-sync/
  )

  const duplicated = selectedEnvelope()
  duplicated.components.push(duplicated.components[0])
  assert.throws(
    () => parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(duplicated, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'),
    /exactly one entry per service/
  )

  const extra = selectedEnvelope()
  extra.manifest.services.unexpected = { url: 'https://unexpected.example.test' }
  extra.components.push({ name: 'unexpected', url: 'https://unexpected.example.test' })
  assert.throws(
    () => parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(extra, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'),
    /exactly these services/
  )
})

  )

test('rejects hostile selected and cached fallback destinations before changing environment', () => {
  for (const url of [
    'https://attacker.example',
    'https://blume-auth-bd-s-1-2-3-aaaaaaaaaaaa.release.blume-codes.com:443',
    'https://auth.blume-codes.com?redirect=attacker',
    'https://auth.blume-codes.com#fragment'
  ]) {
    for (const value of [envelope(), selectedEnvelope()]) {
      value.manifest.services.auth.url = url
      if ('components' in value)
        value.components.find((component) => component.name === 'auth')!.url = url
      const env = { BLUME_AUTH_URL: canonicalServices.auth, BLUME_RELEASE_BUNDLE: 'original' }
      assert.throws(() =>
        applyStableBackendManifest(parseStableBackendManifest(value, '1.2.3', 'bundle-123'), env)
      )
      assert.deepEqual(env, {
        BLUME_AUTH_URL: canonicalServices.auth,
        BLUME_RELEASE_BUNDLE: 'original'
      })
    }
  }
})

test('signed fallback accepts generated stable origins as well as exact legacy service hosts', () => {

test('development preview selection fails closed when the source SHA cannot be resolved', () => {
  const launcher = readFileSync(
    new URL('../../scripts/previewEnvironment.mjs', import.meta.url),
    'utf8'
  )
  const branchLookup = launcher.indexOf('const branch = branchName()')

test('invalid cached stable manifests fall back to the embedded signed bundle', () => {

test('hybrid desktop selects the hosted Deliveries endpoint from its backend set', () => {

  const url = 'https://blume-dlv-runtime-bd-s-1-2-3-aaaaaaaaaaaa.release.blume-codes.com'

test('stable cloud keeps its signed origin while selected backend identity replaces the default', () => {
  const origin = 'https://blume-web-lab-release-1-2-3-aaaaaaaa.release.blume-codes.com'
  const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}
  applyBundledBackendDefaults(
    {
      BLUME_CLOUD_OWNER_URL: origin,
      BLUME_BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_ID: 'bd-s-1-2-3-aaaaaaaaaaaa'
    },
    env,
    true
  )
  // A registry outage retains the signed cloud pair when applying the embedded fallback.
  const fallback = bundledStableBackendManifest(
    '1.2.3',
    'bundle-123',
    Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(STABLE_BACKEND_ENV).map(([service, name]) => [
        name,
        canonicalServices[service]
      ])
    )
  )
  applyStableBackendManifest(fallback, env)
  assert.equal(env.BLUME_CLOUD_OWNER_URL, origin)
  assert.equal(env.BLUME_BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_ID, 'bd-s-1-2-3-aaaaaaaaaaaa')

  // Web Lab verifies this selected identity; an override must not send the baked ID.
  const selected = parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(
    selectedEnvelope('1.2.3', 'bd-h-123-1'),
    '1.2.3',
    'bundle-123'
  )
  applyStableBackendManifest(selected, env)
  assert.equal(env.BLUME_CLOUD_OWNER_URL, origin)
  assert.equal(env.BLUME_BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_ID, 'bd-h-123-1')
})

import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { test } from 'vitest'
import { StableVersionRetiredError } from '../../src/main/backendManifest'
import { reportBackendStartupFailure } from '../../src/main/backendStartupFailure'

test('retirement shows installer guidance before exit, without trusting server error text', () => {
  const events: string[] = []
  reportBackendStartupFailure(
    new StableVersionRetiredError('https://untrusted.example/download'),
    '1.2.3',
    (title, content) => {
      assert.equal(title, 'Update Blume to continue')
      assert.match(content, /Blume 1\.2\.3 is no longer supported/)
      assert.match(content, /https:\/\/updates\.blume-page\.com\/desktop\/stable\/download/)
      assert.match(content, /Keep your existing Blume data folder/)
      assert.doesNotMatch(content, /untrusted/)
      events.push('dialog')
    },
    (code) => events.push(`exit:${code}`)
  )
  assert.deepEqual(events, ['dialog', 'exit:1'])
})

test.each([new Error('https://untrusted.example/secret'), 'untrusted', { secret: 'untrusted' }])(
  'ordinary startup failures show trusted recovery guidance before exiting: %s',
  (error) => {
    const events: string[] = []
    reportBackendStartupFailure(
      error,
      '1.2.3',
      (title, content) => {
        assert.equal(title, 'Blume could not start')
        assert.match(content, /Try opening Blume again/)
        assert.match(content, /https:\/\/updates\.blume-page\.com\/desktop\/stable\/download/)
        assert.match(content, /Keep your existing Blume data folder/)
        assert.doesNotMatch(content, /untrusted|secret|no longer supported/)
        events.push('dialog')
      },
      (code) => events.push(`exit:${code}`)
    )
    assert.deepEqual(events, ['dialog', 'exit:1'])
  }
)

test.each([new StableVersionRetiredError(), new Error('unavailable')])(
  'dialog failure cannot allow startup to continue: %s',
  (error) => {
    let exited = false
    assert.throws(() =>
      reportBackendStartupFailure(
        error,
        '1.2.3',
        () => {
          throw new Error('native dialog unavailable')
        },
        () => {
          exited = true
        }
      )
    )
    assert.equal(exited, true)
  }
)

<file path="__test/regressions/blume-home.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import {
  getOrCreateBlumeDeviceIdAtRoot,
  isHarnessRunsPath,
  resolveBlumeRoot
} from '../../src/main/blume-home'

describe('resolveBlumeRoot', () => {
  it('keeps stable at the historical root and isolates canary', () => {
    const shared = {
      homeDir: '/Users/x',
      isDev: false,
      appPath: '/Applications/Blume.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar'
    }

    expect(resolveBlumeRoot({ ...shared, releaseChannel: 'stable' })).toBe('/Users/x/.blume')
    expect(resolveBlumeRoot({ ...shared, releaseChannel: 'canary' })).toBe(
      '/Users/x/.blume/.canary'
    )
  })

  it('gives dev checkout isolation precedence over the packaged channel', () => {
    expect(
      resolveBlumeRoot({
        homeDir: '/Users/x',
        isDev: true,
        releaseChannel: 'canary',
        appPath: '/Users/x/project/apps/desktop'
      })
    ).toBe('/Users/x/.blume/.dev/Users_x_project_apps_desktop')
  })
})

describe('shared physical device identity', () => {
  it('converges simultaneous installations on one exclusively-created id', async () => {
    const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-device-id-'))
    try {
      let next = 0
      const ids = await Promise.all(
        Array.from({ length: 8 }, () =>
          getOrCreateBlumeDeviceIdAtRoot(root, () => `device-${++next}-identity`)
        )
      )
      expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(1)
      expect(await getOrCreateBlumeDeviceIdAtRoot(root, () => 'device-never-used')).toBe(ids[0])
    } finally {
      await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
    }
  })
})

// Regression coverage for the insights recursion bug: harness runs spawned by
// one Blume instance are written to the GLOBAL `~/.claude` / `~/.codex` session
// stores and ingested by every instance. The matcher must recognize a
// harness-runs dir regardless of which instance's `getBlumeRoot` produced it
// (packaged root or any dev-sandbox slug), or self-runs leak into the
// conversations DB and get analyzed.
describe('isHarnessRunsPath', () => {
  it('matches the packaged root harnessruns dir', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harnessrunsqdfpv5')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harnessrunsqdfpv5/')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harnessrunsqdfpv5/sub/file.txt')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('still matches the legacy harness-runs dir (backward compatible)', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harness-runs')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harness-runs/')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harness-runs/sub/file.txt')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('matches a dev-sandbox harnessruns dir under ANY slug (cross-instance leak)', () => {
    expect(
      isHarnessRunsPath(
        '/Users/x/.blume/.dev/Users_x_sidecar-prototype_apps_desktop/harnessrunsqdfpv5'
      )
    ).toBe(true)
    expect(
      isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/.dev/some-other-worktree-slug/harnessrunsqdfpv5')
    ).toBe(true)
    // The legacy name is still recognized cross-instance too.
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/.dev/some-slug/harness-runs')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('matches the canary sandbox harnessruns dir', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/.canary/harnessrunsqdfpv5')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('normalizes Windows separators', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('C:\\Users\\x\\.blume\\harnessrunsqdfpv5')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('C:\\Users\\x\\.blume\\harness-runs')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('matches legacy blume probe cwd paths', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/tmp/blume-probe')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/tmp/blume-probe/sub/file.jsonl')).toBe(true)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/private/tmp/blume-probe')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('does not match real user conversations', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/sidecar-prototype')).toBe(false)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x')).toBe(false)
    // Legacy `harness-runs` carries no unique id, so a sibling must not match.
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('/Users/x/.blume/harness-runs-backup')).toBe(false)
    // NOTE: strings that merely CONTAIN the unique id (e.g.
    // `harnessrunsqdfpv5-backup`, or a slugified `.claude/projects/<slug>` name)
    // now match by design — the id is treated as a self-run identifier wherever
    // it appears. That's harmless: a real conversation cwd is never such a string.
  })

  it('handles empty / nullish input', () => {
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath(null)).toBe(false)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath(undefined)).toBe(false)
    expect(isHarnessRunsPath('')).toBe(false)
  })
})
</file>

    const processes = projectBlumeProcesses(snapshot())

    expect(processes.map((process) => process.label)).toEqual([
      'Claude suggestion agent',
      'Suggestions run',
      'Parser subprocess',
      'Parsing'
    ])
    expect(processes.map((process) => process.pid)).not.toContain(102)
    expect(processes.map((process) => process.pid)).not.toContain(202)
    expect(processes.map((process) => process.type)).toEqual([

      'suggestions',
      'parsing',
      'parsing'
    ])
  })

  test('keeps process-family relationships and bounded diagnostics for detail views', () => {
    const source = snapshot()
    const processes = projectBlumeProcesses(source)
    const suggestions = processes.find((process) => process.pid === 103)
    const parsing = processes.find((process) => process.pid === 101)

    expect(suggestions).toBeDefined()
    expect(parsing).toBeDefined()
    expect(relatedBlumeProcesses(processes, suggestions!.id).map((process) => process.pid)).toEqual(
      [201]
    )
    expect(relatedBlumeProcesses(processes, parsing!.id).map((process) => process.pid)).toEqual([
      203
    ])
    expect(projectBlumeProcessDiagnostics(source)).toEqual({
      appUptimeSec: 12,
      watcher: source.watcher
    })
  })

  test('separates Electron runtime roles from named Blume background workers', () => {
    const runtime = projectElectronRuntimeProcesses(snapshot())

      'Menu bar popover renderer',
      'GPU process',
      'Network service'
    ])

    expect(runtime.map((process) => process.pid)).not.toContain(103)
    expect(runtime[0]).toMatchObject({

      parentPid: null,
      activityMonitorName: 'Blume'
    })
    expect(runtime[1]).toMatchObject({
      parentPid: 100,

    })
    expect(runtime.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      label: 'Network service',
      activityMonitorName: 'Blume Helper'
    })
  })

  test('keeps resident utility workers visible but excludes idle hosts from active work', () => {
    const source = snapshot()
    source.backgroundProcesses = []
    source.externalProcesses = []
    const processes = projectBlumeProcesses(source)
    const records = mergeBlumeProcessRecords(
      [],
      processes,
      projectBlumeProcessDiagnostics(source),
      1_000
    )
    const split = splitBlumeProcessRecords(records)

    expect(processes.map((process) => process.label)).toEqual([
      'Suggestions worker',
      'Parsing worker'
    ])
    expect(processes.every((process) => !process.active)).toBe(true)
    expect(records.every((record) => record.status === 'idle')).toBe(true)
    expect(split.current).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(split.recent).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test('retains a bounded final snapshot after a process finishes', () => {

    const processes = projectBlumeProcesses(source)
    const first = mergeBlumeProcessRecords([], processes, diagnostics, 1_000)
    const withoutSuggestionAgent = processes.filter((process) => process.pid !== 201)
    const finished = mergeBlumeProcessRecords(first, withoutSuggestionAgent, diagnostics, 2_000)

describe('background process activity registry', () => {
  test('counts request lifecycles per utility service', () => {
    resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
    startBackgroundProcessRequest('blume-refresh-worker', 1)
    startBackgroundProcessRequest('blume-refresh-worker', 2)

    expect(getBackgroundProcessActivity()).toEqual([
      { serviceName: 'blume-refresh-worker', activeRequests: 2 }
    ])

    finishBackgroundProcessRequest('blume-refresh-worker', 1)
    finishBackgroundProcessRequest('blume-refresh-worker', 2)
    expect(getBackgroundProcessActivity()).toEqual([])
    expect(getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-refresh-worker')).toBe(0)
  })

  test('records successful app-requested worker terminations for later exit correlation', () => {
    resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
    const process = { kill: () => true }

    expect(terminateBackgroundProcess(process, 'blume-refresh-worker', 'idle')).toBe(true)
    expect(consumeBackgroundProcessTerminationIntent('blume-refresh-worker')).toBe('idle')
    expect(consumeBackgroundProcessTerminationIntent('blume-refresh-worker')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  test('correlates concurrent worker terminations by process instance', () => {
    resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
    const first = backgroundProcessServiceInstanceName('blume-project-path-resolution-worker', 1)
    const second = backgroundProcessServiceInstanceName('blume-project-path-resolution-worker', 2)
    const process = { kill: () => true }

    terminateBackgroundProcess(process, first, 'request-timeout')
    terminateBackgroundProcess(process, second, 'request-settled')

    expect(consumeBackgroundProcessTerminationIntent(second)).toBe('request-settled')
    expect(consumeBackgroundProcessTerminationIntent(first)).toBe('request-timeout')
    expect(getBlumeBackgroundProcessServiceName(second)).toBe(
      'blume-project-path-resolution-worker'
    )
  })

  test('does not record a termination intent when the worker was already gone', () => {
    resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
    const process = { kill: () => false }

    expect(terminateBackgroundProcess(process, 'blume-refresh-worker', 'dispose')).toBe(false)
    expect(consumeBackgroundProcessTerminationIntent('blume-refresh-worker')).toBeUndefined()
  })

  test('recognizes only Blume-owned utility service names', () => {
    expect(isBlumeBackgroundProcessService('blume-refresh-worker')).toBe(true)
    expect(isBlumeBackgroundProcessService('blume-project-path-resolution-worker')).toBe(true)
    expect(isBlumeBackgroundProcessService('blume-project-path-resolution-worker#42')).toBe(true)
    expect(isBlumeBackgroundProcessService('blume-terminal')).toBe(true)
    expect(isBlumeBackgroundProcessService('Network Service')).toBe(false)
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/careers.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

import { createDesktopCareersFacade } from '../../src/main/careers'

interface CareersHarness {
  handlers: Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>
  fetch: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
  openExternal: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
}

function harness(response: unknown = { openings: [] }): CareersHarness {
  const handlers = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>()
  const fetch = vi.fn(async () => Response.json(response))
  const openExternal = vi.fn(async () => {})
  createDesktopCareersFacade({ fetch, openExternal }).registerIpcHandlers((channel, listener) => {
    handlers.set(channel, listener)
  })
  return { handlers, fetch, openExternal }
}

describe('desktop careers facade', () => {
  test('loads the sanitized Blume careers feed without following redirects', async () => {
    const opening = {
      id: 'job-1',
      title: 'Founding engineer',
      pitch: 'Build Blume.',
      department: 'Engineering',
      location: 'Oslo',
      remoteStatus: 'hybrid',
      employmentType: 'Full time',
      jobUrl: 'https://jobs.blume.codes/jobs/job-1',
      applyUrl: 'https://jobs.blume.codes/jobs/job-1/apply'
    }
    const { handlers, fetch } = harness({ openings: [opening] })

    expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'https://blume.codes/api/careers/jobs',
      expect.objectContaining({ redirect: 'error' })
    )
  })

  test('opens only allow-listed Blume and Teamtailor destinations', async () => {
    const { handlers, openExternal } = harness()
    await handlers.get('careers:openOpening')?.({}, 'https://jobs.blume.codes/jobs/job-1')
    expect(openExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://jobs.blume.codes/jobs/job-1')
    await handlers.get('careers:openOpening')?.({}, 'https://blume-demo.teamtailor.com/jobs/job-1')
    expect(openExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://blume-demo.teamtailor.com/jobs/job-1')
    expect(() => handlers.get('careers:openOpening')?.({}, 'https://example.com/job')).toThrow(
      'Invalid career destination'
    )
  })
