<file path="__test/regressions/console-write-epipe-policy.test.ts">
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import {
  ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors,
  isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe
} from '../../src/main/consoleWriteEpipePolicy'

const SRC_MAIN = resolve(__dirname, '../../src/main')

function productionConsoleWriteEpipe(): Error {
  const error = new Error('write EPIPE') as NodeJS.ErrnoException
  error.code = 'EPIPE'
  error.errno = -32
  error.syscall = 'write'
  error.stack = [
    'Error: write EPIPE',
    '    at afterWriteDispatched (node:internal/stream_base_commons:159:15)',
    '    at writeGeneric (node:internal/stream_base_commons:150:3)',
    '    at Socket._writeGeneric (node:net:1026:11)',
    '    at Socket._write (node:net:1038:8)',
    '    at writeOrBuffer (node:internal/streams/writable:570:12)',
    '    at _write (node:internal/streams/writable:499:10)',
    '    at Writable.write (node:internal/streams/writable:508:10)',
    '    at console.value (node:internal/console/constructor:313:16)',
    '    at console.log (node:internal/console/constructor:416:26)',
    '    at console.log ([Path])'
  ].join('\n')
  return error
}

describe('console write EPIPE policy', () => {
  it('treats production console.log write EPIPE as expected non-fatal noise', () => {
    expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(productionConsoleWriteEpipe())).toBe(true)
  })

  it('treats message-only write EPIPE with a console stack as expected', () => {
    const error = new Error('write EPIPE')
    error.stack = [
      'Error: write EPIPE',
      '    at Writable.write (node:internal/streams/writable:508:10)',
      '    at console.warn (node:internal/console/constructor:416:26)'
    ].join('\n')

    expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(error)).toBe(true)
  })

  it('does not treat errno-code EPIPE with a stream-only write stack as expected', () => {
    // Stream/socket frames alone must not demote — child stdin / IPC EPIPE
    // shares those frames and must stay fatal.
    const error = new Error('broken pipe') as NodeJS.ErrnoException
    error.code = 'EPIPE'
    error.stack = [
      'Error: broken pipe',
      '    at afterWriteDispatched (node:internal/stream_base_commons:159:15)',
      '    at writeGeneric (node:internal/stream_base_commons:150:3)',
      '    at Writable.write (node:internal/streams/writable:508:10)'
    ].join('\n')

    expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(error)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not treat write EPIPE without a console stack as expected', () => {
    const error = new Error('write EPIPE') as NodeJS.ErrnoException
    error.code = 'EPIPE'
    error.stack = [
      'Error: write EPIPE',
      '    at Object.<anonymous> (/app/main/somethingElse.ts:10:5)'
    ].join('\n')

    expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(error)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not treat write EPIPE without a stack as expected', () => {
    const error = new Error('write EPIPE') as NodeJS.ErrnoException
    error.code = 'EPIPE'
    error.stack = undefined

    expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(error)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not swallow unrelated fatals', () => {
    const failures: unknown[] = [
      new Error('Renderer process gone'),
      Object.assign(new Error('ECONNRESET'), { code: 'ECONNRESET' }),
      Object.assign(new Error('read EPIPE'), {
        code: 'EPIPE',
        stack: 'Error: read EPIPE\n    at Socket.read (node:net:1:1)'
      }),
      'write EPIPE',
      null,
      undefined
    ]

    for (const failure of failures) {
      expect(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(failure)).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('attaches a no-op error listener on streams that have none', () => {
    const stream = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      listenerCount: (event: string) => number
    }
    const onSpy = vi.spyOn(stream, 'on')

    ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors([stream as unknown as NodeJS.WritableStream])

    expect(onSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('error', expect.any(Function))
    expect(stream.listenerCount('error')).toBe(1)

    // Second call skips when a listener is already present.
    ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors([stream as unknown as NodeJS.WritableStream])
    expect(stream.listenerCount('error')).toBe(1)
  })

  it('swallows EPIPE/EIO on stdio error and rethrows other codes', () => {
    const stream = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      listenerCount: (event: string) => number
    }
    const warn = vi.fn()

    ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors([stream as unknown as NodeJS.WritableStream], { warn })

    expect(() => {
      stream.emit('error', Object.assign(new Error('write EPIPE'), { code: 'EPIPE' }))
    }).not.toThrow()
    expect(() => {
      stream.emit('error', Object.assign(new Error('write EIO'), { code: 'EIO' }))
    }).not.toThrow()
    expect(warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

    const unexpected = Object.assign(new Error('write ENOSPC'), { code: 'ENOSPC' })
    expect(() => {
      stream.emit('error', unexpected)
    }).toThrow(unexpected)
    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'unexpected stdio stream error',
      expect.objectContaining({
        code: 'ENOSPC',
        error_name: 'Error',
        error_message: 'write ENOSPC'
      })
    )
  })

  it('wires the EPIPE guard into nativeLifecycle before fatal exit', () => {
    const lifecycle = readFileSync(resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'nativeLifecycle.ts'), 'utf8')

    expect(lifecycle).toContain('isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe')
    expect(lifecycle).toContain('ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors')
    expect(lifecycle).toMatch(
      /ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors\(\[process\.stdout, process\.stderr\], deps\.log\)/
    )
    expect(lifecycle).toContain("reporting_action: 'local_log_only'")
    expect(lifecycle).toContain('ignored expected console write EPIPE')
    expect(lifecycle).toMatch(
      /if \(isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe\(err\)\) \{[\s\S]*?return[\s\S]*?deps\.log\.fatal/
    )
  })
})

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const SRC_MAIN = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main')
const WORKER_ENTRY = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/actionWorker.ts')
const WORKER_HOST = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/actionHost.ts')
const NATIVE_IPC = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'nativeIpcRegistration.ts')
const BUILD_CONFIG = resolve(HERE, '../../electron.vite.config.ts')
const IMPORT_RE = /(?:from\s+|import\s*\(\s*|require\s*\(\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g

function resolveRelative(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null {
  const base = resolve(dirname(fromFile), spec)
  for (const candidate of [base, `${base}.ts`, resolve(base, 'index.ts')]) {
    if (candidate.endsWith('.ts') && existsSync(candidate)) return candidate
  }
  return null
}

function workerImportGraph(entry: string): { files: Set<string>; externals: Set<string> } {
  const files = new Set<string>()
  const externals = new Set<string>()
  const queue = [entry]
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const file = queue.pop()
    if (!file || files.has(file)) continue
    files.add(file)
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    for (const match of source.matchAll(IMPORT_RE)) {
      const spec = match[1]
      if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
        const imported = resolveRelative(file, spec)
        if (imported) queue.push(imported)
      } else {
        externals.add(spec)
      }
    }
  }
  return { files, externals }
}

describe('desktop conversation action worker policy', () => {
  test('routes scalable actions through a bundled utility worker without a main fallback', () => {
    const host = readFileSync(WORKER_HOST, 'utf8')
    const config = readFileSync(BUILD_CONFIG, 'utf8')

    expect(host).toContain('utilityProcess.fork')
    expect(host).toContain('WORKER_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS')
    expect(host).toContain('WORKER_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS')
    expect(host).toContain('serializedActions')
    expect(host).toContain(
      "if (disposed) throw new Error('Conversation action workers are disposed')"
    )
    expect(host).toContain('disposed = true')
    expect(host).not.toContain('openDesktopSqliteStorage')
    expect(host).not.toContain('git worktree add')
    expect(config).toContain("actionWorker: resolve('src/main/conversations/actionWorker.ts')")
  })

  test('keeps the action worker graph independent from Electron and its main adapter', () => {
    const { files, externals } = workerImportGraph(WORKER_ENTRY)

    expect(externals.has('electron')).toBe(false)
    expect(files.has(WORKER_HOST)).toBe(false)
    expect(files.has(WORKER_ENTRY)).toBe(true)
  })

  test('opens installed macOS editors by bundle id and reports open failures', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')

    expect(worker).toContain("'com.microsoft.VSCode'")
    expect(worker).toContain("'dev.zed.Zed'")
    expect(worker).toContain("await runProcess('open', ['-b', bundleId, path]")
    expect(worker).not.toContain("process.platform === 'darwin') await runProcess('open'")
  })

  test('reveals explicit files through the same utility worker before opening storage', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')
    const nativeIpc = readFileSync(NATIVE_IPC, 'utf8')
    const explicitFileAction = worker.indexOf("input.action === 'open-file'")
    const storageOpen = worker.indexOf('openDesktopSqliteStorage(input.dbPath)')

    expect(explicitFileAction).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(explicitFileAction).toBeLessThan(storageOpen)
    expect(worker).toContain("await runProcess('open', ['-R', path]")
    expect(worker).toContain("await runProcess('explorer.exe', [`/select,${path}`]")
    expect(worker).not.toContain('function spawnDetached(')
    expect(nativeIpc).toContain("handleIpc('system:openFileLocation'")
    expect(nativeIpc).toContain("runConversationAction({ action: 'open-file', path, target })")
    expect(worker).toContain("input.action === 'open-folder'")
    expect(worker).toContain(
      "await openLocation(await nearestExistingFolder(input.path), 'finder')"
    )
    expect(nativeIpc).toContain("handleIpc('system:openFolderLocation'")
    expect(nativeIpc).toContain("runConversationAction({ action: 'open-folder', path })")
  })

  test('uses the shared injection-safe Windows spawn plan for the VS Code command shim', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')

    expect(worker).toContain("win32SpawnPlan('code.cmd', [path], process.env.ComSpec)")
    expect(worker).toContain('windowsVerbatimArguments: plan.windowsVerbatimArguments')
    expect(worker).not.toContain('BLUME_OPEN_PATH')
  })

  test('runs and reports every rollback step when session creation fails', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')

    expect(worker).toMatch(/unlink\(continuation\.sourcePath\)/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/'worktree',[\s\S]*'remove',[\s\S]*'--force'/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/'branch',[\s\S]*'-D',[\s\S]*continuation\.branch/)
    expect(worker).toContain('Failed to remove conversation source during rollback')
    expect(worker).toContain('Failed to remove conversation worktree during rollback')
    expect(worker).toContain('Failed to delete conversation branch during rollback')
    expect(worker).not.toContain("if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error")
    expect(worker).toContain('prepareConversationContinuation(')
  })

  test('keeps worker-owned storage open until continuation preparation settles', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')

    expect(worker).toContain('return await prepareConversationContinuation(')
    expect(worker).toMatch(
      /return await prepareConversationContinuation\([\s\S]*finally \{\s*handle\.close\(\)/
    )
  })

  test('waits for timed-out child processes and escalates termination once', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(WORKER_ENTRY, 'utf8')

    expect(worker).toContain("child.kill('SIGTERM')")
    expect(worker).toContain("child.kill('SIGKILL')")

  })

  test('ingests continued conversations without launching a harness or terminal', () => {

    expect(continuation).toContain('return continueConversation(ref, target)')
    expect(continuation).not.toContain('conversationRuntime.resume')
  })

<file path="__test/regressions/conversation-list-worker-host.test.ts">
import { afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const handlers = {
    message: null as null | ((message: unknown) => void),
    exit: null as null | (() => void)
  }
  const worker = {
    on: vi.fn((event: string, handler: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
      if (event === 'message') handlers.message = handler as (message: unknown) => void
      if (event === 'exit') handlers.exit = handler as () => void
      return worker
    }),
    postMessage: vi.fn(),
    kill: vi.fn(() => true)
  }
  return {
    handlers,
    worker,
    fork: vi.fn(() => worker),
    getStorage: vi.fn(() => {
      throw new Error('Electron main must not read the conversation list')
    }),
    captureAppError: vi.fn(async () => undefined),
    startBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    finishBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    clearBackgroundProcessRequests: vi.fn(),
    terminateBackgroundProcess: vi.fn((process: { kill: () => boolean }) => process.kill())
  }
})

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db', () => ({ getDbPath: () => '/tmp/blume-list-test.sqlite' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db/storage', () => ({ getStorage: mocks.getStorage }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/backgroundProcessActivity', () => ({
  BLUME_BACKGROUND_PROCESS_SERVICES: { conversationList: 'blume-conversation-list-worker' },
  startBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest,
  finishBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest,
  clearBackgroundProcessRequests: mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests,
  terminateBackgroundProcess: mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess
}))
vi.mock('../../src/main/telemetry', () => ({ captureAppError: mocks.captureAppError }))

type ListHost = typeof import('../../src/main/conversations/listHost')

async function loadHost(): Promise<ListHost> {
  return import('../../src/main/conversations/listHost')
}

interface PostedRequest {
  type: string
  id: number
  dbPath: string
  options: Record<string, unknown>
}

function posted(): PostedRequest[] {
  return mocks.worker.postMessage.mock.calls.map((call) => call[0] as PostedRequest)
}

function answer(id: number, items: unknown[] = [{ ref: `row-${id}` }]): void {
  mocks.handlers.message?.({ type: 'list-for-view-result', id, ok: true, items, queryMs: 3 })
}

describe('conversation list worker host', { timeout: 15_000 }, () => {
  // Transform the shared package graph before timing individual worker behavior.
  beforeAll(async () => {
    await loadHost()
  }, 180_000)
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules()
    mocks.handlers.message = null
    mocks.handlers.exit = null
    mocks.fork.mockReset()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => mocks.worker)
    mocks.worker.on.mockClear()
    mocks.worker.postMessage.mockReset()
    mocks.worker.kill.mockClear()
    mocks.getStorage.mockClear()
    mocks.captureAppError.mockClear()
    mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests.mockClear()
    mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess.mockClear()
  })

  afterEach(async () => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
    ;(await loadHost()).disposeConversationListWorker()
  })

  it('reads transcripts off main with normalized options and fresh coalesced follow-up', async () => {
    const { getTranscriptViaWorker } = await loadHost()
    const first = getTranscriptViaWorker('claude:session', { limit: 1e9, beforeTurnPosition: 8 })
    const second = getTranscriptViaWorker('claude:session', { limit: 1e9, beforeTurnPosition: 8 })
    expect(posted()).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(posted()[0]).toMatchObject({
      type: 'transcript',
      ref: 'claude:session',
      options: { limit: 25, beforeTurnPosition: 8 }
    })
    const result = { userTurns: [{ id: 1 }] }
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'transcript-result',
      id: posted()[0].id,
      ok: true,
      transcript: result,
      queryMs: 4
    })
    expect(await first).toEqual(result)
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(posted()).toHaveLength(2))
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'transcript-result',
      id: posted()[1].id,
      ok: true,
      transcript: null,
      queryMs: 4
    })
    expect(await second).toBeNull()
    expect(mocks.getStorage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('fails transcript reads on worker timeout without main-process fallback', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const host = await loadHost()
    const read = host.getTranscriptViaWorker('claude:session')
    const rejected = expect(read).rejects.toThrow(host.CONVERSATION_LIST_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE)
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(host.CONVERSATION_LIST_TIMEOUT_MS)
    await rejected
    expect(mocks.worker.kill).toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.getStorage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('sends normalized, bounded options to one warm worker and returns its rows', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()

    const first = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({
      sinceMs: 1_700_000_000_123,
      limit: 1e9,
      bogus: 'dropped'
    })
    expect(posted()).toEqual([
      {
        type: 'list-for-view',
        id: 1,
        dbPath: '/tmp/blume-list-test.sqlite',
        options: { sinceMs: 1_700_000_000_000, limit: 2_000 }
      }
    ])
    answer(1)
    await expect(first).resolves.toEqual([{ ref: 'row-1' }])

    const second = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ state: ['running'] })
    answer(posted()[1].id)
    await second
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.getStorage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('cancels abandoned follow-ups while keeping another consumer alive', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()
    const first = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 10 })
    const gone = new AbortController()
    const cancelled = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 10 }, gone.signal)
    const cancellation = expect(cancelled).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' })
    const survivor = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 10 })
    gone.abort()
    await cancellation
    expect(mocks.worker.kill).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    answer(posted()[0].id)
    await first
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(posted()).toHaveLength(2))
    answer(posted()[1].id)
    await survivor

    const active = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 20 })
    const queuedAbort = new AbortController()
    const queued = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 20 }, queuedAbort.signal)
    const rejected = expect(queued).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' })
    queuedAbort.abort()
    await rejected
    answer(posted()[2].id)
    await active
    await Promise.resolve()
    expect(posted()).toHaveLength(3)
  })

  it('stops work only when no active consumer remains, without a failure cooldown', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker, getConversationListWorkerStats } = await loadHost()
    const a = new AbortController()
    const b = new AbortController()
    const readA = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 1 }, a.signal)
    const readB = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 2 }, b.signal)
    const rejectedA = expect(readA).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' })
    const rejectedB = expect(readB).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'AbortError' })
    a.abort()
    await rejectedA
    expect(mocks.worker.kill).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    b.abort()
    await rejectedB
    expect(mocks.worker.kill).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(getConversationListWorkerStats().failures).toBe(0)
    const next = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 3 })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    answer(posted()[2].id)
    await next
  })

  it('coalesces equal requests and runs one fresh follow-up for requests that arrive meanwhile', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker, getConversationListWorkerStats } = await loadHost()

    const a = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ state: 'running' })
    const b = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ state: 'running' })
    const c = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ state: 'running' })
    // Only the first request reaches the worker; b and c share one read that starts after it.
    expect(posted()).toHaveLength(1)
    answer(posted()[0].id, [{ ref: 'before-change' }])
    await expect(a).resolves.toEqual([{ ref: 'before-change' }])
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(posted()).toHaveLength(2))
    answer(posted()[1].id, [{ ref: 'after-change' }])
    await expect(b).resolves.toEqual([{ ref: 'after-change' }])
    await expect(c).resolves.toEqual([{ ref: 'after-change' }])
    expect(getConversationListWorkerStats()).toMatchObject({ requests: 3, coalesced: 2 })

    // Distinct requests are not merged.
    const project = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 1, limit: 5 })
    const other = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 2, limit: 5 })
    expect(posted()).toHaveLength(4)
    answer(posted()[2].id)
    answer(posted()[3].id)
    await Promise.all([project, other])
  })

  it('fails a stuck read, stops the worker and cools down without running the query on main', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date', 'setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] })
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()

    const pending = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({})
    const expectation = expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationListWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'conversation list worker timed out'
    })
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(15_000)
    await expectation
    expect(mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      mocks.worker,
      'blume-conversation-list-worker',
      'request-timeout'
    )
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'main.conversations.list_worker_unavailable',
      expect.any(Error),
      { phase: 'timeout', main_process_fallback: false }
    )

    await expect(listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 1 })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      message: 'conversation list worker circuit breaker is cooling down'
    })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.getStorage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60_000)
    const retried = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 1 })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    answer(posted().at(-1)!.id)
    await retried
  })

  it('rejects when the worker cannot start and reports it once per cooldown', async () => {
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('utility process unavailable')
    })
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()

    await expect(listConversationsForViewViaWorker({})).rejects.toThrow(
      'utility process unavailable'
    )
    await expect(listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 3 })).rejects.toThrow(
      'circuit breaker is cooling down'
    )
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.getStorage).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('keeps the worker warm after a query error and fails reads pending when it exits', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()

    const failing = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({})
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'list-for-view-result',
      id: posted()[0].id,
      ok: false,
      errorMessage: 'no such column',
      errorName: 'SqliteError'
    })
    await expect(failing).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'SqliteError', message: 'no such column' })
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()

    const orphaned = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ limit: 9 })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()
    await expect(orphaned).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationListWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'conversation list worker exited with reads pending'
    })
  })

  it('bounds the number of reads waiting on the worker', async () => {
    const { listConversationsForViewViaWorker, MAX_PENDING_CONVERSATION_LISTS } = await loadHost()

    const reads = Array.from({ length: MAX_PENDING_CONVERSATION_LISTS }, (_, projectId) =>
      listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId })
    )
    await expect(listConversationsForViewViaWorker({ projectId: 999 })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      message: 'conversation list worker is busy'
    })
    expect(posted()).toHaveLength(MAX_PENDING_CONVERSATION_LISTS)
    for (const request of posted()) answer(request.id)
    await Promise.all(reads)
  })

  it('settles waiting reads on quit without reporting app errors', async () => {
    const { disposeConversationListWorker, listConversationsForViewViaWorker } = await loadHost()

    const pending = listConversationsForViewViaWorker({})
    disposeConversationListWorker()

    await expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationListWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'conversation list worker disposed'
    })
    expect(mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      mocks.worker,
      'blume-conversation-list-worker',
      'dispose'
    )
    expect(mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'blume-conversation-list-worker'
    )
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    await expect(listConversationsForViewViaWorker({})).rejects.toThrow(
      'conversation list worker disposed'
    )
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })
})

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const DESKTOP = resolve(HERE, '../..')
const SRC_MAIN = resolve(DESKTOP, 'src/main')
const CONVERSATION_RUNTIME = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/index.ts')
const LIST_HOST = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/listHost.ts')
const LIST_WORKER = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/listWorker.ts')
const MAIN_INDEX = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'index.ts')
const VITE_CONFIG = resolve(DESKTOP, 'electron.vite.config.ts')

const FORBIDDEN_EXTERNALS = new Set(['electron', '@electron-toolkit/utils'])
const FORBIDDEN_FILES = new Set(
  [
    'telemetry.ts',
    'perf.ts',
    'settingsStore.ts',
    'metaStore.ts',
    'blume-home.ts',
    'db/index.ts',
    'db/storage.ts',
    'conversations/index.ts',
    'conversations/listHost.ts',
    'conversations/refreshHost.ts',
    'conversations/providerHost.ts',
    'conversations/parserBinding.ts',
    'conversations/watch.ts'
  ].map((rel) => resolve(SRC_MAIN, rel))
)

const IMPORT_RE = /(?:from\s+|import\s*\(\s*|require\s*\(\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g

function walkImportGraph(entry: string): { files: Set<string>; externals: Set<string> } {
  const files = new Set<string>()
  const externals = new Set<string>()
  const queue = [entry]
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const file = queue.pop()
    if (!file || files.has(file)) continue
    files.add(file)
    for (const match of readFileSync(file, 'utf8').matchAll(IMPORT_RE)) {
      const spec = match[1]
      if (!spec.startsWith('.')) {
        externals.add(spec)
        continue
      }
      const base = resolve(dirname(file), spec)
      const resolved = [base, `${base}.ts`, resolve(base, 'index.ts')].find(
        (candidate) => candidate.endsWith('.ts') && existsSync(candidate)
      )
      if (resolved) queue.push(resolved)
    }
  }
  return { files, externals }
}

describe('conversation view list stays off Electron main', () => {
  test('db:conversations:listForView is served by the conversation list utility process', () => {
    const runtime = readFileSync(CONVERSATION_RUNTIME, 'utf8')
    const host = readFileSync(LIST_HOST, 'utf8')

    expect(runtime).toContain('return listConversationsForViewViaWorker(opts)')
    expect(runtime).toContain('return getTranscriptViaWorker(ref, opts)')
    expect(runtime).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.getTranscript(')
    expect(runtime).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.listConversationsForView')
    expect(host).toContain("utilityProcess.fork(join(__dirname, 'listWorker.js')")
    // No main-process fallback: the host never opens SQLite, reaches main storage or runs the read.
    for (const forbidden of [
      'getStorage',
      'openDesktopSqlite',
      'listConversationViewRecords',
      'loadConversationListItemsForView',
      'gitBranchLabel',
      'better-sqlite3'
    ]) {
      expect(host).not.toContain(forbidden)
    }
  })

  test('the worker is Electron-free, query-only and owns the branch-label filesystem reads', () => {
    const worker = readFileSync(LIST_WORKER, 'utf8')
    const { files, externals } = walkImportGraph(LIST_WORKER)

    expect([...externals].filter((spec) => FORBIDDEN_EXTERNALS.has(spec))).toEqual([])
    expect([...files].filter((file) => FORBIDDEN_FILES.has(file))).toEqual([])
    expect(worker).toContain('openDesktopSqliteConversationReads(')
    expect(worker).not.toContain('openDesktopSqliteStorage')
    expect(worker).toContain('loadConversationListItemsForView(')
    expect(worker).toContain('gitBranchLabel')

    const sqliteStorage = readFileSync(resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'db/sqliteStorage.ts'), 'utf8')
    const opener = sqliteStorage.slice(
      sqliteStorage.indexOf('export function openDesktopSqliteConversationReads'),
      sqliteStorage.indexOf('export function openDesktopSignalAnalyticsStorage')
    )
    expect(opener).toContain('readonly: true')
    expect(opener).toContain('fileMustExist: true')
    expect(opener).toContain("db.pragma('query_only = ON')")
    expect(opener).not.toContain('runDesktopMigrations')
    expect(opener).not.toContain('journal_mode = WAL')
  })

  test('the worker is built as its own entry and stopped on quit', () => {
    expect(readFileSync(VITE_CONFIG, 'utf8')).toContain(
      "listWorker: resolve('src/main/conversations/listWorker.ts')"
    )
    const main = readFileSync(MAIN_INDEX, 'utf8')
    const quit = main.slice(main.indexOf('prepareNativeWindowsForQuit'))
    expect(quit).toContain('disposeConversationListWorker()')
  })
})

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const state = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  posted: [] as unknown[],
  onMessage: null as null | ((event: { data: unknown }) => void),
  openedPaths: [] as string[],
  listOptions: [] as unknown[],
  branchReads: [] as string[],
  records: [] as unknown[],
  transcript: null as unknown,
  transcriptOptions: [] as unknown[]
}))

vi.mock('../../src/main/db/sqliteStorage', () => ({
  openDesktopSqliteConversationReads: (path: string) => {
    state.openedPaths.push(path)
    return {
      sourceCursors: { getSourceCursor: async () => null },
      conversations: {
        getConversationTranscriptByRef: async (ref: string, options: unknown) => {
          state.transcriptOptions.push({ ref, options })
          return state.transcript
        },
        listConversationViewRecords: async (options: unknown) => {
          state.listOptions.push(options)
          return state.records
        }
      },
      close: () => undefined
    }
  },
  openDesktopSqliteStorage: () => {
    throw new Error('the conversation list worker must open the database query-only')
  }
}))
vi.mock('@blume/projects-identity/node', () => ({
  gitBranchLabel: (cwd: string) => {
    state.branchReads.push(cwd)
    return 'feature/list-worker'
  }
}))

function codexWorktreeRecord(id: number): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    conversation: {
      id,
      ref: `codex:${id}`,
      source: 'codex',
      external_id: null,
      thread_source: null,
      cwd: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/abcd/blume',
      workspace: null,
      workspace_kind: null,
      project_id: null,
      last_activity: null,
      last_activity_ts: id
    },
    project: null,
    activeTodos: [],
    toolCalls: [],
    userTurns: [],
    codexChildConversations: []
  }
}

async function request(id: number, options: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  const before = state.posted.length
  state.onMessage?.({
    data: { type: 'list-for-view', id, dbPath: '/tmp/blume-list.sqlite', options }
  })
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(state.posted.length).toBe(before + 1))
  return state.posted.at(-1)
}

describe('conversation list worker', () => {
  const originalParentPort = (process as { parentPort?: unknown }).parentPort

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ;(process as { parentPort?: unknown }).parentPort = {
      on: (event: string, handler: (event: { data: unknown }) => void) => {
        if (event === 'message') state.onMessage = handler
      },
      postMessage: (message: unknown) => state.posted.push(message)
    }
    // Compile the shared package graph before timing worker behavior.
    await import('../../src/main/conversations/listWorker')
  }, 180_000)

  afterAll(() => {
    ;(process as { parentPort?: unknown }).parentPort = originalParentPort
  })

  it('answers view-list reads from its query-only handle with shared projections', async () => {
    state.records = [codexWorktreeRecord(1), codexWorktreeRecord(2)]

    const result = (await request(7, { sinceMs: 1_000, limit: 2_000 })) as {
      type: string
      id: number
      ok: boolean
      items: Array<{ ref: string; workspace: string | null }>
    }

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ type: 'list-for-view-result', id: 7, ok: true })
    expect(result.items.map((item) => item.ref)).toEqual(['codex:1', 'codex:2'])
    expect(state.openedPaths).toEqual(['/tmp/blume-list.sqlite'])
    expect(state.listOptions).toEqual([{ sinceMs: 1_000, limit: 2_000 }])
    // Both rows share a worktree: HEAD is read once and cached for the next read too.
    expect(state.branchReads).toEqual(['/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/abcd/blume'])

    await request(8, { limit: 5 })
    expect(state.openedPaths).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(state.branchReads).toHaveLength(1)
  })

  it('reports a failed read as that request’s error', async () => {
    state.records = null as unknown as unknown[]
    const result = await request(9, {})
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ type: 'list-for-view-result', id: 9, ok: false })
  })

  it('returns native transcript pages and rejects oversized replies inside the worker', async () => {
    const send = async (id: number): Promise<unknown> => {
      const before = state.posted.length
      state.onMessage?.({
        data: {
          type: 'transcript',
          id,
          dbPath: '/tmp/blume-list.sqlite',
          ref: 'claude:session',
          options: { limit: 6 }
        }
      })
      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(state.posted.length).toBe(before + 1))
      return state.posted.at(-1)
    }
    state.transcript = {
      conversation: { source: 'claude' },
      pagination: { hasMoreAfter: true },
      events: []
    }
    expect(await send(10)).toMatchObject({
      type: 'transcript-result',
      id: 10,
      ok: true,
      transcript: state.transcript
    })
    expect(state.transcriptOptions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      ref: 'claude:session',
      options: { limit: 6 }
    })
    state.transcript = { ...(state.transcript as object), text: 'x'.repeat(17 * 1024 * 1024) }
    expect(await send(11)).toMatchObject({
      type: 'transcript-result',
      id: 11,
      ok: false,
      errorMessage: 'Conversation page exceeds the background read limit'
    })
  })

  it('re-reads a branch label once its short cache entry expires', async () => {
    const { cachedBranchLabel, CONVERSATION_LIST_BRANCH_LABEL_TTL_MS } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/listWorker')
    const read = vi.fn(() => 'main')
    expect(cachedBranchLabel('/repo/a', 0, read)).toBe('main')
    expect(cachedBranchLabel('/repo/a', CONVERSATION_LIST_BRANCH_LABEL_TTL_MS - 1, read)).toBe(
      'main'
    )
    expect(read).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    cachedBranchLabel('/repo/a', CONVERSATION_LIST_BRANCH_LABEL_TTL_MS, read)
    expect(read).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import { CLAUDE_CANONICAL_PARSING_STOPPED_MESSAGE } from '@blume/app-core'

import {
  CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE,
  CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISABLED_MESSAGE,
  CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE,
  CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_MENU_SNAPSHOT_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE,
  CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE,
  ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError,
  isConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError,
  isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerOperationalError,
  isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerShutdownError,
  shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError
} from '../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost'

describe('conversation refresh worker operational error policy', () => {
  it('classifies unresponsive, dispose, disable, and circuit-breaker as expected', () => {
    const errors = [
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
        CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE
      ),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
        CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_MENU_SNAPSHOT_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE
      ),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISABLED_MESSAGE),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
        CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE
      )
    ]

    for (const error of errors) {
      expect(isConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(error)).toBe(true)
      expect(isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(true)
      expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(error)).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('keeps dispose-on-quit as the only expected shutdown rejection', () => {
    const dispose = new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
      CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE
    )
    expect(isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerShutdownError(dispose)).toBe(true)

    const operationalButNotShutdown = [
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
        CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE
      ),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_DISABLED_MESSAGE),
      new ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError(
        CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE
      )
    ]
    for (const error of operationalButNotShutdown) {
      expect(isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerShutdownError(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(isExpectedConversationRefreshWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  it('does not report cooperative Claude canonical parse-stop as a refresh app error', () => {
    const stop = new Error(CLAUDE_CANONICAL_PARSING_STOPPED_MESSAGE)
    const stackInMessage = new Error(
      `Error: ${CLAUDE_CANONICAL_PARSING_STOPPED_MESSAGE}\n` +
        '    at summarizeClaudeSessionConversation (refreshWorker.js:1:1)\n' +
        '    at async runRefreshQueue (refreshWorker.js:2:1)'
    )

    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(stop)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(stackInMessage)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not report parser-temp ENOSPC as a refresh app error', () => {
    const enospc = new Error(
      "ENOSPC: no space left on device, mkdtemp '/var/folders/sy/czv8m_m56dv1fj4jh8m6_ffw0000gn/T/blume-parser-output-XXXXXX'"
    )
    const stackInMessage = new Error(
      "Error: ENOSPC: no space left on device, mkdtemp '/var/folders/sy/czv8m_m56dv1fj4jh8m6_ffw0000gn/T/blume-parser-output-XXXXXX'\n" +
        '    at Object.mkdtempSync (node:fs:3050:18)\n' +
        '    at Object.parse (rustBinding.node.js:585:33)'
    )
    const openMasked = new Error("ENOSPC: no space left on device, open '[Path]'")
    const openMaskedStack = new Error(
      "Error: ENOSPC: no space left on device, open '[Path]'\n" +
        '    at Object.openSync (node:fs:561:18)\n' +
        '    at parseCursorSessionWithBinding (providerHostFactory.js:3854:38)\n' +
        '    at async forwardTelemetry (refreshHost.ts:317:5)'
    )
    const openParserOutput = new Error(
      "ENOSPC: no space left on device, open '/tmp/blume-parser-output-abcd/parser-output.json'"
    )

    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(enospc)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(stackInMessage)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(openMasked)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(openMaskedStack)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(openParserOutput)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not report harness-parser stdout ENOSPC exit as a refresh app error', () => {
    const clean = new Error(
      'harness-parser exited 101: \n' +
        "thread 'main' (198982266) panicked at [Path]:1165:9:\n" +
        'failed printing to stdout: No space left on device (os error 28)\n' +
        'note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace\n'
    )

<file path="__test/regressions/conversation-refresh-worker-electron-free.test.ts">
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const SRC_MAIN = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main')
const WORKER_ENTRY = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'conversations/refreshWorker.ts')

const FORBIDDEN_EXTERNALS = new Set(['electron', '@electron-toolkit/utils'])
const FORBIDDEN_FILES = new Set(
  [
    'telemetry.ts',
    'perf.ts',
    'settingsStore.ts',
    'metaStore.ts',
    'blume-home.ts',
    'legacyOverrides.ts',
    'db/index.ts',
    'db/storage.ts',
    'conversations/index.ts',
    'conversations/providerHost.ts',
    'conversations/parserBinding.ts',
    'conversations/watch.ts',
    'conversations/resume.ts'
  ].map((rel) => resolve(SRC_MAIN, rel))
)

const IMPORT_RE = /(?:from\s+|import\s*\(\s*|require\s*\(\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g

function resolveRelative(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null {
  const base = resolve(dirname(fromFile), spec)
  for (const candidate of [base, `${base}.ts`, resolve(base, 'index.ts')]) {
    if (candidate.endsWith('.ts') && existsSync(candidate)) return candidate
  }
  return null
}

function walkImportGraph(entry: string): { files: Set<string>; externals: Set<string> } {
  const files = new Set<string>()
  const externals = new Set<string>()
  const queue = [entry]
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const file = queue.pop()
    if (!file || files.has(file)) continue
    files.add(file)
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    for (const match of source.matchAll(IMPORT_RE)) {
      const spec = match[1]
      if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
        const resolved = resolveRelative(file, spec)
        if (resolved) queue.push(resolved)
      } else {
        externals.add(spec)
      }
    }
  }
  return { files, externals }
}

describe('conversation refresh worker import graph', () => {
  test('stays independent from Electron and desktop main process adapters', () => {
    const { files, externals } = walkImportGraph(WORKER_ENTRY)

    expect(
      [...externals].filter((spec) => FORBIDDEN_EXTERNALS.has(spec)),
      'forbidden external imports in refresh worker graph'
    ).toEqual([])
    expect(
      [...files].filter((file) => FORBIDDEN_FILES.has(file)),
      'forbidden desktop main modules in refresh worker graph'
    ).toEqual([])
    expect(files.has(WORKER_ENTRY)).toBe(true)
  })
})

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const handlers = {
    message: null as null | ((message: unknown) => void),
    exit: null as null | (() => void)
  }
  const worker = {
    on: vi.fn((event: string, handler: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
      if (event === 'message') handlers.message = handler as (message: unknown) => void
      if (event === 'exit') handlers.exit = handler as () => void
      return worker
    }),
    postMessage: vi.fn(),
    kill: vi.fn()
  }
  return {
    handlers,
    worker,
    fork: vi.fn(() => worker),
    captureAppError: vi.fn(async () => undefined),
    captureTelemetryEvent: vi.fn(async () => true),
    startBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    finishBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    clearBackgroundProcessRequests: vi.fn(),
    terminateBackgroundProcess: vi.fn((process: { kill: () => boolean }) => process.kill())
  }
})

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/blume-home', () => ({ getBlumeRoot: () => '/tmp/blume-root' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db', () => ({ getDbPath: () => '/tmp/blume-refresh-test.sqlite' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/conversations/parserBinding', () => ({
  getHarnessParserBinaryPath: () => '/tmp/parser'
}))
vi.mock('../../src/main/conversations/watch', () => ({
  getKnownFiles: () => [],
  isWatcherReady: () => true
}))
vi.mock('../../src/main/backgroundProcessActivity', () => ({
  BLUME_BACKGROUND_PROCESS_SERVICES: { refresh: 'blume-conversation-refresh-worker' },
  startBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest,
  finishBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest,
  clearBackgroundProcessRequests: mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests,
  terminateBackgroundProcess: mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess
}))
vi.mock('../../src/main/telemetry', () => ({
  captureAppError: mocks.captureAppError,
  captureTelemetryEvent: mocks.captureTelemetryEvent
}))

async function waitForPostMessage(): Promise<void> {
  await vi.waitFor(() => {
    expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
}

describe('desktop conversation refresh worker host shutdown', { timeout: 15_000 }, () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    vi.resetModules()
    mocks.handlers.message = null
    mocks.handlers.exit = null
    mocks.fork.mockClear()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => mocks.worker)
    mocks.worker.on.mockClear()
    mocks.worker.postMessage.mockClear()
    mocks.worker.kill.mockClear()
    mocks.captureAppError.mockClear()
    mocks.captureTelemetryEvent.mockClear()
    mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests.mockClear()
    mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess.mockClear()
    const { configureConversationRegistrations } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => ({
      registrations: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }]
    }))
  })

  afterEach(async () => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
    const { disposeConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    disposeConversationRefreshWorker()
  })

  function lastRequest(): {
    id: number
    registeredAgents: unknown
    conversationSkips: unknown
    conversationScope: unknown
    completedEvidence: string[]
    evidencePinCursor: string | null
  } {
    return mocks.worker.postMessage.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0] as never
  }

  function answer(
    registeredConversations: number,
    resolvedEvidence: { signalId: string; messageId: string; conversationRef: string }[] = [],
    evidencePinCursor: string | null = null,
    conversationScope: 'all' | 'blume' = 'blume'
  ): void {
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'refresh-result',
      id: lastRequest().id,
      ok: true,
      parsed: 0,
      maxIngestMs: 0,
      durationMs: 0,
      registeredConversations,
      conversationScope,
      resolvedEvidence,
      evidencePinCursor
    })
  }

  it('reads every project by default, with the ledger Skip choices, even with nothing registered', async () => {
    const { configureConversationRegistrations, refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => ({
      registrations: [],
      skipped: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'said-no' }],
      skippedRepositories: ['https://github.com/acme/docs']
    }))
    for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {
      const refresh = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(index + 1))
      expect(lastRequest().conversationScope).toBe('all')
      answer(0, [], null, 'all')
      await refresh
    }
    // The first request carries the Skip choices; the unchanged answer is not sent again.
    expect(mocks.worker.postMessage.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).toMatchObject({
      registeredAgents: [],
      conversationSkips: {
        conversations: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'said-no' }],
        repositories: ['https://github.com/acme/docs']
      }
    })
    expect(lastRequest()).toMatchObject({ registeredAgents: null, conversationSkips: null })
  })

  it('a ledger without Skip lists sends registrations with unknown skips', async () => {
    const { configureConversationRegistrations, refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => ({
      registrations: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }]
    }))
    const refresh = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await waitForPostMessage()
    expect(lastRequest()).toMatchObject({ conversationSkips: null, conversationScope: 'all' })
    answer(1, [], null, 'blume')
    await refresh
  })

  it('only projects that use Blume: parses cached registrations offline, and nothing when none are registered', async () => {
    const {
      configureConversationRegistrations,
      configureConversationScope,
      refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker
    } = await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    configureConversationScope(() => 'blume')
    // Signed out or offline before anything is known: the worker parses its SQLite cache.
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => {
      throw Error('Account ledger unavailable')
    })
    const offline = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await waitForPostMessage()
    expect(lastRequest().registeredAgents).toBeNull()
    answer(2)
    await offline
    // An empty registration set clears the cache; afterwards nothing starts the worker.
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => ({ registrations: [] }))
    const cleared = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2))
    expect(lastRequest().registeredAgents).toEqual([])
    answer(0)
    await cleared
    await refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => {
      throw Error('Account ledger unavailable')
    })
    await refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })

  it('reads registrations from the ledger at most once per interval', async () => {
    const { configureConversationRegistrations, refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    const load = vi.fn(async () => ({
      registrations: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }]
    }))
    configureConversationRegistrations(load)
    const sent: unknown[] = []
    for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) {
      const refresh = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(index + 1))
      sent.push(lastRequest().registeredAgents)
      answer(1)
      await refresh
    }
    expect(load).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    // The worker stored the set once; unchanged sets are neither re-sent nor rewritten.
    expect(sent).toEqual([[{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }], null, null])
  })

  it('completes resolved evidence through the ledger and deletes only accepted pins', async () => {
    const {
      configureConversationRegistrations,
      configureEvidenceCompletion,
      refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker
    } = await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')
    configureConversationRegistrations(async () => ({
      registrations: [{ harness: 'claude', conversationId: 'session-1' }]
    }))
    const complete = vi.fn(async (pin: { signalId: string }) => {
      if (pin.signalId === 'sig_later')
        throw Error('Blume ledger timed out. Refresh before retrying.')
    })
    configureEvidenceCompletion(complete)
    const first = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await waitForPostMessage()
    expect(lastRequest().completedEvidence).toEqual([])
    answer(
      1,
      [
        { signalId: 'sig_ok', messageId: 'uuid-1', conversationRef: 'claude:session-1' },
        { signalId: 'sig_later', messageId: 'uuid-2', conversationRef: 'claude:session-1' }
      ],
      'sig_later.json'
    )
    await first
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(complete).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2))
    const second = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2))
    expect(lastRequest().completedEvidence).toEqual(['sig_ok'])
    // The next pin pass resumes where the worker stopped, even if the worker restarted.
    expect(lastRequest().evidencePinCursor).toBe('sig_later.json')
    answer(1)
    await second
  })

  it('settles pending menu-bar snapshot work during native disposal without reporting app errors', async () => {
    const { disposeConversationRefreshWorker, loadMenuBarConversationProjectionViaWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')

    const pending = loadMenuBarConversationProjectionViaWorker()
    await waitForPostMessage()

    await expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'refresh worker disposed'
    })

    expect(mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'blume-conversation-refresh-worker'
    )
  })

  it('classifies inactivity watchdog failures as unresponsive without app-error capture', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({
      toFake: ['Date', 'setTimeout', 'clearTimeout', 'setInterval', 'clearInterval']
    })
    const { refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')

    const pending = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await waitForPostMessage()
    expect(mocks.worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        registeredAgents: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }]
      })
    )
    const expectation = expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'refresh worker unresponsive'
    })

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60_000)
    expect(mocks.captureTelemetryEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'conversation_refresh_worker_watchdog_probe',
      expect.objectContaining({
        requested_max_age_ms: 60_000,
        inactivity_ms: 60_000
      })
    )

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(15_000)
    await expectation
    expect(mocks.captureTelemetryEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'conversation_refresh_worker_failed',
      expect.objectContaining({
        outcome: 'unresponsive',
        main_process_fallback: false
      })
    )
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('does not report circuit-breaker cooldown as an app error', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({
      toFake: ['Date', 'setTimeout', 'clearTimeout', 'setInterval', 'clearInterval']
    })
    const { refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')

    const first = refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)
    await waitForPostMessage()
    const firstExpectation = expect(first).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'refresh worker exited with work pending'
    })
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()
    await firstExpectation
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    mocks.captureAppError.mockClear()

    await expect(refreshViaConversationRefreshWorker(60_000)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'refresh worker circuit breaker is cooling down'
    })
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('does not report intentional env-flag disable as an app error', async () => {
    const previous = process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER
    process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER = '1'
    try {
      const {
        getConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableReason,
        reportConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailable
      } = await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')

      expect(getConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableReason()).toBe(
        'conversation refresh worker disabled'
      )
      const error = reportConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailable('refresh')
      expect(error).toMatchObject({
        name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
        message: 'conversation refresh worker disabled'
      })
      expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    } finally {
      if (previous === undefined) {
        delete process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER
      } else {
        process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER = previous
      }
    }
  })

  it('still reports generic refresh-worker unavailability as an app error', async () => {
    const previous = process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER
    delete process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER
    try {
      const {
        getConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableReason,
        reportConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailable
      } = await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost')

      // Fork is mocked as available, so the reason is null and the reporter
      // falls back to the generic unavailable message — still reportable.
      expect(getConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableReason()).toBeNull()
      const error = reportConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailable('refresh')
      expect(error).toMatchObject({
        name: 'ConversationRefreshWorkerUnavailableError',
        message: 'conversation refresh worker unavailable'
      })
      expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'main.parser.refresh_worker_unavailable',
        error,
        expect.objectContaining({
          operation: 'refresh',
          main_process_fallback: false
        })
      )
    } finally {
      if (previous === undefined) {
        delete process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER
      } else {
        process.env.BLUME_DISABLE_REFRESH_WORKER = previous
      }
    }
  })
})

type MessageWaiter = {
  predicate: (message: ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage) => boolean
  resolve: (message: ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage) => void
}

const sent: ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage[] = []
const waiters = new Set<MessageWaiter>()
let onParentMessage: ((event: { data: ConversationRefreshWorkerHostMessage }) => void) | undefined

const fakeParentPort = {
  postMessage(message: ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage) {
    sent.push(message)
    for (const waiter of waiters) {
      if (!waiter.predicate(message)) continue
      waiters.delete(waiter)
      waiter.resolve(message)
    }
  },
  on(event: string, listener: (event: { data: ConversationRefreshWorkerHostMessage }) => void) {
    if (event === 'message') onParentMessage = listener
  }
}

const processWithParentPort = process as typeof process & { parentPort?: typeof fakeParentPort }
const originalParentPort = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'parentPort')

function parsedFixture(sourcePath: string, cwd?: string): ParsedFixture {
  return { conv: { ref: sourcePath, cwd }, sourcePath, sourceMtimeMs: 1 }
}

function request(id = 1): ConversationRefreshWorkerRequest {
  return {
    type: 'refresh',
    registeredAgents: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }],
    evidencePinsDir: '',
    completedEvidence: [],
    evidencePinCursor: null,
    id,
    maxAgeMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    dbPath: '/tmp/blume-worker-test.sqlite',
    blumeRoot: '/tmp/blume-worker-test',
    homeBlumeRoot: '/tmp/home-blume',
    parserBinaryPath: null,
    watcherReady: true,
    invalidateDiscoveryCache: false,
    knownFiles: [],
    targetPaths: null
  }
}

function dispatch(message: ConversationRefreshWorkerHostMessage): void {
  if (!onParentMessage) throw new Error('refresh worker did not register its parent-port listener')
  onParentMessage({ data: message })
}

function waitForMessage<T extends ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage>(
  predicate: (message: ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage) => message is T
): Promise<T> {
  const existing = sent.find(predicate)
  if (existing) return Promise.resolve(existing)
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    waiters.add({ predicate, resolve: (message) => resolve(message as T) })
  })
}

function waitForResult(
  id: number
): Promise<Extract<ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage, { type: 'refresh-result' }>> {
  return waitForMessage(
    (message): message is Extract<ConversationRefreshWorkerMessage, { type: 'refresh-result' }> =>
      message.type === 'refresh-result' && message.id === id
  )
}

describe.sequential('conversation refresh utility worker protocol', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    Object.defineProperty(processWithParentPort, 'parentPort', {
      configurable: true,
      value: fakeParentPort
    })
    await import('../../src/main/conversations/refreshWorker')
  }, 30_000)
  afterAll(() => {
    if (originalParentPort) Object.defineProperty(process, 'parentPort', originalParentPort)
    else delete processWithParentPort.parentPort
  })

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
    sent.length = 0
    waiters.clear()
    state.providers = []
    state.cursors = []
    state.ingest = async () => {}
    state.recentProjects = []
    state.summaries.clear()
    state.observedProjects = []
    state.observedWorkspaces = []
    state.projectPersistenceError = undefined
    state.selfRunPaths.clear()
    state.walkCacheInvalidations = 0
    state.menuBarSnapshotOptions = []
    state.registered = []
    state.storedSources = []
    state.forgotten = []
    state.upsertedCursors = []
    for (const key of Object.keys(state.meta))
      if (key.startsWith('conversation_gate_')) delete state.meta[key]
    state.legacyExclusions = null
    state.links = []
    state.localMessages = []
  })

  test('caches registrations and keeps parsing the cached set offline or signed out', async () => {
    const ingested: string[] = []
    state.ingest = async (parsed) => {
      ingested.push((parsed as ParsedFixture).sourcePath)
    }
    state.providers = [
      {
        source: 'codex',
        async *iterate() {
          yield parsedFixture('/sessions/registered-session.jsonl')
        }
      }
    ]
    dispatch(request(61))
    expect(await waitForResult(61)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, registeredConversations: 1 })
    expect(state.registered).toEqual([{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'registered-session' }])

    // Signed out / offline: main sends null and the worker parses what it cached.
    dispatch({ ...request(62), registeredAgents: null })
    expect(await waitForResult(62)).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      registeredConversations: 1,
      parsed: 1
    })
    expect(ingested).toEqual([
      '/sessions/registered-session.jsonl',
      '/sessions/registered-session.jsonl'
    ])

    // Nothing registered (fresh or cached): nothing is parsed, never every file.
    dispatch({ ...request(63), registeredAgents: [] })
    expect(await waitForResult(63)).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      registeredConversations: 0,
      parsed: 0
    })
    dispatch({ ...request(64), registeredAgents: null })
    expect(await waitForResult(64)).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      registeredConversations: 0,
      parsed: 0
    })
    expect(ingested).toHaveLength(2)
  })

  test('resolves evidence pins to linked messages and deletes completed pins', async () => {
    const pins = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-pins-'))
    try {
      const pin = (quote: string, sessionId = 'session-1') =>
        JSON.stringify({ quote, harness: 'claude', sessionId, recordedAt: 1 })
      await writeFile(join(pins, 'sig_match.json'), pin('please stop renaming my variables'))
      await writeFile(
        join(pins, 'sig_elsewhere.json'),
        pin('please stop renaming', 'other-session')
      )
      await writeFile(join(pins, 'sig_done.json'), pin('already completed quote'))
      await writeFile(join(pins, 'notes.txt'), 'not a pin')
      state.localMessages = [
        {
          messageId: 'uuid-7',
          eventId: 7,
          turnPosition: 2,
          role: 'user',
          text: 'Please STOP renaming my   variables.',
          timestampMs: null
        }
      ]
      dispatch({ ...request(65), evidencePinsDir: pins, completedEvidence: ['sig_done'] })
      expect(await waitForResult(65)).toMatchObject({
        ok: true,
        resolvedEvidence: [
          { signalId: 'sig_match', messageId: 'uuid-7', conversationRef: 'claude:session-1' }
        ]
      })
      expect(state.links).toMatchObject([
        { conversationRef: 'claude:session-1', messageId: 'uuid-7', cloudId: 'sig_match' }
      ])
      const { readdir } = await import('node:fs/promises')
      // The pin stays until the hosted ledger accepted its pointer; completed pins are deleted.
      expect((await readdir(pins)).sort()).toEqual([
        'notes.txt',
        'sig_elsewhere.json',
        'sig_match.json'
      ])
    } finally {
      await rm(pins, { recursive: true, force: true })
    }
  })

  test('dev-build signal pins resolve in their own worker alongside installed-plugin pins, without reading another dev root', async () => {
    const home = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-dev-evidence-'))
    try {
      const sharedRoot = join(home, '.blume')
      const appRoot = join(sharedRoot, '.dev', 'checkout-a')
      const otherRoot = join(sharedRoot, '.dev', 'checkout-b')
      const files = assemblePluginBuild({
        build: join(appRoot, 'plugin', 'builds', 'fixture'),
        hash: 'a'.repeat(12),
        root: appRoot,
        runtime: null,
        scripts: { bridge: '', hook: '', codexSession: '' }
      })
      const env = JSON.parse(files['claude/blume/.mcp.json']).mcpServers.blume.env
      const pin = {
        quote: 'Please stop renaming my variables',
        harness: 'claude',
        sessionId: 'session-1',
        recordedAt: 1
      }
      const devPin = writeEvidencePin('sig_dev', pin, blumeHome(env))
      const sharedPin = writeEvidencePin('sig_installed', pin, sharedRoot)
      const otherPin = writeEvidencePin('sig_other_dev', pin, otherRoot)
      state.localMessages = [
        {
          messageId: 'uuid-dev',
          eventId: 1,
          turnPosition: 0,
          role: 'user',
          text: pin.quote,
          timestampMs: null
        }
      ]
      const input = {
        ...request(68),
        blumeRoot: appRoot,
        evidencePinsDir: evidencePinsDirectory({}, home)
      }
      dispatch(input)
      const first = await waitForResult(68)
      expect(first.ok).toBe(true)
      if (!first.ok) return
      expect(first.resolvedEvidence.map((pin) => pin.signalId).sort()).toEqual([
        'sig_dev',
        'sig_installed'
      ])
      expect(JSON.stringify(first)).not.toContain(pin.quote)
      // Stable reads only its shared root; it must not discover or remove sandboxed pins.
      dispatch({ ...input, id: 69, blumeRoot: sharedRoot })
      const stable = await waitForResult(69)
      expect(stable).toMatchObject({
        ok: true,
        resolvedEvidence: [{ signalId: 'sig_installed', messageId: 'uuid-dev' }]
      })
      dispatch({
        ...input,
        id: 70,
        evidencePinCursor: first.evidencePinCursor,
        completedEvidence: ['sig_dev', 'sig_installed']
      })
      expect(await waitForResult(70)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, resolvedEvidence: [] })
      const { access } = await import('node:fs/promises')
      await expect(access(devPin)).rejects.toThrow()
      await expect(access(sharedPin)).rejects.toThrow()
      await expect(access(otherPin)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
    } finally {
      await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true })
    }
  })

  test('reads every project when asked, but never a conversation or repository that skips Blume', async () => {

    try {
      let allowSource: ((harness: string, path: string) => boolean) | undefined
      state.providers = [
        {
          source: 'codex',
          async *iterate(options?: { allowSource?: (harness: string, path: string) => boolean }) {
            allowSource = options?.allowSource
            yield parsedFixture('/in-notes.jsonl', skipped)
            // A repository inside the skipped folder is its own repository: the plugin uses
            // Blume there, so the app reads it too.
            yield parsedFixture('/in-nested.jsonl', join(skipped, 'daily'))
            yield parsedFixture('/in-shop.jsonl', kept)
          }
        } as TestProvider
      ]
      const ingested: string[] = []
      state.ingest = async (parsed) => {
        ingested.push(parsed.sourcePath)
      }
      dispatch({
        ...request(60),
        registeredAgents: [],
        conversationSkips: {
          conversations: [{ harness: 'codex', conversationId: 'said-no' }],
          repositories: [skipped]
        },
        conversationScope: 'all'
      })
      expect(await waitForResult(60)).toMatchObject({
        ok: true,
        registeredConversations: 0,
        conversationScope: 'all'
      })
      // Nothing is registered, yet every conversation outside the skipped repository is read.
      expect(ingested).toEqual(['/in-nested.jsonl', '/in-shop.jsonl'])
      expect(allowSource?.('codex', '/s/rollout-2026-10-16T09-00-00-anything.jsonl')).toBe(true)
      expect(allowSource?.('codex', '/s/rollout-2026-10-16T09-00-00-said-no.jsonl')).toBe(false)
      // The skipped file's version is remembered, so it is not parsed again while unchanged.
      expect(state.upsertedCursors.map((cursor) => cursor.path)).toEqual(['/in-notes.jsonl'])
    } finally {
      await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
    }
  })

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const CONVERSATION_RUNTIME = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/conversations/index.ts')
const REFRESH_HOST = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost.ts')
const REFRESH_WORKER = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/conversations/refreshWorker.ts')
const MAIN_INDEX = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/index.ts')
const NATIVE_MENU_BAR = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main/nativeMenuBarStatus.ts')

describe('desktop conversation refresh worker policy', () => {
  test('does not fall back to running refresh or boot ingest on Electron main', () => {
    const source = readFileSync(CONVERSATION_RUNTIME, 'utf8')

    expect(source).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.refreshFromDisk')
    expect(source).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.bootIngest')
    expect(source).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.waitForConversationRefreshes')
    expect(source).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.requestConversationRefreshStop')
    expect(source).not.toContain('coreConversationRuntime.resumeConversationRefreshes')
  })

  test('keeps the bounded menu-bar snapshot in the conversation utility process', () => {
    const host = readFileSync(REFRESH_HOST, 'utf8')
    const worker = readFileSync(REFRESH_WORKER, 'utf8')
    const main = readFileSync(MAIN_INDEX, 'utf8')
    const menuBar = readFileSync(NATIVE_MENU_BAR, 'utf8')

    expect(main).toContain(': loadMenuBarConversationProjectionViaWorker')
    expect(main).toContain('loadConversationProjection: loadNativeMenuBarConversationProjection')
    expect(main).not.toContain(
      'loadConversationProjection: () => conversationRuntime.loadMenuBarConversationProjection()'
    )
    expect(host).toContain('utilityProcess.fork')
    expect(host).toContain("type: 'menu-bar-snapshot'")
    expect(worker).toContain('loadMenuBarConversationProjection(')
    expect(menuBar).not.toContain("from 'better-sqlite3'")
    expect(menuBar).not.toContain('getStorage()')
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/conversation-resume.test.ts">
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  getSetting: vi.fn(() => 'Terminal'),
  openExternal: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  openTerminalPage: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  spawn: vi.fn()
}))

vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  shell: {
    openExternal: mocks.openExternal
  }
}))
vi.mock('child_process', () => ({ spawn: mocks.spawn }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/settingsStore', () => ({ getSetting: mocks.getSetting }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/terminal/host', () => ({ openTerminalPage: mocks.openTerminalPage }))

import { openInTerminal, resumeConversation } from '../../src/main/conversations/resume'

const originalPlatform = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'platform')

function setPlatform(value: NodeJS.Platform): void {
  Object.defineProperty(process, 'platform', { value, configurable: true })
}

function childProcess(options: { spawn?: boolean; error?: Error; exitCode?: number } = {}) {
  const child = Object.assign(new EventEmitter(), { unref: vi.fn() })
  process.nextTick(() => {
    if (options.error) child.emit('error', options.error)
    if (options.spawn) child.emit('spawn')
    if (options.exitCode !== undefined) child.emit('exit', options.exitCode)
  })
  return child
}

afterEach(() => {
  if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(process, 'platform', originalPlatform)
  mocks.getSetting.mockReset()
  mocks.getSetting.mockReturnValue('Terminal')
  mocks.openExternal.mockReset()
  mocks.openExternal.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
  mocks.openTerminalPage.mockReset()
  mocks.openTerminalPage.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
  mocks.spawn.mockReset()
})

describe('conversation resume native adapter', () => {
  test('opens commands in Blume terminal without launching a native terminal app', async () => {
    setPlatform('darwin')

    await openInTerminal('codex', '/repo/app', 'codex login')

    expect(mocks.openTerminalPage).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      harnessId: 'codex',
      cwd: '/repo/app',
      command: 'codex login',
      title: 'Codex'
    })
    expect(mocks.spawn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  test('opens Claude by app name on macOS', async () => {
    setPlatform('darwin')
    const child = childProcess()
    mocks.spawn.mockReturnValue(child)

    await resumeConversation({ source: 'claude', id: 'abc', entrypoint: 'claude-desktop' })

    expect(mocks.spawn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('open', ['-a', 'Claude'], { detached: true })
    expect(child.unref).toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  test('opens Claude protocol off macOS for Claude app resume', async () => {
    setPlatform('linux')

    await resumeConversation({ source: 'claude', id: 'abc', entrypoint: 'claude-desktop' })

    expect(mocks.openExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith('claude://')
    expect(mocks.spawn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  test('resumes terminal conversations in the embedded terminal page', async () => {
    setPlatform('darwin')
    await resumeConversation({ source: 'codex', id: 'codex-1', cwd: '/repo/app' })

    expect(mocks.getSetting).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.openTerminalPage).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      harnessId: 'codex',
      cwd: '/repo/app',
      command: 'codex resume codex-1',
      title: 'Codex'
    })
    expect(mocks.spawn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  test('preserves the harness identity for terminal commands without a harness prefix', async () => {
    await resumeConversation({ source: 'pi', id: 'pi-1', cwd: '/repo/app' })

    expect(mocks.openTerminalPage).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      harnessId: 'pi',
      cwd: '/repo/app',
      command: 'pi',
      title: 'pi'
    })
  })
})
