<file path="__test/regressions/db-migrations.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'
import {
  CURRENT_DESKTOP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  runDesktopMigration,
  runDesktopMigrations
} from '@blume/storage-sqlite'

const CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = String(CURRENT_DESKTOP_SCHEMA_VERSION)

interface PreparedStatement {
  get: (...args: unknown[]) => unknown
  run: (...args: unknown[]) => unknown
}

interface FakeConversationRow {
  title: string | null
  title_source: string | null
  provider_title: string | null
}

class FakeMigrationDb {
  tables = new Set(['meta'])
  indexes = new Set<string>()
  columnsByTable = new Map<string, Set<string>>([
    ['app_usage_intervals', new Set<string>()],
    ['conversations', new Set<string>()]
  ])
  conversationRows: FakeConversationRow[] = []
  schemaVersion = '6'

  addColumn(table: string, column: string): void {
    const columns = this.columnsByTable.get(table) ?? new Set<string>()
    if (columns.has(column)) throw new Error(`duplicate column name: ${column}`)
    columns.add(column)
    this.columnsByTable.set(table, columns)
  }

  hasColumn(table: string, column: string): boolean {
    return this.columnsByTable.get(table)?.has(column) ?? false
  }

  prepare(sql: string): PreparedStatement {
    if (sql.includes("sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'meta'")) {
      return {
        get: () => ({ name: 'meta' }),
        run: () => undefined
      }
    }
    if (sql.includes("sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = ?")) {
      return {
        get: (table: unknown) =>
          typeof table === 'string' && this.tables.has(table) ? { name: table } : undefined,
        run: () => undefined
      }
    }
    if (sql.includes('SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = ?')) {
      return {
        get: () => ({ value: this.schemaVersion }),
        run: () => undefined
      }
    }
    if (sql.includes('INSERT INTO meta')) {
      return {
        get: () => undefined,
        run: (_key: unknown, value: unknown) => {
          this.schemaVersion = String(value)
        }
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`Unexpected SQL: ${sql}`)
  }

  exec(sql: string): void {
    if (/IF NOT EXISTS\s+IF NOT EXISTS/.test(sql)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid duplicate IF NOT EXISTS in SQL: ${sql}`)
    }
    for (const createTable of sql.matchAll(/CREATE\s+TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?(\w+)/g)) {
      this.tables.add(createTable[1])
      if (!this.columnsByTable.has(createTable[1])) {
        this.columnsByTable.set(createTable[1], new Set<string>())
      }
    }
    for (const createIndex of sql.matchAll(
      /CREATE\s+(?:UNIQUE\s+)?INDEX\s+(?:IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?(\w+)/g
    )) {
      this.indexes.add(createIndex[1])
    }
    if (sql.includes('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_usage_intervals')) {
      this.tables.add('app_usage_intervals')
    }
    if (sql.includes('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_app_usage_intervals_unsent')) {
      this.indexes.add('idx_app_usage_intervals_unsent')
    }
    if (sql.includes('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_app_usage_intervals_week')) {
      this.indexes.add('idx_app_usage_intervals_week')
    }
    for (const addColumn of sql.matchAll(/ALTER TABLE (\w+) ADD COLUMN (\w+)/g)) {
      const [, table, column] = addColumn
      this.addColumn(table, column)
    }
    if (sql.includes('UPDATE conversations') && sql.includes('SET provider_title = title')) {
      for (const row of this.conversationRows) {
        if (row.title_source === 'provider' && row.provider_title === null) {
          row.provider_title = row.title
        }
      }
    }
  }

  pragma(sql: string): unknown {
    const tableInfo = sql.match(/table_info\('([^']+)'\)/)
    if (tableInfo) {
      return Array.from(this.columnsByTable.get(tableInfo[1]) ?? [], (name) => ({ name }))
    }
    return undefined
  }

  transaction<T>(fn: () => T): () => T {
    return fn
  }
}

describe('database migrations', () => {
  test('fake migration DB extracts guarded table and index names', () => {
    const db = new FakeMigrationDb()

    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guarded_table (id INTEGER);
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS guarded_index ON guarded_table(id);
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS guarded_unique_index ON guarded_table(id);
    `)

    expect(db.tables.has('guarded_table')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.tables.has('IF')).toBe(false)
    expect(db.indexes.has('guarded_index')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.indexes.has('guarded_unique_index')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.indexes.has('IF')).toBe(false)
  })

  test('repair app usage table when schema version 6 was already recorded', () => {
    const db = new FakeMigrationDb()

    runDesktopMigrations(db as never)

    expect(db.tables.has('app_usage_intervals')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.indexes.has('idx_app_usage_intervals_unsent')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.indexes.has('idx_app_usage_intervals_week')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_seconds')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_expanded_seconds')).toBe(true)

    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_seconds')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_expanded_seconds')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_regular_expanded_seconds')).toBe(
      true
    )
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'parent_thread_id')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'thread_source')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'subagent_kind')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'provider_title')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.schemaVersion).toBe(CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION)
  })

  test('migration 8 adds visible mode columns after app usage repair', () => {

    runDesktopMigrations(db as never)

    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_seconds')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_expanded_seconds')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_regular_expanded_seconds')).toBe(
      true
    )
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'parent_thread_id')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'thread_source')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'subagent_kind')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'provider_title')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.schemaVersion).toBe(CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION)
  })

  test('migration 8 skips visible mode columns that already exist', () => {
    const db = new FakeMigrationDb()
    db.schemaVersion = '7'
    db.tables.add('app_usage_intervals')
    db.indexes.add('idx_app_usage_intervals_unsent')

    db.addColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_seconds')
    db.addColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_pinned_expanded_seconds')
    db.addColumn('app_usage_intervals', 'window_visible_regular_expanded_seconds')

    expect(() => runDesktopMigrations(db as never)).not.toThrow()
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'parent_thread_id')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'thread_source')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'subagent_kind')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.hasColumn('conversations', 'provider_title')).toBe(true)
    expect(db.schemaVersion).toBe(CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION)
  })

<file path="__test/regressions/desktop-release-packaging.test.ts">
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import {
  compareDesktopVersions,
  computeNextCanaryVersion,
  computePostStableCanaryBaseline,
  parseDesktopVersion,
  validateCanaryVersion,
  validateStableVersion
} from '../../../../.github/scripts/desktop-release/desktop-version.mjs'

const desktopRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url))

function hasRuntimeWorkspaceImport(source: string) {
  const normalized = source.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  return (
    /\bimport\s+(?!type\b)[^;]*?\sfrom\s*['"]@blume\//.test(normalized) ||
    /\b(?:require|import)\s*\(\s*['"]@blume\//.test(normalized)
  )
}

describe('packaged app never loads raw workspace TypeScript', () => {
  test('desktop builds include the local Raycast search helper', () => {
    const viteConfig = readFileSync(join(desktopRoot, 'electron.vite.config.ts'), 'utf8')
    expect(viteConfig).toContain("raycastSearch: resolve('src/main/raycastSearch.ts')")
  })

  // Workspace packages export raw src/*.ts. Electron cannot require those from
  // app.asar/node_modules (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING crashed
  // a packaged canary), so every workspace dependency of the main process must
  // be bundled by electron-vite instead of externalized to node_modules.
  test('every workspace dependency is excluded from main externalizeDeps', () => {
    const packageJson = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(desktopRoot, 'package.json'), 'utf8')) as {
      dependencies?: Record<string, string>
    }
    const workspaceDeps = Object.entries(packageJson.dependencies ?? {})
      .filter(([, range]) => range.startsWith('workspace:'))
      .map(([name]) => name)
    expect(workspaceDeps.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)

    const viteConfig = readFileSync(join(desktopRoot, 'electron.vite.config.ts'), 'utf8')
    const excludeMatch = /externalizeDeps:\s*\{\s*exclude:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]/.exec(viteConfig)
    expect(
      excludeMatch,
      'main.build.externalizeDeps.exclude missing from electron.vite.config.ts'
    ).toBeTruthy()
    const excludeList = excludeMatch ? excludeMatch[1] : ''
    const excluded = Array.from(excludeList.matchAll(/['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g), (m) => m[1])

    for (const dep of workspaceDeps) {
      expect(excluded, `${dep} must be bundled into out/main (externalizeDeps.exclude)`).toContain(
        dep
      )
    }
  })

  // The exclude list above only covers the main-process build. Preload also
  // externalizes package.json dependencies by default, so a workspace import
  // there would reintroduce the same packaged-app crash.
  test('preload workspace imports are bundled instead of loaded as raw TypeScript', () => {
    const config = readFileSync(join(desktopRoot, 'electron.vite.config.ts'), 'utf8').split(
      'preload:'
    )[1]
    const excluded = [
      ...(config.match(/exclude:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]/)?.[1] ?? '').matchAll(/['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g)
    ].map((m) => m[1])
    const preloadDir = join(desktopRoot, 'src', 'preload')
    const offenders: string[] = []
    for (const entry of readdirSync(preloadDir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (!entry.isFile() || entry.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) continue
      if (!/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(entry.name)) continue
      const filePath = join(entry.parentPath, entry.name)
      const source = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').replace(
        /import type[\s\S]*?from\s*['"][^'"]+['"]/g,
        ''
      )
      for (const match of source.matchAll(/['"](@blume\/[^/'"]+)(?:[^'"]*)['"]/g)) {
        if (!excluded.includes(match[1])) offenders.push(`${filePath}: ${match[1]}`)
      }
    }
    expect(offenders).toEqual([])
  })

  test('runtime workspace import detector covers multiline preload imports', () => {
    expect(
      hasRuntimeWorkspaceImport("import {\n  createClient\n} from '@blume/insights-control'")
    ).toBe(true)
    expect(
      hasRuntimeWorkspaceImport("const mod = await import(\n  '@blume/insights-control'\n)")
    ).toBe(true)
    expect(hasRuntimeWorkspaceImport("const mod = require(\n  '@blume/insights-control'\n)")).toBe(
      true
    )
    expect(
      hasRuntimeWorkspaceImport("import type {\n  Client\n} from '@blume/insights-control'")
    ).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('desktop release version ordering', () => {
  test('stable release computes the next canary baseline', () => {
    expect(computePostStableCanaryBaseline('1.0.51')).toBe('1.0.52-c.0')
    expect(computePostStableCanaryBaseline('1.2.9')).toBe('1.2.10-c.0')
  })

  test('manual canaries continue the baseline train', () => {
    expect(computeNextCanaryVersion({ latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: '1.0.52-c.0' })).toBe(
      '1.0.52-c.1'
    )
    expect(computeNextCanaryVersion({ latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: '1.0.52-c.4' })).toBe(
      '1.0.52-c.5'
    )
  })

  test('a canary train left over from the released stable restarts at the new baseline', () => {
    expect(computeNextCanaryVersion({ latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: '1.0.51-c.7' })).toBe(
      '1.0.52-c.0'
    )
    expect(computeNextCanaryVersion({ latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: null })).toBe(
      '1.0.52-c.0'
    )
  })

  test('stable supersedes every canary of the same base so canary users converge', () => {
    expect(compareDesktopVersions('1.0.52', '1.0.52-c.9')).toBe(1)
    expect(compareDesktopVersions('1.0.52-c.0', '1.0.51')).toBe(1)
  })

  test('canary numbers compare numerically, not lexicographically', () => {
    expect(compareDesktopVersions('1.0.52-c.2', '1.0.52-c.10')).toBe(-1)
  })

  test('stable validation allows releasing the version the canary train was testing', () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateStableVersion({
        requested: '1.0.52',
        latestStable: '1.0.51',
        latestCanary: '1.0.52-c.3'
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
    expect(() =>
      validateStableVersion({ requested: '1.0.51', latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: null })
    ).toThrow(/greater than latest stable/)
    expect(() =>
      validateStableVersion({
        requested: '1.0.52',
        latestStable: '1.0.51',
        latestCanary: '1.0.53-c.0'
      })
    ).toThrow(/behind current canary train/)
  })

  test('canary validation refuses to move the canary feed backwards', () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateCanaryVersion({
        requested: '1.0.52-c.1',
        latestStable: '1.0.51',
        latestCanary: '1.0.52-c.0'
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
    expect(() =>
      validateCanaryVersion({
        requested: '1.0.52-c.0',
        latestStable: '1.0.51',
        latestCanary: '1.0.52-c.3'
      })
    ).toThrow(/greater than latest canary/)
    expect(() =>
      validateCanaryVersion({ requested: '1.0.51-c.4', latestStable: '1.0.51', latestCanary: null })
    ).toThrow(/greater than latest stable/)
  })

  test('only stable X.Y.Z and canary X.Y.Z-c.N versions are accepted', () => {
    expect(parseDesktopVersion('1.0.52').kind).toBe('stable')
    expect(parseDesktopVersion('1.0.52-c.3').kind).toBe('canary')
    expect(() => parseDesktopVersion('1.0.52-beta.1')).toThrow(/Unsupported desktop version/)
    expect(() => parseDesktopVersion('1.0.52-c.01x')).toThrow(/Unsupported desktop version/)
  })
})

describe('stable and canary package identity', () => {
  test('release workflow config and runtime use matching non-conflicting identities', () => {
    const releaseChannel = readFileSync(join(desktopRoot, 'src/main/releaseChannel.ts'), 'utf8')

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const settings = new Map<string, string>()

vi.mock('../../src/main/settingsStore', () => ({
  getAllSettings: () => Object.fromEntries(settings),
  setSettingAsync: async (key: string, value: string) => {
    settings.set(key, value)
  }

import { initializeDevAccountSession } from '../../src/main/devAccountSession'

function encodedImport(entries: Array<{ key: string; value: string }>): string {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(entries)).toString('base64')
}

describe('dev account session initialization', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    settings.clear()
    process.env.BLUME_DEV_INSTALL = '1'
    delete process.env.BLUME_DEV_SIGNED_OUT
    delete process.env.BLUME_DEV_ACCOUNT_SESSION_IMPORT
  })

  it('replaces only account settings with the re-encrypted installed session', async () => {
    settings.set('account.old', 'old')
    settings.set('theme', 'dark')
    process.env.BLUME_DEV_ACCOUNT_SESSION_IMPORT = encodedImport([
      { key: 'account.blume-account.cookie', value: 'enc:v1:encrypted-cookie' },
      { key: 'account.blume-account.local_cache', value: 'enc:v1:encrypted-cache' }
    ])

    await initializeDevAccountSession()

    expect(Object.fromEntries(settings)).toEqual({
      'account.old': '',
      'account.blume-account.cookie': 'enc:v1:encrypted-cookie',
      'account.blume-account.local_cache': 'enc:v1:encrypted-cache',
      theme: 'dark'
    })
  })

  it('clears only the dev account copy in explicit signed-out mode', async () => {
    settings.set('account.blume-account.cookie', 'enc:v1:cookie')
    settings.set('theme', 'light')
    process.env.BLUME_DEV_SIGNED_OUT = '1'

    await initializeDevAccountSession()

    expect(settings.get('account.blume-account.cookie')).toBe('')
    expect(settings.get('theme')).toBe('light')
  })

  it('does nothing outside the dev launcher', async () => {
    settings.set('account.blume-account.cookie', 'existing')
    delete process.env.BLUME_DEV_INSTALL
    process.env.BLUME_DEV_SIGNED_OUT = '1'

    await initializeDevAccountSession()

    expect(settings.get('account.blume-account.cookie')).toBe('existing')
  })
})

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */

import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import {
  devAccountSessionDatabaseCandidates,
  findDevAccountSessionSource,
  validateDevAccountSession
} from '../../scripts/dev-account-session.mjs'

const tempDirs = []

afterEach(() => {
  for (const dir of tempDirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
})

function createSettingsDb(accountCookie = null) {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-dev-account-'))
  tempDirs.push(dir)
  const dbPath = join(dir, 'blume.sqlite')
  const db = new DatabaseSync(dbPath)
  db.exec('CREATE TABLE settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)')
  if (accountCookie !== null) {
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)').run(
      'account.blume-account.cookie',
      accountCookie
    )
  }
  db.close()
  return dbPath
}

describe('dev account session discovery', () => {
  it('prefers stable and falls back to canary', () => {
    const stableDbPath = createSettingsDb('stable-session')
    const canaryDbPath = createSettingsDb('canary-session')
    const candidates = [
      { source: 'stable', dbPath: stableDbPath },
      { source: 'canary', dbPath: canaryDbPath }
    ]
    expect(findDevAccountSessionSource(candidates)).toEqual(candidates[0])

    const db = new DatabaseSync(stableDbPath)
    db.prepare('UPDATE settings SET value = ?').run('')
    db.close()
    expect(findDevAccountSessionSource(candidates)).toEqual(candidates[1])
  })

  it('ignores missing, malformed, and signed-out databases', () => {
    const emptyDb = createSettingsDb()
    expect(
      findDevAccountSessionSource([
        { source: 'missing', dbPath: join(tmpdir(), 'does-not-exist-blume.sqlite') },
        { source: 'empty', dbPath: emptyDb }
      ])
    ).toBeNull()
  })

  it('builds stable and canary candidates without using a dev database', () => {
    expect(
      devAccountSessionDatabaseCandidates({
        homeDir: '/Users/me',
        stableDbPath: '/tmp/main.sqlite'
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { source: 'stable', dbPath: '/tmp/main.sqlite' },
      { source: 'canary', dbPath: '/Users/me/.blume/.canary/blume.sqlite' }
    ])
  })

  it('validates live sessions and distinguishes signed-out records from outages', async () => {
    const settings = [{ key: 'account.blume-account.cookie', value: 'session-cookie' }]
    expect(
      await validateDevAccountSession(settings, 'https://auth.example/', async () =>
        Response.json({ session: { id: 'session' }, user: { id: 'user' } })
      )
    ).toBe('authenticated')
    expect(
      await validateDevAccountSession(settings, 'https://auth.example', async () =>
        Response.json(null)
      )
    ).toBe('invalid')
    expect(
      await validateDevAccountSession(settings, 'https://auth.example', async () => {
        throw new Error('offline')
      })
    ).toBe('unknown')
    expect(await validateDevAccountSession([], 'https://auth.example')).toBe('invalid')
  })
})

import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import {
  devLabelDatabaseCandidates,
  devRunnerArguments,
  inferWorktreeName,
  parseDevLauncherArguments,
  readConversationTitleParameter,
  readRemoteDebuggingPortParameter,
  resolveDevLabel
} from '../../scripts/dev-label.mjs'

const tempDirs = []

afterEach(() => {
  for (const dir of tempDirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
})

function createMainDb() {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-dev-label-'))
  tempDirs.push(dir)
  const dbPath = join(dir, 'blume.sqlite')
  const db = new DatabaseSync(dbPath)
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE conversations (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      ref TEXT NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      external_id TEXT,
      project_id INTEGER,
      workspace TEXT,
      workspace_kind TEXT,
      cwd TEXT,
      title TEXT,
      provider_title TEXT,
      parent_thread_id TEXT,
      thread_source TEXT,
      last_activity_ts INTEGER NOT NULL
    );
    INSERT INTO conversations
      (id, ref, source, external_id, project_id, workspace, workspace_kind, cwd, title,
       parent_thread_id, thread_source, last_activity_ts)
    VALUES
      (1, 'codex/old', 'codex', 'thread-old', 1, '17c8', '.codex', '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo', 'Older title', NULL, 'user', 100),
      (2, 'codex/current', 'codex', 'thread-current', 1, '17c8', '.codex', '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo', 'Current task title', NULL, 'user', 200),
      (3, 'codex/other', 'codex', 'thread-other', 1, '99aa', '.codex', '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/99aa/repo', 'Other worktree', NULL, 'user', 300),
      (4, 'codex/subagent', 'codex', 'thread-subagent', 1, '17c8', '.codex', '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo', NULL, 'thread-current', 'subagent', 400),
      (5, 'codex/orphan-subagent', 'codex', 'thread-orphan', 1, '17c8', '.codex', '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo', 'Wrong sub-agent title', NULL, 'subagent', 500);
  `)
  db.close()
  return dbPath
}

function onlyStable(dbPath) {
  return [{ source: 'stable', dbPath }]
}

describe('dev label resolution', () => {
  it('accepts a conversation title argument or environment fallback', () => {
    expect(readConversationTitleParameter(['--conversation-title', 'Search work'])).toBe(
      'Search work'
    )
    expect(readConversationTitleParameter(['--conversation=Compact title'])).toBe('Compact title')
    expect(readConversationTitleParameter([], { BLUME_DEV_CONVERSATION_TITLE: 'From env' })).toBe(
      'From env'
    )
    expect(() => readConversationTitleParameter(['--conversation-title'])).toThrow(
      'requires a non-empty title'
    )
  })

  it('forwards electron-vite CDP options while consuming launcher-only title flags', () => {
    expect(
      parseDevLauncherArguments([
        '--',
        '--conversation-title',
        'Profile project renders',
        '--remoteDebuggingPort',
        '9223',
        '--sourcemap'
      ])
    ).toEqual({
      conversationTitle: 'Profile project renders',
      runtimeProfile: 'full',
      runnerMode: 'hmr',
      signedOut: false,
      electronViteArgs: ['--remoteDebuggingPort', '9223', '--sourcemap'],
      cdpPort: 9223
    })

    expect(
      parseDevLauncherArguments(['--remoteDebuggingPort=9331', '--conversation=Explicit title'])
    ).toEqual({
      conversationTitle: 'Explicit title',
      runtimeProfile: 'full',
      runnerMode: 'hmr',
      signedOut: false,
      electronViteArgs: ['--remoteDebuggingPort=9331'],
      cdpPort: 9331
    })
  })

  it('only exposes valid CDP ports and preserves the last valid option', () => {
    expect(readRemoteDebuggingPortParameter(['--remoteDebuggingPort', '9223'])).toBe(9223)
    expect(
      readRemoteDebuggingPortParameter([
        '--remoteDebuggingPort=9223',
        '--remoteDebuggingPort',
        '9331'
      ])
    ).toBe(9331)
    expect(readRemoteDebuggingPortParameter(['--remoteDebuggingPort=70000'])).toBeNull()
    expect(readRemoteDebuggingPortParameter(['--remoteDebuggingPort', 'not-a-port'])).toBeNull()
  })

  it('keeps DB label resolution available when a CDP launch has no explicit title', () => {
    expect(
      parseDevLauncherArguments(['--remoteDebuggingPort', '9223'], {
        BLUME_DEV_CONVERSATION_TITLE: ''
      })
    ).toEqual({
      conversationTitle: null,
      runtimeProfile: 'full',
      runnerMode: 'hmr',
      signedOut: false,
      electronViteArgs: ['--remoteDebuggingPort', '9223'],
      cdpPort: 9223
    })
  })

  it('consumes and validates lightweight runtime profiles', () => {
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile', 'ui', '--sourcemap'])).toMatchObject({
      runtimeProfile: 'ui',
      electronViteArgs: ['--sourcemap']
    })
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments([], { BLUME_DEV_PROFILE: 'conversations' })).toMatchObject({
      runtimeProfile: 'conversations'
    })
    expect(() => parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile=unknown'])).toThrow(
      'must be one of: full, ui, conversations, native'
    )
    expect(() => parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile'])).toThrow(
      'requires a non-empty profile'
    )
    expect(() => parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile', '--sourcemap'])).toThrow(
      'requires a non-empty profile'
    )
    expect(() => parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile='])).toThrow(
      'requires a non-empty profile'
    )
  })

  it('consumes the static manual-test runner without forwarding it to electron-vite', () => {
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments(['--profile', 'ui', '--static', '--sourcemap'])).toMatchObject(
      {
        runtimeProfile: 'ui',
        runnerMode: 'static',
        electronViteArgs: ['--sourcemap']
      }
    )
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments([], { BLUME_DEV_RUNNER: 'static' })).toMatchObject({
      runnerMode: 'static'
    })
    expect(
      devRunnerArguments('static', [
        '--remoteDebuggingPort',
        '9337',
        '--sourcemap',
        '--remoteDebuggingPort=9448'
      ])
    ).toEqual(['preview', '--skipBuild', '--sourcemap'])
    expect(devRunnerArguments('hmr', ['--remoteDebuggingPort', '9337'])).toEqual([
      'dev',
      '--remoteDebuggingPort',
      '9337'
    ])
  })

  it('consumes the signed-out launcher flag without forwarding it to electron-vite', () => {
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments(['--signed-out', '--sourcemap'])).toEqual({
      conversationTitle: null,
      runtimeProfile: 'full',
      runnerMode: 'hmr',
      signedOut: true,
      electronViteArgs: ['--sourcemap'],
      cdpPort: null
    })
    expect(parseDevLauncherArguments([], { BLUME_DEV_SIGNED_OUT: '1' }).signedOut).toBe(true)
  })

  it('builds database candidates in canary, stable, current-worktree dev order', () => {
    expect(
      devLabelDatabaseCandidates({
        homeDir: '/Users/me',
        devAppPath: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo/apps/desktop'
      })
    ).toEqual([
      {
        source: 'canary',
        dbPath: '/Users/me/.blume/.canary/blume.sqlite'
      },
      {
        source: 'stable',
        dbPath: '/Users/me/.blume/blume.sqlite'
      },
      {
        source: 'dev-worktree',
        dbPath:
          '/Users/me/.blume/.dev/Users_me_.codex_worktrees_17c8_repo_apps_desktop/blume.sqlite'
      }
    ])
  })

  it('uses the configured main database as the stable candidate without changing priority', () => {
    expect(
      devLabelDatabaseCandidates({
        homeDir: '/Users/me',
        devAppPath: '/Users/me/worktree/apps/desktop',
        stableDbPath: '/tmp/custom-main.sqlite'
      })
    ).toEqual([
      {
        source: 'canary',
        dbPath: '/Users/me/.blume/.canary/blume.sqlite'
      },
      {
        source: 'stable',
        dbPath: '/tmp/custom-main.sqlite'
      },
      {
        source: 'dev-worktree',
        dbPath: '/Users/me/.blume/.dev/Users_me_worktree_apps_desktop/blume.sqlite'
      }
    ])
  })

  it('uses the latest user-owned conversation for the exact checkout path', () => {
    const label = resolveDevLabel({
      dbCandidates: onlyStable(createMainDb()),
      launchPath: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo/apps/desktop',
      workingDirectory: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo',
      conversationTitle: null
    })
    expect(label).toMatchObject({
      conversationName: 'Current task title',
      worktreeName: '17c8',
      source: 'stable',
      error: null
    })
  })

  it('resolves titles from canary, then stable, then the current-worktree dev database', () => {
    const canaryDbPath = createMainDb()
    const stableDbPath = createMainDb()
    const devDbPath = createMainDb()
    const dbCandidates = [
      { source: 'canary', dbPath: canaryDbPath },
      { source: 'stable', dbPath: stableDbPath },
      { source: 'dev-worktree', dbPath: devDbPath }
    ]

    for (const [dbPath, title] of [
      [canaryDbPath, 'Canary title'],
      [stableDbPath, 'Stable title'],
      [devDbPath, 'Dev worktree title']
    ]) {
      const db = new DatabaseSync(dbPath)
      db.prepare('UPDATE conversations SET title = ? WHERE id = 2').run(title)
      db.close()
    }

    const input = {
      dbCandidates,
      launchPath: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo',
      workingDirectory: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo',
      conversationTitle: null
    }
    expect(resolveDevLabel(input)).toMatchObject({
      conversationName: 'Canary title',
      source: 'canary'
    })

    let db = new DatabaseSync(canaryDbPath)
    db.exec('UPDATE conversations SET title = NULL, provider_title = NULL WHERE id = 2;')
    db.close()
    expect(resolveDevLabel(input)).toMatchObject({
      conversationName: 'Stable title',
      source: 'stable'
    })

    db = new DatabaseSync(stableDbPath)
    db.exec('DELETE FROM conversations;')
    db.close()
    expect(resolveDevLabel(input)).toMatchObject({
      conversationName: 'Dev worktree title',
      source: 'dev-worktree'
    })
  })

  it('ignores guardian reviews when choosing the user conversation title', () => {

    const label = resolveDevLabel({

    })
    expect(label.conversationName).toBe('Current task title')
  })

  it('does not cross into another checkout or a parent directory', () => {

    db.exec(`

        (id, ref, source, project_id, cwd, title, thread_source, last_activity_ts)
      VALUES
        (6, 'codex/home', 'codex', 2, '/Users/me', 'Unrelated parent directory', 'user', 900),
        (7, 'codex/nested', 'codex', 1, '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo/apps/desktop', 'Nested checkout task', 'user', 150);
    `)
    db.close()

    const label = resolveDevLabel({

      launchPath: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo/apps/desktop',

      conversationTitle: null
    })
    expect(label.conversationName).toBe('Current task title')
  })

  it('requires an explicit title when the exact path has no conversation', () => {

      source,
      dbPath: createMainDb()
    }))
    const label = resolveDevLabel({
      dbCandidates,

    const label = resolveDevLabel({

    expect(label.conversationName).toBe('Explicit title')
    expect(label.worktreeName).toBe('17c8')
    expect(label.source).toBe('parameter')
  })

  it('can infer common harness worktree names without a database row', () => {
    expect(inferWorktreeName('/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/17c8/repo')).toBe('17c8')
    expect(inferWorktreeName('/Users/me/repo/.claude/worktrees/search-ui')).toBe('search-ui')
    expect(inferWorktreeName('/Users/me/repo')).toBeNull()
  })

import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

  import.meta.url

describe('developer list appearance', () => {
  test('the dev menu uses settings tabs and grouped settings rows', async () => {
    const source = await readFile(devViewUrl, 'utf8')

    expect(source).not.toMatch(/ListAppearanceProvider/)
    expect(source).toMatch(/<SettingsTabs[\s\S]*?value=\{currentTab\}/)
    expect(source).toMatch(/<SettingsTabsTrigger value="product"/)

    expect(source).toMatch(/function DevMenuRow/)

    expect(source).toMatch(/function DevToggleRow[\s\S]*?<SettingsToggleRow/)
    expect(source).toMatch(/function DevMenuSection[\s\S]*?<SettingsSection[\s\S]*?<SettingsGroup>/)
    expect(source).toMatch(/<DevMenuSection label="Preview flows" count=\{1\}>/)
    expect(source).toMatch(/concept="feedback"[\s\S]*?title="Monday Wrapped delivery"/)

  test('process and concept trees use configurable list surfaces and semantic concepts', async () => {
    const [processes, concepts, performance] = await Promise.all([

    expect(processes).toMatch(/<ConfigurableList[\s\S]*?role="tree"/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/aria-label="Current Blume process hierarchy"/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/aria-label="Recently finished Blume process hierarchy"/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/<ConfigurableListRow/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/concept="workflow" icon=\{Layers\}/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/concept="activity"[\s\S]*?runtimeRoleIconComponent/)
    expect(processes).toMatch(/concept=\{processTypeConcept\(process\.type\)\}/)

    expect(concepts).toMatch(/<ConfigurableList[\s\S]*?appearance=\{\{ colorMode: 'concept' \}\}/)
    expect(concepts).toMatch(/<ConfigurableListRow/)
    expect(concepts).toMatch(/<ConfigurableListIcon concept=\{conceptId\} scale="medium" \/>/)

    expect(performance).toMatch(
      /<ConfigurableList className="rounded-lg bg-transparent shadow-none">/
    )
    expect(performance).toMatch(/<ConfigurableListRow/)

<file path="__test/regressions/dev-mock-suggestions.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

import {
  createDevMockSuggestionService,
  isDevMockSuggestionEvidenceJson,
  parseDevMockSuggestionInput
} from '@blume/app-core'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { basename, join } from 'node:path'

describe('dev mock suggestions', () => {
  test('parses and bounds renderer input', () => {
    expect(
      parseDevMockSuggestionInput({
        title: '  Mock title  ',
        summary: '  Mock summary  ',
        action: 'update'
      })
    ).toEqual({
      title: 'Mock title',
      summary: 'Mock summary',
      action: 'update'
    })
    expect(() =>
      parseDevMockSuggestionInput({ title: 'Mock', summary: 'Summary', action: 'execute' })
    ).toThrow('Invalid mock suggestion action')
    expect(() =>
      parseDevMockSuggestionInput({ title: ' ', summary: 'Summary', action: 'create' })
    ).toThrow('Title is required')
  })

  test.each(['create', 'update', 'remove'] as const)(
    'seeds a real %s suggestion against only the isolated passive fixture',
    async (action) => {
      const writeTextFile = vi.fn(async () => undefined)
      const ensureDir = vi.fn(async () => undefined)
      const notifyChanged = vi.fn()
      let insertedSuggestion: Record<string, unknown> | undefined
      const service = createDevMockSuggestionService({
        getRootDir: () => '/tmp/blume-dev-root',
        getStore: () => ({
          async createSignalCluster(input) {
            expect(input.status).toBe('promoted')
            expect(input.tagsJson).toBe('["dev-mock"]')
            return { id: 17 } as never
          },
          async insertSuggestion(input) {
            insertedSuggestion = input
            return { id: 29 } as never
          }
        }),
        ensureDir,
        writeTextFile,
        joinPath: join,
        basename,
        hashText: (content) => createHash('sha256').update(content, 'utf8').digest('hex'),
        createId: () => 'fixed-id',
        now: () => 1234,
        notifyChanged
      })

      const result = await service.create({
        title: 'Exercise Improve',
        summary: 'Harmless lifecycle fixture.',
        action
      })

      expect(result).toEqual({
        suggestionId: 29,
        targetPath: '/tmp/blume-dev-root/dev-mock-suggestions/mock-1234-fixed-id.md',
        action
      })
      expect(ensureDir).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/tmp/blume-dev-root/dev-mock-suggestions')
      expect(writeTextFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(action === 'create' ? 0 : 1)
      expect(notifyChanged).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
      expect(insertedSuggestion?.clusterId).toBe(17)
      expect(insertedSuggestion?.status).toBe('active')
      expect(isDevMockSuggestionEvidenceJson(String(insertedSuggestion?.evidenceJson))).toBe(true)

      const operations = JSON.parse(String(insertedSuggestion?.operationsJson)) as Array<
        Record<string, unknown>
      >
      expect(operations).toHaveLength(1)
      expect(operations[0]).toMatchObject({
        action,
        artifactType: 'doc',
        artifactScope: 'global',
        harnessApplicability: 'shared',
        targetPath: result.targetPath
      })
      expect(String(operations[0].patchPreview)).toContain(
        'diff --git a/dev-mock-suggestions/mock-1234-fixed-id.md'
      )
      expect(String(operations[0].patchPreview)).toContain(
        action === 'create'
          ? '@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@'
          : action === 'update'
            ? '@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@'
            : '@@ -1,7 +0,0 @@'
      )
      expect(String(operations[0].patchPreview)).not.toMatch(/\n[+-]$/)
      expect(String(operations[0].targetPath)).not.toMatch(
        /(?:AGENTS\.md|CLAUDE\.md|settings\.json|SKILL\.md)/
      )
      if (action === 'create') {
        expect(operations[0].baseHash).toBeNull()
      } else {
        expect(operations[0].baseHash).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/)
      }
      if (action === 'remove') {
        expect(operations[0]).not.toHaveProperty('newContent')
      } else {
        expect(String(operations[0].newContent)).toContain('State: after')
      }
    }
  )

  test('recognizes only the explicit dev marker for feedback suppression', () => {
    expect(isDevMockSuggestionEvidenceJson('[]')).toBe(false)
    expect(isDevMockSuggestionEvidenceJson('not json')).toBe(false)
    expect(
      isDevMockSuggestionEvidenceJson(
        JSON.stringify([{ source: 'blume-dev-mock', excerpt: 'fixture' }])
      )
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/dev-preview-environment.test.mjs">
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import { applyPullRequestPreviewEnvironment } from '../../scripts/previewEnvironment.mjs'

const sha = 'a'.repeat(40)
const pr = 1001
const origin = (name) => `https://${name}-pr-${pr}.account.workers.dev`
const services = {
  auth: origin('blume-auth'),
  artifactSync: origin('blume-artifact-sync'),
  feedback: origin('blume-feedback'),
  userAnalytics: origin('blume-analytics'),
  referrals: origin('blume-referrals'),
  insights: origin('blume-insights-control'),
  llm: origin('blume-llm'),
  router: origin('blume-router'),
  webLab: origin('blume-web-lab'),
  runner: `${origin('blume-web-lab')}/runner`,
  deliveriesRuntime: origin('blume-deliveries-runtime')
}
const bundleId = `preview-pr-${pr}-${sha}`
const envelope = (override = {}) => ({
  pullRequestNumber: pr,
  sourceSha: sha,
  bundleId,
  manifest: {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    channel: 'preview',
    bundleId,
    sourceSha: sha,
    services: Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries({ ...services, ...override }).map(([name, url]) => [name, { url }])
    )
  }
})
const health = (release = { channel: 'preview', bundleId, sourceSha: sha }) =>
  Response.json({ ok: true, component: 'deliveriesRuntime', release })

const frontOrigin = (name) => `https://${name}-pr-${pr}.petal-preview.com`
/** A PR with no Workers Preview yet: the front's catch-all answers 404 without JSON. */
const noFrontSet = () =>
  new Response('not found', { status: 404, headers: { 'content-type': 'text/plain' } })

function resolver({
  manifest = envelope(),
  front = noFrontSet(),
  runtimeHealth = health(),
  runtimeUrl = services.deliveriesRuntime,
  pullRequest = pr,
  branch = 'claude/feature'
} = {}) {
  const fetched = []
  return {
    fetched,
    run: (env) =>
      applyPullRequestPreviewEnvironment(env, {
        sourceSha: () => sha,
        branchName: () => branch,
        pullRequestNumber: () => pullRequest,
        log: () => {},
        fetchImpl: async (url) => {
          fetched.push(url)
          if (url === `${frontOrigin('blume-insights-control')}/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`)
            return front instanceof Response ? front : Response.json(front)
          if (url.endsWith(`/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`))
            return manifest instanceof Response ? manifest : Response.json(manifest)
          if (url === `${runtimeUrl}/health`) return runtimeHealth
          throw new Error(`Unexpected ${url}`)
        }
      })
  }
}

describe('pnpm dev backend selection', () => {
  it('uses the exact PR preview set, including hosted Deliveries and same-PR Auth', async () => {
    const env = { CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' }
    const r = resolver()
    expect(await r.run(env)).toEqual({ mode: 'preview', pullRequestNumber: pr, bundleId })
    expect(env.BLUME_AUTH_URL).toBe(services.auth)
    expect(env.MAIN_VITE_BLUME_AUTH_URL).toBe(services.auth)
    expect(env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT).toBe(services.deliveriesRuntime)
    expect(env.BLUME_CLOUD_OWNER_URL).toBe(services.webLab)
    expect(env.BLUME_ARTIFACT_SYNC_URL).toBe(services.artifactSync)
    expect(env.BLUME_RELEASE_BUNDLE).toBe(bundleId)
    expect(r.fetched).toEqual([
      `${frontOrigin('blume-insights-control')}/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`,
      `${origin('blume-insights-control')}/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`,
      `${services.deliveriesRuntime}/health`
    ])
  })

  it('uses a preview set without its optional VPS runner', async () => {
    const { runner: _runner, ...workers } = services
    const withoutRunner = envelope()
    delete withoutRunner.manifest.services.runner
    withoutRunner.manifest.omittedServices = { runner: 'not-requested' }
    const env = { CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' }
    expect(await resolver({ manifest: withoutRunner }).run(env)).toEqual({
      mode: 'preview',
      pullRequestNumber: pr,
      bundleId
    })
    expect(env.BLUME_AUTH_URL).toBe(workers.auth)
    expect(env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT).toBe(workers.deliveriesRuntime)
    expect(env.BLUME_RUNNER_URL).toBe('')
  })

  it('uses a Workers Preview behind the petal-preview.com front first', async () => {
    const frontServices = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(services).map(([name, url]) => [
        name,
        url.replace('.account.workers.dev', '.petal-preview.com')
      ])
    )
    const frontEnvelope = envelope(frontServices)
    const env = { CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' }
    const r = resolver({ front: frontEnvelope, runtimeUrl: frontServices.deliveriesRuntime })
    expect(await r.run(env)).toEqual({ mode: 'preview', pullRequestNumber: pr, bundleId })
    expect(env.BLUME_AUTH_URL).toBe(frontServices.auth)
    expect(env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT).toBe(frontServices.deliveriesRuntime)
    expect(r.fetched).toEqual([
      `${frontOrigin('blume-insights-control')}/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`,
      `${frontServices.deliveriesRuntime}/health`
    ])
    // A registry and a manifest that disagree about hosting are refused, in both directions.
    await expect(
      resolver({ front: envelope() }).run({ CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' })
    ).rejects.toThrow(/disagree about hosting/)
    await expect(
      resolver({ manifest: frontEnvelope }).run({ CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' })
    ).rejects.toThrow(/disagree about hosting/)
    // A front that knows the PR but not this commit does not fall back to old Workers.
    await expect(
      resolver({
        front: Response.json({ error: 'not found' }, { status: 404 })
      }).run({ CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' })
    ).rejects.toThrow(/no ready Product PR Preview/)
    // The front's registry may also be configured explicitly.
    const explicit = resolver({ front: frontEnvelope, runtimeUrl: frontServices.deliveriesRuntime })
    expect(
      await explicit.run({
        CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account',
        BLUME_DEPLOYMENT_REGISTRY_URL: frontOrigin('blume-insights-control')
      })
    ).toEqual({ mode: 'preview', pullRequestNumber: pr, bundleId })
  })

  it('fails closed without a PR unless backends are explicit HTTPS origins', async () => {
    const none = resolver({ pullRequest: null })
    await expect(none.run({})).rejects.toThrow(/no resolvable PR preview/)
    expect(none.fetched).toEqual([])
    const env = {
      BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS: '1',
      BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT:
        'https://blume-dlv-runtime-bd-s-1-0-0-abc.release.blume-codes.com/',
      BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://auth.blume-codes.com'
    }
    const explicit = resolver({ pullRequest: null })
    expect(await explicit.run(env)).toEqual({
      mode: 'explicit',
      endpoint: 'https://blume-dlv-runtime-bd-s-1-0-0-abc.release.blume-codes.com'
    })
    expect(env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT).toBe(
      'https://blume-dlv-runtime-bd-s-1-0-0-abc.release.blume-codes.com'
    )
    expect(explicit.fetched).toEqual([])
    for (const missing of [
      { BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS: '1' },
      {
        BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS: '1',
        BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: 'http://127.0.0.1:6211',
        BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://auth.blume-codes.com'
      },
      {
        BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS: '1',
        BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT
      }
    ])
      await expect(resolver().run(missing)).rejects.toThrow(/explicit HTTPS origin/)
  })

  it('requires the preview account label and the exact PR registry before fetching', async () => {
    for (const env of [
      {},
      { CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account.evil.example' },
      {
        CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account',
        BLUME_DEPLOYMENT_REGISTRY_URL: origin('blume-insights-control').replace('1001', '1002')
      },
      {
        CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account',
        BLUME_DEPLOYMENT_REGISTRY_URL: 'https://agents.blume-codes.com'
      }
    ]) {
      const r = resolver()
      await expect(r.run(env)).rejects.toThrow(/CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN|exact PR/)
      expect(r.fetched).toEqual([])
    }
  })

  it('never selects a missing, cross-PR, production or stale preview set', async () => {
    const env = () => ({ CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN: 'account' })
    await expect(
      resolver({ manifest: new Response(null, { status: 404 }) }).run(env())
    ).rejects.toThrow(/no ready Product PR Preview/)
    await expect(
      resolver({
        manifest: envelope({
          deliveriesRuntime: 'https://blume-deliveries-runtime-pr-990.account.workers.dev'
        })
      }).run(env())
    ).rejects.toThrow(/deliveriesRuntime endpoint does not match its PR/)
    await expect(
      resolver({ manifest: envelope({ auth: 'https://auth.blume-codes.com' }) }).run(env())
    ).rejects.toThrow(/auth endpoint does not match its PR/)
    const withoutDeliveries = envelope()
    delete withoutDeliveries.manifest.services.deliveriesRuntime
    await expect(resolver({ manifest: withoutDeliveries }).run(env())).rejects.toThrow(
      /exactly these services/
    )
    await expect(
      resolver({
        runtimeHealth: health({
          channel: 'preview',
          bundleId: `preview-pr-${pr}-${'b'.repeat(40)}`,
          sourceSha: 'b'.repeat(40)
        })
      }).run(env())
    ).rejects.toThrow(/does not report/)
    await expect(
      resolver({ runtimeHealth: new Response(null, { status: 503 }) }).run(env())
    ).rejects.toThrow(/does not report/)
    const conflicting = { ...env(), BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://auth.blume-codes.com' }
    await expect(resolver().run(conflicting)).rejects.toThrow(/BLUME_AUTH_URL conflicts/)
    expect(conflicting.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('keeps configured defaults on main when no main candidate manifest exists', async () => {
    for (const status of [404, 500]) {
      const env = { BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://unchanged.example' }
      const r = resolver({
        pullRequest: null,
        branch: 'main',
        manifest: new Response(null, { status })
      })
      expect(await r.run(env)).toEqual({ mode: 'defaults' })
      expect(env.BLUME_AUTH_URL).toBe('https://unchanged.example')
    }
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/dev-process-guard.test.mjs">
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */

import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, utimesSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import {
  appendExitRecord,
  claimWrapper,
  descendantsOf,
  classifyElectronProcesses,
  devSandboxDir,
  isLiveWrapper,
  liveWrapper,
  markLaunched,
  parseProcessTable,
  readLaunched,
  readRecordedWrapper,
  releaseWrapper,
  wrapperRecordPath
} from '../../scripts/dev-process-guard.mjs'

const ROOT = '/work/wt-a/apps/desktop'
const ELECTRON = '/work/wt-a/node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron'
const HELPER = `${ELECTRON.replace('MacOS/Electron', 'Frameworks/Electron Helper.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron Helper')} --type=gpu-process --app-path=${ROOT}`

const tempDirs = []
afterEach(() => {
  for (const dir of tempDirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
})
const tempDir = () => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-dev-guard-'))
  tempDirs.push(dir)
  return dir
}

// pid ppid command: wrapper 100 → electron-vite 101 → Electron 102 → helper 103; a stray 200
// whose wrapper is gone (reparented to launchd); another checkout's Electron 300; the root
// `pnpm dev` launcher 500, whose command also contains scripts/dev.mjs.
const table = parseProcessTable(
  [
    '  100   500 node ./scripts/dev.mjs',
    '  101   100 node /work/wt-a/node_modules/.bin/electron-vite dev',
    `  102   101 ${ELECTRON} ${ROOT}`,
    `  103   102 ${HELPER}`,
    `  200     1 ${ELECTRON} ${ROOT}`,
    `  300     1 /work/wt-b/node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron /work/wt-b/apps/desktop`,
    '  400     1 /usr/bin/some-daemon',
    '  500     1 node scripts/dev.mjs'
  ].join('\n')
)
const cwds = { 100: ROOT, 500: '/work/wt-a' }
const cwdOf = (pid) => cwds[pid]

describe('dev process guard', () => {
  it('keeps logs in the HOME sandbox and the ownership claim in the checkout', () => {
    expect(devSandboxDir(ROOT, '/home/u')).toBe('/home/u/.blume/.dev/work_wt-a_apps_desktop')
    expect(wrapperRecordPath(ROOT)).toBe('/work/wt-a/apps/desktop/.dev/dev.pid')
  })

  it('counts a pid as a live wrapper only while it runs dev.mjs from this checkout', () => {
    expect(isLiveWrapper(100, { projectRoot: ROOT, table, cwdOf })).toBe(true)
    // The root launcher's command also contains scripts/dev.mjs, but it runs elsewhere.
    expect(isLiveWrapper(500, { projectRoot: ROOT, table, cwdOf })).toBe(false)
    expect(isLiveWrapper(400, { projectRoot: ROOT, table, cwdOf })).toBe(false)
    expect(isLiveWrapper(555, { projectRoot: ROOT, table, cwdOf })).toBe(false)
    // An unreadable working directory errs towards refusing, never towards killing.
    expect(isLiveWrapper(100, { projectRoot: ROOT, table, cwdOf: () => undefined })).toBe(true)
  })

  it("never classifies another live wrapper's app as a stray", () => {
    const { strays, owned } = classifyElectronProcesses(table, {
      projectRoot: ROOT,
      selfPid: 999,
      ownerPid: 100
    })
    expect(owned.map(({ pid }) => pid).sort()).toEqual([102, 103])
    expect(strays.map(({ pid }) => pid)).toEqual([200])
  })

  it('without a live owner, every Electron process of this checkout is a stray, and no other', () => {
    const { strays, owned } = classifyElectronProcesses(table, {
      projectRoot: ROOT,
      selfPid: 999,
      ownerPid: null
    })
    expect(owned).toEqual([])
    expect(strays.map(({ pid }) => pid).sort()).toEqual([102, 103, 200])
  })

  it('claims a checkout once, refuses a second wrapper and replaces a stale record', () => {
    const root = join(tempDir(), 'apps', 'desktop')
    const live = parseProcessTable(
      ['  100 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs', '  700 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs'].join('\n')
    )
    const here = () => root
    expect(claimWrapper(root, 100, { table: live, cwdOf: here })).toEqual({ ok: true })
    expect(claimWrapper(root, 700, { table: live, cwdOf: here })).toEqual({ ok: false, owner: 100 })
    expect(liveWrapper(root, { selfPid: 700, table: live, cwdOf: here })).toBe(100)
    // The owner is gone (or its pid now runs something else): the record is replaced.
    const after = parseProcessTable(
      ['  100 1 /usr/bin/other', '  700 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs'].join('\n')
    )
    expect(claimWrapper(root, 700, { table: after, cwdOf: here })).toEqual({ ok: true })
    expect(readRecordedWrapper(root)).toBe(700)
  })

  it('leaves a live record alone even when the reclaim lock is free, and clears an old lock', () => {
    const root = join(tempDir(), 'apps', 'desktop')
    const live = parseProcessTable(
      ['  100 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs', '  700 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs'].join('\n')
    )
    const here = () => root
    // A stale record and a reclaim lock left by a killed wrapper long ago.
    mkdirSync(join(root, '.dev'), { recursive: true })
    writeFileSync(wrapperRecordPath(root), '4242\n')
    writeFileSync(`${wrapperRecordPath(root)}.reclaim`, '')
    const old = new Date(Date.now() - 60_000)
    utimesSync(`${wrapperRecordPath(root)}.reclaim`, old, old)
    expect(claimWrapper(root, 100, { table: live, cwdOf: here })).toEqual({ ok: true })
    // Now the record is live: another wrapper is refused and nothing is reclaimed.
    expect(claimWrapper(root, 700, { table: live, cwdOf: here })).toEqual({ ok: false, owner: 100 })
    expect(readRecordedWrapper(root)).toBe(100)
  })

  it("lists a wrapper's whole process tree, deepest first", () => {
    expect(descendantsOf(100, table)).toEqual([103, 102, 101])
    expect(descendantsOf(400, table)).toEqual([])
  })

  it('is independent of HOME: a run with another HOME still sees the claim', () => {
    const root = join(tempDir(), 'apps', 'desktop')
    const live = parseProcessTable('  100 1 node ./scripts/dev.mjs')
    claimWrapper(root, 100, { table: live, cwdOf: () => root })
    const previousHome = process.env.HOME
    process.env.HOME = tempDir()
    try {
      expect(liveWrapper(root, { selfPid: 700, table: live, cwdOf: () => root })).toBe(100)
    } finally {
      process.env.HOME = previousHome
    }
  })

  it('releases the claim and launch marker only while they still name this wrapper', () => {
    const root = join(tempDir(), 'apps', 'desktop')
    mkdirSync(join(root, '.dev'), { recursive: true })
    writeFileSync(wrapperRecordPath(root), '100\n')
    markLaunched(root, 100)
    releaseWrapper(root, 101)
    expect(readRecordedWrapper(root)).toBe(100)
    expect(readLaunched(root)).toBe(100)
    releaseWrapper(root, 100)
    expect(readRecordedWrapper(root)).toBeNull()
    expect(readLaunched(root)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('appends one JSON record per stop', () => {
    const dir = tempDir()
    appendExitRecord(dir, { event: 'dev-stopped', signal: 'SIGHUP', phase: 'pre-launch' })
    appendExitRecord(dir, { event: 'dev-stopped', childExit: 0 })
    const lines = readFileSync(join(dir, 'dev-exits.log'), 'utf8').trim().split('\n')
    expect(lines.map((line) => JSON.parse(line).event)).toEqual(['dev-stopped', 'dev-stopped'])
    expect(JSON.parse(lines[0]).signal).toBe('SIGHUP')
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/embedded-terminal-host.test.ts">
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const handlers = {
    message: null as null | ((message: unknown) => void),
    exit: null as null | (() => void)
  }
  const worker = {
    on: vi.fn((event: string, handler: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
      if (event === 'message') handlers.message = handler as (message: unknown) => void
      if (event === 'exit') handlers.exit = handler as () => void
      return worker
    }),
    postMessage: vi.fn(),
    kill: vi.fn()
  }
  return { handlers, worker, fork: vi.fn(() => worker) }
})

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))

type TerminalHostModule = typeof import('../../src/main/terminal/host')
type BackgroundActivityModule = typeof import('../../src/main/backgroundProcessActivity')
let terminalHost: TerminalHostModule | null = null
let backgroundActivity: BackgroundActivityModule | null = null

function postedRequests(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
  return mocks.worker.postMessage.mock.calls.map(([message]) => message as Record<string, unknown>)
}

function respond(requestId: number, tabId: string): void {
  mocks.handlers.message?.({
    type: 'response',
    requestId,
    ok: true,
    tab: {
      id: tabId,
      harnessId: 'shell',
      title: 'Terminal',
      status: 'running',
      cwd: '/repo'
    }
  })
}

describe('embedded terminal worker host lifecycle', () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    vi.resetModules()
    vi.useRealTimers()
    mocks.handlers.message = null
    mocks.handlers.exit = null
    mocks.fork.mockClear()
    mocks.worker.on.mockClear()
    mocks.worker.postMessage.mockReset()
    mocks.worker.kill.mockReset()
    terminalHost = await import('../../src/main/terminal/host')
    backgroundActivity = await import('../../src/main/backgroundProcessActivity')
    backgroundActivity.resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
  })

  afterEach(() => {
    terminalHost?.disposeTerminalWorker()
    backgroundActivity?.resetBackgroundProcessActivity()
    terminalHost = null
    backgroundActivity = null
    vi.useRealTimers()
  })

  it('serializes opens so the eight-terminal capacity check is atomic', async () => {
    let tab = 0
    mocks.worker.postMessage.mockImplementation((message: { type: string; requestId: number }) => {
      if (message.type !== 'open') return
      const tabId = `tab-${++tab}`
      queueMicrotask(() => respond(message.requestId, tabId))
    })

    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      Array.from({ length: 9 }, () =>
        terminalHost!.openTerminalPage({ harnessId: 'shell', cwd: '/repo' })
      )
    )

    expect(results.filter((result) => result.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(8)
    expect(results.filter((result) => result.status === 'rejected')).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        reason: expect.objectContaining({ message: 'Blume supports at most 8 open terminals' })
      })
    ])
    expect(postedRequests().filter((request) => request.type === 'open')).toHaveLength(8)
  })

  it('terminates the worker on timeout and ignores a late open result', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] })
    const ipc = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>()
    terminalHost!.registerTerminalIpcHandlers(
      ((channel, handler) => ipc.set(channel, handler)) as never,
      { broadcast: vi.fn() }
    )

    const opening = terminalHost!.openTerminalPage({ harnessId: 'shell', cwd: '/repo' })
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(postedRequests()).toHaveLength(1))
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(1)
    const rejection = expect(opening).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'TerminalWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'Terminal worker timed out and was terminated'
    })
    await Promise.resolve()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(15_000)
    await rejection

    expect(mocks.worker.kill).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(0)
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'status',
      tab: {
        id: 'late-tab',
        harnessId: 'shell',
        title: 'Terminal',
        status: 'running',
        cwd: '/repo'
      }
    })
    expect(ipc.get('terminal:list')?.()).toEqual([])
  })

  it('keeps a tab until close is acknowledged while the worker is alive', async () => {
    const ipc = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>()
    terminalHost!.registerTerminalIpcHandlers(
      ((channel, handler) => ipc.set(channel, handler)) as never,
      { broadcast: vi.fn() }
    )
    const opening = terminalHost!.openTerminalPage({ harnessId: 'shell', cwd: '/repo' })
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(postedRequests()).toHaveLength(1))
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(1)
    respond(postedRequests()[0]!.requestId as number, 'close-me')
    await opening
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(0)

    const closing = ipc.get('terminal:close')?.({}, 'close-me') as Promise<void>
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(postedRequests()).toHaveLength(2))
    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'response',
      requestId: postedRequests()[1]!.requestId,
      ok: false,
      errorMessage: 'close failed'
    })

    await expect(closing).rejects.toThrow('close failed')
    expect(ipc.get('terminal:list')?.()).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ id: 'close-me', status: 'running' })
    ])
  })

  it('clears active request tracking when the terminal worker is disposed', async () => {
    const opening = terminalHost!.openTerminalPage({ harnessId: 'shell', cwd: '/repo' })
    const result = opening.catch((error: unknown) => error)
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(postedRequests()).toHaveLength(1))
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(1)

    terminalHost!.disposeTerminalWorker()

    await expect(result).resolves.toMatchObject({ message: 'Terminal worker disposed' })
    expect(backgroundActivity!.getBackgroundProcessActiveRequestCount('blume-terminal')).toBe(0)
  })

  it('buffers output when every attached renderer has been destroyed', async () => {
    const ipc = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>()
    terminalHost!.registerTerminalIpcHandlers(
      ((channel, handler) => ipc.set(channel, handler)) as never,
      { broadcast: vi.fn() }
    )
    const opening = terminalHost!.openTerminalPage({ harnessId: 'shell', cwd: '/repo' })
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(postedRequests()).toHaveLength(1))
    respond(postedRequests()[0]!.requestId as number, 'buffer-me')
    await opening

    const destroyed = { isDestroyed: () => true, send: vi.fn() }
    expect(ipc.get('terminal:attach')?.({ sender: destroyed }, 'buffer-me')).toBe('')
    mocks.handlers.message?.({ type: 'output', tabId: 'buffer-me', data: 'still here' })

    const live = { isDestroyed: () => false, send: vi.fn() }
    expect(ipc.get('terminal:attach')?.({ sender: live }, 'buffer-me')).toBe('still here')
    expect(destroyed.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const root = join(__dirname, '../..')
const host = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/main/terminal/host.ts'), 'utf8')
const worker = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/main/terminal/worker.ts'), 'utf8')
const preload = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/preload/index.ts'), 'utf8')
const resume = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/main/conversations/resume.ts'), 'utf8')
const devView = readFileSync(join(root, 'src/renderer/src/DevView.tsx'), 'utf8')
const webHost = readFileSync(join(root, '../../packages/sidecar/host-web/src/webHost.ts'), 'utf8')
const runnerController = readFileSync(
  join(root, '../../services/interactive-runner/src/sessionController.ts'),
  'utf8'
)
const runnerServer = readFileSync(
  join(root, '../../services/interactive-runner/src/server.ts'),
  'utf8'
)
// The app's main navigation is the rail.
const rail = readFileSync(join(root, '../../packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/rail.ts'), 'utf8')

describe('embedded terminal architecture', () => {
  test('records terminal worker timeouts as intentional background terminations', () => {
    expect(host).toContain('BLUME_BACKGROUND_PROCESS_SERVICES.terminal')
    expect(host).toContain('startBackgroundProcessRequest(')
    expect(host).toContain('finishBackgroundProcessRequest(')
    expect(host).toContain('terminateBackgroundProcess(')
  })

  test('keeps PTY execution in a utility process with bounded renderer messages', () => {
    expect(host).toMatch(/utilityProcess\.fork/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 64 \* 1024/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/MAX_BACKLOG_CHARS = 128 \* 1024/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/MAX_OUTPUT_CHUNK_CHARS = 16 \* 1024/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/data\.charCodeAt\(end - 1\)/)
    expect(preload).toMatch(/queuedChars > maxQueuedChars/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/ensureTerminalCapacity/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/serializeOpen/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/terminateBackgroundProcess\(next,/)
    expect(host).toMatch(/if \(worker !== next\) return/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/createLocalRuntime/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/runtime\.closeTerminal/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(
      /await runtime\.closeTerminal\(terminal\.handle\)[\s\S]*terminal\.detachStatus\(\)/
    )
    expect(worker).toMatch(/input\.harnessId === 'shell'/)
    expect(worker).toMatch(/`\$\{defaultShell\} -l`/)
    expect(worker).not.toMatch(/from ['"]electron['"]/)
  })

  test('replays bounded Web Lab output instead of dropping startup frames', () => {
    expect(webHost).toMatch(/maxTerminalBacklogChars = 128 \* 1024/)
    expect(webHost).toMatch(/mergeTerminalOutputSnapshot/)
    expect(runnerController).toMatch(/MAX_TERMINAL_BACKLOG_CHARS = 128 \* 1024/)
    expect(runnerController).toMatch(/terminalOutputSnapshots/)
    expect(runnerServer).toMatch(/Subscribe first, then replay the bounded per-tab backlog/)
  })

  test('conversation resumes request the embedded page without native terminal launchers', () => {
    expect(resume).toMatch(/openTerminalPage\(\{/)
    expect(resume).not.toMatch(/osascript/)
    expect(resume).not.toMatch(/wt\.exe/)
    expect(resume).not.toMatch(/cmd\.exe/)
  })

  test('exposes the terminal from diagnostics without adding a general navigation action', () => {
    expect(devView).toMatch(/title="Embedded terminal"/)
    expect(devView).toMatch(/<DevTerminalPage onBack=\{goMenu\}/)
    expect(rail).not.toMatch(/open-terminal/)
    expect(rail).not.toMatch(/terminal\.openPage/)
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/evidence-pins-scan.test.ts">
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { test } from 'vitest'

import { EVIDENCE_PIN_LIMITS } from '@blume/app-core'

import {
  EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH,
  evidencePinScanOrder,
  resolveEvidencePinDirectory,
  resolveEvidencePinRoots
} from '../../src/main/conversations/evidencePins'

const pin = (sessionId: string) =>
  JSON.stringify({
    quote: 'please stop renaming my variables',
    harness: 'claude',
    sessionId,
    recordedAt: 1
  })

/** Only `session-ok` is parsed on this computer; every other pin's conversation is missing. */
function references(lookups: string[]) {
  return {
    async findConversationBySession(harness: string, sessionId: string) {
      lookups.push(sessionId)
      return sessionId === 'session-ok'
        ? { id: 1, ref: `${harness}:${sessionId}`, harness, sessionId }
        : null
    },
    async listConversationMessages() {
      return [
        {
          messageId: 'm1',
          eventId: 1,
          turnPosition: 0,
          role: 'user' as const,
          text: 'Please stop renaming my variables',
          timestampMs: null
        }
      ]
    },
    async upsertConversationLink() {}
  }
}

test('scan order resumes after the cursor and wraps to the start', () => {
  const names = ['c.json', 'a.json', 'notes.txt', 'b.json']
  assert.deepEqual(evidencePinScanOrder(names, null), ['a.json', 'b.json', 'c.json'])
  assert.deepEqual(evidencePinScanOrder(names, 'a.json'), ['b.json', 'c.json', 'a.json'])
  assert.deepEqual(evidencePinScanOrder(names, 'c.json'), ['a.json', 'b.json', 'c.json'])
  assert.deepEqual(
    evidencePinScanOrder(names, 'bb.json'),
    ['c.json', 'a.json', 'b.json'],
    'a deleted cursor still resumes in order'
  )
})

test('pins that never resolve cannot hide a later pin from the bounded scan', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-pins-'))
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < EVIDENCE_PIN_LIMITS.files; i++)
      await writeFile(
        join(directory, `sig_a${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.json`),
        pin(`deleted-${i}`)
      )
    await writeFile(join(directory, 'sig_z_valid.json'), pin('session-ok'))
    const lookups: string[] = []
    let cursor: string | null = null
    const found: string[] = []
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 3 && !found.length; pass++) {
      const result = await resolveEvidencePinDirectory({
        directory,
        completed: [],
        references: references(lookups),
        cursor
      })
      cursor = result.cursor
      found.push(...result.resolved.map((r) => r.signalId))
    }
    assert.deepEqual(found, ['sig_z_valid'], 'the valid pin resolves on a later pass')
    assert.ok(lookups.includes('session-ok'))
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test('resolved pins beyond one refresh share come first in the next pass', async () => {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-pins-'))
  try {
    const total = EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH + 5
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++)
      await writeFile(join(directory, `sig_${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.json`), pin('session-ok'))
    const first = await resolveEvidencePinDirectory({
      directory,
      completed: [],
      references: references([]),
      cursor: null
    })
    assert.equal(first.resolved.length, EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH)
    const second = await resolveEvidencePinDirectory({
      directory,
      completed: [],
      references: references([]),
      cursor: first.cursor
    })
    assert.deepEqual(
      second.resolved.slice(0, 5).map((r) => r.signalId),
      Array.from(
        { length: 5 },
        (_, i) => `sig_${String(EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH + i).padStart(3, '0')}`
      )
    )
  } finally {
    await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test('app and shared pins keep independent cursors within the same completion budget', async () => {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-roots-'))
  try {
    const app = join(root, 'dev', 'evidence-pins')
    const shared = join(root, 'evidence-pins')
    await mkdir(app, { recursive: true })
    await mkdir(shared)
    for (const [name, directory] of [
      ['dev', app],
      ['shared', shared]
    ])
      for (let index = 0; index < 15; index++)
        await writeFile(
          join(directory, `sig_${name}_${String(index).padStart(2, '0')}.json`),
          pin('session-ok')
        )
    const input = {
      blumeRoot: join(root, 'dev'),
      sharedDirectory: shared,
      completed: [],
      references: references([])
    }
    const first = await resolveEvidencePinRoots(input)
    const second = await resolveEvidencePinRoots({ ...input, cursor: first.cursor })
    assert.equal(first.resolved.length, EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH)
    assert.equal(second.resolved.length, EVIDENCE_PINS_PER_REFRESH)
    assert.equal(
      new Set([...first.resolved, ...second.resolved].map((item) => item.signalId)).size,
      30
    )
    for (const result of [first, second]) {
      assert.equal(
        result.resolved.filter((item) => item.signalId.startsWith('sig_dev_')).length,
        10
      )
      assert.equal(
        result.resolved.filter((item) => item.signalId.startsWith('sig_shared_')).length,
        10
      )
    }
  } finally {
    await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test('unresolvable pins in both roots cannot starve later pins or exceed the read budget', async () => {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-root-budget-'))
  try {
    const app = join(root, 'dev', 'evidence-pins')
    const shared = join(root, 'evidence-pins')
    await mkdir(app, { recursive: true })
    await mkdir(shared)
    for (const directory of [app, shared]) {
      for (let index = 0; index < EVIDENCE_PIN_LIMITS.files / 2; index++)
        await writeFile(
          join(directory, `sig_a${String(index).padStart(3, '0')}.json`),
          pin(`missing-${index}`)
        )
      await writeFile(
        join(directory, directory === app ? 'sig_z_dev.json' : 'sig_z_shared.json'),
        pin('session-ok')
      )
    }
    const lookups: string[] = []
    const input = {
      blumeRoot: join(root, 'dev'),
      sharedDirectory: shared,
      completed: [],
      references: references(lookups)
    }
    const first = await resolveEvidencePinRoots(input)
    assert.deepEqual(first.resolved, [])
    assert.equal(lookups.length, EVIDENCE_PIN_LIMITS.files)
    lookups.length = 0
    const second = await resolveEvidencePinRoots({ ...input, cursor: first.cursor })
    assert.deepEqual(
      second.resolved.map((item) => item.signalId),
      ['sig_z_dev', 'sig_z_shared']
    )
    assert.equal(lookups.length, EVIDENCE_PIN_LIMITS.files)
  } finally {
    await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test('a legacy filename cursor still resumes the shared root when an app root is added', async () => {
  const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-legacy-cursor-'))
  try {
    await writeFile(join(root, 'sig_a.json'), pin('session-ok'))
    await writeFile(join(root, 'sig_b.json'), pin('session-ok'))
    const result = await resolveEvidencePinRoots({
      blumeRoot: join(root, 'dev'),
      sharedDirectory: root,
      completed: [],
      references: references([]),
      cursor: 'sig_a.json'
    })
    assert.deepEqual(
      result.resolved.map((item) => item.signalId),
      ['sig_b', 'sig_a']
    )
  } finally {
    await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})
