import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

import { createConversationIngestRuntime, describeProjectPath } from '@blume/app-core'
import type { ProviderProjectionParsedConversation as ParsedConversation } from '@blume/conversations-model'

/** Build the smallest parsed conversation shape needed to exercise ingest identity. */
function parsedConversation(input: {
  ref: string
  cwd: string
  projectName: string
  projectRoot: string
  workspaceName?: string
}): ParsedConversation {
  return {
    sourcePath: `/sessions/${input.ref}.jsonl`,
    sourceMtimeMs: 1,
    sourceSize: 1,
    conv: {
      id: input.ref,
      source: 'codex',
      project: input.cwd,
      ref: input.ref,
      lastActivityTs: 1,
      cwd: input.cwd,
      projectName: input.projectName,
      projectRoot: input.projectRoot,
      workspaceName: input.workspaceName,
      workspaceKind: '.codex',
      preview: '',
      state: 'finished'
    },
    transcript: {
      messages: [],
      toolCalls: [],
      todoLists: [],
      userTurns: []
    }
  }
}

describe('Codex project identity', () => {
  test('global worktrees share a stable project root while keeping worktree ids', async () => {
    vi.resetModules()

    const first = describeProjectPath('/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/011f/quick-start-sidecar')
    const second = describeProjectPath('/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/055e/quick-start-sidecar')
    const workspace = describeProjectPath('/Users/me/.codex/workspaces/099a/quick-start-sidecar')

    expect(first.projectRoot).toBe('/Users/me/.codex/projects/quick-start-sidecar')
    expect(second.projectRoot).toBe(first.projectRoot)
    expect(workspace.projectRoot).toBe(first.projectRoot)
    expect(first.project).toBe('quick-start-sidecar')
    expect(second.project).toBe('quick-start-sidecar')
    expect(workspace.project).toBe('quick-start-sidecar')
    expect(first.worktree).toBe('011f')
    expect(second.worktree).toBe('055e')
    expect(workspace.worktree).toBe('099a')
    expect(first.display).toBe('quick-start-sidecar · 011f')
    expect(second.display).toBe('quick-start-sidecar · 055e')
    expect(workspace.display).toBe('quick-start-sidecar · 099a')
  })

  test('ingest stores conversations from global worktrees under one project row', async () => {
    vi.resetModules()
    const projects = new Map<string, { id: number; path: string; name: string }>()
    const conversations: { ref: string; projectId: number | null; workspace: string | null }[] = []

    const ingest = createConversationIngestRuntime({
      sourceCursors: {
        getSourceCursor: async () => null,
        upsertSourceCursor: async () => undefined
      },
      conversations: {
        getSkippedConversation: async () => null,
        applySkippedConversationUpdate: async () => undefined,
        replaceConversation: async (input: {
          project: { path: string; name: string }
          conversation: { ref: string; workspace?: string | null }
        }) => {
          const existing = projects.get(input.project.path)
          const project =
            existing ??
            (() => {
              const created = {
                id: projects.size + 1,
                path: input.project.path,
                name: input.project.name
              }
              projects.set(input.project.path, created)
              return created
            })()
          conversations.push({
            ref: input.conversation.ref,
            projectId: project.id,
            workspace: input.conversation.workspace ?? null
          })
          return {
            conversationId: conversations.length,
            projectId: project.id,
            sourceId: 1
          }
        }
      },
      isSelfRunPath: () => false,
      applyDeferredOverrides: () => undefined,
      now: () => Date.now()
    })

    const first = describeProjectPath('/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/011f/quick-start-sidecar')
    const second = describeProjectPath('/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/055e/quick-start-sidecar')

    await ingest.ingestConversation(
      parsedConversation({
        ref: 'codex-worktree-011f',
        cwd: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/011f/quick-start-sidecar',
        projectName: first.project,
        projectRoot: first.projectRoot,
        workspaceName: first.worktree
      })
    )
    await ingest.ingestConversation(
      parsedConversation({
        ref: 'codex-worktree-055e',
        cwd: '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/055e/quick-start-sidecar',
        projectName: second.project,
        projectRoot: second.projectRoot,
        workspaceName: second.worktree
      })
    )

    expect(conversations).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(conversations[0].projectId).toBe(conversations[1].projectId)
    expect(conversations.map((row) => row.workspace)).toEqual(['011f', '055e'])
    expect([...projects.values()]).toEqual([
      {
        id: conversations[0].projectId,
        path: '/Users/me/.codex/projects/quick-start-sidecar',
        name: 'quick-start-sidecar'
      }
    ])
  })

  test('ingest skip path projects Cursor todo and cursor updates through shared storage', async () => {
    vi.resetModules()

    const sourceCursorWrites: unknown[] = []

    })

        messages: [],
        toolCalls: [],
        userTurns: [{ position: 3, prompt: 'do it', state: 'finished' }],
        todoLists: [
          {
            source: 'composer',
            todos: [{ position: 0, content: 'ship it', state: 'current' }]
          }
        ],
        sourceBytesParsed: 100

    expect(skippedUpdates).toEqual([

        },

    expect(sourceCursorWrites).toEqual([

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
import type { Project, WorkspaceLocation } from '@blume/projects-identity'
import type { ProjectSetupSummary } from '@blume/setup-model'
import type { DesktopProjectRow } from '@blume/storage-port'

const state = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  projects: [] as DesktopProjectRow[],
  canonicalProjects: [] as Project[],
  workspaces: [] as WorkspaceLocation[],
  summaries: new Map<string, ProjectSetupSummary>(),
  requestedPaths: [] as string[],
  desktopListCalls: 0,
  exactGetCalls: 0,
  canonicalLookupCalls: 0,
  workspaceLookupCalls: 0,
  summaryLookupCalls: 0
}))

vi.mock('../../src/main/db/storage', () => ({
  getStorage: () => ({
    desktopProjects: {
      listProjects: async () => {
        state.desktopListCalls += 1
        return state.projects
      },
      listRecentProjects: async (limit = 5) => state.projects.slice(0, limit),
      getProject: async (id: number) => {
        state.exactGetCalls += 1
        return state.projects.find((project) => project.id === id) ?? null
      }
    },
    projects: {
      listProjectsByRoots: async (roots: string[]) => {
        state.canonicalLookupCalls += 1
        const selected = new Set(roots)
        return state.canonicalProjects.filter((project) =>
          selected.has(project.kind === 'git' ? project.repoRoot : project.root)
        )
      },
      listWorkspaceLocationsForProjects: async (projectIds: string[]) => {
        state.workspaceLookupCalls += 1
        const selected = new Set(projectIds)
        return state.workspaces.filter((workspace) => selected.has(workspace.projectId))
      }
    },
    projectSetupSummaries: {
      listForWorkspacePaths: async (paths: string[]) => {
        state.summaryLookupCalls += 1
        state.requestedPaths = paths
        return paths.flatMap((path) => {
          const summary = state.summaries.get(path)
          return summary ? [summary] : []
        })
      }
    }
  })
}))

// The refresh worker answers db:projects:listRecent with the same enrichment over its own handle.
vi.mock('../../src/main/conversations/refreshHost', async () => {
  const { withProjectSetupSummaries } = await import('@blume/app-core')
  const { getStorage } = await import('../../src/main/db/storage')
  return {
    listRecentProjectsViaWorker: async (limit = 5) => {
      const storage = getStorage() as never as Parameters<typeof withProjectSetupSummaries>[0] & {
        desktopProjects: { listRecentProjects(limit: number): Promise<DesktopProjectRow[]> }
      }
      return withProjectSetupSummaries(
        storage,
        await storage.desktopProjects.listRecentProjects(limit)
      )
    }
  }
})

import { registerDesktopDbIpcHandlers } from '../../src/main/db/ipc'

type Handler = (event: never, ...args: any[]) => any

function summary(workspacePath: string): ProjectSetupSummary {
  return {
    workspacePath,
    skills: 2,
    agents: 0,
    commands: 0,
    hooks: 0,
    rules: 1,
    totalEntries: 3,
    scannedAt: 123
  }
}

describe('project setup summary IPC hydration', () => {
  const handlers = new Map<string, Handler>()

  beforeEach(() => {
    handlers.clear()
    state.projects = []
    state.canonicalProjects = []
    state.workspaces = []
    state.summaries.clear()
    state.requestedPaths = []
    state.desktopListCalls = 0
    state.exactGetCalls = 0
    state.canonicalLookupCalls = 0
    state.workspaceLookupCalls = 0
    state.summaryLookupCalls = 0
    registerDesktopDbIpcHandlers((channel, listener) => handlers.set(channel, listener))
  })

  test('hydrates the summary for the display workspace without assigning it to the project key', async () => {
    const root = '/Users/me/.codex/projects/blume'
    const worktree = '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/abcd/blume'
    state.projects = [
      {
        id: 1,
        path: root,
        display_path: worktree,
        name: 'blume',
        git_remote: null,
        created_at: 1,
        updated_at: 2
      }
    ]
    state.summaries.set(worktree, summary(worktree))

    const rows = await handlers.get('db:projects:listRecent')?.({} as never, 5)

    expect(state.requestedPaths).toEqual([root, worktree])
    expect(rows).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        path: root,
        display_path: worktree,
        setup_summary: expect.objectContaining({ workspacePath: worktree, totalEntries: 3 })
      })
    ])
  })

  test('hydrates all cached canonical worktrees for a desktop project row', async () => {
    const root = '/Users/me/code/blume'
    const first = '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/aaaa/blume'
    const second = '/Users/me/.codex/worktrees/bbbb/blume'
    state.projects = [
      {
        id: 1,
        path: root,
        display_path: second,
        name: 'blume',
        git_remote: null,
        created_at: 1,
        updated_at: 2
      }
    ]
    state.canonicalProjects = [
      { kind: 'git', id: 'git-blume', repoRoot: root, gitCommonDir: `${root}/.git` }
    ]
    state.workspaces = [
      { id: 'root', projectId: 'git-blume', path: root, kind: 'repo-root' },
      { id: 'first', projectId: 'git-blume', path: first, kind: 'worktree' },
      { id: 'second', projectId: 'git-blume', path: second, kind: 'worktree' }
    ]
    state.summaries.set(first, summary(first))

    const rows = await handlers.get('db:projects:list')?.({} as never)

    expect(rows?.[0].workspace_locations).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ id: 'root', path: root, kind: 'repo-root' }),
      expect.objectContaining({
        id: 'first',
        path: first,
        kind: 'worktree',
        setup_summary: expect.objectContaining({ workspacePath: first })
      }),
      expect.objectContaining({ id: 'second', path: second, kind: 'worktree' })
    ])
  })

  test('returns one exact desktop project without list or setup-summary hydration', async () => {
    const root = '/Users/me/code/blume'
    state.projects = [
      {
        id: 1,
        path: root,
        display_path: null,
        name: 'blume',
        git_remote: null,
        created_at: 1,
        updated_at: 2
      },
      {
        id: 2,
        path: '/Users/me/code/other',
        display_path: null,
        name: 'other',
        git_remote: null,
        created_at: 1,
        updated_at: 2
      }
    ]
    const row = await handlers.get('db:projects:get')?.({} as never, 1)

    expect(row).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        id: 1,
        path: root,
        name: 'blume'
      })
    )
    expect(row).not.toHaveProperty('setup_summary')
    expect(state.exactGetCalls).toBe(1)
    expect(state.desktopListCalls).toBe(0)
    expect(state.canonicalLookupCalls).toBe(0)
    expect(state.workspaceLookupCalls).toBe(0)
    expect(state.summaryLookupCalls).toBe(0)
    expect(state.requestedPaths).toEqual([])
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/raycast-search-helper.test.ts">
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

import { GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES } from '@blume/storage-port'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import {
  createLatestOnlyLineQueue,
  createRaycastSearchLineFramer,
  parseRaycastSearchRequest,
  RAYCAST_SEARCH_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
} from '../../src/main/raycastSearchProtocol'

describe('Raycast search helper protocol', () => {
  test('keeps the standalone Raycast wire contract aligned with the desktop helper', () => {
    const raycastProtocol = readFileSync(
      new URL('../../../raycast/src/protocol.ts', import.meta.url),
      'utf8'
    )
    expect(raycastProtocol).toContain('RAYCAST_SEARCH_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1')
    expect(raycastProtocol).toContain('RAYCAST_SEARCH_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 8 * 1024')
    for (const category of GLOBAL_SEARCH_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(raycastProtocol).toContain(`"${category}"`)
    }
    for (const field of ['version: 1', 'type: "search"', 'id: number', 'query: string']) {
      expect(raycastProtocol).toContain(field)
    }
    for (const responseType of ['type: "ready"', 'type: "search-result"']) {
      expect(raycastProtocol).toContain(responseType)
    }
  })

  test('accepts bounded shared search requests', () => {
    expect(
      parseRaycastSearchRequest(
        JSON.stringify({
          version: 1,
          type: 'search',
          id: 7,
          query: '  project search  ',
          categories: ['projects', 'messages', 'unknown']
        })
      )
    ).toEqual({
      version: 1,
      type: 'search',
      id: 7,
      query: '  project search  ',
      categories: ['projects', 'messages']
    })
  })

  test('rejects malformed and oversized requests', () => {
    expect(() => parseRaycastSearchRequest('{}')).toThrow(/Invalid Raycast search request/)
    expect(() =>
      parseRaycastSearchRequest(
        JSON.stringify({
          version: 1,
          type: 'search',
          id: 1,
          query: 'x'.repeat(9 * 1024),
          categories: ['projects']
        })
      )
    ).toThrow(/too large/)
  })

  test('bounds raw stdin framing before a complete line is allocated', () => {
    const lines: string[] = []
    let oversized = 0
    const framer = createRaycastSearchLineFramer(
      (line) => lines.push(line),
      () => oversized++
    )
    framer.push(Buffer.alloc(RAYCAST_SEARCH_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, 120))
    framer.push(Buffer.from('x\nvalid\n'))
    framer.push(Buffer.from('crlf\r\n'))
    framer.push(Buffer.from('tail'))
    framer.end()
    expect(oversized).toBe(1)
    expect(lines).toEqual(['valid', 'crlf', 'tail'])
  })

  test('coalesces a request burst to the newest pending search', async () => {
    const ran: string[] = []
    const superseded: string[] = []
    let releaseFirst: (() => void) | undefined
    const first = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      releaseFirst = resolve
    })
    const queue = createLatestOnlyLineQueue(
      async (line) => {
        ran.push(line)
        if (line === 'first') await first
      },
      (line) => superseded.push(line)
    )
    queue.submit('first')
    queue.submit('second')
    queue.submit('latest')
    releaseFirst?.()
    await queue.close()
    expect(ran).toEqual(['first', 'latest'])
    expect(superseded).toEqual(['second'])
  })

  test('continues after a queued search rejects and still closes', async () => {
    const ran: string[] = []
    const failures: string[] = []
    const queue = createLatestOnlyLineQueue(
      async (line) => {
        ran.push(line)
        if (line === 'first') throw new Error('broken search')
      },
      () => undefined,
      (error) => failures.push(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
    )
    queue.submit('first')
    queue.submit('second')
    await queue.close()
    expect(ran).toEqual(['first', 'second'])
    expect(failures).toEqual(['broken search'])
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/referral-error-reporting-policy.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

import { reportReferralBackgroundFailure } from '../../src/main/referralErrorReportingPolicy'

function undiciFetchFailed(cause: Error): TypeError {
  const wrapper = new TypeError('fetch failed')
  ;(wrapper as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause
  return wrapper
}

function nodeSystemError(code: string, message: string, hostname?: string): Error {
  const error = new Error(message)
  ;(error as { code?: string }).code = code
  if (hostname !== undefined) (error as { hostname?: string }).hostname = hostname
  return error
}

describe('referral background error reporting policy', () => {
  it('does not captureAppError for referrals DNS / fetch / abort network noise', () => {
    const captureAppError = vi.fn()
    const logInfo = vi.fn()
    const cases: unknown[] = [
      undiciFetchFailed(
        nodeSystemError(
          'ENOTFOUND',
          'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND referrals.blume-page.com',
          'referrals.blume-page.com'
        )
      ),
      new TypeError('fetch failed'),
      nodeSystemError('ECONNRESET', 'socket hang up'),
      nodeSystemError('ETIMEDOUT', 'connect ETIMEDOUT'),
      Object.assign(new Error('This operation was aborted'), { name: 'AbortError' }),
      Object.assign(new Error('The operation was aborted due to timeout'), {
        name: 'TimeoutError'
      })
    ]

    for (const error of cases) {
      captureAppError.mockClear()
      logInfo.mockClear()
      reportReferralBackgroundFailure('main.referral-activation', error, {
        captureAppError,
        logInfo
      })
      expect(captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(logInfo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'expected referral activation service failure',
        expect.objectContaining({ reporting_action: 'local_log_only' })
      )
    }
  })

  it('still captures unexpected referral background failures', () => {
    const captureAppError = vi.fn()
    const unexpected = new Error('referrals /activate -> 500')

    reportReferralBackgroundFailure('main.referral-claim', unexpected, {
      captureAppError,
      logInfo: vi.fn()
    })

    expect(captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith('main.referral-claim', unexpected)
  })
})

describe('renderer bootstrap preload guard', () => {
  test('checks the Electron bridge before initializing PostHog and does not retry on failure', () => {
    const bootstrapStart = MAIN_SOURCE.indexOf('async function bootstrap()')
    const missingPreloadGuard = MAIN_SOURCE.indexOf('if (!window.api)', bootstrapStart)
    const posthogInitialization = MAIN_SOURCE.indexOf('await initPosthog(', bootstrapStart)
    const failureHandler = MAIN_SOURCE.slice(MAIN_SOURCE.indexOf('void bootstrap().catch'))

    expect(bootstrapStart).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
    expect(missingPreloadGuard).toBeGreaterThan(bootstrapStart)
    expect(posthogInitialization).toBeGreaterThan(missingPreloadGuard)
    expect(failureHandler).not.toContain('initPosthog(')
  })

  test('refreshes the PostHog identity when the desktop account changes', () => {
    expect(MAIN_SOURCE).toMatch(
      /electronSidecarHost\.account\.onChanged\(\(\) => \{\s*void syncPosthogIdentity\(\)/
    )
  })

  '../../../../packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/SidecarApp.tsx',
  import.meta.url
)

  new URL(`../../../../packages/sidecar/ui/src/shell/${path}`, import.meta.url)
const conversationResourceUrl = new URL(

  import.meta.url

  const [app, sidecarApp, conversationRoute, conversationResource] = await Promise.all([
    readFile(appUrl, 'utf8'),
    readFile(sidecarAppUrl, 'utf8'),
    readFile(shellUrl('pages/ConversationRoute.tsx'), 'utf8'),
    readFile(conversationResourceUrl, 'utf8')

  assert.doesNotMatch(electronApp, /const \[items, setItems\]/)
  assert.doesNotMatch(electronApp, /api\.onConversationsChanged\(/)

  assert.match(setupView, /const projects = useHostResource<ProjectView\[\]>/)

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import {
  RESIZE_OBSERVER_LOOP_MESSAGES,
  isResizeObserverLoopError,
  shouldReportResizeObserverAppError
} from '../../src/renderer/src/lib/resizeObserverErrorPolicy'

describe('resize observer loop error policy', () => {
  it('classifies well-known Chromium ResizeObserver loop messages as non-reportable', () => {
    for (const message of RESIZE_OBSERVER_LOOP_MESSAGES) {
      expect(isResizeObserverLoopError(message)).toBe(true)
      expect(isResizeObserverLoopError(new Error(message))).toBe(true)
      expect(shouldReportResizeObserverAppError(message)).toBe(false)
      expect(shouldReportResizeObserverAppError(new Error(message))).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('still reports unrelated errors and near-miss messages', () => {
    const unrelated = [
      new Error('layout failed'),
      'ResizeObserver',
      'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications',
      'ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded!',
      new Error('ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications. '),
      null,
      undefined,
      42
    ]

    for (const value of unrelated) {
      expect(isResizeObserverLoopError(value)).toBe(false)
      expect(shouldReportResizeObserverAppError(value)).toBe(true)
    }
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/scan-root.test.ts">
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

/**
 * isUnsafeScanRoot guards against scanning / watching the macOS home folder or
 * any of its ancestors (which hold every harness's global config plus huge
 * unrelated trees). Real projects live *inside* home and must stay scannable.
 */
describe('isUnsafeScanRoot', () => {
  test('blocks the home folder and its ancestors, allows real projects', async () => {
    vi.resetModules()
    vi.doMock('os', async () => {
      const actual = await vi.importActual<typeof import('os')>('os')
      return { ...actual, homedir: () => '/Users/testuser' }
    })

    try {
      const { isUnsafeScanRoot } = await import('../../src/main/setup')

      // Home itself — including non-normalized forms — is too broad to scan.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/testuser')).toBe(true)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/testuser/')).toBe(true)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/testuser/../testuser')).toBe(true)

      // Ancestors of home are even broader.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users')).toBe(true)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/')).toBe(true)

      // Real repos inside home, sibling homes, and unrelated paths are fine.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/testuser/code/demo')).toBe(false)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/testuser/.cursor/skills/x')).toBe(false)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/Users/otheruser')).toBe(false)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('/tmp/proj')).toBe(false)
    } finally {
      vi.doUnmock('os')
    }
  })

  test('handles Windows drives — blocks home, allows same- and cross-drive projects', async () => {
    vi.resetModules()
    vi.doMock('os', async () => {
      const actual = await vi.importActual<typeof import('os')>('os')
      return { ...actual, homedir: () => 'C:\\Users\\testuser' }
    })
    // Force win32 path semantics so resolve/relative/isAbsolute behave as they
    // would on Windows (drive letters, backslashes, cross-drive relative()).
    vi.doMock('path', async () => {
      const actual = await vi.importActual<typeof import('path')>('path')
      return { ...actual.win32, default: actual.win32 }
    })

    try {
      const { isUnsafeScanRoot } = await import('../../src/main/setup')

      // Home and its ancestors on the home drive are still too broad.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('C:\\Users\\testuser')).toBe(true)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('C:\\Users')).toBe(true)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('C:\\')).toBe(true)

      // A real project on the home drive is fine.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('C:\\Users\\testuser\\code\\demo')).toBe(false)

      // A project on a different drive can't be home or an ancestor of it, so
      // it must stay scannable — even though relative() returns an absolute
      // path across drives.
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('D:\\proj')).toBe(false)
      expect(isUnsafeScanRoot('D:\\')).toBe(false)
    } finally {
      vi.doUnmock('path')
      vi.doUnmock('os')
    }
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/search-index-host.test.ts">
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  fork: vi.fn(),
  captureAppError: vi.fn(async () => undefined)
}))

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db', () => ({ getDbPath: () => '/tmp/blume-search-index-test.sqlite' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/telemetry', () => ({ captureAppError: mocks.captureAppError }))

class FakeWorker extends EventEmitter {
  posted: Array<{ type: string; id: number; commits: boolean }> = []
  killed = false
  postMessage(message: { type: string; id: number; commits: boolean }): void {
    this.posted.push(message)
  }
  kill(): boolean {
    this.killed = true
    return true
  }
}

const progress = {
  phase: 'backfill',
  backfilledRows: 5000,
  backfillDone: false,
  repositories: 0,
  commits: 0,
  errors: 0
}

describe('desktop search index host', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules()
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    mocks.fork.mockReset()
    mocks.captureAppError.mockClear()
  })
  afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())

  it('waits for startup to settle, then runs one pass at a time on an interval', async () => {
    const workers: FakeWorker[] = []
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => {
      const worker = new FakeWorker()
      workers.push(worker)
      return worker
    })
    const host = await import('../../src/main/search/searchIndexHost')
    const { SEARCH_INDEX_START_DELAY_MS, SEARCH_INDEX_INTERVAL_MS } =
      await import('@blume/app-core/features/search/searchIndexing')
    host.startSearchIndexing()
    expect(mocks.fork).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(SEARCH_INDEX_START_DELAY_MS)
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(workers[0]?.posted[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'run', commits: true })
    // A pass is running: no second worker.
    expect(host.runSearchIndexPassNow()).toBe(false)
    const id = workers[0]!.posted[0]!.id
    workers[0]!.emit('message', { type: 'done', id, ok: true, progress, durationMs: 10 })
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(SEARCH_INDEX_INTERVAL_MS)
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    host.disposeSearchIndexing()
    expect(workers[1]?.posted.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'stop' })
    expect(workers[1]?.killed).toBe(true)
    // A pass that finished is not asked to stop.
    expect(workers[0]?.posted.some((message) => message.type === 'stop')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('heartbeats keep a long pass alive; silence stops it and cools down', async () => {
    const worker = new FakeWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockReturnValue(worker)
    const host = await import('../../src/main/search/searchIndexHost')
    expect(host.runSearchIndexPassNow()).toBe(true)
    const id = worker.posted[0]!.id
    for (let beat = 0; beat < 3; beat += 1) {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(host.SEARCH_INDEX_INACTIVITY_MS - 1_000)
      worker.emit('message', { type: 'progress', id, progress })
    }
    expect(worker.killed).toBe(false)
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(host.SEARCH_INDEX_INACTIVITY_MS)
    expect(worker.killed).toBe(true)
    // Asked to stop first, so the worker aborts and kills its Git subprocess (as SIGTERM does).
    expect(worker.posted.at(-1)).toEqual({ type: 'stop', id })
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'main.search.index_worker_failed',
      expect.any(Error),
      { phase: 'timeout', main_process_fallback: false }
    )
    expect(host.runSearchIndexPassNow()).toBe(false)
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(host.SEARCH_INDEX_RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS)
    expect(host.runSearchIndexPassNow()).toBe(true)
    host.disposeSearchIndexing()
  })
})

<file path="__test/regressions/search-worker-host.test.ts">
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import type { GlobalSearchPage, GlobalSearchQuery } from '@blume/storage-port'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  fork: vi.fn(),
  captureAppError: vi.fn(async () => undefined)
}))

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db', () => ({ getDbPath: () => '/tmp/blume-search-test.sqlite' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/telemetry', () => ({ captureAppError: mocks.captureAppError }))

class FakeWorker extends EventEmitter {
  posted: Array<{ type: string; id: number }> = []
  killed = false
  postMessage(message: { type: string; id: number }): void {
    this.posted.push(message)
  }
  kill(): boolean {
    this.killed = true
    return true
  }
  answer(id: number, page: GlobalSearchPage): void {
    this.emit('message', { type: 'search-result', id, ok: true, page })
  }
}

const input: GlobalSearchQuery = { query: 'worker', categories: ['messages'] }
const page = (title: string): GlobalSearchPage => ({
  results: [
    {
      id: title,
      category: 'suggestions',
      title,
      subtitle: null,
      excerpt: null,
      rank: 0,
      updatedAt: 0,
      suggestionId: title,
      status: 'active'
    }
  ],
  truncated: false
})

describe('desktop search worker host', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules()
    mocks.fork.mockReset()
    mocks.captureAppError.mockClear()
  })
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers()
  })

  it('cools down and emits bounded telemetry after worker spawn failure', async () => {
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('worker unavailable')
    })
    const { searchViaUtilityProcess } = await import('../../src/main/search/searchHost')

    await expect(searchViaUtilityProcess(input)).rejects.toThrow('worker unavailable')
    await expect(searchViaUtilityProcess(input)).rejects.toThrow('circuit breaker is cooling down')

    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'main.search.worker_unavailable',
      expect.any(Error),
      { phase: 'spawn', main_process_fallback: false }
    )
  })

  it('keeps one warm worker, supersedes older queries and drops their late answers', async () => {
    const worker = new FakeWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockReturnValue(worker)
    const { searchViaUtilityProcess } = await import('../../src/main/search/searchHost')

    const first = searchViaUtilityProcess(input)
    const second = searchViaUtilityProcess({ ...input, query: 'worker two' })
    // The superseded caller is answered at once with an empty page.
    // A replaced search tells its caller so, instead of answering an empty page.
    await expect(first).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'SearchSupersededError' })
    const [firstRequest, secondRequest] = worker.posted
    expect(firstRequest?.id).toBeLessThan(secondRequest?.id ?? 0)

    worker.answer(firstRequest!.id, page('stale'))
    worker.answer(secondRequest!.id, page('fresh'))
    await expect(second).resolves.toEqual(page('fresh'))

    const third = searchViaUtilityProcess(input)
    worker.answer(worker.posted[2]!.id, page('third'))
    await expect(third).resolves.toEqual(page('third'))
    // One process for every query, and it is still alive.
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(worker.killed).toBe(false)
  })

  it('times out, stops the worker and cools down without a main-process fallback', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const worker = new FakeWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockReturnValue(worker)
    const { searchViaUtilityProcess, SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS } =

    await expect(searchViaUtilityProcess(input)).rejects.toThrow('cooling down')
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'main.search.worker_unavailable',
      expect.any(Error),
      { phase: 'timeout', main_process_fallback: false }
    )
  })

  it('a failed query rejects only itself and the worker stays warm', async () => {

    mocks.fork.mockReturnValue(worker)

      ok: false,

<file path="__test/regressions/settings-sqlite-boundary.fixture.ts">
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks'
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'

import { closeSettingsStorage, getSettingsStorage } from '../../src/main/db/settingsStorage'
import { openDesktopSqliteStorage } from '../../src/main/db/sqliteStorage'

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)

async function holdWriteLock(path: string): Promise<Worker> {
  const worker = new Worker(
    `
      const { parentPort, workerData } = require('node:worker_threads')
      const Database = require(workerData.betterSqlite3Path)
      const db = new Database(workerData.path)
      db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
      parentPort.postMessage('locked')
      setTimeout(() => {
        db.exec('ROLLBACK')
        db.close()
      }, 1000)
    `,
    {
      eval: true,
      workerData: {
        betterSqlite3Path: require.resolve('better-sqlite3'),
        path
      }
    }
  )
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const cleanup = (): void => {
      worker.off('message', handleMessage)
      worker.off('error', handleError)
      worker.off('exit', handleExit)
    }
    const handleMessage = (message: unknown): void => {
      cleanup()
      if (message !== 'locked') {
        reject(new Error(`Unexpected write-lock worker message: ${String(message)}`))
        return
      }
      resolve()
    }
    const handleError = (error: Error): void => {
      cleanup()
      reject(error)
    }
    const handleExit = (code: number): void => {
      cleanup()
      reject(new Error(`Write-lock worker exited before acquiring the lock (code ${code})`))
    }

    worker.once('message', handleMessage)
    worker.once('error', handleError)
    worker.once('exit', handleExit)
  })
  return worker
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const path = process.argv[2]
  if (!path) throw new Error('Expected a SQLite database path')

  const mainStorage = openDesktopSqliteStorage(path)
  const settings = getSettingsStorage(path)
  await settings.getAll()
  const lockWorker = await holdWriteLock(path)

  try {
    const startedAt = performance.now()
    let timerElapsedMs = 0
    const timer = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        timerElapsedMs = performance.now() - startedAt
        resolve()
      }, 10)
    })
    const attempt = settings.set('menuBar.enabled', 'false').then(
      () => ({ status: 'resolved' }),
      (error: unknown) => ({
        status: 'rejected',
        code:
          error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error
            ? String((error as { code?: unknown }).code)
            : undefined
      })
    )

    const [result] = await Promise.all([attempt, timer])
    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ ...result, timerElapsedMs })}\n`)
  } finally {
    await lockWorker.terminate()
    closeSettingsStorage()
    mainStorage.close()
  }
}

void main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})

      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_UNRESPONSIVE_MESSAGE),
      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE),
      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE)

      expect(isExpectedSetupScanWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(true)

      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE)

      expect(isExpectedSetupScanWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(true)
    }

      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError('failed to message setup scan worker'),
      new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError('setup scan worker unavailable'),

      new Error(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE),

    for (const error of errors) {
      expect(isExpectedSetupScanWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(isExpectedSetupScanWorkerShutdownError(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(shouldReportSetupScanAppError(error)).toBe(true)

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const SRC_MAIN = resolve(HERE, '../../src/main')
const WORKER_ENTRY = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'setupScanWorker.ts')
const SETUP_ADAPTER = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'setup.ts')
const WORKER_HOST = resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'setupScanHost.ts')
const BUILD_CONFIG = resolve(HERE, '../../electron.vite.config.ts')

const IMPORT_RE = /(?:from\s+|import\s*\(\s*|require\s*\(\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g

function resolveRelative(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null {
  const base = resolve(dirname(fromFile), spec)
  for (const candidate of [base, `${base}.ts`, resolve(base, 'index.ts')]) {
    if (candidate.endsWith('.ts') && existsSync(candidate)) return candidate
  }
  return null
}

function workerImportGraph(entry: string): { files: Set<string>; externals: Set<string> } {
  const files = new Set<string>()
  const externals = new Set<string>()
  const queue = [entry]
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const file = queue.pop()
    if (!file || files.has(file)) continue
    files.add(file)
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    for (const match of source.matchAll(IMPORT_RE)) {
      const spec = match[1]
      if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
        const imported = resolveRelative(file, spec)
        if (imported) queue.push(imported)
      } else {
        externals.add(spec)
      }
    }
  }
  return { files, externals }
}

describe('desktop setup scan worker policy', () => {
  test('routes project traversal through the bundled utility worker without a main fallback', () => {
    const setup = readFileSync(SETUP_ADAPTER, 'utf8')
    const host = readFileSync(WORKER_HOST, 'utf8')
    const config = readFileSync(BUILD_CONFIG, 'utf8')

    expect(setup).toContain('scanProjectInSetupWorker(path, requestId, context)')
    expect(setup).toContain('listHarnessSetup: () => scanGlobalSetupInSetupWorker()')
    expect(setup).toContain('desktopSetupBrowserService.registerProjectRoot(scan.path)')
    expect(setup).toContain('desktopSetupBrowserService.isUnsafeScanRoot(scan.path)')
    expect(setup).not.toContain('desktopSetupBrowserService.scanProject(path)')
    expect(setup).not.toContain(
      'listHarnessSetup: () => desktopSetupBrowserService.listHarnessSetup()'
    )
    expect(host).toContain('utilityProcess.fork')
    expect(host).toContain("type: 'cancel'")
    expect(host).toContain('WORKER_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS')
    expect(config).toContain("setupScanWorker: resolve('src/main/setupScanWorker.ts')")
  })

  test('keeps expected unresponsive/dispose/circuit-breaker reporting skips wired at capture sites', () => {
    const host = readFileSync(WORKER_HOST, 'utf8')
    const main = readFileSync(resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'index.ts'), 'utf8')
    const lifecycle = readFileSync(resolve(SRC_MAIN, 'nativeLifecycle.ts'), 'utf8')

    expect(host).toContain('shouldReportSetupScanAppError')

    expect(host).toMatch(

    )
    expect(host).toContain(

    expect(host).toContain(
      'new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE)'
    )
    expect(host).toContain(
      'new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError(SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE)'

    expect(host).not.toContain("new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError('setup scan worker unresponsive')")
    expect(host).not.toContain("new SetupScanWorkerUnavailableError('setup scan worker disposed')")

  test('keeps the setup scanner import graph independent from Electron', () => {

    expect(files.has(WORKER_ENTRY)).toBe(true)
  })

  test('keeps artifact snapshot and cloud transfer work in the utility worker', () => {

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

import {
  SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE,
  SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE,
  SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_TIMED_OUT_MESSAGE,
  SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE,
  SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError,
  isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerOperationalError,
  isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerShutdownError,
  isSignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError,
  shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError
} from '../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost'

describe('signal analytics worker operational error policy', () => {
  it('classifies timeout, exit, and dispose as expected operational skips', () => {
    const errors = [
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_TIMED_OUT_MESSAGE),
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE),
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE)
    ]

    for (const error of errors) {
      expect(isSignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(error)).toBe(true)
      expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(true)
      expect(shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError(error)).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('still reports typed unavailable infrastructure failures', () => {
    // EXITED is demoted: one host retry absorbs the common race, and exhausted
    // EXITED after that retry is environmental (utility-process death / OS
    // reclaim), not a signal-analytics product defect. Missing fork stays
    // reportable. OOM / launch-failed still surface via child-process-gone.
    const error = new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(
      SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE
    )

    expect(isSignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(error)).toBe(true)
    expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(false)
    expect(shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError(error)).toBe(true)
  })

  it('keeps dispose-on-quit as the only expected shutdown rejection', () => {
    const dispose = new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(
      SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE
    )
    expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerShutdownError(dispose)).toBe(true)

    const notShutdown = [
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_TIMED_OUT_MESSAGE),
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE),
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE)
    ]
    for (const error of notShutdown) {
      expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerShutdownError(error)).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('still reports unexpected aggregation and untyped message matches', () => {
    const errors = [
      new Error('failed to aggregate signal analytics'),
      new Error(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_TIMED_OUT_MESSAGE),
      new Error(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE),
      new Error(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_DISPOSED_MESSAGE),
      new Error(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE),
      new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError('signal analytics worker message failed')
    ]

    for (const error of errors) {
      expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerOperationalError(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(isExpectedSignalAnalyticsWorkerShutdownError(error)).toBe(false)
      expect(shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError(error)).toBe(true)
    }
  })
})

import type { SignalAnalyticsSummary } from '@blume/user-analytics'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => {

    exit: null as null | (() => void)
  }
  const createWorker = () => {
    const worker = {
      on: vi.fn((event: string, handler: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
        if (event === 'message') handlers.message = handler as (message: unknown) => void
        if (event === 'exit') handlers.exit = handler as () => void
        return worker
      }),
      postMessage: vi.fn(),
      kill: vi.fn(() => true)
    }
    return worker
  }
  return {
    handlers,
    createWorker,
    worker: createWorker(),
    fork: vi.fn(),
    startBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    finishBackgroundProcessRequest: vi.fn(),
    clearBackgroundProcessRequests: vi.fn(),
    terminateBackgroundProcess: vi.fn((process: { kill: () => boolean }) => process.kill())
  }
})

vi.mock('electron', () => ({ utilityProcess: { fork: mocks.fork } }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/db', () => ({ getDbPath: () => '/tmp/blume-signal-analytics-test.sqlite' }))
vi.mock('../../src/main/analyticsCredentials', () => ({
  ANALYTICS_URL: 'http://localhost',
  analyticsToken: async () => 'test-token',
  requestJson: async () => ({})
}))
vi.mock('../../src/main/backgroundProcessActivity', () => ({
  BLUME_BACKGROUND_PROCESS_SERVICES: { signalAnalytics: 'blume-signal-analytics-worker' },
  startBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest,
  finishBackgroundProcessRequest: mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest,
  clearBackgroundProcessRequests: mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests,
  terminateBackgroundProcess: mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess
}))

const emptySummary: SignalAnalyticsSummary = {
  totalTurns: 0,
  turnsWithAnySignal: 0,
  signalRate: 0,
  signalCounts: { correction: 0, steering: 0, frustration: 0 },
  affectedTurnCounts: { correction: 0, steering: 0, frustration: 0 },
  auditCheckCounts: {},
  daily: []
}

async function waitForPostMessage(worker: { postMessage: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> }): Promise<{
  type: string
  id: number
  dbPath: string
}> {
  await vi.waitFor(() => {
    expect(worker.postMessage).toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
  return worker.postMessage.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0] as {
    type: string
    id: number
    dbPath: string
  }
}

describe('signal analytics worker host exit retry', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetModules()
    mocks.handlers.message = null
    mocks.handlers.exit = null
    mocks.worker = mocks.createWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockReset()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => mocks.worker)
    mocks.startBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.finishBackgroundProcessRequest.mockClear()
    mocks.clearBackgroundProcessRequests.mockClear()
    mocks.terminateBackgroundProcess.mockClear()
  })

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('retries once when the active worker exits before responding', async () => {
    const { aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics } = await import('../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost')

    const firstWorker = mocks.worker
    const pending = aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics()
    const firstRequest = await waitForPostMessage(firstWorker)

    const secondWorker = mocks.createWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => secondWorker)
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()

    const secondRequest = await waitForPostMessage(secondWorker)
    expect(secondRequest.id).not.toBe(firstRequest.id)
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)

    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'aggregate-result',
      id: secondRequest.id,
      ok: true,
      summary: emptySummary
    })

    await expect(pending).resolves.toEqual(emptySummary)
  })

  it('hands the hosted signals to the worker, also on its retry', async () => {
    const { aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics } = await import('../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost')
    const signals = [{ at: 1_000, kind: 'correction' as const }]

    const firstWorker = mocks.worker
    const pending = aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics(signals)
    expect(await waitForPostMessage(firstWorker)).toMatchObject({ type: 'aggregate', signals })

    const secondWorker = mocks.createWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => secondWorker)
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()
    const retry = await waitForPostMessage(secondWorker)
    expect(retry).toMatchObject({ type: 'aggregate', signals })

    mocks.handlers.message?.({ type: 'aggregate-result', id: retry.id, ok: true, summary: emptySummary })
    await expect(pending).resolves.toEqual(emptySummary)
  })

  it('rejects EXITED after a second consecutive worker exit without reporting capture policy', async () => {
    const {
      aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics,
      shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError,
      SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError,
      SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE
    } = await import('../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost')

    const firstWorker = mocks.worker
    const pending = aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics()
    await waitForPostMessage(firstWorker)

    const secondWorker = mocks.createWorker()
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => secondWorker)
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()
    await waitForPostMessage(secondWorker)
    mocks.handlers.exit?.()

    await expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'signal analytics worker exited'
    })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(
      shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError(
        new SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError(SIGNAL_ANALYTICS_WORKER_EXITED_MESSAGE)
      )
    ).toBe(false)
  })

  it('retries once when postMessage fails against a dead worker', async () => {
    const { aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics } = await import('../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost')

    const firstWorker = mocks.worker
    firstWorker.postMessage.mockImplementationOnce(() => {
      throw new Error('Object has been destroyed')
    })
    const secondWorker = mocks.createWorker()
    let forks = 0
    mocks.fork.mockImplementation(() => {
      forks += 1
      return forks === 1 ? firstWorker : secondWorker
    })

    const pending = aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics()
    const secondRequest = await waitForPostMessage(secondWorker)
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)

    mocks.handlers.message?.({
      type: 'aggregate-result',
      id: secondRequest.id,
      ok: true,
      summary: emptySummary
    })

    await expect(pending).resolves.toEqual(emptySummary)
  })

  it('does not retry EXITED after dispose', async () => {
    const { aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics, disposeSignalAnalyticsWorker } =
      await import('../../src/main/signalAnalyticsHost')

    const pending = aggregateLocalSignalAnalytics()
    await waitForPostMessage(mocks.worker)
    disposeSignalAnalyticsWorker()

    await expect(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'SignalAnalyticsWorkerUnavailableError',
      message: 'signal analytics worker disposed'
    })
    expect(mocks.fork).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })
})

import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import { aggregateStoredSignalAnalytics } from '@blume/app-core/features/improve/signalAnalytics'
import { createDesktopSignalAnalyticsStore } from '@blume/storage-sqlite'

const directories: string[] = []

afterEach(() => {
  for (const directory of directories.splice(0)) {
    rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

describe('signal analytics SQLite worker storage adapter', () => {
  test('uses real signal types and origin user-turn positions without classifying legacy rows', async () => {
    const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-signal-analytics-'))
    directories.push(directory)
    const path = join(directory, 'blume.sqlite')
    const db = new DatabaseSync(path)
    const day = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 17, 12)
    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE conversations (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        started_at INTEGER,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE user_turns (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER NOT NULL,
        started_at INTEGER,
        ended_at INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE events (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        user_turn_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        timestamp_ms INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE signals (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        type TEXT,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_agent_conversation_reads (
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        agent_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        conversation_activity_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, agent_version_id)
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_runs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        stage TEXT,
        finished_at INTEGER
      );
    `)
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO conversations (id, started_at, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(
      7,
      day,
      day
    )
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO conversations (id, started_at, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(
      8,
      day + 2_000,
      day + 2_000
    )
    const insertTurn = db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO user_turns (id, conversation_id, position, started_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)'
    )
    insertTurn.run(1, 7, 0, day)
    insertTurn.run(2, 7, 1, day + 1_000)
    insertTurn.run(3, 8, 0, null)
    insertTurn.run(4, 8, 1, day + 4_000)
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO events (user_turn_id, timestamp_ms) VALUES (?, ?)').run(3, day + 2_000)
    const markProcessed = db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO insight_agent_conversation_reads
       (conversation_id, agent_version_id, conversation_activity_ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?)`
    )
    markProcessed.run(7, 'agent-v1', day + 1_000)
    markProcessed.run(8, 'agent-v1', day + 2_000)
    const insertRun = db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO insight_runs (id, conversation_id, status, stage, finished_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
    )
    insertRun.run(1, 7, 'succeeded', 'done', day + 1_000)
    insertRun.run(2, 8, 'succeeded', 'done', day + 2_000)
    const insertSignal = db.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO signals (id, conversation_id, type, kind, evidence_json, created_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
    )
    insertSignal.run(1, 7, 'correction', 'workflow', '[{"turn":0,"role":"user"}]', day)
    insertSignal.run(2, 7, 'frustration', 'domain', '[{"turn":0,"role":"user"}]', day)
    insertSignal.run(3, 8, 'steering', 'preference', '[{"turn":0,"role":"user"}]', day)
    insertSignal.run(4, 7, null, 'workflow', '[{"turn":1,"role":"user"}]', day)

    const summary = await aggregateStoredSignalAnalytics(
      createDesktopSignalAnalyticsStore(db as never)
    )
    db.close()

    expect(summary.totalTurns).toBe(3)
    expect(summary.turnsWithAnySignal).toBe(2)
    expect(summary.signalCounts).toEqual({ correction: 1, steering: 1, frustration: 1 })
    expect(summary.affectedTurnCounts).toEqual({ correction: 1, steering: 1, frustration: 1 })
  })

  test('excludes turns from conversations the pipeline has not processed', async () => {
    const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-signal-analytics-'))
    directories.push(directory)
    const path = join(directory, 'blume.sqlite')
    const db = new DatabaseSync(path)
    const day = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 17, 12)
    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE conversations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, started_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER);
      CREATE TABLE user_turns (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER, position INTEGER,
        started_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_turn_id INTEGER, timestamp_ms INTEGER);
      CREATE TABLE signals (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER, type TEXT, evidence_json TEXT,
        created_at INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_agent_conversation_reads (
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, agent_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        conversation_activity_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, agent_version_id)
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_runs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT, finished_at INTEGER
      );
      INSERT INTO conversations VALUES (1, ${day}, ${day});
      INSERT INTO conversations VALUES (2, ${day}, ${day});
      INSERT INTO user_turns VALUES (1, 1, 0, ${day}, ${day});
      INSERT INTO user_turns VALUES (2, 2, 0, ${day}, ${day});
      INSERT INTO insight_runs VALUES (1, 1, 'succeeded', 'done', ${day});
    `)

    const summary = await aggregateStoredSignalAnalytics(
      createDesktopSignalAnalyticsStore(db as never)
    )
    db.close()

    expect(summary.totalTurns).toBe(1)
  })

  test('reports zero counts once the retired local Improve pipeline stops writing', async () => {
    const directory = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-signal-analytics-'))
    directories.push(directory)
    const db = new DatabaseSync(join(directory, 'blume.sqlite'))
    const day = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 3, 12)
    // Conversations keep arriving, but no signal, run or read rows are written any more.
    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE conversations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, started_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER);
      CREATE TABLE user_turns (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER, position INTEGER,
        started_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_turn_id INTEGER, timestamp_ms INTEGER);
      CREATE TABLE signals (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER, type TEXT, kind TEXT, evidence_json TEXT,
        created_at INTEGER
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_agent_conversation_reads (
        conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, agent_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        conversation_activity_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, agent_version_id)
      );
      CREATE TABLE insight_runs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT, finished_at INTEGER
      );
      INSERT INTO conversations VALUES (1, ${day}, ${day});
      INSERT INTO user_turns VALUES (1, 1, 0, ${day}, ${day});
    `)

    const summary = await aggregateStoredSignalAnalytics(
      createDesktopSignalAnalyticsStore(db as never)
    )
    db.close()

    expect(summary.totalTurns).toBe(0)
    expect(summary.turnsWithAnySignal).toBe(0)
    expect(summary.signalRate).toBe(0)
    expect(summary.daily).toEqual([])
  })

import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import { validateJsonObjectAgainstSchema } from '@blume/insights-control'

describe('sub-agent input schema validation', () => {
  test('rejects missing, mistyped, and extra sub-agent input fields', () => {
    const schema = {
      type: 'object',
      required: ['conversationId', 'signalIds'],
      properties: {
        conversationId: { type: 'number' },
        signalIds: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'number' } },
        mode: { enum: ['cluster', 'promote'] }
      },
      additionalProperties: false
    }

    expect(
      validateJsonObjectAgainstSchema(
        {
          conversationId: '42',
          signalIds: [1, '2'],
          extraUserText: 'do not allow this',
          mode: 'other'
        },
        schema
      )
    ).toEqual([
      'input.extraUserText is not allowed',
      'input.conversationId must be a number',
      'input.signalIds[1] must be a number',
      'input.mode must be one of "cluster", "promote"'
    ])

    expect(validateJsonObjectAgainstSchema({ conversationId: 42 }, schema)).toEqual([
      'input.signalIds is required'
    ])
  })
})

import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import {
  buildSurveyResponseProperties,
  surveyIdBasedResponseKey,
  surveyIndexBasedResponseKey
} from '../../src/renderer/src/lib/surveyPayload'

describe('survey response payloads', () => {
  const questions = [
    { id: 'email-question', question: "What's your email?" },
    { id: 'note-question', question: "Anything you'd like us to know?" }
  ]

  test('emits id-based and index-based response keys for PostHog survey compatibility', () => {
    expect(
      buildSurveyResponseProperties(questions, {
        'email-question': 'person@example.com',
        'note-question': 'Happy to chat'
      })
    ).toEqual({
      $survey_questions: [
        { id: 'email-question', question: "What's your email?", response: 'person@example.com' },
        {
          id: 'note-question',
          question: "Anything you'd like us to know?",
          response: 'Happy to chat'
        }
      ],
      '$survey_response_email-question': 'person@example.com',
      $survey_response: 'person@example.com',
      '$survey_response_note-question': 'Happy to chat',
      $survey_response_1: 'Happy to chat'
    })
  })

  test('omits unanswered optional questions from response keys', () => {
    expect(
      buildSurveyResponseProperties(questions, {
        'email-question': 'person@example.com',
        'note-question': undefined
      })
    ).toEqual({
      $survey_questions: [
        { id: 'email-question', question: "What's your email?", response: 'person@example.com' },
        { id: 'note-question', question: "Anything you'd like us to know?" }
      ],
      '$survey_response_email-question': 'person@example.com',
      $survey_response: 'person@example.com'
    })
  })

  test('matches PostHog survey response key conventions', () => {
    expect(surveyIdBasedResponseKey('question-id')).toBe('$survey_response_question-id')
    expect(surveyIndexBasedResponseKey(0)).toBe('$survey_response')
    expect(surveyIndexBasedResponseKey(2)).toBe('$survey_response_2')
  })
})

import {
  classifyFailure,

  diagnosticPropertiesForError,
  isSensitiveTelemetryKey,
  safeTelemetryError,
  sanitizeTelemetryText

describe('telemetry diagnostics', () => {
  test('labels feature-level user impact for high-volume production error families', () => {
    expect(
      diagnosticPropertiesForError(
        'main.parser.worker_ingest',
        new Error('EIO: i/o error, stat \\wsl.localhost\\Ubuntu\\home\\person\\project'),
        { provider: 'codex' }
      )
    ).toMatchObject({

      failure_class: 'path_io_failed',
      failure_stage: 'conversation_ingest',
      user_impact: 'conversations_may_be_stale',
      impact_scope: 'feature_degraded',
      recovery_mode: 'stale_data_retained'
    })

    expect(
      diagnosticPropertiesForError('main.ipc', new Error('This operation was aborted'), {
        channel: 'referrals:getStatus'
      })
    ).toMatchObject({
      feature_area: 'referrals',
      user_impact: 'referral_status_unavailable',
      failure_stage: 'ipc_request'
    })

    expect(
      diagnosticPropertiesForError('insights.pipeline', new Error('Clustering failed: timed out'), {
        stage: 'clustering'
      })
    ).toMatchObject({
      feature_area: 'improve',
      failure_class: 'timeout',
      failure_stage: 'clustering',
      user_impact: 'improve_result_unavailable'
    })
  })

  test('classifies failures without preserving high-cardinality messages', () => {
    expect(classifyFailure(new Error('file is not a database'))).toBe('sqlite_corruption')
    expect(classifyFailure(new Error('unable to get local issuer certificate'))).toBe(
      'certificate_validation_failed'
    )
    expect(
      classifyFailure(
        new Error('codex exited with code 1: failed to decode models response: unknown variant max')
      )
    ).toBe('harness_version_incompatible')
  })

  test('removes content-bearing identifiers and classifies paths', () => {
    expect(isSensitiveTelemetryKey('sourcePath')).toBe(true)
    expect(isSensitiveTelemetryKey('workspace_path')).toBe(true)
    expect(isSensitiveTelemetryKey('conversation_id')).toBe(true)
    expect(isSensitiveTelemetryKey('run_id')).toBe(true)
    expect(isSensitiveTelemetryKey('path_kind')).toBe(false)
    expect(classifyTelemetryPath('\\\\wsl.localhost\\Ubuntu\\home\\person\\project')).toBe(
      'wsl_unc'
    )
    expect(classifyTelemetryPath('C:\\Users\\person\\project')).toBe('windows_absolute')
    expect(classifyTelemetryPath('/Users/person/project')).toBe('unix_absolute')
  })

  test('redacts filesystem locations from messages and stacks', () => {
    const raw =
      "ENOENT: no such file, stat 'C:\\Users\\Person\\secret-project\\session.jsonl' at parse (/Users/person/project/parser.ts:4:2); mirrors: file://server/share/private/project and C:/Users/Person/forward-secret/session.jsonl"
    const sanitized = sanitizeTelemetryText(raw)
    expect(sanitized).not.toContain('Person')
    expect(sanitized).not.toContain('secret-project')
    expect(sanitized).not.toContain('/Users/person/project')
    expect(sanitized).not.toContain('server/share/private')
    expect(sanitized).not.toContain('forward-secret')
    expect(sanitizeTelemetryText('request failed at https://updates.example.test/feed')).toContain(
      'https://updates.example.test/feed'
    )
    expect(sanitized).toContain('[Path]')
  })

  test('redacts complete quoted filesystem locations containing spaces', () => {
    const raw = [
      "open 'file:///Users/person/My Secret/project.ts'",
      'open "C:/Users/person/My Secret/project.ts"',
      "open 'C:\\Users\\person\\My Secret\\project.ts'",
      'open "/Users/person/My Secret/project.ts"',
      'open "/Users/O\'Connor/My Project/file.ts"'
    ].join('; ')
    const sanitized = sanitizeTelemetryText(raw)

    expect(sanitized).toBe(
      'open \'[Path]\'; open "[Path]"; open \'[Path]\'; open "[Path]"; open "[Path]"'
    )
    expect(sanitizeTelemetryText('normal prose: "please retry later"')).toBe(
      'normal prose: "please retry later"'
    )
    expect(sanitizeTelemetryText('request failed at "https://updates.example.test/My Feed"')).toBe(
      'request failed at "https://updates.example.test/My Feed"'
    )
  })

  test('replaces Improve subprocess output with a stable safe exception', () => {
    const error = new Error(
      'codex exited with code 1: {"type":"error","message":"response content that must not leave the app"}'
    )
    const safe = safeTelemetryError('insights.pipeline', error)
    expect(safe.message).toBe('External analysis process exited with code 1')
    expect(safe.message).not.toContain('response content')
  })

const originalPlatform = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(process, 'platform')

function setPlatform(value: NodeJS.Platform): void {
  Object.defineProperty(process, 'platform', { value, configurable: true })
}

function restorePlatform(): void {
  if (originalPlatform) Object.defineProperty(process, 'platform', originalPlatform)
}

      unref: vi.fn()
    }
    mocks.spawn.mockReturnValue(watchdog)

    const originalSetTimeout = globalThis.setTimeout
    const scheduled: Array<{
      delay: number | undefined
      run: () => void
      unref: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>
    }> = []
    const fakeSetTimeout = ((
      handler: Parameters<typeof setTimeout>[0],
      delay?: number,
      ...args: unknown[]
    ) => {
      const unref = vi.fn()
      scheduled.push({
        delay,
        run: () => {
          if (typeof handler === 'function') handler(...args)
        },
        unref
      })
      return { unref } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
    }) as typeof setTimeout
    vi.stubGlobal('setTimeout', fakeSetTimeout)

      schema: 1,
      sourceVersion: '1.2.2',
      targetVersion: '1.2.3',
      recordedAt: '2026-07-21T12:00:00.000Z'
    })
    mocks.fileRead.mockImplementation(async (buffer: Buffer) => {
      const bytesRead = buffer.write(record, 'utf8')
      return { bytesRead, buffer }
    })
    mocks.open.mockResolvedValue({ read: mocks.fileRead, close: mocks.fileClose })
    mocks.dialogShowMessageBox.mockResolvedValue({ response: 0 })

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    startAutoUpdates()
    await vi.waitFor(() =>
      expect(mocks.logError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'previous update install was not confirmed',
        expect.objectContaining({ message: expect.stringContaining('current version is 1.2.2') })
      )
    )
    await vi.waitFor(() =>
      expect(mocks.openExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'https://updates.blume-page.com/desktop/stable/download'
      )
    )

    expect(mocks.dialogShowMessageBox).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        title: 'Update Couldn\u2019t Finish',
        message: 'Blume 1.2.3 may not have installed.'
      })
    )
    expect(mocks.unlink).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  test('treats a newer current version as a superseded install attempt without recovery or capture', async () => {
    const record = JSON.stringify({
      schema: 1,
      sourceVersion: '1.0.58',
      targetVersion: '1.0.59',
      recordedAt: '2026-08-25T12:00:00.000Z'
    })
    mocks.appGetVersion.mockReturnValue('1.0.71')
    mocks.fileRead.mockImplementation(async (buffer: Buffer) => {
      const bytesRead = buffer.write(record, 'utf8')
      return { bytesRead, buffer }
    })
    mocks.open.mockResolvedValue({ read: mocks.fileRead, close: mocks.fileClose })

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    startAutoUpdates()
    await vi.waitFor(() =>
      expect(mocks.logInfo).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'previous update install superseded by newer version',
        {
          source_version: '1.0.58',
          target_version: '1.0.59',
          current_version: '1.0.71'
        }
      )
    )

    expect(mocks.logError).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'previous update install was not confirmed',
      expect.anything()
    )
    expect(mocks.dialogShowMessageBox).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.captureAppError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mocks.unlink).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      '/tmp/blume-updater-test-logs/pending-update-install.json'
    )
  })

  test('pauses background services before macOS update checks and resumes when no download starts', async () => {
    const calls: string[] = []
    const prepareForUpdateCheck = vi.fn(async () => {
      calls.push('prepare')
    })
    const resumeAfterUpdateCheck = vi.fn(() => {
      calls.push('resume')
    })
    mocks.checkForUpdates.mockImplementation(() => {
      calls.push('check')
      return Promise.resolve(null)
    })

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')

    startAutoUpdates({ prepareForUpdateCheck, resumeAfterUpdateCheck })
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10_000)
    await Promise.resolve()
    await Promise.resolve()

    expect(mocks.checkForUpdates).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(calls).toEqual(['prepare', 'check', 'resume'])
  })

  test('checks again each hour without overlapping a check already in flight', async () => {
    let resolveFirstCheck: ((value: null) => void) | undefined
    mocks.checkForUpdates.mockImplementationOnce(
      () =>
        new Promise<null>((resolve) => {
          resolveFirstCheck = resolve
        })
    )

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    startAutoUpdates()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0)

    expect(mocks.checkForUpdates).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60 * 60_000)
    expect(mocks.checkForUpdates).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)

    resolveFirstCheck?.(null)
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0)
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60 * 60_000)

    expect(mocks.checkForUpdates).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })

  test('stops periodic checks after an update is ready to restart', async () => {
    const updaterListeners = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>()
    const nativeListeners = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>()
    mocks.updaterOn.mockImplementation((event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
      updaterListeners.set(event, listener)
    })
    mocks.nativeUpdaterOn.mockImplementation(
      (event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
        nativeListeners.set(event, listener)
      }
    )

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    startAutoUpdates()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0)

    updaterListeners.get('update-downloaded')?.({ version: '1.2.3' })
    nativeListeners.get('update-downloaded')?.()
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(3 * 60 * 60_000)

    expect(mocks.checkForUpdates).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  test('adapts native updater Error objects before forwarding them to the app logger', async () => {
    const nativeError = new Error('The operation couldn’t be completed. Bad file descriptor')
    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    const { autoUpdater } = await import('electron-updater')

    expect(() => autoUpdater.logger?.warn(nativeError)).not.toThrow()
    expect(mocks.logWarn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

    )
  })

  test('clears pending macOS restart prompt when native staging fails', async () => {
    const updaterListeners = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>()
    const nativeListeners = new Map<string, (...args: unknown[]) => void>()
    mocks.updaterOn.mockImplementation((event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
      updaterListeners.set(event, listener)
    })
    mocks.nativeUpdaterOn.mockImplementation(
      (event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => {
        nativeListeners.set(event, listener)
      }
    )

    const { startAutoUpdates } = await import('../../src/main/updater')

    const resumeAfterUpdateCheck = vi.fn()
    startAutoUpdates({ resumeAfterUpdateCheck })

    updaterListeners.get('update-downloaded')?.({ version: '1.2.3' })
    updaterListeners.get('error')?.(
      new Error('The operation couldn’t be completed. Bad file descriptor')
    )
    nativeListeners.get('update-downloaded')?.()
    await Promise.resolve()

    expect(mocks.dialogShowMessageBox).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.dialogShowMessageBox).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        title: 'Update Couldn\u2019t Finish',
        message: 'Blume could not prepare the downloaded update.'
      })
    )
    expect(resumeAfterUpdateCheck).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(mocks.logWarn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'clearing pending macOS update after updater error',
      { update_version: 'v1.2.3' }
    )
    expect(mocks.logWarn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ignoring late macOS native updater staging event')
  })

  test('keeps certificate and signing failures reportable', async () => {
    const { isNonFatalUpdaterError } = await import('../../src/main/updater')

    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(new Error('net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID'))).toBe(false)
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(new Error('New version is not signed'))).toBe(false)
    expect(
      isNonFatalUpdaterError(
        new Error(
          'Cannot download "https://updates.blume-page.com/desktop/stable/latest-mac.yml": net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID'
        )
      )
    ).toBe(false)
    expect(
      isNonFatalUpdaterError(
        new Error(
          'Cannot download "https://updates.blume-page.com/desktop/stable/latest-mac.yml": net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR'
        )
      )
    ).toBe(false)
    // Security markers must win even if a dialog-presentation substring is present.
    expect(
      isNonFatalUpdaterError(new Error('New version is not signed (OSStatus error -60006.)'))
    ).toBe(false)
  })

  test('classifies Windows installer spawn permission failures as non-fatal only on win32', async () => {
    const spawnEperm = Object.assign(new Error('spawn EPERM'), {
      code: 'EPERM',
      errno: -4048,
      syscall: 'spawn'
    })
    const spawnEacces = Object.assign(new Error('spawn EACCES'), {
      code: 'EACCES',
      errno: -13,
      syscall: 'spawn'
    })
    const spawnWithPath = Object.assign(
      new Error("spawn 'C:\\Users\\user\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\blume-setup.exe' EPERM"),
      { code: 'EPERM', syscall: 'spawn' }
    )

    setPlatform('win32')
    const { isNonFatalUpdaterError } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(spawnEperm)).toBe(true)
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(spawnEacces)).toBe(true)
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(spawnWithPath)).toBe(true)
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(new Error('EPERM'))).toBe(false)
    expect(isNonFatalUpdaterError(new Error('permission denied'))).toBe(false)

    setPlatform('darwin')
    vi.resetModules()
    const { isNonFatalUpdaterError: isNonFatalOnDarwin } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    expect(isNonFatalOnDarwin(spawnEperm)).toBe(false)
    expect(isNonFatalOnDarwin(spawnEacces)).toBe(false)
    expect(isNonFatalOnDarwin(spawnWithPath)).toBe(false)

    setPlatform('linux')
    vi.resetModules()
    const { isNonFatalUpdaterError: isNonFatalOnLinux } = await import('../../src/main/updater')
    expect(isNonFatalOnLinux(spawnEperm)).toBe(false)
    expect(isNonFatalOnLinux(spawnEacces)).toBe(false)
  })
