            const replaced = await installedKeyId(harness);
            step("key", `Creating an installation key for ${name}`);
            discovery.signal.throwIfAborted();
            const key = await input.createKey(harness);
            if (!INSTALL_KEY.test(key.token) || !URL.canParse(key.endpoint))
              throw new InstallError("Blume did not return a usable installation key.");
            let last;
            const run2 = await runSetup(harness, "install", {
              cli: found,
              setup,
              endpoint: key.endpoint,
              key: key.token,
              dev: input.dev,
              appLink: input.appLink,
              flower: iconFlower(harness, input.flower),
              onStep: (value) => {
                if (value === last) return;
                last = value;
                step(
                  value,
                  value === "files" ? `Writing Blume’s plugin files for ${name}` : value === "register" ? `Adding Blume to ${name}` : `Checking ${name}’s connection to Blume`
                );
              }
            });
            if (run2.code === 0 && run2.result?.ok === true) {
              if (key.id) {
                await recordInstalledKey(harness, key.id);
                if (replaced && replaced !== key.id)
                  await input.revokeKey?.(replaced).catch(() => void 0);
              }
              const version = typeof run2.result.version === "string" ? run2.result.version : BLUME_PLUGIN.version;
              step("done", `Blume ${version} is installed in ${name}`);
              outcomes.push({ harness, ok: true, version });
              continue;
            }
            throw new InstallError(
              run2.result?.problem === "no-runtime" ? `Blume was added to ${name}, but this computer has no Node.js for it to run on. Install Node 24 or newer, then install again.` : run2.result && run2.result.ok === false ? `Blume was added to ${name}, but its connection check failed. Check you are signed in, then install again.` : run2.error ?? `Setup for ${name} stopped unexpectedly.`
            );
          } catch (error) {
            const message2 = error instanceof InstallError || error instanceof Error && error.message.length <= 300 ? error.message : `Could not install Blume in ${name}.`;
            step("failed", message2);
            outcomes.push({ harness, ok: false, error: message2 });
          }
        }
        return outcomes;
      });
    },
    /** Updates each agent whose Blume installation this app owns and is older; never installs.
     * With `moves`, an installation it may not update but made for an earlier runtime of its
     * channel has only its endpoint moved to this app's runtime (`pluginMoveDecision`). */
    update(input) {
      return serialize(async () => {
        const outcomes = [];
        for (const { id: harness } of PLUGIN_HARNESSES) {
          if (input.harnesses && !input.harnesses.includes(harness)) continue;
          try {
            let recovery;
            if ((input.moves || input.enabled) && await require$$0.access(_n.join(base(harness), MOVE_JOURNAL)).then(() => true, () => false)) {
              const found2 = await cli(harness);
              if (found2) {
                const run22 = await runSetup(harness, "update", { cli: found2, setup: await setupScript(), moveOnly: true });
                if (run22.code !== 0 || run22.result?.ok !== true) {
                  outcomes.push({ harness, updated: false, ok: false, from: null, to: null, error: run22.error ?? "Finishing an interrupted move did not complete." });
                  continue;
                }
                const value = run22.result?.recovery;
                if (value === "finished" || value === "rolled-back" || value === "set-aside") recovery = value;
              }
            }
            const recovered = recovery ? { recovery, ...recovery === "finished" ? { moved: true } : {} } : {};
            const recorded = await record(harness);
            const app = {
              latest: BLUME_PLUGIN.version,
              channel: input.channel,
              endpoint: options.ledger,
              appLink: input.appLink ?? null
            };
            const decision = pluginUpdateDecision(recorded, {
              ...app,
              autoUpdate: input.autoUpdate[harness] !== false,
              enabled: input.enabled,
              flower: iconFlower(harness, input.flower)
            });
            const move = !decision.update && input.moves ? pluginMoveDecision(recorded, { ...app, enabled: true }) : null;
            if (!decision.update && !move?.move) {
              outcomes.push({
                harness,
                updated: false,
                ok: true,
                from: null,
                to: null,
                reason: decision.reason,
                ...move ? { moveReason: move.reason } : {},
                ...recovered
              });
              continue;
            }
            const from = decision.update ? decision.from : move.move ? move.version : null;
            const found = await cli(harness);
            if (!found) {
              outcomes.push({ harness, updated: false, ok: true, from, to: null, reason: "unavailable", ...recovered });
              continue;
            }
            const expected = await expectation(harness, recorded);
            if (!expected) {
              outcomes.push({ harness, updated: false, ok: false, from, to: null, error: "The installation has no reusable Blume connection. Install it again from Blume → Plugin.", ...recovered });
              continue;
            }
            if (move?.move) {
              const run22 = await runSetup(harness, "update", {
                cli: found,
                setup: await setupScript(),
                endpoint: mcpEndpoint(move.to),
                moveOnly: true,
                expected
              });
              const ok = run22.code === 0 && run22.result?.ok === true;
              outcomes.push({
                harness,
                updated: false,
                ok,
                from: move.version,
                to: move.version,
                ...recovered,
                moved: ok && run22.result?.moved === true || recovery === "finished",
                ...ok && run22.result?.reason === "changed" ? { moveReason: "changed" } : {},
                ...ok ? {} : { error: run22.error ?? "Moving the installation did not complete." }
              });
              continue;
            }
            if (!decision.update) continue;
            const run2 = await runSetup(harness, "update", {
              cli: found,
              setup: await setupScript(),
              flower: iconFlower(harness, input.flower),
              // The channel's runtime moved: point the installation there (its key stays valid).
              ...decision.moveTo ? { endpoint: mcpEndpoint(decision.moveTo) } : {},
              expected
            });
            const updated = run2.result?.updated === true;
            outcomes.push({
              harness,
              updated,
              ok: run2.code === 0 && run2.result?.ok === true,
              from: decision.from,
              to: updated ? BLUME_PLUGIN.version : null,
              ...recovered,
              ...run2.result?.reason === "changed" ? { reason: "changed" } : {},
              ...run2.code === 0 && run2.result?.ok === true ? {} : { error: run2.error ?? "Update did not complete." }
            });
          } catch (error) {
            outcomes.push({
              harness,
              updated: false,
              ok: false,
              from: null,
              to: null,
              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 300) : "Update failed."
            });
          }
        }
        return outcomes;
      });
    },
    /** Stops running setup processes (with their agent CLIs) and refuses new ones. */
    cancel() {
      closed = true;
      discovery.abort(new InstallError("Blume is closing."));
      for (const stop of [...running2]) stop();
    }
  };
}

function hookCaller(context, harness) {
  const argv = context.hookArgv("claude");
  return `import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'

// Added by the Blume app; removing Blume in the app removes this file. It asks Blume's hook script
// (${harness}) what to add: the session card, messages between tool calls, and a reason to keep going.
const BLUME_HOOK = ${JSON.stringify(argv)}
function blume(event, payload) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let out = ''
    let child
    try {
      child = spawn(BLUME_HOOK.command, BLUME_HOOK.args, { env: { ...process.env, ...BLUME_HOOK.env }, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore'] })
    } catch {
      return resolve(null)
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill(), 15000)
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => (out += chunk))
    child.on('error', () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(null) })
    child.on('close', () => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      try { resolve(out.trim() ? JSON.parse(out) : null) } catch { resolve(null) }
    })
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify({ hook_event_name: event, ...payload }))
  })
}
const contextOf = (out) => (out && out.hookSpecificOutput && out.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) || undefined
const reasonOf = (out) => (out && out.decision === 'block' && out.reason) || undefined
`;
}
function piExtension(context) {
  return `${hookCaller(context, "Pi")}
export default function (pi) {
  let start
  let continuations = 0
  pi.on('session_start', async (_event, ctx) => {
    continuations = 0
    start = contextOf(await blume('SessionStart', { session_id: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), cwd: ctx.cwd }))
  })
  pi.on('before_agent_start', async () => {
    if (!start) return
    const content = start
    start = undefined
    return { message: { customType: 'blume', content, display: false } }
  })
  pi.on('tool_result', async (event, ctx) => {
    const text = contextOf(await blume('PostToolUse', { session_id: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), cwd: ctx.cwd, tool_name: event.toolName }))
    if (!text) return
    return { content: [...event.content, { type: 'text', text }], structuredContent: event.structuredContent }
  })
  pi.on('agent_before_settle', async (event, ctx) => {
    if (event.outcome !== 'completed' || continuations >= 3) return
    const reason = reasonOf(await blume('Stop', { session_id: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), cwd: ctx.cwd, stop_hook_active: continuations > 0 }))
    if (!reason) {
      continuations = 0
      return
    }
    continuations++
    return { entries: [...event.entries, { type: 'custom_message', customType: 'blume', content: reason, display: true }], continue: true }
  })
}
`;
}
function ompExtension(context) {
  return `${hookCaller(context, "Oh My Pi")}
export default function (pi) {
  let start
  const load = async (ctx) => {
    start = contextOf(await blume('SessionStart', { session_id: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), cwd: ctx.cwd }))
  }
  pi.on('session_start', async (_event, ctx) => load(ctx))
  pi.on('session_switch', async (_event, ctx) => load(ctx))
  pi.on('before_agent_start', async () => {
    if (!start) return
    const content = start
    start = undefined
    return { message: { customType: 'blume', content, display: false } }
  })
  pi.on('tool_result', async (event, ctx) => {
    const text = contextOf(await blume('PostToolUse', { session_id: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), cwd: ctx.cwd, tool_name: event.toolName }))
    return text ? { additionalContext: text } : undefined
  })
  pi.on('session_stop', async (event, ctx) => {
    if (event.stop_hook_active) return
    const reason = reasonOf(await blume('Stop', { session_id: event.session_id, cwd: ctx.cwd }))
    return reason ? { decision: 'block', reason } : undefined
  })
}
`;
}
function opencodePlugin(context) {
  return `${hookCaller(context, "OpenCode")}
export const BlumePlugin = async ({ client, directory }) => {
  const started = new Map()
  const continued = new Map()
  return {
    'experimental.chat.system.transform': async (input, output) => {
      const id = input.sessionID
      if (!id) return
      if (!started.has(id)) started.set(id, contextOf(await blume('SessionStart', { session_id: id, cwd: directory })) ?? '')
      const text = started.get(id)
      if (text) output.system.push(text)
    },
    'tool.execute.after': async (input, output) => {
      const note = contextOf(await blume('PostToolUse', { session_id: input.sessionID, cwd: directory, tool_name: input.tool }))
      if (note && typeof output.output === 'string') output.output += '\\n\\n' + note
    },
    event: async ({ event }) => {
      if (event.type !== 'session.idle') return
      const id = event.properties.sessionID
      const count = continued.get(id) ?? 0
      const reason = count < 3 ? reasonOf(await blume('Stop', { session_id: id, cwd: directory, stop_hook_active: count > 0 })) : undefined
      if (!reason) {
        continued.delete(id)
        return
      }
      continued.set(id, count + 1)
      await client.session.promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: 'text', text: reason }] } })
    }
  }
}
`;
}
function ampPlugin(context) {
  return `${hookCaller(context, "Amp")}
export const description = 'Blume: the session card, messages between tool calls, and a reason to keep going'

export default function (amp) {
  const seen = new Set()
  amp.on('agent.start', async (event) => {
    const id = event.thread.id
    if (seen.has(id)) return
    seen.add(id)
    const text = contextOf(await blume('SessionStart', { session_id: id, cwd: process.cwd() }))
    return text ? { message: { content: text, display: false } } : undefined
  })
  amp.on('tool.result', async (event) => {
    if (event.status !== 'done' || typeof event.output !== 'string') return
    const note = contextOf(await blume('PostToolUse', { session_id: event.thread.id, cwd: process.cwd(), tool_name: event.tool }))
    return note ? { status: 'done', output: event.output + '\\n\\n' + note } : undefined
  })
  amp.on('agent.end', async (event) => {
    if (event.status !== 'done') return
    const reason = reasonOf(await blume('Stop', { session_id: event.thread.id, cwd: process.cwd() }))
    return reason ? { action: 'continue', userMessage: reason, maxContinuations: 3 } : undefined
  })
}
`;
}

}

class OperationError extends Error {
}
const runCommand = (command, args, options) => new Promise((resolve2) => {
  const child = node_child_process.spawn(command, [...args], {
    env: { ...process.env, ...options.env },
    stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
    detached: process.platform !== "win32"
  });
  let stdout = "";
  let stderr = "";
  child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => stdout = (stdout + chunk).slice(-2e5));
  child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => stderr = (stderr + chunk).slice(-2e5));
  const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      if (child.pid && process.platform !== "win32") process.kill(-child.pid, "SIGKILL");
      else child.kill("SIGKILL");
    } catch {
    }
  }, options.timeoutMs ?? 12e4);
  child.on("error", (error) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    resolve2({ code: null, stdout, stderr: stderr || String(error) });
  });
  child.on("close", (code2) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    resolve2({ code: code2, stdout, stderr });
  });
});
const exists = (path) => require$$0.access(path).then(() => true, () => false);
const readText = (path) => require$$0.readFile(path, "utf8").catch((error) => {
  if (error.code === "ENOENT") return "";
  throw new OperationError(`Blume could not read ${path}.`);
});
async function writeText(link, content, mode) {
  const path = await require$$0.realpath(link).catch(() => link);
  await require$$0.mkdir(_n.dirname(path), { recursive: true });
  const kept = await require$$0.stat(path).then((info) => info.mode & 511, () => void 0);
  const temporary = `${path}.blume-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}.tmp`;
  await require$$0.writeFile(temporary, content, { mode: mode ?? kept ?? 420 });
  await require$$0.rename(temporary, path);
}
async function edit(path, change) {
  const before = await readText(path);
  const after = change(before);
  if (after !== before) await writeText(path, after);
}
function empty(text2, kind) {
  if (!text2.trim()) return true;
  try {
    const value = kind === "json" || kind === "json-item" ? jsoncGet(text2, []) : kind.startsWith("yaml") ? yamlGet(text2, []) : text2;
    return value === null || value === void 0 || typeof value === "object" && Object.keys(value).length === 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
async function tidy(operation) {
  if (!operation.created || !("file" in operation) || operation.kind === "file") return;
  if (empty(await readText(operation.file), operation.kind)) await require$$0.rm(operation.file, { force: true });
}
async function retire(operation) {
  const marker = await require$$0.readFile(_n.join(operation.path, operation.marker), "utf8").catch(() => "");
  if (marker.includes(operation.match)) await require$$0.rm(operation.path, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
const ownValue = (value) => /blume/i.test(JSON.stringify(value) ?? "");
const yamlLabel = (path) => path.split("/").slice(-2).join("/");
async function apply(operation, run2) {
  if ("file" in operation && operation.kind !== "file" && !await exists(operation.file)) operation.created = true;
  if (operation.kind === "json" || operation.kind === "yaml") {
    const read = operation.kind === "json" ? jsoncGet : yamlGet;
    const previous = await readText(operation.file).then((text2) => read(text2, operation.path), () => void 0);
    if (previous !== void 0 && !ownValue(previous)) operation.previous = previous;
  }
  switch (operation.kind) {
    case "retire":
      return retire(operation);
    case "json-item":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => jsoncListPut(text2, operation.path, operation.item, operation.match, yamlLabel(operation.file)));
    case "yaml-item":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => yamlListPut(text2, operation.path, operation.item, operation.match, yamlLabel(operation.file)));
    case "json":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => jsoncSet(text2, operation.path, operation.value, yamlLabel(operation.file)));
    case "yaml":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => yamlSet(text2, operation.path, operation.value, yamlLabel(operation.file)));
    case "yaml-list":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => yamlListAdd(text2, operation.path, operation.item, yamlLabel(operation.file)));
    case "file": {
      const before = await require$$0.readFile(operation.file, "utf8").catch(() => null);
      if (before !== null && !/blume/i.test(before)) {
        if (operation.keepExisting) {
          operation.kept = true;
          return;
        }
        operation.previousContent = before;
      }
      return writeText(operation.file, operation.content, operation.mode);
    }
    case "dir":
      await require$$0.rm(operation.to, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await require$$0.mkdir(_n.dirname(operation.to), { recursive: true });
      await require$$0.cp(operation.from, operation.to, { recursive: true });
      return;
    case "block":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => blockSet(text2, operation.content, operation.style));
    case "line":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => lineAdd(text2, operation.line));
    case "run": {
      const result = await run2(operation.command, operation.args, { env: operation.env, timeoutMs: operation.timeoutMs });
      if (result.code !== 0 && !operation.optional)
        throw new OperationError(`${operation.label} did not work${result.stderr.trim() ? `: ${result.stderr.trim().split("\n").slice(-1)[0]}` : "."}`);
      return;
    }
  }
}
async function undo(operation, run2, keepShared) {
  await undoChange(operation, run2, keepShared);
  await tidy(operation);
}
async function undoChange(operation, run2, keepShared) {
  switch (operation.kind) {
    case "retire":
      return retire(operation);
    case "json-item":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => jsoncListRemove(text2, operation.path, operation.match));
    case "yaml-item":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => yamlEntriesRemove(text2, operation.path, operation.match));
    case "json":
      return edit(
        operation.file,
        (text2) => operation.previous !== void 0 ? jsoncSet(text2, operation.path, operation.previous, yamlLabel(operation.file)) : jsoncDelete(text2, operation.path)
      );
    case "yaml":
      return edit(
        operation.file,
        (text2) => operation.previous !== void 0 ? yamlSet(text2, operation.path, operation.previous, yamlLabel(operation.file)) : yamlDelete(text2, operation.path)
      );
    case "yaml-list":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => yamlListRemove(text2, operation.path, operation.item));
    case "file":
      if (operation.kept) return;
      if (operation.previousContent !== void 0) return writeText(operation.file, operation.previousContent);
      return require$$0.rm(operation.file, { force: true });
    case "dir":
      if (operation.shared && keepShared(operation.to)) return;
      return require$$0.rm(operation.to, { recursive: true, force: true });
    case "block":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => blockRemove(text2, operation.style));
    case "line":
      return edit(operation.file, (text2) => lineRemove(text2, operation.line));
    case "run": {
      if (!operation.undo) return;
      const result = await run2(operation.undo.command, operation.undo.args, { env: operation.env, timeoutMs: operation.timeoutMs });
      const said = `${result.stderr}
${result.stdout}`;
      if (result.code !== 0 && !/not (installed|found)|no such|unknown (plugin|extension|marketplace|server)|does not exist|isn't installed/i.test(said))
        throw new OperationError(`${operation.label} could not be taken back${result.stderr.trim() ? `: ${result.stderr.trim().split("\n").slice(-1)[0]}` : "."}`);
      return;
    }
  }
}
async function applyOperations(operations, options = {}) {
  const run2 = options.run ?? runCommand;
  const done = [];
  try {
    for (const operation of operations) {
      await apply(operation, run2);
      done.push(operation);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    await undoOperations(done, options).catch(() => {
    });
    throw error instanceof OperationError ? error : new OperationError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
  }
}
async function undoOperations(operations, options = {}) {
  const run2 = options.run ?? runCommand;
  const keepShared = options.keepShared ?? (() => false);
  let failure;
  for (const operation of [...operations].reverse()) {
    try {
      await undo(operation, run2, keepShared);
    } catch (error) {
      failure ??= error;
    }
  }
  if (failure) throw failure instanceof OperationError ? failure : new OperationError(String(failure));
}
async function operationsPresent(operations) {
  for (const operation of operations) {
    switch (operation.kind) {
      case "json-item":
      case "yaml-item": {
        const read = operation.kind === "json-item" ? jsoncGet : yamlGet;
        const list = await readText(operation.file).then((text2) => read(text2, operation.path), () => void 0);
        if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.some(holds(operation.match))) return false;
        break;
      }
      case "json":
        if (await readText(operation.file).then((text2) => jsoncGet(text2, operation.path), () => void 0) === void 0) return false;
        break;
      case "yaml":
        if (await readText(operation.file).then((text2) => yamlGet(text2, operation.path), () => void 0) === void 0) return false;
        break;
      case "yaml-list": {
        const list = await readText(operation.file).then((text2) => yamlGet(text2, operation.path), () => void 0);
        if (!(Array.isArray(list) ? list.includes(operation.item) : list === operation.item)) return false;
        break;
      }
      case "file":
        if (!operation.kept && !await exists(operation.file)) return false;
        break;
      case "dir":
        if (!await exists(operation.to)) return false;
        break;
      case "block":
        if (!blockPresent(await readText(operation.file), operation.style)) return false;
        break;
      case "line":
        if (!(await readText(operation.file)).split("\n").some((line) => line.trim() === operation.line.trim())) return false;
        break;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function ownedImageRequest(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") throw Error("Invalid image chat request");
  const input = value;
  if (input.action !== "create" && input.action !== "send")
    throw Error("Only image create and send requests may use this port");
  if (input.action === "create" && (input.cloud !== void 0 || input.projectId !== void 0))
    throw Error("Images are available in chats on this computer.");
  const request = pullRequestContent.validateOwnedChatRequest({
    action: input.action,
    requestId: input.requestId,
    message: input.message,
    images: input.images,
    ...input.action === "create" ? { cwd: input.cwd, harness: input.harness } : { id: input.id }
  });

function middleCut(value, maxBytes) {
  if (pullRequestContent.utf8Bytes(value) <= maxBytes) return value;
  const points = Array.from(value);
  const room = maxBytes - 3;
  let headBytes = 0;
  let head = 0;
  while (head < points.length && headBytes + pullRequestContent.utf8Bytes(points[head]) <= Math.ceil(room / 2)) headBytes += pullRequestContent.utf8Bytes(points[head++]);
  let tailBytes = 0;
  let tail = points.length;
  while (tail > head && headBytes + tailBytes + pullRequestContent.utf8Bytes(points[tail - 1]) <= room) tailBytes += pullRequestContent.utf8Bytes(points[--tail]);
  return `${points.slice(0, head).join("")}…${points.slice(tail).join("")}`;
}

const MOVES = "READY_FOR_REVIEW_EVENT, CONVERT_TO_DRAFT_EVENT, CLOSED_EVENT, REOPENED_EVENT";

  ConvertToDraftEvent: "convert_to_draft",

  ReopenedEvent: "reopened"

async function readPullMoves(reader, target2) {
  const data = await reader.query(
    `query($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $number: Int!) {
  repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) {
    pullRequest(number: $number) {
      first: timelineItems(first: 1, itemTypes: [READY_FOR_REVIEW_EVENT, CONVERT_TO_DRAFT_EVENT]) { nodes { __typename } }
      moves: timelineItems(last: 20, itemTypes: [${MOVES}]) {
        nodes {
          __typename
          ... on ReadyForReviewEvent { createdAt }
          ... on ConvertToDraftEvent { createdAt }
          ... on ClosedEvent { createdAt }
          ... on ReopenedEvent { createdAt }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}`,
    { owner: target2.owner, repo: target2.repo, number: target2.number }
  );
  const pull = data?.repository?.pullRequest;
  if (!pull) throw new pullRequestContent.GitHubReadError("Pull request not found", 404);

      return event ? [{ event, created_at: node2.createdAt }] : [];
    }),
    ...first === "ready_for_review" || first === "convert_to_draft" ? { firstMove: first } : {}
  };
}

function syncErrorSummary(notes, limit2, max = 500) {

const DEPLOYMENT_STATES = ["pending", "in_progress", "queued", "success", "failure", "error", "inactive"];
async function collectDeployments(repo, pr2, reader, notes) {
  const base = `/repos/${repo.owner}/${repo.repo}`;
  const label2 = `${repo.owner}/${repo.repo}#${pr2.number} deployments`;
  const read = async (path) => {
    try {
      return await reader.get(path);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof pullRequestContent.GitHubReadError && error.status === 404) return void 0;
      return optional(Promise.reject(error), notes, label2);
    }
  };
  const fact = async (deployment, contains2) => {
    const sha = String(deployment?.sha ?? "").toLowerCase();
    const environment = String(deployment?.environment ?? "").slice(0, 80);
    if (!SHA.test(sha) || !environment || !Number.isSafeInteger(deployment.id)) return void 0;

    const latest2 = Array.isArray(statuses) ? statuses[0] : void 0;
    const state = DEPLOYMENT_STATES.includes(latest2?.state) ? latest2.state : "pending";
    const url2 = [latest2?.environment_url, latest2?.target_url].find((value) => typeof value === "string" && /^https?:\/\//.test(value));
    const created = Date.parse(String(deployment.created_at ?? ""));
    const description2 = typeof latest2?.description === "string" ? latest2.description.trim().slice(0, pullRequestContent.DEPLOYMENT_DESCRIPTION).trim() : "";
    const logUrl = typeof latest2?.log_url === "string" && /^https?:\/\//.test(latest2.log_url) && latest2.log_url.length <= 2e3 ? latest2.log_url : void 0;
    const version = pullRequestContent.deploymentVersion(deployment.ref, pr2);
    return {
      id: deployment.id,
      environment,
      sha,
      state,
      ...url2 ? { url: String(url2).slice(0, 2e3) } : {},
      ...description2 ? { description: description2 } : {},
      ...logUrl ? { logUrl } : {},
      ...version ? { version } : {},
      createdAt: Number.isFinite(created) ? created : 0,
      pullRequest: pr2.number,
      repository: pr2.repository,
      contains: contains2
    };
  };
  const facts2 = [];
  const latest = [];

  for (const deployment of latestPerEnvironment(previews).slice(0, 3)) {
    const made = await fact(deployment, "head");
    if (made) facts2.push(made);
  }

    for (const deployment of latestPerEnvironment(recent).slice(0, 5)) {

      const created = Date.parse(String(deployment?.created_at ?? ""));

        if (compare?.status !== "ahead" && compare?.status !== "identical") continue;
      }
      const made = await fact(deployment, "merge");
      if (made) facts2.push(made);
    }
  }
  return { facts: facts2, latest };
}
function latestPerEnvironment(list) {
  const newest = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const deployment of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
    const environment = String(deployment?.environment ?? "");
    const current = newest.get(environment);
    if (!current || Date.parse(deployment.created_at) > Date.parse(current.created_at)) newest.set(environment, deployment);
  }
  return [...newest.values()].sort((a2, b2) => Date.parse(b2.created_at) - Date.parse(a2.created_at));
}
const UNREAD_LINK_MS = 15 * 6e4;
function unreadLink(delivery, now) {
  return (delivery.links ?? []).some((link) => link.kind === "pr" && now - link.reportedAt < UNREAD_LINK_MS && githubPullTargets(delivery).has(link.url.toLowerCase()) && !delivery.github?.prs.some((pr2) => pr2.url.toLowerCase() === link.url.toLowerCase()));
}
const RELEASE_ACTIVE_MS = 2 * 60 * 6e4;
function releasing(delivery, now) {
  if (delivery.phase !== deliveryBriefs.PHASE.release) return false;
  const github = delivery.github;
  if (github?.deployments?.some((deployment) => deployment.state === "pending" || deployment.state === "queued" || deployment.state === "in_progress"))
    return true;
  if (github?.prs.some((pr2) => pr2.runs.some((run2) => run2.status !== "completed"))) return true;
  const latest = Math.max(
    delivery.updatedAt,
    ...delivery.history.filter((visit2) => visit2.phase === deliveryBriefs.PHASE.release).map((visit2) => visit2.enteredAt),
    ...(github?.prs ?? []).map((pr2) => pr2.mergedAt ?? 0),
    ...(github?.deployments ?? []).map((deployment) => deployment.createdAt),
    ...(github?.environments ?? []).map((deployment) => deployment.createdAt)
  );
  return now - latest < RELEASE_ACTIVE_MS;
}
function settled(delivery, now) {
  const github = delivery.github;
  return Boolean(
    github && !releasing(delivery, now) && github.prs.length && github.prs.every((pr2) => (pr2.state === "merged" || pr2.state === "closed") && pr2.runs.every((run2) => run2.status === "completed")) && !unreadLink(delivery, now)
  );
}
function running(delivery) {
  return Boolean(delivery.github?.prs.some((pr2) => (pr2.state === "open" || pr2.state === "draft") && (pr2.checks.pending > 0 || pr2.runs.some((run2) => run2.status !== "completed"))));
}
const GITHUB_SYNC_PACE = {
  /** A run or check is still going, the delivery is releasing (RELEASE_ACTIVE_MS), or it is on screen. (A pull request
   * its agent just linked is read in the next cycle, until sync has read it.) */
  active: 6e4,
  /** Open pull requests with nothing running, or the agent changed the delivery since the last read. */
  open: 3 * 6e4,
  /** An open delivery's pace doubles from `open` up to this while GitHub shows nothing new. */
  quiet: 15 * 6e4,
  /** Every pull request merged or closed and its runs finished. */
  settled: 60 * 6e4
};
function readWanted(delivery, read) {
  const wanted = delivery.github?.readWanted;
  return wanted !== void 0 && wanted > (read?.at ?? delivery.github?.syncedAt ?? 0);
}
function pace(delivery, read, now, focused) {
  if (unreadLink(delivery, now) || readWanted(delivery, read)) return 0;
  if (focused || releasing(delivery, now) || running(delivery)) return GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.active;
  if (settled(delivery, now)) return GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.settled;
  if (!read || delivery.updatedAt > read.updatedAt) return GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.open;
  return Math.min(Math.max(read.interval, GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.open), GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.quiet);
}
const facts = (payload) => JSON.stringify(payload ?? null);
function remember(reads, id2, at2, updatedAt, payload) {
  const previous = reads.get(id2);
  const seen = facts(payload);
  const interval = previous && previous.facts === seen ? Math.min(previous.interval * 2, GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.quiet) : GITHUB_SYNC_PACE.open;
  reads.delete(id2);
  reads.set(id2, { at: at2, interval, facts: seen, updatedAt });
  if (reads.size > 2e3) reads.delete(reads.keys().next().value);
}
const GITHUB_SYNC_BUDGET = {
  /** Never read while less than this share of the quota is left: it stays for the person's tools. */
  headroom: 0.2,
  /** This app's background reads spend at most this share of each hour's quota... */
  share: 0.2,
  /** ...spread over the hour: by any minute, the elapsed share of it plus this burst. */
  burst: 0.25
};
const HOUR = 60 * 6e4;
function createGitHubSyncBudget(reader) {
  let window;
  let mark;
  return {
    /**
     * Undefined while the sync may read. Otherwise when to try again, and whether that is the
     * headroom (shown to the person) or only this hour's pace.
     */
    check(now) {
      const rate = reader.rateLimit();
      const billed = reader.usage().billed;
      const start = mark ?? billed;
      mark = billed;
      if (!rate.resetAt || rate.resetAt <= now) {
        window = void 0;
        return void 0;
      }
      if (!window || Math.abs(window.resetAt - rate.resetAt) > 5e3) window = { resetAt: rate.resetAt, billed: start };
      const quota = rate.limit ?? 5e3;
      if (rate.remaining !== void 0 && rate.remaining < quota * GITHUB_SYNC_BUDGET.headroom) return { until: rate.resetAt, headroom: true };

      if (billed - window.billed >= allowed) return { until: Math.min(rate.resetAt, now + 6e4), headroom: false };
      return void 0;
    }
  };

function toInstallation(raw) {

async function listGitHubProjects(reader, now) {

    }

    return { project: project2, projectRoot: projectRoot2, worktree: worktree2, toolingDir: ".codex", branch, display: display2 };
  }
  const normalizedHome = normalizePathSeparators(options.homeDir ?? "").replace(/\/+$/, "");

    return {
      project: project2,
      projectRoot: projectRoot2,
      worktree: worktree2,
      toolingDir: ".cursor",
      branch,
      display: `${project2} · ${worktree2}`
    };
  }

function describeLegacyWorktreePath(path, options) {
  const normalized = normalizeLegacyPath(path);
  if (CODEX_PROJECT_PATH_RE.test(normalized)) return null;
  const pathInfo = describeProjectPath(normalized, void 0, options);
  if (pathInfo.worktree && pathInfo.toolingDir) {
    return { root: pathInfo.projectRoot };
  }
  const match = LEGACY_UNDOTTED_WORKTREE_PATH_RE.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return null;
  const root = normalized.slice(0, match.index).replace(/\/$/, "");
  return { root: root || normalized };
}
function workspaceClaimedByAnotherRow(workspacePath, row, rows2) {
  const normalizedWorkspacePath = normalizeLegacyPath(workspacePath);
  return rows2.some(
    (candidate) => String(candidate.id) !== String(row.id) && candidate.workspace_locations?.some(
      (workspace) => normalizeLegacyPath(workspace.path) === normalizedWorkspacePath
    )
  );
}
function codexProjectName(path) {
  const match = CODEX_PROJECT_PATH_RE.exec(normalizeLegacyPath(path));
  return match?.[1] ?? null;
}
function hasCodexProjectIdentity(name, rows2) {
  return rows2.some((row) => codexProjectName(row.path) === name);
}
function findCanonicalRow(path, rows2) {
  const parts = pathParts(path);
  const matches = rows2.filter((row) => !isSyntheticCodexDatePath(row.path)).map((row) => ({ row, nameParts: splitProjectName(row.name) })).filter(
    ({ row, nameParts }) => nameParts.length > 1 && normalizeLegacyPath(row.path) !== normalizeLegacyPath(path) && endsWithParts(parts, nameParts)
  ).sort((a, b) => b.nameParts.length - a.nameParts.length);
  return matches[0]?.row ?? null;
}
function findCanonicalCodexProjectRow(name, rows2) {
  const normalizedName = name.toLocaleLowerCase();
  const candidates = rows2.filter(
    (row) => Boolean(row.git_remote) && !codexProjectName(row.path) && pathLeaf(row.path).toLocaleLowerCase() === normalizedName
  );
  const remotes = new Set(candidates.map((row) => row.git_remote?.trim()).filter(Boolean));
  if (remotes.size !== 1) return null;
  return candidates.sort((left, right) => (right.updated_at ?? 0) - (left.updated_at ?? 0))[0] ?? null;
}
function workspaceKind(path, kind, options) {
  if (describeLegacyWorktreePath(path, options) || CODEX_WORKTREE_PATH_RE.test(normalizeLegacyPath(path))) {
    return "worktree";
  }
  return kind === "git" ? "repo-root" : "folder-root";
}
function projectIdentityForRow(row, rows2, options) {
  if (isSyntheticCodexDatePath(row.path)) return null;
  const normalized = normalizeLegacyPath(row.path);
  const displayWorkspacePath = normalizeLegacyPath(row.display_path ?? row.path);
  const displayClaimedElsewhere = workspaceClaimedByAnotherRow(displayWorkspacePath, row, rows2);
  if (displayClaimedElsewhere && codexProjectName(normalized)) return null;
  const workspacePath = displayClaimedElsewhere ? normalized : displayWorkspacePath;
  const remoteName = remoteRepoName(row.git_remote);
  const worktree = describeLegacyWorktreePath(workspacePath, options);
  const rootCandidate = worktree?.root ?? normalized;
  const syntheticCodexName = codexProjectName(normalized);
  const managedWorktreeName = worktree ? describeProjectPath(workspacePath, void 0, options).project : null;
  const syntheticManagedName = syntheticCodexName ?? managedWorktreeName;
  const canonicalRow = findCanonicalRow(rootCandidate, rows2) ?? (syntheticManagedName ? findCanonicalCodexProjectRow(syntheticManagedName, rows2) : null);
  const canonicalPath = canonicalRow ? normalizeLegacyPath(canonicalRow.path) : rootCandidate;
  const codexName = codexProjectName(canonicalPath) ?? codexProjectName(normalized);
  const managedIdentityName = codexName ?? managedWorktreeName ?? (hasCodexProjectIdentity(row.name, rows2) ? row.name : null);
  const pathInfo = describeProjectPath(canonicalPath, void 0, options);
  const name = remoteName ?? remoteRepoName(canonicalRow?.git_remote) ?? managedIdentityName ?? canonicalRow?.name ?? pathInfo.project ?? pathLeaf(canonicalPath);
  const kind = row.git_remote || canonicalRow?.git_remote || worktree || codexName || hasCodexProjectIdentity(name, rows2) ? "git" : "folder";
  const id = String(canonicalRow?.id ?? row.id);
  const canonicalRemote = row.git_remote ?? canonicalRow?.git_remote ?? void 0;
  const key = canonicalRemote ?? (managedIdentityName ? `git:${managedIdentityName}` : `${kind}:${canonicalPath}`);
  return {
    id,
    key,
    kind,
    name,
    root: canonicalPath,
    lastActivityTs: row.updated_at ?? canonicalRow?.updated_at ?? void 0,
    canonicalRemote,
    workspaces: [
      ...row.workspace_locations ?? [],
      {
        id: String(row.id),
        path: workspacePath,
        kind: workspaceKind(workspacePath, kind, options)
      }
    ],
    legacyId: String(row.id)
  };
}
function identifyLegacyDesktopProjects(rows2, options = {}) {
  const byKey = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const row of rows2) {
    const identity = projectIdentityForRow(row, rows2, options);
    if (!identity) continue;
    const existing = byKey.get(identity.key);
    if (!existing) {
      byKey.set(identity.key, {
        id: identity.id,
        kind: identity.kind,
        name: identity.name,
        root: identity.root,
        ...identity.lastActivityTs === void 0 ? {} : { lastActivityTs: identity.lastActivityTs },
        canonicalRemote: identity.canonicalRemote,
        workspaceLocations: identity.workspaces.filter(
          (workspace, index, locations) => locations.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.path === workspace.path) === index
        ),
        legacyIds: [identity.legacyId]
      });
      continue;
    }
    if (codexProjectName(existing.root) && !codexProjectName(identity.root)) {
      existing.id = identity.id;
      existing.root = identity.root;
    }
    if (identity.lastActivityTs !== void 0) {
      existing.lastActivityTs = Math.max(existing.lastActivityTs ?? 0, identity.lastActivityTs);
    }
    for (const workspace of identity.workspaces) {
      if (!existing.workspaceLocations.some((candidate) => candidate.path === workspace.path)) {
        existing.workspaceLocations.push(workspace);
      }
    }
    if (!existing.legacyIds.includes(identity.legacyId)) existing.legacyIds.push(identity.legacyId);
  }
  return [...byKey.values()].sort(
    (left, right) => (right.lastActivityTs ?? 0) - (left.lastActivityTs ?? 0) || left.name.localeCompare(right.name)
  );
}
const MAX_SEARCH_TERMS = 16;
const MAX_TOKEN_CHARS = 64;
const TOKEN_PATTERN = /[\p{L}\p{N}\p{Co}]+/gu;
const COMBINING_MARKS = new RegExp("\\p{M}+", "gu");
function foldSearchText(value) {
  return value.normalize("NFD").replace(COMBINING_MARKS, "").toLowerCase();
}
function tokensOf(value) {
  const tokens = [];
  for (const match of value.matchAll(TOKEN_PATTERN)) {
    const folded = foldSearchText(match[0]);
    if (folded) tokens.push(folded.slice(0, MAX_TOKEN_CHARS));
  }
  return tokens;
}
function parseSearchTerms(query) {
  const terms = [];
  const pattern = /"([^"]*)"?|(\S+)/g;
  for (const match of query.matchAll(pattern)) {
    const quoted = match[1];
    const typed = (quoted ?? match[2] ?? "").trim();
    const tokens = tokensOf(typed);
    if (tokens.length === 0) continue;
    const prefix = quoted === void 0 && !(tokens.length === 1 && tokens[0].length < 2);
    terms.push({ tokens, prefix, raw: typed.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ") });
    if (terms.length === MAX_SEARCH_TERMS) break;
  }
  return terms;
}
function buildFtsMatchExpression(terms) {
  if (terms.length === 0) return null;
  return terms.map((term) => `"${term.tokens.join(" ").replaceAll('"', '""')}"${term.prefix ? "*" : ""}`).join(" AND ");
}
function ftsColumnExpression(column2, expression) {
  if (!/^[a-z_]+$/.test(column2)) throw new Error(`invalid FTS column ${column2}`);
  return `${column2} : (${expression})`;
}
function likePatternsForTerms(terms) {
  return terms.map((term) => `%${escapeLikePattern(term.raw)}%`);
}
function escapeLikePattern(value) {
  return value.replace(/[\\%_]/g, "\\$&");
}
const EXCERPT_CHARS = 220;
const EXCERPT_LEAD_CHARS = 72;
const MAX_SCANNED_CHARS = 256 * 1024;
function compact(value) {
  const head = value.length > MAX_SCANNED_CHARS ? value.slice(0, MAX_SCANNED_CHARS) : value;
  return head.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}
function originalPrefixLength(token, foldedLength) {
  let folded = 0;
  let length = 0;
  for (const char of token) {
    if (folded >= foldedLength) break;
    folded += foldSearchText(char).length;
    length += char.length;
  }
  return length;
}
function tokenMatchRanges(text2, terms) {
  const wanted = terms.flatMap(
    (term) => term.tokens.map((token, index) => ({
      token,
      prefix: term.prefix && index === term.tokens.length - 1
    }))
  );
  const ranges = [];
  for (const match of text2.matchAll(TOKEN_PATTERN)) {
    const folded = foldSearchText(match[0]);
    let best = 0;
    for (const { token, prefix } of wanted) {
      if (prefix ? folded.startsWith(token) : folded === token) {
        best = Math.max(best, prefix ? token.length : folded.length);
      }
    }
    if (best === 0) continue;
    const start = match.index;
    const length = best >= folded.length ? match[0].length : originalPrefixLength(match[0], best);
    ranges.push([start, start + length]);
  }
  return ranges;
}
function substringMatchRanges(text2, terms) {
  const lower = text2.toLowerCase();
  const ranges = [];
  for (const term of terms) {
    const needle = term.raw;
    if (!needle) continue;
    let from = 0;
    while (ranges.length < 64) {
      const index = lower.indexOf(needle, from);
      if (index < 0) break;
      ranges.push([index, index + needle.length]);
      from = index + needle.length;
    }
  }
  return mergeRanges(ranges);
}
function mergeRanges(ranges) {
  const sorted = [...ranges].sort((left, right) => left[0] - right[0] || left[1] - right[1]);
  const merged = [];
  for (const range of sorted) {
    const last = merged.at(-1);
    if (last && range[0] <= last[1]) last[1] = Math.max(last[1], range[1]);
    else merged.push([range[0], range[1]]);
  }
  return merged;
}
function searchExcerpt(value, terms) {
  const text2 = compact(value == null ? "" : String(value));
  let ranges = tokenMatchRanges(text2, terms);
  if (ranges.length === 0) ranges = substringMatchRanges(text2, terms);
  const first = ranges[0];
  if (text2.length <= EXCERPT_CHARS || !first) {
    const excerpt2 = text2.slice(0, EXCERPT_CHARS);
    return { excerpt: excerpt2, ranges: clipRanges(ranges, 0, excerpt2.length, 0) };
  }
  const start = Math.max(0, first[0] - EXCERPT_LEAD_CHARS);
  const end = Math.min(text2.length, Math.max(first[1], start + EXCERPT_CHARS));
  const leading = start > 0 ? "…" : "";
  const body = text2.slice(start, end);
  const trimmedStart = body.length - body.trimStart().length;
  const trimmed = body.trim();
  const excerpt = `${leading}${trimmed}${end < text2.length ? "…" : ""}`;
  return {
    excerpt,
    ranges: clipRanges(
      ranges,
      start + trimmedStart,
      start + trimmedStart + trimmed.length,
      leading.length - start - trimmedStart
    )
  };
}
function clipRanges(ranges, from, to, shift) {
  return ranges.filter(([start, end]) => end > from && start < to).map(([start, end]) => [
    Math.max(start, from) + shift,
    Math.min(end, to) + shift
  ]).filter(([start, end]) => end > start);
}
function termsMatchText(value, terms) {
  if (terms.length === 0) return false;
  const tokens = tokensOf(value);
  return terms.every((term) => {
    const [first] = term.tokens;
    if (first === void 0) return false;
    for (let index = 0; index + term.tokens.length <= tokens.length; index += 1) {
      const fits = term.tokens.every((token, offset) => {
        const candidate = tokens[index + offset];
        const last = offset === term.tokens.length - 1;
        return last && term.prefix ? candidate.startsWith(token) : candidate === token;
      });
      if (fits) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });
}
function searchRank(title, terms, bm25) {
  const foldedTitle = tokensOf(title).join(" ");
  const foldedQuery = terms.map((term) => term.tokens.join(" ")).join(" ");
  if (foldedQuery && foldedTitle === foldedQuery) return 0;
  if (foldedQuery && foldedTitle.startsWith(foldedQuery)) return 1;
  if (termsMatchText(title, terms)) return 2;
  return 5;
}

const COMMIT_INDEX_DDL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS git_commits (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository   TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha          TEXT NOT NULL,
  project_id   TEXT,
  author       TEXT NOT NULL,
  committed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_git_commits_sha ON git_commits (sha);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_git_commits_committed_at ON git_commits (committed_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS git_commit_repositories (

`;
const BACKFILL_DDL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS search_index_backfill (
  name       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  high_rowid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  low_rowid  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
`;
function columnNames(definition) {
  return definition.columns.map((entry) => entry.name).join(", ");
}
function columnExprs(definition, row) {
  return definition.columns.map((entry) => entry.expr(row)).join(", ");
}
function ftsIndexDdl(definition) {
  const { name, table, rowid } = definition;
  const cols = columnNames(definition);
  const insertWhen = definition.when ? ` WHEN ${definition.when("new")}` : "";
  const updateWhere = definition.when ? ` WHERE ${definition.when("new")}` : "";
  return `
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${name} USING fts5(${cols}, ${FTS_OPTIONS});
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ${name}_ai AFTER INSERT ON ${table}${insertWhen} BEGIN
  INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ${name}(rowid, ${cols}) VALUES (new.${rowid}, ${columnExprs(definition, "new")});
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ${name}_ad AFTER DELETE ON ${table} BEGIN
  DELETE FROM ${name} WHERE rowid = old.${rowid};
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ${name}_au AFTER UPDATE OF ${definition.updateOf.join(", ")} ON ${table} BEGIN
  DELETE FROM ${name} WHERE rowid = old.${rowid};
  INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ${name}(rowid, ${cols})
    SELECT new.${rowid}, ${columnExprs(definition, "new")}${updateWhere};
END;
`;
}
function tableExists(db, name) {
  return !!db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table', 'view') AND name = ?").get(name);
}
function sqliteSupportsSearchIndex(db) {
  try {
    const row = db.prepare(
      "SELECT sqlite_compileoption_used('ENABLE_FTS5') AS fts5, sqlite_version() AS version"
    ).get();
    if (Number(row?.fts5) !== 1) return false;
    const [major = 0, minor = 0] = String(row?.version ?? "").split(".").map((part) => Number(part));
    return major > 3 || major === 3 && minor >= 43;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function installSearchIndexes(db, definitions, nowMs = Date.now()) {
  if (!sqliteSupportsSearchIndex(db)) return false;
  db.exec(COMMIT_INDEX_DDL);
  db.exec(BACKFILL_DDL);
  for (const definition of definitions) {
    if (!tableExists(db, definition.table)) continue;
    const created = !tableExists(db, definition.name);
    db.exec(ftsIndexDdl(definition));
    db.prepare(
      `INSERT OR ${created ? "REPLACE" : "IGNORE"} INTO search_index_backfill (name, high_rowid, low_rowid, updated_at)
       SELECT ?, coalesce(max(${definition.rowid}), 0), coalesce(max(${definition.rowid}), 0) + 1, ?
       FROM ${definition.table}`
    ).run(definition.name, nowMs);
  }
  return true;
}
function installDesktopSearchIndexes(db, nowMs) {
  return installSearchIndexes(db, DESKTOP_FTS_INDEXES, nowMs);
}
function installSharedSearchIndexes(db, nowMs) {
  return installSearchIndexes(db, SHARED_FTS_INDEXES, nowMs);
}

function runSearchIndexBackfillStep(db, definitions, options = {}) {
  const chunkRows = options.chunkRows ?? SEARCH_BACKFILL_CHUNK_ROWS;
  const chunkChars = options.chunkChars ?? SEARCH_BACKFILL_CHUNK_CHARS;
  const pending = db.prepare("SELECT name, low_rowid FROM search_index_backfill WHERE low_rowid > 1").all().map((row) => ({ name: String(row.name), low_rowid: Number(row.low_rowid) }));
  const definitionByName = new Map(definitions.map((definition2) => [definition2.name, definition2]));
  const next = pending.filter((row) => definitionByName.has(row.name)).sort((left, right) => right.low_rowid - left.low_rowid)[0];
  if (!next) return { indexed: 0, done: true, remaining: 0 };
  const definition = definitionByName.get(next.name);
  const cols = columnNames(definition);
  const where = definition.when ? ` AND ${definition.when("t")}` : "";
  let indexed = 0;
  db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
  try {
    const current = db.prepare("SELECT low_rowid FROM search_index_backfill WHERE name = ?").get(definition.name);
    const low = Number(current?.low_rowid ?? 0);
    const rows2 = db.prepare(
      `SELECT t.${definition.rowid} AS rid, ${columnExprs(definition, "t")}
         FROM ${definition.table} t
         WHERE t.${definition.rowid} < ?${where}
         ORDER BY t.${definition.rowid} DESC
         LIMIT ?`
    ).all(low, chunkRows);
    const insert = db.prepare(
      `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ${definition.name}(rowid, ${cols}) VALUES (?${", ?".repeat(definition.columns.length)})`
    );
    let chars = 0;
    let nextLow = low;
    for (const row of rows2) {
      const values = Object.entries(row).filter(([key]) => key !== "rid").map(([, value]) => value == null ? null : value);
      insert.run(Number(row.rid), ...values);
      indexed += 1;
      nextLow = Number(row.rid);
      for (const value of values) if (typeof value === "string") chars += value.length;
      if (chars >= chunkChars) break;
    }
    if (indexed === rows2.length && rows2.length < chunkRows) nextLow = 0;
    db.prepare("UPDATE search_index_backfill SET low_rowid = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE name = ?").run(
      nextLow,
      options.nowMs ?? Date.now(),
      definition.name
    );
    db.exec("COMMIT");
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      db.exec("ROLLBACK");
    } catch {
    }
    throw error;
  }
  const remaining = db.prepare(
    "SELECT coalesce(sum(low_rowid), 0) AS n FROM search_index_backfill WHERE low_rowid > 1"
  ).get().n;
  return { indexed, done: Number(remaining) === 0, remaining: Number(remaining) || 0 };
}

        `INSERT INTO ${definition.name}(${definition.name}, rank) VALUES ('merge', ?)`
      ).run(pages);
    } catch {
    }
  }
}

function rankedRows(context, source, index, options = {}) {

function nextCursor(context, page, truncated) {

      ...bySource.get(place.source) ?? [],
      { result, cursor: place.cursor }
    ]);
  for (const [source, rows2] of bySource) {
    rows2.sort((left, right) => compareCursor(left.cursor, right.cursor));
    let last;
    for (const row of rows2) {

    }

  }

        title,

        excerpt: null,

function conversationScope(input, harnessColumn = "c.source") {
  const parts = [];
  const params = [];
  if (input.harnesses?.length) {
    parts.push(`${harnessColumn} IN ${JSON_IDS}`);
    params.push(JSON.stringify(input.harnesses));
  }
  if (input.conversationSessions) {
    const sessions = input.conversationSessions.map(
      () => `(${harnessColumn} = ? AND instr(c.ref, ?) > 0)`
    );
    parts.push(sessions.length ? `(${sessions.join(" OR ")})` : "0");
    for (const session of input.conversationSessions)
      params.push(session.harness, session.sessionId);
  }
  if (input.conversationRef) {
    parts.push("c.ref = ?");
    params.push(input.conversationRef);
  }
  if (input.conversationRefs) {
    parts.push(`c.ref IN ${JSON_IDS}`);
    params.push(JSON.stringify(input.conversationRefs));
  }
  return parts.length > 0 ? { sql: parts.join(" AND "), params } : null;
}

function likeAll(expression, patternCount) {
  return Array.from({ length: patternCount }, () => `${expression} LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'`).join(
    " AND "
  );

function createDesktopSearchStore(db) {
  const all2 = (sql, params) => rows(db.prepare(sql).all(...params));
  const watermarks = createWatermarkReader(db);
  return {
    async query(input, options = {}) {
      const categories = new Set(input.categories);
      const limit = deliveryBriefs.normalizeGlobalSearchLimit(input.limit);
      if (categories.size === 0) return { results: [], truncated: false };
      const candidateLimit = Math.max(limit + 1, 200);
      const context = createFtsSearchContext(db, input, watermarks(), candidateLimit, options);
      const results = [];
      const finishers = [];
      if (categories.has("conversations")) {
        results.push(...await searchConversations(context, DESKTOP_CONVERSATION_SOURCE));
      }
      if (categories.has("messages")) {
        const messages = await searchMessages(context, DESKTOP_MESSAGE_SOURCES);
        results.push(...messages.results);
        finishers.push(messages.finish);
      }
      if (categories.has("commits")) {
        results.push(...await searchCommits(context, input));
      }
      if (context.likePatterns.length > 0 && context.firstPage) {
        await checkpoint(options.signal);
        results.push(...searchSmallTables(context, categories, all2));
      }
      const ordered = sortSearchResults(results);
      const page = ordered.slice(0, limit);
      for (const finish of finishers) finish(page);
      const truncated = ordered.length > limit || context.more.size > 0;
      const next = nextCursor(context, page, truncated);
      return { results: page, truncated, ...next ? { next } : {} };
    }
  };
}
function searchSmallTables(context, categories, all2) {
  const { terms, likePatterns, candidateLimit } = context;
  const results = [];
  const canonicalFor = (ids) => {
    if (!ids.length) return [];
    const projectRows = all2(
      `SELECT id, path, name, git_remote, display_path, updated_at FROM projects
       WHERE id IN ${JSON_IDS}
          OR (git_remote IS NOT NULL AND git_remote IN (SELECT git_remote FROM projects WHERE id IN ${JSON_IDS}))
          OR path IN (SELECT path FROM projects WHERE id IN ${JSON_IDS})
          OR name IN (SELECT name FROM projects WHERE id IN ${JSON_IDS})`,
      [JSON.stringify(ids), JSON.stringify(ids), JSON.stringify(ids), JSON.stringify(ids)]
    );
    return identifyLegacyDesktopProjects(
      projectRows.map((row) => ({
        id: text(row.id),
        path: text(row.path),
        name: text(row.name),
        git_remote: textOrNull(row.git_remote),
        display_path: textOrNull(row.display_path),
        updated_at: int(row.updated_at)
      }))
    );
  };
  if (categories.has("projects")) {
    const projectText = `lower(name || ' ' || path || ' ' || coalesce(display_path, '') || ' ' || coalesce(git_remote, ''))`;
    const phrase = context.phrase;
    const matched = all2(
      `SELECT id FROM projects WHERE ${likeAll(projectText, likePatterns.length)}
       ORDER BY (CASE WHEN lower(name) = ? THEN 0 WHEN lower(name) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END),
                updated_at DESC, id LIMIT ?`,
      [...likePatterns, phrase, `${escapeLikePattern(phrase)}%`, candidateLimit]
    ).map((row) => text(row.id));
    const order = new Map(matched.map((id, index) => [id, index]));
    const place = (project) => Math.min(...project.legacyIds.map((id) => order.get(id) ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY));
    const projects = canonicalFor(matched).filter((project) => Number.isFinite(place(project)));
    for (const project of projects) {
      const matchedText = [
        project.name,
        project.root,
        project.canonicalRemote,
        ...project.workspaceLocations.map((workspace) => workspace.path)
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      const { excerpt, ranges } = searchExcerpt(matchedText, terms);
      const at = place(project);
      results.push({
        id: `project:${project.id}`,
        category: "projects",
        title: project.name,
        subtitle: project.canonicalRemote ?? null,
        excerpt,
        ...ranges.length > 0 ? { ranges } : {},
        // Its SQL position: the name tier, then recency.
        rank: 2 + at / (matched.length + 1),
        updatedAt: project.lastActivityTs ?? 0,
        projectId: project.id,
        root: project.root
      });
    }
  }
  if (categories.has("setup")) {
    const setupText = `lower(coalesce(a.source_path, '') || ' ' || a.harness_id || ' ' || a.kind || ' ' || v.content)`;
    let setupRows = [];
    try {
      setupRows = all2(
        `SELECT a.id, a.project_id, a.harness_id, a.kind, a.scope, a.source_path,
                v.content, v.created_at
         FROM setup_artifacts a JOIN setup_versions v ON v.id = a.current_version_id
         WHERE ${likeAll(setupText, likePatterns.length)}
         ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
         LIMIT ?`,
        [...likePatterns, candidateLimit]
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!/no such table/i.test(String(error))) throw error;
    }
    const setupProjectIds = new Map(
      canonicalFor([
        ...new Set(setupRows.map((row) => text(row.project_id)).filter(Boolean))
      ]).flatMap((project) => project.legacyIds.map((legacyId) => [legacyId, project.id]))
    );
    for (const row of setupRows) {
      const sourcePath = textOrNull(row.source_path);
      const title = sourcePath?.split(/[\\/]/).filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? `${text(row.harness_id)} ${text(row.kind)}`;
      const { excerpt, ranges } = searchExcerpt(row.content, terms);
      results.push({
        id: `setup:${text(row.id)}`,
        category: "setup",
        title,
        subtitle: `${text(row.harness_id)} · ${text(row.scope)} · ${text(row.kind)}`,
        excerpt,
        ...ranges.length > 0 ? { ranges } : {},
        rank: termsMatchText(title, terms) ? searchRank(title, terms) : 4.5,
        updatedAt: Date.parse(text(row.created_at)) || 0,
        artifactId: text(row.id),
        projectId: textOrNull(row.project_id) === null ? null : setupProjectIds.get(text(row.project_id)) ?? text(row.project_id),
        harnessId: text(row.harness_id),
        sourcePath
      });
    }
  }
  if (categories.has("suggestions")) {
    const suggestionText = `lower(title || ' ' || summary || ' ' || coalesce(operations_json, ''))`;
    const suggestionRows = all2(
      `SELECT id, title, summary, status, updated_at,
              (title || ' ' || summary || ' ' || coalesce(operations_json, '')) AS matched_text
       FROM suggestions
       WHERE ${likeAll(suggestionText, likePatterns.length)}
       ORDER BY updated_at DESC
       LIMIT ?`,
      [...likePatterns, candidateLimit]
    );
    for (const row of suggestionRows) {
      const title = text(row.title);
      const { excerpt, ranges } = searchExcerpt(row.matched_text, terms);
      results.push({
        id: `suggestion:${text(row.id)}`,
        category: "suggestions",
        title,
        subtitle: text(row.status),
        excerpt,
        ...ranges.length > 0 ? { ranges } : {},
        rank: termsMatchText(title, terms) ? searchRank(title, terms) : 4.5,
        updatedAt: int(row.updated_at),
        suggestionId: text(row.id),
        status: text(row.status)
      });
    }
  }
  return results;
}

const WAITING_MS = 60 * 6e4;
function deactivateStaleActivityState(state, lastActivityTs, now = Date.now(), waitingMs = WAITING_MS) {
  if (state === "idle" || state === "inactive" || state === "needs-approval") return state;
  return lastActivityTs <= now - waitingMs ? "inactive" : state;

function classifyActivity(a, b, c) {
  const inputs = typeof a === "number" ? { lastEventTs: a, lastEventKind: b ?? "other" } : a;
  const now = typeof a === "number" ? Date.now() : b ?? Date.now();
  const {
    lastEventTs,
    lastEventKind: lastEventKind2,
    lastMessageTs = 0,
    lastToolCallTs = 0,
    lastToolResultTs = 0,
    needsApproval = false
  } = inputs;
  const age = now - lastEventTs;
  if (lastEventKind2 === "assistant-error") return "failed";
  if (needsApproval) return "needs-approval";
  if (age >= WAITING_MS) return "inactive";
  if (lastEventKind2 === "user" && lastEventTs > Math.max(lastMessageTs, lastToolCallTs, lastToolResultTs)) {
    return "running";
  }
  if (lastMessageTs > 0 || lastToolCallTs > 0) {
    if (lastMessageTs > lastToolCallTs && lastMessageTs >= lastToolResultTs) return "finished";
    if (lastToolCallTs > lastToolResultTs) {
      return "running";
    }
    if (lastToolResultTs >= lastToolCallTs) {
      if (lastEventKind2 === "user" && lastEventTs >= lastToolResultTs) return "running";
      return "finished";
    }
    return "running";
  }
  if (lastEventKind2 === "assistant-final") return "finished";
  if (lastEventKind2 === "assistant-tool-use") {
    return "running";
  }
  return "running";
}

      if (!existing || stat.mtimeMs >= existing.mtimeMs) {
        states.set(projected.sessionId, projected);
      }
    } catch {
    }
  }
  return states;
}
async function collectClaudeTaskStateFiles(tasksRoot, sessionId, deps) {
  const dir = deps.path.join(tasksRoot, sessionId);
  let entries;
  let latestMtimeMs = 0;
  try {
    const [dirEntries, dirStat] = await Promise.all([deps.fs.readdir(dir), deps.fs.stat(dir)]);
    entries = dirEntries;
    latestMtimeMs = dirStat.mtimeMs;
  } catch {
    return void 0;
  }
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.isFile() || !entry.name.endsWith(".json")) continue;
    const childPath = deps.path.join(dir, entry.name);
    try {
      const stat = await deps.fs.stat(childPath);
      latestMtimeMs = Math.max(latestMtimeMs, stat.mtimeMs);
      files.push({ path: childPath, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs });
    } catch {
    }
  }
  return { mtimeMs: latestMtimeMs, files };
}
async function loadClaudeTaskStateRecords(tasksRoot, sessionId, deps) {

  if (!taskFiles) return void 0;

      const projected = projectClaudeTaskStateRecord(
        await deps.fs.readFile(file.path),
        deps.path.basename(file.path).replace(/\.json$/, "")
      );
      if (projected) states.set(projected.id, projected.state);
    } catch {
    }
  }
  return { mtimeMs: taskFiles.mtimeMs, states };
}
function createClaudeExternalStateRuntime(input) {
  let askRuleCache;
  let desktopTitleCache;
  let sessionStateCache;
  const ttlMs = input.desktopTitleCacheTtlMs;
  const now = input.now ?? Date.now;
  const settingsPath = () => resolveRuntimePath(input.settingsPath);
  const desktopSessionsRoot = () => resolveRuntimePath(input.desktopSessionsRoot);
  const tasksRoot = () => resolveRuntimePath(input.tasksRoot);
  async function loadDesktopTitles(force = false) {
    const root = desktopSessionsRoot();
    const loadedAt = now();
    if (!force && desktopTitleCache && desktopTitleCache.root === root && loadedAt - desktopTitleCache.loadedAt < ttlMs) {
      return desktopTitleCache.titles;
    }
    const titles = await loadClaudeDesktopTitleRecords(root, input.deps);
    desktopTitleCache = { root, loadedAt, titles };
    return titles;
  }
  async function loadSessionStates(force = false) {
    const root = desktopSessionsRoot();
    const loadedAt = now();
    if (!force && sessionStateCache && sessionStateCache.root === root && loadedAt - sessionStateCache.loadedAt < ttlMs) {
      return sessionStateCache.states;
    }
    const states = await loadClaudeSessionStateRecords(root, input.deps);
    sessionStateCache = { root, loadedAt, states };
    return states;
  }
  return {
    async readAskRules() {
      const path = settingsPath();
      let mtimeMs = 0;
      try {
        mtimeMs = (await input.deps.fs.stat(path)).mtimeMs;
        if (askRuleCache?.settingsPath === path && askRuleCache.mtimeMs === mtimeMs) {
          return askRuleCache.rules;
        }
        const rules = parseClaudeAskRules(await input.deps.fs.readFile(path));
        askRuleCache = { settingsPath: path, mtimeMs, rules };
        return rules;
      } catch {
        askRuleCache = { settingsPath: path, mtimeMs, rules: [] };
        return [];
      }
    },
    async readDesktopTitle(sessionId) {
      return (await loadDesktopTitles()).get(sessionId);
    },
    async readSessionState(sessionId) {
      return (await loadSessionStates()).get(sessionId);
    },
    async readSessionStateVersion(sessionId) {
      return (await loadSessionStates()).get(sessionId);
    },
    readTaskState(sessionId) {
      return loadClaudeTaskStateRecords(tasksRoot(), sessionId, input.deps);
    },
    readTaskStateVersion(sessionId) {
      return collectClaudeTaskStateFiles(tasksRoot(), sessionId, input.deps);
    },
    async applyDesktopTitle(cliSessionId, title) {
      normalizeClaudeDesktopTitleWritebackTitle(title);
      const records = await loadDesktopTitles(true);
      const record = records.get(cliSessionId);
      if (!record) {
        throw new Error("No Claude Desktop title metadata found for this conversation.");
      }
      const parsed = parseJsonRecord(await input.deps.fs.readFile(record.path));
      if (parsed.isErr()) {
        throw new Error("Claude Desktop title metadata is not valid JSON.");
      }
      const raw = projectClaudeDesktopTitleWritebackRecord(parsed.value, title);
      await input.deps.fs.writeFile(record.path, JSON.stringify(raw));
      desktopTitleCache = void 0;
    },
    resetDesktopTitleCache() {
      desktopTitleCache = void 0;
      sessionStateCache = void 0;
    }
  };
}
function wildcardMatches$1(pattern, value) {
  if (pattern === "*") return true;
  const normalized = pattern.endsWith(":*") ? pattern.slice(0, -2) + "*" : pattern;
  const escaped = normalized.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  const re = new RegExp(`^${escaped.replace(/\*/g, ".*")}$`);
  return re.test(value);
}

function firstReadableUserLine(text) {

const CLAUDE_LOCAL_COMMAND_CAVEAT = "Caveat: The messages below were generated by the user while running local commands.";
function isClaudeLocalCommandCaveat(text) {
  return comparableText(text).startsWith(CLAUDE_LOCAL_COMMAND_CAVEAT);
}
function comparableText(text) {
  return text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}
const ECHO_PREFIX_CHARS = 60;
function stripTruncationMarker(text) {
  return text.endsWith("…") ? text.slice(0, -1) : text;
}
function parsedToolResultTexts(parsed) {
  const exact = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const byPrefix = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const toolCall of parsed.toolCalls) {
    if (!toolCall.resultText) continue;
    const text = comparableText(toolCall.resultText);
    if (!text) continue;
    exact.add(text);
    const stripped = stripTruncationMarker(text);
    if (stripped.length < ECHO_PREFIX_CHARS) continue;
    const key = stripped.slice(0, ECHO_PREFIX_CHARS);
    const entry = { text: stripped, truncated: stripped !== text };
    const bucket = byPrefix.get(key);
    if (bucket) bucket.push(entry);
    else byPrefix.set(key, [entry]);
  }
  return { exact, byPrefix };
}
function isToolResultText(text, toolResultTexts) {
  const comparable = comparableText(text);
  if (!comparable) return false;
  if (toolResultTexts.exact.has(comparable)) return true;
  const stripped = stripTruncationMarker(comparable);
  if (stripped.length < ECHO_PREFIX_CHARS) return false;
  const candidates = toolResultTexts.byPrefix.get(stripped.slice(0, ECHO_PREFIX_CHARS));
  if (!candidates) return false;
  const messageTruncated = comparable !== stripped;
  return candidates.some((candidate) => {
    if (!messageTruncated || !candidate.truncated) return false;
    return candidate.text.startsWith(stripped) || stripped.startsWith(candidate.text);
  });
}
function projectedMessageRole(message, toolResultTexts) {
  if (message.role === "user" && isToolResultText(message.text, toolResultTexts)) return "tool";
  return message.role;
}
function toolCallActivityTs(toolCall) {
  return Math.max(toolCall.endedAtMs ?? 0, toolCall.startedAtMs ?? 0);
}
function isToolUseStopText(text) {
  return !!text && (isRejectedToolUseText(text) || isInterruptedToolUseText(text));
}
function latestToolUseStopMarkerTs(parsed, messages) {
  let latest = 0;
  for (const message of messages) {
    if (isToolUseStopText(message.text)) latest = Math.max(latest, message.timestampMs ?? 0);
  }
  for (const toolCall of parsed.toolCalls) {
    if (isToolUseStopText(toolCall.resultText))
      latest = Math.max(latest, toolCallActivityTs(toolCall));
  }
  return latest;
}
function latestTerminalErrorTs(parsed) {
  let latest = 0;
  for (const toolCall of parsed.toolCalls) {
    if (!toolCall.isError || toolCall.name === "turn_aborted" || isToolUseStopText(toolCall.resultText))
      continue;
    latest = Math.max(latest, toolCallActivityTs(toolCall));
  }
  return latest;
}
function pendingApprovalTimes(source, toolCalls, fallbackTimestampMs) {
  if (source !== "claude") return [];
  const pending = [];
  for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {
    if (toolCall.endedAtMs !== void 0 || toolCall.resultText !== void 0) continue;
    if (claudeToolRequiresApproval({ name: toolCall.name, input: toolCall.input }, [])) {
      pending.push(toolCall.startedAtMs ?? fallbackTimestampMs);
    }
  }
  return pending;
}
function toolCallLabel(toolCall) {
  const input = toolCall.input;
  let arg = "";
  if (typeof input === "string") {
    arg = input;
  } else if (input && typeof input === "object") {
    const record = input;
    for (const key of [
      "command",
      "cmd",
      "file_path",
      "path",
      "pattern",
      "query",
      "description",
      "prompt",
      "subagent_type",
      "url"
    ]) {
      const value = record[key];
      if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) {
        arg = value;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  const compactArg = arg.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return compactArg ? `${toolCall.name} · ${compactArg.slice(0, 300)}` : toolCall.name;
}
const MAX_LAST_TOOL_INPUT_CHARS = 4e3;

function parseSourceLocation(source) {
  const match = source?.match(/^(.*):(\d+)$/);
  if (!match) return null;
  const line = Number(match[2]);
  return Number.isFinite(line) ? { path: match[1] ?? "", line } : null;
}
function terminalSignalLocations(parsed) {
  const locations = parsed.toolCalls.filter((toolCall) => toolCall.isError || toolCall.name === "turn_aborted").map((toolCall) => parseSourceLocation(toolCall.source)).filter((location) => location !== null);
  if (parsed.state === "failed" || parsed.state === "inactive") {
    const activityLocation = parseSourceLocation(parsed.activitySource);
    if (activityLocation) locations.push(activityLocation);
  }
  return locations;
}
function isAfterTerminalSignal(location, terminalSignals) {
  if (!location) return false;
  return terminalSignals.some(
    (errorLocation) => location.path === errorLocation.path && location.line > errorLocation.line
  );
}
function hasActivityAfterTerminalSignal(parsed, messages) {
  const terminalSignals = terminalSignalLocations(parsed);
  if (terminalSignals.length === 0) return false;
  return messages.some(
    (message) => isAfterTerminalSignal(parseSourceLocation(message.source), terminalSignals)
  ) || parsed.toolCalls.some(
    (toolCall) => isAfterTerminalSignal(parseSourceLocation(toolCall.source), terminalSignals)
  );
}
function shouldTrustExplicitLastKind(explicit, timestamps) {
  if (explicit === "assistant-tool-use") {
    return timestamps.lastToolResultTs === 0 || timestamps.lastToolCallTs > timestamps.lastToolResultTs;
  }
  if (explicit === "assistant-final") {
    return timestamps.lastToolCallTs <= timestamps.lastMessageTs;
  }
  if (explicit === "user") {
    return timestamps.lastToolCallTs <= Math.max(timestamps.lastMessageTs, timestamps.lastToolResultTs);
  }
  return true;
}
function deriveLastKind(parsed, messages) {
  const lastMessage = [...messages].reverse().find((message) => message.timestampMs !== void 0);
  const lastToolCall = [...parsed.toolCalls].reverse().find((toolCall) => toolCall.startedAtMs !== void 0);
  const lastToolResult = [...parsed.toolCalls].reverse().find((toolCall) => toolCall.endedAtMs !== void 0);
  const lastMessageTs = lastMessage?.timestampMs ?? 0;
  const lastToolCallTs = lastToolCall?.startedAtMs ?? 0;
  const lastToolResultTs = lastToolResult?.endedAtMs ?? 0;
  const errorTs = latestTerminalErrorTs(parsed);
  if (errorTs > 0 && errorTs >= Math.max(lastMessageTs, lastToolCallTs, lastToolResultTs)) {
    return "assistant-error";
  }
  if (parsed.state === "inactive" && parsed.toolCalls.some((toolCall) => toolCall.name === "turn_aborted") && !hasActivityAfterTerminalSignal(parsed, messages)) {
    return "user";
  }
  const explicit = lastEventKind(parsed.lastEventKind);
  if (explicit !== "other" && !hasActivityAfterTerminalSignal(parsed, messages) && shouldTrustExplicitLastKind(explicit, { lastMessageTs, lastToolCallTs, lastToolResultTs })) {
    return explicit;
  }
  if (lastToolCallTs > lastMessageTs && lastToolCallTs > lastToolResultTs)
    return "assistant-tool-use";
  if (lastToolResultTs > lastMessageTs && lastToolResultTs >= lastToolCallTs) return "user";
  if (!lastMessage) return "other";
  if (lastMessage.role === "user" || lastMessage.role === "tool") return "user";
  if (lastMessage.role === "assistant") {
    const hasToolCall = parsed.toolCalls.some(
      (toolCall) => toolCall.startedAtMs !== void 0 && lastMessage.timestampMs !== void 0 && toolCall.startedAtMs === lastMessage.timestampMs
    );
    return hasToolCall ? "assistant-tool-use" : "assistant-final";
  }
  return "other";
}
function mapMessages(parsed) {

  }));
}
function mapToolCalls(parsed, messages) {
  const sourceLocation = (source) => {
    const match = source?.match(/:(\d+)$/);
    if (!match) return null;
    const value = Number(match[1]);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? { path: source?.slice(0, -(match[0]?.length ?? 0)) ?? "", order: value } : null;
  };
  const sourceOrder = (source) => sourceLocation(source)?.order ?? null;
  const toolOrders = parsed.toolCalls.map((toolCall) => sourceOrder(toolCall.source));
  const nextToolOrders = new Array(toolOrders.length);
  let nextOrder;
  for (let index2 = toolOrders.length - 1; index2 >= 0; index2--) {
    nextToolOrders[index2] = nextOrder;
    if (toolOrders[index2] !== null) nextOrder = toolOrders[index2];
  }
  const messageByPosition = new Map(messages.map((message) => [message.position, message]));
  const candidateOwnersByToolPosition = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const ownerByMessagePosition = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
