  }
  function visibleStatusCounts(counts) {
    return TRAY_STATUS_ORDER.reduce(
      (visible, status) => {
        visible[status] = readMenuBarShowStatusCounter(status) ? counts[status] : 0;
        return visible;
      },
      { running: 0, waiting: 0, finished: 0 }
    );
  }
  function createTrayImage() {
    const flower = readTrayFlower(deps.getSetting, deps.flowerAssets);
    const image = deliveryNative.nativeImage.createFromPath(deps.flowerAssets[flower]);
    const resized = resizeTrayImage(
      image.isEmpty() ? deliveryNative.nativeImage.createFromPath(deps.appIcon) : image
    );
    resized.setTemplateImage(!readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsColored());
    return resized;
  }
  function getTrayFlowerDataUrl() {
    const flower = readTrayFlower(deps.getSetting, deps.flowerAssets);
    if (trayFlowerDataUrlCache?.flower === flower) return trayFlowerDataUrlCache.dataUrl;
    const image = deliveryNative.nativeImage.createFromPath(deps.flowerAssets[flower]);
    const dataUrl = image.isEmpty() ? null : image.resize({
      width: Math.round(evidencePins.TRAY_FLOWER_SIZE * evidencePins.TRAY_IMAGE_SCALE),
      height: Math.round(evidencePins.TRAY_FLOWER_SIZE * evidencePins.TRAY_IMAGE_SCALE),
      quality: "best"
    }).toDataURL();
    trayFlowerDataUrlCache = { flower, dataUrl };
    return dataUrl;
  }
  function getHarnessIconDataUrls() {
    if (harnessIconDataUrls) return harnessIconDataUrls;
    harnessIconDataUrls = {};
    for (const [source, assetPath] of Object.entries(deps.harnessIconAssets)) {
      if (!assetPath) {
        harnessIconDataUrls[source] = null;
        continue;
      }
      harnessIconDataUrls[source] = assetDataUrl(assetPath, "image/svg+xml");
    }
    return harnessIconDataUrls;
  }
  function stopPopoverFocusTimer() {
    if (!popoverFocusTimer) return;
    clearInterval(popoverFocusTimer);
    popoverFocusTimer = null;
  }
  function cancelPopoverHoverPreload() {
    if (!popoverHoverPreloadTimer) return;
    clearTimeout(popoverHoverPreloadTimer);
    popoverHoverPreloadTimer = null;
  }
  function cancelPopoverWarmRetention() {
    if (!popoverWarmRetentionTimer) return;
    clearTimeout(popoverWarmRetentionTimer);
    popoverWarmRetentionTimer = null;
  }
  function destroyWarmPopover() {
    if (!popoverWindow || popoverWindow.isDestroyed() || popoverWindow.isVisible()) return;
    popoverRenderId += 1;
    popoverWindow.destroy();
    popoverWindow = null;
    renderedPopoverHtml = null;
  }
  function schedulePopoverWarmTeardown() {
    cancelPopoverWarmRetention();
    if (!popoverWindow || popoverWindow.isDestroyed() || popoverWindow.isVisible()) return;
    popoverWarmRetentionTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      popoverWarmRetentionTimer = null;
      destroyWarmPopover();
    }, MENU_BAR_POPOVER_WARM_RETENTION_MS);
    popoverWarmRetentionTimer.unref?.();
  }
  function setPopoverMotion(window, running) {
    if (window.isDestroyed()) return;
    void window.webContents.executeJavaScript(
      `document.body.dataset.motion = ${running ? "'running'" : "'paused'"}`,
      true
    ).catch(() => void 0);
  }
  function hidePopover() {
    stopPopoverFocusTimer();
    if (!popoverWindow || popoverWindow.isDestroyed() || !popoverWindow.isVisible()) return;
    setPopoverMotion(popoverWindow, false);
    popoverWindow.hide();
    menuOpen = false;
    if (iconCounts) renderMenuBarIcon(iconCounts);
    schedulePopoverWarmTeardown();
  }
  function showPopover(window) {
    cancelPopoverWarmRetention();
    menuOpen = true;
    window.show();
    window.focus();
    setPopoverMotion(window, true);
    stopPopoverFocusTimer();
    const shownAt = Date.now();
    popoverFocusTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (window.isDestroyed() || !window.isVisible()) {
        stopPopoverFocusTimer();
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - shownAt >= 250 && (!deliveryNative.app.isActive() || !window.isFocused())) hidePopover();
    }, 100);
    popoverFocusTimer.unref();
  }
  function handleNativeThemeUpdated() {
    if (!tray) return;
    void update().catch((err) => deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-theme", err));
  }
  function installNativeThemeListener() {
    if (nativeThemeListenerInstalled) return;
    deliveryNative.nativeTheme.on("updated", handleNativeThemeUpdated);
    nativeThemeListenerInstalled = true;
  }
  function removeNativeThemeListener() {
    if (!nativeThemeListenerInstalled) return;
    deliveryNative.nativeTheme.removeListener("updated", handleNativeThemeUpdated);
    nativeThemeListenerInstalled = false;
  }
  function handlePopoverAction(url) {
    const action = new URL(url);
    hidePopover();
    switch (action.hostname) {
      case "open":
        deps.nativeWindow.focusPrimaryWindow();
        return;
      case "preferences":
        void deps.nativeWindow.openPathFromNativeMenu("/settings");
        return;
      case "quit":
        deps.requestQuit("menu-bar-popover");
        return;
      case "conversation": {
        const ref = action.searchParams.get("ref");
        if (ref) void deps.nativeWindow.openConversationFromNativeMenu(ref);
        return;
      }
      case "usage": {
        const provider = action.searchParams.get("provider");
        if (provider && evidencePins.MENU_BAR_USAGE_PROVIDER_ORDER.includes(provider)) {
          void deps.nativeWindow.openPathFromNativeMenu("/settings/usage");
        }
      }
    }
  }
  function getPopoverWindow() {
    if (popoverWindow && !popoverWindow.isDestroyed()) return popoverWindow;
    const window = new deliveryNative.BrowserWindow({
      width: MENU_BAR_POPOVER_WIDTH,
      height: 1,
      show: false,
      frame: false,
      transparent: true,
      backgroundColor: "#00000000",
      vibrancy: "menu",
      visualEffectState: "active",
      roundedCorners: true,
      hasShadow: true,
      resizable: false,
      movable: false,
      minimizable: false,
      maximizable: false,
      fullscreenable: false,
      skipTaskbar: true,
      webPreferences: {
        contextIsolation: true,
        nodeIntegration: false,
        sandbox: true
      }
    });
    popoverWindow = window;
    window.setAlwaysOnTop(true, "pop-up-menu");
    window.setVisibleOnAllWorkspaces(true, {
      visibleOnFullScreen: true,
      skipTransformProcessType: true
    });
    window.on("blur", hidePopover);
    window.on("closed", () => {
      if (popoverWindow === window) {
        stopPopoverFocusTimer();
        popoverWindow = null;
        renderedPopoverHtml = null;
        popoverShowPending = false;
      }
    });
    window.webContents.on("will-navigate", (event, url) => {
      if (!url.startsWith("blume-menu://")) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      handlePopoverAction(url);
    });
    window.webContents.on("before-input-event", (event, input) => {
      if (input.type !== "keyDown") return;
      if (input.key === "Escape") {
        event.preventDefault();
        hidePopover();
        return;
      }
      if (input.meta && !input.control && !input.alt && input.key === ",") {
        event.preventDefault();
        handlePopoverAction("blume-menu://preferences");
      }
    });
    window.webContents.on("render-process-gone", () => {
      if (!window.isDestroyed()) window.destroy();
    });
    window.webContents.on("unresponsive", () => {
      if (!window.isDestroyed()) window.destroy();
    });
    return window;
  }
  function positionPopover(window, height) {
    if (!tray) return;
    const trayBounds = tray.getBounds();
    const display = deliveryNative.screen.getDisplayNearestPoint({
      x: Math.round(trayBounds.x + trayBounds.width / 2),
      y: Math.round(trayBounds.y + trayBounds.height / 2)
    });
    const workArea = display.workArea;
    const width = MENU_BAR_POPOVER_WIDTH;
    const boundedHeight = Math.min(height, Math.max(120, workArea.height - 16));
    const idealX = Math.round(trayBounds.x + trayBounds.width / 2 - width / 2);
    const x = Math.min(Math.max(idealX, workArea.x + 4), workArea.x + workArea.width - width - 4);
    const belowY = Math.round(trayBounds.y + trayBounds.height + 4);
    const y = belowY + boundedHeight <= workArea.y + workArea.height ? belowY : Math.max(workArea.y + 4, Math.round(trayBounds.y - boundedHeight - 4));
    window.setBounds({ x, y, width, height: boundedHeight }, false);
  }
  async function withPopoverOperationTimeout(window, operation, task) {
    let timeout = null;
    try {
      return await Promise.race([
        task,
        new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
          timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!window.isDestroyed()) window.destroy();
            reject(new Error(`Menu bar popover ${operation} timed out`));
          }, MENU_BAR_POPOVER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
          timeout.unref?.();
        })
      ]);
    } finally {
      if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }
  async function renderPopoverOnce() {
    const model = latestPopoverModel;
    if (!model || !tray) return;
    const window = getPopoverWindow();
    const html = createMenuBarPopoverHtml(model);
    if (renderedPopoverHtml === html) {
      positionPopover(window, renderedPopoverHeight);
      return;
    }
    const renderId = ++popoverRenderId;
    try {
      await withPopoverOperationTimeout(
        window,
        "load",
        window.loadURL(`data:text/html;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(html)}`)
      );
    } catch (err) {
      if (renderId !== popoverRenderId) return;
      throw err;
    }
    if (renderId !== popoverRenderId || window.isDestroyed()) return;
    let measuredHeight = renderedPopoverHeight;
    try {
      measuredHeight = await withPopoverOperationTimeout(
        window,
        "height measurement",
        window.webContents.executeJavaScript(
          `(() => {
            const panel = document.querySelector('.panel')
            const bodyStyle = getComputedStyle(document.body)
            return Math.ceil(
              (panel?.scrollHeight ?? 0) +
                Number.parseFloat(bodyStyle.paddingTop) +
                Number.parseFloat(bodyStyle.paddingBottom)
            )
          })()`,
          true
        )
      );
    } catch (err) {
      deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-popover-height", err);
    }
    if (renderId !== popoverRenderId || window.isDestroyed()) return;
    renderedPopoverHtml = html;
    if (window.isVisible()) setPopoverMotion(window, true);
    if (typeof measuredHeight === "number" && Number.isFinite(measuredHeight) && measuredHeight > 0) {
      renderedPopoverHeight = measuredHeight;
    }
    positionPopover(window, renderedPopoverHeight);
  }
  function preparePopover(showAfterRender) {
    if (showAfterRender) popoverShowPending = true;
    if (popoverRenderInFlight) {
      popoverRenderPending = true;
      return popoverRenderInFlight.then(() => {
        if (!popoverRenderPending || !tray) return;
        return preparePopover(false);
      });
    }
    const run = (async () => {
      try {
        do {
          popoverRenderPending = false;
          await renderPopoverOnce();
        } while (popoverRenderPending && tray);
      } catch (error) {
        popoverShowPending = false;
        throw error;
      }
      if (!popoverShowPending) return;
      if (!latestPopoverModel) return;
      if (!popoverWindow || popoverWindow.isDestroyed() || !tray) {
        popoverShowPending = false;
        return;
      }
      popoverShowPending = false;
      showPopover(popoverWindow);
    })();
    const completion = run.finally(() => {
      if (popoverRenderInFlight === completion) popoverRenderInFlight = null;
    });
    popoverRenderInFlight = completion;
    return completion;
  }
  function preloadPopoverOnHover() {
    cancelPopoverWarmRetention();
    if (popoverWindow?.isVisible() || popoverHoverPreloadTimer) return;
    popoverHoverPreloadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      popoverHoverPreloadTimer = null;
      void preparePopover(false).catch(
        (err) => reportMenuBarPopoverLoadFailure("main.menu-bar-popover-preload", err, {
          logInfo: deps.logInfo,
          captureAppError: deps.captureAppError
        })
      );
    }, MENU_BAR_POPOVER_HOVER_PRELOAD_DELAY_MS);
    popoverHoverPreloadTimer.unref?.();
  }
  function handleTrayMouseLeave() {
    cancelPopoverHoverPreload();
    schedulePopoverWarmTeardown();
  }
  function createPopoverModel(conversations, totalConversationCount, usageItems) {
    const iconDataUrls = getHarnessIconDataUrls();
    const dark = deliveryNative.nativeTheme.shouldUseDarkColors;
    return {
      dark,
      appDisplayName: menuBarActionDisplayName(deps.appDisplayName),
      showConversations: readMenuBarShowConversations(),
      conversations: conversations.map((conversation) => ({
        ref: conversation.ref,
        title: conversation.title,
        source: conversation.source,
        state: conversation.state,
        statusColor: conversation.state === "running" ? runningAccentColor() : evidencePins.menuBarColorForStatus(conversation.state),
        harnessColor: evidencePins.menuBarColorForHarness(conversation.source),
        harnessIconDataUrl: iconDataUrls[conversation.source] ?? null
      })),
      hiddenConversationCount: Math.max(0, totalConversationCount - conversations.length),
      showUsage: readMenuBarShowUsageInDropdown(),
      usage: usageItems.map((item) => ({
        provider: item.provider,
        label: evidencePins.MENU_BAR_USAGE_PROVIDER_LABELS[item.provider],
        harnessColor: evidencePins.menuBarColorForHarness(item.provider),
        harnessIconDataUrl: iconDataUrls[item.provider] ?? null,
        windows: item.windows.map((window) => ({
          id: window.windowId,
          label: window.label,
          remainingPercent: window.remainingPercent,
          resetText: window.resetText
        }))
      }))
    };
  }
  function createMenuBarRenderPayload(counts, colored, animationFrame) {
    return evidencePins.createMenuBarTrayIconRenderPayload({
      counts,
      colored,
      statusIndicatorsFilled: readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsFilled(),
      animationFrame,
      flowerDataUrl: getTrayFlowerDataUrl(),
      usageIndicators: usageIndicatorsForRender(),
      harnessIconDataUrls: getHarnessIconDataUrls()
    });
  }
  function menuBarIconRenderKey(counts) {
    return JSON.stringify({
      counts,
      colored: readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsColored(),
      filled: readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsFilled(),
      flower: readTrayFlower(deps.getSetting, deps.flowerAssets),
      usage: usageIndicatorsForRender()
    });
  }
  async function createRenderedMenuBarImage(counts, animationFrame) {
    const colored = readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsColored();
    const payload = createMenuBarRenderPayload(counts, colored, animationFrame);
    const { renderAsync } = await import("@resvg/resvg-js");
    const rendered = await renderAsync(evidencePins.createMenuBarTrayIconSvg(payload), {
      fitTo: { mode: "zoom", value: payload.scale },
      font: createTrayRasterFontOptions(deps.trayFontFiles),
      logLevel: "off"
    });
    const image = deliveryNative.nativeImage.createFromBuffer(Buffer.from(rendered.asPng()), {
      scaleFactor: payload.scale
    });
    if (image.isEmpty()) throw new Error("Tray SVG rasterizer returned an empty image");
    image.setTemplateImage(!colored);
    return image;
  }
  function createFallbackMenuBarImage(counts, animationFrame) {
    const colored = readMenuBarStatusIndicatorsColored();
    const payload = createMenuBarRenderPayload(counts, colored, animationFrame);
    const image = deliveryNative.nativeImage.createFromBuffer(createFallbackMenuBarPng(payload), {
      scaleFactor: payload.scale
    });
    if (image.isEmpty()) return createTrayImage();
    image.setTemplateImage(!colored);
    return image;
  }
  function stopMenuBarIconAnimation() {
    if (!iconAnimationTimer) return;
    clearInterval(iconAnimationTimer);
    iconAnimationTimer = null;
    iconAnimationFrame = 0;
  }
  function renderMenuBarIcon(counts) {
    if (!tray || menuOpen) return;
    if (iconRenderInFlight) {
      iconRenderPending = true;
      return;
    }
    const cacheKey = menuBarIconRenderKey(counts);
    if (iconFrameCache?.key !== cacheKey) {
      iconFrameCache = { key: cacheKey, frames: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map() };
    }
    const animationFrame = iconAnimationFrame % evidencePins.TRAY_RUNNING_ANIMATION_FRAMES;
    const cachedImage = iconFrameCache.frames.get(animationFrame);
    if (cachedImage) {
      tray.setImage(cachedImage);
      tray.setTitle("");
      return;
    }
    const renderId = ++iconRenderId;
    iconRenderInFlight = true;
    void createRenderedMenuBarImage(counts, animationFrame).then((image) => {
      if (!tray || renderId !== iconRenderId) return;
      if (iconFrameCache?.key === cacheKey) iconFrameCache.frames.set(animationFrame, image);
      iconRenderFailureLogged = false;
      tray.setImage(image);
      tray.setTitle("");
    }).catch((err) => {
      if (!tray || renderId !== iconRenderId) return;
      const fallback = createFallbackMenuBarImage(counts, animationFrame);
      if (iconFrameCache?.key === cacheKey) iconFrameCache.frames.set(animationFrame, fallback);
      tray.setImage(fallback);
      if (!iconRenderFailureLogged) {
        iconRenderFailureLogged = true;
        deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-render", err);
      }
    }).finally(() => {
      iconRenderInFlight = false;
      if (!tray || !iconRenderPending) return;
      iconRenderPending = false;
      renderMenuBarIcon(iconCounts ?? counts);
    });
  }
  function syncMenuBarIconAnimation(counts) {
    if (!tray || !evidencePins.shouldAnimateMenuBarIcon(counts)) {
      stopMenuBarIconAnimation();
      return;
    }
    if (iconAnimationTimer) return;
    iconAnimationTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!tray) {
        stopMenuBarIconAnimation();
        return;
      }
      const counts2 = iconCounts;
      if (!counts2 || !evidencePins.shouldAnimateMenuBarIcon(counts2)) {
        stopMenuBarIconAnimation();
        return;
      }
      iconAnimationFrame += 1;
      renderMenuBarIcon(counts2);
    }, evidencePins.TRAY_ANIMATION_FRAME_MS);
  }
  async function refreshUsage(force) {
    if (!tray) return;
    if (!readMenuBarShowUsage() && !readMenuBarShowUsageInDropdown()) {
      usageReport = null;
      await update();
      return;
    }
    if (usageRefreshInFlight) return usageRefreshInFlight;
    usageRefreshInFlight = (async () => {
      try {
        const report = await deps.fetchUsageReport(force);
        if (!tray) return;
        usageReport = report;
        await update();
      } catch (err) {
        deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-usage", err);
      } finally {
        usageRefreshInFlight = null;
      }
    })();
    return usageRefreshInFlight;
  }
  function stopUsageRefreshTimer() {
    if (!usageRefreshTimer) return;
    clearInterval(usageRefreshTimer);
    usageRefreshTimer = null;
  }
  function syncUsageRefreshTimer() {
    if (!tray || !readMenuBarShowUsage() && !readMenuBarShowUsageInDropdown()) {
      stopUsageRefreshTimer();
      return;
    }
    if (usageRefreshTimer) return;
    usageRefreshTimer = setInterval(() => void refreshUsage(false), MENU_BAR_USAGE_REFRESH_MS);
    usageRefreshTimer.unref?.();
  }
  function showMenu() {
    if (!tray) return;
    cancelPopoverHoverPreload();
    cancelPopoverWarmRetention();
    if (popoverWindow?.isVisible()) {
      hidePopover();
      return;
    }
    void preparePopover(true).catch(
      (err) => reportMenuBarPopoverLoadFailure("main.menu-bar-popover", err, {
        logInfo: deps.logInfo,
        captureAppError: deps.captureAppError
      })
    );
    void refreshUsage(false);
  }
  function update(refreshConversations = false) {
    if (!tray) return Promise.resolve();
    if (updateInFlight) {
      updatePending = true;
      updatePendingConversationRefresh ||= refreshConversations;
      return updateInFlight;
    }
    const run = (async () => {
      const updateSyncId = syncId;
      if (refreshConversations) {
        try {
          latestConversationProjection = await deps.loadConversationProjection();
          conversationProjectionFailureLogged = false;
        } catch (err) {
          if (!conversationProjectionFailureLogged && shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(err)) {
            conversationProjectionFailureLogged = true;
            deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-snapshot", err);
          }
        }
      }
      if (updateSyncId !== syncId || !tray) return;
      const projected = latestConversationProjection;
      const counts = visibleStatusCounts(projected.counts);
      iconCounts = counts;
      syncMenuBarIconAnimation(counts);
      tray.setTitle("");
      const statusTooltip = TRAY_STATUS_ORDER.filter(readMenuBarShowStatusCounter).map((status) => `${counts[status]} ${evidencePins.MENU_BAR_AGENT_STATUS_LABELS[status]}`).join(", ");
      const tooltipParts = statusTooltip ? [statusTooltip] : [];
      const usageProjection = projectCurrentMenuBarUsage();
      if (readMenuBarShowUsage()) {
        const usageTooltip = usageProjection.indicators.map(
          (item) => `${evidencePins.MENU_BAR_USAGE_PROVIDER_LABELS[item.provider]} ${Math.round(item.remainingPercent)}% remaining`
        ).join(", ");
        if (usageTooltip) tooltipParts.push(usageTooltip);
      }
      tray.setToolTip(`${deps.appDisplayName}: ${tooltipParts.join("; ") || "menu bar item"}`);
      const visibleConversations = projected.rows;
      const usageItems = usageProjection.items;
      latestPopoverModel = createPopoverModel(
        visibleConversations,
        projected.totalConversationCount,
        usageItems
      );
      if (!tray) return;
      tray.setContextMenu(null);
      if (popoverShowPending || popoverWindow && !popoverWindow.isDestroyed() && (popoverWindow.isVisible() || popoverRenderInFlight)) {
        void preparePopover(false).catch(
          (err) => reportMenuBarPopoverLoadFailure("main.menu-bar-popover-update", err, {
            logInfo: deps.logInfo,
            captureAppError: deps.captureAppError
          })
        );
      }
      renderMenuBarIcon(counts);
    })();
    const completion = run.finally(async () => {
      if (updateInFlight === completion) updateInFlight = null;
      if (updatePending && tray) {
        const shouldRefreshConversations = updatePendingConversationRefresh;
        updatePending = false;
        updatePendingConversationRefresh = false;
        await update(shouldRefreshConversations);
      }
    });
    updateInFlight = completion;
    return completion;
  }
  function destroy() {
    syncId += 1;
    iconRenderId += 1;
    iconRenderPending = false;
    iconRenderInFlight = false;
    iconCounts = null;
    menuOpen = false;
    harnessIconDataUrls = null;
    trayFlowerDataUrlCache = null;
    iconFrameCache = null;
    latestPopoverModel = null;
    renderedPopoverHtml = null;
    renderedPopoverHeight = 400;
    latestConversationProjection = {
      rows: [],
      totalConversationCount: 0,
      counts: { running: 0, waiting: 0, finished: 0 }
    };
    popoverRenderInFlight = null;
    popoverRenderPending = false;
    popoverShowPending = false;
    usageReport = null;
    usageRefreshInFlight = null;
    updatePending = false;
    updatePendingConversationRefresh = false;
    conversationProjectionFailureLogged = false;
    stopMenuBarIconAnimation();
    stopPopoverFocusTimer();
    cancelPopoverHoverPreload();
    cancelPopoverWarmRetention();
    stopUsageRefreshTimer();
    removeNativeThemeListener();
    if (tray) tray.destroy();
    tray = null;
    popoverRenderId += 1;
    if (popoverWindow && !popoverWindow.isDestroyed()) popoverWindow.destroy();
    popoverWindow = null;
  }
  async function sync() {
    if (process.platform !== "darwin") return;
    if (!readMenuBarEnabled()) {
      destroy();
      return;
    }
    const currentSync = ++syncId;
    const featureEnabled = await deps.isFeatureEnabled(MAC_MENU_BAR_STATUS_ITEM_FLAG);
    if (currentSync !== syncId) return;
    if (!featureEnabled) {
      destroy();
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (!tray) {
        tray = new deliveryNative.Tray(createTrayImage());
        tray.setIgnoreDoubleClickEvents(true);
        tray.on("click", showMenu);
        tray.on("right-click", showMenu);
        tray.on("mouse-enter", preloadPopoverOnHover);
        tray.on("mouse-leave", handleTrayMouseLeave);
        tray.setHighlightMode?.("never");
      }
      installNativeThemeListener();
      syncUsageRefreshTimer();
      void refreshUsage(false);
      await update(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[blume] failed to sync menu bar icon:", err);
      deps.captureAppError("main.menu-bar-sync", err);
    }
  }
  async function notifySettingChanged(key) {
    if (key === MENU_BAR_ENABLED_SETTING_KEY) {
      await sync();
      return;
    }

const WRITE_EPIPE_MESSAGE = "write EPIPE";
const EPIPE_CODE = "EPIPE";
const EIO_CODE = "EIO";
const CONSOLE_WRITE_STACK_PATTERN = /\bconsole\.(?:log|info|warn|error|debug|value|trace)\b/;
function readErrnoCode(error) {
  if (!error || typeof error !== "object") return void 0;
  if (!("code" in error)) return void 0;
  const value = error.code;
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : void 0;
}
function errorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
  return String(error);
}
function errorStack(error) {
  if (error instanceof Error && typeof error.stack === "string") return error.stack;
  return "";

function isWriteEpipeMessage(message) {
  const trimmed = message.trim();
  return trimmed === WRITE_EPIPE_MESSAGE || trimmed.endsWith(`: ${WRITE_EPIPE_MESSAGE}`);
}
function stackLooksLikeConsoleWrite(stack) {
  return CONSOLE_WRITE_STACK_PATTERN.test(stack);

function isExpectedConsoleWriteEpipe(error) {
  if (!(error instanceof Error)) return false;
  const messageMatches = isWriteEpipeMessage(errorMessage(error));
  const codeMatches = readErrnoCode(error) === EPIPE_CODE;
  if (!messageMatches && !codeMatches) return false;
  const stack = errorStack(error);
  if (!stack) return false;

function isExpectedBrokenStdioPipeCode(code) {
  return code === EPIPE_CODE || code === EIO_CODE;
}
function ignoreBrokenStdioPipeErrors(streams = [process.stdout, process.stderr], log2) {
  for (const stream of streams) {
    if (!stream || typeof stream.on !== "function") continue;
    if (typeof stream.listenerCount === "function" && stream.listenerCount("error") > 0) {
      continue;
    }
    stream.on("error", (error) => {
      const code = readErrnoCode(error);
      if (isExpectedBrokenStdioPipeCode(code)) {
        return;
      }
      log2?.warn("unexpected stdio stream error", {
        code: code ?? null,
        error_name: error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown",
        error_message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      });
      throw error;
    });
  }
}

function createWrappedWeeklyJob(deps) {
  let inFlight = null;
  async function runTick() {
    let accountUserId = null;
    try {
      accountUserId = await deps.accountUserId();
    } catch {
      return "signed-out";
    }
    if (!accountUserId) return "signed-out";
    const nowMs = deps.now();
    const state = deps.readState();
    if (!useCases.isWeeklyWrappedDue({
      nowMs,
      lastRunMs: state.lastRunMs,
      lastPeriodStart: state.lastPeriodStart
    })) {
      return "not-due";
    }
    let result;
    try {
      result = await deps.generate({
        accountUserId,
        nowMs,
        lastRunMs: state.lastRunMs,
        lastPeriodStart: state.lastPeriodStart
      });
    } catch (error) {
      deps.writeState({ lastRunMs: nowMs, lastPeriodStart: state.lastPeriodStart });
      deps.onUnavailable?.(error);
      return "unavailable";
    }
    if (result.status === "skipped") {
      deps.writeState({ lastRunMs: nowMs, lastPeriodStart: state.lastPeriodStart });
      return "skipped";
    }
    deps.writeState({
      lastRunMs: nowMs,
      lastPeriodStart: result.periodStart ?? state.lastPeriodStart
    });
    if (result.status === "too-quiet") return "too-quiet";
    deps.onGenerated?.(result.periodStart);
    return "generated";
  }
  return {
    tick() {
      if (inFlight) return inFlight;
      const run = runTick().finally(() => {
        inFlight = null;
      });
      inFlight = run;
      return run;
    }
  };
}
function createWrappedScheduledTick(deps) {
  const weeklyJob = createWrappedWeeklyJob({
    now: deps.now,
    accountUserId: deps.accountUserId,
    readState: deps.readState,
    writeState: deps.writeState,
    generate: (input) => deps.generate({ mode: "weekly-if-due", ...input }),
    onGenerated: deps.onWeeklyGenerated,
    onUnavailable: deps.onWeeklyUnavailable
  });
  async function runGatedTick() {
    let featureEnabled = false;
    try {
      featureEnabled = await deps.isFeatureEnabled();
    } catch {
    }
    if (!featureEnabled) return null;
    let wrappedEnabled = true;
    try {
      wrappedEnabled = await deps.isWrappedEnabled();
    } catch {
    }
    if (!wrappedEnabled) return null;

    try {
      accountUserId = await deps.accountUserId();
    } catch {
    }
    try {
      const launchResult = await deps.generate({
        mode: "launch-recap",
        accountUserId,
        nowMs: deps.now()
      });
      if (launchResult.wrappedId && (launchResult.status === "created" || launchResult.status === "replaced")) {
        deps.onLaunchGenerated?.();
      }
    } catch {
    }
    return weeklyJob.tick();
  }
  let tickInFlight = null;
  let tickQueued = false;
  function requestTick() {
    if (tickInFlight) {
      tickQueued = true;
      return tickInFlight;
    }
    tickInFlight = (async () => {
      try {
        do {
          tickQueued = false;
          await runGatedTick();
        } while (tickQueued);
      } finally {
        tickQueued = false;
        tickInFlight = null;
      }
    })();
    return tickInFlight;
  }
  return {
    tick: requestTick
  };
}

  }

  }
  return { title, body, ...anonymous !== void 0 ? { anonymous } : {} };

function requireCommentInput(value) {

async function request(path, init = {}, authentication = "required") {
  let accessToken = null;
  try {
    accessToken = await getFeedbackAccountAccessToken();
  } catch (error) {
    if (authentication === "required") throw error;
  }
  const response = await fetch(`${FEEDBACK_BOARD_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS$2),
    headers: {
      Accept: "application/json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {},
      ...init.headers
    }
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
    throw new Error(
      typeof body?.error === "string" ? body.error : `Feedback board request failed (${response.status})`
    );
  }
  return response.json();
}

const MAX_CHILDREN_PER_PARENT = 40;
const MAX_NESTED_CHILDREN = 20;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 4;

const STARTER_README = `# First project

This folder was created by Blume so you have somewhere safe to try an AI agent.

Try asking your agent something like:

function homeRelative(ports, relative) {
  return ports.join(ports.homeDir(), ...relative.split("/"));
}
async function suggestProjectFolders(ports, limit = DEFAULT_LIMIT) {
  const found = [];
  const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const consider = async (path, name) => {
    const key = path.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    const isRepository = await ports.exists(ports.join(path, ".git"));
    seen.add(key);
    found.push({
      path,
      name,
      reason: isRepository ? "git" : "recent",
      modifiedAt: await ports.modifiedAt(path) ?? 0
    });
    return isRepository;
  };
  for (const parent of PROJECT_PARENTS) {
    const parentPath = homeRelative(ports, parent);
    const children2 = (await ports.readDirectories(parentPath)).slice(0, MAX_CHILDREN_PER_PARENT);
    for (const name of children2) {
      if (name.startsWith(".")) continue;
      const path = ports.join(parentPath, name);
      const wasRepository = await consider(path, name);
      if (wasRepository) continue;
      const nested = (await ports.readDirectories(path)).slice(0, MAX_NESTED_CHILDREN);
      for (const child of nested) {
        if (child.startsWith(".")) continue;
        await consider(ports.join(path, child), child);
      }
    }
  }
  return found.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.reason !== b.reason) return a.reason === "git" ? -1 : 1;
    return b.modifiedAt - a.modifiedAt;
  }).slice(0, limit).map(({ path, name, reason }) => ({ path, name, reason }));
}

  if (!await ports.exists(readme)) await ports.writeFile(readme, STARTER_README);
  return path;
}

function planManagedPiSetup(input) {

function managedPaymentMethodsFromJson(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return void 0;
  return value.flatMap((candidate, index2) => {
    if (typeof candidate !== "object" || candidate === null || Array.isArray(candidate)) return [];
    const record = candidate;
    const type = record.type === "card" || record.type === "bank" ? record.type : "other";
    const method = {
      id: nonEmptyString(record.id) ?? `payment-method-${index2 + 1}`,
      type,
      brand: nonEmptyString(record.brand) ?? (type === "card" ? "Card" : type === "bank" ? "Bank account" : "Payment method")
    };
    const last4 = nonEmptyString(record.last4);
    if (last4) method.last4 = last4;
    if (typeof record.expiryMonth === "number" && Number.isInteger(record.expiryMonth) && record.expiryMonth >= 1 && record.expiryMonth <= 12) {
      method.expiryMonth = record.expiryMonth;
    }
    if (typeof record.expiryYear === "number" && Number.isInteger(record.expiryYear) && record.expiryYear > 0) {
      method.expiryYear = record.expiryYear;
    }
    return [method];
  });

async function managedBillingUrl() {
  if (!await routerAvailable()) {
    return { status: "unavailable", reason: "The Blume router is not available yet." };
  }

  try {
    token = await getRouterAccountAccessToken();
  } catch (error) {

    return { status: "unavailable", reason: `Could not get a token for the router. ${detail}` };
  }

    method: "POST",
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });

  }

    return { status: "unavailable", reason: "The router sent something Blume could not read." };
  }

      label: model.label
    })),

    const target = _n.join(home, edit.path);

  }

    status: "ready",
    model: body.model,
    grantRemainingUsd: Number.isFinite(grantMicroUsd) ? grantMicroUsd / MICRO_USD_PER_USD : 0

function ensureWorker() {
  idleShutdown.cancel();
  if (worker) return worker;
  const forked = deliveryNative.utilityProcess.fork(pn.join(__dirname, "searchWorker.js"), [], {
    serviceName: SERVICE$1
  });

    if (worker !== forked || message?.type !== "search-result") return;
    const current = takePending(message.id);
    if (!current) return;

      lastFailureAtMs$1 = null;
      current.resolve(message.page);
      return;

function searchViaUtilityProcess(input) {
  if (pending) takePending(pending.id)?.reject(new SearchSupersededError());

    return Promise.reject(
      new SearchWorkerUnavailableError("search worker circuit breaker is cooling down")
    );
  }

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let target;
    try {
      target = ensureWorker();
    } catch (error) {
      const unavailable = unavailableError(error, "failed to spawn search worker");
      recordWorkerFailure(unavailable, "spawn");
      reject(unavailable);
      return;
    }
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      if (pending?.id !== id) return;
      failWorker(new SearchWorkerUnavailableError("search worker timed out"), "timeout");

    timeout.unref();

      target.postMessage({ type: "search", id, dbPath: getDbPath(), input });
    } catch (error) {
      failWorker(unavailableError(error, "failed to message search worker"), "message");
    }
  });
}

const SERVICE = BLUME_BACKGROUND_PROCESS_SERVICES.searchIndex;
let active = null;
let nextPassId = 0;

let disposed = false;
let lastFailureAtMs = null;
function schedule(delayMs) {
  if (disposed) return;
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timer = null;
    runSearchIndexPassNow();

}
function finish(pass, intent) {
  if (active !== pass) return;
  active = null;
  if (pass.watchdog) clearTimeout(pass.watchdog);
  finishBackgroundProcessRequest(SERVICE, pass.id);
  if (intent !== "request-settled") {
    try {
      pass.worker.postMessage({ type: "stop", id: pass.id });
    } catch {
    }
  }
  try {
    terminateBackgroundProcess(pass.worker, SERVICE, intent);
  } catch {
  }
}
function fail(pass, error, phase) {
  if (active !== pass) return;
  lastFailureAtMs = Date.now();
  finish(pass, phase === "timeout" ? "request-timeout" : "request-settled");
  void captureAppError("main.search.index_worker_failed", error, {
    phase,
    main_process_fallback: false
  });
}
function armWatchdog(pass) {
  if (pass.watchdog) clearTimeout(pass.watchdog);
  pass.watchdog = setTimeout(
    () => fail(pass, new Error("search index worker stopped responding"), "timeout"),
    SEARCH_INDEX_INACTIVITY_MS
  );
  pass.watchdog.unref();
}
function runSearchIndexPassNow() {
  if (disposed || active) return false;
  if (lastFailureAtMs !== null && Date.now() - lastFailureAtMs < SEARCH_INDEX_RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS) {
    return false;
  }
  let worker2;
  try {
    worker2 = deliveryNative.utilityProcess.fork(pn.join(__dirname, "searchIndexWorker.js"), [], {
      serviceName: SERVICE
    });
  } catch (error) {
    lastFailureAtMs = Date.now();
    void captureAppError("main.search.index_worker_failed", error, {
      phase: "spawn",
      main_process_fallback: false
    });
    return false;
  }
  const pass = { id: ++nextPassId, worker: worker2, watchdog: null };
  active = pass;
  startBackgroundProcessRequest(SERVICE, pass.id);
  armWatchdog(pass);
  worker2.on("message", (message) => {
    if (active !== pass || message?.id !== pass.id) return;
    if (message.type === "progress") {
      armWatchdog(pass);
      return;
    }
    if (message.ok) {
      lastFailureAtMs = null;
      finish(pass, "request-settled");
    } else {
      const error = new Error(message.errorMessage);
      if (message.errorName) error.name = message.errorName;
      fail(pass, error, "pass");
    }
  });
  worker2.on("exit", () => {
    if (active === pass) fail(pass, new Error("search index worker exited"), "exit");
  });
  try {
    worker2.postMessage({ type: "run", id: pass.id, dbPath: getDbPath(), commits: true });
  } catch (error) {
    fail(pass, error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), "message");
  }
  return true;
}

}

  timer = null;
  if (active) finish(active, "dispose");

}

      );
    }
  };
}
const CAREERS_TIMEOUT_MS = 5e3;
function createDesktopCareersFacade(deps) {
  const endpoint = deps.endpoint?.trim() || CAREERS_PRODUCTION_URL;
  const request2 = deps.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  async function listOpenings() {
    const response = await request2(endpoint, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CAREERS_TIMEOUT_MS),
      redirect: "error"
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`careers request failed (${response.status})`);
    return parseCareerOpeningsResponse(await response.json()).openings;
  }
  return {
    registerIpcHandlers(handleIpc2) {
      handleIpc2("careers:listOpenings", () => listOpenings());
      handleIpc2("careers:openOpening", (_event, value) => {
        if (typeof value !== "string" || !isAllowedCareerDestination(value)) {
          throw new TypeError("Invalid career destination");
        }
        return deps.openExternal(value);
      });
    }
  };
}
const ACCOUNT_SETTING_PREFIX = "account.";
const MAX_ACCOUNT_SETTINGS = 32;
const MAX_ACCOUNT_SETTING_LENGTH = 1e6;
function parseAccountSettings(encoded) {
  const value = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encoded, "base64").toString("utf8"));
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > MAX_ACCOUNT_SETTINGS) {
    throw new Error("Invalid dev account session import");
  }
  return value.map((entry) => {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object" || typeof entry.key !== "string" || !entry.key.startsWith(ACCOUNT_SETTING_PREFIX) || typeof entry.value !== "string" || entry.value.length > MAX_ACCOUNT_SETTING_LENGTH) {
      throw new Error("Invalid dev account session setting");
    }
    return { key: entry.key, value: entry.value };
  });
}
async function replaceDevAccountSettings(settings) {
  const current = getAllSettings();
  const incoming = new Map(settings.map(({ key, value }) => [key, value]));
  const writes = [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(current)) {
    if (key.startsWith(ACCOUNT_SETTING_PREFIX) && !incoming.has(key) && value !== "") {
      writes.push(setSettingAsync(key, ""));
    }
  }
  for (const { key, value } of settings) {
    if (current[key] !== value) writes.push(setSettingAsync(key, value));
  }
  await Promise.all(writes);
}
async function initializeDevAccountSession() {
  if (process.env.BLUME_DEV_INSTALL !== "1") return;
  if (process.env.BLUME_DEV_SIGNED_OUT === "1") {
    await replaceDevAccountSettings([]);
    return;
  }
  const accountSessionImport = process.env.BLUME_DEV_ACCOUNT_SESSION_IMPORT?.trim();
  if (!accountSessionImport) return;
  await replaceDevAccountSettings(parseAccountSettings(accountSessionImport));
}

const handleIpc = (channel, listener) => {
  deliveryNative.ipcMain.handle(channel, async (event, ...args) => {
    if (nativeLifecycle.isQuitting()) return void 0;
    const startedAtMs = Date.now();
    const failureProperties = (error) => ({
      source: "main.ipc",
      channel,
      duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - startedAtMs),
      online: deliveryNative.net.isOnline(),
      ...diagnosticPropertiesForError("main.ipc", error, { channel })
    });
    return invokeWithIpcErrorReporting({
      channel,
      // Timed per channel (bounded histogram + slow-call warnings), surfaced by perf:snapshot.
      invoke: () => timeIpcHandler(channel, () => listener(event, ...args)),
      readIsOnline: () => deliveryNative.net.isOnline(),
      onPathRejected: () => {
        void captureTelemetryEvent("ipc_path_rejected", {
          channel,
          duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - startedAtMs)
        });
      },
      onExpectedAuthState: () => {
        ipcLog.info("expected signed-out IPC read", {
          ...failureProperties(new Error("authentication required")),
          reporting_action: "local_log_only"
        });
      },
      onConfirmedOffline: (network, error) => {
        ipcLog.info("expected offline IPC failure", {
          ...failureProperties(error),
          network_failure_kind: network.kind,
          network_error_code: network.code,
          network_hostname_present: Boolean(network.hostname),
          reporting_action: "local_log_only"
        });
      },
      onExpectedServiceFailure: (network, error) => {
        void capturePosthogLog("info", "Expected optional-service IPC failure", {
          ...failureProperties(error),
          network_failure_kind: network.kind,
          network_error_code: network.code,
          network_hostname_present: Boolean(network.hostname),
          reporting_action: "posthog_log_only"
        });
      },
      onUnexpected: (error) => {
        if (!shouldReportConversationRefreshAppError(error)) return;
        if (!shouldReportSetupScanAppError(error)) return;
        if (!shouldReportSignalAnalyticsAppError(error)) return;
        if (!shouldReportWrappedGenerateAppError(error)) return;
        void captureAppError("main.ipc", error, failureProperties(error));
      }
    });
  });
};

function createDesktopConversationCompatibilityStore(db, desktop) {
  initializeCompatibilityTables(db);
  return {
    async latestActivityByProject(projectIds) {
      const latest = {};

        if (legacyProjectId === null) continue;
        const [row] = await desktop.listConversations({ projectId: legacyProjectId, limit: 1 });
        if (row) latest[projectId] = row.last_activity_ts;
      }
      return latest;
    },
    async listProjectConversations(projectId) {

      if (legacyProjectId === null) return [];

    },
    async getConversation(id) {

      if (legacyId === null) return null;

      return row ? conversationFromDesktop(db, row) : null;
    },
    async getConversationByRef(ref) {

      return row ? conversationFromDesktop(db, row) : null;
    },
    async getConversationTranscript(id, options) {
      const legacyId = resolvedLegacyId(db, "conversation", id);
      if (legacyId === null) return null;
      const conversation = await desktop.getConversationById(legacyId);
      if (!conversation) return null;
      const transcript = await desktop.getConversationTranscriptByRef(conversation.ref, options);
      return transcript ? { ...transcript, conversation: conversationFromDesktop(db, transcript.conversation) } : null;
    },
    async searchConversationTranscript(id, query, beforeTurnPosition) {
      const legacyId = resolvedLegacyId(db, "conversation", id);
      if (legacyId === null) {
        return { matches: [], nextBeforeTurnPosition: null, done: true };
      }
      const conversation = await desktop.getConversationById(legacyId);
      return conversation ? desktop.searchConversationTranscriptByRef(conversation.ref, query, beforeTurnPosition) : { matches: [], nextBeforeTurnPosition: null, done: true };
    },
    async markConversationIdle(id) {
      const legacyId = resolvedLegacyId(db, "conversation", id);
      if (legacyId === null) return;
      const conversation = await desktop.getConversationById(legacyId);
      if (conversation) await desktop.markConversationIdle(conversation.ref);
    },
    async dismissConversation(id, dismissedAt) {
      const legacyId = resolvedLegacyId(db, "conversation", id);
      if (legacyId === null) return;
      const conversation = await desktop.getConversationById(legacyId);
      if (conversation) await desktop.dismissConversation(conversation.ref, dismissedAt);
    },
    async upsertConversationIngest(batch) {
      await upsertCanonicalConversations(db, desktop, batch);
    }
  };
}

function replacementActivityEventCount(input) {
  const toolSourcePositions = new Set(
    input.toolCalls.flatMap(
      (tool) => tool.sourceEventPosition == null ? [] : [tool.sourceEventPosition]
    )
  );
  const toolResultPositions = new Set(
    input.toolCalls.flatMap(
      (tool) => tool.resultEventPosition == null ? [] : [tool.resultEventPosition]
    )
  );
  const visibleEvents = input.events.filter((event) => {
    if (event.sourcePosition == null) return true;
    if (event.kind === "tool_result" && toolResultPositions.has(event.sourcePosition)) return false;
    return !(event.kind === "assistant_text" && toolSourcePositions.has(event.sourcePosition) && !event.text?.trim());
  }).length;
  return visibleEvents + input.toolCalls.length;
}
function transcriptSearchExcerpt(text2, query) {
  const compact = text2.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const index2 = compact.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLocaleLowerCase());
  if (index2 < 0 || compact.length <= 260) return compact.slice(0, 260);
  const start = Math.max(0, index2 - 84);
  const end = Math.min(compact.length, index2 + query.length + 164);
  return `${start > 0 ? "…" : ""}${compact.slice(start, end).trim()}${end < compact.length ? "…" : ""}`;
}

    where.push(`state NOT IN (${states.map(() => "?").join(", ")})`);
    params.push(...states);

    where.push(`source IN (${sources2.map(() => "?").join(", ")})`);

    );
    params.push(...index.CODEX_SUBAGENT_THREAD_SOURCES);
  }

    params.push(opts.projectId);

  }

    async searchConversationTranscriptByRef(ref, query, beforeTurnPosition) {
      const needle = query.trim();
      if (needle.length < 2) return { matches: [], nextBeforeTurnPosition: null, done: true };
      const conversation = desktopConversationRow(
        db.prepare("SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE ref = ?").get(ref)
      );
      if (!conversation) return { matches: [], nextBeforeTurnPosition: null, done: true };
      const conversationId = int$3(conversation.id);
      const turn = db.prepare(
        `SELECT id, position FROM user_turns
           WHERE conversation_id = ? AND (? IS NULL OR position < ?)
           ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1`
      ).get(conversationId, beforeTurnPosition ?? null, beforeTurnPosition ?? null);
      if (!isRow$5(turn)) return { matches: [], nextBeforeTurnPosition: null, done: true };
      const turnId = int$3(turn.id);
      const turnPosition = int$3(turn.position);
      const pattern = `%${escapeLike(needle.toLowerCase())}%`;
      const rows2 = db.prepare(
        `SELECT key, label, text, turn_position, focus_event_id, focus_tool_call_id
           FROM (
             SELECT 'turn-' || ut.id || '-prompt' AS key, 'User' AS label, ut.prompt AS text,
               ut.position AS turn_position, NULL AS focus_event_id, NULL AS focus_tool_call_id,
               0 AS kind_order, ut.id AS row_id
             FROM user_turns ut
             WHERE ut.id = ? AND lower(ut.prompt) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.user_turn_id = ut.id AND e.kind = 'user_text')
             UNION ALL
             SELECT 'event-' || e.id,
               CASE e.kind WHEN 'user_text' THEN 'User' WHEN 'assistant_text' THEN 'Assistant' ELSE 'Tool result' END,
               e.text, ut.position, e.id, NULL, 1, e.id
             FROM events e JOIN user_turns ut ON ut.id = e.user_turn_id
             WHERE ut.id = ? AND e.text IS NOT NULL AND lower(e.text) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'
               AND NOT (e.kind = 'tool_result' AND e.tool_call_id IS NOT NULL)
             UNION ALL
             SELECT 'tool-' || tc.id, 'Tool',
               trim(tc.name || ' ' || coalesce(tc.input_json, '') || ' ' || coalesce(tc.result_text, '')),
               coalesce(ut.position, ?), tc.event_id, tc.id, 2, tc.id
             FROM tool_calls tc
             LEFT JOIN events e ON e.id = tc.event_id
             LEFT JOIN user_turns ut ON ut.id = e.user_turn_id
             WHERE tc.conversation_id = ?
               AND (ut.id = ? OR (tc.event_id IS NULL AND ? = (
                 SELECT max(position) FROM user_turns latest WHERE latest.conversation_id = tc.conversation_id
               )))
               AND lower(tc.name || ' ' || coalesce(tc.input_json, '') || ' ' || coalesce(tc.result_text, ''))
                 LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'
             UNION ALL
             SELECT 'todos-' || tl.id, 'Tasks updated', todo.content, ut.position,
               NULL, NULL, 3, todo.id
             FROM todos todo
             JOIN todo_lists tl ON tl.id = todo.list_id
             JOIN user_turns ut ON ut.id = tl.user_turn_id
             WHERE ut.id = ? AND lower(todo.content) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'
           )
           ORDER BY kind_order DESC, row_id DESC
           LIMIT 100`
      ).all(
        turnId,
        pattern,
        turnId,
        pattern,
        turnPosition,
        conversationId,
        turnId,
        turnPosition,
        pattern,
        turnId,
        pattern
      );
      const matches = rows2.flatMap((row) => {
        if (!isRow$5(row)) return [];
        const label = String(row.label);
        return [
          {
            key: String(row.key),
            label,
            excerpt: transcriptSearchExcerpt(String(row.text ?? ""), needle),
            turnPosition: int$3(row.turn_position),
            focusEventId: nullableNumberValue$1(row.focus_event_id),
            focusToolCallId: nullableNumberValue$1(row.focus_tool_call_id)
          }
        ];
      });
      const previous = db.prepare(
        "SELECT max(position) AS position FROM user_turns WHERE conversation_id = ? AND position < ?"
      ).get(conversationId, turnPosition);
      const previousPosition = isRow$5(previous) ? nullableNumberValue$1(previous.position) : null;
      return {
        matches,
        nextBeforeTurnPosition: previousPosition === null ? null : turnPosition,
        done: previousPosition === null
      };
    },

    async deleteConversationsBySourcePaths(paths) {
      const uniquePaths = [...new Set(paths)];
      if (uniquePaths.length === 0) return 0;
      return runInTransaction$1(db, () => {
        const statement = db.prepare(
          `DELETE FROM conversations
           WHERE source_id IN (SELECT id FROM sources WHERE path = ?)`
        );
        let deleted = 0;
        for (const path of uniquePaths) {
          const result = statement.run(path);
          if (isRow$5(result)) deleted += int$3(result.changes);
        }
        return deleted;
      });
    },

    async applyLegacyConversationOverrides(overrides) {
      if (overrides.length === 0) return [];
      return runInTransaction$1(db, () => {
        const deferred = [];
        const exists = db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM conversations WHERE ref = ?");
        const updateTitle = db.prepare(
          "UPDATE conversations SET title = ?, title_source = 'user' WHERE ref = ? AND title_source IS NOT 'user'"
        );
        const updateDismissed = db.prepare(
          "UPDATE conversations SET dismissed_at = ? WHERE ref = ?"
        );
        for (const override of overrides) {
          if (!isRow$5(exists.get(override.ref))) {
            deferred.push(override);
            continue;
          }
          if (override.title) updateTitle.run(override.title, override.ref);
          if (override.dismissedAt !== void 0) {
            updateDismissed.run(override.dismissedAt, override.ref);
          }
        }
        return deferred;
      });
    },

const RUN_VIEW_SELECT = `
  SELECT
    r.*,
    c.ref AS conversation_ref,
    c.title AS conversation_title,
    c.cwd AS conversation_cwd,
    p.path AS conversation_project_path,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS signal_count,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.cluster_id)
      FROM signal_cluster_members m
      JOIN signals s ON s.id = m.signal_id
      WHERE s.run_id = r.id
    ) AS cluster_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions su WHERE su.run_id = r.id) AS suggestion_count,
    (
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(h.token_estimate), 0)
      FROM insight_harness_calls h
      WHERE h.run_id = r.id
    ) AS token_estimate
  FROM insight_runs r
  LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
  LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
`;
function recomputeSignalClusterStats(db, clusterId, highPainScore) {
  const agg = db.prepare(
    `SELECT
         COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.conversation_id) AS conversation_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.project_id) AS project_count,
         MIN(s.created_at) AS first_seen,
         MAX(s.created_at) AS last_seen
       FROM signal_cluster_members m
       JOIN signals s ON s.id = m.signal_id
       LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = s.conversation_id
       WHERE m.cluster_id = ?`
  ).get(clusterId);
  const stats = isRow$4(agg) ? {
    signalCount: int$2(agg.signal_count),
    conversationCount: int$2(agg.conversation_count),
    projectCount: int$2(agg.project_count),
    firstSeen: agg.first_seen == null ? null : int$2(agg.first_seen),
    lastSeen: agg.last_seen == null ? null : int$2(agg.last_seen)
  } : {
    signalCount: 0,
    conversationCount: 0,
    projectCount: 0,
    firstSeen: null,
    lastSeen: null
  };
  const harnessRows = db.prepare(
    `SELECT DISTINCT s.observed_harness AS h
       FROM signal_cluster_members m
       JOIN signals s ON s.id = m.signal_id
       WHERE m.cluster_id = ?`
  ).all(clusterId).filter(isRow$4);
  const harnesses = harnessRows.map((row) => textOrNull$3(row.h)).filter(Boolean);
  const highPain = db.prepare(
    `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.conversation_id) AS n
       FROM signal_cluster_members m
       JOIN signals s ON s.id = m.signal_id
       WHERE m.cluster_id = ? AND s.pain_score >= ?`
  ).get(clusterId, highPainScore);
  const highPainConversationCount = isRow$4(highPain) ? int$2(highPain.n) : 0;
  const now = Date.now();
  db.prepare(
    `UPDATE signal_clusters
     SET signal_count = ?, conversation_count = ?, project_count = ?,
         harnesses_json = ?, high_pain_conversation_count = ?,
         first_seen_at = COALESCE(?, first_seen_at),
         last_seen_at = ?
     WHERE id = ?`
  ).run(
    stats.signalCount,
    stats.conversationCount,
    stats.projectCount,
    JSON.stringify(harnesses),
    highPainConversationCount,
    stats.firstSeen,
    stats.lastSeen ?? now,
    clusterId
  );
}
function replaceSuggestionClusters(db, suggestionId, clusterIds) {
  if (!tableExists$1(db, "suggestion_clusters")) return;
  const ids = uniquePositiveIds(clusterIds);
  const now = Date.now();
  db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
  try {
    db.prepare("DELETE FROM suggestion_clusters WHERE suggestion_id = ?").run(suggestionId);
    const stmt = db.prepare(
      `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO suggestion_clusters (suggestion_id, cluster_id, created_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?)`
    );
    for (const clusterId of ids) stmt.run(suggestionId, clusterId, now);
    db.exec("COMMIT");
  } catch (error) {
    db.exec("ROLLBACK");
    throw error;
  }
}

    async searchSignalClusters(query) {
      const scope = creatorReadScope(clustersHaveCreator, query);
      if (scope.empty) return [];
      ensureSearchFunctions();
      const { where, params } = insights$1.improveSearchWhere(
        {
          ...query,
          creatorAgentVersionId: clustersHaveCreator ? query.creatorAgentVersionId : void 0
        },
        {
          text: "blume_improve_fold(COALESCE(normalized_key, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(canonical_summary, ''))",
          tags: `blume_improve_tags(${clustersHaveTags ? "tags_json" : "'[]'"})`
        }
      );
      const eligibility = [
        where.slice(7),
        ...query.status ? ["status = ?"] : [],
        ...query.candidates ? ["status IN ('open', 'promoted')"] : []
      ].filter(Boolean);
      if (query.status) params.push(query.status);
      let score = "0";
      if (query.candidates) {
        const weights = insights$1.improveCandidateWeights(query.candidates);
        db.function(
          "blume_improve_score",
          { deterministic: true },
          (key, summary, harnesses) => insights$1.improveCandidateScore(
            {
              normalized_key: stringValue(key) ?? "",
              canonical_summary: stringValue(summary) ?? "",
              harnesses_json: stringValue(harnesses) ?? "[]"
            },
            weights
          )
        );
        score = "blume_improve_score(normalized_key, canonical_summary, harnesses_json)";
      }
      return compactMappedRows(
        db.prepare(
          `WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, ${score} AS candidate_score FROM signal_clusters${eligibility.length ? " WHERE " + eligibility.join(" AND ") : ""}) SELECT * FROM ranked ${query.candidates ? "WHERE candidate_score > 0" : ""} ORDER BY candidate_score DESC, last_seen_at DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?`
        ).all(...params, Math.max(0, Math.trunc(query.limit))),
        desktopSignalClusterRow
      );
    },
    async listSignalClusters(status, filter) {
      const scope = creatorReadScope(clustersHaveCreator, filter);
      if (scope.empty) return [];
      const clauses = [];
      const params = [];
      if (status) {
        clauses.push("status = ?");
        params.push(status);
      }
      if (scope.clause) {
        clauses.push(scope.clause);
        params.push(...scope.params);
      }
      const where = clauses.length ? ` WHERE ${clauses.join(" AND ")}` : "";
      return compactMappedRows(
        db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM signal_clusters${where} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC`).all(...params),
        desktopSignalClusterRow
      );
    },

    async addSignalClusterMember(clusterId, signalId, matchReason) {
      if (signalsHaveCreator && clustersHaveCreator) {
        const ownership = db.prepare(
          `SELECT
               c.creator_agent_version_id AS cluster_creator,
               s.creator_agent_version_id AS signal_creator
             FROM signal_clusters c
             JOIN signals s ON s.id = ?
             WHERE c.id = ?`
        ).get(signalId, clusterId);
        if (!isRow$4(ownership))
          throw new Error(`Cluster ${clusterId} or signal ${signalId} not found`);
        if (stringValue(ownership.cluster_creator) !== stringValue(ownership.signal_creator)) {
          throw new Error(
            "Cannot assign a signal to a cluster created by a different agent version"
          );
        }
      }
      db.prepare(
        `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO signal_cluster_members (cluster_id, signal_id, match_reason)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?)`
      ).run(clusterId, signalId, matchReason);
    },

    async clearPriorRunSignals(conversationId, transcriptHash, exceptRunId, highPainScore) {
      const sigRows = db.prepare(
        `SELECT s.id AS id FROM signals s
           JOIN insight_runs r ON r.id = s.run_id
           WHERE s.conversation_id = ? AND r.transcript_hash = ? AND s.run_id != ?`
      ).all(conversationId, transcriptHash, exceptRunId).filter(isRow$4);
      if (sigRows.length === 0) return 0;
      const signalIds = sigRows.map((row) => int$2(row.id));
      const placeholders2 = signalIds.map(() => "?").join(",");
      db.exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
      try {
        const clusterRows = db.prepare(
          `SELECT DISTINCT cluster_id AS id FROM signal_cluster_members
             WHERE signal_id IN (${placeholders2})`
        ).all(...signalIds).filter(isRow$4);
        const clusterIds = clusterRows.map((row) => int$2(row.id));
        db.prepare(`DELETE FROM signal_cluster_members WHERE signal_id IN (${placeholders2})`).run(
          ...signalIds
        );
        db.prepare(`DELETE FROM signals WHERE id IN (${placeholders2})`).run(...signalIds);
        for (const clusterId of clusterIds) {
          recomputeSignalClusterStats(db, clusterId, highPainScore);
        }
        db.exec("COMMIT");
        return signalIds.length;
      } catch (err) {
        db.exec("ROLLBACK");
        throw err;
      }
    },

    async listPendingSuggestionClusterRefs() {
      const statuses = `('draft', 'active', 'needs_review', 'snoozed')`;
      const creatorColumn = suggestionsHaveCreator ? "s.creator_agent_version_id" : "NULL";
      const linkRows = tableExists$1(db, "suggestion_clusters") ? db.prepare(
        `SELECT sc.cluster_id AS cluster_id, ${creatorColumn} AS creator
               FROM suggestion_clusters sc JOIN suggestions s ON s.id = sc.suggestion_id
               WHERE s.status IN ${statuses}`
      ).all() : [];
      const primaryRows = db.prepare(
        `SELECT s.cluster_id AS cluster_id, ${creatorColumn} AS creator
           FROM suggestions s WHERE s.status IN ${statuses}`
      ).all();
      const refs = [];
      for (const raw of [...primaryRows, ...linkRows]) {
        if (!isRow$4(raw)) continue;
        const clusterId = numberValue(raw.cluster_id);
        if (clusterId === null) continue;
        const creator = stringValue(raw.creator);
        refs.push({
          cluster_id: clusterId,
          ...creator ? { creator_agent_version_id: creator } : {}
        });
      }
      return refs;
    },

    async updateSuggestion(id, patch) {
      const sets = [];
      const params = [];
      if (patch.status !== void 0) {
        sets.push("status = ?");
        params.push(patch.status);
      }
      if (patch.snoozedUntil !== void 0) {
        sets.push("snoozed_until = ?");
        params.push(patch.snoozedUntil);
      }
      if (patch.applyResultJson !== void 0) {
        sets.push("apply_result_json = ?");
        params.push(patch.applyResultJson);
      }
      if (patch.title !== void 0) {
        sets.push("title = ?");
        params.push(patch.title);
      }
      if (patch.summary !== void 0) {
        sets.push("summary = ?");
        params.push(patch.summary);
      }
      if (suggestionsHaveFeedbackReasons && patch.feedbackReasonsJson !== void 0) {
        sets.push("feedback_reasons_json = ?");
        params.push(patch.feedbackReasonsJson);
      }
      if (patch.operationsJson !== void 0) {
        sets.push("operations_json = ?");
        params.push(patch.operationsJson);
      }
      if (patch.evidenceJson !== void 0) {
        sets.push("evidence_json = ?");
        params.push(patch.evidenceJson);
      }
      if (patch.clusterIds !== void 0) {
        const [primaryClusterId] = uniquePositiveIds(patch.clusterIds);
        if (primaryClusterId) {
          sets.push("cluster_id = ?");
          params.push(primaryClusterId);
        }
      }
      sets.push("updated_at = ?");
      params.push(Date.now());
      params.push(id);
      db.prepare(`UPDATE suggestions SET ${sets.join(", ")} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
      if (patch.clusterIds !== void 0) {
        replaceSuggestionClusters(db, id, patch.clusterIds);
      }
    },
    async getSignalCluster(id, filter) {
      const row = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM signal_clusters WHERE id = ?").get(id);
      const mapped = desktopSignalClusterRow(row);
      const creator = filter?.creatorAgentVersionId;
      if (mapped && creator && mapped.creator_agent_version_id !== creator) return null;
      return mapped;
    },
    async listSignalClusterDuplicateCandidates() {
      return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM signal_cluster_duplicate_candidates ORDER BY id DESC").all().map(desktopSignalClusterDuplicateCandidateRow).filter((row) => row !== null);
    },
    async insertSignalClusterDuplicateCandidate(input) {
      db.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO signal_cluster_duplicate_candidates
          (cluster_ids_json, reason, confidence, status, created_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'open', ?)`
      ).run(JSON.stringify(input.clusterIds), input.reason, input.confidence, Date.now());
    },
    async setSignalClusterStatus(id, status, promotedAt) {
      if (promotedAt !== void 0) {
        db.prepare("UPDATE signal_clusters SET status = ?, promoted_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(
          status,
          promotedAt,
          id
        );
        return;
      }
      db.prepare("UPDATE signal_clusters SET status = ? WHERE id = ?").run(status, id);
    },
    async incrementSignalClusterDismissed(id) {
      db.prepare(
        "UPDATE signal_clusters SET dismissed_count = dismissed_count + 1 WHERE id = ?"
      ).run(id);
    },
    async decrementSignalClusterDismissed(id) {
      db.prepare(
        "UPDATE signal_clusters SET dismissed_count = MAX(0, dismissed_count - 1) WHERE id = ?"
      ).run(id);
    }
  };
}
const initial = `-- Blume local DB. Source of truth for everything the app surfaces;
-- conversation rows are projected from on-disk JSONL via the ingestion
-- pipeline (see @blume/app-core conversation ingest runtime).
--
-- All timestamps are unix epoch milliseconds (Date.now()) unless suffixed
-- otherwise. Text fields use TEXT (utf8); JSON payloads are stored as TEXT
-- containing JSON for application-level decode.

CREATE TABLE meta (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Auto-created on conversation ingest, keyed by the canonical absolute
-- path of the project root (the directory above any tooling marker like
-- .claude / .git / .cursor). Different worktrees / harnesses of the same
-- repo share this path and therefore one row — they show up as different
-- conversations under one project, not as separate projects.
--
-- \`name\` is the display leaf (basename of \`path\`); the user can rename it
-- without breaking the upsert because identity is \`path\`. \`git_remote\` is
-- recorded for future cross-machine identity work but not used as a key
-- yet (left null in v0).
CREATE TABLE projects (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  path         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         TEXT NOT NULL,
  git_remote   TEXT,
  display_path TEXT,
  created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_name ON projects (name);

CREATE TABLE conversations (
  id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref               TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  source            TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- harness id: claude / cursor / codex / pi / omp
  external_id       TEXT,
  project_id        INTEGER REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  workspace         TEXT,                              -- worktree / sub-context id; null when conv runs from project root
  workspace_kind    TEXT,                              -- tooling dir that introduced the workspace (".claude", ".git", …)
  cwd               TEXT,
  branch            TEXT,
  entrypoint        TEXT,
  title             TEXT,
  title_source      TEXT,                              -- 'provider' | 'llm' | 'user'
  preview           TEXT,
  state             TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- 'running' | 'needs-approval' | 'finished' | 'idle' | 'failed' | 'inactive'
  last_kind         TEXT,
  started_at        INTEGER,
  last_activity_ts  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- ---- Denormalized UI cache (display only) --------------------------
  -- Populated by the ingest in the same transaction as the source events.
  -- Lets the agents-list card render without joins. JSON shape (all keys
  -- optional):
  --   { user_message?:      string, user_message_ts?:      number,
  --     assistant_message?: string, assistant_message_ts?: number,
  --     tool_call?:         string, tool_call_ts?:         number,
  --     tool_result?:       string, tool_result_ts?:       number }
  -- Drift is impossible by construction: one writer, one tx.
  last_activity     TEXT,                              -- JSON; null when empty
  -- --------------------------------------------------------------------
  dismissed_at      INTEGER,
  source_path       TEXT,
  source_mtime_ms   INTEGER,
  source_size       INTEGER,
  source_bytes_parsed INTEGER,
  ingested_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at        INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_state_activity ON conversations (state, last_activity_ts DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_project ON conversations (project_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_source ON conversations (source);
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_source_path ON conversations (source_path);

-- Chronological event log within an agent run. Renamed from \`messages\`;
-- the rename is semantic — these aren't just chat messages, they're every
-- observable thing the agent emitted in one run.
--
-- \`agent_run_id\` is the owning run. Conversation membership is reachable
-- via \`agent_runs.conversation_id\` — no duplicated FK on the event row.
--
-- \`kind\` discriminates: 'user_text' (a user message), 'assistant_text'
-- (an assistant text block), 'tool_result' (a tool result that came
-- back). Tool USES (the assistant asking to run a tool) are not their
-- own event row in v0 — the assistant message that contained them is
-- the event; the structured payload lives in tool_calls and joins back
-- via \`tool_calls.event_id\`.
--
-- \`position\` is run-scoped, monotonic, source-line order. The tuple
-- (agent_run_id, position) is unique. Ordering by position is the
-- canonical transcript order; \`timestamp_ms\` is wall-clock data only,
-- not authoritative (tool_result events may share timestamps with their
-- parent assistant message).
CREATE TABLE events (
  id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  agent_run_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind            TEXT NOT NULL,                    -- 'user_text' | 'assistant_text' | 'tool_result'
  text            TEXT,
  timestamp_ms    INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (agent_run_id, position)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_run_pos ON events (agent_run_id, position);

CREATE TABLE tool_calls (
  id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_id        INTEGER REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  tool_use_id     TEXT,
  name            TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_json      TEXT,
  result_text     TEXT,
  is_error        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  started_at_ms   INTEGER,
  ended_at_ms     INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX idx_tool_calls_conv    ON tool_calls (conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_tool_calls_use_id  ON tool_calls (conversation_id, tool_use_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_tool_calls_name    ON tool_calls (name);
CREATE INDEX idx_tool_calls_event   ON tool_calls (event_id);

-- One row per cycle of agent processing in a conversation. A run is
-- triggered by either a user message (kind='user_turn') or a parent
-- tool_use that spawned this conversation as a sub-agent
-- (kind='sub_agent_spawn'). Approval pauses stay inside one run; a fresh
-- user message opens a new run.
--
-- \`position\` is sequential per conversation; the tuple
-- (conversation_id, position) is unique. We never order by started_at
-- alone — runs can be fast back-to-back in programmatic flows.
--
-- \`parent_tool_use_id\` is null for user_turn runs. For sub_agent_spawn
-- runs it carries the tool_use_id of the Task/Agent tool call that
-- spawned this run — a string FK into the tool_calls table within the
-- same conversation. Read "parent" as "predecessor / triggering": the
-- tool_use came first, this run is what it produced. Stored as a string
-- (not an INTEGER FK) because cross-file ingest ordering is not
-- guaranteed.
--
-- \`title\` is null for user_turn (no spawn description); set to the
-- spawning tool call's \`description\` for sub_agent_spawn. The UI uses
-- it for the sub-agent chip label.
--
-- \`prompt\` is the input that started the run: the user's message text
-- for user_turn, the full spawn prompt for sub_agent_spawn.
--
-- \`position\` is conversation-scoped and assigned in source-line order;
-- user_turn and sub_agent_spawn rows share the position space so the
-- "what happened next" timeline is structurally captured.
CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
  id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position           INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind               TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'user_turn' | 'sub_agent_spawn'
  parent_tool_use_id TEXT,
  title              TEXT,
  prompt             TEXT NOT NULL,
  state              TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at         INTEGER,
  ended_at           INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (conversation_id, position)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_conv_pos ON agent_runs (conversation_id, position);
CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_kind     ON agent_runs (kind);

-- Append-only versioned todo lists. Each \`TodoWrite\` call in a conversation
-- emits a new row in \`todo_lists\` (the harnesses' TodoWrite API takes a
-- complete list snapshot, not item-level patches — so a "new list" is the
-- natural representation). The previous list's \`superseded_at\` gets set to
-- the new list's \`created_at\` at ingest time. Active list = the row where
-- \`superseded_at IS NULL\`.
--
-- Bonus: keeping every version gives us the trajectory of any todo for
-- free — query historic lists to see "task X was pending in list 3,
-- current in list 5, done in list 8."
CREATE TABLE todo_lists (
  id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_event_id INTEGER REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  superseded_at   INTEGER                    -- null = currently active
);
CREATE INDEX idx_todo_lists_conv_active ON todo_lists (conversation_id, superseded_at);

CREATE TABLE todos (
  id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  list_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_lists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  content   TEXT NOT NULL,
  state     TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- 'pending' | 'current' | 'done'
  UNIQUE (list_id, position)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_todos_list_pos ON todos (list_id, position);

-- Reserved for canonical agentic_setup_artifacts + agentic_setup_artifact_versions
-- in a follow-up migration. The previous prototype table (\`setup_files\`) was
-- removed because it stored Blume's own install log under a name that would
-- collide with the canonical artifact identity table.

CREATE TABLE settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
);
`;
