function artifactProviderFromPath(path) {
  const normalized = path.replace(/\\/g, "/");
  const segments = normalized.toLowerCase().split("/");
  if (segments.includes(".claude")) return "claude";
  if (segments.includes(".codex")) return "codex";
  if (segments.includes(".cursor")) return "cursor";
  const file = segments[segments.length - 1];
  if (file === "claude.md" || file === "claude.local.md") return "claude";
  if (file === "agents.md" || file === "agents.local.md" || file === "codex.md") return "codex";
  if (file === "cursor.md" || file === ".cursorrules") return "cursor";
  return void 0;
}
function classifyArtifactDocumentPath(path, options = {}) {
  const normalized = path.replace(/\\/g, "/");
  const segments = normalized.toLowerCase().split("/");
  const file = segments[segments.length - 1];
  const provider = artifactProviderFromPath(normalized);
  const harnessRootIndex = segments.findIndex(
    (segment) => [".claude", ".codex", ".cursor", ".agents"].includes(segment)
  );
  const harnessSegments = harnessRootIndex >= 0 ? segments.slice(harnessRootIndex + 1) : [];
  if (harnessSegments.includes("rules")) return { kind: "instruction", provider };
  if (harnessSegments.includes("agents")) return { kind: "sub-agent", provider };
  if (harnessSegments.includes("commands")) return { kind: "command", provider };
  if (harnessSegments.includes("hooks")) return { kind: "hook", provider };
  if (file === "agents.md" || file === "agents.local.md") {
    return { kind: "instruction", provider };
  }
  if (file === "claude.md" || file === "claude.local.md" || file === "codex.md" || file === "cursor.md" || file === ".cursorrules") {
    return { kind: "instruction", provider };
  }
  if (file === "skill.md" && !options.containedBySkill) return { kind: "skill", provider };
  if (file === "skill.md") return { kind: "instruction", provider };
  return { kind: "knowledge", provider };
}
function setupBrowserCategoryOrder(name) {
  const idx = CONFIG_CATEGORY_ORDER.indexOf(name);
  return idx === -1 ? CONFIG_CATEGORY_ORDER.length : idx;
}
function configCategory(name) {
  const key = name.toLowerCase();
  return Object.hasOwn(CONFIG_CATEGORY_BY_NAME, key) ? CONFIG_CATEGORY_BY_NAME[key] : void 0;
}
function isConfigName(name) {
  return Object.hasOwn(CONFIG_CATEGORY_BY_NAME, name.toLowerCase());
}
const CONFIG_SOURCE_BY_NAME = {
  "claude.md": "claude",
  "claude.local.md": "claude",
  "cursor.md": "cursor",
  ".cursorrules": "cursor",
  "codex.md": "codex"
};
function configSource(name) {
  const key = name.toLowerCase();
  return Object.hasOwn(CONFIG_SOURCE_BY_NAME, key) ? CONFIG_SOURCE_BY_NAME[key] : void 0;
}
const READABLE_EXT_RE = /\.(md|mdc|markdown|txt|toml|ya?ml|json|jsonl|sh|bash|py|ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|html|xml|sql|log)$/i;
function isReadableFileName(name) {
  return READABLE_EXT_RE.test(name) || isConfigName(name);
}
function isSetupDevFormatReadableFileName(name) {
  return isReadableFileName(name) || name.toLowerCase() === "settings";
}
function approxSetupBrowserTokens(text) {
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(text.length / 4));
}
async function setupBrowserTokensForFile(path, fs) {
  try {
    return approxSetupBrowserTokens(await fs.readFile(path));
  } catch {
    return void 0;
  }
}
async function setupBrowserDirectoryListing(dir, fs) {
  if (fs.readdirEntries) {
    const values = await fs.readdirEntries(dir);
    return {
      names: values.map((entry) => entry.name),
      entries: new Map(values.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry]))
    };
  }
  return { names: await fs.readdir(dir) };
}
async function setupBrowserEntryStat(child, name, listing, fs) {
  const entry = listing.entries?.get(name);
  if (entry && (entry.isDirectory() || entry.isFile())) return entry;
  return fs.stat(child);
}
async function resolveSetupBrowserContentPath(entryPath, deps) {
  if (await setupBrowserSafeIsFile(entryPath, deps.fs)) {
    return isSetupBrowserContentFileName(entryPath) ? entryPath : void 0;
  }
  if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(entryPath, deps.fs)) return void 0;
  for (const name of SETUP_BROWSER_PREFERRED_CONTENT_FILES) {
    const candidate = deps.path.join(entryPath, name);
    if (await setupBrowserSafeIsFile(candidate, deps.fs)) return candidate;
  }
  let kids;
  try {
    kids = await deps.fs.readdir(entryPath);
  } catch {
    return void 0;
  }
  const md = kids.find((name) => /\.md$/i.test(name));
  return md ? deps.path.join(entryPath, md) : void 0;
}
async function walkSetupBrowserEntryFiles(root, deps) {
  const maxFiles = deps.maxFiles ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_MAX_ENTRY_FILES;
  const maxDepth = deps.maxDepth ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_MAX_ENTRY_WALK_DEPTH;
  const results = [];
  async function recurse(dir, depth) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    if (results.length >= maxFiles) return;
    if (depth > maxDepth) return;
    let listing;
    try {
      listing = await setupBrowserDirectoryListing(dir, deps.fs);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    const kids = listing.names;
    kids.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    for (const name of kids) {
      throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
      if (results.length >= maxFiles) return;
      if (name.startsWith(".")) continue;
      if (shouldSkipSetupBrowserSubdir(name)) continue;
      const child = deps.path.join(dir, name);
      let st;
      try {
        st = await setupBrowserEntryStat(child, name, listing, deps.fs);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      if (st.isDirectory()) {
        await recurse(child, depth + 1);
      } else if (st.isFile() && READABLE_EXT_RE.test(name)) {
        results.push({
          relPath: child.startsWith(root + deps.path.sep) ? child.slice(root.length + 1) : name,
          absPath: child,
          tokens: deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await setupBrowserTokensForFile(child, deps.fs)
        });
      }
    }
  }
  await recurse(root, 0);
  return results;
}
async function listSetupBrowserCategoryEntries(dir, deps) {
  let names;
  try {
    names = await deps.fs.readdir(dir);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
  const filtered = names.filter((name) => {
    if (name.startsWith(".")) return false;
    if (name.endsWith(".json") && name !== "package.json") return false;
    return true;
  });
  filtered.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  const entries = [];
  for (const name of filtered) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    const entryPath = deps.path.join(dir, name);
    const isDir = await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(entryPath, deps.fs);
    const contentPath = await resolveSetupBrowserContentPath(entryPath, deps);
    if (!isDir) {
      const tokens2 = contentPath ? deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await setupBrowserTokensForFile(contentPath, deps.fs) : void 0;
      entries.push({ name, contentPath, tokens: tokens2 });
      continue;
    }
    const files = deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await walkSetupBrowserEntryFiles(entryPath, deps);
    const tokens = files?.reduce((n, f) => n + (f.tokens ?? 0), 0) || void 0;
    entries.push({ name, contentPath, tokens, files });
  }
  return entries;
}
async function listSetupBrowserHarnessCategories(root, deps) {
  const categories = [];
  for (const name of SETUP_BROWSER_CATEGORY_DIRS) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    const sub = deps.path.join(root, name);
    if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(sub, deps.fs)) continue;
    const entries = await listSetupBrowserCategoryEntries(sub, deps);
    if (entries.length === 0) continue;
    categories.push({ name, entries });
  }
  return categories;
}
function discoveredArtifact(identity, input) {
  return {
    ...identity,
    id: artifactId(identity),
    name: input.name,
    kind: input.kind,
    influence: influenceForArtifactKind(input.kind),
    composition: input.composition,
    enabled: input.enabled,
    effective: input.enabled === false ? false : void 0,
    metadata: input.metadata,
    parserVersion: input.parserVersion,
    scannerVersion: input.scannerVersion
  };
}
function artifactKindForCategory(category) {
  switch (category) {
    case "skills":
      return "skill";
    case "agents":
      return "sub-agent";
    case "commands":
      return "command";
    case "hooks":
      return "hook";
    case "rules":
      return "instruction";
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}
function harnessCategoryArtifacts(source, root, categories, path) {
  const artifacts = [];
  const artifactRelationships = [];
  const globalRootName = harnessHomeDir(source).replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/$/, "");
  for (const category of categories) {
    const kind = artifactKindForCategory(category.name);
    for (const entry of category.entries) {
      const runtimePath = path.join(root, category.name, entry.name);
      const sourcePath = `${globalRootName}/${category.name}/${entry.name}`;
      const composite = Boolean(entry.files?.length) || kind === "skill";
      const parent = discoveredArtifact(
        {
          scope: "global",
          provider: source,
          source: composite ? { type: "directory", path: sourcePath, runtimePath } : {
            type: "file",
            path: sourcePath,
            runtimePath: entry.contentPath ?? runtimePath
          }
        },
        {
          name: entry.name,
          kind,
          composition: composite ? "composite" : "atomic",
          parserVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_PARSER_VERSION,
          scannerVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_SCANNER_VERSION
        }
      );
      artifacts.push(parent);
      for (const file of entry.files ?? []) {
        if (!isArtifactDocumentFileName(file.relPath)) continue;
        const childPath = `${sourcePath}/${file.relPath.replace(/\\/g, "/")}`;
        const classification = classifyArtifactDocumentPath(childPath, {
          containedBySkill: kind === "skill"
        });
        const child = discoveredArtifact(
          {
            scope: "global",
            provider: source,
            source: { type: "file", path: childPath, runtimePath: file.absPath }
          },
          {
            name: file.relPath,
            kind: classification.kind,
            composition: "atomic",
            parserVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_PARSER_VERSION,
            scannerVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_SCANNER_VERSION
          }
        );
        artifacts.push(child);
        artifactRelationships.push({
          fromUnitId: parent.id,
          toUnitId: child.id,
          kind: "contains",
          evidence: "confirmed"
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { artifacts, artifactRelationships };
}
async function installedPluginArtifacts(source, root, deps) {
  if (source !== "codex" && source !== "claude") return { units: [], relationships: [] };
  const cacheRoot = deps.path.join(root, "plugins", "cache");
  if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(cacheRoot, deps.fs)) return { units: [], relationships: [] };
  const marketplaceNames = (await deps.fs.readdir(cacheRoot)).filter((name) => !name.startsWith(".")).sort().slice(0, 64);
  const units = [];
  const relationships = [];
  const maxProvidedUnitsPerPlugin = 512;
  for (const marketplace of marketplaceNames) {
    const marketplacePath = deps.path.join(cacheRoot, marketplace);
    if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(marketplacePath, deps.fs)) continue;
    const pluginNames = (await deps.fs.readdir(marketplacePath)).filter((name) => !name.startsWith(".")).sort().slice(0, 256);
    for (const plugin of pluginNames) {
      const pluginPath = deps.path.join(marketplacePath, plugin);
      if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(pluginPath, deps.fs)) continue;
      const versionNames = (await deps.fs.readdir(pluginPath)).filter((name) => !name.startsWith(".")).sort((left, right) => right.localeCompare(left, void 0, { numeric: true }));
      const version = versionNames[0];
      const runtimePath = version ? deps.path.join(pluginPath, version) : pluginPath;
      if (version && !await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(runtimePath, deps.fs)) continue;
      const packageId = `${plugin}@${marketplace}`;
      const portablePath2 = `${harnessHomeDir(source).replace(/\\/g, "/")}/plugins/cache/${marketplace}/${plugin}`;
      const pluginUnit = discoveredArtifact(
        {
          scope: "global",
          provider: source,
          source: {
            type: "installed-package",
            packageId,
            version,
            path: portablePath2,
            runtimePath
          }
        },
        {
          name: plugin,
          kind: "plugin",
          composition: "composite",
          metadata: { packageId, marketplace, installed: true, ...version ? { version } : {} },
          parserVersion: STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT_PARSER_VERSION,
          scannerVersion: STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT_SCANNER_VERSION
        }
      );
      units.push(pluginUnit);
      let providedUnitCount = 0;
      for (const category of SETUP_BROWSER_CATEGORY_DIRS) {
        if (providedUnitCount >= maxProvidedUnitsPerPlugin) break;
        const categoryPath = deps.path.join(runtimePath, category);
        if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(categoryPath, deps.fs)) continue;
        const entryNames = (await deps.fs.readdir(categoryPath)).filter((name) => !name.startsWith(".")).sort().slice(0, maxProvidedUnitsPerPlugin - providedUnitCount);
        for (const entryName of entryNames) {
          const entryRuntimePath = deps.path.join(categoryPath, entryName);
          let stat;
          try {
            stat = await deps.fs.stat(entryRuntimePath);
          } catch {
            continue;
          }
          if (!stat.isDirectory() && !stat.isFile()) continue;
          const entrySourcePath = `${portablePath2}/${category}/${entryName}`;
          const providedUnit = discoveredArtifact(
            {
              scope: "global",
              provider: source,
              source: stat.isDirectory() ? { type: "directory", path: entrySourcePath, runtimePath: entryRuntimePath } : { type: "file", path: entrySourcePath, runtimePath: entryRuntimePath }
            },
            {
              name: entryName,
              kind: artifactKindForCategory(category),
              composition: stat.isDirectory() ? "composite" : "atomic",
              metadata: { providedBy: packageId },
              parserVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_PARSER_VERSION,
              scannerVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_SCANNER_VERSION
            }
          );
          units.push(providedUnit);
          relationships.push({
            fromUnitId: pluginUnit.id,
            toUnitId: providedUnit.id,
            kind: "provides",
            evidence: "confirmed"
          });
          providedUnitCount += 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return { units, relationships };
}
function mergeInstalledPluginUnits(target, installed) {
  const remappedIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const candidate of installed.units.filter((unit2) => unit2.kind === "plugin")) {
    const candidatePackageId = String(candidate.metadata?.packageId ?? "");
    const declared = target.artifacts.find((unit2) => {
      if (unit2.kind !== "plugin" || unit2.source.type !== "config-entry") return false;
      const declaredPackageId = String(unit2.metadata?.packageId ?? unit2.name);
      return declaredPackageId === candidatePackageId || declaredPackageId.split("@")[0] === candidatePackageId.split("@")[0];
    });
    if (declared) {
      declared.metadata = { ...declared.metadata, ...candidate.metadata };
      remappedIds.set(candidate.id, declared.id);
      continue;
    }
    target.artifacts.push(candidate);
  }
  for (const candidate of installed.units.filter((unit2) => unit2.kind !== "plugin")) {
    if (!target.artifacts.some((unit2) => unit2.id === candidate.id)) target.artifacts.push(candidate);
  }
  target.artifactRelationships.push(
    ...installed.relationships.map((relationship) => ({
      ...relationship,
      fromUnitId: remappedIds.get(relationship.fromUnitId) ?? relationship.fromUnitId,
      toUnitId: remappedIds.get(relationship.toUnitId) ?? relationship.toUnitId
    }))
  );
}
async function readStructuredArtifacts(path, parser, fs) {
  if (!await setupBrowserSafeIsFile(path, fs)) {
    return { units: [], relationships: [], diagnostics: [] };
  }
  try {
    return parser(await fs.readFile(path));
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      units: [],
      relationships: [],
      diagnostics: [
        {
          sourcePath: path,
          severity: "error",
          code: "parse-error",
          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }
      ]
    };
  }
}
function mergeStructuredArtifacts(target, addition) {
  const existing = new Set(target.artifacts.map((unit2) => unit2.id));
  for (const unit2 of addition.units) {
    if (!existing.has(unit2.id)) target.artifacts.push(unit2);
  }
  target.artifactRelationships.push(...addition.relationships);
  target.artifactDiagnostics.push(...addition.diagnostics);
}
async function scanSetupBrowserHarness(source, root, deps) {
  const exists = await setupBrowserSafeIsDir(root, deps.fs);
  if (!exists) {
    return {
      source,
      path: "",
      exists: false,
      categories: [],
      artifacts: [],
      artifactRelationships: [],
      artifactDiagnostics: []
    };
  }
  const categories = await listSetupBrowserHarnessCategories(root, deps);
  const categoryUnits = harnessCategoryArtifacts(source, root, categories, deps.path);
  const result = {
    source,
    path: root,
    exists: true,
    categories,
    ...categoryUnits,
    artifactDiagnostics: []
  };
  const sourcePathRoot = harnessHomeDir(source).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  if (source === "codex") {
    const configPath = deps.path.join(root, "config.toml");
    mergeStructuredArtifacts(
      result,
      await readStructuredArtifacts(
        configPath,
        (content) => parseCodexConfigArtifacts(content, {
          scope: "global",
          sourcePath: `${sourcePathRoot}/config.toml`,
          runtimePath: configPath
        }),
        deps.fs
      )
    );
  } else if (source === "claude") {
    const settingsPath = deps.path.join(root, "settings.json");
    mergeStructuredArtifacts(
      result,
      await readStructuredArtifacts(
        settingsPath,
        (content) => parseClaudeSettingsArtifacts(content, {
          scope: "global",
          sourcePath: `${sourcePathRoot}/settings.json`,
          runtimePath: settingsPath
        }),
        deps.fs
      )
    );
  }
  mergeInstalledPluginUnits(result, await installedPluginArtifacts(source, root, deps));
  return result;
}
async function scanSetupBrowserHarnesses(deps) {
  const scans = await Promise.all(
    deps.sources.map(
      (source) => scanSetupBrowserHarness(source, deps.path.join(deps.home, harnessHomeDir(source)), deps)
    )
  );
  const existing = scans.filter((harness) => harness.exists);
  const claude = existing.find((harness) => harness.source === "claude");
  if (claude) {
    const userConfigPath = deps.path.join(deps.home, ".claude.json");
    mergeStructuredArtifacts(
      claude,
      await readStructuredArtifacts(
        userConfigPath,
        (content) => parseClaudeMcpArtifacts(content, {
          scope: "global",
          sourcePath: ".claude.json",
          runtimePath: userConfigPath
        }),
        deps.fs
      )
    );
  }
  return existing;
}
async function walkSetupBrowserScatteredConfigFiles(root, deps) {
  const maxFiles = deps.maxFiles ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_SCATTERED_MAX_FILES;
  const maxDepth = deps.maxDepth ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_SCATTERED_MAX_DEPTH;
  const results = [];
  async function recurse(dir, depth) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    if (results.length >= maxFiles) return;
    if (depth > maxDepth) return;
    let listing;
    try {
      listing = await setupBrowserDirectoryListing(dir, deps.fs);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    const kids = listing.names;
    kids.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    for (const name of kids) {
      throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
      if (results.length >= maxFiles) return;
      if (shouldSkipSetupBrowserSubdir(name)) continue;
      const child = deps.path.join(dir, name);
      let st;
      try {
        st = await setupBrowserEntryStat(child, name, listing, deps.fs);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      if (st.isFile() && isConfigName(name)) {
        results.push({
          relPath: child.startsWith(root + deps.path.sep) ? child.slice(root.length + 1) : name,
          absPath: child,
          tokens: deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await setupBrowserTokensForFile(child, deps.fs)
        });
      } else if (st.isDirectory()) {
        if (name.startsWith(".")) continue;
        await recurse(child, depth + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  await recurse(root, 0);
  return results;
}
async function collectSetupBrowserScatteredEntries(root, deps) {
  const maxFiles = deps.maxFiles ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_PROJECT_SCAN_MAX_FILES;
  const maxDepth = deps.maxDepth ?? DEFAULT_SETUP_BROWSER_PROJECT_SCAN_MAX_DEPTH;
  const found = [];
  async function recurse(dir, depth) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    if (found.length >= maxFiles) return;
    if (depth > maxDepth) return;
    let listing;
    try {
      listing = await setupBrowserDirectoryListing(dir, deps.fs);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    const names = listing.names;
    names.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    const skillFile = names.find((name) => name.toLowerCase() === "skill.md");
    if (skillFile) {
      const files = deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await walkSetupBrowserEntryFiles(dir, deps);
      const contentPath = await resolveSetupBrowserContentPath(dir, deps);
      const tokens = files?.reduce((n, f) => n + (f.tokens ?? 0), 0) || void 0;
      found.push({
        category: "skills",
        entry: {
          name: setupBrowserPathLeaf(dir, deps.path.sep),
          contentPath,
          tokens,
          files,
          source: configSource(skillFile)
        }
      });
      return;
    }
    const subdirs = [];
    for (const name of names) {
      throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
      if (found.length >= maxFiles) return;
      if (shouldSkipSetupBrowserSubdir(name)) continue;
      if (isSetupBrowserSourceDirSegment(name, deps.sources)) continue;
      const child = deps.path.join(dir, name);
      let st;
      try {
        st = await setupBrowserEntryStat(child, name, listing, deps.fs);
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      if (st.isDirectory()) {
        subdirs.push(child);
        continue;
      }
      if (!st.isFile()) continue;
      const category = configCategory(name);
      if (!category) continue;
      const rel = child.startsWith(root + deps.path.sep) ? child.slice(root.length + 1) : name;
      found.push({
        category,
        entry: {
          name: rel,
          contentPath: child,
          tokens: deps.summaryOnly ? void 0 : await setupBrowserTokensForFile(child, deps.fs),
          source: configSource(name)
        }
      });
    }
    for (const child of subdirs) {
      throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
      if (found.length >= maxFiles) return;
      await recurse(child, depth + 1);
    }
  }
  await recurse(root, 0);
  return found;
}
function projectArtifact(input) {
  const identity = {
    scope: "project",
    provider: input.provider,
    projectId: input.projectId,
    workspaceLocationId: input.workspaceLocationId,
    source: input.source
  };
  return {
    ...identity,
    id: artifactId(identity),
    name: input.name,
    kind: input.kind,
    influence: influenceForArtifactKind(input.kind),
    composition: input.composition,
    parserVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_PARSER_VERSION,
    scannerVersion: ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_SCANNER_VERSION
  };
}
async function discoverProjectAgentDocumentUnits(root, deps) {
  const maxUnits = deps.maxUnits ?? DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_MAX_UNITS;
  const maxDepth = deps.maxDepth ?? DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_MAX_DEPTH;
  const units = [];
  const relationships = [];
  let truncated = false;
  function relativePath(path) {
    return path.startsWith(root + deps.path.sep) ? path.slice(root.length + 1) : path;
  }
  function pushUnit(unit2, containingUnitId) {
    if (units.length >= maxUnits) {
      truncated = true;
      return false;
    }
    units.push(unit2);
    if (containingUnitId) {
      relationships.push({
        fromUnitId: containingUnitId,
        toUnitId: unit2.id,
        kind: "contains",
        evidence: "confirmed"
      });
    }
    return true;
  }
  async function recurse(dir, depth, containingUnitId) {
    throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
    if (units.length >= maxUnits) {
      truncated = true;
      return;
    }
    let listing;
    try {
      listing = await setupBrowserDirectoryListing(dir, deps.fs);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    const names = listing.names.sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
    const skillFile = names.find((name) => name.toLowerCase() === "skill.md");
    let currentContainerId = containingUnitId;
    if (skillFile) {
      const skillPath = relativePath(dir) || ".";
      const classification = classifyArtifactDocumentPath(deps.path.join(skillPath, skillFile));
      const skill = projectArtifact({
        name: setupBrowserPathLeaf(dir, deps.path.sep),
        kind: "skill",
        composition: "composite",
        provider: classification.provider,
        projectId: deps.projectId,
        workspaceLocationId: deps.workspaceLocationId,
        source: { type: "directory", path: skillPath, runtimePath: dir }
      });
      if (!pushUnit(skill, containingUnitId)) return;
      currentContainerId = skill.id;
    }
    const subdirs = [];
    for (const name of names) {
      throwIfSetupBrowserScanAborted(deps.signal);
      if (units.length >= maxUnits) {
        truncated = true;
        return;
      }
      if (shouldSkipArtifactDocumentSubdir(name)) continue;
      const child = deps.path.join(dir, name);
      const childRelativePath = relativePath(child);
      if (isArtifactDocumentManagedWorktreePath(childRelativePath) || isArtifactDocumentWorkspaceTemplatePath(childRelativePath)) {
        continue;
      }
      const listedEntry = listing.entries?.get(name);
      if (listedEntry && !listedEntry.isDirectory() && !listedEntry.isFile()) continue;
      let stat;
      try {
        stat = await setupBrowserEntryStat(child, name, listing, deps.fs);

async function writeAllowedSetupBrowserFile(absPath, content, deps) {
  const allowedPath = resolveAllowedSetupBrowserFilePath(absPath, deps);
  try {
    const st = await deps.fs.lstat(allowedPath);
    if (st.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("path not allowed");
    if (!st.isFile()) throw new Error("path is not a file");
    const realTarget = await deps.fs.realpath(allowedPath);
    if (!deps.allowPath(realTarget)) throw new Error("path not allowed");
    if (deps.expectedContent !== void 0) {
      const current = await deps.fs.readFile(realTarget);
      if (current !== deps.expectedContent) throw new SetupWriteConflictError(absPath);
    }
    await deps.fs.writeFile(realTarget, content);
    return;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof SetupWriteConflictError) throw err;
    if (!deps.allowCreate || !isSetupBrowserMissingFileError(err)) throw err;
    if (deps.expectedContent !== void 0) {
      throw new SetupWriteConflictError(absPath);
    }
    const parent = deps.path.dirname(allowedPath);
    const parentSt = await deps.fs.lstat(parent);
    if (parentSt.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("path not allowed");
    if (!parentSt.isDirectory()) throw new Error("parent is not a directory");
    const realParent = await deps.fs.realpath(parent);
    if (!deps.allowPath(deps.path.join(realParent, deps.path.basename(allowedPath)))) {

async function deleteAllowedSetupBrowserPath(absPath, expectedType, deps) {

  if (expectedType === "directory" && !st.isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error("path is not a directory");
  }
  if (expectedType === "either" && !st.isFile() && !st.isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error("path cannot be deleted");

async function listSetupDevFormatChildren(path, deps) {

    return { children: [], truncated: false };
  }

    entries = await deps.fs.readdir(path);

    return { children: [], truncated: false };
  }

    if (hiddenDelta !== 0) return hiddenDelta;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  const truncated = entries.length > maxChildren;
  if (truncated) entries = entries.slice(0, maxChildren);

      children.push(setupDevFormatNodeFromStat(childPath, entry, await deps.fs.stat(childPath)));
    } catch {
    }
  }

    if (a.kind !== b.kind) return a.kind === "directory" ? -1 : 1;
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });

}

  }
  return { read, write };
}
const BLUME_APP_NAME = "Blume";
const BLUME_DEV_APP_NAME = "Blume Dev";
const DEV_RUNTIME_PROFILES = ["full", "ui", "conversations", "native"];
function normalizeDevCdpPort(value) {
  if (value === null || value === void 0 || value === "") return null;
  const port = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(port) && port >= 1 && port <= 65535 ? port : null;
}
function normalizeDevRuntimeProfile(value) {
  return DEV_RUNTIME_PROFILES.includes(value) ? value : "full";
}
function projectNameFromDevAppPath(appPath) {
  const projectRoot = appPath.replace(/[/\\]apps[/\\]desktop[/\\]?$/, "");
  const trimmed = projectRoot.replace(/[/\\]+$/, "");
  if (!trimmed) return "";
  const segments = trimmed.split(/[/\\]/).filter(Boolean);
  return segments[segments.length - 1] ?? "";
}
function formatDevAppName(conversationName) {
  const name = conversationName.trim();
  return name ? `${BLUME_DEV_APP_NAME} - ${name}` : BLUME_DEV_APP_NAME;
}
function createDevProjectInfo(input) {
  const projectName = projectNameFromDevAppPath(input.appPath);
  const conversationName = input.conversationName?.trim() || projectName;
  const worktreeName = input.worktreeName?.trim() || null;
  return {
    projectPath: input.appPath,
    projectName,
    conversationName,
    worktreeName,
    appName: formatDevAppName(conversationName),
    appVersion: input.appVersion,
    cdpPort: normalizeDevCdpPort(input.cdpPort),
    runtimeProfile: normalizeDevRuntimeProfile(input.runtimeProfile),
    signedOut: input.signedOut === true || input.signedOut === "1"
  };
}

const DEPLOYMENT_SET_SERVICE_GROUPS = {
  product: [
    "auth",
    "feedback",
    "userAnalytics",
    "referrals",
    "insights",
    "llm",
    "router",
    "webLab",
    "runner"
  ],
  backend: ["auth", "feedback", "userAnalytics", "referrals", "insights", "llm", "router"],
  // PR previews also carry unreleased services. Canary and stable sets never include these.
  preview: [
    "auth",
    "feedback",
    "userAnalytics",
    "referrals",
    "insights",
    "llm",
    "router",
    "webLab",
    "runner",
    "deliveriesRuntime"
  ]
};
const DELIVERIES_SERVICES = ["deliveriesRuntime"];
const OPTIONAL_PREVIEW_SERVICES = ["runner"];
const PREVIEW_SERVICE_OMISSION_REASONS = ["not-requested", "failed"];
const MANIFEST_TO_COMPONENT_NAME = {
  artifactSync: "artifact-sync",
  userAnalytics: "user-analytics",
  deliveriesRuntime: "deliveries-runtime"
};
function isObject(value) {
  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function requiredHttpsUrl(value, serviceName) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    throw new Error(`Deployment set is missing the ${serviceName} HTTPS endpoint.`);
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(value);
    if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" || parsed.username || parsed.password) throw new Error();
    return parsed.toString().replace(/\/$/, "");
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Deployment set is missing the ${serviceName} HTTPS endpoint.`);
  }
}
function validateDeploymentSetManifest(value, options = {}) {
  if (!isObject(value)) throw new Error("Deployment set manifest must be an object.");
  if (value.schemaVersion !== 1) throw new Error("Unsupported deployment set schemaVersion.");
  if (!["preview", "canary", "stable"].includes(String(value.channel))) {
    throw new Error("Deployment set channel is invalid.");
  }
  const channel = value.channel;
  if (options.channel && channel !== options.channel) {
    throw new Error("Deployment set channel does not match its operation.");
  }
  if (channel === "stable" && !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(String(value.version ?? ""))) {
    throw new Error("Stable deployment set version must be X.Y.Z.");
  }
  if (channel === "canary" && !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+-c\.\d+$/.test(String(value.version ?? ""))) {
    throw new Error("Canary deployment set version must be X.Y.Z-c.N.");
  }
  if (typeof value.bundleId !== "string" || !value.bundleId.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Deployment set bundleId is required.");
  }
  if (typeof value.sourceSha !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.sourceSha)) {
    throw new Error("Deployment set sourceSha must be an exact commit.");
  }
  if (!isObject(value.services)) throw new Error("Deployment set services are required.");
  const group = options.group ?? "product";
  const knownGroup = DEPLOYMENT_SET_SERVICE_GROUPS[group];
  if (!knownGroup) throw new Error(`Unknown deployment set service group: ${group}.`);
  const omittedServices = deploymentSetOmissions(value.omittedServices, group, channel);
  const required = (options.requireArtifactSync ? [...knownGroup, "artifactSync"] : [...knownGroup]).filter((name) => !(name in omittedServices));
  const actualServiceNames = Object.keys(value.services);
  for (const name of Object.keys(omittedServices))
    if (actualServiceNames.includes(name))
      throw new Error(`Deployment set cannot both include and omit the ${name} service.`);
  if (group === "preview") {
    for (const name of OPTIONAL_PREVIEW_SERVICES)
      if (!actualServiceNames.includes(name) && !(name in omittedServices))
        throw new Error(`Preview deployment set must include the ${name} or say why it is omitted.`);
  }
  if (options.allowDeliveries && group !== "preview")
    required.push(...DELIVERIES_SERVICES.filter((name) => actualServiceNames.includes(name)));
  if (actualServiceNames.length !== required.length || actualServiceNames.some((name) => !required.includes(name))) {
    throw new Error(
      `Deployment set must contain exactly these services: ${required.slice().sort().join(", ")}.`
    );
  }
  const services = {};
  for (const [name, service] of Object.entries(value.services)) {
    if (!isObject(service)) {
      throw new Error(`Deployment set is missing the ${name} HTTPS endpoint.`);
    }
    services[name] = { url: requiredHttpsUrl(service.url, name) };
  }
  for (const name of required) {
    if (!services[name]) throw new Error(`Deployment set is missing the ${name} HTTPS endpoint.`);
  }
  return {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    ...typeof value.version === "string" ? { version: value.version } : {},
    channel,
    bundleId: value.bundleId,
    sourceSha: value.sourceSha,
    services,
    ...Object.keys(omittedServices).length > 0 ? { omittedServices } : {}
  };
}
function deploymentSetOmissions(value, group, channel) {
  if (value === void 0) return {};
  if (group !== "preview" || channel !== "preview")
    throw new Error("Only a preview deployment set may omit a service.");
  if (!isObject(value)) throw new Error("Deployment set omittedServices must be an object.");
  const omissions = {};
  for (const [name, reason] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (!OPTIONAL_PREVIEW_SERVICES.includes(name))
      throw new Error(`Deployment set cannot omit the ${name} service.`);
    if (!PREVIEW_SERVICE_OMISSION_REASONS.includes(reason))
      throw new Error(
        `Deployment set omits the ${name} for an unknown reason; use one of: ${PREVIEW_SERVICE_OMISSION_REASONS.join(", ")}.`
      );
    omissions[name] = reason;
  }
  return omissions;
}
function validateDeploymentSetEnvelope(input, options) {
  const manifest = validateDeploymentSetManifest(input.manifest, options);
  if (input.bundleId !== manifest.bundleId || input.sourceSha !== manifest.sourceSha) {
    throw new Error("Deployment set envelope identity does not match its manifest.");
  }
  return manifest;
}
const STABLE_SERVICE_WORKERS = {
  auth: "blume-auth",
  feedback: "blume-feedback",
  userAnalytics: "blume-analytics",
  referrals: "blume-referrals",
  insights: "blume-insights",
  llm: "blume-llm",
  router: "blume-router",
  artifactSync: "blume-artifact-sync",
  deliveriesRuntime: "blume-dlv-runtime"
};
const STABLE_LLM_DOMAIN = "agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev";
const LEGACY_STABLE_HOSTS = {
  auth: ["auth.blume-codes.com", "auth.blume-page.com"],
  feedback: ["feedback.blume-page.com"],
  userAnalytics: ["analytics.blume-page.com"],
  referrals: ["referrals.blume-page.com"],
  insights: ["agents.blume-codes.com", "blume-insights-control.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev"],
  llm: ["blume-llm-service.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev"],
  router: ["router.blume-page.com"],
  artifactSync: ["sync.blume-codes.com"]
};
function validateStableBackendServiceUrl(value, service, backendDeploymentId) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+\/?$/i.test(value)) {
    throw new Error(`Stable backend ${service} HTTPS endpoint must be an owned origin.`);
  }
  const url = new URL(value);
  const worker = STABLE_SERVICE_WORKERS[service];
  const domains = service === "llm" ? [STABLE_LLM_DOMAIN, "release.blume-codes.com"] : ["release.blume-codes.com"];
  const prefix = `${worker}-`;
  const suffix = domains.map((domain) => `.${domain}`).find((end) => url.hostname.endsWith(end));
  const deploymentId = suffix ? url.hostname.slice(prefix.length, -suffix.length) : "";
  const versioned = !!worker && !!suffix && url.hostname.startsWith(prefix) && /^(?:bd-s|bd-h)-[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(deploymentId);
  const allowed = backendDeploymentId !== void 0 ? versioned && deploymentId === backendDeploymentId : versioned || LEGACY_STABLE_HOSTS[service]?.includes(url.hostname);
  if (!allowed) {
    throw new Error(`Stable backend ${service} HTTPS endpoint must match its owned deployment.`);
  }
  return url.origin;
}
function validateStableBackendSelection(value, expectedVersion, expectedAppBundleId) {
  if (!isObject(value) || value.version !== expectedVersion || value.channel !== "stable" || value.bundleId !== expectedAppBundleId) {
    throw new Error("Stable backend manifest identity does not match this product version.");
  }
  if (typeof value.backendDeploymentId !== "string" || !/^(?:bd-s|bd-h)-[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(value.backendDeploymentId) || typeof value.backendBundleId !== "string" || !value.backendBundleId || typeof value.sourceSha !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(value.sourceSha)) {
    throw new Error("Stable backend payload is missing its selected deployment identity.");
  }
  const manifest = validateDeploymentSetEnvelope(
    { sourceSha: value.sourceSha, bundleId: value.backendBundleId, manifest: value.manifest },
    { channel: "stable", group: "backend", requireArtifactSync: true }
  );
  if (manifest.version !== expectedVersion) {
    throw new Error("Stable backend manifest version does not match this product version.");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(value.components)) {
    throw new Error("Stable backend payload is missing its component inventory.");
  }
  const expectedServices = [...DEPLOYMENT_SET_SERVICE_GROUPS.backend, "artifactSync"];
  if (value.components.length !== expectedServices.length) {
    throw new Error(
      "Stable backend component inventory must contain exactly one entry per service."
    );
  }
  for (const manifestName of expectedServices) {
    validateStableBackendServiceUrl(
      value.manifest.services[manifestName]?.url,
      manifestName,
      value.backendDeploymentId
    );
    const componentName = MANIFEST_TO_COMPONENT_NAME[manifestName] ?? manifestName;
    const candidates = value.components.filter(
      (candidate) => isObject(candidate) && candidate.name === componentName
    );
    if (candidates.length !== 1) {
      throw new Error(`Stable backend component inventory does not match ${componentName}.`);
    }
    const componentUrl = requiredHttpsUrl(candidates[0]?.url, componentName);
    if (componentUrl !== manifest.services[manifestName]?.url) {
      throw new Error(`Stable backend component inventory does not match ${componentName}.`);
    }
    validateStableBackendServiceUrl(candidates[0]?.url, manifestName, value.backendDeploymentId);
  }
  return {
    backendDeploymentId: value.backendDeploymentId,
    backendBundleId: value.backendBundleId,
    sourceSha: value.sourceSha,
    services: Object.fromEntries(
      expectedServices.map((name) => [name, manifest.services[name]])
    )
  };
}

async function getOrCreateBlumeDeviceIdAtRoot(root, createId = require$$0$1.randomUUID) {
  const file = pn.join(root, "device-id");
  const read = async () => {
    const value = (await promises.readFile(file, "utf8")).trim();
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,127}$/.test(value)) {
      throw new Error("The shared Blume device identity is invalid.");
    }
    return value;
  };
  try {
    return await read();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
  }
  await promises.mkdir(root, { recursive: true });
  const created = createId();
  try {
    await promises.writeFile(file, `${created}
`, { encoding: "utf8", flag: "wx", mode: 384 });
    return created;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== "EEXIST") throw error;
    return read();
  }
}

  if (!keys || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+[\],]+$/.test(keys)) return void 0;

function sanitizeMenuCommands(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const text = (item, max) => typeof item === "string" && item.length > 0 && item.length <= max ? item : void 0;
  return value.slice(0, 60).flatMap((raw) => {
    const item = raw ?? {};
    const id = text(item.id, 80);
    const label = text(item.label, 80);
    if (!id || !label) return [];
    return [{ id, label, keys: text(item.keys, 40), group: text(item.group, 40) }];
  });
}

  const groups = [...new Set(commands.map((command) => command.group ?? ""))];
  return groups.flatMap((group, index) => [
    ...index > 0 ? [{ type: "separator" }] : [],
    ...commands.filter((command) => (command.group ?? "") === group).map(
      (command) => ({
        label: command.label,
        accelerator: menuAccelerator(command.keys),
        registerAccelerator: false,
        click: (_item, _window, event) => {
          if (!event.triggeredByAccelerator) run(command.id);
        }
      })
    )
  ]);
}

const MAX_PENDING_EVENTS = 32;
const MAX_ARGUMENTS = 64;
const MAX_EVENT_CHARACTERS = 16384;
function createNativeStartupEvents(onOverflow = () => void 0) {
  const pending = [];
  const urlListeners = [];
  const instanceListeners = [];
  let active = false;
  let disposed = false;
  function deliver(event) {
    if (event.kind === "url") {
      for (const listener of urlListeners) listener({ preventDefault() {
      } }, event.url);
    } else {
      for (const listener of instanceListeners) listener({}, event.argv);
    }
  }
  function receive(event) {
    if (disposed) return;
    if (active) return deliver(event);
    if (pending.length === MAX_PENDING_EVENTS) {
      pending.shift();
      onOverflow();
    }
    pending.push(event);
  }
  return {
    receiveContinueActivity(event, type, _userInfo, details) {
      if (type !== "NSUserActivityTypeBrowsingWeb" || typeof details?.webpageURL !== "string")
        return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (details.webpageURL.length > MAX_EVENT_CHARACTERS) return onOverflow();
      receive({ kind: "url", url: details.webpageURL });
    },
    receiveOpenUrl(event, url) {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (url.length > MAX_EVENT_CHARACTERS) return onOverflow();
      receive({ kind: "url", url });
    },
    receiveSecondInstance(_event, argv) {
      if (argv.length > MAX_ARGUMENTS || argv.reduce((size, value) => size + value.length, 0) > MAX_EVENT_CHARACTERS)
        return onOverflow();
      receive({ kind: "argv", argv: [...argv] });
    },
    onOpenUrl(listener) {
      urlListeners.push(listener);
    },
    onSecondInstance(listener) {
      instanceListeners.push(listener);
    },
    activate() {
      if (active || disposed) return;
      active = true;
      for (const event of pending.splice(0)) deliver(event);
    },
    dispose() {
      disposed = true;
      pending.length = urlListeners.length = instanceListeners.length = 0;
    }
  };
}

class StableVersionRetiredError extends Error {
}
function stableBackendResponseError(status, version2) {
  if (status === 426) {
    return new StableVersionRetiredError(
      `Blume ${version2} is no longer supported. Install the latest stable version to continue.`
    );
  }

function parseStableBackendManifest(value, version2, expectedBundleId, requireSelectedDeployment = false) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") throw new Error("Backend manifest is not an object.");
  const envelope = value;
  if (envelope.version !== version2 || envelope.channel !== "stable" || envelope.bundleId !== expectedBundleId)
    throw new Error("Backend manifest release identity does not match the app.");
  if (!envelope.bundleId || !envelope.manifest?.services)
    throw new Error("Backend manifest is incomplete.");
  if (requireSelectedDeployment || envelope.backendDeploymentId !== void 0) {
    validateStableBackendSelection(value, version2, expectedBundleId);
    return envelope;
  }
  if (envelope.backendBundleId !== void 0 || envelope.sourceSha !== void 0 || envelope.components !== void 0) {
    throw new Error("Partial selected backend deployment identity is not allowed.");
  }
  for (const service of Object.keys(STABLE_BACKEND_ENV)) {
    exactHttpsUrl(envelope.manifest.services[service]?.url, service);
  }
  for (const service of Object.keys(OPTIONAL_STABLE_BACKEND_ENV)) {
    const url = envelope.manifest.services[service]?.url;
    if (url !== void 0) {
      try {
        exactHttpsUrl(url, service);
      } catch {
        throw new Error(`Backend manifest is missing optional ${service} endpoint.`);
      }
    }
  }
  return envelope;
}

function applyStableBackendManifest(envelope, env) {

    env[envName] = envelope.manifest.services[service].url;
  }

  }
}

async function configureStableBackends() {
  const cachePath = _n.join(deliveryNative.app.getPath("userData"), "release", `backend-${version}.json`);
  const retirementPath = `${cachePath}.retired`;
  const persistedRetirement = await readBackendManifestCacheFile(retirementPath);
  if (isStableBackendRetirementTombstone(persistedRetirement, version, bundleId)) {
    throw new StableVersionRetiredError(
      `Blume ${version} is no longer supported. Install the latest stable version to continue.`
    );
  }
  const cached = await readCachedSelection(cachePath);
  const fromRegistry = selectFromRegistry(cachePath, retirementPath);
  const manifest = cached ? await Promise.race([
    fromRegistry.catch((error) => {
      if (error instanceof StableVersionRetiredError) throw error;
      return cached;
    }),
    new Promise(
      (resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(cached), CACHED_REGISTRY_WAIT_MS)
    )
  ]) : await fromRegistry.catch((networkError) => {
    if (networkError instanceof StableVersionRetiredError) throw networkError;
    console.warn(
      `[backend-manifest] registry and cache unavailable; using the signed app's embedded backend bundle: ${networkError instanceof Error ? networkError.message : String(networkError)}`
    );
    return bundledStableBackendManifest(version, bundleId, process.env);
  });
  fromRegistry.catch(() => {
  });
  applyStableBackendManifest(manifest, process.env);
}

async function selectFromRegistry(cachePath, retirementPath) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${registry}/v1/backend-manifests/${encodeURIComponent(version)}`,
      {
        headers: { "cache-control": "no-cache" },
        redirect: "error",
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1e4)
      }
    );
    if (!response.ok) throw stableBackendResponseError(response.status, version);
    const payload = await response.json();
    const manifest = parseSelectedStableBackendManifest(payload, version, bundleId);
    try {
      await writeBackendManifestCacheFile(cachePath, manifest);
    } catch (cacheError) {
      console.warn(
        `[backend-manifest] selected registry backend but could not update its local cache: ${cacheError instanceof Error ? cacheError.message : String(cacheError)}`
      );
    }
    return manifest;
  } catch (networkError) {
    if (networkError instanceof StableVersionRetiredError) {
      try {
        await writeBackendManifestCacheFile(
          retirementPath,
          stableBackendRetirementTombstone(version, bundleId)
        );
      } catch (cacheError) {
        console.warn(
          `[backend-manifest] could not persist stable retirement: ${cacheError instanceof Error ? cacheError.message : String(cacheError)}`
        );
      }
    }
    throw networkError;
  }
}

function createCompactTextDelta(before, after) {
  let start = 0;
  const sharedLength = Math.min(before.length, after.length);
  while (start < sharedLength && before[start] === after[start]) start++;
  let suffix = 0;
  const maxSuffix = Math.min(before.length - start, after.length - start);
  while (suffix < maxSuffix && before[before.length - 1 - suffix] === after[after.length - 1 - suffix]) {
    suffix++;
  }
  return {
    version: 1,
    start,
    deleteCount: before.length - start - suffix,
    insert: after.slice(start, after.length - suffix)
  };
}
function applyCompactTextDelta(before, delta) {
  if (delta.version !== 1) throw new Error(`Unsupported text delta version: ${delta.version}`);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(delta.start) || !Number.isSafeInteger(delta.deleteCount) || delta.start < 0 || delta.deleteCount < 0 || delta.start + delta.deleteCount > before.length) {
    throw new Error("Invalid text delta range");
  }
  return before.slice(0, delta.start) + delta.insert + before.slice(delta.start + delta.deleteCount);
}

  return JSON.stringify(delta);

  const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
  if (parsed.version !== 1 || typeof parsed.start !== "number" || typeof parsed.deleteCount !== "number" || typeof parsed.insert !== "string") {
    throw new Error("Invalid serialized text delta");
  }

}

function confirmedGithubMerge(call) {
  if (!/github_merge_pull_request$/i.test(call.name) || call.isError) return null;
  if (!/"merged"\s*:\s*true|Pull Request successfully merged/i.test(call.resultText ?? "")) {
    return null;
  }

  const repository = input?.repository_full_name;

  return typeof repository === "string" && (typeof pullRequest === "number" || typeof pullRequest === "string") ? `${repository.toLowerCase()}#${pullRequest}` : null;
}
function confirmedBashMerges(call) {

  const input = parsedInput(call.inputJson);
  const command = typeof input?.command === "string" ? input.command : "";
  if (command.length === 0 || command.length > 1024) return [];

  }

}

function normalizeProjectResolutionPath(path) {
  const value = path.trim().replace(/\\/g, "/");
  if (!value) return null;
  let prefix;
  let remainder;
  let protectedSegments = 0;
  if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(value)) {
    prefix = `${value[0].toUpperCase()}:/`;
    remainder = value.slice(3);
  } else if (value.startsWith("//")) {
    prefix = "//";
    remainder = value.slice(2);
    protectedSegments = 2;
  } else if (value.startsWith("/")) {
    prefix = "/";
    remainder = value.slice(1);
  } else {
    return null;
  }
  const segments = [];
  for (const segment of remainder.split("/")) {
    if (!segment || segment === ".") continue;
    if (segment === "..") {
      if (segments.length > protectedSegments) segments.pop();
      continue;
    }
    segments.push(segment);
  }
  if (prefix === "//") {
    if (segments.length < protectedSegments) return null;
    return `//${segments.join("/")}`;
  }
  return segments.length === 0 ? prefix : `${prefix}${segments.join("/")}`;
}

  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}
function text(value) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "bigint") return String(value);
  return "";
}
function textOrNull(value) {
  return value == null ? null : text(value);
}
function int(value) {
  if (typeof value === "number") return value;
  if (typeof value === "bigint") return Number(value);
  if (typeof value === "string") return Number(value);
  return 0;
}
function intOrNull(value) {
  return value == null ? null : int(value);
}
function json(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(value);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

      AND (status IN ('active', 'needs_review')

      OR status IN ('applied', 'dismissed', 'archived')

function seedFor(kind, root, remote) {
  if (!root) return null;
  return identity.projectFlowerSeedFor({ kind, root, canonicalRemote: remote });
}
function wrappedProjectKey(projectId) {
  if (projectId === null || projectId.length === 0) return null;
  const numeric = Number(projectId);
  if (Number.isSafeInteger(numeric) && numeric > 0) return numeric;
  return Number(BigInt(`0x${identity.fnv1a64Hex(projectId)}`) & 0x7fffffffn);
}
function rowToWrappedRecord(row) {
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    period_start: text(row.period_start),
    period_kind: text(row.period_kind),
    started_at_ms: int(row.started_at_ms),
    ended_at_ms: int(row.ended_at_ms),
    account_user_id: textOrNull(row.account_user_id),
    schema_version: int(row.schema_version),
    summary_json: text(row.summary_json),
    created_at: int(row.created_at)
  };
}
function createSqlWrappedStore({ run, get, all }) {
  return {
    async listWrapped(limit) {
      return (await all("SELECT * FROM wrapped_records ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?", [
        Math.max(0, Math.trunc(limit))
      ])).map(rowToWrappedRecord);
    },
    async getWrapped(id) {
      const row = await get("SELECT * FROM wrapped_records WHERE id = ?", [id]);
      return row ? rowToWrappedRecord(row) : null;
    },
    async saveWrapped(input) {
      await run(
        `INSERT INTO wrapped_records (
           id, period_start, period_kind, started_at_ms, ended_at_ms,
           account_user_id, schema_version, summary_json, created_at
         ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
           period_start = excluded.period_start,
           period_kind = excluded.period_kind,
           started_at_ms = excluded.started_at_ms,
           ended_at_ms = excluded.ended_at_ms,
           account_user_id = excluded.account_user_id,
           schema_version = excluded.schema_version,
           summary_json = excluded.summary_json,
           created_at = excluded.created_at`,
        [
          input.id,
          input.periodStart,
          input.periodKind,
          input.startedAtMs,
          input.endedAtMs,
          input.accountUserId,
          input.schemaVersion,
          input.summaryJson,
          input.createdAt
        ]
      );
    },
    async deleteWrapped(id) {
      await run("DELETE FROM wrapped_records WHERE id = ?", [id]);
    },
    async listWrappedActivity(startMs, endMs, idleGapMs = deliveryBriefs.WRAPPED_DEFAULT_IDLE_GAP_MS) {
      if (!(endMs > startMs)) return [];
      const rows = await all(
        `SELECT conversations.id AS conversation_id,
                conversations.project_id AS project_id,
                -- Raw identity columns; projectFlowerSeedFor derives the
                -- avatar seed below, so every dialect agrees with the avatar.
                (SELECT projects.kind FROM projects WHERE projects.id = conversations.project_id) AS project_kind,
                (SELECT COALESCE(projects.repo_root, projects.root) FROM projects WHERE projects.id = conversations.project_id) AS project_root,
                (SELECT projects.canonical_remote FROM projects WHERE projects.id = conversations.project_id) AS project_remote,
                COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) AS started_at,
                conversations.last_activity_ts AS ended_at,
                conversations.state AS state,
                (
                  SELECT COUNT(*)
                  FROM conversation_transcript_user_turns AS turns
                  WHERE turns.conversation_id = conversations.id
                ) AS turns,
                (
                  -- A conversation with no events at all cannot be measured and
                  -- falls back to the caller's capped span. One that has events
                  -- but none inside the window worked zero minutes in it.
                  SELECT CASE
                    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM conversation_transcript_events e2
                      WHERE e2.conversation_id = conversations.id
                        AND e2.timestamp_ms IS NOT NULL
                    ) THEN NULL
                    ELSE COALESCE(SUM(burst_end - burst_start), 0)
                  END FROM (
                    SELECT MIN(ts) AS burst_start, MAX(ts) AS burst_end
                    FROM (
                      SELECT ts,
                             SUM(gap) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS burst
                      FROM (
                        SELECT ts,
                               CASE
                                 WHEN LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) IS NULL
                                   OR ts - LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) > ?
                                 THEN 1 ELSE 0
                               END AS gap
                        FROM (
                          SELECT e.timestamp_ms AS ts
                          FROM conversation_transcript_events e
                          WHERE e.conversation_id = conversations.id
                            AND e.timestamp_ms >= ?
                            AND e.timestamp_ms < ?
                        ) AS pts
                      ) AS gapped
                    ) AS grouped
                    GROUP BY burst
                  ) AS bursts
                ) AS active_ms
         FROM conversations
         WHERE COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) < ?
           AND COALESCE(conversations.last_activity_ts, conversations.started_at) >= ?
         ORDER BY started_at ASC`,
        [idleGapMs, startMs, endMs, endMs, startMs]
      );
      const intervalsByConversation = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      const conversationIds = rows.map((row) => text(row.conversation_id));
      for (let offset = 0; offset < conversationIds.length; offset += 200) {
        const batch = conversationIds.slice(offset, offset + 200);
        const placeholders = batch.map(() => "?").join(", ");
        const intervals = await all(
          `WITH points AS (
             SELECT conversation_id, timestamp_ms AS ts
             FROM conversation_transcript_events
             WHERE conversation_id IN (${placeholders})
               AND timestamp_ms >= ? AND timestamp_ms < ?
           ), gapped AS (
             SELECT conversation_id, ts,
                    CASE
                      WHEN LAG(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY ts) IS NULL
                        OR ts - LAG(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY ts) > ?
                      THEN 1 ELSE 0
                    END AS gap
             FROM points
           ), grouped AS (
             SELECT conversation_id, ts,
                    SUM(gap) OVER (
                      PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                    ) AS burst
             FROM gapped
           )
           SELECT conversation_id, MIN(ts) AS started_at, MAX(ts) AS ended_at
           FROM grouped
           GROUP BY conversation_id, burst
           ORDER BY conversation_id, started_at`,
          [...batch, startMs, endMs, idleGapMs]
        );
        for (const interval of intervals) {
          const conversationId = text(interval.conversation_id);
          const activeIntervals = intervalsByConversation.get(conversationId) ?? [];
          activeIntervals.push({
            started_at: int(interval.started_at),
            ended_at: int(interval.ended_at)
          });
          intervalsByConversation.set(conversationId, activeIntervals);
        }
      }
      return rows.map(
        (row) => ({
          active_intervals: intOrNull(row.active_ms) === null ? null : intervalsByConversation.get(text(row.conversation_id)) ?? [],
          project_seed: seedFor(
            text(row.project_kind) === "git" ? "git" : "folder",
            textOrNull(row.project_root),
            textOrNull(row.project_remote)
          ),
          project_id: wrappedProjectKey(textOrNull(row.project_id)),
          started_at: int(row.started_at),
          ended_at: intOrNull(row.ended_at),
          turns: int(row.turns),
          finished: text(row.state) === "finished",
          active_ms: intOrNull(row.active_ms)
        })
      );
    },
    async listWrappedSessionStarts(beforeStartedAtMs, beforeSessionId, limit) {
      const bounded = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(limit));
      if (bounded === 0 || !Number.isFinite(beforeStartedAtMs)) return [];
      const cursor = beforeSessionId === null ? {
        clause: "COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) < ?",
        params: [beforeStartedAtMs]
      } : {
        clause: `(COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) < ?
                        OR (
                          COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) = ?
                          AND conversations.id < ?
                        ))`,
        params: [beforeStartedAtMs, beforeStartedAtMs, beforeSessionId]
      };
      const rows = await all(
        `SELECT conversations.id AS session_id,
                COALESCE(conversations.started_at, conversations.last_activity_ts) AS started_at
         FROM conversations
         WHERE ${cursor.clause}
         ORDER BY started_at DESC, session_id DESC
         LIMIT ?`,
        [...cursor.params, bounded]
      );
      return rows.map(
        (row) => ({
          session_id: text(row.session_id),
          started_at: int(row.started_at)
        })
      );
    },
    async sumWrappedVisibleMinutes(startMs, endMs) {
      if (!(endMs > startMs)) return 0;
      const rows = await all(
        `SELECT started_at_ms, ended_at_ms, window_visible_seconds
         FROM app_usage_intervals
         WHERE started_at_ms < ? AND ended_at_ms > ?`,
        [endMs, startMs]
      );
      let minutes = 0;
      for (const row of rows) {
        const startedAt = int(row.started_at_ms);
        const endedAt = int(row.ended_at_ms);
        const duration = endedAt - startedAt;
        if (!(duration > 0)) continue;
        const overlap = Math.min(endedAt, endMs) - Math.max(startedAt, startMs);
        if (!(overlap > 0)) continue;
        minutes += int(row.window_visible_seconds) / 60 * (overlap / duration);
      }
      return Math.round(minutes * 10) / 10;
    },
    async countWrappedFrictionSignals(startMs, endMs) {
      if (!(endMs > startMs)) return 0;
      const row = await get(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM improve_signals WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?",
        [startMs, endMs]
      );
      return row ? int(row.count) : 0;
    },
    async countWrappedMergedPullRequests(startMs, endMs) {
      if (!(endMs > startMs)) return 0;
      const rows = await all(
        `SELECT conversation_id, name, input_json, result_text, is_error
         FROM conversation_transcript_tool_calls
         WHERE started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?
           AND (
             (name = 'Bash' AND input_json LIKE '%gh pr merge%')
             OR lower(name) LIKE '%github_merge_pull_request'
           )`,
        [startMs, endMs]
      );
      return countConfirmedWrappedPullRequestMerges(
        rows.map(
          (row) => ({
            conversationKey: text(row.conversation_id),
            name: text(row.name),
            inputJson: textOrNull(row.input_json),
            resultText: textOrNull(row.result_text),
            isError: int(row.is_error) !== 0
          })
        )
      );
    },
    async countWrappedFilesTouched(startMs, endMs) {
      if (!(endMs > startMs)) return 0;
      const rows = await all(
        `SELECT input_json
         FROM conversation_transcript_tool_calls
         WHERE started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?
           AND name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit')`,
        [startMs, endMs]
      );
      const files = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      for (const row of rows) {
        const inputJson = textOrNull(row.input_json);
        if (!inputJson) continue;
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(inputJson);
          if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) continue;
          const filePath = parsed.file_path;
          if (typeof filePath === "string" && filePath.length > 0) files.add(filePath);
        } catch {
        }
      }
      return files.size;
    }
  };
}
function eventsForTurnsCappedSql(turnCount) {
  const placeholders = Array.from({ length: turnCount }, () => "?").join(",");
  return `SELECT capped.* FROM (
    SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_turn_id ORDER BY e.position DESC) AS recency,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_turn_id) AS total_count
    FROM conversation_transcript_events e
    WHERE e.conversation_id = ? AND e.user_turn_id IN (${placeholders})
  ) capped
  JOIN conversation_transcript_user_turns t ON t.id = capped.user_turn_id AND t.conversation_id = capped.conversation_id
  WHERE recency <= ? ORDER BY t.position, capped.position`;
}

const SQL_IDENTIFIERS = [
  "conversation_transcript_todo_lists",
  "conversation_transcript_user_turns",

const SQL_IDENTIFIER_RE = new RegExp(`\\b(${SQL_IDENTIFIERS.join("|")})\\b`, "g");
function validateTablePrefix(prefix) {
  if (/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(prefix)) return;
  throw new Error(`Invalid SQL table prefix: ${prefix}`);
}
function namespaceSql(sql, prefix) {
  if (!prefix) return sql;
  validateTablePrefix(prefix);
  return sql.replace(SQL_IDENTIFIER_RE, (identifier) => `${prefix}${identifier}`);
}
function setupKind(value) {
  switch (value) {
    case "rule":
    case "skill":
    case "plugin":
    case "hook":
    case "command":
    case "agent":
    case "mcp":
    case "setting":
    case "doc":
    case "auth-layout":
    case "usage-layout":
      return value;
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}
function setupAuthor(value) {
  return value === "user" || value === "improve" || value === "migration" || value === "harness-lab" ? value : "scanner";
}
function mapProjectSetupSummary(row) {
  return {
    workspacePath: text(row.workspace_path),
    skills: int(row.skills),
    agents: int(row.agents),
    commands: int(row.commands),
    hooks: int(row.hooks),
    rules: int(row.rules),
    totalEntries: int(row.total_entries),
    scannedAt: int(row.scanned_at)
  };
}
function mapVersion(row, materializedContent) {
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    artifactId: text(row.artifact_id),
    content: materializedContent ?? text(row.content),
    parsedShape: json(row.parsed_shape),
    rawShape: json(row.raw_shape),
    contentHash: text(row.content_hash),
    createdAt: text(row.created_at),
    createdBy: setupAuthor(text(row.created_by))
  };
}
function materializeVersionRows(rows) {
  let previous = "";
  return rows.map((row) => {
    const stored = text(row.content);
    const content = row.content_storage === "delta" ? applyCompactTextDelta(previous, parseCompactTextDelta(stored)) : stored;
    previous = content;
    return mapVersion(row, content);
  });
}
function mapArtifact(row) {
  const projectId = textOrNull(row.project_id);
  const workspaceLocationId = textOrNull(row.workspace_location_id);
  const sourcePath = textOrNull(row.source_path);
  return {
    id: text(row.id),
    harnessId: text(row.harness_id),
    scope: text(row.scope) === "global" ? "global" : "project",
    kind: setupKind(text(row.kind)),
    currentVersionId: text(row.current_version_id),
    parserVersion: text(row.parser_version),
    scannerVersion: text(row.scanner_version),
    ...projectId ? { projectId } : {},
    ...workspaceLocationId ? { workspaceLocationId } : {},
    ...sourcePath ? { sourcePath } : {}
  };
}
function rowToProject(row) {
  if (text(row.kind) === "git") {
    const canonicalRemote = textOrNull(row.canonical_remote);
    return {
      kind: "git",

      repoRoot: text(row.repo_root),
      gitCommonDir: text(row.git_common_dir),
      ...canonicalRemote ? { canonicalRemote } : {}
    };
  }
  return { kind: "folder", id: text(row.id), root: text(row.root) };
}

function transcriptExcerpt(textValue, query) {
  const compact = textValue.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const index2 = compact.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLocaleLowerCase());
  if (index2 < 0 || compact.length <= 260) return compact.slice(0, 260);
  const start = Math.max(0, index2 - 84);
  const end = Math.min(compact.length, index2 + query.length + 164);
  return `${start > 0 ? "…" : ""}${compact.slice(start, end).trim()}${end < compact.length ? "…" : ""}`;
}

function isDuplicateColumnError(error) {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message.toLowerCase() : String(error).toLowerCase();
  return message.includes("duplicate column") || message.includes("already exists");
}
async function addColumnIfMissing(sql, table, column, definition) {
  try {
    await sql.run(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${column} ${definition}`, []);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!isDuplicateColumnError(error)) throw error;
  }
}
const RESYNC_APP_USAGE_INTERVAL_IDS_SQL = `INSERT INTO app_usage_interval_ids (singleton, next_id)
     SELECT 1, COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM app_usage_intervals
     WHERE 1 = 1
     ON CONFLICT (singleton) DO UPDATE SET next_id = CASE
       WHEN app_usage_interval_ids.next_id < excluded.next_id THEN excluded.next_id
       ELSE app_usage_interval_ids.next_id
     END`;
const ALLOCATE_APP_USAGE_INTERVAL_ID_SQL = `INSERT INTO app_usage_interval_ids (singleton, next_id) VALUES (1, 1)
           ON CONFLICT (singleton) DO UPDATE SET next_id = app_usage_interval_ids.next_id + 1
           RETURNING next_id`;
const APP_USAGE_INTERVAL_INSERT_ATTEMPTS = 8;
async function ensureSharedMigrations(sql) {
  await sql.run(RESYNC_APP_USAGE_INTERVAL_IDS_SQL, []);
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "setup_versions", "content_storage", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full'");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "conversations", "state_override_turn_position", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "conversations", "failure_reason", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "conversations", "activity_event_count", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "conversations", "started_at", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "change_json", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "operations_json", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "evidence_json", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "feedback_reasons_json", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "apply_result_json", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "snoozed_until", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(
    sql,
    "improve_suggestions",
    "creator_agent_version_id",
    "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-3-step-workflow'"
  );
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "hidden_at", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "hidden_reason", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "hidden_until", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "last_shown_at", "BIGINT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_suggestions", "shown_count", "BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0");
  await addColumnIfMissing(
    sql,
    "improve_signals",
    "creator_agent_version_id",
    "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-3-step-workflow'"
  );
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_signals", "type", "TEXT");
  await sql.exec(
    "UPDATE improve_signals SET type = kind WHERE type IS NULL AND kind IN ('correction', 'steering', 'frustration')"
  );
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_signals", "tags_json", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_signals", "search_text", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_signals", "search_tags", "TEXT");
  for (const column of ["search_text", "search_tags", "search_tokens"])
    await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_signal_clusters", column, "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(
    sql,
    "improve_signal_clusters",
    "creator_agent_version_id",
    "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-3-step-workflow'"
  );
  await addColumnIfMissing(
    sql,
    "improve_signal_clusters",
    "tags_json",
    "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'"
  );
  await sql.exec(`
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_suggestions_creator_agent_version_id
      ON improve_suggestions (creator_agent_version_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_signals_creator_agent_version_id
      ON improve_signals (creator_agent_version_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_signal_clusters_creator_agent_version_id
      ON improve_signal_clusters (creator_agent_version_id);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS improve_agent_conversation_reads (
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      agent_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      transcript_hash TEXT,
      conversation_activity_ts BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_processed_message_position BIGINT,
      read_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
      read_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, agent_version_id)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_agent_conversation_reads_agent
      ON improve_agent_conversation_reads (agent_version_id, read_at DESC);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS improve_suggestion_feedback_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      suggestion_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      agent_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      created_at BIGINT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_suggestion_feedback_events_suggestion
      ON improve_suggestion_feedback_events (suggestion_id, created_at);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS improve_suggestion_clusters (
      suggestion_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (suggestion_id, cluster_id)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_improve_suggestion_clusters_cluster
      ON improve_suggestion_clusters (cluster_id, suggestion_id);
    INSERT INTO improve_suggestion_clusters (suggestion_id, cluster_id, created_at)
    SELECT id, cluster_id, created_at FROM improve_suggestions WHERE 1 = 1
    ON CONFLICT (suggestion_id, cluster_id) DO NOTHING;
  `);
  await addColumnIfMissing(
    sql,
    "improve_agent_conversation_reads",
    "last_processed_message_position",
    "BIGINT"
  );
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_runs", "task_type", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_runs", "project_path", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_runs", "processing_provider", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_runs", "model_provider", "TEXT");
  await addColumnIfMissing(sql, "improve_runs", "model", "TEXT");
  await purgeLegacyImproveData(sql);
}
const PURGE_INSIGHTS_STEP = "purge-legacy-improve-data";
async function purgeLegacyImproveData(sql) {
  await sql.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS improve_maintenance_steps (
      step TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      completed_at BIGINT NOT NULL
    );
  `);
  const done = await sql.get("SELECT step FROM improve_maintenance_steps WHERE step = ?", [
    PURGE_INSIGHTS_STEP
  ]);
  if (done) return;
  await sql.exec(`
    DELETE FROM improve_suggestion_feedback_events;
    DELETE FROM improve_suggestion_clusters;
    DELETE FROM improve_suggestions;
    DELETE FROM improve_signal_cluster_duplicate_candidates;
    DELETE FROM improve_signal_cluster_members;
    DELETE FROM improve_signal_clusters;
    DELETE FROM improve_signals;
    DELETE FROM improve_runs;
    DELETE FROM improve_agent_conversation_reads;
  `);
  await sql.run(
    "INSERT INTO improve_maintenance_steps (step, completed_at) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT (step) DO NOTHING",
    [PURGE_INSIGHTS_STEP, Date.now()]
  );
}
const LEGACY_CREATOR_AGENT_VERSION_ID = "legacy-3-step-workflow";
function searchExcerpt(value, query) {
  const compact = text(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const index2 = compact.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLocaleLowerCase());
  if (index2 < 0 || compact.length <= 220) return compact.slice(0, 220);
  const start = Math.max(0, index2 - 72);
  const end = Math.min(compact.length, index2 + query.length + 140);
  return `${start > 0 ? "…" : ""}${compact.slice(start, end).trim()}${end < compact.length ? "…" : ""}`;
}
function searchTitle(value, fallback) {
  return text(value).trim() || text(fallback).trim() || "Untitled";
}
function searchRank(title, excerpt, query, base) {
  const needle = query.toLocaleLowerCase();
  const normalizedTitle = title.toLocaleLowerCase();
  if (normalizedTitle === needle) return base;
  if (normalizedTitle.startsWith(needle)) return base + 1;
  if (normalizedTitle.includes(needle)) return base + 2;
  if (excerpt?.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle)) return base + 3;
  return base + 4;
}
function sortSearchResults(results) {
  return results.sort(
    (left, right) => left.rank - right.rank || right.updatedAt - left.updatedAt || left.title.localeCompare(right.title)
  );
}
function signalAnalyticsType(value) {
  return value === "correction" || value === "steering" || value === "frustration" ? value : null;
}
function auditTagIdentity(value) {
  let tags;
  try {
    tags = JSON.parse(text(value));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(tags)) return null;
  const checkTag = tags.find(
    (tag) => typeof tag === "string" && tag.startsWith("check:")
  );
  const catalogTag = tags.find(
    (tag) => typeof tag === "string" && tag.startsWith("catalog:v")
  );
  const checkId = checkTag?.slice("check:".length).trim() ?? "";
  const catalogVersion = Number(catalogTag?.slice("catalog:v".length));
  return checkId && Number.isSafeInteger(catalogVersion) && catalogVersion > 0 ? { checkId, catalogVersion } : null;
}
function creatorAgentVersionId(input) {
  return input?.creatorAgentVersionId ?? LEGACY_CREATOR_AGENT_VERSION_ID;
}
function uniqueClusterIds(ids) {
  const out = [];
  const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const value of ids) {
    const id = String(value ?? "").trim();
    if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    out.push(id);
  }
  return out;
}
