function tableSpec(table) {
  const spec2 = LEDGER_TABLES[table];
  if (!spec2) throw Error(`Unknown ledger table ${table}`);
  return spec2;
}
function fromRow(row, map2, extra = {}) {
  const stored = row;
  const columnOf = new Map(Object.entries(map2.fields).map(([column, field2]) => [field2, column]));
  const data = stored.data;
  const out = {};
  if (data)
    for (const [field2, inner] of Object.entries(data)) {
      if (columnOf.has(field2)) out[field2] = stored[columnOf.get(field2)] ?? null;
      else if (field2 in extra) {
        if (extra[field2] !== void 0) out[field2] = extra[field2];
      } else out[field2] = inner;
    }
  else
    for (const [column, field2] of Object.entries(map2.fields)) {
      const inner = stored[column];
      if (inner !== null && inner !== void 0) out[field2] = inner;
      else if (map2.keepNull?.includes(field2)) out[field2] = null;
    }
  for (const [field2, inner] of Object.entries(extra)) if (inner !== void 0 && !(field2 in out)) out[field2] = inner;
  return out;
}

    emoji: "emoji",
    archived_at: "archivedAt",
    restored_at: "restoredAt",

    approved_despite: "approvedDespite",

  fields: {
    id: "id",
    phase: "phase",

    entered_at: "enteredAt",
    actor_id: "actorId",
    source: "source",

const WORK_EVENT = { fields: { work: "work", revision: "revision", actor_id: "actorId", recorded_at: "recordedAt" } };
const PLAN = { fields: { id: "id", version: "version", status: "status", code: "code" } };
function visitFromRow(row, events) {
  return fromRow(row, VISIT, row.records_events ? { workEvents: events.map((e) => fromRow(e, WORK_EVENT)) } : {});
}
const planFromRow = (row) => fromRow(row, PLAN);
const registry = [];
function register(spec2) {
  if (registry.some((other) => other.name === spec2.name)) throw Error(`Duplicate ledger SQL ${spec2.name}`);
  registry.push(spec2);
  return spec2;
}
function defineQuery(name2, sql, map2) {
  return register({ kind: "query", name: name2, sql, ...map2 ? { map: map2 } : {} });
}
function defineAssertion(name2, sql) {
  return register({ kind: "assertion", name: name2, sql });
}
function defineStatement(name2, sql) {
  return register({ kind: "statement", name: name2, sql });
}
defineQuery(
  "evidence-execution",
  `SELECT e.at FROM test_runs r INDEXED BY test_runs_id
   JOIN test_executions e ON e.workspace_id = ?1 AND e.id = r.execution_id
   JOIN workspace_settings s ON s.workspace_id = ?1 AND s.has_tests = 1
   WHERE r.workspace_id = ?1 AND r.id = ?2 ORDER BY e.position, e.id LIMIT 1`,
  (row) => ({ at: Number(row.at) })
);

  (row) => decodeRow("test_plans", row)
);

  "inbox-has-room",
  "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.workspace_id = ?1 AND m.to_id = ?2 AND m.acknowledged_at IS NULL) < ?3"
);

  "active-agents-below",
  "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.revoked = 0) < ?2"

defineAssertion(
  "agent-creation-allowed",
  `NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_creation_window w WHERE w.workspace_id = ?1 AND w.id = 'creation'
    AND w.started_at > ?2 - ?3 AND w.count >= ?4)`
);
defineStatement(
  "record-agent-creation",
  `INSERT INTO agent_creation_window (workspace_id, id, started_at, count) VALUES (?1, 'creation', ?2, 1)
   ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, id) DO UPDATE SET
     count = CASE WHEN agent_creation_window.started_at <= ?2 - ?3 THEN 1 ELSE agent_creation_window.count + 1 END,
     started_at = CASE WHEN agent_creation_window.started_at <= ?2 - ?3 THEN ?2 ELSE agent_creation_window.started_at END
   WHERE agent_creation_window.workspace_id = ?1`
);
const idleAgent = `t.conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND t.revoked = 0 AND t.merged_into IS NULL
  AND t.last_seen_at > 0 AND t.last_seen_at <= ?2
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_threads d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1 AND d.thread_id = t.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM threads a WHERE a.workspace_id = ?1 AND a.merged_into = t.id)`;
defineQuery(
  "idle-agents",
  `SELECT t.id FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND ${idleAgent} ORDER BY t.last_seen_at, t.id LIMIT ?3`,
  (row) => String(row.id)
);
defineAssertion(
  "idle-agent-unreferenced",
  `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.id = ?3 AND ${idleAgent})`

defineStatement(
  "fail-retired-messages",
  `UPDATE messages SET failed_at = ?3, seq = $seq WHERE messages.workspace_id = ?1 AND to_id = ?2
   AND (acknowledged_at IS NULL OR acknowledged_at = 0) AND (failed_at IS NULL OR failed_at = 0)`
);
defineQuery(
  "expired-messages",
  `SELECT m.id FROM messages m WHERE m.workspace_id = ?1
   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.acknowledged_at, 0), NULLIF(m.failed_at, 0), CASE WHEN m.to_id = 'human' THEN NULLIF(m.delivered_at, 0) END) <= ?2
   ORDER BY m.position, m.id LIMIT 100`,
  (row) => String(row.id)
);
defineQuery(
  "participant-messages",

   UNION SELECT m.id FROM messages m WHERE m.workspace_id = ?1 AND m.from_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))`,
  (row) => String(row.id)

defineQuery(
  "delivery-repository-spellings",
  `SELECT DISTINCT d.repository AS repository FROM deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1
   UNION SELECT DISTINCT r.repository AS repository FROM delivery_repositories r WHERE r.workspace_id = ?1`,
  (row) => String(row.repository)

const ownerKeys = (gate) => `owners(repository) AS (
  SELECT (SELECT MIN(first.repository) FROM deliveries first WHERE first.workspace_id = ?1 AND first.repository IS NOT NULL) ${gate}
  UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT MIN(d.repository) FROM deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1
    AND d.repository > owners.repository) FROM owners WHERE repository IS NOT NULL)`;
defineQuery(
  "delivery-owners",
  `WITH RECURSIVE ${ownerKeys("")} SELECT repository FROM owners WHERE repository IS NOT NULL`,
  (row) => String(row.repository)
);
defineQuery(
  "creator-delivery-owners",
  `WITH RECURSIVE source(repository) AS (
     SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(t.usage, '$.repository'), t.repository) FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.id = ?2),
   locations(repository) AS (SELECT repository FROM source UNION SELECT pb.repository
     FROM source JOIN project_repositories pa ON pa.workspace_id = ?1 AND pa.repository = source.repository
     JOIN project_repositories pb ON pb.workspace_id = ?1 AND pb.project_id = pa.project_id),
   exact(repository) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.repository FROM locations l WHERE EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1 AND d.repository = l.repository) LIMIT 1),
   ${ownerKeys("WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact)")}
   SELECT repository FROM exact UNION ALL SELECT repository FROM owners WHERE repository IS NOT NULL`,
  (row) => String(row.repository)
);
defineQuery(
  "primary-repositories-with-deliveries",
  `SELECT location.value AS repository FROM json_each(?2) location
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1 AND d.repository = location.value)`,
  (row) => String(row.repository)
);
const DELIVERIES_CHANGED_SINCE = defineQuery(
  "deliveries-changed-since",
  `SELECT d.id AS id FROM deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id = ?1 AND d.seq > ?2
   UNION SELECT t.id AS id FROM tombstones t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.seq > ?2 AND t.entity = 'deliveries'
   UNION SELECT m.delivery_id AS id FROM messages m WHERE m.workspace_id = ?1 AND m.seq > ?2 AND m.delivery_id IS NOT NULL
   UNION SELECT NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages a WHERE a.workspace_id = ?1 AND a.seq > ?2 AND (a.from_id = 'human' OR a.to_id = 'human'))
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tombstones r WHERE r.workspace_id = ?1 AND r.seq > ?2 AND r.entity = 'messages')`,
  (row) => row.id == null ? null : String(row.id)
);
defineQuery(

   ORDER BY t.last_seen_at DESC, t.id LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4`,

const agentIdentityBranches = {
  // ?2: JSON array of ids.
  ids: `SELECT t.id FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))
   UNION SELECT t.merged_into AS id FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1
     AND t.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2)) AND t.merged_into IS NOT NULL`,
  recent: (n) => `SELECT id FROM (SELECT r.id FROM threads r WHERE r.workspace_id = ?1 AND r.revoked = 0
     ORDER BY r.last_seen_at DESC, r.id LIMIT ?${n})`,
  // Distinct live repositories by skip-scan over threads_project_recency, then each one's latest agent.
  liveSources: `SELECT (SELECT p.id FROM threads p WHERE p.workspace_id = ?1 AND p.revoked = 0 AND p.repository = live.repository
       ORDER BY p.last_seen_at DESC, p.id LIMIT 1) AS id
     FROM (WITH RECURSIVE live(repository) AS (
       SELECT (SELECT MIN(s.repository) FROM threads s WHERE s.workspace_id = ?1 AND s.revoked = 0)
       UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT MIN(s.repository) FROM threads s WHERE s.workspace_id = ?1 AND s.revoked = 0 AND s.repository > live.repository)
       FROM live WHERE live.repository IS NOT NULL
     ) SELECT repository FROM live WHERE repository IS NOT NULL) live`,
  // Distinct repositories of every agent (revoked too) by skip-scan over threads_project_sources, each
  // one's lowest id; agents without a repository form their own group, as GROUP BY repository did.
  allSources: `SELECT (SELECT MIN(p.id) FROM threads p WHERE p.workspace_id = ?1 AND p.repository = every.repository) AS id
     FROM (WITH RECURSIVE every(repository) AS (
       SELECT (SELECT MIN(s.repository) FROM threads s WHERE s.workspace_id = ?1)
       UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT MIN(s.repository) FROM threads s WHERE s.workspace_id = ?1 AND s.repository > every.repository)
       FROM every WHERE every.repository IS NOT NULL
     ) SELECT repository FROM every WHERE repository IS NOT NULL) every
   UNION SELECT MIN(p.id) AS id FROM threads p WHERE p.workspace_id = ?1 AND p.repository IS NULL`,
  // ?n: JSON array of lowercased repositories. Pinned to threads_project_aliases (workspace_id,
  // lower(repository), id): without statistics SQLite otherwise walks a covering index of every agent
  // to compute lower(repository). A dropped index then fails loudly instead of scanning silently.
  repositories: (n) => `SELECT MIN(a.id) AS id FROM threads a INDEXED BY threads_project_aliases
     WHERE a.workspace_id = ?1 AND lower(a.repository) IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?${n})) GROUP BY a.repository`,
  // ?n: JSON array of repositories; the three latest live agents of each, through threads_project_recency.
  recentSources: (n) => `SELECT id FROM (SELECT r.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.repository ORDER BY r.last_seen_at DESC, r.id) AS rank
     FROM threads r WHERE r.workspace_id = ?1 AND r.revoked = 0 AND r.repository IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?${n})))
     WHERE rank <= 3`
};
const agentIdentityQueries = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
for (let mask = 0; mask < 24; mask++) {
  const recent = Boolean(mask & 1), repositories = Boolean(mask & 2), recentSources = Boolean(mask & 4), sources = mask >> 3;
  if (sources > 2) continue;
  let next = 3;
  const parts = [agentIdentityBranches.ids];
  if (recent) parts.push(agentIdentityBranches.recent(next++));
  if (sources === 1) parts.push(agentIdentityBranches.liveSources);
  if (sources === 2) parts.push(agentIdentityBranches.allSources);
  if (repositories) parts.push(agentIdentityBranches.repositories(next++));
  if (recentSources) parts.push(agentIdentityBranches.recentSources(next++));
  const key = `${+recent}${sources}${+repositories}${+recentSources}`;
  const terms = parts.map((part) => `SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM (${part}))`);
  const groups = [terms.slice(0, 3), terms.slice(3)].filter((group) => group.length).map((group) => `SELECT id FROM (${group.join("\n   UNION ")})`);
  agentIdentityQueries.set(key, defineQuery(`agent-identities-${key}`, groups.join("\n UNION "), (row) => String(row.id)));
}

(() => {
  const sources = Object.fromEntries(SEARCH_KINDS.map((kind2) => [kind2, []]));
  for (const [table, spec2] of Object.entries(LEDGER_SEARCH)) {
    if (!("search" in spec2) || !spec2.search) continue;
    const search = spec2.search;
    sources[search.kind].push({
      table,
      ...search.as ? { when: `NOT (${search.as.when})` } : {}
    });
    if (search.as)
      sources[search.as.kind].push({
        table,
        when: search.as.when,
        ...search.as.hiddenWhen ? { hidden: search.as.hiddenWhen } : {},
        ...search.as.key ? { key: search.as.key } : {}
      });
  }
  return sources;
})();
function spec$1(table) {
  const found = LEDGER_SEARCH[table];
  return "excluded" in found ? null : found;
}
function isSearchTable(table) {
  return Boolean(spec$1(table)?.search);
}
Object.keys(LEDGER_SEARCH).filter(isSearchTable);
function decodeRow(table, row) {
  const { columns } = tableSpec(table);
  const out = {};
  for (const [column, kind2] of Object.entries(columns)) {
    const value = row[column];
    if (value === void 0 || value === null) out[column] = null;
    else if (kind2 === "json") out[column] = JSON.parse(String(value));
    else if (kind2 === "bool") out[column] = Number(value) === 1;
    else if (kind2 === "int") out[column] = Number(value);
    else out[column] = String(value);
  }
  return out;
}

function queries(recipient, acknowledged) {
  const unread = `(COALESCE(m.acknowledged_at, 0) = 0 OR (m.data IS NOT NULL AND json_type(m.data, '$.acknowledgedAt') IS NULL))`;
  const scope = `m.workspace_id = ?1${recipient ? " AND m.to_id = ?2 AND (m.data IS NULL OR json_type(m.data, '$.to') IS NOT NULL)" : ""}${acknowledged ? "" : ` AND ${unread}`}`;
  const index = acknowledged ? "" : ` INDEXED BY messages_unread_${recipient ? "recipient" : "workspace"}_page`;
  const name2 = `inbox-${recipient ? "recipient" : "human"}-${acknowledged ? "all" : "unread"}`;
  const rowJson = (table, alias) => `json_object(${Object.keys(tableSpec(table).columns).flatMap((column) => [`'${column}'`, `${alias}.${column}`]).join(", ")})`;
  const snapshot2 = defineQuery(`${name2}-snapshot`, `WITH workspace AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT seq FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?1
    ), page AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT m.* FROM messages m${index} WHERE (SELECT seq FROM workspace) != ?5 AND ${scope}
      ORDER BY m.position, m.id LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4
    ), refs AS (
      SELECT from_id AS id FROM page UNION SELECT to_id FROM page
      UNION SELECT ?2 WHERE ?2 IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT seq FROM workspace) != ?5
    ), agents AS (
      SELECT t.* FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.id IN (
        SELECT id FROM refs UNION SELECT a.merged_into FROM refs JOIN threads a ON a.workspace_id = ?1 AND a.id = refs.id)
    )
    SELECT 'header' AS kind, json_object('version', seq, 'messages',
      (SELECT json_object('count', COUNT(*), 'seq', COALESCE(MAX(m.seq), 0)) FROM messages m${index} WHERE ${scope})) AS payload, -1 AS position, '' AS id FROM workspace
    UNION ALL SELECT 'message', ${rowJson("messages", "p")}, p.position, p.id FROM page p
    UNION ALL SELECT 'thread', ${rowJson("threads", "t")}, t.position, t.id FROM agents t
    ORDER BY kind, position, id`, (row) => ({ kind: String(row.kind), value: JSON.parse(String(row.payload)) }));
  const validate = defineQuery(`${name2}-generation`, `SELECT w.seq AS version,
    CASE WHEN w.seq = ?4 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT json_object('count', COUNT(*), 'seq', COALESCE(MAX(m.seq), 0))
      FROM messages m${index} WHERE ${scope}) END AS messages,
    CASE WHEN w.seq = ?4 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT json_object('count', COUNT(*), 'seq', COALESCE(MAX(t.seq), 0))
      FROM threads t WHERE t.workspace_id = ?1 AND t.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?3))) END AS agents
    FROM workspaces w WHERE w.id = ?1`, (row) => ({
    version: Number(row.version),
    messages: row.messages === null ? null : JSON.parse(String(row.messages)),
    agents: row.agents === null ? null : JSON.parse(String(row.agents))
  }));
  return { snapshot: snapshot2, validate };
}
({

  human: { unread: queries(false, false), all: queries(false, true) }
});

function guardedMaintenanceQuery(source2, columns, parameters) {
  if (!columns.length || columns.some((column) => !/^[a-z_]+$/.test(column))) throw Error("Invalid maintenance projection");
  const chunks = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(columns.length / 16) }, (_, i) => `json_array(${columns.slice(i * 16, i * 16 + 16).join(",")})`);
  const sql = `SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_array(${chunks.join(",")})), '[]') AS snapshot FROM (${source2.sql})`;
  const read = defineQuery(`${source2.name}-snapshot`, sql, (row) => {
    const snapshot2 = String(row.snapshot);
    const rows = JSON.parse(snapshot2).map((chunks2) => {
      const values = chunks2.flat();
      const raw = Object.fromEntries(columns.map((column, index) => [column, values[index]]));
      return source2.map ? source2.map(raw) : raw;
    });
    return { snapshot: snapshot2, rows };
  });
  const unchanged = defineAssertion(`${source2.name}-unchanged`, `(${sql}) = ?${parameters + 2}`);
  return {
    read,
    result(answer, values = []) {
      if (values.length !== parameters) throw Error("Invalid maintenance guard parameters");
      return { rows: answer.rows, stage: (write) => {
        write.assert(unchanged, [...values, answer.snapshot]);
      } };
    },
    async load(ws, values = []) {
      return this.result((await ws.first(ws.query(read, [...values])))[0], values);
    }
  };
}

);

function blockShapeProblem(b) {
  if (b.type === "diagram") {
    const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    const places = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (const node of b.nodes) {
      if (ids.has(node.id)) return `nodes: "${node.id}" is used by another box`;
      ids.add(node.id);
      const place = `${node.col},${node.row}`;
      if (places.has(place)) return `nodes: "${node.id}" is on column ${node.col}, row ${node.row}, where another box is; give each box its own place`;
      places.add(place);
    }
    for (const edge of b.edges) {
      for (const end of [edge.from, edge.to]) if (!ids.has(end)) return `edges: "${end}" is not a box; boxes: ${[...ids].join(", ")}`;
    }
    const lastColumn = Math.max(...b.nodes.map((node) => node.col));
    for (const lane of b.lanes ?? []) {
      if (lane.from > lane.to) return `lanes: "${lane.label}" runs from column ${lane.from} to ${lane.to}; from must not be after to`;
      if (lane.to > lastColumn) return `lanes: "${lane.label}" reaches column ${lane.to}, but the boxes stop at column ${lastColumn}`;
    }
  }
  if (b.type === "table") {
    const wrong = b.rows.findIndex((row) => row.length !== b.columns.length);
    if (wrong >= 0) return `rows.${wrong}: has ${b.rows[wrong].length} cells, but the table has ${b.columns.length} columns`;
  }
  if (b.type === "timeline") {
    const lost = b.items.findIndex((item) => item.image !== void 0 && !item.evidence);
    if (lost >= 0) return `items.${lost}: image picks a picture of the step's evidence; give evidence too`;
  }
  if (b.type === "matrix") {
    if (b.cells.length !== b.criteria.length) return `cells: has ${b.cells.length} rows, but there are ${b.criteria.length} criteria; one row per criterion`;
    const wrong = b.cells.findIndex((row) => row.length !== b.options.length);
    if (wrong >= 0) return `cells.${wrong}: has ${b.cells[wrong].length} cells, but there are ${b.options.length} options; one cell per option`;
    if (b.options.filter((option2) => option2.picked).length > 1) return "options: pick one option at most";
  }
  return void 0;
}

function asWritten(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return raw;
  const b = raw;
  if (b.type === "prose" && b.newer && typeof b.newer === "object") return b.newer;
  if (b.type === "figure" && b.caption === "") {
    const { caption: _empty, ...figure } = b;
    return figure;
  }
  return raw;
}

  if (parsed.success) {
    const data = parsed.data.type === "explain" ? deliveryBriefs.briefFigureOf(parsed.data) : parsed.data;
    const shape = blockShapeProblem(data);
    if (!shape) return data;
    ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `${shape}. For example: ${BLOCK_EXAMPLES[data.type]}` });
    return NEVER;
  }
  const known = kind2 !== void 0 && kind2 in BLOCK_EXAMPLES;
  const problems = known ? parsed.error.issues.map((issue2) => `${issue2.path.length ? issue2.path.join(".") : "block"}: ${issue2.message}`).join("; ") : `a block needs type ${Object.keys(BLOCK_EXAMPLES).filter((type) => type !== "explain").join(", ")}`;
  ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `${problems}. For example: ${known ? BLOCK_EXAMPLES[kind2] : BLOCK_EXAMPLES.prose}` });
  return NEVER;
});

function textProblem(source2) {
  const unknown2 = deliveryBriefs.unknownRefKinds(source2);
  if (unknown2.length) return `unknown reference kind "${unknown2[0]}:"; use ${deliveryBriefs.BRIEF_REF_KINDS.join(", ")} or https`;

  if (/\bTODO\b/.test(source2)) return "replace the skeleton's TODO with what you found";
  return void 0;
}

function compactTool(tool2) {
  const strip = (value) => {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(strip);
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return value;
    const out = {};
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
      if (key === "$schema" || key === "additionalProperties" && child === false) continue;
      if (key === "enum" && JSON.stringify(child) === JSON.stringify(deliveryBriefs.DELIVERY_PHASES)) {
        out[key] = [...deliveryBriefs.PHASE_CHOICES];
        continue;
      }
      if (key === "propertyNames" && JSON.stringify(child) === '{"type":"string"}') continue;
      if (key === "additionalProperties" && JSON.stringify(child) === "{}") continue;
      if (key === "minLength" && child === 1) continue;
      if (key === "maximum" && child === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || key === "minimum" && child === Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER) continue;
      out[key] = strip(child);
    }
    return out;
  };
  return { ...tool2, inputSchema: strip(tool2.inputSchema) };
}
function ackArguments(args) {
  const { id: id2, messageId, messageIds, ...rest } = args;
  const ids = (value) => {
    if (typeof value !== "string") return value;
    const text2 = value.trim();
    if (text2.startsWith("[")) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(text2);
      } catch {
        return value;
      }
    }
    return text2.split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean);
  };
  if (messageIds !== void 0) return { ...rest, messageIds: ids(messageIds), ...id2 === void 0 ? {} : { id: id2 }, ...messageId === void 0 ? {} : { messageId } };
  const single = messageId ?? id2;
  return single === void 0 ? args : { ...rest, messageIds: Array.isArray(single) ? single : ids(single) };
}

function setupTool(kind2) {
  return (args) => {
    const resources = kind2 === "get" ? [args.resource] : Array.isArray(args.changes) ? args.changes.map((change) => change && typeof change === "object" ? change.resource : void 0) : [];
    const workspace = resources.filter((resource2) => WORKSPACE_RESOURCES.has(String(resource2))).length;
    if (workspace && workspace !== resources.length)
      throw Error("One setup update changes workspace resources (workspace, behavior, usage) or project resources, not both");
    return workspace ? `blume_workspace_${kind2}` : `blume_project_${kind2}`;
  };
}

function resolveProjectLocationCandidates(candidates, targetPath) {
  const target = insights.normalizeProjectResolutionPath(targetPath);
  if (!target) return null;
  const match = candidates.flatMap((candidate) => {
    const path = insights.normalizeProjectResolutionPath(candidate.path);
    return path ? [{ ...candidate, path }] : [];
  }).filter((candidate) => insights.projectResolutionPathContains(candidate.path, target)).sort((left, right) => right.path.length - left.path.length)[0];
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    projectId: match.projectId,
    ...match.workspaceLocationId ? { workspaceLocationId: match.workspaceLocationId } : {}
  };
}

parentPort?.once("message", (event) => {

  let handle = null;

    const candidates = index.listDesktopProjectPathResolutionCandidates(
      handle.db,
      request.targetPath
    );
    post({
      type: "resolve-project-path-result",
      id: request.id,
      ok: true,
      resolution: resolveProjectLocationCandidates(candidates, request.targetPath)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    post({
      type: "resolve-project-path-result",
      id: request.id,
      ok: false,
      errorMessage: err.message,
      errorName: err.name,
      errorStack: err.stack
    });
  } finally {
    handle?.close();
    setImmediate(() => process.exit(0));
  }
});

    flushLegacy(chat);
    void discard(
      messages2.flatMap((message) => shown2.has(message.id) ? [] : message.images ?? [])
    );
    bound();
  }
  function load() {
    return loaded ??= (async () => {
      const saved = await options.store.load() ?? { version: 1, chats: [] };
      if (saved.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(saved.chats))
        throw Error("Unknown saved chat format");
      commands = (saved.commands ?? []).map(validateOwnedDirectCommand);
      for (const chat of saved.chats) {
        if (!chat.threadId) continue;
        if (!chat.id || !options.isAbsolutePath(chat.cwd) || !Array.isArray(chat.queue) || !Array.isArray(chat.messages))
          throw Error("Invalid saved chat");
        const uncertain = chat.queue.some((message) => message.state === "sending");
        const interrupted = chat.status === "running" || chat.status === "approval" || uncertain;
        const resume = chat.status === "running" && !uncertain;
        if (resume && !chat.queue.some((message) => message.state === "queued")) {
          const id = options.newId();
          chat.queue.push({
            id,
            text: "Blume restarted while you were working. Continue the unfinished task from the existing conversation. Check the current state before repeating any action that may already have completed. Preserve all previous instructions and approval requirements; this restart does not grant any new approval.",
            state: "queued"
          });
          chat.messages.push({
            id,
            role: "system",
            at: Date.now(),
            text: "Blume restarted. Automatically resuming the interrupted work."
          });
        }
        const { spent: _spent, ...kept } = chat;
        chats.set(chat.id, {
          ...kept,
          spent: [],
          ledgerSeen: chat.ledgerSeen ?? [],
          approvals: [],
          status: resume ? "idle" : interrupted ? "error" : chat.status,
          ...resume ? { error: void 0 } : interrupted ? {
            error: "Blume restarted while the agent was working. Send a message to resume this chat."
          } : {}
        });
      }
      const retained = [...chats.values()].flatMap((chat) => [
        ...chat.queue.flatMap((item) => item.images?.map((image) => image.path) ?? []),
        ...chat.messages.flatMap(
          (message) => message.images?.flatMap((image) => image.file ? [image.file] : []) ?? []
        )
      ]);
      if (options.attachments?.pruneRetained)
        await options.attachments.pruneRetained(retained).catch(() => {
        });
      else if (options.attachments?.prune) {
        const hasRetained = [...chats.values()].some(
          (chat) => chat.messages.some((message) => message.images?.some((image) => image.file))
        );
        if (!hasRetained)
          await options.attachments.prune(
            [...chats.values()].flatMap(
              (chat) => chat.queue.flatMap((message) => message.images ?? [])
            )
          ).catch(() => {
          });
      }
      if (!options.attachments?.pruneRetained && !options.attachments?.prune) {
        const keep = new Set(
          [...chats.values()].flatMap(
            (chat) => chat.queue.flatMap((message) => message.images?.map((image) => image.path) ?? [])
          )
        );
        await discard(
          saved.chats.flatMap((chat) => chat.spent ?? []).filter((image) => !keep.has(image.path))
        );
      }
      const evicted = bound();
      if (evicted || saved.chats.some((chat) => chat.status === "running")) await save();
    })();
  }
  function save() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimer);
    saveTimer = void 0;
    const snapshot = structuredClone({
      version: 1,
      chats: [...chats.values()].filter((chat) => chat.threadId).map(
        (chat) => live.get(chat.id)?.cancelRequested && chat.status === "running" ? { ...chat, status: "idle" } : chat
      ),
      commands
    });
    const next = disk.then(() => options.store.save(snapshot));
    disk = next.catch(() => {
    });
    return next;
  }
  function changed(chat) {
    chat.updatedAt = Math.max(Date.now(), chat.updatedAt + 1);
    options.changed?.();
    if (!stopped && !saveTimer)
      saveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        saveTimer = void 0;
        void save().catch((error2) => {
          chat.status = "error";
          chat.error = `Could not save chat: ${String(error2)}`;
          options.changed?.();
        });
      }, 150);
  }
  function trim(chat) {
    const before = chat.messages;
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    let bytes = 2;
    const messages2 = chat.messages.slice(-200);
    let start = messages2.length;
    for (let i = messages2.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const message = messages2[i];
      message.text = message.text.slice(-32e3);
      if (message.tool)
        message.tool = {
          ...message.tool,
          name: message.tool.name.slice(0, 200),
          input: message.tool.input?.slice(0, 16e3),
          result: message.tool.result?.slice(0, 16e3)
        };
      let size = encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(message)).byteLength + 1;
      for (let attempts = 0; size > 96e3 && attempts < 4; attempts++) {
        message.text = message.text.slice(-Math.floor(message.text.length / 2));
        if (message.tool) {
          message.tool.input = message.tool.input?.slice(
            0,
            Math.floor(message.tool.input.length / 2)
          );
          message.tool.result = message.tool.result?.slice(
            0,
            Math.floor(message.tool.result.length / 2)
          );
        }
        size = encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(message)).byteLength + 1;
      }
      if (bytes + size > 2e5) break;
      bytes += size;
      start = i;
    }
    chat.messages = messages2.slice(start);
    void discard(dropped(before, chat));
  }
  function error(chat, cause) {
    if (stopped) return;
    chat.status = "error";
    chat.error = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
    changed(chat);
  }
  function idle(chat, current) {
    clearTimeout(current.idleTimer);
    clearTimeout(current.titleTimer);
    if (live.get(chat.id) !== current) return;
    flushLegacy(chat);
    current.idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (live.get(chat.id) !== current) return;
      if (current.turnId || current.starting || chat.approvals.length) return;
      current.rpc.close();
      live.delete(chat.id);
    }, options.idleMs ?? 3e4);
    current.idleTimer.unref?.();
  }
  async function interrupt(chat, current) {
    if (!current.cancelRequested || !current.turnId || current.interruptSent) return;
    current.interruptSent = true;
    const turnId = current.turnId;
    try {
      const result = await current.rpc.request("turn/interrupt", {
        threadId: chat.threadId,
        turnId
      });
      if (result.closed && live.get(chat.id) === current) {
        live.delete(chat.id);
        current.turnId = void 0;
        flushLegacy(chat);
        chat.status = "idle";
        changed(chat);
      }
    } catch (cause) {
      current.interruptSent = false;
      if (cause instanceof CodexRequestRejected && cause.message === "no active turn to interrupt") {
        if (live.get(chat.id) === current && current.turnId === turnId) {
          current.turnId = void 0;
          flushLegacy(chat);
          chat.status = "idle";
          if (!current.starting) idle(chat, current);
          changed(chat);
        }
        return;
      }
      throw cause;
    }
  }
  function notification(chat, message) {
    const current = live.get(chat.id);
    const params = message.params ?? {};
    if (params.threadId && params.threadId !== chat.threadId) return;
    if (message.id !== void 0 && message.method) {
      if (!current) return;
      if (["item/commandExecution/requestApproval", "item/fileChange/requestApproval"].includes(
        message.method
      )) {
        current.rpc.reply(message.id, { decision: "accept" });
      } else if (message.method === "mcpServer/elicitation/request" && params.mode === "form" && params._meta?.codex_approval_kind === "mcp_tool_call" && !Object.keys(
        params.requestedSchema?.properties ?? {}
      ).length) {
        current.rpc.reply(message.id, { action: "accept", content: {}, _meta: null });
      } else {
        current.rpc.reject(
          message.id,
          "This request is not supported in Blume. Ask the person in a chat message or with Blume MCP."
        );
        chat.messages.push({
          id: options.newId(),
          role: "system",
          text: `The agent requested input Blume cannot display yet (${message.method}). Ask the agent to continue using chat messages.`
        });
        trim(chat);
      }
    } else if (message.method === "thread/model/updated") {
      if (!current || params.threadId !== chat.threadId) return;
      if (!adoptModel(chat, params.model)) return;
    } else if (message.method === "thread/name/updated") {
      if (!current || params.threadId !== chat.threadId) return;
      current.titleVersion = (current.titleVersion ?? 0) + 1;
      adoptTitle(chat, params.threadName);
      return;
    } else if (message.method === "turn/started" && current) {
      current.turnId = String(params.turn?.id ?? "");
      chat.status = "running";
      void interrupt(chat, current).catch((cause) => error(chat, cause));
    } else if (message.method === "item/agentMessage/delta") {
      const id = String(params.itemId);
      let item = chat.messages.find((item2) => item2.id === id);
      if (!item) {
        item = { id, role: "assistant", at: Date.now(), text: "" };
        chat.messages.push(item);
      }
      item.text += String(params.delta ?? "");
      trim(chat);
    } else if (message.method === "item/completed" || message.method === "item/started") {
      const item = params.item;
      if (item?.id && ["commandExecution", "fileChange", "mcpToolCall"].includes(item.type ?? "")) {
        const existing = chat.messages.find((message2) => message2.id === item.id);
        const tool = {
          name: item.tool ?? item.command ?? item.type,
          input: JSON.stringify(item.arguments ?? {}).slice(0, 16e3),
          result: (item.aggregatedOutput ?? JSON.stringify(item.result ?? "")).slice(0, 16e3),
          status: item.status === "failed" ? "failed" : message.method === "item/completed" ? "completed" : "running"
        };
        if (existing) existing.tool = tool;
        else chat.messages.push({ id: item.id, role: "tool", text: "", at: Date.now(), tool });
        trim(chat);
      }
      if (item?.type === "agentMessage" && item.id && typeof item.text === "string") {
        const existing = chat.messages.find((message2) => message2.id === item.id);
        if (existing) existing.text = item.text;
        else chat.messages.push({ id: item.id, role: "assistant", at: Date.now(), text: item.text });
        trim(chat);
      }
    } else if (message.method === "turn/completed" && current) {
      const turn = params.turn;
      current.turnId = void 0;
      chat.approvals = [];
      current.requests.clear();
      chat.status = turn?.status === "failed" ? "error" : "idle";
      if (turn?.status === "failed")
        chat.error = turn.error?.message ?? "The agent could not finish this turn";
      else delete chat.error;
      idle(chat, current);
      refreshTitle(chat, current);
      if (turn?.status !== "failed") nameChat(chat, current);
      if (!current.starting) kick(chat);
    } else if (message.method === "serverRequest/resolved") {
      const id = String(params.requestId);
      current?.requests.delete(id);
      chat.approvals = chat.approvals.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
    } else return;
    changed(chat);
  }
  function adoptModel(chat, value) {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._:/+-]{0,199}$/.test(value) || chat.model === value)
      return false;
    chat.model = value;
    return true;
  }
  function adoptTitle(chat, value) {
    if (stopped || typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) return;
    const title = value.trim().slice(0, 500);
    if (chat.title === title && chat.titleSource === "provider") return;
    chat.title = title;
    chat.titleSource = "provider";
    changed(chat);
  }
  function refreshTitle(chat, current) {
    if (stopped || live.get(chat.id) !== current || current.titleRead) return;
    clearTimeout(current.titleTimer);
    const version = current.titleVersion;
    current.titleRead = current.rpc.request("thread/read", {
      threadId: chat.threadId,
      includeTurns: false
    }).then((result) => {
      if (!stopped && live.get(chat.id) === current && current.titleVersion === version && result.thread?.id === chat.threadId)
        adoptTitle(chat, result.thread.name);
    }).catch(() => {
    }).finally(() => {
      current.titleRead = void 0;
      if (!stopped && live.get(chat.id) === current) {
        current.titleTimer = setTimeout(() => refreshTitle(chat, current), 5e3);
        current.titleTimer.unref?.();
      }
    });
  }
  function nameChat(chat, current) {
    const generate = options.generateTitle;
    if (!generate || stopped || live.get(chat.id) !== current || current.titleNamed || (chat.harness ?? "codex") !== "codex" || !chat.threadId || chat.titleSource === "provider")
      return;
    const messages2 = ownedTitleExcerpt(chat.messages);
    if (!messages2.some((message) => message.role === "user")) return;
    current.titleNamed = true;
    const version = current.titleVersion;
    const stillWanted = () => !stopped && live.get(chat.id) === current && current.titleVersion === version && chat.titleSource !== "provider";
    void generate(messages2).then(async (generated) => {
      const name = generated?.trim().slice(0, 100);
      if (!name || !stillWanted()) return;
      await current.rpc.request("thread/name/set", { threadId: chat.threadId, name });
      if (stillWanted()) adoptTitle(chat, name);
    }).catch(() => {
    });
  }
  async function connect(chat, creating2 = false) {
    const pending = connections.get(chat.id);
    if (pending) return pending;
    const job = connectOnce(chat, creating2);
    connections.set(chat.id, job);
    try {
      return await job;
    } finally {
      connections.delete(chat.id);
    }
  }
  async function connectOnce(chat, creating2 = false) {
    if (stopped) throw Error("Chat runtime stopped");
    const existing = live.get(chat.id);
    if (existing) {
      clearTimeout(existing.idleTimer);
      return existing;
    }
    if (live.size + connecting.size >= MAX_ACTIVE_CHATS)
      throw Error(`${MAX_ACTIVE_CHATS} agent chats are active. Stop one or wait for it to finish.`);
    connecting.add(chat.id);
    try {
      const config = await options.configuration(chat.cwd, chat.harness ?? "codex");
      if (stopped) throw Error("Chat runtime stopped");
      const rpc = options.createTransport({
        cwd: chat.cwd,
        harness: chat.harness ?? "codex",
        onMessage: (message) => {
          if (!stopped && live.get(chat.id)?.rpc === rpc) notification(chat, message);
        },
        onExit: (cause) => {
          const current2 = live.get(chat.id);
          if (current2?.rpc !== rpc) return;
          clearTimeout(current2.idleTimer);
          clearTimeout(current2.titleTimer);
          live.delete(chat.id);
          current2.turnId = void 0;
          flushLegacy(chat);
          chat.approvals = [];
          error(chat, cause);
        }
      });
      const current = { rpc, starting: false, requests: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map() };
      live.set(chat.id, current);
      connecting.delete(chat.id);
      try {
        await rpc.initialize();
        if (stopped) throw Error("Chat runtime stopped");
        const result = await rpc.request(creating2 ? "thread/start" : "thread/resume", {
          ...creating2 ? {} : { threadId: chat.threadId, excludeTurns: true },
          cwd: chat.cwd,
          ...chat.model ? { model: chat.model } : {},
          ...chat.effort ? { effort: chat.effort } : {},
          config,
          sandbox: "workspace-write",
          approvalPolicy: "on-request",
          developerInstructions: "This chat is owned by Blume. Messages and recorded review decisions arrive directly as user turns on this session. Do not poll or read the Blume inbox to receive them and do not acknowledge them through MCP. Use blume_owned for Blume tools when the work requires them. Do not invent approvals. When an image helps answer the person, include it in your reply with Markdown image syntax: ![Description](<image source>). Use an HTTPS image URL" + (options.externallySandboxed ? ". Local cloud workspace paths cannot be displayed; use an accessible image URL supplied by your tools." : " or an absolute path to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF inside this chat’s working directory. Save generated images there before referencing them. Local images must be at most 20 MiB. Do not embed base64 image data in your reply.")
        });
        if (stopped) throw Error("Chat runtime stopped");
        if (!result.thread?.id || !creating2 && result.thread.id !== chat.threadId)
          throw Error("The agent returned a different chat identity");
        chat.threadId = result.thread.id;
        adoptModel(chat, result.model);
        adoptTitle(chat, result.thread.name);
        const mcp = await rpc.request("mcpServerStatus/list", { threadId: chat.threadId, serverName: "blume_owned" });
        const server = mcp.data.find((item) => item.name === "blume_owned");
        if (!server || server.toolsError || !Object.keys(server.tools).some((name) => name.endsWith("blume_context")))
          throw Error("Blume MCP did not connect. Check your Blume sign-in and try again.");
        chat.mcpReady = true;
        refreshTitle(chat, current);
        for (const pending of chat.queue.filter((item) => item.state === "sending")) {
          const history = await rpc.request("thread/turns/list", {
            threadId: chat.threadId,
            limit: 20,
            itemsView: "full",
            sortDirection: "desc"
          });
          if (history.data.some(
            (turn) => turn.items?.some(
              (item) => item.type === "userMessage" && item.clientId === pending.id
            )
          )) {
            pending.state = "sent";
            retire(chat, [pending]);
            chat.accepted = [...chat.accepted, pending.id].slice(-2e3);
          } else
            throw Error(
              "The previous message has an uncertain delivery status. Check the conversation, then dismiss this send before continuing. It will not be sent again automatically."
            );
        }
        await save();
        return current;
      } catch (cause) {
        rpc.close();
        live.delete(chat.id);
        chat.mcpReady = false;
        throw cause;
      }
    } finally {
      connecting.delete(chat.id);
    }
  }
  function kick(chat) {
    if (stopped) return;
    const job = pump(chat).catch((cause) => error(chat, cause));
    jobs.add(job);
    void job.finally(() => jobs.delete(job));
  }
  async function pump(chat) {
    if (stopped || pumping.has(chat.id)) return;
    const active = live.get(chat.id);
    if (!canSend(active)) return;
    if (!chat.queue.some((item) => item.state === "queued")) return;
    pumping.add(chat.id);
    try {
      const current = await connect(chat);
      if (stopped) return;
      if (!canSend(current)) return;
      const message = chat.queue.find((item) => item.state === "queued");
      if (!message) {
        if (!current.turnId) idle(chat, current);
        return;
      }
      current.starting = true;
      const steering = current.turnId;
      if (!steering) {
        current.cancelRequested = false;
        current.interruptSent = false;
      }
      try {
        message.state = "sending";
        chat.status = "running";
        delete chat.error;
        changed(chat);
        await save();
        if (stopped) {
          message.state = "queued";
          chat.status = "idle";
          return;
        }
        const result = await current.rpc.request(steering ? "turn/steer" : "turn/start", {
          threadId: chat.threadId,
          ...steering ? { expectedTurnId: steering } : {},
          clientUserMessageId: message.id,
          ...!steering && chat.model ? { model: chat.model } : {},
          ...!steering && chat.effort ? { effort: chat.effort } : {},
          ...!steering && options.externallySandboxed && (chat.harness ?? "codex") === "codex" ? { sandboxPolicy: { type: "externalSandbox", networkAccess: "enabled" } } : {},
          input: turnInput(message)
        });
        message.state = "sent";
        chat.accepted = [...chat.accepted, message.id].slice(-2e3);
        retire(
          chat,
          chat.queue.filter((item) => item.state === "sent")
        );
        if (!steering && chat.status === "running" && result.turn?.status === "inProgress")
          current.turnId = result.turn.id;
        await interrupt(chat, current);
        bound();
        await save();
      } catch (cause) {
        if (current.cancelRequested) {
          retire(chat, [message]);
          chat.accepted = [...chat.accepted, message.id].slice(-2e3);
          bound();
        } else if (steering && cause instanceof CodexRequestRejected) {
          message.state = "queued";
          current.steerRejectedTurnId = steering;
        } else {
          if (cause instanceof CodexRequestRejected) message.state = "queued";
          error(chat, cause);
          current.rpc.close();
          live.delete(chat.id);
        }
      } finally {
        current.starting = false;
        flushLegacy(chat);
        changed(chat);
      }
      if (!current.turnId && chat.status !== "error") idle(chat, current);
    } catch (cause) {
      error(chat, cause);
    } finally {
      pumping.delete(chat.id);
      if (!stopped && chat.status !== "error" && canSend(live.get(chat.id)) && chat.queue.some((item) => item.state === "queued"))
        kick(chat);
    }
  }
  function canSend(current) {
    return !current?.starting && (!current?.turnId || !current.cancelRequested && current.steerRejectedTurnId !== current.turnId);
  }
  async function enqueue(chat, requestId, text2, images) {
    if (chat.accepted.includes(requestId)) return;
    if (chat.queue.some((item) => item.id === requestId)) {
      kick(chat);
      return;
    }
    if (chat.queue.length >= 50)
      throw Error("This chat has too many queued messages. Wait for the agent to reply.");
    let saved;
    if (images?.length) {
      if (!options.attachments) throw Error("Images cannot be attached in this chat runtime");
      saved = await options.attachments.save(chat.id, requestId, images);
    }
    const before = saved ? { queue: [...chat.queue], messages: [...chat.messages], status: chat.status } : void 0;
    chat.queue.push({ id: requestId, text: text2, state: "queued", ...saved ? { images: saved } : {} });
    chat.messages.push({
      id: requestId,
      role: "user",
      at: Date.now(),
      text: text2,
      ...saved ? { images: shown(saved) } : {}
    });
    if (chat.status === "idle") chat.status = "running";
    trim(chat);
    try {
      await save();
    } catch (cause) {
      if (before) {
        chat.queue = before.queue;
        chat.messages = before.messages;
        chat.status = before.status;
        void discard(saved);
      }
      throw cause;
    }
    if (saved && bound()) await save().catch(() => {
    });
    kick(chat);
    changed(chat);
  }
  const delivering = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  function commandChanged(command) {
    for (const chat of chats.values()) if (command.threadIds.includes(chat.threadId)) changed(chat);
  }
  function deliverCommand(command, resolved) {
    const active = delivering.get(command.id);
    if (active) return active;
    const job = deliverCommandOnce(command, resolved).finally(() => delivering.delete(command.id));
    delivering.set(command.id, job);
    return job;
  }
  async function deliverCommandOnce(command, resolved) {
    if (stopped || !options.dispatch) throw Error("Direct review delivery is unavailable");
    let result;
    const uncertain = command.uncertain;
    await serialize(async () => {
      command.uncertain = true;
      await save();
    });
    try {
      result = await options.dispatch(command);
    } catch (cause) {
      await serialize(async () => {
        if (stopped) return;
        if (cause instanceof OwnedDirectRejected && !uncertain)
          commands = commands.filter((item) => item.id !== command.id);
        else command.uncertain = true;
        commandChanged(command);
        await save();
      });
      throw cause;
    }
    const remoteMessages = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(result.directMessages))
      throw Error("This backend does not support direct chat delivery");
    const known = resolved ?? [];
    const external = result.directMessages.every(
      ({ threadId }) => isLocalRecipient(threadId) || known.some((chat) => chat.threadId === threadId)
    ) ? known : await options.external?.list() ?? [];
    await serialize(async () => {
      if (stopped) throw Error("Chat runtime stopped");
      const touched = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      for (const message of result.directMessages) {
        const chat = [...chats.values()].find((chat2) => chat2.threadId === message.threadId);
        const remote = external.find((chat2) => chat2.threadId === message.threadId);
        if (!chat && !remote || !command.threadIds.includes(message.threadId))
          throw Error("Decision targets a chat this runtime does not own");
        if (typeof message.id !== "string" || typeof message.text !== "string" || message.text.length > 32e3)
          throw Error("Invalid direct review message");
        const id = `decision:${message.id}`;
        if (!chat && remote) {

        });

          const { requestId: _new, ...newInput } = input;
          return item.operation === operation && JSON.stringify(oldInput) === JSON.stringify(newInput);
        });

          throw Error("Delivery request ID was reused");

            throw Error("Too many pending review decisions. Retry the existing decisions first.");
          commands.push(command);

      }).then((command) => deliverCommand(command, resolvedExternal));

      });

          clearTimeout(current.titleTimer);
          current.rpc.close();
        }
        live.clear();
      });
    },
    async stop() {

      await options.external?.close();

      saveTimer = void 0;
      for (const chat of chats.values()) {

      }

      }
    }
  };

const sameRepository = (a, b) => (a.repository ?? "").toLowerCase() === (b.repository ?? "").toLowerCase();
function linkedMerges(d) {
  return (d.github?.prs ?? []).filter((pr) => pr.state === "merged" && Boolean(pr.mergeCommitSha));
}
function mergedCurrentPullRequests(d) {
  const heads = [d.revision, ...d.committedAs ?? []].filter(Boolean);
  const revision = d.revisions?.at(-1);
  const listed = new Set(revision && heads.includes(revision.commit) ? revision.pullRequests.map((pr) => pr.url.toLowerCase()) : []);
  return linkedMerges(d).filter((pr) => heads.includes(pr.headSha) || heads.includes(pr.mergeCommitSha) || listed.has(pr.url.toLowerCase()));
}
function terminalMerge(pr, linked, seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set()) {
  const defaultBranch = pr.defaultBranch;
  if (defaultBranch && pr.baseBranch === defaultBranch) return pr;
  const parent = linked.find((other) => other !== pr && !seen.has(other) && sameRepository(other, pr) && other.headBranch === pr.baseBranch && Boolean(other.headRepository) && other.headRepository.toLowerCase() === pr.repository.toLowerCase());
  if (!parent) return defaultBranch ? void 0 : pr;
  if (parent.state !== "merged" || !parent.mergeCommitSha) return void 0;
  if (pr.mergedAt !== void 0 && parent.mergedAt !== void 0 && pr.mergedAt > parent.mergedAt) return void 0;
  return terminalMerge(parent, linked, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...seen, pr]));
}
function shippedCode(d) {
  const linked = d.github?.prs ?? [];
  const current = mergedCurrentPullRequests(d);
  const terminals = current.flatMap((pr) => {
    const terminal = terminalMerge(pr, linked);
    return terminal && terminal !== pr ? [terminal] : [];
  });
  const pullRequests = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...current, ...terminals])];
  const reached = pullRequests.filter((pr) => terminalMerge(pr, linked) === pr);
  const elsewhere = pullRequests.filter((pr) => !terminalMerge(pr, linked) && !reached.some((other) => sameRepository(other, pr)));
  return {
    pullRequests,
    newest: newestMerges([...reached, ...elsewhere]),
    agentShas: new Set([d.revision, ...d.committedAs ?? [], ...pullRequests.map((pr) => pr.mergeCommitSha)].filter(Boolean))
  };
}
function newestMerges(merges) {
  const byRepository = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const pr of merges) {
    const repository = (pr.repository ?? "").toLowerCase();
    byRepository.set(repository, [...byRepository.get(repository) ?? [], pr]);
  }
  return [...byRepository.values()].flatMap((prs) => {
    if (prs.some((pr) => pr.mergedAt === void 0)) return prs;
    const last = Math.max(...prs.map((pr) => pr.mergedAt));
    return prs.filter((pr) => pr.mergedAt === last);
  });
}

const NAME = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}$/;
const repoOf = (owner, repo) => {
  repo = repo.replace(/\.git$/i, "");
  return NAME.test(owner) && NAME.test(repo) && repo !== "." && repo !== ".." ? { owner, repo } : void 0;
};
function githubRepoFromProject(project) {
  if (!project) return void 0;
  const value = project.trim();
  const scp = /^git@github\.com:([^/]+)\/([^/]+?)\/?$/i.exec(value);
  if (scp) return repoOf(scp[1], scp[2]);
  const bare = /^(?:(?:https?|ssh|git):\/\/(?:[^@/]+@)?)?(?:www\.)?github\.com[:/]([^/]+)\/([^/?#]+?)\/?(?:[?#].*)?$/i.exec(
    value
  );
  return bare ? repoOf(bare[1], bare[2]) : void 0;
}
function githubPullFromUrl(url) {
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(url);
  } catch {
    return void 0;
  }
  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" || !/^(www\.)?github\.com$/i.test(parsed.hostname))
    return void 0;
  const match = /^\/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)\/pull\/(\d{1,9})(?:\/.*)?$/.exec(parsed.pathname);
  const repo = match && repoOf(match[1], match[2]);
  if (!repo) return void 0;
  const number = Number(match[3]);
  return {
    ...repo,
    number,
    url: `https://github.com/${repo.owner}/${repo.repo}/pull/${number}`
  };
}
const sameRepo = (a, b) => Boolean(
  a && b && a.owner.toLowerCase() === b.owner.toLowerCase() && a.repo.toLowerCase() === b.repo.toLowerCase()
);
function revisionMatches(revision, sha) {
  if (!revision || !sha || !/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i.test(revision)) return false;
  return sha.toLowerCase().startsWith(revision.toLowerCase());
}
function runMatchesDelivery(delivery, prs, headSha) {
  const code = typeof delivery === "object" ? delivery : { revision: delivery ?? "" };
  const sha = headSha.toLowerCase();
  if (revisionMatches(code.revision, sha)) return true;
  if (prs.some((pr) => pr.state === "merged" && pr.mergeCommitSha?.toLowerCase() === sha && revisionMatches(code.revision, pr.headSha))) return true;
  const whole = prs.filter((pr) => "baseBranch" in pr && "headBranch" in pr && "repository" in pr);
  if (!whole.length) return false;
  return shippedCode({ ...code, github: { prs: whole, syncedAt: 0 } }).pullRequests.some((pr) => pr.mergeCommitSha?.toLowerCase() === sha);
}

  const b = time(end);
  return a !== void 0 && b !== void 0 && b >= a ? b - a : void 0;
};
const nonnegative = (value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0 ? value : void 0;

const githubLogin = (value) => typeof value === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38})(?:\[bot\])?$/.test(value) ? value : void 0;
function checkRunState(status, conclusion) {
  if (status !== "completed") return status === "in_progress" ? "running" : "queued";
  switch (conclusion) {
    case "success":
      return "passed";
    case "cancelled":
      return "cancelled";
    case "skipped":
      return "skipped";
    case "neutral":
    case "stale":
      return "neutral";
    default:
      return "failed";
  }
}
function commitStatusState(state) {

function mapChecks(checkRuns, combinedStatus, workflows = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()) {

  }

    const name = text(status.context) || "Commit status";

      name,
      state: commitStatusState(status.state),
      ...githubUrl(status.target_url) ? { url: githubUrl(status.target_url) } : {}
    });
  }

    pending: count2(["queued", "running"]),

    items: items.map((item, index) => ({ item, index })).sort((a, b) => ORDER[a.item.state] - ORDER[b.item.state] || a.index - b.index).slice(0, GITHUB_LIMITS.checkItems).map(({ item }) => item)

function reviewDecision(reviews, pull) {
  const latest = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const review of Array.isArray(reviews) ? reviews : []) {
    const who = review?.user?.login;
    if (typeof who !== "string") continue;
    if (review.state === "APPROVED" || review.state === "CHANGES_REQUESTED") latest.set(who, review.state);
    else if (review.state === "DISMISSED") latest.delete(who);
  }
  const states = [...latest.values()];
  if (states.includes("CHANGES_REQUESTED")) return "changes_requested";
  if (states.includes("APPROVED")) return "approved";
  if (pull.requested_reviewers?.length || pull.requested_teams?.length) return "review_required";
  return "none";
}

function workflowJobKey(apiName, jobs) {

    const length = exact ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : derived ? prefix.length : -1;

}

    error.message += ` at line ${line2}, column ${col}`;
    let ci = col - 1;
    let lineStr = src.substring(lc.lineStarts[line2 - 1], lc.lineStarts[line2]).replace(/[\n\r]+$/, "");
    if (ci >= 60 && lineStr.length > 80) {
      const trimStart = Math.min(ci - 39, lineStr.length - 79);
      lineStr = "…" + lineStr.substring(trimStart);
      ci -= trimStart - 1;
    }
    if (lineStr.length > 80)
      lineStr = lineStr.substring(0, 79) + "…";
    if (line2 > 1 && /^ *$/.test(lineStr.substring(0, ci))) {
      let prev = src.substring(lc.lineStarts[line2 - 2], lc.lineStarts[line2 - 1]);
      if (prev.length > 80)
        prev = prev.substring(0, 79) + "…\n";
      lineStr = prev + lineStr;
    }
    if (/[^ ]/.test(lineStr)) {
      let count2 = 1;
      const end = error.linePos[1];
      if (end?.line === line2 && end.col > col) {
        count2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(end.col - col, 80 - ci));
      }
      const pointer = " ".repeat(ci) + "^".repeat(count2);
      error.message += `:

${lineStr}
${pointer}
`;
    }
  };
  errors.YAMLError = YAMLError;
  errors.YAMLParseError = YAMLParseError;
  errors.YAMLWarning = YAMLWarning;
  errors.prettifyError = prettifyError;

}

var utilContainsNewline = {};
var hasRequiredUtilContainsNewline;
function requireUtilContainsNewline() {
  if (hasRequiredUtilContainsNewline) return utilContainsNewline;
  hasRequiredUtilContainsNewline = 1;
  function containsNewline(key) {
    if (!key)
      return null;
    switch (key.type) {
      case "alias":
      case "scalar":
      case "double-quoted-scalar":
      case "single-quoted-scalar":
        if (key.source.includes("\n"))
          return true;
        if (key.end) {
          for (const st of key.end)
            if (st.type === "newline")
              return true;
        }
        return false;
      case "flow-collection":
        for (const it of key.items) {
          for (const st of it.start)
            if (st.type === "newline")
              return true;
          if (it.sep) {
            for (const st of it.sep)
              if (st.type === "newline")
                return true;
          }
          if (containsNewline(it.key) || containsNewline(it.value))
            return true;
        }
        return false;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  }
  utilContainsNewline.containsNewline = containsNewline;
  return utilContainsNewline;
}

  function doubleQuotedValue(source, onError) {
