      }
      this.atEnd = !incomplete;
      let next = this.next ?? "stream";
      while (next && (incomplete || this.hasChars(1)))
        next = yield* this.parseNext(next);
    }
    atLineEnd() {
      let i = this.pos;
      let ch = this.buffer[i];
      while (ch === " " || ch === "	")
        ch = this.buffer[++i];
      if (!ch || ch === "#" || ch === "\n")
        return true;
      if (ch === "\r")
        return this.buffer[i + 1] === "\n";
      return false;
    }
    charAt(n) {
      return this.buffer[this.pos + n];
    }
    continueScalar(offset) {
      let ch = this.buffer[offset];
      if (this.indentNext > 0) {
        let indent = 0;
        while (ch === " ")
          ch = this.buffer[++indent + offset];
        if (ch === "\r") {
          const next = this.buffer[indent + offset + 1];
          if (next === "\n" || !next && !this.atEnd)
            return offset + indent + 1;
        }
        return ch === "\n" || indent >= this.indentNext || !ch && !this.atEnd ? offset + indent : -1;
      }
      if (ch === "-" || ch === ".") {
        const dt = this.buffer.substr(offset, 3);
        if ((dt === "---" || dt === "...") && isEmpty(this.buffer[offset + 3]))
          return -1;
      }
      return offset;
    }
    getLine() {
      let end = this.lineEndPos;
      if (typeof end !== "number" || end !== -1 && end < this.pos) {
        end = this.buffer.indexOf("\n", this.pos);
        this.lineEndPos = end;
      }
      if (end === -1)
        return this.atEnd ? this.buffer.substring(this.pos) : null;
      if (this.buffer[end - 1] === "\r")
        end -= 1;
      return this.buffer.substring(this.pos, end);
    }
    hasChars(n) {
      return this.pos + n <= this.buffer.length;
    }
    setNext(state) {
      this.buffer = this.buffer.substring(this.pos);
      this.pos = 0;
      this.lineEndPos = null;
      this.next = state;
      return null;
    }
    peek(n) {
      return this.buffer.substr(this.pos, n);
    }
    *parseNext(next) {
      switch (next) {
        case "stream":
          return yield* this.parseStream();
        case "line-start":
          return yield* this.parseLineStart();
        case "block-start":
          return yield* this.parseBlockStart();
        case "doc":
          return yield* this.parseDocument();
        case "flow":
          return yield* this.parseFlowCollection();
        case "quoted-scalar":
          return yield* this.parseQuotedScalar();
        case "block-scalar":
          return yield* this.parseBlockScalar();
        case "plain-scalar":
          return yield* this.parsePlainScalar();
      }
    }
    *parseStream() {
      let line2 = this.getLine();
      if (line2 === null)
        return this.setNext("stream");
      if (line2[0] === cst2.BOM) {
        yield* this.pushCount(1);
        line2 = line2.substring(1);
      }
      if (line2[0] === "%") {
        let dirEnd = line2.length;
        let cs = line2.indexOf("#");
        while (cs !== -1) {
          const ch = line2[cs - 1];
          if (ch === " " || ch === "	") {
            dirEnd = cs - 1;
            break;
          } else {
            cs = line2.indexOf("#", cs + 1);
          }
        }
        while (true) {
          const ch = line2[dirEnd - 1];
          if (ch === " " || ch === "	")
            dirEnd -= 1;
          else
            break;
        }
        const n = (yield* this.pushCount(dirEnd)) + (yield* this.pushSpaces(true));
        yield* this.pushCount(line2.length - n);
        this.pushNewline();
        return "stream";
      }
      if (this.atLineEnd()) {
        const sp = yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
        yield* this.pushCount(line2.length - sp);
        yield* this.pushNewline();
        return "stream";
      }
      yield cst2.DOCUMENT;
      return yield* this.parseLineStart();
    }
    *parseLineStart() {
      const ch = this.charAt(0);
      if (!ch && !this.atEnd)
        return this.setNext("line-start");
      if (ch === "-" || ch === ".") {
        if (!this.atEnd && !this.hasChars(4))
          return this.setNext("line-start");
        const s = this.peek(3);
        if ((s === "---" || s === "...") && isEmpty(this.charAt(3))) {
          yield* this.pushCount(3);
          this.indentValue = 0;
          this.indentNext = 0;
          return s === "---" ? "doc" : "stream";
        }
      }
      this.indentValue = yield* this.pushSpaces(false);
      if (this.indentNext > this.indentValue && !isEmpty(this.charAt(1)))
        this.indentNext = this.indentValue;
      return yield* this.parseBlockStart();
    }
    *parseBlockStart() {
      const [ch0, ch1] = this.peek(2);
      if (!ch1 && !this.atEnd)
        return this.setNext("block-start");
      if ((ch0 === "-" || ch0 === "?" || ch0 === ":") && isEmpty(ch1)) {
        const n = (yield* this.pushCount(1)) + (yield* this.pushSpaces(true));
        this.indentNext = this.indentValue + 1;
        this.indentValue += n;
        return "block-start";
      }
      return "doc";
    }
    *parseDocument() {
      yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
      const line2 = this.getLine();
      if (line2 === null)
        return this.setNext("doc");
      let n = yield* this.pushIndicators();
      switch (line2[n]) {
        case "#":
          yield* this.pushCount(line2.length - n);
        // fallthrough
        case void 0:
          yield* this.pushNewline();
          return yield* this.parseLineStart();
        case "{":
        case "[":
          yield* this.pushCount(1);
          this.flowKey = false;
          this.flowLevel = 1;
          return "flow";
        case "}":
        case "]":
          yield* this.pushCount(1);
          return "doc";
        case "*":
          yield* this.pushUntil(isNotAnchorChar);
          return "doc";
        case '"':
        case "'":
          return yield* this.parseQuotedScalar();
        case "|":
        case ">":
          n += yield* this.parseBlockScalarHeader();
          n += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
          yield* this.pushCount(line2.length - n);
          yield* this.pushNewline();
          return yield* this.parseBlockScalar();
        default:
          return yield* this.parsePlainScalar();
      }
    }
    *parseFlowCollection() {
      let nl, sp;
      let indent = -1;
      do {
        nl = yield* this.pushNewline();
        if (nl > 0) {
          sp = yield* this.pushSpaces(false);
          this.indentValue = indent = sp;
        } else {
          sp = 0;
        }
        sp += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
      } while (nl + sp > 0);
      const line2 = this.getLine();
      if (line2 === null)
        return this.setNext("flow");
      if (indent !== -1 && indent < this.indentNext && line2[0] !== "#" || indent === 0 && (line2.startsWith("---") || line2.startsWith("...")) && isEmpty(line2[3])) {
        const atFlowEndMarker = indent === this.indentNext - 1 && this.flowLevel === 1 && (line2[0] === "]" || line2[0] === "}");
        if (!atFlowEndMarker) {
          this.flowLevel = 0;
          yield cst2.FLOW_END;
          return yield* this.parseLineStart();
        }
      }
      let n = 0;
      while (line2[n] === ",") {
        n += yield* this.pushCount(1);
        n += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
        this.flowKey = false;
      }
      n += yield* this.pushIndicators();
      switch (line2[n]) {
        case void 0:
          return "flow";
        case "#":
          yield* this.pushCount(line2.length - n);
          return "flow";
        case "{":
        case "[":
          yield* this.pushCount(1);
          this.flowKey = false;
          this.flowLevel += 1;
          return "flow";
        case "}":
        case "]":
          yield* this.pushCount(1);
          this.flowKey = true;
          this.flowLevel -= 1;
          return this.flowLevel ? "flow" : "doc";
        case "*":
          yield* this.pushUntil(isNotAnchorChar);
          return "flow";
        case '"':
        case "'":
          this.flowKey = true;
          return yield* this.parseQuotedScalar();
        case ":": {
          const next = this.charAt(1);
          if (this.flowKey || isEmpty(next) || next === ",") {
            this.flowKey = false;
            yield* this.pushCount(1);
            yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
            return "flow";
          }
        }
        // fallthrough
        default:
          this.flowKey = false;
          return yield* this.parsePlainScalar();
      }
    }
    *parseQuotedScalar() {
      const quote = this.charAt(0);
      let end = this.buffer.indexOf(quote, this.pos + 1);
      if (quote === "'") {
        while (end !== -1 && this.buffer[end + 1] === "'")
          end = this.buffer.indexOf("'", end + 2);
      } else {
        while (end !== -1) {
          let n = 0;
          while (this.buffer[end - 1 - n] === "\\")
            n += 1;
          if (n % 2 === 0)
            break;
          end = this.buffer.indexOf('"', end + 1);
        }
      }
      const qb = this.buffer.substring(0, end);
      let nl = qb.indexOf("\n", this.pos);
      if (nl !== -1) {
        while (nl !== -1) {
          const cs = this.continueScalar(nl + 1);
          if (cs === -1)
            break;
          nl = qb.indexOf("\n", cs);
        }
        if (nl !== -1) {
          end = nl - (qb[nl - 1] === "\r" ? 2 : 1);
        }
      }
      if (end === -1) {
        if (!this.atEnd)
          return this.setNext("quoted-scalar");
        end = this.buffer.length;
      }
      yield* this.pushToIndex(end + 1, false);
      return this.flowLevel ? "flow" : "doc";
    }
    *parseBlockScalarHeader() {
      this.blockScalarIndent = -1;
      this.blockScalarKeep = false;
      let i = this.pos;
      while (true) {
        const ch = this.buffer[++i];
        if (ch === "+")
          this.blockScalarKeep = true;
        else if (ch > "0" && ch <= "9")
          this.blockScalarIndent = Number(ch) - 1;
        else if (ch !== "-")
          break;
      }
      return yield* this.pushUntil((ch) => isEmpty(ch) || ch === "#");
    }
    *parseBlockScalar() {
      let nl = this.pos - 1;
      let indent = 0;
      let ch;
      loop: for (let i2 = this.pos; ch = this.buffer[i2]; ++i2) {
        switch (ch) {
          case " ":
            indent += 1;
            break;
          case "\n":
            nl = i2;
            indent = 0;
            break;
          case "\r": {
            const next = this.buffer[i2 + 1];
            if (!next && !this.atEnd)
              return this.setNext("block-scalar");
            if (next === "\n")
              break;
          }
          // fallthrough
          default:
            break loop;
        }
      }
      if (!ch && !this.atEnd)
        return this.setNext("block-scalar");
      if (indent >= this.indentNext) {
        if (this.blockScalarIndent === -1)
          this.indentNext = indent;
        else {
          this.indentNext = this.blockScalarIndent + (this.indentNext === 0 ? 1 : this.indentNext);
        }
        do {
          const cs = this.continueScalar(nl + 1);
          if (cs === -1)
            break;
          nl = this.buffer.indexOf("\n", cs);
        } while (nl !== -1);
        if (nl === -1) {
          if (!this.atEnd)
            return this.setNext("block-scalar");
          nl = this.buffer.length;
        }
      }
      let i = nl + 1;
      ch = this.buffer[i];
      while (ch === " ")
        ch = this.buffer[++i];
      if (ch === "	") {
        while (ch === "	" || ch === " " || ch === "\r" || ch === "\n")
          ch = this.buffer[++i];
        nl = i - 1;
      } else if (!this.blockScalarKeep) {
        do {
          let i2 = nl - 1;
          let ch2 = this.buffer[i2];
          if (ch2 === "\r")
            ch2 = this.buffer[--i2];
          const lastChar = i2;
          while (ch2 === " ")
            ch2 = this.buffer[--i2];
          if (ch2 === "\n" && i2 >= this.pos && i2 + 1 + indent > lastChar)
            nl = i2;
          else
            break;
        } while (true);
      }
      yield cst2.SCALAR;
      yield* this.pushToIndex(nl + 1, true);
      return yield* this.parseLineStart();
    }
    *parsePlainScalar() {
      const inFlow = this.flowLevel > 0;
      let end = this.pos - 1;
      let i = this.pos - 1;
      let ch;
      while (ch = this.buffer[++i]) {
        if (ch === ":") {
          const next = this.buffer[i + 1];
          if (isEmpty(next) || inFlow && flowIndicatorChars.has(next))
            break;
          end = i;
        } else if (isEmpty(ch)) {
          let next = this.buffer[i + 1];
          if (ch === "\r") {
            if (next === "\n") {
              i += 1;
              ch = "\n";
              next = this.buffer[i + 1];
            } else
              end = i;
          }
          if (next === "#" || inFlow && flowIndicatorChars.has(next))
            break;
          if (ch === "\n") {
            const cs = this.continueScalar(i + 1);
            if (cs === -1)
              break;
            i = Math.max(i, cs - 2);
          }
        } else {
          if (inFlow && flowIndicatorChars.has(ch))
            break;
          end = i;
        }
      }
      if (!ch && !this.atEnd)
        return this.setNext("plain-scalar");
      yield cst2.SCALAR;
      yield* this.pushToIndex(end + 1, true);
      return inFlow ? "flow" : "doc";
    }
    *pushCount(n) {
      if (n > 0) {
        yield this.buffer.substr(this.pos, n);
        this.pos += n;
        return n;
      }
      return 0;
    }
    *pushToIndex(i, allowEmpty) {
      const s = this.buffer.slice(this.pos, i);
      if (s) {
        yield s;
        this.pos += s.length;
        return s.length;
      } else if (allowEmpty)
        yield "";
      return 0;
    }
    *pushIndicators() {
      let n = 0;
      loop: while (true) {
        switch (this.charAt(0)) {
          case "!":
            n += yield* this.pushTag();
            n += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
            continue loop;
          case "&":
            n += yield* this.pushUntil(isNotAnchorChar);
            n += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
            continue loop;
          case "-":
          // this is an error
          case "?":
          // this is an error outside flow collections
          case ":": {
            const inFlow = this.flowLevel > 0;
            const ch1 = this.charAt(1);
            if (isEmpty(ch1) || inFlow && flowIndicatorChars.has(ch1)) {
              if (!inFlow)
                this.indentNext = this.indentValue + 1;
              else if (this.flowKey)
                this.flowKey = false;
              n += yield* this.pushCount(1);
              n += yield* this.pushSpaces(true);
              continue loop;
            }
          }
        }
        break loop;
      }
      return n;
    }
    *pushTag() {
      if (this.charAt(1) === "<") {
        let i = this.pos + 2;
        let ch = this.buffer[i];
        while (!isEmpty(ch) && ch !== ">")
          ch = this.buffer[++i];
        return yield* this.pushToIndex(ch === ">" ? i + 1 : i, false);
      } else {
        let i = this.pos + 1;
        let ch = this.buffer[i];
        while (ch) {
          if (tagChars.has(ch))
            ch = this.buffer[++i];
          else if (ch === "%" && hexDigits.has(this.buffer[i + 1]) && hexDigits.has(this.buffer[i + 2])) {
            ch = this.buffer[i += 3];
          } else
            break;
        }
        return yield* this.pushToIndex(i, false);
      }
    }
    *pushNewline() {
      const ch = this.buffer[this.pos];
      if (ch === "\n")
        return yield* this.pushCount(1);
      else if (ch === "\r" && this.charAt(1) === "\n")
        return yield* this.pushCount(2);
      else
        return 0;
    }
    *pushSpaces(allowTabs) {
      let i = this.pos - 1;
      let ch;
      do {
        ch = this.buffer[++i];
      } while (ch === " " || allowTabs && ch === "	");
      const n = i - this.pos;
      if (n > 0) {
        yield this.buffer.substr(this.pos, n);
        this.pos = i;
      }
      return n;
    }
    *pushUntil(test) {
      let i = this.pos;
      let ch = this.buffer[i];
      while (!test(ch))
        ch = this.buffer[++i];
      return yield* this.pushToIndex(i, false);
    }
  }
  lexer.Lexer = Lexer;
  return lexer;
}
var lineCounter = {};
var hasRequiredLineCounter;
function requireLineCounter() {
  if (hasRequiredLineCounter) return lineCounter;
  hasRequiredLineCounter = 1;
  class LineCounter {
    constructor() {
      this.lineStarts = [];
      this.addNewLine = (offset) => this.lineStarts.push(offset);
      this.linePos = (offset) => {
        let low = 0;
        let high = this.lineStarts.length;
        while (low < high) {
          const mid = low + high >> 1;
          if (this.lineStarts[mid] < offset)
            low = mid + 1;
          else
            high = mid;
        }
        if (this.lineStarts[low] === offset)
          return { line: low + 1, col: 1 };
        if (low === 0)
          return { line: 0, col: offset };
        const start = this.lineStarts[low - 1];
        return { line: low, col: offset - start + 1 };
      };
    }
  }
  lineCounter.LineCounter = LineCounter;
  return lineCounter;
}
var parser = {};
var hasRequiredParser;
function requireParser() {
  if (hasRequiredParser) return parser;
  hasRequiredParser = 1;
  var node_process = require$$0;
  var cst2 = requireCst();
  var lexer2 = requireLexer();
  function includesToken(list, type) {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; ++i)
      if (list[i].type === type)
        return true;
    return false;
  }
  function findNonEmptyIndex(list) {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; ++i) {
      switch (list[i].type) {
        case "space":
        case "comment":
        case "newline":
          break;
        default:
          return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }
  function isFlowToken(token) {
    switch (token?.type) {
      case "alias":
      case "scalar":
      case "single-quoted-scalar":
      case "double-quoted-scalar":
      case "flow-collection":
        return true;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }
  function getPrevProps(parent) {
    switch (parent.type) {
      case "document":
        return parent.start;
      case "block-map": {
        const it = parent.items[parent.items.length - 1];
        return it.sep ?? it.start;
      }
      case "block-seq":
        return parent.items[parent.items.length - 1].start;
      /* istanbul ignore next should not happen */
      default:
        return [];
    }
  }
  function getFirstKeyStartProps(prev) {
    if (prev.length === 0)
      return [];
    let i = prev.length;
    loop: while (--i >= 0) {
      switch (prev[i].type) {
        case "doc-start":
        case "explicit-key-ind":
        case "map-value-ind":
        case "seq-item-ind":
        case "newline":
          break loop;
      }
    }
    while (prev[++i]?.type === "space") {
    }
    return prev.splice(i, prev.length);
  }
  function arrayPushArray(target, source) {
    if (source.length < 1e5)
      Array.prototype.push.apply(target, source);
    else
      for (let i = 0; i < source.length; ++i)
        target.push(source[i]);
  }
  function fixFlowSeqItems(fc) {
    if (fc.start.type === "flow-seq-start") {
      for (const it of fc.items) {
        if (it.sep && !it.value && !includesToken(it.start, "explicit-key-ind") && !includesToken(it.sep, "map-value-ind")) {
          if (it.key)
            it.value = it.key;
          delete it.key;
          if (isFlowToken(it.value)) {
            if (it.value.end)
              arrayPushArray(it.value.end, it.sep);
            else
              it.value.end = it.sep;
          } else
            arrayPushArray(it.start, it.sep);
          delete it.sep;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  class Parser {
    /**
     * @param onNewLine - If defined, called separately with the start position of
     *   each new line (in `parse()`, including the start of input).
     */
    constructor(onNewLine) {
      this.atNewLine = true;
      this.atScalar = false;
      this.indent = 0;
      this.offset = 0;
      this.onKeyLine = false;
      this.stack = [];
      this.source = "";
      this.type = "";
      this.lexer = new lexer2.Lexer();
      this.onNewLine = onNewLine;
    }
    /**
     * Parse `source` as a YAML stream.
     * If `incomplete`, a part of the last line may be left as a buffer for the next call.
     *
     * Errors are not thrown, but yielded as `{ type: 'error', message }` tokens.
     *
     * @returns A generator of tokens representing each directive, document, and other structure.
     */
    *parse(source, incomplete = false) {
      if (this.onNewLine && this.offset === 0)
        this.onNewLine(0);
      for (const lexeme of this.lexer.lex(source, incomplete))
        yield* this.next(lexeme);
      if (!incomplete)
        yield* this.end();
    }
    /**
     * Advance the parser by the `source` of one lexical token.
     */
    *next(source) {
      this.source = source;
      if (node_process.env.LOG_TOKENS)
        console.log("|", cst2.prettyToken(source));
      if (this.atScalar) {
        this.atScalar = false;
        yield* this.step();
        this.offset += source.length;
        return;
      }
      const type = cst2.tokenType(source);
      if (!type) {
        const message = `Not a YAML token: ${source}`;
        yield* this.pop({ type: "error", offset: this.offset, message, source });
        this.offset += source.length;
      } else if (type === "scalar") {
        this.atNewLine = false;
        this.atScalar = true;
        this.type = "scalar";
      } else {
        this.type = type;
        yield* this.step();
        switch (type) {
          case "newline":
            this.atNewLine = true;
            this.indent = 0;
            if (this.onNewLine)
              this.onNewLine(this.offset + source.length);
            break;
          case "space":
            if (this.atNewLine && source[0] === " ")
              this.indent += source.length;
            break;
          case "explicit-key-ind":
          case "map-value-ind":
          case "seq-item-ind":
            if (this.atNewLine)
              this.indent += source.length;
            break;
          case "doc-mode":
          case "flow-error-end":
            return;
          default:
            this.atNewLine = false;
        }
        this.offset += source.length;
      }
    }
    /** Call at end of input to push out any remaining constructions */
    *end() {
      while (this.stack.length > 0)
        yield* this.pop();
    }
    get sourceToken() {
      const st = {
        type: this.type,
        offset: this.offset,
        indent: this.indent,
        source: this.source
      };
      return st;
    }
    *step() {
      const top = this.peek(1);
      if (this.type === "doc-end" && top?.type !== "doc-end") {
        while (this.stack.length > 0)
          yield* this.pop();
        this.stack.push({
          type: "doc-end",
          offset: this.offset,
          source: this.source
        });
        return;
      }
      if (!top)
        return yield* this.stream();
      switch (top.type) {
        case "document":
          return yield* this.document(top);
        case "alias":
        case "scalar":
        case "single-quoted-scalar":
        case "double-quoted-scalar":
          return yield* this.scalar(top);
        case "block-scalar":
          return yield* this.blockScalar(top);

      return this.stack[this.stack.length - n];

          fixFlowSeqItems(token);

            break;
          case "block-scalar":
            top.props.push(token);
            break;
          case "block-map": {
            const it = top.items[top.items.length - 1];
            if (it.value) {
              top.items.push({ start: [], key: token, sep: [] });
              this.onKeyLine = true;
              return;
            } else if (it.sep) {
              it.value = token;
            } else {
              Object.assign(it, { key: token, sep: [] });
              this.onKeyLine = !it.explicitKey;
              return;
            }
            break;
          }
          case "block-seq": {
            const it = top.items[top.items.length - 1];
            if (it.value)
              top.items.push({ start: [], value: token });
            else

            break;
          }
          case "flow-collection": {
            const it = top.items[top.items.length - 1];
            if (!it || it.value)
              top.items.push({ start: [], key: token, sep: [] });
            else if (it.sep)
              it.value = token;
            else
              Object.assign(it, { key: token, sep: [] });
            return;
          }
          /* istanbul ignore next should not happen */
          default:
            yield* this.pop();
            yield* this.pop(token);
        }
        if ((top.type === "document" || top.type === "block-map" || top.type === "block-seq") && (token.type === "block-map" || token.type === "block-seq")) {
          const last = token.items[token.items.length - 1];
          if (last && !last.sep && !last.value && last.start.length > 0 && findNonEmptyIndex(last.start) === -1 && (token.indent === 0 || last.start.every((st) => st.type !== "comment" || st.indent < token.indent))) {

              top.end = last.start;
            else
              top.items.push({ start: last.start });
            token.items.splice(-1, 1);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    *stream() {
      switch (this.type) {
        case "directive-line":
          yield { type: "directive", offset: this.offset, source: this.source };

        case "newline":

            doc.start.push(this.sourceToken);
          this.stack.push(doc);
          return;
        }
      }
      yield {
        type: "error",
        offset: this.offset,
        message: `Unexpected ${this.type} token in YAML stream`,
        source: this.source

    }

      if (doc.value)
        return yield* this.lineEnd(doc);
      switch (this.type) {
        case "doc-start": {
          if (findNonEmptyIndex(doc.start) !== -1) {
            yield* this.pop();

          } else

          return;
        }

        case "tag":
        case "space":
        case "comment":
        case "newline":
          doc.start.push(this.sourceToken);
          return;

      if (bv)

          offset: this.offset,

          source: this.source
        };
      }
    }

      if (this.type === "map-value-ind") {

          break;
        /* istanbul ignore next should not happen */
        default:
          yield* this.pop();
          yield* this.step();

class GitHubReadError extends Error {

function lastPageOf(link) {
  const last = /<[^>]*[?&]page=(\d+)[^>]*>;\s*rel="last"/.exec(link ?? "");

function githubEndpointShape(path2) {
  const [route, query] = path2.split("?");
  const shape = route.replace(/^\/repos\/[^/]+\/[^/]+/, "/repos/{repo}").replace(/\/[0-9a-f]{40}(?=\/|$)/g, "/{sha}").replace(/\/compare\/[^/]+$/, "/compare/{range}").replace(/\/contents\/.*$/, "/contents/{path}").replace(/\/\d+(?=\/|$)/g, "/{n}");
  const keys = query ? [...new URLSearchParams(query).keys()].filter((key) => key !== "per_page" && key !== "page") : [];
  return `${shape}${keys.length ? `?${keys.join("&")}` : ""}`;
}

    for (const kind of kinds) {

  };

      try {

          redirect: "error",

          headers: {
            Accept: "application/vnd.github+json",
            Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}`,
            "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",

          }

      if (Number.isFinite(quota) && quota > 0) limit.limit = quota;

      }

        if (response.status === 429 || remaining === 0 || Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 || typeof reason === "string" && /rate limit/i.test(reason)) {
          const until = Math.max(
            now + 6e4,
            remaining === 0 && reset ? reset : 0,
            Number.isFinite(retryAfter) ? now + retryAfter * 1e3 : 0
          );
          limit.pausedUntil = Math.min(until, now + 60 * 6e4);
          throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub rate limit reached; waiting before retrying", 429, limit.pausedUntil);
        }

        throw new GitHubReadError(
          `GitHub denied access. The token needs read access to this repository.${typeof reason === "string" && reason ? ` (${reason.slice(0, 120)})` : ""}`,
          403,
          void 0,
          // A fine-grained token without this repository says so; anything else (single sign-on,
          // an IP allow list) is left to the person.
          typeof reason === "string" && /not accessible by personal access token/i.test(reason) ? true : void 0
        );
      }
      if (response.status === 401) throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub rejected the token. Reconnect GitHub in Settings.", 401);
      if (response.status === 404) throw new GitHubReadError("Not found, or the token cannot read this repository", 404);
      if (!response.ok) throw new GitHubReadError(`GitHub responded with ${response.status}`, response.status);

      if (etag && etag.length < 200 && getOptions.cache !== false) {
        cache.delete(url.href);
        cache.set(url.href, { etag, body, last: lastPageOf(response.headers.get("link")) });
        if (cache.size > (options.cacheEntries ?? 500)) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
      }
      getOptions.pages?.(lastPageOf(response.headers.get("link")));

    } finally {
      release();
    }
  }

  async function query(document, variables) {

      throw new GitHubReadError("Only GraphQL queries are supported", 0);

          redirect: "error",
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(options.timeoutMs ?? 15e3),
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
            Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": "Blume-Deliveries"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ query: document, variables })
        });
      } catch {
        throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub could not be reached", 0);
      }

      const pause = () => {
        graphPausedUntil = Math.min(Math.max(now + 6e4, Number.isFinite(reset) ? reset : 0), now + 60 * 6e4);

      };
      if (response.status === 401) throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub rejected the token. Reconnect GitHub in Settings.", 401);
      if (response.status === 429 || response.status === 403 && (response.headers.get("x-ratelimit-remaining") === "0" || response.headers.has("retry-after")))
        throw pause();
      if (response.status === 403) throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub denied the GraphQL read. The token needs read access to this repository.", 403);
      if (!response.ok) throw new GitHubReadError(`GitHub responded with ${response.status}`, response.status);
      const bodyText = await response.text();
      if (bodyText.length > 1024 * 1024) throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub response is too large", 413);
      let body;
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(bodyText);
      } catch {
        throw new GitHubReadError("GitHub returned an unreadable response", 502);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(body.errors) && body.errors.length) {
        if (body.errors.some((error) => error?.type === "RATE_LIMITED")) throw pause();
        const reason = typeof body.errors[0]?.message === "string" ? body.errors[0].message.slice(0, 120) : "";
        throw new GitHubReadError(`GitHub could not answer the query${reason ? ` (${reason})` : ""}`, 502);
      }
      return body.data;
    } finally {
      release();
    }
  }
  return {
    get,
    query,
    rateLimit: () => ({ ...limit }),
    usage: () => ({
      ...usage,
      endpoints: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(usage.endpoints).map(([key, counts]) => [key, { ...counts }]))
    })
  };
}
const PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS = {
  /** The description kept, in UTF-8 bytes. */
  bodyBytes: 64 * 1024,
  /** GitHub lists at most 3,000 files of a pull request, 100 a page. */
  files: 3e3,
  filesPerPage: 100,
  /** One file's patch kept, and all of a pull request's patches together, in UTF-8 bytes. */
  patchBytes: 1024 * 1024,
  patchesBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024,
  /** One page of files can carry large patches: past the reader's usual 4 MiB. */
  pageBytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
  /** Its reviews and comments together, newest kept; one comment at most. */
  conversationBytes: 256 * 1024,
  commentBytes: 64 * 1024,
  /** Pages of each conversation list read (100 entries a page). */
  conversationPages: 10
};
const SHA = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
function utf8Bytes(value) {
  let bytes = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
    const code = value.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code < 128) bytes += 1;
    else if (code < 2048) bytes += 2;
    else if (code >= 55296 && code <= 56319 && i + 1 < value.length && (value.charCodeAt(i + 1) & 64512) === 56320) {
      bytes += 4;
      i++;
    } else bytes += 3;
  }
  return bytes;
}
function capUtf8(value, bytes) {
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(value);
  if (encoded.byteLength <= bytes) return { text: value, truncated: false };
  let end = bytes;
  while (end > 0 && (encoded[end] & 192) === 128) end--;
  return { text: new TextDecoder().decode(encoded.subarray(0, end)), truncated: true };
}
function mapPullRequestBody(pull) {
  const raw = typeof pull?.body === "string" ? pull.body : "";
  const { text: text2, truncated } = capUtf8(raw, PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS.bodyBytes);
  return { body: text2, ...truncated ? { bodyTruncated: true } : {} };
}
const STATUS = {
  added: "added",
  copied: "added",
  removed: "removed",
  renamed: "renamed",
  modified: "modified",
  changed: "modified",
  unchanged: "modified"
};
const count = (value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0 ? value : 0;
const path = (value) => typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 ? value.slice(0, 4096) : void 0;
function mapPullRequestFile(raw) {
  const filename = path(raw?.filename);
  if (!filename) return void 0;
  const status = STATUS[String(raw.status ?? "")] ?? "modified";
  const added = count(raw.additions);
  const removed = count(raw.deletions);
  const moved = raw.status === "renamed" || raw.status === "copied";
  const previous = moved ? path(raw.previous_filename) : void 0;
  const patch = typeof raw.patch === "string" ? raw.patch : void 0;
  const lines = added + removed;
  const patchMissing = patch !== void 0 ? void 0 : lines > 0 ? "too-large" : moved ? void 0 : "binary";
  return {
    path: filename,
    status,
    added,
    removed,
    ...previous && previous !== filename ? { previousPath: previous } : {},
    ...patch !== void 0 ? { patch } : {},
    ...patchMissing ? { patchMissing } : {}
  };
}
function createPullRequestFilesMapper() {
  const files = [];
  let budget = PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS.patchesBytes;
  let cut = false;
  return {
    add(page) {
      for (const raw of page) {
        if (files.length >= PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS.files) return;
        const file = mapPullRequestFile(raw);
        if (!file) continue;
        if (file.patch !== void 0) {
          const size = utf8Bytes(file.patch);
          if (size > PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS.patchBytes || size > budget) {
            delete file.patch;
            file.patchMissing = "too-large";
            cut = true;
          } else budget -= size;
        }
        files.push(file);
      }
    },
    result: () => ({ files, cut })
  };
}
async function readPullRequestContentParts(reader, target, now, known) {
  const base = `/repos/${target.owner}/${target.repo}/pulls/${target.number}`;
  const revisionOf = (raw) => {
    const headSha = String(raw?.head?.sha ?? "").toLowerCase();
    if (!SHA.test(headSha)) throw new GitHubReadError("Pull request has no head commit", 502);
    const baseSha = String(raw?.base?.sha ?? "").toLowerCase();
    const baseBranch = typeof raw?.base?.ref === "string" ? raw.base.ref.slice(0, 200) : "";
    return { headSha, ...SHA.test(baseSha) ? { baseSha } : {}, ...baseBranch ? { baseBranch } : {} };
  };
  const same = (a, b) => a.headSha === b.headSha && a.baseSha === b.baseSha && a.baseBranch === b.baseBranch;
  let pull = await reader.get(base);
  let revision = revisionOf(pull);
  let diff;
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    if (known?.files && same(revision, known)) {
      diff = { files: known.files, changedFiles: known.changedFiles ?? known.files.length, ...known.truncated ? { truncated: true } : {} };
      break;
    }
    diff = await readPullRequestFiles(reader, base, pull);
    const after = await reader.get(base);
    const moved = revisionOf(after);
    pull = after;
    if (same(moved, revision)) break;
    if (attempt > 0) throw new GitHubReadError("The pull request kept moving while Blume read its diff; open it again", 409);
    revision = moved;
  }
  const notes = [];
  let conversation;
  let conversationRead = false;
  try {
    conversation = await readPullRequestConversation(reader, target);
    conversationRead = true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof GitHubReadError && (error.status === 401 || error.status === 429)) throw error;
    const reason = error instanceof GitHubReadError ? error.message : "GitHub could not be read";
    conversation = known?.conversation;
    notes.push(conversation ? `Showing the conversation as last read; it could not be read again: ${reason}` : `The conversation could not be read: ${reason}`);
  }
  const updated = Date.parse(String(pull.updated_at ?? ""));
  return {
    conversationRead,
    content: {
      status: "ready",
      pullRequestUrl: target.url,
      ...revision,
      ...mapPullRequestBody(pull),
      ...diff,
      ...conversation ? { conversation } : {},
      ...Number.isFinite(updated) ? { updatedAt: updated } : {},
      ...notes.length ? { message: notes.join(" ").slice(0, 300) } : {},
      fetchedAt: now()
    }
  };
}
async function readPullRequestFiles(reader, base, pull) {
  const changed = Number.isSafeInteger(pull.changed_files) ? pull.changed_files : void 0;
  const { filesPerPage, files: maxFiles, pageBytes } = PULL_REQUEST_CONTENT_LIMITS;
  const mapper = createPullRequestFilesMapper();
  let listed = 0;
  for (let page = 1; listed < maxFiles; page++) {
    if (changed !== void 0 && listed >= changed) break;
    const items = await reader.get(`${base}/files?per_page=${filesPerPage}&page=${page}`, { maxBytes: pageBytes, cache: false });
    const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
    mapper.add(list);
    listed += list.length;
    if (list.length < filesPerPage) break;
  }
  const { files, cut } = mapper.result();
  const total = changed ?? files.length;
  return { files, changedFiles: total, ...cut || files.length < total ? { truncated: true } : {} };
}
const listOf = (value) => Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
async function readNewestPages(reader, path2, maxPages) {
  let last = 1;
  const first = listOf(await reader.get(`${path2}?per_page=100&page=1`, { pages: (page) => last = page }));
  if (last <= 1) return { items: first, more: false };
  const newest = Math.max(2, last - maxPages + 1);
  const items = [];
  for (let page = last; page >= newest; page--) items.push(...listOf(await reader.get(`${path2}?per_page=100&page=${page}`)));
  return last <= maxPages ? { items: [...first, ...items], more: false } : { items, more: true };
}
async function readNewestFirst(reader, path2, maxPages) {
  const items = [];
  for (let page = 1; page <= maxPages; page++) {
    const entries = listOf(await reader.get(`${path2}?sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=100&page=${page}`));
    items.push(...entries);
    if (entries.length < 100) return { items, more: false };
  }
  return { items, more: true };
}

function mapPullRequestLineComment(raw) {
  const id = Number.isSafeInteger(raw?.id) ? raw.id : void 0;
  const file = path(raw?.path);
  const created = at(raw?.created_at);
  if (id === void 0 || !file || created === void 0) return void 0;

  const original = line(raw.original_line);

function createLatestOnlyLineQueue(run, onSuperseded, onRunError = () => void 0) {

  let closing = null;

  const gate = evidencePins.conversationGate(scope, registrations, skips, request.legacyRows);
  if (!request.fullPass || scope !== request.conversationScope)
    return { gate, scope, registrations, changed: false };
  const fingerprint = evidencePins.conversationGateFingerprint(scope, registrations, skips);
  const workspaces = JSON.stringify([
    [...skips?.repositories ?? []].sort(),
    request.legacyRows.map((row) => row.id).sort()
  ]);
  const shape = evidencePins.conversationGateFingerprint(scope, [], skips);
  const before = await store.getMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_META_KEY);
  const workspacesBefore = await store.getMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_WORKSPACES_META_KEY);
  const shapeBefore = await store.getMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_SHAPE_META_KEY);
  if (before === fingerprint && workspacesBefore === workspaces)
    return { gate, scope, registrations, changed: false };
  const startedAtMs = ports.now();
  const outside = before === fingerprint ? [] : evidencePins.conversationSourcesOutsideGate(gate, await store.listStoredSources());
  const removal = await forgetInBatches(store, outside, ports);
  const forgotten = removal.complete && workspacesBefore !== workspaces ? await store.listSourcesWithoutConversation() : [];
  const forgetting = removal.complete ? await forgetInBatches(store, forgotten, ports) : { complete: false };
  if (removal.complete && forgetting.complete) {
    await store.setMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_META_KEY, fingerprint);
    await store.setMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_WORKSPACES_META_KEY, workspaces);
    await store.setMeta(CONVERSATION_GATE_SHAPE_META_KEY, shape);
  }
  ports.onReconciled?.({
    scope,
    removedConversations: removal.removed,
    forgottenSources: forgotten.length,
    durationMs: ports.now() - startedAtMs
  });
  return {
    gate,
    scope,
    registrations,
    // The first check has nothing to compare with: the boot pass and the history parser read
    // everything anyway, so it must not widen the first pass to a week.
    changed: shapeBefore != null && (shapeBefore !== shape || workspacesBefore !== workspaces)
  };
}

async function refresh(input, performance, signal) {

    {

      fullPass: input.targetPaths === null

      shouldStop: () => signal.aborted,

        name: "main.parser.worker_gate_reconciled",

          forgotten_sources: result.forgottenSources,
          duration_ms: result.durationMs

        post({
          type: "telemetry",
          kind: "app-error",
          name: "main.parser.worker_meta",
          properties: { operation, key },
          errorMessage: errorMessage(error)
        });
      }
    }
  );

    getParserBinding,
    isWatcherReady: () => watcherReady,
    getKnownFiles: () => knownFiles,

        post({
          type: "telemetry",
          kind: "app-error",
          name,
          properties,
          errorMessage: errorMessage(error)
        });
      },
      captureEvent: (name, properties) => {
        post({ type: "telemetry", kind: "event", name, properties });
      }
    },
    readCursorComposerState: evidencePins.loadCursorComposerState,
    readCursorComposerRepoPath: evidencePins.loadCursorComposerRepoPath,

  });

    sourceCursors: {
      getSourceCursor: (kind, path) => storage.sourceCursors.getSourceCursor(kind, path),

      }
    }),
    now: () => Date.now()
  });

    conversations: {
      deleteConversationsBySourcePaths: (paths) => storage.desktopConversations.deleteConversationsBySourcePaths(paths),
      markStaleConversationsInactive: (cutoffMs) => storage.desktopConversations.markStaleConversationsInactive(cutoffMs)
    },
    isSelfRunPath: (path) => isSelfRunPath(input, path),
    ingestConversation: async (parsed) => {
      const seq = ingestSequence++;
      const startedAtMs = Date.now();
      let ok = false;
      let ingestError;
      try {
        if (await legacyExclusions.legacyExclusionExcludesConversation(
          {
            size: gate.exclusions,
            excludes: (workspace) => gate.excludesConversation(parsed.conv.source, parsed.sourcePath, workspace)
          },
          parsed.conv,
          (candidate) => observedWorkspaceIdentity.identifyWorkspace(candidate)
        )) {
          const version = evidencePins.sourceVersionFromParsed(parsed);
          await storage.sourceCursors.upsertSourceCursor({
            kind: parsed.conv.source,
            path: parsed.sourcePath,

          ok = true;

        const result = await ingestRuntime.ingestConversation(canonicalParsed);
        performance.parsed += 1;
        if (result && !result.skipped) performance.stored = (performance.stored ?? 0) + 1;
        ok = true;
        return result;
      } catch (error) {
        ingestError = errorMessage(error);
        throw error;
      } finally {
        const ingestMs = Date.now() - startedAtMs;
        performance.maxIngestMs = Math.max(performance.maxIngestMs, ingestMs);
        post({
          type: "refresh-progress",
          id: input.id,
          seq,
          sourcePath: parsed.sourcePath,
          ref: parsed.conv.ref,
          ingestMs,
          ok,
          errorMessage: ingestError
        });
      }
    },
    getMeta: meta.get,
    setMeta: meta.set,
    captureError: (name, error, context) => {
      post({
        type: "telemetry",
        kind: "app-error",
        name,
        properties: { ...context ?? {} },
        errorMessage: errorMessage(error)
      });
    },
    onIngestError: (error, context) => {
      post({
        type: "telemetry",
        kind: "app-error",
        name: "main.parser.worker_ingest",
        properties: context,
        errorMessage: errorMessage(error)
      });
    },
    track: async (_name, fn) => fn(),
    now: () => Date.now()
  });
  activeRefreshService = refreshService;
  const requestRefreshStop = () => refreshService.requestStop();
  signal.addEventListener("abort", requestRefreshStop, { once: true });
  if (signal.aborted) requestRefreshStop();
  let refreshError;
  try {
    await refreshService.refreshFromDisk(
      changed ? Math.max(
        input.maxAgeMs,
        typeof input.activityCutoffMs === "number" ? Date.now() - input.activityCutoffMs : evidencePins.CONVERSATION_WEEK_MS
      ) : input.maxAgeMs,
      {
        targetPaths: input.targetPaths ?? void 0
      }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    refreshError = error;
  } finally {
    signal.removeEventListener("abort", requestRefreshStop);
    if (activeRefreshService === refreshService) activeRefreshService = null;
  }
  await refreshRecentProjectSetupSummaries(input, storage, signal);
  if (refreshError) throw refreshError;
  const evidence = await resolveEvidence(input, storage, signal);
  return {
    registeredConversations: registrations.length,
    conversationScope: scope,
    oldestSourceMs,
    resolvedEvidence: evidence.resolved,
    evidencePinCursor: evidence.cursor
  };
}

async function handleMessage(message) {
  if (message.type === "stop") {
    activeRefreshService?.requestStop();
    activeRequestAbortController?.abort();
    return;
  }
  if (message.type === "menu-bar-snapshot") {
    await loadMenuBarSnapshot(message);
    return;
  }
  if (message.type === "evidence-location") {
    await locateConversationEvidence(message);
    return;
  }
  if (message.type === "recent-projects") {
    await listRecentProjects(message);
    return;
  }
  const performance = {
    parsed: 0,
    stored: 0,
    maxIngestMs: 0,
    durationMs: 0
  };
  if (activeRefreshId !== null) {
    post(
      serializeError(
        message.id,
        new Error("conversation refresh worker already has a refresh in flight"),
        performance
      )
    );
    return;
  }
  activeRefreshId = message.id;
  const requestAbortController = new AbortController();
  activeRequestAbortController = requestAbortController;
  const startedAtMs = Date.now();
  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
    post({ type: "heartbeat", id: message.id });
  }, CONVERSATION_REFRESH_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS);
  try {
    const outcome = await refresh(message, performance, requestAbortController.signal);
    performance.durationMs = Date.now() - startedAtMs;
    post({ type: "refresh-result", id: message.id, ok: true, ...performance, ...outcome });
  } catch (err) {
    performance.durationMs = Date.now() - startedAtMs;
    post(serializeError(message.id, err, performance));
  } finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeat);
    if (activeRequestAbortController === requestAbortController) {
      activeRequestAbortController = null;
    }
    activeRefreshId = null;
  }
}
parentPort?.on("message", (event) => {
  void handleMessage(event.data);
});

const desktopSearch = require("./desktopSearch-UUzZxN96.js");
function repositoryMatchKey(identity) {
  const value = identity?.trim();
  if (!value) return null;
  if (value.startsWith("file:")) {
    let path2 = value.replace(/^file:(\/\/)?/, "");
    try {
      const url2 = new URL(value);
      path2 = `${url2.hostname ? `//${url2.hostname}` : ""}${url2.pathname}`;
    } catch {
    }
    try {
      path2 = decodeURIComponent(path2);
    } catch {
    }
    if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(path2)) path2 = path2.slice(1);
    return folderKey(path2.startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(path2) ? path2 : `/${path2}`);
  }
  if (value.startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(value) || value.startsWith("\\\\"))
    return folderKey(value);
  let host;
  let path;
  const url = /^[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:\/\/(?:[^@/]*@)?([^/:]+)(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/i.exec(value);
  const scp = /^(?:[^@\s/]+@)?([^:/\s]+):(?!\/)(.+)$/.exec(value);
  const bare = /^([a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,})\/(.+)$/i.exec(value);
  if (url) [, host, path] = url;
  else if (scp) [, host, path] = scp;
  else if (bare) [, host, path] = bare;
  else return null;
  path = path.replace(/[?#].*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\.git$/i, "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
  if (!path) return null;
  return `git:${host.toLowerCase()}/${path.toLowerCase()}`;
}
function folderKey(path) {
  const normalized = desktopSearch.normalizePathSeparators(path).replace(/^[a-z]:/, (drive) => drive.toUpperCase()).replace(/^\/\/[^/]+/, (host) => {
    try {
      const canonical = new URL(`file:${host}/`).hostname;
      return canonical ? `//${canonical}` : "";
    } catch {
      return host.toLowerCase();
    }
  });
  return `path:${normalized.replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/"}`;
}
function windowsFolderMatchKey(identity) {
  const key = repositoryMatchKey(identity);
  return key && /^path:(?:[A-Z]:\/|\/\/)/.test(key) ? key.toLowerCase() : null;
}
exports.repositoryMatchKey = repositoryMatchKey;
exports.windowsFolderMatchKey = windowsFolderMatchKey;

function codexSubagentKind(source) {

function mapState(state) {

    case "running":

      return "idle";
  }

function latestTimestampMs(messages, toolCalls, fallback) {
  let latest = 0;

  for (const toolCall2 of toolCalls) {
    if (toolCall2.startedAtMs !== void 0 && toolCall2.startedAtMs > latest)
      latest = toolCall2.startedAtMs;
    if (toolCall2.endedAtMs !== void 0 && toolCall2.endedAtMs > latest) latest = toolCall2.endedAtMs;
  }
  return latest || fallback;
}

          result = node_child_process.spawnSync(
            options.binaryPath,
            [
              ...options.binaryArgs ?? [],
              "parse-run",
              "--input",
              materialized.path,
              "--harness",
              input.harnessId,
              "--version",
              input.formatVersion ?? options.defaultVersion ?? "family"
            ],
            // Large Codex/Claude sessions can emit parser JSON beyond Node's
            // child-process stdout buffer. Write stdout to disk and keep only
            // stderr buffered for diagnostics. windowsHide: the parser is a
            // console-subsystem exe; without it every parse flashes a console
            // window on Windows.
            {
              encoding: "utf8",
              stdio: ["ignore", outputFd, "pipe"],
              maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
              windowsHide: true
            }
          );
        } finally {
          fs.closeSync(outputFd);
        }
        if (result.error) throw result.error;
        if (result.status !== 0) {
          throw new Error(`harness-parser exited ${result.status}: ${result.stderr}`);
        }
        const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outputPath, "utf8"));
        return validateParsedConversation(input, mapParserOutput(raw));
      } finally {
        fs.rmSync(outputDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        materialized.cleanup();
      }
    }
  };
}
exports.createSubprocessBinding = createSubprocessBinding;
exports.resolveHarnessParserBinaryPath = resolveHarnessParserBinaryPath;

const SEARCH_INDEX_START_DELAY_MS = 3e4;
const SEARCH_INDEX_INTERVAL_MS = 10 * 6e4;
const SEARCH_BACKFILL_PAUSE_MS = 25;
const MAX_COMMIT_INDEX_REPOSITORIES = 64;

const defaultSleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
function aborted(signal) {
  return signal?.aborted === true;
}
function message(error) {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
async function indexRepository(store, git, candidate, signal) {
  let lastError = null;
  for (const root of candidate.paths) {
    if (aborted(signal)) return { commits: 0, error: null };
    let tips;
    try {
      tips = await git.readTips(root, signal);
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = message(error);
      continue;
    }
    const state = await store.getCommitRepositoryState(candidate.repository);
    const indexed = state?.heads ?? [];
    const current = new Set(tips.map((tip) => tip.sha));
    if (state && indexed.length === current.size && indexed.every((sha) => current.has(sha))) {
      await store.writeCommits({
        repository: candidate.repository,
        root,
        projectId: candidate.projectId,
        heads: [...current],
        commits: []
      });
      return { commits: 0, error: null };
    }
    try {
      const commits = await git.readCommits(root, tips, indexed, signal);
      if (aborted(signal)) return { commits: 0, error: null };
      await store.writeCommits({
        repository: candidate.repository,
        root,
        projectId: candidate.projectId,
        heads: [...current],
        commits
      });
      return { commits: commits.length, error: null };
    } catch (error) {
      if (aborted(signal)) return { commits: 0, error: null };
      const reason = message(error);
      await store.recordCommitIndexError({
        repository: candidate.repository,
        root,
        projectId: candidate.projectId,
        error: reason
      });
      return { commits: 0, error: reason };
    }
  }
  if (lastError && !aborted(signal))
    await store.recordCommitIndexError({
      repository: candidate.repository,
      root: candidate.paths[0] ?? candidate.repository,
      projectId: candidate.projectId,
      error: lastError
    });
  return { commits: 0, error: lastError };
}
async function runSearchIndexPass(store, git, options = {}) {
  const sleep = options.sleep ?? defaultSleep;
  const pauseMs = options.pauseMs ?? SEARCH_BACKFILL_PAUSE_MS;
  const progress = {
    phase: "backfill",
    backfilledRows: 0,
    backfillDone: false,
    repositories: 0,
    commits: 0,
    errors: 0
  };
  if (!await store.available()) {
    progress.backfillDone = true;
    return progress;
  }
  while (!aborted(options.signal)) {
    const step = await store.backfillStep();
    progress.backfilledRows += step.indexed;
    progress.backfillDone = step.done;
    options.onProgress?.({ ...progress });
    if (step.done) break;
    await sleep(pauseMs);
  }
  if (aborted(options.signal)) return progress;
  await store.optimize();
  if (!git) return progress;
  progress.phase = "commits";
  const candidates = await store.listCommitRepositories();
  const visitedAt = new Map(
    await Promise.all(
      candidates.map(
        async (candidate) => [
          candidate.repository,
          (await store.getCommitRepositoryState(candidate.repository))?.indexedAt ?? 0
        ]
      )
    )
  );
  const repositories = candidates.map((candidate, order) => ({ candidate, order })).sort(
    (a, b) => (visitedAt.get(a.candidate.repository) ?? 0) - (visitedAt.get(b.candidate.repository) ?? 0) || a.order - b.order
  ).slice(0, MAX_COMMIT_INDEX_REPOSITORIES).map(({ candidate }) => candidate);
  const heartbeat = options.onProgress ? setInterval(
    () => options.onProgress?.({ ...progress }),
    options.heartbeatMs ?? SEARCH_INDEX_HEARTBEAT_MS
  ) : null;
  try {
    for (const candidate of repositories) {
      if (aborted(options.signal)) break;
      const result = await indexRepository(store, git, candidate, options.signal);
      progress.repositories += 1;
      progress.commits += result.commits;
      if (result.error) progress.errors += 1;
      options.onProgress?.({ ...progress });
    }
  } finally {
    if (heartbeat) clearInterval(heartbeat);
  }
  return progress;
}
exports.SEARCH_INDEX_INTERVAL_MS = SEARCH_INDEX_INTERVAL_MS;
exports.SEARCH_INDEX_START_DELAY_MS = SEARCH_INDEX_START_DELAY_MS;
exports.runSearchIndexPass = runSearchIndexPass;

function parseGitCommitLog(output) {
  const commits = [];
  const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const chunk of output.split("")) {
    const record = chunk.replace(/^\n+/, "");

function runGit(cwd, args, stdin, options) {

  const maxBytes = options.maxBytes ?? GIT_COMMIT_LOG_MAX_BYTES;
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (options.signal?.aborted) {
      reject(new GitCommandError("git command aborted", "aborted"));
      return;
    }
    const child = node_child_process.spawn(options.gitPath ?? "git", ["-C", cwd, ...args], {

    });

    const finish = (error, output) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      options.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      if (error) {
        child.kill("SIGKILL");
        reject(error);
      } else resolve(output ?? "");
    };

      () => finish(new GitCommandError(`git ${args[0]} timed out`, "timeout")),
      timeoutMs
    );
    timer.unref?.();

      bytes += chunk.length;
      if (bytes > maxBytes) {
        finish(
          new GitCommandError(`git ${args[0]} output exceeded ${maxBytes} bytes`, "output-limit")
        );
        return;
      }
      chunks.push(chunk);
    });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      if (stderr.length < 4096) stderr += chunk.toString("utf8");
    });
    child.on(
      "error",
      (error) => finish(new GitCommandError(error.message || "git failed to start", "spawn"))
    );
    child.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0) finish(null, Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
      else
        finish(

function decideArtifactCloudSyncDirection(input) {
  const remote = input.remote;
  if (!remote) return "upload";
  if (remote.contentHash === input.localHash) return "unchanged";
  const localChanged = input.lastSyncedHash !== void 0 && input.localHash !== input.lastSyncedHash;
  const remoteChanged = input.lastSyncedHash !== void 0 && remote.contentHash !== input.lastSyncedHash;
  if (remoteChanged) return "download";
  return localChanged ? "upload" : "download";
}

async function withStateLock(path, operation) {

  let release;
  const current = new Promise((resolveLock) => {
    release = resolveLock;
  });

  await previous;

    return await operation();

  }

function safeSnapshot(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value))
    throw new Error("Invalid sync snapshot.");
  const candidate = value;
  if (candidate.version !== 1 || candidate.kind !== "file" && candidate.kind !== "directory" || !Array.isArray(candidate.files)) {
    throw new Error("Unsupported sync snapshot.");
  }
  let bytes = 0;
  const files = candidate.files.map((file) => {
    if (!file || typeof file.path !== "string" || typeof file.data !== "string")
      throw new Error("Invalid sync file.");
    const normalized = file.path.replace(/\\/g, "/");
    if (!normalized || normalized.startsWith("/") || normalized.split("/").includes(".."))
      throw new Error("Unsafe sync file path.");
    bytes += Buffer.byteLength(file.data, "base64");
    if (bytes > MAX_BYTES) throw new Error("Sync snapshot exceeds the size limit.");
    return { path: normalized, data: file.data };
  });
  if (files.length > MAX_FILES) throw new Error("Sync snapshot exceeds the file limit.");
  return { version: 1, kind: candidate.kind, files };
}

function conflictPath(path, revision, occupied) {
  const suffix = `.blume-local-conflict-r${revision}`;
  let candidate = `${path}${suffix}`;
  let copy = 2;
  while (occupied.has(candidate)) candidate = `${path}${suffix}-${copy++}`;
  occupied.add(candidate);
  return candidate;
}
function decodeText(file) {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(file.data, "base64");
  if (bytes.byteLength > 256 * 1024 || bytes.includes(0)) return null;
  try {
    return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
function previewText(file) {
  if (!file) return { text: "" };
  const bytes = Buffer.from(file.data, "base64");
  if (bytes.byteLength > MAX_PREVIEW_TEXT_BYTES) return { unavailable: "too-large" };
  if (bytes.includes(0)) return { unavailable: "binary" };
  try {
    return { text: new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes) };
  } catch {
    return { unavailable: "binary" };
  }
}
function contentPreview(path, before, after) {

  const afterText = previewText(after);

  if (unavailable) return { previewUnavailable: unavailable };

      path,

      afterText && "text" in afterText ? afterText.text : ""

  };

function mergeTextFiles(baseFile, localFile, remoteFile) {
  if (!baseFile || !localFile || !remoteFile) return null;
  const base = decodeText(baseFile);
  const local = decodeText(localFile);
  const remote = decodeText(remoteFile);
  if (base === null || local === null || remote === null) return null;
  const edit = (variant) => {
    let start = 0;
    while (start < base.length && start < variant.length && base[start] === variant[start]) start++;
    let baseEnd = base.length;
    let variantEnd = variant.length;
    while (baseEnd > start && variantEnd > start && base[baseEnd - 1] === variant[variantEnd - 1]) {
      baseEnd--;
      variantEnd--;
    }
    return { start, end: baseEnd, replacement: variant.slice(start, variantEnd) };
  };
  const localEdit = edit(local);
  const remoteEdit = edit(remote);
  if (localEdit.start === remoteEdit.start && localEdit.end === remoteEdit.end && localEdit.replacement === remoteEdit.replacement) {
    return localFile;
  }
  const localInsertion = localEdit.start === localEdit.end;
  const remoteInsertion = remoteEdit.start === remoteEdit.end;
  const overlaps = localInsertion ? remoteInsertion ? localEdit.start === remoteEdit.start : localEdit.start > remoteEdit.start && localEdit.start < remoteEdit.end : remoteInsertion ? remoteEdit.start > localEdit.start && remoteEdit.start < localEdit.end : localEdit.start < remoteEdit.end && remoteEdit.start < localEdit.end;
  if (overlaps) return null;
  const edits = [localEdit, remoteEdit].sort((left, right) => right.start - left.start);
  let merged = base;
  for (const item of edits) {
    merged = `${merged.slice(0, item.start)}${item.replacement}${merged.slice(item.end)}`;
  }
  return { path: localFile.path, data: Buffer.from(merged).toString("base64") };
}
function reconcileSnapshots(base, local, remote, remoteRevision) {
  if (local.kind === "file" || remote.kind === "file") {
    const localFile = local.files[0];
    const remoteFile = remote.files[0];
    const baseFile = base?.kind === "file" ? base.files[0] : void 0;
    if (sameFile(localFile, remoteFile)) return { snapshot: remote, conflicts: [] };
    if (base && sameFile(localFile, baseFile)) return { snapshot: remote, conflicts: [] };
    if (base && sameFile(remoteFile, baseFile)) return { snapshot: local, conflicts: [] };
    const merged = mergeTextFiles(baseFile, localFile, remoteFile);
    if (merged) {
      return {
        snapshot: { version: 1, kind: "file", files: [merged] },
        conflicts: []
      };
    }
    return {
      snapshot: remote,
      conflicts: [
        { path: "artifact", preservedPath: `artifact.blume-local-conflict-r${remoteRevision}` }
      ],
      ...localFile ? { fileConflict: Buffer.from(localFile.data, "base64") } : {}
    };
  }
  const baseByPath = base?.kind === "directory" ? snapshotFiles(base) : /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const localByPath = snapshotFiles(local);
  const remoteByPath = snapshotFiles(remote);
  const occupied = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...baseByPath.keys(), ...localByPath.keys(), ...remoteByPath.keys()]);
  const paths = [...occupied].sort();
  const files = [];
  const conflicts = [];
  for (const path of paths) {
    const baseFile = baseByPath.get(path);
    const localFile = localByPath.get(path);
    const remoteFile = remoteByPath.get(path);
    if (sameFile(localFile, remoteFile)) {
      if (localFile) files.push(localFile);
      continue;
    }
    if (base && sameFile(localFile, baseFile)) {
      if (remoteFile) files.push(remoteFile);
      continue;
    }
    if (base && sameFile(remoteFile, baseFile)) {
      if (localFile) files.push(localFile);
      continue;
    }
    const merged = mergeTextFiles(baseFile, localFile, remoteFile);
    if (merged) {
      files.push(merged);
      continue;
    }
    if (!baseFile && !localFile && remoteFile) {
      files.push(remoteFile);
      continue;
    }
    if (!baseFile && localFile && !remoteFile) {
      files.push(localFile);
      continue;
    }
    if (remoteFile) files.push(remoteFile);
    if (localFile) {
      const preservedPath = conflictPath(path, remoteRevision, occupied);
      files.push({ ...localFile, path: preservedPath });
      conflicts.push({ path, preservedPath });
    } else {
      const preservedPath = conflictPath(`${path}.deleted`, remoteRevision, occupied);
      files.push({
        path: preservedPath,
        data: Buffer.from(`Local deletion conflicted with remote changes to ${path}.
`).toString(
          "base64"
        )
      });
      conflicts.push({ path, preservedPath });
    }
  }
  files.sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
  return { snapshot: { version: 1, kind: "directory", files }, conflicts };
}
function snapshotPreviewChanges(local, remote, type) {
  const localFiles = local ? snapshotFiles(local) : /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const remoteFiles = remote ? snapshotFiles(remote) : /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  return [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...localFiles.keys(), ...remoteFiles.keys()])].sort().map((path) => {
    const localFile = localFiles.get(path);
    const remoteFile = remoteFiles.get(path);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength((localFile ?? remoteFile)?.data ?? "", "base64");
    const before = type === "place" ? localFile : remoteFile;
    const after = type === "place" ? remoteFile : localFile;
    if (!localFile) {
      return {
        path,
        action: "add",
        bytes,
        ...contentPreview(path, before, after)
      };
    }
    if (!remoteFile)
      return {
        path,
        action: type === "place" ? "unchanged" : "add",
        bytes,
        ...type === "place" ? {} : contentPreview(path, before, after)

    return {
      path,
      action: "conflict",
      bytes,
      ...contentPreview(path, before, after)
    };
  });
}
function previewItem(artifact, local, remote, type) {
  const allChanges = snapshotPreviewChanges(local, remote, type);
  const changed = allChanges.filter((change) => change.action !== "unchanged");
  const visibleChanges = changed.slice(0, MAX_PREVIEW_CHANGES);
  const source = local ?? remote;
  return {
    artifactId: artifact.id,
    name: artifact.name,
    kind: source?.kind ?? "file",
    fileCount: source?.files.length ?? 0,
    totalBytes: source?.files.reduce((total, file) => total + Buffer.byteLength(file.data, "base64"), 0) ?? 0,
    changes: visibleChanges,
    omittedChanges: Math.max(0, changed.length - visibleChanges.length),
    addCount: changed.filter((change) => change.action === "add").length,
    updateCount: changed.filter((change) => change.action === "update").length,
    removeCount: changed.filter((change) => change.action === "remove").length,
    conflictCount: changed.filter((change) => change.action === "conflict").length
  };
}

const SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 1e4;
const SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_MAX_QUEUE = 32;
const queue = [];

function post(message) {
  parentPort?.postMessage(message);

function serializeError(id, error) {
  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
  return {
    type: "scan-result",
    id,
    ok: false,
    errorMessage: err.message,
    errorName: err.name,
    errorStack: err.stack
  };
}
async function canonicalArtifact(artifact) {
  if (artifact.source.type === "external" || !artifact.source.runtimePath) {
    throw new Error("Artifact sync source is outside the allowed setup roots.");
  }
  const runtimePath2 = await setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService.resolveAllowedArtifactSyncPath(
    artifact.source.runtimePath
  );
  if (!runtimePath2) throw new Error("Artifact sync source is outside the allowed setup roots.");
  return { ...artifact, source: { ...artifact.source, runtimePath: runtimePath2 } };
}
async function canonicalSelection(selection) {
  return {
    ...selection,
    artifacts: await Promise.all(selection.artifacts.map(canonicalArtifact))
  };
}
async function canonicalPlacement(placement) {
  const runtimePath2 = await setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService.resolveAllowedArtifactSyncPath(
    placement.runtimePath
  );
  if (!runtimePath2) throw new Error("Artifact sync destination is outside the allowed setup roots.");
  return { ...placement, runtimePath: runtimePath2 };
}
async function runNext() {
  if (active || queue.length === 0) return;
  const request = queue.shift();
  if (!request) return;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  active = { request, controller };
  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
    post({ type: "heartbeat", id: request.id });
    for (const queued of queue) post({ type: "heartbeat", id: queued.id });
  }, SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS);
  try {
    if (request.type === "scan-global") {
      const setups = await setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService.listHarnessSetup();
      post({ type: "global-result", id: request.id, ok: true, setups });
    } else if (request.type === "scan-project") {
      const scan = await setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService.scanProject(request.path, {
        signal: controller.signal,
        projectId: request.projectId,
        workspaceLocationId: request.workspaceLocationId
      });
      post({ type: "project-result", id: request.id, ok: true, scan });
    } else if (request.type === "delete-artifact") {
      await setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService.deleteArtifact(request.artifact);
      post({ type: "delete-result", id: request.id, ok: true });
    } else {
      const itemCount = request.type === "list-artifact-sync" ? request.artifactIds?.length ?? 0 : request.type === "preview-artifact-sync" ? request.preview.type === "enable" ? request.preview.artifacts.length : 1 : request.availableArtifacts?.length ?? request.selection?.artifacts.length ?? 0;
      setupScanProtocol.assertBoundedArtifactSyncMessage(request, itemCount);
      const runtime = createArtifactCloudSyncRuntime({
        statePath: request.statePath,
        filePort: createDesktopArtifactSyncFilePort(setupScanProtocol.desktopSetupBrowserService),
        ...request.baseUrl ? { baseUrl: request.baseUrl } : {}
      });
      if (request.type === "preview-artifact-sync") {
        const preview = request.preview.type === "enable" ? {
          type: "enable",
          artifacts: await canonicalSelection({
            artifacts: request.preview.artifacts,
            enabled: true
          }).then((selection) => selection.artifacts)
        } : {
          type: "place",
          placement: await canonicalPlacement(request.preview.placement)
        };
        post({
          type: "artifact-sync-preview-result",
          id: request.id,
          ok: true,
          preview: await runtime.preview(preview, request.accessToken, controller.signal)
        });
        return;
      }
      const states = request.type === "list-artifact-sync" ? await runtime.listStates(request.artifactIds, controller.signal) : request.placement ? await runtime.placeSynced(
        await canonicalPlacement(request.placement),
        request.accessToken,
        controller.signal
      ) : request.selection ? await runtime.setSynced(
        await canonicalSelection(request.selection),
        request.accessToken,
        controller.signal
      ) : await runtime.syncAll(
        request.accessToken,
        request.availableArtifacts ? await Promise.all(request.availableArtifacts.map(canonicalArtifact)) : void 0,
        controller.signal
      );
      post({ type: "artifact-sync-result", id: request.id, ok: true, states });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    post(serializeError(request.id, error));
  } finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeat);
    active = null;
    void runNext();
  }
}
function handleMessage(message) {
  if (message.type === "cancel") {
    if (active?.request.id === message.id) {
      active.controller.abort();
      return;
    }
    const index = queue.findIndex((request) => request.id === message.id);
    if (index >= 0) queue.splice(index, 1);
    return;
  }
  if (queue.length + (active ? 1 : 0) >= SETUP_SCAN_WORKER_MAX_QUEUE) {
    post(serializeError(message.id, new Error("setup scan worker queue is full")));
    return;
  }
  queue.push(message);
  void runNext();
}
parentPort?.on("message", (event) => {
  handleMessage(event.data);
});

function aggregateSignalAnalytics(turns, signals, auditEvents = []) {

  const daily = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const allAffected = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const affectedByType = {
    correction: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(),
    steering: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(),
    frustration: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set()
  };
  const signalCounts = emptyCounts();
  const dayMetric = (periodStart) => {
    let metric = daily.get(periodStart);
    if (!metric) {
      metric = {
        periodStart,
        totalTurns: 0,
        turnsWithAnySignal: 0,
        signalCounts: emptyCounts(),
        affectedTurnCounts: emptyCounts(),
        auditCheckCounts: {}
      };
      daily.set(periodStart, metric);

      dayMetric(utcDay(turn.occurredAt)).totalTurns += 1;
    }

    }

      const turn = turnByKey.get(key);
      if (!turn) continue;

      if (!allAffected.has(key)) {
        allAffected.add(key);
        if (day) day.turnsWithAnySignal += 1;
      }
      if (!affectedByType[signal.type].has(key)) {
        affectedByType[signal.type].add(key);
        if (day) day.affectedTurnCounts[signal.type] += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  const auditCheckCounts = {};
  for (const event of auditEvents) {
    if (!event.checkId || !Number.isSafeInteger(event.catalogVersion) || event.catalogVersion < 1 || !Number.isFinite(event.createdAt)) {
      continue;
    }
    const total = auditCheckCounts[event.checkId] ??= emptyAuditCheckCounts();
    total[event.type] += 1;
    const day = dayMetric(utcDay(event.createdAt));
    const dayCounts = day.auditCheckCounts[event.checkId] ??= emptyAuditCheckCounts();
    dayCounts[event.type] += 1;
  }
  const totalTurns = turns.length;
  return {
    totalTurns,
    turnsWithAnySignal: allAffected.size,
    signalRate: totalTurns > 0 ? allAffected.size / totalTurns : 0,
    signalCounts,
    affectedTurnCounts: {
      correction: affectedByType.correction.size,
      steering: affectedByType.steering.size,
      frustration: affectedByType.frustration.size
    },

    daily: [...daily.values()].sort((left, right) => left.periodStart.localeCompare(right.periodStart)).slice(-90)
  };

const MAX_HOSTED_SIGNAL_FACTS = 5e3;
function parseHostedSignalFacts(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > MAX_HOSTED_SIGNAL_FACTS)
    throw new Error(`signals must list at most ${MAX_HOSTED_SIGNAL_FACTS} facts`);
  return value.map((raw) => {
    const fact = raw;
    if (!fact || typeof fact.at !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(fact.at) || !["correction", "steering", "frustration", "preference"].includes(fact.kind))
      throw new Error("signals must be { at, kind } facts");
    return { at: fact.at, kind: fact.kind };
  });
}
function aggregateHostedSignalAnalytics(turns, signals, auditEvents = []) {
  const base = aggregateSignalAnalytics(turns, [], auditEvents);
  const byDay = new Map(base.daily.map((day) => [day.periodStart, day]));
  const signalCounts = emptyCounts();
  for (const signal of signals) {
    const type = signal.kind === "preference" ? "steering" : signal.kind;
    signalCounts[type] += 1;
    const periodStart = utcDay(signal.at);
    let day = byDay.get(periodStart);
    if (!day) {
      day = {
        periodStart,
        totalTurns: 0,
        turnsWithAnySignal: 0,
        signalCounts: emptyCounts(),
        affectedTurnCounts: emptyCounts(),
        auditCheckCounts: {}
      };
      byDay.set(periodStart, day);
    }
    day.signalCounts[type] += 1;
  }
  const affectedTurnCounts = emptyCounts();
  let turnsWithAnySignal = 0;
  for (const day of byDay.values()) {
    for (const type of SIGNAL_TYPES) {
      day.affectedTurnCounts[type] = Math.min(day.signalCounts[type], day.totalTurns);
      affectedTurnCounts[type] += day.affectedTurnCounts[type];
    }
    day.turnsWithAnySignal = Math.min(
      SIGNAL_TYPES.reduce((total, type) => total + day.signalCounts[type], 0),
      day.totalTurns
    );
    turnsWithAnySignal += day.turnsWithAnySignal;
  }
  return {
    ...base,
    turnsWithAnySignal,
    signalRate: base.totalTurns > 0 ? turnsWithAnySignal / base.totalTurns : 0,
    signalCounts,
    affectedTurnCounts,
    daily: [...byDay.values()].sort((left, right) => left.periodStart.localeCompare(right.periodStart)).slice(-90)
  };
}

class AsyncQueue {
  constructor() {
    this.buffer = [];
    this.waiters = [];
    this.closed = false;
  }
  push(item) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    const waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    if (waiter) waiter({ value: item, done: false });
    else this.buffer.push(item);
  }
  close() {
    this.closed = true;
    let waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    while (waiter) {
      waiter({ value: void 0, done: true });
      waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    }
  }
  [Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    return {
      next: () => {
        if (this.buffer.length > 0) {
          const [value] = this.buffer.splice(0, 1);
          return Promise.resolve({ value, done: false });
        }
        if (this.closed) return Promise.resolve({ value: void 0, done: true });
        return new Promise((resolve) => this.waiters.push(resolve));
      },
      return: () => {
        this.close();
        return Promise.resolve({ value: void 0, done: true });
      }
    };
  }
}

const COMMAND_EXIT_SENTINEL_TERMINATOR = "\x07";
function commandExitSentinelPrefix(nonce) {
  return `\x1B]1337;blume-command-exit;${nonce};`;

function commandExitSentinelPattern(nonce) {
  return new RegExp(`\x1B\\]1337;blume-command-exit;${nonce};(-?\\d+)\x07`, "g");
