    s += `<ellipse cx="-6.6" cy="10.6" rx="2.6" ry="1.2" transform="rotate(-16 -6.6 10.6)" fill="${hue}" opacity="0.9"/>`;
  } else if (stage === 8) {
    s += clumpSvg(ctx, 2);
  } else if (stage === 9) {
    s += clumpSvg(ctx, 3);
  } else {
    s += clumpSvg(ctx, 5);
  }
  return `<g data-stage="${stage}">${s}</g>`;
}
function vignetteSvg(ctx) {
  const hue = HUES[ctx.badgeId];
  const stage = ctx.level;
  const clipId = `${ctx.uid}-c-${ctx.badgeId}${ctx.key}`;
  const tint = 0.095 + stage * 0.0155;
  const edge = 0.24 + stage * 0.021;
  let out = "";
  if (ctx.halo) {
    out += `<circle r="19.8" fill="none" stroke="${mixHex(DISC_BASE, hue, 0.38)}" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  }
  out += `<circle r="16.5" fill="${mixHex(DISC_BASE, hue, tint)}" stroke="${mixHex(DISC_BASE, hue, edge)}" stroke-width="1"${` filter="url(#${ctx.uid}-lift)"`}/>`;
  out += `<defs><clipPath id="${clipId}"><circle r="${CLIP_R}"/></clipPath></defs>`;
  out += `<g clip-path="url(#${clipId})">`;
  out += `<path d="M-14,18.5 Q-11,9.9 0,8.7 Q11,9.9 14,18.5 Z" fill="${EARTH}"/>`;
  out += `<path d="M-14,18.5 Q-6,13.4 0,13.2 Q6,13.4 14,18.5 Z" fill="${EARTH_DARK}" opacity=".55"/>`;
  out += plantSvg(ctx);
  out += "</g>";
  out += '<circle r="15.6" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" stroke-width="1"/>';
  return out;
}
function estWidth(text, fs, factor) {
  return text.length * fs * factor;
}
function estCaps(text, fs, ls) {
  return text.length * (fs * 0.64 + fs * ls);
}
function wrapCaps(name, fs, avail) {
  const t = name.toUpperCase();
  if (estCaps(t, fs, 0.08) <= avail || !t.includes(" ")) return [t];
  let best = -1;
  let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    if (t[i] === " ") {
      const d = Math.abs(i - t.length / 2);
      if (d < bestDistance) {
        bestDistance = d;
        best = i;
      }
    }
  }
  if (best < 0) return [t];
  return [t.slice(0, best), t.slice(best + 1)];
}
function fitValue(text, base, avail, floor) {
  if (estWidth(text, base, 0.53) <= avail) return { fs: base, tl: 0 };
  const fs = Math.max(floor, Math.min(base, Math.floor(avail / (text.length * 0.53) * 2) / 2));
  return { fs, tl: estWidth(text, fs, 0.53) > avail ? avail : 0 };
}

function renderTile(badge, x, y, w, h, o) {
  const z = TILE_KINDS[o.kind];
  const hue = HUES[badge.id];
  const level = clamp(Math.round(badge.level), 1, 10);
  const hueInk = lighten(hue, -0.3);
  const wash = 0.15 + 0.016 * level + (o.winner ? 0.06 : 0);
  const bg = mixHex(TILE_BG, hue, wash);
  const alpha = o.winner ? 0.68 : 0.6;
  const valueColor = level >= 8 || o.winner ? hueInk : INK;
  const halo = level >= 8 || o.winner;
  let out = `<g data-badge="${badge.id}" data-level="${level}" data-blooms="${badge.blooms}" data-win="${o.winner ? 1 : 0}" data-kind="${o.kind}">`;
  out += `<title>${esc(badge.name)}: ${esc(badge.display)} (level ${level} of 10)</title>`;
  out += `<rect x="${fx(x)}" y="${fx(y)}" width="${fx(w)}" height="${fx(h)}" rx="${z.rx}" fill="${bg}" fill-opacity="${alpha}" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" stroke-width="1"/>`;
  if (o.winner) {
    out += `<rect x="${fx(x - 1.5)}" y="${fx(y - 1.5)}" width="${fx(w + 3)}" height="${fx(h + 3)}" rx="${z.rx + 1.5}" fill="none" stroke="${hue}" stroke-opacity="0.26" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  }
  out += `<rect x="${fx(x + 1)}" y="${fx(y + 1)}" width="${fx(w - 2)}" height="${fx(h - 2)}" rx="${z.rx - 1}" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)" stroke-width="1"/>`;
  const nameLineHeight = z.nameFs + 3;
  const nameColor = o.winner ? lighten(hue, -0.4) : INK_SOFT;
  const dia = 2 * 19.8 * z.sc;
  const avail = w - 2 * z.pad;
  const fit = fitValue(badge.display, z.valFs, avail, Math.min(24, z.valFs));
  const lines = wrapCaps(badge.name, z.nameFs, avail);
  const blockH = dia + z.gapV + fit.fs * 0.95 + lines.length * nameLineHeight;
  const top = y + (h - blockH) / 2;
  const cx = x + w / 2;
  const cy = top + dia / 2;
  out += `<g transform="translate(${fx(cx)},${fx(cy)}) scale(${z.sc.toFixed(3)})">`;
  out += vignetteSvg({ uid: o.uid, key: o.key, halo, badgeId: badge.id, level });
  out += "</g>";
  const valueY = top + dia + z.gapV + fit.fs * 0.78;
  out += `<text x="${fx(cx)}" y="${fx(valueY)}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${GELICA}" font-weight="500" font-size="${fit.fs}" letter-spacing="-.02em"${fit.tl ? ` textLength="${fx(fit.tl)}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"` : ""} style="font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums" fill="${valueColor}">${esc(badge.display)}</text>`;
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    out += `<text x="${fx(cx)}" y="${fx(valueY + z.gapV * 0.5 + z.nameFs + i * nameLineHeight)}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="700" font-size="${z.nameFs}" letter-spacing=".08em" fill="${nameColor}">${esc(line)}</text>`;
  });
  out += "</g>";
  return out;
}

function cardDefs(uid, sky, horizonY) {
  let d = "<defs>";
  for (const id of BADGE_IDS) {
    const hue = HUES[id];
    d += `<linearGradient id="${uid}-p-${id}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${lighten(hue, 0.16)}"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="${hue}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${lighten(hue, -0.12)}"/></linearGradient>`;
  }
  d += `<linearGradient id="${uid}-sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="${fx(horizonY * 1.2)}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" spreadMethod="pad">` + sky.stops.map(([p, c]) => `<stop offset="${p}" stop-color="${c}"/>`).join("") + "</linearGradient>";
  d += `<linearGradient id="${uid}-comet" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffecc8" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffecc8" stop-opacity="0.9"/></linearGradient>`;
  d += `<filter id="${uid}-tile" x="-25%" y="-25%" width="150%" height="150%"><feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#3d2f16" flood-opacity="0.2"/></filter>`;
  d += `<filter id="${uid}-lift" x="-45%" y="-45%" width="190%" height="190%"><feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2.2" stdDeviation="2.6" flood-color="#3d2f16" flood-opacity="0.22"/></filter>`;
  return `${d}</defs>`;
}
function renderLockup(persona, geo, ink, flowerId) {
  const frame = geo.lockF;
  const crown = badgeCrown(persona);
  const markScale = frame * 0.3 / crown.headRadius;
  const mx = geo.lockX + frame * 0.4;
  const my = geo.lockY + frame * 0.5;
  const fontSize = frame * 0.52447398;
  let out = `<g data-blume-mark="1" data-flower="${esc(flowerId ?? "")}" data-mark-x="${fx(geo.lockX)}" data-mark-y="${fx(geo.lockY)}" data-mark-size="${fx(frame)}"><g transform="translate(${fx(mx)},${fx(my)}) scale(${markScale.toFixed(4)})">${crown.svg}</g></g><!--/blume-mark-->`;
  out += `<text x="${fx(geo.lockX + frame * 0.82244762)}" y="${fx(geo.lockY + frame * 0.25886423 + fontSize * 0.8)}" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="400" font-size="${fx(fontSize)}" letter-spacing="-.01em" fill="${ink}">blume</text>`;
  return out;
}
function renderWrappedCardSvg(summary, options = {}) {
  const format = options.format === "square" ? "square" : "portrait";
  const geo = GEOMETRY[format];
  const w = CARD_WIDTH;
  const h = geo.h;
  const sky = SKIES[summary.persona] ?? SKIES.hours;
  const ground = GROUNDS[summary.persona] ?? GROUNDS.hours;
  const ink = sky.ink;
  const uid = `wr-${summary.period.periodStart.replace(/[^0-9a-zA-Z-]/g, "")}-${format}`;
  const rng = createRng(`wrapped:${summary.period.periodStart}:${summary.persona}:${format}`);
  const pixelWidth = options.width && options.width > 0 ? options.width : w;
  const pixelHeight = Math.round(pixelWidth * h / w);
  let out = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" width="${pixelWidth}" height="${pixelHeight}" role="img" aria-label="Blume Wrapped, ${esc(summary.rangeLabel)}">`;
  out += cardDefs(uid, sky, h * geo.horizon);
  const horizon = h * geo.horizon;
  let scene = "";
  scene += `<rect width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="url(#${uid}-sky)"/>`;
  scene += `<g data-layer="weather">${renderWeather(summary.persona, w, horizon, rng.fork("weather"), uid)}</g>`;
  scene += `<g data-layer="meadow">${renderMeadow(summary, w, h, geo, rng.fork("meadow"), uid, sky, ground)}</g>`;
  scene += `<g data-layer="brand">${renderLockup(summary.persona, geo, ink, summary.flowerId)}</g>`;
  scene += `<text x="${w - 32}" y="${fx(geo.rangeY + 8)}" text-anchor="end" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="700" font-size="${geo.rangeFs}" letter-spacing=".18em" fill="${ink}" opacity="0.88">${esc(summary.rangeLabel.toUpperCase())}</text>`;
  out += scene;
  const heroValue = summary.hero.value;
  const heroUnit = summary.hero.unit ? ` ${summary.hero.unit}` : "";
  const heroFit = fitValue(heroValue + heroUnit, geo.numFs, w - 76, Math.round(geo.numFs * 0.45));
  const smallFs = Math.round(heroFit.fs * 0.55);
  out += `<g data-layer="hero">`;
  out += `<text x="${w / 2}" y="${geo.kickerY}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="700" font-size="${geo.kickerFs}" letter-spacing=".22em" fill="${ink}" opacity="0.88">${esc(summary.hero.kicker.toUpperCase())}</text>`;
  out += `<text x="${w / 2}" y="${geo.numY}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${GELICA}" font-weight="500" font-size="${heroFit.fs}" letter-spacing="-.02em" fill="${ink}">${esc(heroValue)}`;
  if (summary.hero.unit) {
    out += `<tspan font-size="${smallFs}" font-weight="500"> ${esc(summary.hero.unit)}</tspan>`;
  }
  out += "</text>";
  out += `<text x="${w / 2}" y="${geo.subY}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="400" font-size="${geo.subFs}" fill="${ink}" opacity="0.92">${esc(summary.hero.detail)}</text>`;
  out += "</g>";
  const byId = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const badge of summary.badges) byId.set(badge.id, badge);
  const winner = byId.get(summary.persona) ?? summary.badges[0];
  const rest = summary.badges.filter((badge) => badge.id !== winner?.id).slice().sort((a, b) => b.level - a.level || summary.badges.indexOf(a) - summary.badges.indexOf(b));
  const colW = (w - 2 * geo.gridX - 3 * geo.gap) / 4;
  const rowY = [geo.gridY, geo.gridY + geo.rowH + geo.gap, geo.gridY + 2 * (geo.rowH + geo.gap)];
  const colX = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => geo.gridX + i * (colW + geo.gap));
  let key = 0;
  const mistTop = geo.gridY - 96;
  const mistH = h - mistTop;
  out += `<defs><clipPath id="${uid}-glassclip"><rect x="0" y="${fx(mistTop)}" width="${w}" height="${fx(mistH)}"/></clipPath><filter id="${uid}-glassblur" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12"/><feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="1.15"/></filter><linearGradient id="${uid}-glassfade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.7"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.88"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.88"/></linearGradient><mask id="${uid}-glassmask"><rect x="0" y="${fx(mistTop)}" width="${w}" height="${fx(mistH)}" fill="url(#${uid}-glassfade)"/></mask></defs>`;
  out += `<g data-layer="glass" clip-path="url(#${uid}-glassclip)" mask="url(#${uid}-glassmask)"><g filter="url(#${uid}-glassblur)">${scene.replaceAll(`${uid}-`, `${uid}-g-`)}</g><rect x="0" y="${fx(mistTop)}" width="${w}" height="${fx(mistH)}" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.16"/><rect x="0" y="${fx(mistTop)}" width="${w}" height="${fx(mistH)}" fill="#fdf7eb" fill-opacity="0.08"/></g>`;
  out += '<g data-layer="bento">';
  if (winner) {
    out += renderTile(winner, colX[0], rowY[0], colW * 2 + geo.gap, geo.rowH * 2 + geo.gap, {
      uid,
      kind: geo.feature,
      winner: true,
      key: `t${key++}`
    });
  }
  const cells = [
    [2, 0],
    [3, 0],
    [2, 1],
    [3, 1]
  ];
  cells.forEach((cell, i) => {
    const badge = rest[i];
    if (!badge) return;
    out += renderTile(badge, colX[cell[0]], rowY[cell[1]], colW, geo.rowH, {
      uid,
      kind: geo.narrow,
      winner: false,
      key: `t${key++}`
    });
  });
  const wideW = (w - 2 * geo.gridX - 2 * geo.gap) / 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const badge = rest[4 + i];
    if (!badge) continue;
    out += renderTile(badge, geo.gridX + i * (wideW + geo.gap), rowY[2], wideW, geo.rowH, {
      uid,
      kind: geo.wide,
      winner: false,
      key: `t${key++}`
    });
  }
  out += "</g>";
  const gridBottom = rowY[2] + geo.rowH;
  out += `<text x="${fx(w - geo.gridX)}" y="${fx(gridBottom + (h - gridBottom) / 2 + geo.urlFs * 0.36)}" text-anchor="end" font-family="${SNPRO}" font-weight="600" font-size="${geo.urlFs}" letter-spacing=".06em" fill="${INK_SOFT}" opacity="0.55">blume.codes</text>`;
  out += "</svg>";
  return out;
}

  parentPort?.postMessage(message);

function serializeError(id, error) {
  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
  return {
    type: "worker-error",
    id,
    ok: false,
    errorMessage: err.message,
    errorName: err.name,
    errorStack: err.stack
  };
}
function getStorageHandle(dbPath) {
  if (storageHandle && storagePath === dbPath) return storageHandle;
  storageHandle?.close();
  storageHandle = sqliteStorage.openDesktopSqliteStorage(dbPath);
  storagePath = dbPath;
  return storageHandle;
}
function readSummary(outcome) {
  if (!outcome?.record) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(outcome.record.summary_json);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
function cardBytesFor(summary) {
  if (!summary) return 0;
  try {
    return renderWrappedCardSvg(summary).length;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}
function badgeValuesFor(outcome, summary) {
  if (!outcome?.record || outcome.record.period_kind !== "weekly") return null;
  const badges = summary?.badges;
  if (!Array.isArray(badges)) return null;
  const values = {};
  for (const badge of badges) {
    if (typeof badge?.id !== "string" || typeof badge.value !== "number") continue;
    if (!Number.isFinite(badge.value)) continue;
    values[badge.id] = badge.value;
  }
  return Object.keys(values).length > 0 ? values : null;
}
async function generate(request) {
  const startedAtMs = Date.now();
  const { storage } = getStorageHandle(request.dbPath);
  const useCases$1 = useCases.createWrappedUseCases({
    store: storage.wrapped,
    settings: storage.settings,
    now: () => request.nowMs,
    accountUserId: async () => request.accountUserId,
    // The curve arrives already resolved: this process has no analytics
    // credentials and makes no network calls. Contribution is main's job,
    // driven by the badge values posted back below.
    cohort: {
      load: async () => request.cohort,
      contribute: async () => {
      }
    }
  });
  const outcome = request.mode === "rolling" ? await useCases$1.generateLastSevenDays() : request.mode === "launch-recap" ? await useCases$1.runLaunchRecapIfDue(true) : request.mode === "archive-week" ? await useCases$1.generateArchiveWeek(request.periodStart) : await useCases$1.runWeeklyIfDue(request.lastRunMs, request.lastPeriodStart);
  const summary = readSummary(outcome);
  const attemptedPeriodStart = outcome === null ? null : outcome.record?.period_start ?? (request.mode === "weekly-if-due" || request.mode === "launch-recap" ? useCases.previousWeekPeriod(request.nowMs).periodStart : request.mode === "archive-week" ? request.periodStart : null);
  post({
    type: "generate-result",
    id: request.id,
    ok: true,
    status: outcome?.status ?? "skipped",
    wrappedId: outcome?.record?.id ?? null,
    periodStart: attemptedPeriodStart,
    sessionCount: typeof summary?.sessionCount === "number" ? summary.sessionCount : 0,
    cardBytes: cardBytesFor(summary),
    durationMs: Date.now() - startedAtMs,
    badgeValues: badgeValuesFor(outcome, summary)
  });
}
async function listAvailableWeeks(request, signal) {

  const useCases$1 = useCases.createWrappedUseCases({
    store: storage.wrapped,
    settings: storage.settings,
    now: () => request.nowMs,
    accountUserId: async () => null

async function handleMessage(message) {
  if (message.type === "cancel") {
    if (activeRequestId === message.id) activeAbortController?.abort();
    return;
  }
  if (busy) {
    post(serializeError(message.id, new Error("wrapped generation already in flight")));
    return;
  }
  busy = true;
  activeRequestId = message.id;
  activeAbortController = message.type === "list-available-weeks" ? new AbortController() : null;
  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
    post({ type: "heartbeat", id: message.id });
  }, WRAPPED_GENERATE_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS);
  try {
    if (message.type === "list-available-weeks") {
      await listAvailableWeeks(message, activeAbortController.signal);
    } else await generate(message);
  } catch (error) {
    post(serializeError(message.id, error));
  } finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeat);
    activeRequestId = null;
    activeAbortController = null;
    busy = false;
  }
}
parentPort?.on("message", (event) => {
  void handleMessage(event.data);
});

  }

    throw Error("Choose Codex or Claude");
  if (input.action === "create" && input.projectId !== void 0 && !text("projectId", 200))
    throw Error("Choose a project");
  if (input.action === "list") return { action: "list" };

  if (input.action === "create" && input.cloud !== void 0) {

    if (cloud?.workspaceId !== void 0 && (typeof cloud.workspaceId !== "string" || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,160}$/.test(cloud.workspaceId)))
      throw Error("Choose a cloud workspace");
    if (cloud?.importSubscription !== true)
      throw Error("Allow subscription sign-in import to create a cloud agent");
    if (!cloud || typeof cloud.repository !== "string" || cloud.repository.length > 2e3 || !/^https:\/\/github\.com\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:\.git)?$/.test(
      cloud.repository
    ) || typeof cloud.revision !== "string" || !cloud.revision.trim() || cloud.revision.length > 256 || cloud.revision.startsWith("-") || /[\s\x00-\x1f]/.test(cloud.revision))
      throw Error("Choose a GitHub repository URL and starting branch or commit");
  }
  if (input.action === "create" || input.action === "send") {
    images = validateOwnedChatImages(input.images);
    if (!text("requestId", 160)) throw Error("Invalid message request");
    if (typeof input.message !== "string" || input.message.length > 32e3)
      throw Error("Enter a message of at most 32,000 characters");
    if (!input.message.trim() && !images?.length) throw Error("Enter a message or attach an image");
    if (input.action === "create" && !text("cwd", 4096)) throw Error("Choose a project folder");
  }

  if ((input.action === "dismissUncertain" || input.action === "dismissDelivery") && !text("requestId", 160))
    throw Error("Choose the uncertain message");
  if (input.action === "approval" && (!text("approvalId", 160) || typeof input.approved !== "boolean"))

const BASE64 = /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/;
function validateOwnedChatImages(value) {
  if (value === void 0) return void 0;
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw Error("Invalid image attachments");
  if (value.length > OWNED_CHAT_IMAGE_LIMITS.count)
    throw Error(`Attach at most ${OWNED_CHAT_IMAGE_LIMITS.count} images to one message`);
  return value.map((item) => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") throw Error("Invalid image attachment");
    const { name, mediaType, data } = item;
    if (typeof name !== "string" || !name.trim() || name.length > OWNED_CHAT_IMAGE_LIMITS.nameLength)
      throw Error("Invalid image name");
    if (!OWNED_CHAT_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(mediaType))
      throw Error("Attach PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images");
    if (typeof data !== "string" || !data || data.length % 4 !== 0)
      throw Error("Invalid image data");
    if (data.length > Math.ceil(OWNED_CHAT_IMAGE_LIMITS.bytes / 3) * 4)
      throw Error("Each image must be smaller than 2 MB");
    if (!BASE64.test(data)) throw Error("Invalid image data");
    return { name, mediaType, data };
  });
}
function ownedImageRequest(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") throw Error("Invalid image chat request");
  const input = value;
  if (input.action !== "create" && input.action !== "send")
    throw Error("Only image create and send requests may use this port");
  if (input.action === "create" && (input.cloud !== void 0 || input.projectId !== void 0))
    throw Error("Images are available in chats on this computer.");
  const request = validateOwnedChatRequest({
    action: input.action,
    requestId: input.requestId,
    message: input.message,
    images: input.images,
    ...input.action === "create" ? { cwd: input.cwd, harness: input.harness } : { id: input.id }
  });
  if (!request.images?.length) throw Error("Attach an image to use this port");
  return request;
}
function createFeedClient(openPort, timeoutMs = 65e3) {
  let port;
  let cancelOpening;
  let opened = 0;
  const pending = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const listeners = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  let sequence = 0;
  let imagePending = false;
  function receive(data) {
    const message = data;
    if (!message || typeof message !== "object") return;
    if (typeof message.id === "string") {
      const waiting = pending.get(message.id);
      if (!waiting) return;
      pending.delete(message.id);
      clearTimeout(waiting.timer);
      if (typeof message.error === "string") waiting.reject(Error(message.error));
      else waiting.resolve(message.result);
    } else if ("moved" in message) {
      const cursor = Number.isSafeInteger(message.moved) ? message.moved : void 0;
      for (const listener of listeners) listener(cursor);
    }
  }
  function connect() {
    if (!port) {
      const generation = ++opened;
      const handshake = new AbortController();
      let deadline;
      port = Promise.race([
        openPort(handshake.signal),
        new Promise((_, reject) => {
          cancelOpening = () => {
            clearTimeout(deadline);
            handshake.abort();
            reject(Error("Account changed. Try again."));
          };
          deadline = setTimeout(() => {
            handshake.abort();
            reject(Error("Blume ledger did not connect. Refresh before retrying."));
          }, timeoutMs);
        })
      ]).then(
        (next) => {
          clearTimeout(deadline);
          if (generation === opened) cancelOpening = void 0;
          if (generation !== opened) {
            next.close();
            throw Error("Account changed. Try again.");
          }
          next.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
            if (generation === opened) receive(event.data);
          });
          next.start();
          if (listeners.size) next.postMessage({ op: "follow" });
          return next;
        },
        (error) => {
          clearTimeout(deadline);
          if (generation === opened) cancelOpening = void 0;
          throw error;
        }
      );
      port.catch(() => {
        if (generation === opened) port = void 0;
      });
    }
    return port;
  }
  return {
    /** Image bytes cross only this port, not ipcRenderer.invoke or Electron main. One submission
     * at a time bounds retained payloads; a timeout is surfaced, never automatically retried. */
    async ownedImage(value) {
      if (imagePending)
        throw Error("An image message is already being submitted. Wait before retrying.");
      const input = ownedImageRequest(value);
      imagePending = true;
      try {
        const connection = connect();
        const generation = opened;
        const current = await connection;
        if (generation !== opened) throw Error("Account changed. Try again.");
        const id = `${++sequence}`;
        return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            pending.delete(id);
            reject(Error("Image submission timed out. Check the chat before retrying."));
          }, timeoutMs);
          pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer });
          try {
            current.postMessage({ id, op: "owned-image", input });
          } catch (error) {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            pending.delete(id);
            reject(error);
          }
        });
      } finally {
        imagePending = false;
      }
    },
    async changes(cursor, ledger) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cursor) || cursor < 0) throw Error("Invalid change cursor");
      if (ledger !== void 0 && (typeof ledger !== "string" || !/^[a-f0-9]{1,64}$/.test(ledger)))
        throw Error("Invalid ledger");
      const current = await connect();
      const id = `${++sequence}`;
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          pending.delete(id);
          reject(Error("Blume ledger timed out. Refresh before retrying."));
        }, timeoutMs);
        pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer });
        current.postMessage({
          id,
          op: "changes",
          cursor,
          ...ledger === void 0 ? {} : { ledger }
        });
      });
    },
    subscribe(listener) {
      const first = listeners.size === 0;
      listeners.add(listener);
      if (first) {
        const existing = port;
        if (existing)
          void existing.then(
            (current) => current.postMessage({ op: "follow" }),
            () => {
            }
          );
        else void connect().catch(() => {
        });
      }
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
        if (!listeners.size)
          void port?.then(
            (current) => current.postMessage({ op: "unfollow" }),
            () => {
            }
          );
      };
    },
    /** The account (or its workspace) changed: requests in flight are dropped and the next goes
     * through a port for the new one; followers are moved over and told to check. */
    reset() {
      const previous = port;
      cancelOpening?.();
      cancelOpening = void 0;
      port = void 0;
      opened++;
      void previous?.then(
        (current) => current.close(),
        () => {
        }
      );
      for (const [id, waiting] of pending) {
        clearTimeout(waiting.timer);
        waiting.reject(Error("Account changed. Try again."));
        pending.delete(id);
      }
      if (listeners.size) {
        void connect().catch(() => {
        });
        for (const listener of listeners) listener(void 0);
      }
    }
  };
}

const MAX_ARTIFACT_SYNC_MESSAGE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
function boundedArtifactSyncInvoke(channel, value, itemCount, ...args) {
  try {
    if (itemCount > MAX_ARTIFACT_SYNC_ITEMS_PER_MESSAGE) {
      throw new Error(
        `Artifact sync supports at most ${MAX_ARTIFACT_SYNC_ITEMS_PER_MESSAGE} items per request.`
      );
    }
    const serializedValue = JSON.stringify(value);
    if (serializedValue !== void 0 && Buffer.byteLength(serializedValue, "utf8") > MAX_ARTIFACT_SYNC_MESSAGE_BYTES) {
      throw new Error("Artifact sync request exceeds the 1 MB IPC limit.");
    }
    return deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, value, ...args);
  } catch (error) {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
}

  onTerminalOutput: (tabId, callback) => {
    const maxQueuedChars = 128 * 1024;
    let attached = false;
    let stopped = false;
    let queuedChars = 0;
    const queued = [];
    const listener = (_event, outputTabId, data) => {
      if (outputTabId !== tabId || stopped) return;
      if (attached) callback(data);
      else {
        queued.push(data);
        queuedChars += data.length;
        while (queuedChars > maxQueuedChars && queued.length > 1) {
          queuedChars -= queued.shift()?.length ?? 0;
        }
      }
    };
    deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.on("terminal:output", listener);
    void deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.invoke("terminal:attach", tabId).then((backlog) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      if (typeof backlog === "string" && backlog) callback(backlog);
      attached = true;
      for (const data of queued) callback(data);
      queued.length = 0;
      queuedChars = 0;
    });
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.removeListener("terminal:output", listener);
      void deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.invoke("terminal:detach", tabId);
    };
  },
  onTerminalStatus: (callback) => {
    const listener = (_event, tab) => callback(tab);
    deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.on("terminal:status", listener);
    return () => deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.removeListener("terminal:status", listener);
  },
  openTerminalAppForTab: (tabId) => deliveryBridge.ipcRenderer.invoke("terminal:openTerminalApp", tabId),

function renderFileWithHighlighter(file, highlighter, { theme = DEFAULT_THEMES, tokenizeMaxLineLength, useTokenTransformer }, { forcePlainText, startingLine, totalLines, lines } = DEFAULT_PLAIN_TEXT_OPTIONS) {

    startingLine ??= 0;
    totalLines ??= Infinity;
  } else {
    startingLine = 0;
    totalLines = Infinity;
  }
  const isWindowedHighlight = startingLine > 0 || totalLines < Infinity;
  const { state, transformers } = createTransformerWithState(useTokenTransformer);
  const lang = forcePlainText ? "text" : file.lang ?? getFiletypeFromFileName(file.name);
  const baseThemeType = typeof theme === "string" ? highlighter.getTheme(theme).type : void 0;
  const themeStyles = getHighlighterThemeStyles({
    theme,
    highlighter
  });
  state.lineInfo = (shikiLineNumber) => ({
    type: "context",
    lineIndex: shikiLineNumber - 1 + startingLine,
    lineNumber: shikiLineNumber + startingLine
  });
  const hastConfig = (() => {
    if (typeof theme === "string") return {
      lang,
      theme,
      transformers,
      defaultColor: false,
      cssVariablePrefix: formatCSSVariablePrefix("token"),
      tokenizeMaxLineLength,
      tokenizeTimeLimit: 0
    };
    return {
      lang,
      themes: theme,
      transformers,
      defaultColor: false,
      cssVariablePrefix: formatCSSVariablePrefix("token"),
      tokenizeMaxLineLength,
      tokenizeTimeLimit: 0
    };
  })();
  const highlightedLines = getLineNodes(highlighter.codeToHast(isWindowedHighlight ? extractWindowedFileContent(lines ?? linesFromFileContents(file.contents), startingLine, totalLines) : file.contents, hastConfig));
  const code = isWindowedHighlight ? new Array(startingLine) : highlightedLines;
  if (isWindowedHighlight) code.push(...highlightedLines);
  return {

    themeStyles,
    baseThemeType
  };
}
function extractWindowedFileContent(lines, startingLine, totalLines) {
  if (lines.length === 0) return "";
  const endLine = Math.min(startingLine + totalLines, lines.length);
  return lines.slice(startingLine, endLine).join("");
}

  hydrate(props) {

    if (!this.enabled) throw new Error("File.hydrate: attempting to call hydrate after cleaned up");

    this.hydrateElements(fileContainer, prerenderedHTML);
    if (shouldRenderCode(this.pre, file, this.options.collapsed) || shouldRenderHeader(this.headerElement, file, this.options.disableFileHeader)) this.render({
      ...props,

    });

    });

  }
  hydrateElements(fileContainer, prerenderedHTML) {
    if (this.fileContainer !== fileContainer) this.emitPostRender(true);

    for (const element of Array.from(fileContainer.shadowRoot?.children ?? [])) {
      if (element instanceof SVGElement) {
        this.spriteSVG = element;
        continue;
      }
      if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      if (element instanceof HTMLPreElement) {
        this.pre = element;
        this.appliedPreAttributes = void 0;
        continue;
      }
      if (element instanceof HTMLStyleElement && element.hasAttribute("data-theme-css")) {
        this.themeCSSStyle = element;
        continue;
      }
      if (element instanceof HTMLStyleElement && element.hasAttribute("data-unsafe-css")) {
        this.unsafeCSSStyle = element;
        this.appliedUnsafeCSS = element.textContent;
        continue;
      }
      if ("diffsHeader" in element.dataset) {
        this.headerElement = element;
        this.lastRenderedHeaderHTML = void 0;
        continue;
      }
    }
    if (this.pre != null) {

  renderPreparedFile({ file, fileContainer, forceRender = false, preventEmit = false, containerWrapper, deferManagers = false, lineAnnotations, renderRange }) {
    this.editor?.__postponeBgTokenizeToNextFrame();
    const { collapsed = false, themeType = "system" } = this.options;
    const nextRenderRange = collapsed ? void 0 : renderRange;
    const previousRenderRange = this.renderRange;
    const themeChanged = this.hasThemeChanged();
    const annotationsChanged = lineAnnotations != null && (lineAnnotations.length > 0 || this.lineAnnotations.length > 0) ? lineAnnotations !== this.lineAnnotations : false;
    const didFileChange = !areFilesEqual(this.file, file) || this.fileRenderer.hasUnkeyedFileContentsChanged(file);
    if (!collapsed && !forceRender && areRenderRangesEqual(nextRenderRange, this.renderRange) && !didFileChange && !annotationsChanged && !themeChanged) return this.applyCachedThemeState(themeType);
    this.renderRange = nextRenderRange;
    if (didFileChange) this.cachedHeaderHTML = void 0;
    this.file = file;
    this.fileRenderer.setOptions(getFileRendererOptions(this.options));
    this.syncInteractionOptions();
    if (lineAnnotations != null) this.setLineAnnotations(lineAnnotations);
    this.fileRenderer.setLineAnnotations(this.lineAnnotations);
    const { disableErrorHandling = false, disableFileHeader = false } = this.options;
    if (disableFileHeader) {
      if (this.headerElement != null) {
        this.headerElement.remove();
        this.headerElement = void 0;
        this.lastRenderedHeaderHTML = void 0;
      }
      this.clearHeaderSlots();
    }
    fileContainer = this.getOrCreateFileContainerNode(fileContainer, containerWrapper);
    this.applyCachedThemeState(themeType);
    if (collapsed) {
      this.removeRenderedCode();
      this.clearAuxiliaryNodes();
      try {
        const fileResult = this.fileRenderer.renderFile(file, EMPTY_RENDER_RANGE);
        if (fileResult != null) this.applyThemeState(fileContainer, fileResult.themeStyles, themeType, fileResult.baseThemeType);
        if (fileResult?.headerAST != null) this.applyHeaderToDOM(fileResult.headerAST, fileContainer);
        this.injectUnsafeCSS();
      } catch (error) {
        if (disableErrorHandling) throw error;
        console.error(error);
        if (error instanceof Error) this.applyErrorToDOM(error, fileContainer);
      }
      if (!preventEmit) this.emitPostRender();
      return true;
    }
    try {
      const pre = this.getOrCreatePreNode(fileContainer);
      if (!this.canPartiallyRender(forceRender, annotationsChanged, didFileChange || themeChanged) || !this.applyPartialRender(previousRenderRange, nextRenderRange)) {
        const fileResult = this.fileRenderer.renderFile(file, nextRenderRange);
        if (fileResult == null) {
          if (this.workerManager?.isInitialized() === false) this.workerManager.initialize().then(() => this.rerender());
          return false;
        }
        this.applyThemeState(fileContainer, fileResult.themeStyles, themeType, fileResult.baseThemeType);
        if (fileResult.headerAST != null) this.applyHeaderToDOM(fileResult.headerAST, fileContainer);
        this.applyFullRender(fileResult, pre);
      }
      this.applyBuffers(pre, nextRenderRange);
      this.injectUnsafeCSS();
      this.renderAnnotations();
      this.renderGutterUtility();
      this.managersDirty = true;
      if (!deferManagers) this.flushManagers();
      if (this.editor != null) this.syncRenderViewToEditor();
    } catch (error) {
      if (disableErrorHandling) throw error;
      console.error(error);
      if (error instanceof Error) this.applyErrorToDOM(error, fileContainer);
    }
    if (!preventEmit) this.emitPostRender();
    return true;
  }
  emitPostRender(unmount = false) {

    if (fileContainer == null) return;

    this.mounted = true;
    onPostRender?.(fileContainer, this, phase);
  }

  renderAnnotations() {
    if (this.isContainerManaged || this.fileContainer == null) {
      for (const { element } of this.annotationCache.values()) element.remove();
      this.annotationCache.clear();
      return;
    }
    const staleAnnotations = new Map(this.annotationCache);
    const { renderAnnotation } = this.options;
    if (renderAnnotation != null && this.lineAnnotations.length > 0) for (const [index, annotation] of this.lineAnnotations.entries()) {
      const id = `${index}-${getLineAnnotationName(annotation)}`;
      let cache = this.annotationCache.get(id);
      if (cache == null || !areLineAnnotationsEqual(annotation, cache.annotation)) {
        cache?.element.remove();
        const content = renderAnnotation(annotation);
        if (content == null) continue;
        cache = {
          element: createAnnotationWrapperNode(getLineAnnotationName(annotation)),
          annotation
        };
        cache.element.appendChild(content);
        this.fileContainer.appendChild(cache.element);
        this.annotationCache.set(id, cache);
      }
      staleAnnotations.delete(id);
    }
    for (const [id, { element }] of staleAnnotations.entries()) {
      this.annotationCache.delete(id);
      element.remove();
    }
  }

  applyThemeState(container, themeStyles, themeType, baseThemeType) {
    const shadowRoot = container.shadowRoot ?? container.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
    const effectiveThemeType = baseThemeType ?? themeType;
    const currentTheme = this.options.theme ?? DEFAULT_THEMES;
    const theme = typeof currentTheme === "string" ? currentTheme : { ...currentTheme };
    const scrollbarGutter = getMeasuredScrollbarGutter(shadowRoot);
    if (this.themeCSSStyle?.parentNode === shadowRoot && this.appliedThemeCSS?.themeStyles === themeStyles && this.appliedThemeCSS.themeType === effectiveThemeType && this.appliedThemeCSS.scrollbarGutter === scrollbarGutter) {
      this.appliedThemeCSS.theme = theme;
      return;
    }
    if (this.hasAdoptedThemeCSS && this.themeCSSStyle?.parentNode === shadowRoot) {
      this.hasAdoptedThemeCSS = false;
      this.appliedThemeCSS = {
        theme,
        themeStyles,
        themeType: effectiveThemeType,
        baseThemeType,
        scrollbarGutter
      };
      return;
    }
    this.themeCSSStyle = upsertHostThemeStyle({
      shadowRoot,
      currentNode: this.themeCSSStyle,
      themeCSS: wrapThemeCSS(themeStyles, effectiveThemeType, scrollbarGutter)
    });
    this.appliedThemeCSS = this.themeCSSStyle != null ? {
      theme,
      themeStyles,
      themeType: effectiveThemeType,
      baseThemeType,
      scrollbarGutter
    } : void 0;
  }

  applyFullRender(result, pre) {
    this.cleanupErrorWrapper();
    this.applyPreNodeAttributes(pre, result);
    const code = this.code = getOrCreateCodeNode({ code: this.code });
    const codeAst = this.fileRenderer.renderCodeAST(result);
    this.editor?.__captureFocusForDOMReplacement();
    const applyColumns = () => {
      if (code.childElementCount >= 2) for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const domEl = code.children[i];
        const astEl = codeAst[i];
        domEl.innerHTML = toHtml(astEl.children);
        domEl.style.cssText = astEl.properties.style;
      }
      else code.innerHTML = toHtml(codeAst);
      if (!pre.contains(code)) pre.replaceChildren(code);
    };
    if (this.shouldGuardRebuildScroll()) guardWebKitScrollDuringRebuild(pre, applyColumns);
    else applyColumns();
    this.lastRowCount = result.rowCount;
  }
  applyPartialRender(previousRenderRange, renderRange) {
    if (previousRenderRange == null || renderRange == null) return false;
    const { file, code } = this;
    const columns = code != null ? this.getColumns(code) : void 0;
    if (file == null || code == null || columns == null) return false;
    const previousStart = previousRenderRange.startingLine;
    const nextStart = renderRange.startingLine;
    const previousEnd = previousRenderRange.totalLines === Infinity ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : previousStart + previousRenderRange.totalLines;
    const nextEnd = renderRange.totalLines === Infinity ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : nextStart + renderRange.totalLines;
    const overlapStart = Math.max(previousStart, nextStart);
    const overlapEnd = Math.min(previousEnd, nextEnd);
    if (overlapEnd <= overlapStart) return false;
    if (!this.trimDOMToOverlap(columns.gutter, overlapStart, overlapEnd) || !this.trimDOMToOverlap(columns.content, overlapStart, overlapEnd)) throw new Error("File.applyPartialRender: failed to trim to overlap");
    let { length: rowCount } = columns.content.children;
    const renderChunk = (startingLine, totalLines) => {
      if (totalLines <= 0) return;
      return this.fileRenderer.renderFile(file, {
        startingLine,
        totalLines,
        bufferBefore: 0,
        bufferAfter: 0
      });
    };
    const prependResult = nextStart < overlapStart ? renderChunk(nextStart, overlapStart - nextStart) : void 0;
    if (prependResult === void 0 && nextStart < overlapStart) return false;
    const appendTotalLines = nextEnd === Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : Math.max(0, nextEnd - overlapEnd);
    const appendResult = nextEnd > overlapEnd ? renderChunk(overlapEnd, appendTotalLines) : void 0;
    if (appendResult === void 0 && nextEnd > overlapEnd) return false;
    this.cleanupErrorWrapper();
    if (prependResult != null) {
      columns.gutter.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", this.fileRenderer.renderPartialHTML(prependResult.gutterAST));
      columns.content.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", this.fileRenderer.renderPartialHTML(prependResult.contentAST));
      rowCount += prependResult.rowCount;
    }
    if (appendResult != null) {
      columns.gutter.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", this.fileRenderer.renderPartialHTML(appendResult.gutterAST));
      columns.content.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", this.fileRenderer.renderPartialHTML(appendResult.contentAST));
      rowCount += appendResult.rowCount;
    }
    if (this.lastRowCount !== rowCount) {
      columns.gutter.style.setProperty("grid-row", `span ${rowCount}`);
      columns.content.style.setProperty("grid-row", `span ${rowCount}`);
      this.lastRowCount = rowCount;
    }
    return true;
  }
  getColumns(code) {
    const gutter = code.children[0];
    const content = code.children[1];
    if (!(gutter instanceof HTMLElement) || !(content instanceof HTMLElement) || gutter.dataset.gutter == null || content.dataset.content == null) return;
    return {
      gutter,
      content
    };
  }
  trimDOMToOverlap(container, overlapStart, overlapEnd) {
    const boundaryIndices = this.getDOMBoundaryIndices(container, [overlapStart, overlapEnd]);
    const startIndex = boundaryIndices.get(overlapStart) ?? container.children.length;
    const endIndex = boundaryIndices.get(overlapEnd) ?? container.children.length;
    if (startIndex > endIndex) return false;
    for (let i = container.children.length - 1; i >= endIndex; i -= 1) container.children[i]?.remove();
    for (let i = startIndex - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) container.children[i]?.remove();
    return true;
  }
  getDOMBoundaryIndices(container, boundaries) {
    const sortedBoundaries = [...new Set(boundaries)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const boundaryIndices = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    if (sortedBoundaries.length === 0) return boundaryIndices;
    let boundaryIndex = 0;
    let nextBoundary = sortedBoundaries[boundaryIndex];
    const { children } = container;
    if (nextBoundary === 0) {
      boundaryIndices.set(0, 0);
      boundaryIndex += 1;
      nextBoundary = sortedBoundaries[boundaryIndex];
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i += 1) {
      const child = children[i];
      if (!(child instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      const lineIndex = this.getLineIndexFromDOMNode(child);
      if (lineIndex == null) continue;
      while (nextBoundary != null && lineIndex >= nextBoundary) {
        boundaryIndices.set(nextBoundary, i);
        boundaryIndex += 1;
        nextBoundary = sortedBoundaries[boundaryIndex];
      }
      if (boundaryIndex >= sortedBoundaries.length) break;
    }
    for (const boundary of sortedBoundaries) if (!boundaryIndices.has(boundary)) boundaryIndices.set(boundary, children.length);
    return boundaryIndices;
  }
  getLineIndexFromDOMNode(node) {
    const lineIndexAttr = node.dataset.lineIndex;
    if (lineIndexAttr == null) return;
    const parsed = Number(lineIndexAttr);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? void 0 : parsed;
  }
  applyBuffers(pre, renderRange) {
    if (renderRange == null || this.shouldDisableVirtualizationBuffers()) {
      if (this.bufferBefore != null) {
        this.bufferBefore.remove();
        this.bufferBefore = void 0;
      }
      if (this.bufferAfter != null) {
        this.bufferAfter.remove();
        this.bufferAfter = void 0;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (renderRange.bufferBefore > 0) {
      if (this.bufferBefore == null) {
        this.bufferBefore = document.createElement("div");
        this.bufferBefore.dataset.virtualizerBuffer = "before";
        pre.before(this.bufferBefore);
      }
      this.bufferBefore.style.setProperty("height", `${renderRange.bufferBefore}px`);
      this.bufferBefore.style.setProperty("contain", "strict");
    } else if (this.bufferBefore != null) {
      this.bufferBefore.remove();
      this.bufferBefore = void 0;
    }
    if (renderRange.bufferAfter > 0) {
      if (this.bufferAfter == null) {
        this.bufferAfter = document.createElement("div");
        this.bufferAfter.dataset.virtualizerBuffer = "after";
        pre.after(this.bufferAfter);
      }
      this.bufferAfter.style.setProperty("height", `${renderRange.bufferAfter}px`);
      this.bufferAfter.style.setProperty("contain", "strict");
    } else if (this.bufferAfter != null) {
      this.bufferAfter.remove();
      this.bufferAfter = void 0;
    }
  }

    return this.options.disableVirtualizationBuffers ?? false;

  applyHeaderToDOM(headerAST, container) {

    if (file == null) return;
    this.cleanupErrorWrapper();
    this.placeHolder?.remove();
    this.placeHolder = void 0;

    this.cachedHeaderHTML = headerHTML;

      else container.shadowRoot?.prepend(newHeader);

      this.headerPrefix?.remove();
      this.headerFilenameSuffix?.remove();
      this.headerMetadata?.remove();
      this.headerPrefix = void 0;
      this.headerFilenameSuffix = void 0;
      this.headerMetadata = void 0;

      const suffix = renderHeaderFilenameSuffix?.(file) ?? void 0;

      this.headerFilenameSuffix = this.upsertHeaderSlotElement(container, this.headerFilenameSuffix, HEADER_FILENAME_SUFFIX_SLOT_ID, suffix);
      this.headerMetadata = this.upsertHeaderSlotElement(container, this.headerMetadata, HEADER_METADATA_SLOT_ID, content);
      this.headerCustom?.remove();
      this.headerCustom = void 0;
    }
  }
  clearHeaderSlots() {
    this.headerPrefix?.remove();
    this.headerFilenameSuffix?.remove();
    this.headerMetadata?.remove();

    this.headerFilenameSuffix = void 0;

  upsertHeaderSlotElement(container, current, slot, content) {
    if (content == null) {
      current?.remove();
      return;
    }
    const element = current ?? this.createHeaderSlotElement(slot);
    if (current == null) container.appendChild(element);
    this.replaceHeaderSlotContent(element, content);
    return element;
  }
  replaceHeaderSlotContent(element, content) {
    element.replaceChildren();
    if (content instanceof Element) element.appendChild(content);
    else element.innerText = `${content}`;
  }
  createHeaderSlotElement(slot) {

    return element;
  }
  getOrCreateFileContainerNode(fileContainer, parentNode) {
    const { fileContainer: previousContainer } = this;
    const nextContainer = fileContainer ?? previousContainer ?? document.createElement("diffs-container");
    const containerChanged = previousContainer !== nextContainer;
    if (previousContainer != null && containerChanged) this.editor?.__captureFocusForDOMReplacement();
    if (containerChanged) this.emitPostRender(true);
    this.fileContainer = nextContainer;
    if (previousContainer != null && containerChanged) {
      this.lastRenderedHeaderHTML = void 0;
      this.headerElement = void 0;
    }
    if (parentNode != null && this.fileContainer.parentNode !== parentNode) parentNode.appendChild(this.fileContainer);
    if (containerChanged) this.adoptReusableShellElements(this.fileContainer);
    this.ensureSpriteSVG(this.fileContainer);
    return this.fileContainer;
  }
  adoptReusableShellElements(fileContainer) {
    const { shadowRoot } = fileContainer;
    if (shadowRoot == null) return;
    for (const element of shadowRoot.children) if (element instanceof SVGElement) this.spriteSVG ??= element;
    else if (isStyleNode(element) && element.hasAttribute("data-theme-css")) {
      this.themeCSSStyle ??= element;
      this.hasAdoptedThemeCSS = true;
    } else if (isStyleNode(element) && element.hasAttribute("data-unsafe-css")) {
      this.unsafeCSSStyle ??= element;
      this.appliedUnsafeCSS ??= this.options.unsafeCSS ?? void 0;
    }
  }
  ensureSpriteSVG(fileContainer) {
    const shadowRoot = fileContainer.shadowRoot ?? fileContainer.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
    if (this.spriteSVG == null) {
      const fragment = document.createElement("div");
      fragment.innerHTML = SVGSpriteSheet;
      const firstChild = fragment.firstChild;
      if (firstChild instanceof SVGElement) this.spriteSVG = firstChild;
    }
    if (this.spriteSVG != null && this.spriteSVG.parentNode !== shadowRoot) shadowRoot.appendChild(this.spriteSVG);
  }
  getOrCreatePreNode(container) {
    const shadowRoot = container.shadowRoot ?? container.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
    if (this.pre == null) {
      this.pre = document.createElement("pre");
      this.appliedPreAttributes = void 0;
      this.code = void 0;
      shadowRoot.appendChild(this.pre);
    } else if (this.pre.parentNode !== shadowRoot) {
      this.editor?.__captureFocusForDOMReplacement();
      container.shadowRoot?.appendChild(this.pre);
      this.appliedPreAttributes = void 0;
    }
    this.placeHolder?.remove();
    this.placeHolder = void 0;
    return this.pre;
  }
  syncCodeNodeFromPre(pre) {
    this.code = void 0;
    for (const child of Array.from(pre.children)) {
      if (!(child instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      if (child.hasAttribute("data-code")) {
        this.code = child;
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  applyPreNodeAttributes(pre, { totalLines }) {
    const { overflow = "scroll", disableLineNumbers = false } = this.options;
    const preProperties = {
      type: "file",
      split: false,
      overflow,
      disableLineNumbers,
      diffIndicators: "none",
      disableBackground: true,
      totalLines
    };
    if (arePrePropertiesEqual(preProperties, this.appliedPreAttributes)) return;
    setPreNodeProperties(pre, preProperties);
    this.appliedPreAttributes = preProperties;
  }
  applyErrorToDOM(error, container) {
    this.cleanupErrorWrapper();
    this.pre?.remove();
    this.pre = void 0;
    this.appliedPreAttributes = void 0;
    const shadowRoot = container.shadowRoot ?? container.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
    this.errorWrapper ??= document.createElement("div");
    this.errorWrapper.dataset.errorWrapper = "";
    this.errorWrapper.textContent = "";
    shadowRoot.appendChild(this.errorWrapper);
    const errorMessage = document.createElement("div");
    errorMessage.dataset.errorMessage = "";
    errorMessage.innerText = error.message;
    this.errorWrapper.appendChild(errorMessage);
    const errorStack = document.createElement("pre");
    errorStack.dataset.errorStack = "";
    errorStack.innerText = error.stack ?? "No Error Stack";
    this.errorWrapper.appendChild(errorStack);
  }
  cleanupErrorWrapper() {
    this.errorWrapper?.remove();
    this.errorWrapper = void 0;
  }
};

function shouldRenderHeader(headerElement, file, disableFileHeader = false) {
  return headerElement == null && file != null && !disableFileHeader;

function hasFileLayoutOptionChanged(previousOptions, nextOptions) {
  return (previousOptions.overflow ?? "scroll") !== (nextOptions.overflow ?? "scroll") || (previousOptions.collapsed ?? false) !== (nextOptions.collapsed ?? false) || (previousOptions.disableLineNumbers ?? false) !== (nextOptions.disableLineNumbers ?? false) || (previousOptions.disableFileHeader ?? false) !== (nextOptions.disableFileHeader ?? false) || previousOptions.unsafeCSS !== nextOptions.unsafeCSS;
}

  reconcileHeights() {
    let hasHeightChange = false;
    if (this.fileContainer == null || this.file == null) {
      if (this.height !== 0) hasHeightChange = true;
      this.height = 0;
      return hasHeightChange;
    }
    const { overflow = "scroll" } = this.options;
    this.top = this.getVirtualizedTop();
    if (overflow === "scroll" && this.lineAnnotations.length === 0 && !this.isResizeDebuggingEnabled()) return hasHeightChange;
    if (this.code == null) return hasHeightChange;
    const content = this.code.children[1];
    if (!(content instanceof HTMLElement)) return hasHeightChange;
    const hasFileAnnotations = includesFileAnnotations(this.lineAnnotations);
    if (this.renderRange != null && hasFileAnnotations && shouldRenderFileAnnotations(this.renderRange)) {
      const nextFileAnnotationHeight = measureFileAnnotationHeight(content) ?? 0;
      if (nextFileAnnotationHeight !== this.cache.fileAnnotationHeight) {
        this.cache.fileAnnotationHeight = nextFileAnnotationHeight;
        hasHeightChange = true;
      }
    } else if (!hasFileAnnotations && this.cache.fileAnnotationHeight !== 0) {
      this.cache.fileAnnotationHeight = 0;
      hasHeightChange = true;
    }
    for (const line of content.children) {
      if (!(line instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      const lineIndexAttr = line.dataset.lineIndex;
      if (lineIndexAttr == null) continue;
      const lineIndex = Number(lineIndexAttr);
      let measuredHeight = line.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      let hasMetadata = false;
      if (line.nextElementSibling instanceof HTMLElement && ("lineAnnotation" in line.nextElementSibling.dataset || "noNewline" in line.nextElementSibling.dataset)) {
        if ("noNewline" in line.nextElementSibling.dataset) hasMetadata = true;
        measuredHeight += line.nextElementSibling.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      }
      const expectedHeight = this.getLineHeight(lineIndex, hasMetadata);
      if (measuredHeight === expectedHeight) continue;
      hasHeightChange = true;
      if (measuredHeight === this.metrics.lineHeight * (hasMetadata ? 2 : 1)) this.cache.heights.delete(lineIndex);
      else this.cache.heights.set(lineIndex, measuredHeight);
    }
    if (hasHeightChange || this.isResizeDebuggingEnabled()) this.computeApproximateSize(true);
    return hasHeightChange;
  }

  getLinePosition(lineNumber) {
    if (this.file == null || lineNumber < 1) return;
    const { disableFileHeader = false, collapsed = false } = this.options;
    const lastLineIndex = this.fileRenderer.getLineCount(this.file) - 1;
    let top = getVirtualFileHeaderRegion(this.metrics, disableFileHeader);
    if (collapsed || lastLineIndex < 0) return {
      top,
      height: 0
    };
    const clampedLineIndex = Math.min(Math.max(lineNumber - 1, 0), lastLineIndex);

      top: top + clampedLineIndex * lineHeight,
      height: lineHeight

    top = checkpoint?.top ?? top;

  getNumericScrollAnchor(localViewportTop) {
    if (this.file == null || this.renderRange == null) return;
    const { disableFileHeader = false, collapsed = false, overflow = "scroll" } = this.options;
    if (collapsed || this.renderRange.totalLines <= 0) return;

    const firstRenderedLineIndex = Math.min(this.renderRange.startingLine, lastLineIndex);
    const lastRenderedLineIndex = Math.min(firstRenderedLineIndex + this.renderRange.totalLines - 1, lastLineIndex);
    if (lastRenderedLineIndex < firstRenderedLineIndex) return;

    if (overflow === "scroll" && !this.hasLineAnnotations()) {
      const { lineHeight } = this.metrics;
      const firstRenderedLineTop = headerRegion + (firstRenderedLineIndex === 0 ? fileAnnotationHeight : this.renderRange.bufferBefore);
      const lineIndex = firstRenderedLineIndex + Math.max(Math.ceil((localViewportTop - firstRenderedLineTop) / lineHeight), 0);
      if (lineIndex > lastRenderedLineIndex) return;
      return {
        lineNumber: lineIndex + 1,
        top: headerRegion + fileAnnotationHeight + lineIndex * lineHeight
      };
    }
    let top = headerRegion + (firstRenderedLineIndex === 0 ? fileAnnotationHeight : this.renderRange.bufferBefore);
    for (let lineIndex = firstRenderedLineIndex; lineIndex <= lastRenderedLineIndex; lineIndex++) {
      if (top >= localViewportTop) return {
        lineNumber: lineIndex + 1,

      };
      top += this.getLineHeight(lineIndex);
    }

  renderPreparedFile({ fileContainer, file, forceRender = false, lineAnnotations, ...props }) {
    const didFileChange = this.file == null || !areFilesEqual(this.file, file) || this.fileRenderer.hasUnkeyedFileContentsChanged(file);
    const { forceRenderOverride, isSetup } = this;
    this.forceRenderOverride = void 0;

      return false;
    }

      this.computeApproximateSize(false, file);
      const virtualizer = this.getSimpleVirtualizer();

      else {

        virtualizer.connect(fileContainer, this);
        this.isVisible = virtualizer.isInstanceVisible(this.top ?? 0, this.height);
      }
      this.isSetup = true;
    } else {
      this.top ??= this.getVirtualizedTop();

        this.getSimpleVirtualizer()?.markDOMDirty();
        this.resetLayoutCache(false);
        this.computeApproximateSize(false, file);
      }
    }

      file,
      fileContainer,
      renderRange,
      lineAnnotations,
      forceRender: (forceRenderOverride ?? forceRender) || annotationsChanged || didFileChange,
      ...props
    });
    if (this.isSimpleMode() && rendered) this.getSimpleVirtualizer()?.requestHeightReconcile(this);
    return rendered;

  addLayoutCheckpoint(lineIndex, top) {

  getLayoutCheckpointBeforeLineIndex(lineIndex) {
    if (lineIndex <= 0 || this.cache.checkpoints.length === 0) return;
    let low = 0;
    let high = this.cache.checkpoints.length - 1;
    let result;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = low + high >> 1;
      const checkpoint = this.cache.checkpoints[mid];
      if (checkpoint == null) throw new Error("VirtualizedFile: invalid checkpoint index");
      if (checkpoint.lineIndex <= lineIndex) {
        result = checkpoint;
        low = mid + 1;
      } else high = mid - 1;
    }
    return result;
  }
  getLayoutCheckpointBeforeTop(top, hunkLineCount) {
    let low = 0;
    let high = this.cache.checkpoints.length - 1;
    let resultIndex = -1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = low + high >> 1;
      const checkpoint = this.cache.checkpoints[mid];
      if (checkpoint == null) throw new Error("VirtualizedFile: invalid checkpoint index");
      if (checkpoint.top <= top) {
        resultIndex = mid;
        low = mid + 1;
      } else high = mid - 1;
    }
    if (hunkLineCount == null) return resultIndex >= 0 ? this.cache.checkpoints[resultIndex] : void 0;
    for (let index = resultIndex; index >= 0; index--) {
      const checkpoint = this.cache.checkpoints[index];
      if (checkpoint == null) throw new Error("VirtualizedFile: invalid checkpoint index");
      if (checkpoint.lineIndex % hunkLineCount === 0) return checkpoint;
    }
  }
  getVirtualizedTop() {
    if (this.virtualizer.type === "advanced") return this.virtualizer.getLocalTopForInstance(this);
    return this.fileContainer != null ? this.virtualizer.getOffsetInScrollContainer(this.fileContainer) : 0;
  }
  getSimpleVirtualizer() {
    return this.virtualizer.type === "simple" ? this.virtualizer : void 0;
  }
  getAdvancedVirtualizer() {
    return this.virtualizer.type === "advanced" ? this.virtualizer : void 0;
  }
  isResizeDebuggingEnabled() {
    return this.getSimpleVirtualizer()?.config.resizeDebugging ?? false;
  }
  computeRenderRangeFromWindow(file, fileTop, { top, bottom }) {
    const { disableFileHeader = false, overflow = "scroll" } = this.options;
    const { hunkLineCount, lineHeight } = this.metrics;
    const lineCount = this.fileRenderer.getLineCount(file);
    const fileHeight = this.height;
    const headerRegion = getVirtualFileHeaderRegion(this.metrics, disableFileHeader);
    const paddingBottom = lineCount > 0 ? getVirtualFilePaddingBottom(this.metrics) : 0;
    const { fileAnnotationHeight } = this.cache;
    const codeRegionTop = headerRegion + fileAnnotationHeight;
    const codeRowsHeight = Math.max(0, fileHeight - headerRegion - fileAnnotationHeight - paddingBottom);
    const hasFileAnnotations = includesFileAnnotations(this.lineAnnotations);
    const fileAnnotationTop = fileTop + headerRegion;
    const measuredFileAnnotationVisible = fileAnnotationHeight > 0 && hasFileAnnotations && fileAnnotationTop < bottom && fileAnnotationTop + fileAnnotationHeight > top;
    if (fileTop < top - fileHeight || fileTop > bottom) return {
      startingLine: 0,
      totalLines: 0,
      bufferBefore: 0,
      bufferAfter: fileHeight - headerRegion - paddingBottom
    };
    if (lineCount <= hunkLineCount) return {
      startingLine: 0,
      totalLines: hunkLineCount,
      bufferBefore: 0,
      bufferAfter: 0
    };
    const estimatedTargetLines = Math.ceil(Math.max(bottom - top, 0) / lineHeight);
    const totalLines = Math.ceil(estimatedTargetLines / hunkLineCount) * hunkLineCount + hunkLineCount;
    const totalHunks = totalLines / hunkLineCount;
    const viewportCenter = (top + bottom) / 2;
    if (overflow === "scroll" && !this.hasLineAnnotations()) {
      const sourceRowsTop = fileTop + codeRegionTop;
      const sourceRowsBottom = sourceRowsTop + codeRowsHeight;
      if (!measuredFileAnnotationVisible && !(sourceRowsTop < bottom && sourceRowsBottom > top)) return {
        startingLine: 0,
        totalLines: 0,
        bufferBefore: 0,
        bufferAfter: fileHeight - headerRegion - paddingBottom
      };
      const centerLine = Math.floor(measuredFileAnnotationVisible && viewportCenter < fileTop + codeRegionTop ? 0 : (viewportCenter - (fileTop + codeRegionTop)) / lineHeight);
      const idealStartHunk2 = Math.floor(centerLine / hunkLineCount) - Math.floor(totalHunks / 2);
      const totalHunksInFile = Math.ceil(lineCount / hunkLineCount);
      const startingLine2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(idealStartHunk2, totalHunksInFile)) * hunkLineCount;
      const clampedTotalLines2 = idealStartHunk2 < 0 ? totalLines + idealStartHunk2 * hunkLineCount : totalLines;
      const bufferBefore2 = startingLine2 === 0 ? 0 : fileAnnotationHeight + startingLine2 * lineHeight;
      const renderedLines = Math.min(clampedTotalLines2, lineCount - startingLine2);
      return {
        startingLine: startingLine2,
        totalLines: clampedTotalLines2,
        bufferBefore: bufferBefore2,
        bufferAfter: Math.max(0, (lineCount - startingLine2 - renderedLines) * lineHeight)
      };
    }
    const overflowHunks = totalHunks;
    const hunkOffsets = [];
    const checkpoint = this.getLayoutCheckpointBeforeTop(Math.max(0, top - fileTop - totalLines * lineHeight * 2), hunkLineCount);
    let absoluteLineTop = fileTop + (checkpoint?.top ?? codeRegionTop);
    let currentLine = checkpoint?.lineIndex ?? 0;
    let firstVisibleHunk;
    let centerHunk;
    let overflowCounter;
    const startingLineIndex = checkpoint?.lineIndex ?? 0;
    for (let lineIndex = startingLineIndex; lineIndex < lineCount; lineIndex++) {
      const isAtHunkBoundary = currentLine % hunkLineCount === 0;
      const currentHunk = Math.floor(currentLine / hunkLineCount);
      if (isAtHunkBoundary) {
        hunkOffsets[currentHunk] = absoluteLineTop - (fileTop + codeRegionTop);
        if (overflowCounter != null) {
          if (overflowCounter <= 0) break;
          overflowCounter--;
        }
      }
      const lineHeight2 = this.getLineHeight(lineIndex, false);
      if (absoluteLineTop > top - lineHeight2 && absoluteLineTop < bottom) firstVisibleHunk ??= currentHunk;
      if (absoluteLineTop + lineHeight2 > viewportCenter) centerHunk ??= currentHunk;
      if (overflowCounter == null && absoluteLineTop >= bottom && isAtHunkBoundary) overflowCounter = overflowHunks;
      currentLine++;
      absoluteLineTop += lineHeight2;
    }
    if (firstVisibleHunk == null) if (measuredFileAnnotationVisible) {
      firstVisibleHunk = 0;
      centerHunk = 0;
    } else return {
      startingLine: 0,
      totalLines: 0,
      bufferBefore: 0,
      bufferAfter: fileHeight - headerRegion - paddingBottom
    };
    centerHunk ??= firstVisibleHunk;
    const idealStartHunk = Math.round(centerHunk - totalHunks / 2);
    const maxStartHunk = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(lineCount / hunkLineCount) - totalHunks);
    const startHunk = Math.max(0, Math.min(idealStartHunk, maxStartHunk));
    const startingLine = startHunk * hunkLineCount;
    const clampedTotalLines = idealStartHunk < 0 ? totalLines + idealStartHunk * hunkLineCount : totalLines;
    const codeBufferBefore = hunkOffsets[startHunk] ?? 0;
    const bufferBefore = startingLine === 0 ? 0 : fileAnnotationHeight + codeBufferBefore;
    const finalHunkIndex = startHunk + clampedTotalLines / hunkLineCount;
    const bufferAfter = finalHunkIndex < hunkOffsets.length ? codeRowsHeight - hunkOffsets[finalHunkIndex] : codeRowsHeight - (absoluteLineTop - fileTop - codeRegionTop);
    return {
      startingLine,
      totalLines: clampedTotalLines,
      bufferBefore,
      bufferAfter: Math.max(0, bufferAfter)
    };
  }
};
function measureFileAnnotationHeight(content) {
  let height;
  for (const child of content.children) {
    if (!(child instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
    if (child.dataset.lineAnnotation !== FILE_ANNOTATION_DOM_KEY) continue;
    height = Math.max(height ?? 0, child.getBoundingClientRect().height);
  }
  return height;
}

function useFileInstance({ file, options, editorOptions, lineAnnotations, selectedLines, prerenderedHTML, metrics, hasGutterRenderUtility, hasCustomHeader, disableWorkerPool, edit }) {
  const simpleVirtualizer = useVirtualizer();
  const controlledSelection = selectedLines !== void 0;

  const createEditor = useCreateEditor();

        controlledSelection,
        hasCustomHeader,
        hasGutterRenderUtility,
        options
      }), simpleVirtualizer, metrics, !disableWorkerPool ? poolManager : void 0, true);

        controlledSelection,
        hasCustomHeader,
        hasGutterRenderUtility,
        options
      }), !disableWorkerPool ? poolManager : void 0, true);
      instanceRef.current.hydrate({
        file,
        fileContainer: node,
        lineAnnotations,
        prerenderedHTML
      });
    } else {
      if (instanceRef.current == null) throw new Error("File: A File instance should exist when unmounting");
      instanceRef.current.cleanUp();
      instanceRef.current = null;
    }
  });
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (instanceRef.current == null) return;
    const newOptions = mergeFileOptions({
      controlledSelection,
      hasCustomHeader,
      hasGutterRenderUtility,
      options
    });
    const forceRender = newOptions !== void 0 && !areOptionsEqual(instanceRef.current.options, newOptions);
    instanceRef.current.setOptions(newOptions);
    instanceRef.current.render({
      file,
      lineAnnotations,
      forceRender
    });
    if (selectedLines !== void 0) instanceRef.current.setSelectedLines(selectedLines);
  });
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (edit && instanceRef.current != null) {
      if (createEditor === void 0) throw new Error("File: EditContext is not attached");
      const editor = createEditor(editorOptions ?? {});
      if (editor == null) throw new Error("File: EditProvider.createEditor must return an editor instance");
      try {
        return editor.edit(instanceRef.current);
      } catch (error) {
        editor.cleanUp();
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }, [edit]);
  return {
    ref,
    getHoveredLine: reactExports.useCallback(() => {
      return instanceRef.current?.getHoveredLine();
    }, [])
  };
}

  };
}

function scrollMask({ start, end }) {
  if (!start && !end) return void 0;
  if (start && end) {
    return "linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 32px, black calc(100% - 32px), transparent)";
  }
  if (start) return "linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 32px, black 100%)";
  return "linear-gradient(to right, black 0, black calc(100% - 32px), transparent)";
}

function EntityPageRelationEntitiesRow({
  entities,
  label = "Related entities",
  className,
  variant = "badges"
}) {
  const viewportRef = reactExports.useRef(null);
  const [scrollEdges, setScrollEdges] = reactExports.useState({ start: false, end: false });
  const updateScrollEdges = reactExports.useCallback(() => {
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    if (!viewport) return;
    const maxScrollLeft = Math.max(0, viewport.scrollWidth - viewport.clientWidth);
    const next = {
      start: viewport.scrollLeft > 1,
      end: viewport.scrollLeft < maxScrollLeft - 1
    };
    setScrollEdges(
      (current) => current.start === next.start && current.end === next.end ? current : next
    );
  }, []);
  reactExports.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const viewport = viewportRef.current;
    if (!viewport) return;
    updateScrollEdges();
    viewport.addEventListener("scroll", updateScrollEdges, { passive: true });
    const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(updateScrollEdges);
    observer?.observe(viewport);
    for (const child of viewport.children) observer?.observe(child);
    return () => {
      viewport.removeEventListener("scroll", updateScrollEdges);
      observer?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [entities.length, updateScrollEdges]);
  const mask = scrollMask(scrollEdges);
  const scrollStyle = mask ? { maskImage: mask, WebkitMaskImage: mask } : void 0;
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("section", { className: cn$1("min-w-0", className), "aria-label": label, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    "div",
    {
      ref: viewportRef,
      "data-figma-layer": "Relations",
      "data-scroll-start": scrollEdges.start || void 0,
      "data-scroll-end": scrollEdges.end || void 0,
      style: scrollStyle,
      className: cn$1(
        "flex min-w-0 overflow-x-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden",
        variant === "inline" ? "gap-0.5" : "gap-2 pb-1"
      ),
      children: entities.map(
        (entity) => variant === "inline" ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(InlineRelation, { entity }, entity.id) : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(RelationBadge, { entity }, entity.id)
      )
    }
  ) });
}

function toneForValue(value, warn, bad, higherIsBetter) {
  if (higherIsBetter) {
    if (value >= warn) return "good";
    if (value >= bad) return "warn";
    return "bad";
  }
  if (value < warn) return "good";
  if (value < bad) return "warn";
  return "bad";
}

  good: "bg-[var(--info)]",

  bad: "bg-[var(--danger)]"

  warn: "var(--warn)",
  bad: "var(--danger)",
  muted: "var(--text-muted)"
};
function formatDuration(ms) {
  const totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1e3));
  const minutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
  const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  return `${hours}h ${minutes % 60}m`;
}
function HistoryChart({
  label,
  unit,
  max,
  series
}) {
  const pointCount = Math.max(1, ...series.map((s) => s.values.length));
  const indices = Array.from({ length: Math.min(pointCount, 90) }, (_, i) => {
    if (pointCount <= 90) return i;
    return Math.floor(i / 89 * (pointCount - 1));
  });
  const chartWidth = 240;
  const chartHeight = 72;
  const padX = 6;
  const padTop = 8;
  const padBottom = 10;
  const plotWidth = chartWidth - padX * 2;
  const plotHeight = chartHeight - padTop - padBottom;
  const barGap = indices.length > 60 ? 0.5 : 1;
  const barWidth = Math.max(1, plotWidth / indices.length - barGap);
  const totals = indices.map((idx) => series.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s.values[idx] ?? 0), 0));
  const linePoints = totals.map((total, i) => {
    const x = padX + i * (plotWidth / Math.max(1, indices.length - 1));
    const y = padTop + plotHeight - Math.min(1, total / max) * plotHeight;
    return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
  }).join(" ");
  const latestTotal = totals[totals.length - 1] ?? 0;
  const averageTotal = totals.length > 0 ? totals.reduce((sum, total) => sum + total, 0) / totals.length : 0;
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "py-1.5", children: [
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 mb-1", children: [
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("span", { className: "text-[var(--text-body)] text-[11px]", children: label }),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("span", { className: "text-[var(--text-muted)] text-[10px] tabular-nums", children: [
        "now ",
        latestTotal.toFixed(label === "CPU" ? 1 : 0),
        unit,
        " · avg ",
        averageTotal.toFixed(label === "CPU" ? 1 : 0),
        unit,
        " · scale ",
        max.toFixed(label === "CPU" ? 1 : 0),
        unit
      ] })
    ] }),
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
      "svg",
      {
        className: "h-24 w-full rounded bg-[var(--bg-inner)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]/50",
        viewBox: `0 0 ${chartWidth} ${chartHeight}`,
        preserveAspectRatio: "none",
        role: "img",
        "aria-label": `${label} process history chart`,
        children: [
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
            "line",
            {
              x1: padX,
              x2: chartWidth - padX,
              y1: padTop,
              y2: padTop,
              stroke: "var(--border-subtle)",
              strokeOpacity: "0.5",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke"
            }
          ),
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
            "line",
            {
              x1: padX,
              x2: chartWidth - padX,
              y1: padTop + plotHeight / 2,
              y2: padTop + plotHeight / 2,
              stroke: "var(--border-subtle)",
              strokeOpacity: "0.35",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke"
            }
          ),
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
            "line",
            {
              x1: padX,
              x2: chartWidth - padX,
              y1: padTop + plotHeight,
              y2: padTop + plotHeight,
              stroke: "var(--border-subtle)",
              strokeOpacity: "0.6",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke"
            }
          ),
          indices.map((idx, i) => {
            const x = padX + i * (plotWidth / indices.length);
            let y = padTop + plotHeight;
            return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("g", { children: [
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("title", { children: series.map((s) => {
                const value = s.values[idx] ?? 0;
                return `${s.label}: ${value.toFixed(label === "CPU" ? 1 : 0)}${unit}`;
              }).join(" · ") }),
              series.map((s) => {
                const value = s.values[idx] ?? 0;
                const segmentHeight = value > 0 ? Math.max(0.9, Math.min(plotHeight, value / max * plotHeight)) : 0;
                y -= segmentHeight;
                return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                  "rect",
                  {
                    x,
                    y,
                    width: barWidth,
                    height: segmentHeight,
                    fill: CHART_COLOR[s.tone],
                    opacity: "0.8"
                  },
                  s.label
                );
              })
            ] }, `${idx}-${i}`);
          }),
          linePoints && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
            "polyline",
            {
              points: linePoints,
              fill: "none",
              stroke: "var(--text-body)",
              strokeOpacity: "0.75",
              strokeWidth: "1",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke"
            }
          ),
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
            "text",
            {
              x: padX,
              y: chartHeight - 2,
              fill: "var(--text-muted)",
              fontSize: "6",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke",
              children: [
                indices.length,
                " samples"
              ]
            }
          ),
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
            "text",
            {
              x: chartWidth - padX,
              y: chartHeight - 2,
              fill: "var(--text-muted)",
              fontSize: "6",
              textAnchor: "end",
              vectorEffect: "non-scaling-stroke",
              children: "total"
            }
          )
        ]
      }
    ),
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("div", { className: "flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 mt-1", children: series.map((s) => {
      const last = s.values[s.values.length - 1] ?? 0;
      return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
        "span",
        {
          className: "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)]",
          children: [
            /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("span", { className: `inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full ${CHART_BAR[s.tone]}` }),
            s.label,
            " ",
            /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("span", { className: "tabular-nums", children: [
              last.toFixed(label === "CPU" ? 1 : 0),
              unit
            ] })
          ]
        },
        s.label
      );
    }) })
  ] });
}

function Meter({
  label,
  value,
  display: display2,
  max,
  warn,
  bad,
  higherIsBetter = false,
  hint,
  compact = false
}) {
  const tone = toneForValue(value, warn, bad, higherIsBetter);
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value / max * 100));
  const warnPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, warn / max * 100));
  const badPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, bad / max * 100));
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: compact ? "py-0.5" : "py-1", children: [
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 leading-tight", children: [
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(TooltipLabel, { label: hint ? `${label} — ${hint}` : label, side: "top", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("span", { className: "text-[var(--text-body)] truncate text-[11px]", children: label }) }),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("span", { className: `tabular-nums shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[tone]}`, children: display2 })
    ] }),
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "relative mt-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--bg-inner)] overflow-hidden", children: [
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        "div",
        {
          className: `h-full ${TONE_BAR[tone]} transition-[width] duration-300`,
          style: { width: `${pct}%` }
        }
      ),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        "div",
        {
          "aria-hidden": true,
          className: "absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-px bg-[var(--text-strong)]/15",
          style: { left: `${warnPct}%` }
        }
      ),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        "div",
        {
          "aria-hidden": true,
          className: "absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-px bg-[var(--text-strong)]/15",
          style: { left: `${badPct}%` }
        }
      )
    ] })
  ] });
}
