function EditableMarkdownBlock({
  children,
  node,
  body,
  bodyOffset,
  editable,
  onChange,
  renderView,
  textareaClassName
}) {
  const position = node?.position;
  const localStart = position ? offsetFromPosition(body, position.start) : 0;
  const localEnd = position ? offsetFromPosition(body, position.end) : 0;
  const sourceStart = bodyOffset + localStart;
  const sourceEnd = bodyOffset + localEnd;
  const rawText = position ? body.slice(localStart, localEnd) : "";
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    EditableSourceBlock,
    {
      rawText,
      sourceStart,
      sourceEnd,
      editable: editable && !!position,
      onChange,
      renderView,
      textareaClassName,
      children
    }
  );
}
function EditableSourceBlock({
  children,
  rawText,
  sourceStart,
  sourceEnd,
  editable,
  onChange,
  renderView,
  textareaClassName
}) {
  const textareaRef = reactExports.useRef(null);
  const openTimerRef = reactExports.useRef(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [fadingOut, setFadingOut] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [editBox, setEditBox] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [editHeight, setEditHeight] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [openingAnimated, setOpeningAnimated] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [editVisible, setEditVisible] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = reactExports.useState(rawText);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (openTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(openTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing || !textareaRef.current) return;
    const textarea = textareaRef.current;
    textarea.focus();
    textarea.select();
  }, [editing]);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing || !textareaRef.current) return;
    const textarea = textareaRef.current;
    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const nextHeight = textarea.scrollHeight;
      setEditHeight((currentHeight) => {
        if (currentHeight !== null && Math.abs(currentHeight - nextHeight) < 2) {
          setOpeningAnimated(false);
          setEditVisible(true);
          return currentHeight;
        }
        return nextHeight;
      });
      setEditVisible(true);
    });
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setOpeningAnimated(false);
    }, 160);
    return () => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [editing]);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing || openingAnimated || !textareaRef.current) return;
    setEditHeight(textareaRef.current.scrollHeight);
  }, [editing, openingAnimated, value]);
  const commit = async () => {
    if (!editing) return;
    setEditing(false);
    setEditVisible(false);
    if (value === rawText) return;
    await onChange(sourceStart, sourceEnd, value);
  };
  if (editing) {
    return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      Textarea,
      {
        ref: textareaRef,
        className: `block w-full resize-none overflow-hidden rounded-md border bg-[var(--bg-card-soft)]/45 px-1.5 py-1 text-[12.5px] leading-[1.6] text-[var(--text-strong)] outline-none ring-1 ${openingAnimated ? "border-transparent ring-transparent focus-visible:ring-transparent transition-[height,opacity] duration-150 ease-out" : "border-[var(--border-subtle)] ring-[var(--accent-soft)]/50 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[var(--accent-soft)]/50"} ${editVisible ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"} ${textareaClassName ?? ""}`,
        style: editBox ? {
          height: `${editHeight ?? editBox.height}px`,
          marginTop: editBox.marginTop,
          marginBottom: editBox.marginBottom
        } : void 0,
        value,
        onChange: (event) => setValue(event.target.value),
        onBlur: () => {
          void commit();
        },
        onKeyDown: (event) => {
          if (event.key === "Escape") {
            setValue(rawText);
            setEditing(false);
            setEditVisible(false);
            return;
          }
          if (event.key === "Enter" && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            void commit();
          }
        }
      }
    );
  }
  const startEdit = (target) => {
    if (!editable) return;
    setValue(rawText);
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const styles = window.getComputedStyle(target);
    setEditBox({
      height: rect.height,
      marginTop: styles.marginTop,
      marginBottom: styles.marginBottom
    });
    setEditHeight(rect.height);
    setOpeningAnimated(true);
    setEditVisible(false);
    setFadingOut(true);
    if (openTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(openTimerRef.current);
    openTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      openTimerRef.current = null;
      setFadingOut(false);
      setEditing(true);
    }, 90);
  };
  const activateEdit = (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    startEdit(event.currentTarget);
  };
  const activateTrigger = (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const target = event.currentTarget.previousElementSibling;
    if (target instanceof HTMLElement) startEdit(target);
  };
  const view = renderView({
    children,
    className: "-mx-1 rounded-md px-1 transition-[background-color,opacity] duration-100 " + (fadingOut ? "opacity-0 " : "opacity-100 ") + (editable ? "cursor-text hover:bg-[var(--bg-subtle)]/60" : ""),
    onClick: activateEdit
  });
  if (!editable) return view;
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(jsxRuntimeExports.Fragment, { children: [
    view,
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      "button",
      {
        type: "button",
        className: "sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-3 focus:top-3 focus:z-50 focus:rounded-md focus:border focus:border-[var(--border-subtle)] focus:bg-[var(--bg-card)] focus:px-2 focus:py-1 focus:text-[11px] focus:text-[var(--text-strong)] focus:shadow-sm",
        onClick: activateTrigger,
        onKeyDown: (event) => {
          if (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== " ") return;
          event.preventDefault();
          activateTrigger(event);
        },
        children: "Edit block"
      }
    )
  ] });
}

!function(){try{var e="undefined"!=typeof window?window:"undefined"!=typeof global?global:"undefined"!=typeof globalThis?globalThis:"undefined"!=typeof self?self:{},n=(new e.Error).stack;n&&(e._sentryDebugIds=e._sentryDebugIds||{},e._sentryDebugIds[n]="83b23c28-8088-515e-b36a-1eac383096d2")}catch(e){}}();
const OFFSET = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
const PRIME = 0x100000001b3n;
const MASK = 0xffffffffffffffffn;
function fnv1a64Hex(input) {
  let hash = OFFSET;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const code = input.charCodeAt(i);
    hash ^= BigInt(code & 255);
    hash = hash * PRIME & MASK;
    hash ^= BigInt(code >> 8 & 255);
    hash = hash * PRIME & MASK;
  }
  return hash.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}
const contentHash = (content) => `fnv1a64:${fnv1a64Hex(content)}`;
export {
  contentHash as c,
  fnv1a64Hex as f
};

function signalsSignature(clusters) {
  let signals = 0;
  let lastAt = 0;
  for (const cluster of clusters) {
    signals += cluster.counts?.signals ?? 0;
    lastAt = Math.max(lastAt, cluster.counts?.lastAt ?? 0);
  }
  return `${clusters.length}|${signals}|${lastAt}`;
}
const ANALYTICS_KEY = "improve/analytics";
const ANALYTICS_MAX_AGE_MS = 6e4;
const NO_ACTIVITY = "This workspace’s ledger does not report signal activity yet.";
const NO_COMPARISON = "Blume could not compare your signals right now.";
function useImproveAnalytics(ledger, revision) {
  const local = useOptionalSidecarHost();
  const scope = useAccountScope(ledger);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = reactExports.useState(0);
  const [answer, setAnswer] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const last = answer?.scope === scope ? null : readCached({ scope, key: ANALYTICS_KEY });
  const result = answer?.scope === scope ? answer : last ? { data: last.data, error: null } : null;
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const settle = (data, error) => {
      if (live) setAnswer({ scope, data, error });
    };
    if (!local) {
      settle(null, "Analytics count your messages on this computer: open the Blume app here.");
      return;
    }
    cachedLoad(
      { scope, key: `${ANALYTICS_KEY}#${revision}` },
      async () => {
        const value = await ledger.call("improve_activity", {}).catch(() => {
          throw new Error(NO_ACTIVITY);
        });
        const signals = (
          // A ledger without this read answers nothing: no hosted signals.
          (value?.signals ?? []).flatMap((signal) => signal.kind ? [{ at: signal.at, kind: signal.kind }] : [])
        );
        const data = await local.improve.getSignalAnalytics({ signals }).catch(() => {
          throw new Error(NO_COMPARISON);
        });
        writeCached({ scope, key: ANALYTICS_KEY }, data);
        return data;
      },
      ANALYTICS_MAX_AGE_MS
    ).then(
      (data) => settle(data, null),
      (error) => settle(null, error instanceof Error && error.message === NO_ACTIVITY ? NO_ACTIVITY : NO_COMPARISON)
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [ledger, scope, local, revision, attempt]);
  return {
    data: result?.data ?? null,
    loading: result === null,
    error: result?.error ?? null,
    reload: reactExports.useCallback(() => {
      invalidateCached(scope, `${ANALYTICS_KEY}#`);
      setAttempt((value) => value + 1);
    }, [scope])
  };
}

function ClusterDetails({
  data,
  actions
}) {
  const { cluster, project, improvements, signals, state, now } = data;
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const sections = useExpandableSections(() => ["improvement"]);
  const current = improvements.find((item) => item.id === cluster.improvementId) ?? improvements[0];
  const earlier = improvements.filter((item) => item !== current);
  const counts = cluster.counts;
  const list = signals ?? [];
  const signalCount = counts?.signals ?? list.length;
  const conversations = counts?.conversations ?? 0;
  const people = counts?.people ?? 0;
  const lastAt = counts?.lastAt ?? list[0]?.createdAt ?? null;
  const firstAt = clusterFirstSignalAt(cluster, list);
  const kinds = KINDS.map((kind) => ({
    kind,
    count: counts?.kinds?.[kind] ?? list.filter((signal) => signal.kind === kind).length
  })).filter((entry) => entry.count > 0);
  const deliveryIds = [
    ...new Set(list.flatMap((signal) => signal.deliveryId ? [signal.deliveryId] : []))
  ];
  const deliveries = deliveryIds.flatMap((id) => {
    const delivery = state.deliveries.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    return delivery ? [{ delivery, count: list.filter((signal) => signal.deliveryId === id).length }] : [];
  });
  const threadIds = [
    ...new Set(list.flatMap((signal) => signal.threadId ? [signal.threadId] : []))
  ];
  const agents = threadIds.flatMap((id) => {
    const thread = state.threads.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    return thread ? [{ thread, count: list.filter((signal) => signal.threadId === id).length }] : [];
  });
  const header = {
    view: "improve",
    kind: "Cluster",
    kindConcept: "cluster",
    title: cluster.title,
    titleEdit: {
      label: "Cluster name",
      maxLength: 160,
      editing: renaming,
      onEditingChange: setRenaming,
      onSubmit: async (title) => {
        const next = title.trim();
        if (next && next !== cluster.title) await actions.onRename(next);
        setRenaming(false);
      }
    },
    identity: { node: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ConceptIcon, { concept: "cluster", tileSize: "lg" }), shape: "tile" },
    status: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ClusterStatusFacet, { status: cluster.status, form: "badge", size: "sm" }),
    summary: [
      plural(signalCount, "signal", "signals"),
      plural(conversations, "conversation", "conversations"),
      plural(people, "person", "people")
    ].join(" · "),
    facts: [
      project ? {
        id: "project",
        label: "Project",
        // The fact is the link; the project is its reference (its flower and name, its Peek).
        value: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          ProjectReference,
          {
            project: {
              id: project.id,
              name: project.name,
              seed: repositoryFlowerSeed(project.repositories[0])
            }
          }
        ),
        link: { onSelect: () => actions.onOpenProject(project.id) },
        linkLabel: `Open project ${project.name}`
      } : { id: "visibility", label: "Visible to", value: "Only you", concept: "global" },
      ...project ? [
        {
          id: "visibility",
          label: "Visible to",
          value: "The project",
          icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(Users, { size: 14, "aria-hidden": true })
        }
      ] : [],
      {
        id: "fix",
        label: "Fix lands in",
        value: cluster.fixTarget === "repo" ? "The repository" : "Global setup",
        concept: cluster.fixTarget === "repo" ? "project" : "global"
      },
      { id: "first", label: "First signal", value: date(firstAt), concept: "activity" },
      ...cluster.aliases?.length ? [
        {
          id: "merged",
          label: "Merged from",
          value: plural(cluster.aliases.length, "cluster", "clusters"),
          concept: "cluster"
        }
      ] : [],
      ...lastAt ? [
        {
          id: "last",
          label: "Last signal",
          value: deliveryActivityLabel(lastAt, now),
          concept: "activity",
          metric: true
        }
      ] : []
    ],
    menu: [
      { label: "Open cluster page", onSelect: actions.onOpenClusterPage },
      { label: "Rename", icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(Pencil, { "aria-hidden": true }), onSelect: () => setRenaming(true) },
      ...actions.menu
    ]
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    PageContent,
    {
      as: "section",
      padding: "sm",
      stack: true,
      "data-cluster-details": cluster.key,
      "aria-label": cluster.title,
      children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(PageHeaderPage, { header, bodyClassName: "grid min-w-0 gap-2", children: [
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          ExpandableSection,
          {

const TRANSCRIPT_WINDOW = 8;
function useSignalMessage(host, signal) {
  const sidecar = useOptionalSidecarHost();
  const pointer = signal.evidence.find((evidence) => evidence.sessionId);
  const own = canOpenSignalMessage(signal);
  const [state, setState] = reactExports.useState({ status: "loading" });
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const done = (next) => {
      if (live) setState(next);
    };
    if (!own || !pointer?.sessionId) {
      done({
        status: "unavailable",
        message: signal.mine ? "This signal was recorded without a pointer to its message." : "Only the person whose message it was can read it. A signal carries the agent’s summary, never anyone’s words."
      });
      return;
    }
    if (!host.openConversationAt || !sidecar) {
      done({
        status: "unavailable",
        message: "Open the Blume desktop app on the computer where this was recorded to read the message."
      });
      return;
    }
    setState({ status: "loading" });
    host.openConversationAt({
      harness: pointer.harness,
      sessionId: pointer.sessionId,
      messageId: pointer.messageId ?? null
    }).then(async (location) => {
      if (location.status !== "local") {
        done({ status: "unavailable", message: "This message is on another computer." });
        return;
      }
      const transcript = await sidecar.conversations.getTranscript(location.conversationRef, {
        ...location.focus ? { aroundPosition: location.focus.turnPosition, focusEventId: location.focus.eventId } : {},
        limit: TRANSCRIPT_WINDOW
      });
      done({ status: "local", location, transcript });
    }).catch(
      () => done({
        status: "unavailable",
        message: "Blume could not open this conversation. Try again in a moment."
      })
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [host, sidecar, signal.id, own, pointer?.harness, pointer?.sessionId, pointer?.messageId, signal.mine]);
  return state;
}
function SignalMessage({ host, signal }) {
  const state = useSignalMessage(host, signal);
  const { open } = useAppRoute();
  const expansion = useScopedExpansionStore(`signal:${signal.id}`);
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    PageColumnCard,
    {
      header: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        CardHeaderLabel,
        {
          title: "Message",
          concept: "message",
          trailing: state.status === "local" && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
            Button,
            {
              type: "button",
              variant: "ghost",
              size: "xs",
              onClick: () => open(conversationPath(state.location.conversationRef, state.location.focus)),
              children: [
                "Open conversation",
                /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ArrowUpRight, { size: 12, "aria-hidden": true })
              ]
            }
          )
        }
      ),
      children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("div", { className: "min-w-0", "data-signal-message": true, children: state.status === "loading" ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("p", { role: "status", className: "m-0 cp-muted", children: "Finding the message on this computer…" }) : state.status === "unavailable" ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("p", { className: "m-0 cp-muted", children: state.message }) : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ExpansionStoreProvider, { value: expansion, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        ConversationTranscriptPreview,

function clusterActions(cluster, clusters, { onRename, onSetDismissed, onMerge }) {
  const targets = onMerge ? mergeTargets(clusters, cluster) : [];
  return [
    onRename && { label: "Rename", icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(Pencil, { "aria-hidden": true }), onSelect: onRename },
    onMerge && targets.length > 0 && {
      label: "Merge into",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(GitMerge, { "aria-hidden": true }),
      entries: targets.map((target) => ({
        label: target.title,
        onSelect: async () => {
          await onMerge(target);
        },
        confirm: {
          title: `Merge into “${target.title}”?`,
          body: "This cluster’s signals and improvement move into that one; agents may keep using either name.",
          confirmLabel: "Merge",
          busyLabel: "Merging…"
        }
      }))
    },
    { separator: true },
    onSetDismissed && (cluster.status === "dismissed" ? {
      label: "Restore cluster",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ArchiveRestore, { "aria-hidden": true }),
      onSelect: async () => {
        await onSetDismissed(false);
      }
    } : {
      label: "Dismiss cluster",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(X, { "aria-hidden": true }),
      onSelect: async () => {
        await onSetDismissed(true);
      }
    })
  ];
}

/*
 * A phase line: one 1px line down a list, drawn in pieces beside each item (`PhaseLineItem`) in the
 * colour of the phase the item is in, blending from the phase above where it changed. The pieces
 * meet edge to edge, so the line runs unbroken; the first starts at its marker and the last ends
 * there. Markers sit on the line in a 24px column, so its centre is 12px in.
 */
.phase-line-item {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
}
.phase-line-item > [data-slot='phase-line'] {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 11.5px;
  width: 1px;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--phase-line-from), var(--phase-line-to));
  /* Soft: the line sits behind the rows, not over them. */
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.phase-line-item[data-span='from-marker'] > [data-slot='phase-line'] {
  top: var(--phase-line-marker);
}
.phase-line-item[data-span='to-marker'] > [data-slot='phase-line'] {
  bottom: auto;
  height: var(--phase-line-marker);
}

/* A moment on the line: a small dot in its phase's colour, ringed in the surface so the line parts. */
.phase-line-dot {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  /* A circle, not the app's squircle corners. */
  corner-shape: round;
  /* As soft as the line, mixed rather than faded, so the line does not show through it. */
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--phase-line-to) 70%, var(--bg-card));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-card);
}
/* A session (its number inside, in a very small bold figure) or the line's end: a little larger. */

  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;

  /* The heaviest weight: at 7px anything lighter reads as regular. */
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/**
 * Baseline styles for the shared sidecar UI. Consumers import
 * `@blume/sidecar-ui/styles.css`. Intentionally minimal/themeable via CSS vars;
 * a host app can override these tokens.
 */

/* The brand lockup travels with the baseline styles so no shell can render
   `BlumeLogo` unstyled. Also available on its own as
   `@blume/sidecar-ui/blume-lockup.css` for surfaces that want nothing else. */
/**
 * The Blume lockup, in pure CSS.
 *
 * Consumers import `@blume/sidecar-ui/blume-lockup.css` (or get it transitively
 * from `styles.css`). React surfaces go through the `BlumeLogo` component; Astro
 * and plain-HTML surfaces use these classes directly. Either way the geometry
 * lives here once.
 *
 * The only input is `--blume-frame`: the size of the flower mark's 312×312
 * canvas. It is read as an inherited fallback rather than declared on the block,
 * so any ancestor can set it — which is how the marketing site drives responsive
 * lockups from a media query with no JS and no resize listener:
 *
 *   .site-nav__logo { --blume-frame: 46px; }
 *   @media (min-width: 640px) { .site-nav__logo { --blume-frame: 64px; } }
 *
 * The calc() factors are the derived ratios from `components/blumeLockup.ts`;
 * `testing/blumeLockup.test.ts` fails if the two drift apart. Do not hand-tune a
 * number here — change the spec in that file and let the test tell you what
 * these should become.
 */

/*
 * The shipped size steps. Mirrors `BLUME_LOCKUP_SIZES` in
 * `components/blumeLockup.ts`; the test asserts the two agree.
 *
 * Surfaces pick a step with `.blume-lockup--<step>` (or `<BlumeLogo size>`).
 * Responsive surfaces compose two steps in their own stylesheet by referencing
 * the tokens, so the numbers are never re-typed:
 *
 *   .site-nav__logo-mark { --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-lg); }
 *   @media (min-width: 640px) {
 *     .site-nav__logo-mark { --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-2xl); }
 *   }
 */
:root {
  --blume-lockup-size-xs: 24px;
  --blume-lockup-size-sm: 30px;
  --blume-lockup-size-md: 34px;
  --blume-lockup-size-lg: 38px;
  --blume-lockup-size-xl: 42px;
  --blume-lockup-size-2xl: 46px;
  --blume-lockup-size-3xl: 52px;
  --blume-lockup-size-4xl: 64px;
}

.blume-lockup--xs {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-xs);
}

.blume-lockup--sm {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-sm);
}

.blume-lockup--md {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-md);
}

.blume-lockup--lg {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-lg);
}

.blume-lockup--xl {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-xl);
}

.blume-lockup--2xl {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-2xl);
}

.blume-lockup--3xl {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-3xl);
}

.blume-lockup--4xl {
  --blume-frame: var(--blume-lockup-size-4xl);
}

/*
 * The original marketing composition shifted its 107px-square mark 21px left
 * to remove the transparent canvas inset. Opt-in surfaces can preserve that
 * optical edge while the canonical lockup continues to use frame-based
 * geometry. Width and both children lose the same inset, so their relationship
 * is unchanged and centring uses the visible composition rather than the padded
 * image canvas.
 */
.blume-lockup--trim-mark-start {
  --blume-mark-start-trim: calc(var(--blume-frame, 34px) * 0.19626168);
}

.blume-lockup {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  flex: none;

  height: var(--blume-frame, 34px);
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

   wordmark only widens the box. */

class SetupHistory {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.artifacts = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    this.versions = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    this.hash = options.hash ?? contentHash;
    this.now = options.now ?? (() => (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString());
  }
  /**
   * Observe one artifact's content. Creates the artifact + initial version when
   * new; appends a version when content changed; no-ops (returns the current
   * version) when content is unchanged. Metadata (parser/scanner version,
   * sourcePath) is refreshed on every observation regardless.
   */
  record(observation) {
    const id = setupArtifactId(setupArtifactKey(observation));
    const hash = this.hash(observation.content);
    const existing = this.artifacts.get(id);
    if (!existing) {
      const version2 = this.makeVersion(id, 1, hash, observation);
      const artifact = {
        id,
        harnessId: observation.harnessId,
        scope: observation.scope,
        kind: observation.kind,
        currentVersionId: version2.id,
        parserVersion: observation.parserVersion,
        scannerVersion: observation.scannerVersion,
        ...observation.projectId ? { projectId: observation.projectId } : {},
        ...observation.workspaceLocationId ? { workspaceLocationId: observation.workspaceLocationId } : {},
        ...observation.sourcePath ? { sourcePath: observation.sourcePath } : {}
      };
      this.artifacts.set(id, artifact);
      this.versions.set(id, [version2]);
      return { artifact, version: version2, changed: true, created: true };
    }
    const history = this.versions.get(id);
    const current = history.find((v) => v.id === existing.currentVersionId);
    existing.parserVersion = observation.parserVersion;
    existing.scannerVersion = observation.scannerVersion;
    if (observation.sourcePath) existing.sourcePath = observation.sourcePath;
    if (current.contentHash === hash) {
      return { artifact: existing, version: current, changed: false, created: false };
    }
    const version = this.makeVersion(id, history.length + 1, hash, observation);
    history.push(version);
    existing.currentVersionId = version.id;
    return { artifact: existing, version, changed: true, created: false };
  }
  /**
   * Move the current pointer back one version (undo the latest change). Returns
   * the version that is now current, or `null` when already at the first
   * version (nothing to undo). History is preserved — re-applying creates a new
   * version on top.
   */
  undo(artifactId) {
    const artifact = this.artifacts.get(artifactId);
    const history = this.versions.get(artifactId);
    if (!artifact || !history) return null;
    const index = history.findIndex((v) => v.id === artifact.currentVersionId);
    if (index <= 0) return null;
    const previous = history[index - 1];
    artifact.currentVersionId = previous.id;
    return previous;
  }
  getArtifact(artifactId) {
    return this.artifacts.get(artifactId) ?? null;
  }
  currentVersion(artifactId) {
    const artifact = this.artifacts.get(artifactId);
    if (!artifact) return null;
    return this.versions.get(artifactId)?.find((v) => v.id === artifact.currentVersionId) ?? null;
  }
  listVersions(artifactId) {
    return [...this.versions.get(artifactId) ?? []];
  }
  getVersion(versionId) {
    for (const history of this.versions.values()) {
      const found = history.find((v) => v.id === versionId);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }
  listArtifacts(filter = {}) {
    const out = [];
    for (const artifact of this.artifacts.values()) {
      if (filter.scope && artifact.scope !== filter.scope) continue;
      if (filter.kind && artifact.kind !== filter.kind) continue;
      if (filter.harnessId && artifact.harnessId !== filter.harnessId) continue;
      if (filter.projectId && artifact.projectId !== filter.projectId) continue;
      const current = this.currentVersion(artifact.id);
      if (current) out.push({ artifact, current });
    }
    return out;
  }

      rawShape: obs.rawShape ?? null,
      contentHash: hash,
      createdAt: this.now(),
      createdBy: obs.createdBy ?? "scanner"
    };
  }

          let content;

          } catch {

            scope: "global",

            sourcePath: entry.contentPath,
            content,
            parserVersion: input.parserVersion,
            scannerVersion: input.scannerVersion,
            createdBy: "scanner"
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return this.deps.setup.ingestScan(observations);
  }

function normalizeProjectResolutionPath(path) {
  const value = path.trim().replace(/\\/g, "/");
  if (!value) return null;
  let prefix;
  let remainder;
  let protectedSegments = 0;
  if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(value)) {
    prefix = `${value[0].toUpperCase()}:/`;
    remainder = value.slice(3);
  } else if (value.startsWith("//")) {
    prefix = "//";
    remainder = value.slice(2);
    protectedSegments = 2;
  } else if (value.startsWith("/")) {
    prefix = "/";
    remainder = value.slice(1);
  } else {
    return null;
  }
  const segments = [];
  for (const segment of remainder.split("/")) {
    if (!segment || segment === ".") continue;
    if (segment === "..") {
      if (segments.length > protectedSegments) segments.pop();
      continue;
    }
    segments.push(segment);
  }
  if (prefix === "//") {
    if (segments.length < protectedSegments) return null;
    return `//${segments.join("/")}`;
  }
  return segments.length === 0 ? prefix : `${prefix}${segments.join("/")}`;
}
function projectResolutionPathContains(root, target) {
  if (root.endsWith("/")) return target.startsWith(root);
  return target === root || target.startsWith(`${root}/`);
}
function resolveProjectLocationForPath(projects, targetPath) {
  const candidates = projects.flatMap((project) => [
    {
      projectId: project.id,
      path: project.root
    },
    ...project.workspaceLocations.map((workspace) => ({
      projectId: project.id,
      workspaceLocationId: workspace.id,
      path: workspace.path
    }))
  ]);
  return resolveProjectLocationCandidates(candidates, targetPath);
}
function resolveProjectLocationCandidates(candidates, targetPath) {
  const target = normalizeProjectResolutionPath(targetPath);
  if (!target) return null;
  const match = candidates.flatMap((candidate) => {
    const path = normalizeProjectResolutionPath(candidate.path);
    return path ? [{ ...candidate, path }] : [];
  }).filter((candidate) => projectResolutionPathContains(candidate.path, target)).sort((left, right) => right.path.length - left.path.length)[0];
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    projectId: match.projectId,
    ...match.workspaceLocationId ? { workspaceLocationId: match.workspaceLocationId } : {}
  };
}

function formatHoursMinutes(totalMinutes) {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.round(totalMinutes));
  const hours = Math.floor(safe / 60);
  const minutes = safe % 60;
  if (hours === 0) return `${minutes}m`;
  return `${hours}h ${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}m`;
}
function agentMinutes(activity) {
  return activity.sessions.reduce((total, session) => total + session.minutes, 0);
}

    display: (v) => `${v} at once`
  },

  },

    // Compared against the user's own median, never against other people.
    value: (a) => a.frictionMedian > 0 ? a.frictionSignals / a.frictionMedian : 0,
    display: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}× median`
  },
  {

  },

    id: "craft",
    name: "Setup upgrades",

    value: (a) => a.setupChanges,
    display: (v) => `${v} upgrades`
  }
];
const WRAPPED_MAX_LEVEL = 10;
function levelFor(value, thresholds) {
  let level = 1;
  for (const threshold of thresholds) if (value >= threshold) level += 1;
  return level;
}
function progressFor(value, thresholds) {
  const level = levelFor(value, thresholds);
  if (level >= WRAPPED_MAX_LEVEL) return 1;
  const low = level === 1 ? 0 : thresholds[level - 2];
  const high = thresholds[level - 1];
  const withinLevel = high > low ? (value - low) / (high - low) : 0;
  const raw = (level - 1 + withinLevel) / (WRAPPED_MAX_LEVEL - 1);
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, raw));
}
function bloomCount(level) {
  if (level <= 7) return 1;
  if (level === 8) return 2;
  if (level === 9) return 3;
  return 5;
}
const WRAPPED_MIN_HISTORY_WEEKS = 3;
function normalCdf(z) {
  const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const x = Math.abs(z) / Math.SQRT2;
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x);
  const poly = t * (0.254829592 + t * (-0.284496736 + t * (1.421413741 + t * (-1.453152027 + t * 1.061405429))));
  const erf = 1 - poly * Math.exp(-x * x);
  return 0.5 * (1 + sign * erf);
}
const WRAPPED_MIN_COHORT_SUBJECTS = 10;
function levelFromMoments(value, mean, rawSigma) {
  const sigma = Math.max(rawSigma, Math.abs(mean) * 0.15, mean === 0 ? 1 : 0);
  const percentile = normalCdf((value - mean) / sigma);
  const level = Math.min(WRAPPED_MAX_LEVEL, Math.max(1, 1 + Math.floor(percentile * 10)));
  return { level, progress: percentile };
}
function levelFromCohort(value, stats) {
  if (!stats) return null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(stats.mean) || !Number.isFinite(stats.sigma) || stats.sigma < 0) return null;
  if (stats.subjects < WRAPPED_MIN_COHORT_SUBJECTS) return null;
  return levelFromMoments(value, stats.mean, stats.sigma);
}
function levelFromHistory(value, history) {
  if (history.length < WRAPPED_MIN_HISTORY_WEEKS) return null;
  const mean = history.reduce((sum, sample) => sum + sample, 0) / history.length;
  const variance = history.reduce((sum, sample) => sum + (sample - mean) ** 2, 0) / history.length;
  return levelFromMoments(value, mean, Math.sqrt(variance));
}
function computeBadges(activity, options = {}) {
  const { history = {}, cohort = {} } = options;
  return WRAPPED_BADGES.map((def) => {
    const value = def.value(activity);
    const scaled = levelFromCohort(value, cohort[def.id]) ?? levelFromHistory(value, history[def.id] ?? []);
    const level = scaled?.level ?? levelFor(value, def.thresholds);
    const progress = scaled?.progress ?? progressFor(value, def.thresholds);
    return {
      id: def.id,
      name: def.name,
      value,
      display: def.display(value),
      level,
      progress,
      blooms: bloomCount(level)
    };
  });
}
const PERSONA_PRIORITY = [
  "peak",
  "hours",
  "shipped",
  "tempest",
  "endurance",
  "nightowl",
  "flow",
  "craft"
];
function personaFor(badges) {
  const best = badges.reduce((max, badge) => Math.max(max, badge.level), 0);
  for (const id of PERSONA_PRIORITY) {
    const badge = badges.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (badge && badge.level === best) return badge.id;
  }
  return "hours";
}
function heroFor(persona, activity, badges) {
  const badge = (id) => badges.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
  const agentMinutes2 = activity.sessions.reduce((total, session) => total + session.minutes, 0);
  switch (persona) {
    case "peak":
      return {
        kicker: "at your peak",
        value: String(activity.peakParallel),
        unit: activity.peakParallel === 1 ? "agent" : "agents",
        detail: "running at once, you orchestrating"
      };
    case "shipped":
      return {
        kicker: "shipped this week",
        value: String(activity.prsMerged),
        unit: activity.prsMerged === 1 ? "PR" : "PRs",
        detail: `merged across ${activity.projectCount} ${activity.projectCount === 1 ? "project" : "projects"}`
      };
    case "tempest":
      return {
        kicker: "a rough week, weathered",
        value: (badge("tempest")?.value ?? 0).toFixed(1),
        unit: "×",
        detail: "the usual friction, shipped anyway"
      };
    case "endurance":
      return {
        kicker: "longest unattended run",
        value: formatHoursMinutes(activity.longestRunMinutes),
        detail: "agents working, keyboard untouched"
      };
    case "nightowl":
      return {
        kicker: "while you slept",
        value: String(Math.round(activity.nightSharePercent)),
        unit: "%",
        detail: "of the week ran after 10pm"
      };
    case "flow":
      return {
        kicker: "all week long",
        value: activity.averageParallel.toFixed(1),
        unit: activity.averageParallel === 1 ? "agent" : "agents",
        detail: "running on average, steady output"
      };
    case "craft":
      return {
        kicker: "sharpened the tools",
        value: String(activity.setupChanges),
        unit: activity.setupChanges === 1 ? "upgrade" : "upgrades",
        detail: "skills, hooks and rules improved"
      };
    case "hours":
    default: {
      const leverage = activity.typedMinutes > 0 ? agentMinutes2 / activity.typedMinutes : 0;
      const detail = leverage > 0 ? `you typed for ${formatHoursMinutes(activity.typedMinutes)}, ${leverage.toFixed(
        1
      )}× leverage` : "agents working while you were away";
      return {
        kicker: "your agents worked",
        value: formatHoursMinutes(agentMinutes2),
        detail
      };
    }
  }
}
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1e3;
function formatLocalDate(date) {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}
function periodFromMonday(start) {
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setDate(end.getDate() + 7);
  return {
    periodStart: formatLocalDate(start),
    startMs: start.getTime(),
    endMs: end.getTime(),
    kind: "weekly"
  };
}
function weekStartDate(ms) {
  const date = new Date(ms);
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const daysSinceMonday = (date.getDay() + 6) % 7;
  date.setDate(date.getDate() - daysSinceMonday);
  return date;
}
function previousWeekPeriod(nowMs) {
  const thisMonday = weekStartDate(nowMs);
  const start = new Date(thisMonday);
  start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
  return periodFromMonday(start);
}
function weeklyPeriodFromStart(periodStart) {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(periodStart);
  if (!match) return null;
  const year = Number(match[1]);
  const month = Number(match[2]);
  const day = Number(match[3]);
  const start = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (start.getFullYear() !== year || start.getMonth() !== month - 1 || start.getDate() !== day || start.getDay() !== 1) {
    return null;
  }
  return periodFromMonday(start);
}
function lastSevenDaysPeriod(nowMs) {
  const end = new Date(nowMs);
  end.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);
  const start = new Date(end.getTime() - 7 * DAY_MS);
  return {
    periodStart: formatLocalDate(start),
    startMs: start.getTime(),
    endMs: end.getTime(),
    kind: "rolling"
  };
}
function wrappedIdFor(period) {
  return `${period.kind}:${period.periodStart}`;
}
const WRAPPED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4;
const MONTHS = [
  "JAN",
  "FEB",
  "MAR",
  "APR",
  "MAY",
  "JUN",
  "JUL",
  "AUG",
  "SEP",
  "OCT",
  "NOV",
  "DEC"
];
function rangeLabelFor(period) {
  const start = new Date(period.startMs);
  const end = new Date(period.endMs - 1);
  const startMonth = MONTHS[start.getMonth()];
  const endMonth = MONTHS[end.getMonth()];
  if (startMonth === endMonth) return `${startMonth} ${start.getDate()}–${end.getDate()}`;
  return `${startMonth} ${start.getDate()}–${endMonth} ${end.getDate()}`;
}
function bucketDays(period, activity) {
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => ({ sessions: [] }));
  const dayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1e3;
  for (const session of activity.sessions) {
    const offset = Math.floor((session.startedAtMs - period.startMs) / dayMs);
    if (offset < 0 || offset > 6) continue;
    days[offset].sessions.push(session);
  }
  for (const day of days) day.sessions.sort((a, b) => a.startedAtMs - b.startedAtMs);
  return days;
}
function buildWrappedSummary(period, activity, options = {}) {
  const badges = computeBadges(activity, { history: options.history, cohort: options.cohort });
  const persona = personaFor(badges);
  const projectKeys = [...new Set(activity.sessions.map((session) => session.projectKey))].sort();
  return {
    schemaVersion: WRAPPED_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    period,
    persona,
    hero: heroFor(persona, activity, badges),
    badges,
    sessionCount: activity.sessions.length,
    days: bucketDays(period, activity),
    projectKeys,
    rangeLabel: rangeLabelFor(period),
    ...options.flowerId ? { flowerId: options.flowerId } : {}
  };
}
function createMemorySetupStore(options) {
  const history = new SetupHistory(options);
  return {
    history,
    async listSetup(filter) {
      return history.listArtifacts(filter);
    },
    async getArtifact(artifactId) {
      return history.getArtifact(artifactId);
    },
    async getCurrentVersion(artifactId) {
      return history.currentVersion(artifactId);
    },
    async listVersions(artifactId) {
      return history.listVersions(artifactId);
    },
    async getVersion(versionId) {
      return history.getVersion(versionId);
    },
    async ingestScan(observations) {
      let created = 0;
      let changed = 0;
      let unchanged = 0;
      for (const observation of observations) {
        const result = history.record(observation);
        if (result.created) created++;
        else if (result.changed) changed++;
        else unchanged++;
      }
      return { created, changed, unchanged };
    },
    async createSetupVersion(change) {
      const result = history.record({ createdBy: "user", ...change });
      return result.version;
    },
    async undoSetupArtifact(artifactId) {
      return history.undo(artifactId);
    }
  };
}
function createMemorySettingsStore(seed = {}) {
  const map = new Map(Object.entries(seed));
  return {
    async getAll() {
      return Object.fromEntries(map);
    },
    async get(key) {
      return map.get(key) ?? null;
    },
    async set(key, value) {
      map.set(key, value);
    }
  };
}
function isRecord(value) {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function asString(value, fallback = "") {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : fallback;
}
function asCount(value) {
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(value)) : 0;
}
function asLevel(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) return 1;
  return Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(value)));
}
function toPeriodKind(value) {
  return value === "rolling" ? "rolling" : "weekly";
}
function parseSummary(summaryJson) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(summaryJson);
    return isRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
function toDayCounts(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.map(
    (day) => isRecord(day) && Array.isArray(day.sessions) ? day.sessions.length : 0
  );
}
function toBadgeViews(value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const badges = [];
  for (const entry of value) {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) continue;
    const id = asString(entry.id);
    if (!id) continue;
    badges.push({
      id,
      name: asString(entry.name, id),
      display: asString(entry.display),
      level: asLevel(entry.level)
    });
  }
  return badges;
}
function fallbackView(row) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    periodStart: asString(row.period_start),
    periodKind: toPeriodKind(row.period_kind),
    rangeLabel: asString(row.period_start),
    createdAt: asCount(row.created_at),
    persona: "hours",
    heroKicker: "",
    heroValue: "",
    heroDetail: "",
    sessionCount: 0,
    dayCounts: [],
    badges: [],
    summaryJson: ""
  };
}
function projectWrappedView(row) {
  const summary = parseSummary(asString(row.summary_json));
  if (!summary) return fallbackView(row);
  const raw = summary;
  const hero = isRecord(raw.hero) ? raw.hero : {};
  const heroUnit = asString(hero.unit);
  const period = isRecord(raw.period) ? raw.period : {};
  return {
    id: row.id,
    periodStart: asString(row.period_start) || asString(period.periodStart),
    periodKind: toPeriodKind(row.period_kind ?? period.kind),
    rangeLabel: asString(raw.rangeLabel) || asString(row.period_start),
    createdAt: asCount(row.created_at),
    persona: asString(raw.persona, "hours"),
    heroKicker: asString(hero.kicker),
    heroValue: asString(hero.value),
    ...heroUnit ? { heroUnit } : {},
    heroDetail: asString(hero.detail),
    sessionCount: asCount(raw.sessionCount),
    dayCounts: toDayCounts(raw.days),
    badges: toBadgeViews(raw.badges),
    summaryJson: asString(row.summary_json)
  };
}

const fixtureArchitectureSkill = `---
name: blume-architecture
description: Place shared product changes in the correct package and preserve Electron and Web Lab parity.
---

# Blume Architecture

Use this skill when a change affects package ownership, shared UI, host contracts, storage, parsing, or Electron background work.

## Decision path

1. Classify the change as shared UI, host contract, app-core policy, domain behavior, port, adapter, or shell-only behavior.
2. Trace the request through both Electron and Web Lab before changing a public contract.
3. Keep product behavior in shared packages and platform APIs in runtime adapters.
4. Move filesystem walks, parsing, and bulk database work out of Electron main.

## Required checks

- Run pnpm test:architecture.
- Run tests for every affected package.
- Compare Electron and Web Lab at the same sidecar width for user-visible changes.

Never fix a parity mismatch with a second shell-specific implementation.
`;

function createEmitter() {
  const subscribers = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  return {
    emit(value) {
      for (const subscriber of subscribers) subscriber(value);
    },
    subscribe(callback) {
      subscribers.add(callback);
      return () => {
        subscribers.delete(callback);
      };
    }
  };
}

function createSignalAnalyticsFixture(nowMs = Date.now()) {
  const daily = TOTAL_TURNS.map((totalTurns2, index) => {
    const affectedTurnCounts2 = {
      correction: AFFECTED_TURNS.correction[index],
      steering: AFFECTED_TURNS.steering[index],
      frustration: AFFECTED_TURNS.frustration[index]
    };
    const signalCounts2 = {
      correction: affectedTurnCounts2.correction + (index % 6 === 1 ? 1 : 0),
      steering: affectedTurnCounts2.steering + (index % 10 === 2 ? 1 : 0),
      frustration: affectedTurnCounts2.frustration
    };
    return {
      periodStart: new Date(nowMs - (TOTAL_TURNS.length - 1 - index) * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      totalTurns: totalTurns2,
      turnsWithAnySignal: Math.max(affectedTurnCounts2.correction, affectedTurnCounts2.steering) + affectedTurnCounts2.frustration,
      signalCounts: signalCounts2,
      affectedTurnCounts: affectedTurnCounts2,
      auditCheckCounts: {}
    };
  });
  const totalTurns = daily.reduce((total, day) => total + day.totalTurns, 0);
  const turnsWithAnySignal = daily.reduce((total, day) => total + day.turnsWithAnySignal, 0);
  const signalCounts = daily.reduce((totals, day) => {
    for (const type of Object.keys(totals)) totals[type] += day.signalCounts[type];
    return totals;
  }, emptyCounts());
  const affectedTurnCounts = daily.reduce((totals, day) => {
    for (const type of Object.keys(totals))
      totals[type] += day.affectedTurnCounts[type];
    return totals;
  }, emptyCounts());
  const signalRate = turnsWithAnySignal / totalTurns;
  return {
    local: {
      totalTurns,
      turnsWithAnySignal,
      signalRate,
      signalCounts,
      affectedTurnCounts,
      auditCheckCounts: {},
      daily
    },
    comparison: {
      schemaVersion: 1,
      windowDays: 30,
      cohortKind: "installation",
      cohortSize: 284,
      privacyThresholdMet: true,
      signalRate: { value: signalRate, percentile: 49 },
      signalsPerHundredTurns: {
        value: (signalCounts.correction + signalCounts.steering + signalCounts.frustration) / totalTurns * 100,
        percentile: 52
      },
      typeRates: {
        correction: {
          value: affectedTurnCounts.correction / totalTurns,
          percentile: 63,
          zones: { greenMax: 0.045, yellowMax: 0.08 }
        },
        steering: {
          value: affectedTurnCounts.steering / totalTurns,
          percentile: 48,
          zones: { greenMax: 0.055, yellowMax: 0.09 }
        },
        frustration: {
          value: affectedTurnCounts.frustration / totalTurns,
          percentile: 61,
          zones: { greenMax: 8e-3, yellowMax: 0.022 }
        }
      }
    },
    syncStatus: "synced",
    lastSyncedAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString()
  };
}

function fixtureWrappedSessions(period, count) {

      projectKey: projects[index % projects.length],
      startedAtMs,
      minutes: 18 + index * 13 % 95,
      turns: 3 + index * 5 % 22,
      finished: index % 4 !== 0
    };
  });
}

function createEchoTerminalHost(options = {}) {
  const tabs = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const output = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const statusChanged = createEmitter();
  const pageRequested = createEmitter();
  const commandExits = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  let counter = 0;
  const open = async (input, requestPage) => {
    const id = `tab_${++counter}`;
    const tab = {
      id,
      harnessId: input.harnessId,
      title: input.title ?? input.harnessId,
      status: "running",
      cwd: input.cwd ?? "/home/blume-session/project",
      ..."suggestions" in input && input.suggestions?.length ? { suggestions: input.suggestions } : {}
    };
    tabs.set(id, tab);
    output.set(id, createEmitter());
    commandExits.set(id, createEmitter());
    statusChanged.emit({ ...tab });
    if (requestPage) pageRequested.emit({ ...tab });
    if (input.command) {
      options.onCommandRun?.(id, input.command, {
        fire: (exitCode) => commandExits.get(id)?.emit(exitCode),
        write: (data) => output.get(id)?.emit(data)
      });
    }
    return { ...tab };
  };
  return {
    async listTabs() {
      return [...tabs.values()].map((t) => ({ ...t }));
    },
    openTab: (input) => open(input, false),
    openPage: (input) => open(input, true),
    async write(tabId, data) {
      output.get(tabId)?.emit(data);
    },
    async resize() {
    },
    async restart(tabId) {
      const tab = tabs.get(tabId);
      if (tab) {
        tab.status = "running";
        statusChanged.emit({ ...tab });
      }
    },
    async close(tabId) {
      tabs.delete(tabId);
      output.delete(tabId);
    },
    onCommandExit(tabId, callback) {
      let emitter = commandExits.get(tabId);
      if (!emitter) {
        emitter = createEmitter();
        commandExits.set(tabId, emitter);
      }
      return emitter.subscribe(callback);
    },
    onOutput(tabId, callback) {
      let emitter = output.get(tabId);
      if (!emitter) {
        emitter = createEmitter();
        output.set(tabId, emitter);
      }
      return emitter.subscribe(callback);
    },
    onStatus: (callback) => statusChanged.subscribe(callback),
    onPageRequested: (callback) => pageRequested.subscribe(callback)
  };
}

function usePluginPage(props) {
  const { host, threads, state } = props;
  const now = useRelativeActivityClock();
  const scan = usePluginScan(host);
  const installKeys = usePluginInstallKeys(host);
  const latest = BLUME_PLUGIN.version;
  const rows = pluginHarnessRows({ threads, scan: scan.scan, keys: installKeys.keys, latest, now });
  const step = pluginNextStep(rows, latest);
  const [installHarness, setInstallHarness] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const installRef = reactExports.useRef(null);
  const connected = threads.filter((thread) => !thread.revoked).length;
  const activeKeys = rows.flatMap((row) => row.keys);
  return {
    now,
    scan,
    installKeys,
    latest,
    rows,
    step,
    installHarness,
    setInstallHarness,
    installRef,
    openInstall: (harness) => {
      setInstallHarness(harness);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => installRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }));
    },
    refresh: () => {
      void scan.refresh();
      void installKeys.refresh();
    },
    inUse: rows.filter((row) => row.connected > 0 || row.local?.status === "installed"),
    current: rows.filter((row) => row.status.tone === "success").length,
    outdated: rows.filter((row) => row.status.label === "Update available"),
    connected,
    revoked: threads.length - connected,
    activeKeys,
    savedRepositories: state.usagePolicy?.repositories.length ?? 0,
    defaultMode: state.usagePolicy?.defaultMode === "use" ? "Use Blume" : "Ask when unclear"
  };
}

function scanText(model) {
  const { scan } = model.scan;
  if (model.scan.error) return model.scan.error;
  if (!scan) return "Checking this computer…";
  return scan.scope === "local" ? `Checked ${relativeTime(scan.checkedAt, model.now)}` : scan.note;
}
function pluginStatus(model) {
  if (model.outdated.length) return { label: "Update available", tone: "warn" };
  if (model.step?.kind === "repair") return { label: "Install unfinished", tone: "warn" };
  if (model.inUse.length) return { label: "In use", tone: "success" };
  if (model.step?.kind === "start") return { label: "Waiting for a conversation", tone: "info" };
  return { label: "Not set up", tone: "neutral" };
}

function pluginFacts(model, nav = {}, { sentence = false } = {}) {
  const at = (place) => place ? { place } : {};
  const lastReport = model.rows.reduce(
    (latest, row) => row.lastSeenAt && (!latest || row.lastSeenAt > latest) ? row.lastSeenAt : latest,
    null
  );
  const inUse = new Set(model.inUse.map((row) => row.key));
  const outdated = new Set(model.outdated.map((row) => row.key));
  const rank = (key) => outdated.has(key) ? 2 : inUse.has(key) ? 1 : 0;
  return {
    version: (place) => ({
      id: "version",
      label: "Latest version",
      value: sentence ? `Latest v${model.latest}` : `v${model.latest}`,
      concept: "plugin",
      ...at(place)
    }),
    lastReport: (place) => lastReport ? {
      id: "report",
      label: "Last report from an agent",
      value: sentence ? `Last report ${relativeTime(lastReport, model.now)}` : relativeTime(lastReport, model.now),
      concept: "activity",
      metric: true,
      ...at(place)
    } : null,
    computer: (place) => ({
      id: "computer",
      label: "This computer",
      value: sentence && model.scan.scan?.scope === "local" ? `This computer ${scanText(model).toLowerCase()}` : scanText(model),
      concept: "harness",
      metric: true,
      priority: "secondary",
      ...at(place)
    }),
    agents: (place) => ({
      id: "agents",
      label: "Agents",
      value: `${model.connected} connected${model.revoked ? `, ${model.revoked} revoked` : ""}`,
      concept: "agent",
      link: nav.onShowAgents ? { onSelect: nav.onShowAgents } : void 0,
      ...at(place)
    }),
    keys: (place) => model.installKeys.supported ? {
      id: "keys",
      label: "Installation keys",
      value: plural(model.activeKeys.length, "key"),
      concept: "setup",
      link: nav.onShowKeys ? { onSelect: nav.onShowKeys } : void 0,
      ...at(place)
    } : null,
    harnesses: (place) => [...model.rows].sort((a, b) => rank(b.key) - rank(a.key)).map((row) => ({
      id: `harness-${row.key}`,
      label: row.label,
      value: row.status.label,
      icon: harnessIcon(row.key),
      link: nav.onShowHarness ? { onSelect: () => nav.onShowHarness(row.key) } : void 0,
      priority: inUse.has(row.key) || outdated.has(row.key) ? "primary" : "secondary",
      ...at(place)
    })),
    /** What the package installs: MCP tools, skills, rules…; it leads to How it works. */
    package: (place) => ({
      id: "package",
      label: "Package",
      value: (() => {
        const parts = BLUME_PLUGIN.contents.filter((item) => item.included).map((item) => PACKAGE_WORDS[item.kind] ?? item.kind);
        const shown = parts.slice(0, 3).join(", ");
        return parts.length > 3 ? `${shown} +${parts.length - 3}` : shown;
      })(),
      concept: "artifact",
      link: nav.onShowGuide ? { onSelect: nav.onShowGuide } : void 0,
      linkLabel: "What the package includes",
      ...at(place)
    }),
    usage: (place) => ({
      id: "usage",
      label: "New conversations",
      value: model.defaultMode,
      concept: "usage",
      link: nav.onShowUsage ? { onSelect: nav.onShowUsage } : void 0,
      ...at(place)
    })
  };
}

const describe = (kind) => BLUME_PLUGIN.contents.find((item) => item.kind === kind)?.description ?? "";
function pluginContents() {
  const marker = "/__blume_plugin__";
  const files = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(convertBlumePlugin("claude", `${marker}/scripts/serve.mjs`)).map(
      ([path, content]) => [path, content.replaceAll(marker, PLUGIN_FOLDER)]
    )
  );
  const file = (path, language = "markdown") => ({
    path,
    content: files[path] ?? "",
    language
  });
  const tools = listedToolCounts();
  return [
    {
      id: "mcp",
      concept: "mcp",
      title: "MCP tools",
      summary: `${tools.total} tools · ${tools.reads} read, ${tools.writes} write`,
      description: describe("MCP"),
      reach: { when: "always", label: "Tool list always; results when called" },
      files: []
    },
    {
      id: "skills",
      concept: "skill",
      title: "Skills",
      summary: "blume, setup",
      description: describe("Skills"),
      reach: { when: "on-use", label: "Its description always; the process when used" },
      files: [
        file("skills/blume/SKILL.md"),
        file("skills/blume/references/testing.md"),
        file("skills/blume/references/tools.md"),
        file("skills/setup/SKILL.md")
      ]
    },
    {
      id: "hooks",
      concept: "hook",
      title: "Hooks",
      summary: PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENTS.map((hook) => hook.event).join(", "),
      description: describe("Hooks"),
      reach: {
        when: "always",
        label: "The card at every conversation start; messages when waiting"
      },
      files: [
        { path: "Session-start card", content: BLUME_PLUGIN.card + "\n", language: "markdown" },
        {
          path: "hooks/hooks.json",
          // The installer's own builder, with the plugin's path shown as a placeholder.
          content: JSON.stringify(
            blumeHooksConfig(
              `'/bin/sh' '${PLUGIN_FOLDER}/scripts/node.sh' '${PLUGIN_FOLDER}/scripts/hook.mjs'`
            ),
            null,
            2
          ) + "\n",
          language: "json"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: "scripts",
      concept: "command",
      title: "Connection script",
      summary: ".mcp.json",
      description: describe("Scripts"),
      reach: { when: "never", label: "Not in context: it runs the tools" },
      files: [
        {
          // As the installer writes it; the key stays in the agent's own settings, never shown here.
          path: ".mcp.json",
          content: JSON.stringify(
            blumeMcpConfig(
              {
                command: "/bin/sh",
                args: [`${PLUGIN_FOLDER}/scripts/node.sh`, `${PLUGIN_FOLDER}/scripts/serve.mjs`]
              },
              {
                endpoint: "<your workspace in Blume>",
                key: "<this agent’s private key>",
                appLink: "<how the agent opens Blume, when the app gives one>"
              },
              "<claude or codex>"
            ),
            null,
            2
          ) + "\n",
          language: "json"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: "docs",
      concept: "documentation",
      title: "README",
      summary: "README.md",
      description: describe("Docs"),
      reach: { when: "never", label: "Not in context: for people" },
      files: [file("README.md")]
    }
  ];
}

  const openTerminal = (harness) => {

  const install = (harness) => {
    if (installer.supported && (harness === "claude" || harness === "codex")) {
      setTab("overview");
      void installer.install([harness]);

  };
  const { route, update } = useAppRoute();

      return;

const VIEW_CONCEPTS = {
  overview: "plugin",
  installation: "agent",
  workflow: "workflow",
  tools: "mcp",
  setup: "setting"
};
function pluginViews(tabs) {
  return tabs.map((tab) => ({
    id: tab.id,
    chip: { concept: VIEW_CONCEPTS[tab.id] ?? "documentation", label: tab.label, count: tab.count },
    content: tab.content
  }));
}
function PluginRoute() {
  const { host, state, pending, act } = useHostedData();
  const { setPage, routeContext, openAgentConversation } = useHostedNavigation();
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(HostedPage, { children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("div", { className: "cp-plugin-page flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(PageTakeoverRegion, { children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("div", { className: "cp-plugin-scroll h-full min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    PluginPage,
    {
      host,
      state,
      pending,
      act,
      threads: state.threads.filter((thread) => !thread.mergedInto),
      onOpenAgentConversation: openAgentConversation,
      onOpenDeliveries: () => setPage("deliveries"),
      onOpenAgent: (threadId) => {
        const thread = state.threads.find((t) => t.id === threadId);
        if (!thread) return;
        setPage("projects");
        routeContext.update((route) => ({
          ...route,
          projectId: resolveProject(state, thread.project).id,
          projectSetup: void 0,
          projectAgent: threadId
        }));
      }
    }
  ) }) }) }) });
}

!function(){try{var e="undefined"!=typeof window?window:"undefined"!=typeof global?global:"undefined"!=typeof globalThis?globalThis:"undefined"!=typeof self?self:{},n=(new e.Error).stack;n&&(e._sentryDebugIds=e._sentryDebugIds||{},e._sentryDebugIds[n]="912c6b18-87f0-5031-a65b-8cd28dd1a91c")}catch(e){}}();
import { hx as reactExports, hy as readCached, fs as cachedLoad, gp as githubErrorText, iW as useHostResource, gw as hostSnapshotsEqual } from "./index-nrW_ocxo.js";
const GITHUB_FOCUS_REFRESH_MS = 6e4;
function repositoriesCache(projects, login) {
  return { scope: projects, key: `github.projects.list:${login ?? ""}` };
}
function useGitHubRepositories(projects, connected, login) {
  const cache = reactExports.useMemo(
    () => projects && connected ? repositoriesCache(projects, login) : void 0,
    [projects, connected, login]
  );
  const [list, setList] = reactExports.useState(
    () => cache ? readCached(cache)?.data : void 0
  );
  const [error, setError] = reactExports.useState("");
  const load = reactExports.useCallback(
    (refresh = false) => {
      if (!projects || !cache) return;
      void cachedLoad(cache, () => projects.list({ refresh })).then(
        (next) => {
          setList(next);
          setError("");
        },
        (e) => setError(githubErrorText(e))
      );
    },
    [projects, cache]
  );
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (!projects || !cache) {
      setList(void 0);
      return;
    }
    setList(readCached(cache)?.data);
    load();
    const onFocus = () => {
      if (Date.now() - (readCached(cache)?.at ?? 0) >= GITHUB_FOCUS_REFRESH_MS) load(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    const stop = projects.onChanged?.(() => load());
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
      stop?.();
    };
  }, [load, projects, cache]);
  return { list: cache ? list : void 0, error, reload: load };
}
function useLocalProjects(localHost) {
  return useHostResource(
    () => localHost ? localHost.projects.list() : Promise.resolve(null),
    (onChanged) => localHost ? localHost.projects.onChanged(onChanged) : () => {
    },
    [localHost],
    {
      isEqual: hostSnapshotsEqual,
      cache: localHost ? { scope: localHost, key: "projects.list" } : void 0
    }
  );
}
const CONVERSATION_LIMIT = 50;
function useProjectConversations(localHost, locals) {
  const ids = locals.map((local) => local.id).join("\n");
  return useHostResource(
    async () => {
      if (!localHost) return null;
      if (!ids) return [];
      const pages = await Promise.all(
        ids.split("\n").map(
          (projectId) => localHost.conversations.list({
            projectId,
            includeDismissed: true,
            limit: CONVERSATION_LIMIT
          })
        )
      );
      return pages.flat().sort((a, b) => b.lastActivityTs - a.lastActivityTs).slice(0, CONVERSATION_LIMIT);
    },
    (onChanged) => localHost ? localHost.conversations.onChanged(onChanged) : () => {
    },
    [localHost, ids],
    {
      isEqual: hostSnapshotsEqual,
      debounceMs: 500,
      cache: localHost ? { scope: localHost, key: `projects.conversations:${CONVERSATION_LIMIT}:${ids}` } : void 0
    }
  );
}
export {
  useLocalProjects as a,
  useProjectConversations as b,
  useGitHubRepositories as u
};

function normalizeAbsoluteFolderPath(value) {
  if (/[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(value)) return null;
  const windows = /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(value) || value.startsWith("\\\\") || value.startsWith("//");
  const path = windows ? normalizePathSeparators(value) : value;
  if (path.split("/").some((part) => part === "." || part === "..")) return null;
  if (path.startsWith("//")) {
    if (!/^\/\/[^/?]+\/[^/]+(?:\/.*)?$/.test(path)) return null;
  } else if (windows) {
    if (!/^[A-Za-z]:\/.+/.test(path) || /^[A-Za-z]:\/+\s*$/.test(path)) return null;
  } else if (!path.startsWith("/") || /^\/+$/.test(path)) return null;
  return path.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}
function shellEscape(s) {
  return `'${s.replace(/'/g, `'\\''`)}'`;
}

function refKey(value) {
  return `${value.id}@${value.version}`;
}
function requireUniqueVersioned(values, context, path, label) {
  const identities = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const key = refKey(value);
    if (identities.has(key)) {
      context.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: `Duplicate ${label} identity "${key}"`,
        path: [...path, index]
      });
    }
    identities.add(key);
  }
}
function requireUniqueIds(values, context, path, label) {
  const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    if (ids.has(value.id)) {
      context.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: `Duplicate active ${label} id "${value.id}"`,
        path: [...path, index, "id"]
      });
    }
    ids.add(value.id);
  }
}
function validateLifecycleState(value, context, path) {
  if (value.enabled !== (value.status === "active")) {
    context.addIssue({
      code: "custom",
      message: "Only active catalog entities may be enabled",
      path: [...path, "enabled"]
    });
  }
}
object({

      context.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: "Driver capabilities must be unique",
        path: ["drivers", driverIndex, "capabilities"]
      });
    }
  }
  requireUniqueVersioned(catalog.authentications, context, ["authentications"], "authentication");
  requireUniqueIds(catalog.authentications, context, ["authentications"], "authentication");
  requireUniqueVersioned(catalog.fixtures, context, ["fixtures"], "fixture");
  requireUniqueIds(catalog.fixtures, context, ["fixtures"], "fixture");
  requireUniqueVersioned(catalog.applications, context, ["applications"], "application");
  requireUniqueIds(catalog.applications, context, ["applications"], "application");
  const drivers = new Set(catalog.drivers.map(refKey));
  const driverCapabilities = new Map(
    catalog.drivers.map((driver) => [refKey(driver), new Set(driver.capabilities ?? [])])
  );
  const authentications = new Set(catalog.authentications.map(refKey));
  const fixtures = new Set(catalog.fixtures.map(refKey));
  const validateRefs = (value, path) => {
    for (const [field, known] of [
      ["driver", drivers],
      ["authentication", authentications],
      ["fixture", fixtures]
    ]) {
      const ref = value[field];
      if (!known.has(refKey(ref))) {
        context.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: `Unknown ${field} reference "${refKey(ref)}"`,
          path: [...path, field]
        });
      }
    }
  };
  for (const [applicationIndex, application] of catalog.applications.entries()) {
    validateLifecycleState(application, context, ["applications", applicationIndex]);
    requireUniqueVersioned(
      application.surfaces,
      context,
      ["applications", applicationIndex, "surfaces"],
      `surface in application "${application.id}"`
    );
    requireUniqueIds(
      application.surfaces,
      context,
      ["applications", applicationIndex, "surfaces"],
      `surface in application "${application.id}"`
    );
    for (const [surfaceIndex, surface] of application.surfaces.entries()) {
      const surfacePath = ["applications", applicationIndex, "surfaces", surfaceIndex];
      validateLifecycleState(surface, context, surfacePath);
      validateRefs(surface, surfacePath);
      const repeatedCapabilities = (surface.capabilities ?? []).filter(
        (capability, index) => surface.capabilities?.indexOf(capability) !== index
      );
      if (repeatedCapabilities.length > 0) {
        context.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: `Duplicate surface capability "${repeatedCapabilities[0]}"`,
          path: [...surfacePath, "capabilities"]
        });
      }
      const supportedCapabilities = driverCapabilities.get(refKey(surface.driver));
      for (const [capabilityIndex, capability] of (surface.capabilities ?? []).entries()) {
        if (supportedCapabilities && !supportedCapabilities.has(capability)) {
          context.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            message: `Surface capability "${capability}" is not supported by driver "${refKey(surface.driver)}"`,
            path: [...surfacePath, "capabilities", capabilityIndex]
          });
        }
      }
      if (surface.allowedOrigins && new Set(surface.allowedOrigins).size !== surface.allowedOrigins.length) {
        context.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: "Surface allowed origins must be unique",
          path: [...surfacePath, "allowedOrigins"]
        });
      }
      requireUniqueVersioned(
        surface.environments,
        context,
        [...surfacePath, "environments"],
        `environment in surface "${surface.id}"`
      );
      requireUniqueIds(
        surface.environments,
        context,
        [...surfacePath, "environments"],
        `environment in surface "${surface.id}"`
      );
      for (const [environmentIndex, environment] of surface.environments.entries()) {
        const environmentPath = [...surfacePath, "environments", environmentIndex];

        validateRefs(environment, environmentPath);
        if (refKey(environment.driver) !== refKey(surface.driver)) {
          context.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            message: `Environment driver "${refKey(environment.driver)}" must match its surface driver "${refKey(surface.driver)}"`,
            path: [...environmentPath, "driver"]
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
});

function normalize(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(normalize);
  if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
    const output = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort()) {
      const entry = value[key];
      if (entry !== void 0) output[key] = normalize(entry);
    }
    return output;
  }
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) {
    throw new TypeError("Canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers");
  }
  return value;
}
function canonicalJson(value) {
  return JSON.stringify(normalize(value));
}

  }).strict(),

  source: ScenarioAssertion,
  target: CompiledLocator.optional()

const ActionPlanStep = object({
  id: identifier,
  scenarioStepId: identifier,
  description: string().trim().min(1).max(500),
  action: CompiledAction.optional(),
  assertions: array(CompiledAssertion).max(50).default([]),
  preconditions: array(string().trim().min(1).max(1e3)).max(20).optional(),
  expectedPostconditions: array(string().trim().min(1).max(1e3)).max(50).optional(),
  timeoutMs: number().int().min(100).max(12e4)
}).strict().refine((step) => step.action !== void 0 || step.assertions.length > 0, {
  message: "A compiled step must contain an action, at least one assertion, or both"
});
function locatorPreservesSource(compiled, source) {
  return compiled.fallbacks.length === 0 && JSON.stringify(compiled.primary) === JSON.stringify(source);
}
function actionPreservesSource(compiled, source) {
  return actionMatchesSource(compiled, source, locatorPreservesSource);
}
function actionMatchesSource(compiled, source, locatorMatches) {
  switch (source.kind) {
    case "navigate":
      return compiled.kind === "navigate" && compiled.route === source.route;
    case "click":
      return compiled.kind === "click" && compiled.button === source.button && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
    case "fill":
      return compiled.kind === "fill" && compiled.value === source.value && compiled.sensitive === (source.sensitive ?? false) && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
    case "select":
      return compiled.kind === "select" && JSON.stringify(compiled.value) === JSON.stringify(source.value) && compiled.sensitive === (source.sensitive ?? false) && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
    case "check":
    case "uncheck":
    case "hover":
      return compiled.kind === source.kind && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
    case "press":
      return compiled.kind === "press" && compiled.key === source.key && JSON.stringify(compiled.modifiers) === JSON.stringify(source.modifiers ?? []) && (source.target === void 0 ? compiled.target === void 0 : compiled.target !== void 0 && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target));
    case "drag":
      return compiled.kind === "drag" && locatorMatches(compiled.source, source.source) && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
    case "wait":
      switch (source.for.kind) {
        case "visible":
          return compiled.kind === "wait-visible" && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.for.target);
        case "hidden":
          return compiled.kind === "wait-hidden" && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.for.target);
        case "route":
          return compiled.kind === "wait-route" && compiled.route === source.for.route;
        case "text":
          return compiled.kind === "wait-text" && compiled.value === source.for.value && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.for.target);
        case "network-idle":
          return compiled.kind === "wait-network-idle";
      }
    case "upload":
      return compiled.kind === "upload" && compiled.fixture === source.fixture && locatorMatches(compiled.target, source.target);
  }
}
const ActionPlanLifecycleStep = object({
  id: identifier,
  scenarioStepId: identifier,

  if (!actionPreservesSource(step.action, step.source)) {
    context.addIssue({

  }

const ActionPlan = object({
  schemaVersion: literal(1),
  scenarioId: identifier,
  scenarioHash: string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/),
  planHash: string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/).optional(),

  executorProtocolVersion: literal(1),
  createdAt: string().datetime(),
  createdBy: _enum(["ai-exploration", "accepted-repair", "hand-authored"]),
  /** Canonical configured execution driver kind. */
  driverKind: WebTestTargetKind.optional(),
  /** @deprecated Historical plan discriminator; use driverKind. */
  target: WebTestTargetKind.optional(),
  targetProvenance: WebTestTargetProvenance.optional(),
  capabilities: array(WebTestCapability).max(50).optional(),
  assumptions: object({
