  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
    "span",
    {
      "aria-hidden": true,
      style: { "--menu-option-accent": accent },
      className: "flex size-[18px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] border border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--menu-option-accent)_28%,var(--border-subtle))] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--menu-option-accent)_11%,var(--bg-inner))] text-[var(--menu-option-accent)]",
      children
    }
  );
}
const INDICATOR_SHAPE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "filled", label: "Filled", icon: createIndicatorShapeIcon("filled") },
  { value: "bordered", label: "Bordered", icon: createIndicatorShapeIcon("bordered") }
];
function MenuBarSettings({ cursorUsageAvailable = true }) {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = reactExports.useState(true);
  const [colored, setColored] = reactExports.useState(true);
  const [indicatorStyle, setIndicatorStyle] = reactExports.useState("filled");
  const [menuBarStatuses, setMenuBarStatuses] = reactExports.useState(DEFAULT_STATUS_CONTENT);
  const [menuBarUsageProviders, setMenuBarUsageProviders] = reactExports.useState(DEFAULT_MENU_BAR_USAGE_CONTENT);
  const [showConversations, setShowConversations] = reactExports.useState(true);
  const [showDropdownUsage, setShowDropdownUsage] = reactExports.useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = reactExports.useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = reactExports.useState(false);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const load = () => {
      void Promise.all([
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_ENABLED_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_STATUS_INDICATORS_COLORED_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_STATUS_INDICATOR_STYLE_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_STATUS_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_RUNNING_STATUS_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_WAITING_STATUS_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_FINISHED_STATUS_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_USAGE_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_CURSOR_USAGE_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_CLAUDE_USAGE_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_CODEX_USAGE_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_CONVERSATIONS_SETTING_KEY),
        host.settings.get(MENU_BAR_SHOW_USAGE_IN_DROPDOWN_SETTING_KEY)
      ]).then(
        ([
          enabledValue,
          coloredValue,
          indicatorStyleValue,
          showStatusValue,
          showRunningStatusValue,
          showWaitingStatusValue,
          showFinishedStatusValue,
          showUsageValue,
          showCursorUsageValue,
          showClaudeUsageValue,
          showCodexUsageValue,
          showConversationsValue,
          showDropdownUsageValue
        ]) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          const menuStatusDefault = showStatusValue !== "false";
          const menuUsageDefault = showUsageValue !== "false";
          setEnabled(enabledValue !== "false");
          setColored(coloredValue !== "false");
          setIndicatorStyle(indicatorStyleValue === "bordered" ? "bordered" : "filled");
          setMenuBarStatuses({
            running: settingBoolean(showRunningStatusValue, menuStatusDefault),
            waiting: settingBoolean(showWaitingStatusValue, menuStatusDefault),
            finished: settingBoolean(showFinishedStatusValue, menuStatusDefault)
          });
          setMenuBarUsageProviders({
            cursor: settingBoolean(showCursorUsageValue, menuUsageDefault),
            claude: settingBoolean(showClaudeUsageValue, menuUsageDefault),
            codex: settingBoolean(showCodexUsageValue, menuUsageDefault)
          });
          setShowConversations(showConversationsValue !== "false");
          setShowDropdownUsage(showDropdownUsageValue !== "false");
        }
      ).catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setEnabled(true);
        setColored(true);
        setIndicatorStyle("filled");
        setMenuBarStatuses(DEFAULT_STATUS_CONTENT);
        setMenuBarUsageProviders(DEFAULT_MENU_BAR_USAGE_CONTENT);
        setShowConversations(true);
        setShowDropdownUsage(true);
      }).finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    };
    load();
    const unsubscribe = host.settings.onChanged(load);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [host]);
  const toggleEnabled = reactExports.useCallback(() => {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    const next = !enabled;
    setEnabled(next);
    setSaving(true);
    host.system.captureEvent?.("menu_bar_enabled_changed", { enabled: next });
    void host.settings.set(MENU_BAR_ENABLED_SETTING_KEY, next ? "true" : "false").catch(() => {
      setEnabled(!next);
    }).finally(() => {
      setSaving(false);
    });
  }, [enabled, host, loading, saving]);
  const toggleColored = reactExports.useCallback(() => {
    if (loading || saving) return;
    const next = !colored;
    setColored(next);
    setSaving(true);
    host.system.captureEvent?.("menu_bar_status_indicators_changed", { colored: next });
    void host.settings.set(MENU_BAR_STATUS_INDICATORS_COLORED_SETTING_KEY, next ? "true" : "false").catch(() => {
      setColored(!next);
    }).finally(() => {
      setSaving(false);
    });
  }, [colored, host, loading, saving]);
  const setMonochromeIndicatorStyle = reactExports.useCallback(
    (next) => {
      if (loading || saving || indicatorStyle === next) return;
      const previous = indicatorStyle;
      setIndicatorStyle(next);
      setSaving(true);
      host.system.captureEvent?.("menu_bar_status_indicator_style_changed", { style: next });
      void host.settings.set(MENU_BAR_STATUS_INDICATOR_STYLE_SETTING_KEY, next).catch(() => {
        setIndicatorStyle(previous);
      }).finally(() => {
        setSaving(false);
      });
    },
    [host, indicatorStyle, loading, saving]
  );
  const saveBooleanSetting = reactExports.useCallback(
    (key, next, setter, eventName, eventProperties) => {
      if (loading || saving) return;
      setter(next);
      setSaving(true);
      host.system.captureEvent?.(eventName, eventProperties);
      void host.settings.set(key, next ? "true" : "false").catch(() => {
        setter(!next);
      }).finally(() => {
        setSaving(false);
      });
    },
    [host, loading, saving]
  );
  const toggleMenuBarStatus = reactExports.useCallback(
    (id) => {
      if (loading || saving) return;
      const next = !menuBarStatuses[id];
      setMenuBarStatuses((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: next }));
      setSaving(true);
      host.system.captureEvent?.("menu_bar_content_changed", {
        item: `status_${id}`,
        visible: next
      });
      void host.settings.set(MENU_BAR_STATUS_SETTING_KEYS[id], next ? "true" : "false").catch(() => {
        setMenuBarStatuses((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: !next }));
      }).finally(() => {
        setSaving(false);
      });
    },
    [host, loading, menuBarStatuses, saving]
  );
  const toggleMenuBarUsageProvider = reactExports.useCallback(
    (id) => {
      if (loading || saving || id === "cursor" && !cursorUsageAvailable) return;
      const next = !menuBarUsageProviders[id];
      setMenuBarUsageProviders((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: next }));
      setSaving(true);
      host.system.captureEvent?.("menu_bar_content_changed", { item: `usage_${id}`, visible: next });
      void host.settings.set(MENU_BAR_USAGE_SETTING_KEYS[id], next ? "true" : "false").catch(() => {
        setMenuBarUsageProviders((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: !next }));
      }).finally(() => {
        setSaving(false);
      });
    },
    [cursorUsageAvailable, host, loading, menuBarUsageProviders, saving]
  );
  const enabledUsageProviderOptions = USAGE_PROVIDER_OPTIONS.filter(
    (option) => option.id !== "cursor" || cursorUsageAvailable
  );
  const menuBarPickerDisabled = loading || saving || !enabled;
  const menuBarContentOptions = [
    ...STATUS_CONTENT_OPTIONS.map((option) => ({
      value: `status:${option.id}`,
      label: option.label,
      description: option.description,
      group: "Status",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(StatusBadge, { state: option.state, size: 18, renderSize: 18 })
    })),
    {
      value: "conversations",
      label: "Menu: Agents",
      description: "Agent list",
      group: "Menu Content",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(MenuOptionIconTile, { accent: CONCEPT_META.agent.accent, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(UsersRound, { size: 12, strokeWidth: 2 }) })
    },
    {
      value: "usage-rows",
      label: "Menu: Usage",
      description: "Usage details",
      group: "Menu Content",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(MenuOptionIconTile, { accent: CONCEPT_META.usage.accent, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(Gauge, { size: 12, strokeWidth: 2 }) })
    },
    ...enabledUsageProviderOptions.map((option) => ({
      value: `usage:${option.id}`,
      label: option.label,
      description: option.description,
      group: "Usage",
      icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(HarnessTile, { harness: option.source, size: "sm", showTooltip: false })
    }))
  ];
  const menuBarContentValues = [
    ...STATUS_CONTENT_OPTIONS.filter((option) => menuBarStatuses[option.id]).map(
      (option) => `status:${option.id}`
    ),
    ...showConversations ? ["conversations"] : [],
    ...showDropdownUsage ? ["usage-rows"] : [],
    ...enabledUsageProviderOptions.filter((option) => menuBarUsageProviders[option.id]).map((option) => `usage:${option.id}`)
  ];
  const changeMenuBarContents = (nextValues) => {
    const next = new Set(nextValues);
    const changedStatus = STATUS_CONTENT_OPTIONS.find(
      (option) => menuBarStatuses[option.id] !== next.has(`status:${option.id}`)
    );
    if (changedStatus) {
      toggleMenuBarStatus(changedStatus.id);
      return;
    }
    const changedUsage = enabledUsageProviderOptions.find(
      (option) => menuBarUsageProviders[option.id] !== next.has(`usage:${option.id}`)
    );
    if (changedUsage) {
      toggleMenuBarUsageProvider(changedUsage.id);
      return;
    }
    if (showConversations !== next.has("conversations")) {
      saveBooleanSetting(
        MENU_BAR_SHOW_CONVERSATIONS_SETTING_KEY,
        !showConversations,
        setShowConversations,
        "menu_bar_content_changed",
        { item: "conversations", visible: !showConversations }
      );
      return;
    }
    if (showDropdownUsage !== next.has("usage-rows")) {
      saveBooleanSetting(
        MENU_BAR_SHOW_USAGE_IN_DROPDOWN_SETTING_KEY,
        !showDropdownUsage,
        setShowDropdownUsage,
        "menu_bar_content_changed",
        { item: "dropdown_usage", visible: !showDropdownUsage }
      );
    }
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
    SettingsScreen,
    {
      title: "Menu Bar",
      description: "The macOS status item — flower, counters, and usage.",
      children: [
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          SettingsSection,
          {
            label: "Status item",
            footnote: "Colored indicators use status and harness colors in the menu bar; monochrome indicators draw as filled or bordered bubbles.",
            children: loading ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSkeletonGroup, { rows: 3 }) : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsGroup, { children: [
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                SettingsToggleRow,
                {
                  title: "Show menu bar item",
                  checked: enabled,
                  busy: saving,
                  onCheckedChange: toggleEnabled
                }
              ),
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                SettingsToggleRow,
                {
                  title: "Colored indicators",
                  checked: colored,
                  disabled: !enabled,
                  busy: saving,
                  onCheckedChange: toggleColored
                }
              ),
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                SettingsSegmentRow,
                {
                  title: "Indicator shape",
                  value: indicatorStyle,
                  options: INDICATOR_SHAPE_OPTIONS,
                  disabled: !enabled,
                  busy: saving,
                  onValueChange: setMonochromeIndicatorStyle
                }
              )
            ] })
          }
        ),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          SettingsSection,
          {
            label: "Contents",
            footnote: "Counters and usage gauges sit beside the flower; Menu items appear in the dropdown.",
            children: loading ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSkeletonGroup, { rows: 1 }) : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsGroup, { children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
              SettingsMultiSelectRow,
              {
                title: "Menu bar",
                "aria-label": "Menu bar contents",
                value: menuBarContentValues,
                options: menuBarContentOptions,
                disabled: menuBarPickerDisabled,
                busy: saving,
                removableTags: true,
                compactTags: true,
                maxVisibleTags: 5,
                placeholder: "Choose menu bar contents…",
                onValueChange: changeMenuBarContents
              }
            ) })
          }
        )
      ]
    }
  );
}
const SCREEN_TITLE = "MCP";
const SCREEN_DESCRIPTION = "Control whether local agents can connect and what they can do.";
function McpSettings({ onBack }) {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const settings = useAsync(() => host.agentMcp.getSettings(), [host], {
    cache: { scope: host, key: "agentMcp.getSettings" }
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [applyingClientId, setApplyingClientId] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [clientResults, setClientResults] = reactExports.useState({});
  const [clientErrors, setClientErrors] = reactExports.useState({});
  const inPageChrome = useInPageChrome();
  useSubHeader({ title: SCREEN_TITLE, onBack: inPageChrome ? void 0 : onBack }, "settings-mcp");
  if (settings.loading && settings.data === null) {
    return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsScreen, { title: SCREEN_TITLE, description: SCREEN_DESCRIPTION, children: [
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSection, { label: "Server", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSkeletonGroup, { rows: 3 }) }),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSection, { label: "Connect your agent", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSkeletonGroup, { rows: 3 }) }),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSection, { label: "MCP specification", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSkeletonGroup, { rows: 6 }) })
    ] });
  }
  if (settings.error && settings.data === null) {
    return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsScreen, { title: SCREEN_TITLE, description: SCREEN_DESCRIPTION, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsSection, { label: "Server", children: [
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsNote, { tone: "danger", icon: TriangleAlert, children: settings.error }),
      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsButton, { block: true, onClick: settings.reload, children: "Try again" })
    ] }) });
  }
  const value = settings.data;
  if (!value) return null;
  if (!value.supported) {
    return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsScreen, { title: SCREEN_TITLE, description: SCREEN_DESCRIPTION, children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsGroup, { children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      SettingsEmpty,
      {
        icon: Database,
        title: "Available in Blume Desktop",
        description: value.unavailableReason ?? "The MCP server connects to the local Blume database and requires the desktop app."
      }
    ) }) });
  }
  const patch = async (next) => {
    if (saving) return;
    setSaveError(null);
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      writeCached(
        { scope: host, key: "agentMcp.getSettings" },
        await host.agentMcp.setSettings(next)
      );
      settings.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      setSaveError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  const applyClientSetup = async (client) => {
    if (applyingClientId) return;
    setApplyingClientId(client.id);
    setClientErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [client.id]: void 0 }));
    try {
      const result = await host.agentMcp.applyClientSetup(client.id);
      setClientResults((current) => ({ ...current, [client.id]: result.detail }));
      settings.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      setClientErrors((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [client.id]: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      }));
    } finally {
      setApplyingClientId(null);
    }
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
    SettingsScreen,
    {
      title: SCREEN_TITLE,
      description: SCREEN_DESCRIPTION,
      actions: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsBadge, { tone: value.enabled ? "success" : "neutral", children: value.enabled ? "On" : "Off" }),
      children: [
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
          SettingsSection,
          {
            label: "Server",
            footnote: "Read only lets agents search and read Blume; Contribute also lets them add signals and drafts. Access changes apply when an agent reconnects.",
            children: [
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsGroup, { children: [
                /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                  SettingsToggleRow,
                  {
                    title: "Blume MCP",
                    icon: Server,
                    iconColor: CONCEPT_META.mcp.accent,
                    checked: value.enabled,
                    busy: saving,
                    onCheckedChange: (enabled) => void patch({ enabled })
                  }
                ),
                /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
                  ChoiceGroup,
                  {
                    "aria-label": "MCP access level",
                    value: value.permission,
                    busy: saving,
                    onValueChange: (permission) => void patch({ permission }),
                    children: [
                      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                        ChoiceRow,
                        {
                          value: "read",
                          title: "Read only",
                          description: "Search and read Blume",
                          badge: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsBadge, { tone: "accent", children: "Recommended" })
                        }
                      ),
                      /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                        ChoiceRow,
                        {
                          value: "contribute",
                          title: "Contribute",
                          description: "Add signals and drafts"
                        }
                      )
                    ]
                  }
                )
              ] }),
              saveError ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsNote, { tone: "danger", icon: TriangleAlert, children: saveError }) : null
            ]
          }
        ),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          SettingsSection,
          {
            label: "Connect your agent",
            footnote: "Each setup adds Blume to one agent's user-level config. Open a client to review the exact change before applying it.",
            children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsGroup, { children: [
              value.clients.length === 0 ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                SettingsEmpty,
                {
                  icon: Server,
                  title: "No supported agents",
                  description: "No user-level agent clients are available for automatic setup on this machine."
                }
              ) : value.clients.map((client) => /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                ClientSetupDisclosure,
                {
                  client,
                  applying: applyingClientId === client.id,
                  result: clientResults[client.id],
                  error: clientErrors[client.id],
                  onApply: () => void applyClientSetup(client)
                },
                client.id
              )),
              /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(PromptExamplesDisclosure, {})
            ] })
          }
        ),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(McpSpecificationSection, { specification: value.specification })
      ]
    }
  );
}

        PluginVersionFacet,
        {
          state: applying ? "installing" : error ? "failed" : applied ? "added" : "missing",

          of: client.label
        }
      ),
      summary: "MCP + skill",

        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("p", { className: "text-[11px] leading-[1.55] text-[var(--text-muted)]", children: [

        ] }),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          SettingsKeyValue,
          {
            entries: [

          }
        ),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsCode, { label: "Exact command", code: client.command }),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsCode, { label: "Exact SKILL.md", code: skillMarkdown }),
        result ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsNote, { tone: "success", icon: Check, children: [
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("span", { className: "font-semibold", children: "Applied:" }),

          client.label,
          ", then try",

          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(PromptCard, { size: "inline", prompt: client.verifyPrompt })
        ] }) : applied ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsNote, { tone: "success", icon: Check, children: [
          "Already in ",
          client.label,
          "’s user config. Try",
          " ",
          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(PromptCard, { size: "inline", prompt: client.verifyPrompt })
        ] }) : null,
        error ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsNote, { tone: "danger", icon: TriangleAlert, children: [
          error,
          " The setup worker rolls the skill back if the client command fails. You can copy the MCP command and SKILL.md above and apply them manually instead."
        ] }) : null,
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsButton, { variant: "primary", block: true, busy: applying, disabled: applied, onClick: onApply, children: applying ? "Applying…" : applied ? "Applied" : "Apply MCP and skill" })
      ]
    }
  );
}

const CONVERSATION_SCOPE_SETTING = "conversations.scope";
function conversationScopeFromSetting(value) {
  return value === "blume" ? "blume" : "all";
}
function projectSummary(row) {
  const conversations = row.local ? "On this computer" : row.conversations === 0 ? "No conversations yet" : row.conversations === 1 ? "1 conversation" : `${row.conversations} conversations`;
  const state = row.mode === "use" ? "Uses Blume" : row.mode === "skip" ? "Skipped" : row.mode === "ask" ? "Asks before using Blume" : row.mode === "mixed" ? "Differs per repository" : "Asks first · default";
  return `${state} · ${conversations}`;
}
function projectChoiceInput(version, row, choice) {
  return {
    expectedVersion: version,
    ...row.repositories.length === 1 ? { repository: row.repositories[0] } : { repositories: row.repositories },
    mode: choice === "default" ? "inherit" : choice
  };
}
function projectChoiceAction(version, row, choice, {
  recordId = (entry) => entry.id,
  repositoryChoice = false
} = {}) {
  if (row.computerOnly)
    return choice === "ask" ? null : { operation: "usage_configure", input: projectChoiceInput(version, row, choice) };
  return {
    operation: "project_set_usage",
    input: {
      projectId: recordId(row),
      usage: choice,
      // Default asks first: an older repository choice that would still apply goes in
      // the same write.
      ...choice === "default" && repositoryChoice ? { clearRepositoryChoices: true } : {}
    }
  };
}
function projectChoiceRows(rows, local, saved, same) {
  const identityOf = (project) => project.canonicalRemote ?? project.root;
  const onThisComputer = (repository) => local.some((project) => identityOf(project) && same(identityOf(project), repository));
  const ledger = rows.map(
    (row) => row.conversations === 0 && row.repositories.some(onThisComputer) ? { ...row, local: true } : row
  );
  const known = rows.flatMap((row) => row.repositories);
  const extra = [];
  for (const project of local) {
    const identity = identityOf(project);
    if (!identity) continue;
    if ([...known, ...extra.flatMap((row) => row.repositories)].some((r) => same(r, identity)))
      continue;
    extra.push({
      id: `local:${project.id}`,
      name: project.name,
      repositories: [identity],
      mode: saved.find((entry) => same(entry.repository, identity))?.mode ?? null,
      usesBlume: false,
      conversations: 0,
      local: true,
      computerOnly: true
    });
  }
  return [...ledger, ...extra];
}

function useLocalSetting(key) {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const [value, setValue] = reactExports.useState(void 0);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const read = () => void host.settings.get(key).then(
      (next) => live && setValue(next),
      () => live && setValue(null)
    );
    read();
    const unsubscribe = host.settings.onChanged(read);
    return () => {
      live = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [host, key]);
  return [
    value,
    (next) => {
      setValue(next);
      void host.settings.set(key, next).catch(() => void 0);
    }
  ];
}
function defaultModeOf(data) {
  return data?.state.usagePolicy?.defaultMode ?? "ask";
}

  const host = useSidecarHost();

  return choiceRowsOf(data, local);
}
function choiceRowsOf(data, local) {
  if (!data) return [];

    usageProjectRows(data.state),
    local,
    data.state.usagePolicy?.repositories ?? [],
    sameRepository
  );
}

function ProjectChoicesSettings() {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const data = useOptionalHostedData();
  const readsLocally = typeof host.settings.getConversationParseDefault === "function";
  const rows = useProjectChoiceRows(data);
  const options = choiceOptions(readsLocally);
  const recordId = (row) => data?.state.projects?.find((project) => project.id === row.id)?.id ?? data?.state.projects?.find(
    (project) => project.repositories.some(
      (repository) => sameRepository(repository, row.repositories[0] ?? "")
    )
  )?.id ?? row.id;
  const choose = (row, choice) => {
    if (!data) return;
    const action = projectChoiceAction(data.state.version, row, choice, {
      recordId,
      repositoryChoice: row.repositories.some(
        (repository) => data.state.usagePolicy?.repositories.some(
          (saved) => sameRepository(saved.repository, repository)
        )
      )
    });
    if (action) void data.act(action.operation, action.input);
  };
  const [skipping, setSkipping] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const requestChoice = (row, choice) => {
    if (!readsLocally || choice !== "skip" || row.mode === "skip") {
      choose(row, choice);
      return;
    }
    const ask = (counted) => setSkipping({
      row,
      removed: removedConversationsLabel(
        counted && (counted.count > 0 || counted.capped) ? counted : { count: row.conversations, capped: false },
        SKIP_FALLBACK
      )
    });
    void countConversationsForRepositories(host, row.repositories).then(ask, () => ask(null));
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(
    SettingsScreen,
    {
      title: "Project choices",
      description: "Whether agents use Blume in each project Blume knows.",
      children: [
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          SettingsSection,
          {
            footnote: readsLocally ? "A skipped project is left alone: its agents do not use Blume, and the app does not read its conversations." : "A skipped project is left alone: its agents do not use Blume there.",
            children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsGroup, { children: rows.length === 0 ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
              SettingsEmpty,
              {
                icon: FolderGit2,
                title: data?.loaded ? "No projects yet" : "Loading projects",
                description: data?.loaded ? "Projects appear here once an agent works in them." : void 0
              }
            ) : rows.map((row) => /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
              SettingsRow,
              {
                leading: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                  ProjectAvatar,
                  {
                    seed: row.avatar ?? repositoryFlowerSeed(row.repositories[0] ?? row.name),
                    size: 20
                  }
                ),
                title: row.name,
                description: projectSummary(row),
                trailing: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
                  SettingsSegmentControl,
                  {
                    label: `Blume in ${row.name}`,
                    display: "icons",
                    value: row.mode === null ? "default" : row.mode === "mixed" ? "" : row.mode,
                    options: row.computerOnly ? options.filter((option) => option.value !== "ask") : options,
                    disabled: !data?.loaded,
                    busy: data?.pending,
                    onValueChange: (choice) => requestChoice(row, choice)
                  }
                )
              },
              row.id
            )) })
          }
        ),
        /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
          DeleteConversationsWarning,
          {
            open: skipping !== null,
            title: `Skip ${skipping?.row.name ?? "this project"}?`,
            removed: skipping?.removed ?? "",
            confirmLabel: "Skip project",
            onConfirm: () => {
              if (skipping) choose(skipping.row, "skip");
              setSkipping(null);
            },
            onCancel: () => setSkipping(null)
          }
        )
      ]
    }
  );
}

      children
    }
  );
}

const HOSTED_RUNS_EXPLAINED = "Hosted test runs use Blume’s own browsers and AI, so your tests run while your computer is off or busy, and from pull requests.";

const BILLING_UNAVAILABLE = "Plans are set by Blume while billing is being built.";
const RANK = { free: 0, pro: 1, team: 2 };
const upgradePlan = (kind) => kind === "personal" ? "pro" : "team";
function planCardAction(plan, workspace, current, billing) {
  if (plan === current) return { kind: "current" };
  if (billing?.planOverride?.active) return { kind: "none" };
  const target = upgradePlan(workspace.kind);
  if (plan !== "free" && plan !== target)
    return workspace.kind === "personal" ? {
      kind: "elsewhere",
      text: "Team is an organization’s plan. Create an organization or switch to one to use it.",
      switchWorkspace: true
    } : {
      kind: "elsewhere",
      text: "Pro is for one person’s own workspace. Organizations use Team.",
      switchWorkspace: false
    };
  if (RANK[plan] < RANK[current] || billing === void 0) return { kind: "none" };
  if (!billing?.available) return { kind: "unavailable", text: BILLING_UNAVAILABLE };
  if (!billing.canManage)
    return { kind: "ask", text: `Ask an owner or admin of ${workspace.name} to upgrade.` };
  if (billing.subscription) return { kind: "none" };
  return { kind: "upgrade", label: `Upgrade to ${plan === "team" ? "Team" : "Pro"}` };
}
function useBilling(workspace) {
  const [billing, setBilling] = reactExports.useState();
  const load = reactExports.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!workspace) return;
    try {
      setBilling(await workspace({ action: "billing" }));
    } catch {
      setBilling(null);
    }
  }, [workspace]);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    const onFocus = () => void load();
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
  }, [load]);
  return { billing, reload: load };
}

function isLaunchAtLoginSelected(status) {
  return status?.status === "enabled" || status?.status === "requires-approval";
}
function launchAtLoginSummary(status) {
  if (status === null) return "Checking startup setting";
  if (status.status === "enabled") return "On · opens the Blume window";
  if (status.status === "requires-approval") return "Approval required in System Settings";
  if (status.status === "disabled") return "Off";
  return "Unavailable on this platform";
}
function SystemSettings({ composed = false } = {}) {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const canManageLaunchAtLogin = typeof host.settings.getLaunchAtLogin === "function" && typeof host.settings.setLaunchAtLogin === "function";
  const [launchAtLogin, setLaunchAtLogin] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [launchAtLoginBusy, setLaunchAtLoginBusy] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const refreshLaunchAtLogin = reactExports.useCallback(() => {
    if (!host.settings.getLaunchAtLogin) return;
    void host.settings.getLaunchAtLogin().then(setLaunchAtLogin, () => setLaunchAtLogin(null));
  }, [host]);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (!canManageLaunchAtLogin) return;
    refreshLaunchAtLogin();
    window.addEventListener("focus", refreshLaunchAtLogin);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", refreshLaunchAtLogin);
  }, [canManageLaunchAtLogin, refreshLaunchAtLogin]);
  const launchAtLoginSupported = launchAtLogin !== null && launchAtLogin.status !== "unsupported";
  const launchAtLoginEnabled = isLaunchAtLoginSelected(launchAtLogin);
  const launchSummary = launchAtLoginSummary(launchAtLogin);
  const launchSummaryVisible = launchAtLogin === null || launchAtLogin.status === "unsupported" || launchAtLogin.status === "requires-approval";
  const showLaunchAtLoginRow = canManageLaunchAtLogin;
  const toggleLaunchAtLogin = () => {
    if (!host.settings.setLaunchAtLogin || !launchAtLoginSupported || launchAtLoginBusy) return;
    const enabled = !launchAtLoginEnabled;
    const previous = launchAtLogin;
    host.system.captureEvent?.("launch_at_login_toggled", { enabled });
    setLaunchAtLogin({ status: enabled ? "enabled" : "disabled" });
    setLaunchAtLoginBusy(true);
    void host.settings.setLaunchAtLogin(enabled).then(setLaunchAtLogin, () => {
      setLaunchAtLogin(previous);
      refreshLaunchAtLogin();
    }).finally(() => setLaunchAtLoginBusy(false));
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsScreen, { title: "System", hideHeader: composed, children: showLaunchAtLoginRow ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSection, { children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(SettingsGroup, { children: [
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      SettingsToggleRow,
      {
        icon: Power,
        iconColor: CONCEPT_META.command.accent,
        title: "Open Blume at login",
        description: launchSummaryVisible ? launchSummary : void 0,
        checked: launchAtLoginEnabled,
        busy: launchAtLoginBusy,
        disabled: !launchAtLoginSupported,
        onCheckedChange: toggleLaunchAtLogin
      }
    ),
    launchAtLogin?.status === "requires-approval" && host.settings.openLaunchAtLoginSettings ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      SettingsActionRow,
      {
        tone: "accent",
        label: "Open Login Items in System Settings",
        onPress: () => void host.settings.openLaunchAtLoginSettings?.().catch(() => void 0)
      }
    ) : null
  ] }) }) : null });
}
function AgentSignInSettings({ host }) {
  const enabled = useCloudChatFeature();
  const cloudOnly = host?.ownedChatExecution === "cloud-only";
  const [status, setStatus] = reactExports.useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = reactExports.useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [token, setToken] = reactExports.useState("");
  const [showToken, setShowToken] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [disconnect, setDisconnect] = reactExports.useState(false);
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false;
    setStatus([]);
    setToken("");
    if (!enabled) return;
    if (!host) {
      setError("Sign in to Blume to manage cloud agent sign-ins.");
      return;
    }
    void host.call(OWNED_CLOUD_SUBSCRIPTION_OPERATION, { action: "status" }).then(
      (value) => {
        if (!stopped) {
          setStatus(value);
          setError("");
        }
      },
      (cause) => {
        if (!stopped)
          setError(userFacingErrorMessage(cause, "Could not load cloud sign-ins. Try again."));
      }
    );
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
    };
  }, [host, enabled]);
  const act = async (request) => {
    if (!enabled || !host || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      setStatus(
        await host.call(OWNED_CLOUD_SUBSCRIPTION_OPERATION, request)
      );
      setShowToken(false);
      setDisconnect(false);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(userFacingErrorMessage(cause, "Could not save the agent sign-in."));
    } finally {
      setToken("");
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  if (!enabled)
    return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsScreen, { title: "Agents", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(PageContent, { padding: "sm", children: "Cloud agents are not enabled." }) });
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsScreen, { title: "Agents", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(SettingsSection, { label: "Cloud subscriptions", children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(PageContent, { padding: "sm", stack: true, children: [
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx("p", { className: "m-0 type-ui-body", children: "Personal sign-ins for your cloud agents. Updated credentials apply on the next message. Your chats and files stay in place." }),
    ["codex", "claude"].map((harness) => {
      const saved = status.find((item) => item.harness === harness);
      const name = harness === "codex" ? "Codex" : "Claude";
      return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        FormField,
        {
          label: name,
          group: true,
          hint: saved?.configured ? saved.source === "subscription-token" ? "Subscription token saved" : cloudOnly ? "Local sign-in imported. Update it in Blume Desktop." : "Local sign-in imported" : cloudOnly ? `No cloud sign-in saved. Import your ${name} sign-in in Blume Desktop.` : `No cloud sign-in saved. Sign in with ${harness === "codex" ? "codex login" : "claude auth login"} on the computer running your agents.`,
          children: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "flex flex-wrap gap-2", children: [
            !cloudOnly && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
              Button,
              {

                size: "sm",
                disabled: busy || !host,
                onClick: () => void act({ action: "import", harness }),
                children: saved?.configured ? `Import ${name} sign-in again` : `Import ${name} sign-in`
              }
            ),
            harness === "claude" && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(

                children: "Use subscription token"
              }
            )
          ] })
        },
        harness
      );
    }),
    showToken && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs(

            Input,

          /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(

    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(

        },

      }
    ),
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(

function artifactSyncFolderRuntimePath(folderPath, artifacts) {
  const folder = portablePath(folderPath);
  for (const artifact of artifacts) {
    if (artifact.source.type === "external" || !artifact.source.runtimePath) continue;
    const source = artifact.source.path ? portablePath(artifact.source.path) : "";
    if (source !== folder && !source.startsWith(`${folder}/`)) continue;
    const relativeSegments = source === folder ? [] : source.slice(folder.length + 1).split("/");

      runtime = parent;
    }
    return runtime;
  }
  return null;
}

function artifactSourceLabel(artifact) {
  const source = artifact.source;
  if (source.type === "external") return source.uri;
  if (source.type === "installed-package") return source.packageId;
  if (source.type === "config-entry") return `${source.path} › ${source.keyPath}`;
  return source.path;
}
function artifactProviderLabel(artifact) {
  return artifact.provider ? harnessLabel(artifact.provider) : "Shared";
}
function artifactMetadataEntries(artifact) {
  return Object.entries(artifact.metadata ?? {}).flatMap(
    ([key, value]) => {
      if (value === void 0 || value === null) return [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        const items = value.filter(
          (item) => typeof item === "string" || typeof item === "number" || typeof item === "boolean"
        ).map(String);
        if (items.length === 0) return [];
        return [{ key, value: items.join(", "), items }];
      }
      if (typeof value === "object") return [];
      return [{ key, value: String(value) }];
    }
  );
}
function artifactKindNoun(kind, count) {
  const noun = kind === "mcp-server" ? "MCP server" : ARTIFACT_KIND_LABELS[kind].toLocaleLowerCase();
  return count === 1 ? noun : `${noun}s`;
}
function artifactOf(artifact, facts = {}) {
  return {
    id: artifact.id,
    name: artifact.name,
    kind: artifact.kind,
    ...artifact.provider ? { provider: artifact.provider } : {},
    source: artifactSourceLabel(artifact),
    effect: artifact.enabled === false ? "disabled" : artifact.effective === false ? "shadowed" : "active",
    metadata: artifactMetadataEntries(artifact),
    ...facts
  };
}
function artifactKindOfCategory(category) {
  const name = category.toLowerCase();
  if (name.includes("skill")) return "skill";
  if (name.includes("hook")) return "hook";
  if (name.includes("command")) return "command";
  if (name.includes("mcp")) return "mcp-server";
  if (name.includes("plugin")) return "plugin";
  if (name.includes("agent") && !name.includes(".md")) return "sub-agent";
  if (name.includes("setting") || name.includes("config")) return "configuration";
  if (name.includes("doc") || name.includes("knowledge")) return "knowledge";
  if (name.includes("rule") || name.includes("instruction") || name.includes("memor"))
    return "instruction";
  return "unknown";
}
function artifactOfEntry(entry, category) {
  const files = entry.files?.length ?? 0;
  return {
    id: entry.contentPath ?? `${category}:${entry.name}`,
    name: stripExt(entry.name),

    ...entry.harnessId ? { provider: entry.harnessId } : {},
    ...entry.contentPath ? { source: entry.contentPath } : {},
    ...files > 1 ? { detail: `${files} files` } : {},
    ...entry.tokens !== void 0 ? { tokens: entry.tokens } : {},
    effect: "active",
    metadata: []
  };
}

const COLLAPSED_HARNESS_ENTRY_COUNT = 5;
function countCategoryEntries(categories) {
  return categories.reduce((total, category) => total + category.entries.length, 0);
}
function countCategoryTokens(categories) {
  return categories.reduce(
    (total, category) => total + category.entries.reduce((categoryTotal, entry) => categoryTotal + (entry.tokens ?? 0), 0),
    0
  );
}
function countHarnessEntries(harnesses) {
  return harnesses.reduce((total, harness) => total + countCategoryEntries(harness.categories), 0);
}
function harnessesWithEntries(harnesses) {
  return harnesses.filter((harness) => countCategoryEntries(harness.categories) > 0);
}
function takeCategoryEntries(categories, limit) {
  let remaining = Math.max(0, limit);
  return categories.flatMap((category) => {
    if (remaining === 0) return [];
    const entries = category.entries.slice(0, remaining);
    remaining -= entries.length;
    return entries.length > 0 ? [{ ...category, entries }] : [];
  });
}
function setupEntryIdentity(entry) {
  return entry.contentPath ?? entry.files?.map((file) => file.absPath).join("\n") ?? entry.name;
}
function removeHarnessDuplicates(categories, harnesses) {
  const harnessEntries = new Set(
    harnesses.flatMap(
      (harness) => harness.categories.flatMap((category) => category.entries.map(setupEntryIdentity))
    )
  );
  return categories.flatMap((category) => {
    const entries = category.entries.filter(
      (entry) => !harnessEntries.has(setupEntryIdentity(entry))
    );
    return entries.length > 0 ? [{ ...category, entries }] : [];
  });
}

const PROVIDER_ORDER = new Map(SOURCES.map((source, index) => [source, index]));
const KIND_ORDER = new Map(ARTIFACT_KINDS.map((kind, index) => [kind, index]));
function providerRank(artifact) {
  if (!artifact.provider) return -1;
  return PROVIDER_ORDER.get(artifact.provider) ?? SOURCES.length;
}
function compareArtifacts(left, right, kindPriority = []) {
  const fallbackPriority = kindPriority.length;
  const leftPriority = kindPriority.indexOf(left.kind);
  const rightPriority = kindPriority.indexOf(right.kind);
  return (leftPriority < 0 ? fallbackPriority : leftPriority) - (rightPriority < 0 ? fallbackPriority : rightPriority) || providerRank(left) - providerRank(right) || (left.provider ?? "").localeCompare(right.provider ?? "") || (KIND_ORDER.get(left.kind) ?? ARTIFACT_KINDS.length) - (KIND_ORDER.get(right.kind) ?? ARTIFACT_KINDS.length) || left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
}
function artifactRootUnits(artifacts, relationships) {
  const childIds = new Set(
    relationships.filter(
      (relationship) => relationship.kind === "contains" || relationship.kind === "provides"
    ).map((relationship) => relationship.toUnitId)
  );
  return artifacts.filter((artifact) => !childIds.has(artifact.id));
}
function artifactTreeLeafName(artifact) {
  if (artifact.source.type === "external" || artifact.source.type === "config-entry") {
    return artifact.name;
  }
  const sourcePath = artifact.source.path;
  if (!sourcePath) return artifact.name;
  const name = sourcePath.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/+$/, "").split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1);
  return name || artifact.name;
}
function artifactContainerSegments(artifact) {
  const source = artifact.source;
  if (source.type === "external") return [];
  const sourcePath = source.path;
  if (!sourcePath) return [];
  const normalized = sourcePath.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\.\/+/, "").replace(/^~\/+/, "").replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
  if (!normalized || normalized === ".") return [];
  const segments = normalized.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  segments.pop();
  return segments;
}
function artifactFolderPaths(artifact) {
  const result = [];
  let path = "";
  for (const segment of artifactContainerSegments(artifact)) {
    path = path ? `${path}/${segment}` : segment;
    result.push(path);
  }
  return result;
}
function representativeArtifact(item) {
  if (item.type === "artifact") return item.artifact;
  const firstArtifact = item.items[0];
  if (!firstArtifact) {
    throw new Error(`Artifact folder "${item.path}" must contain at least one artifact`);
  }
  return representativeArtifact(firstArtifact);
}
function finalizeFolder(folder, kindPriority) {
  const items = [
    ...Array.from(folder.folders.values(), (child) => finalizeFolder(child, kindPriority)),
    ...folder.artifacts.map((artifact) => ({ type: "artifact", artifact }))
  ];
  items.sort((left, right) => {
    if (left.type !== right.type) return left.type === "artifact" ? -1 : 1;
    const artifactOrder = compareArtifacts(
      representativeArtifact(left),
      representativeArtifact(right),
      kindPriority
    );
    if (artifactOrder !== 0) return artifactOrder;
    const leftName = left.type === "folder" ? left.name : left.artifact.name;
    const rightName = right.type === "folder" ? right.name : right.artifact.name;
    return leftName.localeCompare(rightName);
  });
  const artifacts = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.type === "folder") {
      artifacts.push(...item.artifacts);
    } else {
      artifacts.push(item.artifact);
    }
  }
  const artifactIds = new Set(artifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.id));
  return {
    type: "folder",
    name: folder.name,
    path: folder.path,
    artifactCount: artifactIds.size,
    artifacts,
    artifactIds,
    items
  };
}
function buildArtifactTree(artifacts, kindPriority = []) {
  const root = {
    name: "",
    path: "",
    folders: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(),
    artifacts: []
  };
  for (const artifact of artifacts) {
    let current = root;
    for (const path of artifactFolderPaths(artifact)) {
      const name = path.split("/").at(-1) ?? path;
      let folder = current.folders.get(name);
      if (!folder) {
        folder = { name, path, folders: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), artifacts: [] };
        current.folders.set(name, folder);
      }
      current = folder;
    }
    current.artifacts.push(artifact);
  }
  return finalizeFolder(root, kindPriority).items;
}
function folderAutoExpansionPaths(folder) {
  const paths = [];
  let current = folder;
  while (true) {
    paths.push(current.path);
    const childFolders = current.items.filter(
      (item) => item.type === "folder"
    );
    const hasDirectArtifact = current.items.some((item) => item.type === "artifact");
    if (hasDirectArtifact || childFolders.length !== 1) return paths;
    current = childFolders[0];
  }
}
function flattenArtifactTree(items, expandedPaths, depth = 0, ancestorBranchHasNext = []) {
  const rows = [];
  items.forEach((item, index) => {
    const branchHasNext = depth === 0 ? [] : [...ancestorBranchHasNext, index < items.length - 1];
    rows.push({ item, depth, branchHasNext });
    if (item.type === "folder" && expandedPaths.has(item.path)) {
      rows.push(...flattenArtifactTree(item.items, expandedPaths, depth + 1, branchHasNext));
    }
  });
  return rows;
}
function countArtifactsInTreeItems(items) {
  return items.reduce((count, item) => count + (item.type === "folder" ? item.artifactCount : 1), 0);
}
function findArtifactRootIndex(items, artifactId2) {
  return items.findIndex(
    (item) => item.type === "folder" ? item.artifactIds.has(artifactId2) : item.artifact.id === artifactId2
  );
}
const ARTIFACT_SYNC_SIGN_IN_MESSAGE = "Sign in to Blume to sync artifacts between systems.";
function artifactSyncRequiresSignIn(cause) {
  return cause instanceof Error && /sign in required/i.test(cause.message);
}
function artifactSyncErrorMessage(cause, fallback) {
  if (artifactSyncRequiresSignIn(cause)) return ARTIFACT_SYNC_SIGN_IN_MESSAGE;
  const raw = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "";
  if (/fetch failed|network|enotfound|could not resolve/i.test(raw)) {
    return "The artifact sync service is unavailable. Try again later.";
  }
  const message = userFacingErrorMessage(cause, fallback);
  return message;
}
function canDeleteArtifact(artifact) {
  return artifact.source.type !== "external" && Boolean(artifact.source.runtimePath);
}
function deletionDescription(artifact) {
  if (artifact.source.type === "config-entry") {
    return `This removes “${artifact.name}” from its configuration file.`;
  }
  if (artifact.source.type === "directory" || artifact.source.type === "installed-package") {
    return `This permanently removes “${artifact.name}” and its contents from disk.`;
  }
  return `This permanently removes “${artifact.name}” from disk.`;
}

  };
}

    })
  ];
}

function artifactSourcePath(artifact) {
  return artifact.source.type === "external" ? "" : artifact.source.path ?? artifact.name;
}
function artifactSyncDisplayPath(path, item) {
  return item.kind === "file" && path === "artifact" ? item.name : path;
}
function pathSeparator(path) {
  return path.includes("\\") ? "\\" : "/";
}
function joinArtifactPath(root, relative) {
  const separator = pathSeparator(root);
  return `${root.replace(/[\\/]+$/, "")}${separator}${relative.replace(/^[\\/]+/, "").replace(/[\\/]+/g, separator)}`;
}
function defaultArtifactDestination(artifact, homeDir) {
  const portable = artifactSourcePath(artifact).replace(/^~?[\\/]+/, "");
  return homeDir ? joinArtifactPath(homeDir, portable) : portable;
}
function relativeToFolder(artifact, folderPath) {
  const portable = artifactSourcePath(artifact).replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\.?\//, "");
  const normalizedFolder = folderPath.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\.?\//, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
  return portable.startsWith(`${normalizedFolder}/`) ? portable.slice(normalizedFolder.length + 1) : portable.split("/").at(-1) || artifact.name;
}
function artifactSyncPlacementTargets(artifacts, destination, folderPath) {
  const target = destination.trim();
  if (!target) return [];
  const multiple = artifacts.length > 1;
  return artifacts.map((artifact) => ({
    artifact,
    runtimePath: multiple && folderPath ? joinArtifactPath(target, relativeToFolder(artifact, folderPath)) : target
  }));
}

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.ceil(bytes / 1024)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function unavailablePreviewMessage(change) {
  if (change.previewUnavailable === "too-large") {
    return "This file is too large to show here. Its full contents are still included.";
  }
  if (change.previewUnavailable === "binary") {
    return "This binary file cannot be shown as a text diff. Its full contents are still included.";
  }
  if (change.action === "unchanged") return "The local and synced contents already match.";
  return "A text diff is not available for this file.";
}

function ArtifactSyncPreviewPage({
  preview: initialPreview,
  placements: initialPlacements,
  destination: initialDestination,
  states,
  folderPath,
  missing,
  onDone,
  onChanged
}) {
  const host = useSidecarHost();
  const artifacts = reactExports.useMemo(
    () => states.map((state) => state.artifact).filter((item) => Boolean(item)),
    [states]
  );
  const [destination, setDestination] = reactExports.useState(initialDestination);
  const [destinationPreview, setDestinationPreview] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const [destinationPreviewLoading, setDestinationPreviewLoading] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const placementTargets = reactExports.useMemo(
    () => artifactSyncPlacementTargets(artifacts, destination, folderPath),
    [artifacts, destination, folderPath]
  );
  const placements = reactExports.useMemo(
    () => destination === initialDestination ? initialPlacements : placementTargets.map(({ artifact, runtimePath }) => ({
      artifactId: artifact.id,
      runtimePath
    })),
    [destination, initialDestination, initialPlacements, placementTargets]
  );
  const [saving, setSaving] = reactExports.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = reactExports.useState(null);
  const preview = destination === initialDestination ? initialPreview : destinationPreview;
  const previewLoading = destination !== initialDestination && placementTargets.length > 0 && destinationPreviewLoading;
  reactExports.useEffect(() => {
    if (destination === initialDestination) return;
    setDestinationPreview(null);
    if (placementTargets.length === 0) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setDestinationPreviewLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      void Promise.all(
        placementTargets.map(
          ({ artifact, runtimePath }) => host.setup.previewSync(
            { type: "place", placement: { artifactId: artifact.id, runtimePath } },
            { signal: controller.signal }
          )
        )
      ).then((previews) => setDestinationPreview(combineArtifactSyncPreviews(previews))).catch((cause) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setError(artifactSyncErrorMessage(cause, "Could not preview changes at this location."));
      }).finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setDestinationPreviewLoading(false);
      });
    }, 350);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [destination, host.setup, initialDestination, placementTargets]);
  const apply = async () => {
    if (!preview || placements.length === 0) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      for (const placement of placements) await host.setup.placeSynced(placement);
      await host.setup.refresh().catch(() => {
      });
      onChanged();
      onDone();
    } catch (cause) {
      await host.setup.refresh().catch(() => {
      });
      onChanged();
      setError(artifactSyncErrorMessage(cause, "Could not apply these sync changes."));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  const skip = async () => {
    if (artifacts.length === 0) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await host.setup.setSynced({ artifacts, enabled: false });
      onChanged();
      onDone();
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(artifactSyncErrorMessage(cause, "Could not skip this synced item."));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col", children: [
    /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
      ChangeDetailsBody,

            title: "Changes on this system",
            subtitle: "Review every file operation before applying it.",
            className: "mb-[15px]"

            content: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { className: "mt-[7px]", children: [

const NO_KIND_PRIORITY = [];

function syncableArtifacts(artifacts) {
  return artifacts.filter(
    (artifact) => artifact.source.type !== "external" && Boolean(artifact.source.runtimePath)
  );
}
function folderSyncTargets(items) {
  return items.flatMap((item) => {
    if (item.type !== "folder") return [];
    const target = artifactSyncFolderTarget(item.path, item.artifacts);
    return [...target ? [target] : [], ...folderSyncTargets(item.items)];
  });
}
function pathLeaf(path) {
  return path.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/+$/, "").split("/").at(-1) || path;
}
function syncConflictMessage(name) {
  return `Disable sync on “${name}” to sync this item.`;
}

function unitDetail(unit, childUnits) {
  if (childUnits.length > 0) {
    const counts = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (const child of childUnits) counts.set(child.kind, (counts.get(child.kind) ?? 0) + 1);
    return [...counts].map(([kind, count]) => `${count} ${artifactKindNoun(kind, count)}`).join(", ");
  }
  if (unit.source.type === "installed-package" && unit.source.version) {
    return `v${unit.source.version}`;
  }
  const metadata = unit.metadata ?? {};
  if (typeof metadata.version === "string" && metadata.version) return `v${metadata.version}`;
  if (typeof metadata.transport === "string" && metadata.transport) return metadata.transport;
  if (typeof metadata.event === "string" && metadata.event) return metadata.event;
  return null;
}

function artifactHeaderData(artifact, context) {
  const concept = ARTIFACT_KIND_CONCEPTS[artifact.kind];
  const provider = artifact.provider && isSource(artifact.provider) ? artifact.provider : null;
  const parents = context.related.filter((group) => PARENT_RELATIONS.has(group.label));
  const trail = parents.flatMap(
    (group) => group.entries.map(({ item }) => ({
      id: `${group.label}:${item.id}`,
      label: item.name,
      concept: ARTIFACT_KIND_CONCEPTS[item.kind],
      target: { onSelect: () => context.onOpenArtifact(item) },
      property: group.label
    }))
  );
  const facts = [
    {
      id: "provider",
      label: "Provider",
      value: artifactProviderLabel(artifact),
      ...provider ? { icon: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(HarnessTile, { harness: provider, showTooltip: false }) } : { concept: "harness" }
    },
    // The source path is in the Details card; the top strip says who provides it and its scope.
    { id: "scope", label: "Scope", value: artifact.scope === "global" ? "Global" : "Project", concept: artifact.scope === "global" ? "global" : "folder-project" }
  ];
  return {
    view: "settings",
    kind: ARTIFACT_KIND_LABELS[artifact.kind],
    kindConcept: concept,
    title: artifact.name,
    identity: { node: /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ConceptIcon, { concept, tileSize: "lg" }), shape: "tile" },
    status: artifact.enabled === void 0 ? void 0 : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(StatusSummaryBadge, { tone: artifact.enabled ? "success" : "neutral", children: artifact.enabled ? "Enabled" : "Disabled" }),
    summary: context.summary,
    trail,
    facts
  };
}

  }

    case "knowledge":
      return "Reference material the agent can use as context while working in this environment.";

    case "mcp-server":
      return "A Model Context Protocol server that exposes tools or resources to the agent.";
    case "plugin":
      return "An installed package that can provide skills, commands, hooks, or integrations.";
    case "sub-agent":
      return "A specialized agent definition that can be invoked for a narrower role.";
    case "command":
      return "A reusable command or prompt that starts a defined agent workflow.";
    case "hook":
      return "Automation triggered by an agent or lifecycle event.";
    case "configuration":
      return "Settings that change which capabilities are available or how the agent operates.";
    case "workflow":
      return "A multi-step process that coordinates agent behavior or tools.";
    case "unknown":
      return "A discovered non-code artifact that may influence the agent environment.";
  }
}

function relatedArtifactGroups(artifact, artifacts, relationships) {
  const artifactsById = new Map(artifacts.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const add = (label, entry) => {
    const existing = groups.get(label);
    if (existing) existing.push(entry);
    else groups.set(label, [entry]);
  };
  for (const relationship of relationships) {
    if (artifact.kind === "plugin" && !(relationship.fromUnitId === artifact.id && (relationship.kind === "contains" || relationship.kind === "provides"))) {
      continue;
    }
    if (relationship.fromUnitId === artifact.id) {
      const item = artifactsById.get(relationship.toUnitId);
      if (item) {
        add(RELATIONSHIP_LABELS[relationship.kind], { item, evidence: relationship.evidence });
      }
    } else if (relationship.toUnitId === artifact.id) {
      const item = artifactsById.get(relationship.fromUnitId);
      if (item) {
        add(INCOMING_RELATIONSHIP_LABELS[relationship.kind], {
          item,
          evidence: relationship.evidence
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return [...groups.entries()].map(([label, entries]) => ({ label, entries }));
}

function basename$2(path) {
  return path.replace(/\\/g, "/").split("/").pop() || path;
}
function isRecord(value) {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function resolveConfigKeyPath(value, keyPath) {
  let node = value;
  let rest = keyPath;
  let leafKey = keyPath;
  while (rest !== "") {
    const index = rest.match(/^\[(\d+)\]/);
    if (index) {
      const position = Number(index[1]);
      if (!Array.isArray(node) || position >= node.length) return void 0;
      node = node[position];
      leafKey = `${leafKey}[${position}]`;
      rest = rest.slice(index[0].length).replace(/^\./, "");
      continue;
    }
    if (!isRecord(node)) return void 0;
    const record = node;
    const key = Object.keys(record).filter(
      (candidate) => rest === candidate || rest.startsWith(`${candidate}.`) || rest.startsWith(`${candidate}[`)
    ).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0];
    if (key === void 0) return void 0;
    node = record[key];
    leafKey = key;
    rest = rest.slice(key.length).replace(/^\./, "");
  }
  return { value: node, leafKey };
}
function normalizeTomlHeader(header) {
  return header.replace(/["']/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, "");
}
function sliceTomlSection(content, keyPath) {
  const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
  const wanted = normalizeTomlHeader(keyPath);
  const headerAt = (line) => {
    const match = line.match(/^\s*\[\[?([^\]]+)\]\]?\s*$/);
    return match ? normalizeTomlHeader(match[1]) : null;
  };
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => headerAt(line) === wanted);
  if (start === -1) return null;
  let end = lines.length;
  for (let index = start + 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const header = headerAt(lines[index]);
    if (header !== null && !header.startsWith(`${wanted}.`)) {
      end = index;
      break;
    }
  }
  return lines.slice(start, end).join("\n").replace(/\s+$/, "");
}
function ConfigEntryContent({

      }

    }).catch(() => {

    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [runtimePath, sourcePath, keyPath]);

function globalArtifactKindCounts(units) {

  for (const unit of units) counts.set(unit.kind, (counts.get(unit.kind) ?? 0) + 1);

  );
}

  }

}

function missingSyncedArtifactItems(states) {
  return states.flatMap((state) => {
    if (!state.missingOnSystem || !state.artifact) return [];
    return [
      {
        state,
        artifact: state.artifact,
        folder: isArtifactSyncFolder(state.artifact) || state.artifact.source.type === "directory"
      }
    ];
  });
}

async function readArtifactSyncAccountAvailability(enabled, getSession) {
  if (!enabled) return "signed-out";
  try {
    return await getSession() ? "signed-in" : "signed-out";
  } catch (error) {
    if (isAccountAuthenticationRequired(error)) return "signed-out";
    return "unavailable";
  }
}
function canReadArtifactSyncState(enabled, account) {
  return enabled && (account === "signed-in" || account === "unavailable");
}
const TILE_WIDTH = 76;
const GAP = 6;
const SLOT = TILE_WIDTH + GAP;
const SHOW_MORE_RESERVE = 82;
function formatTokens(n) {
  if (n < 1e3) return `${n}`;
  if (n < 1e4) return `${(n / 1e3).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return `${Math.round(n / 1e3)}k`;
}
function basename$1(p) {
  return p.split("/").pop() || p;
}
function iconFor(relPath) {
  const ext = relPath.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  if (ext === "md" || ext === "mdc" || ext === "markdown") return BookOpen;
  if (ext === "json") return FileBraces;
  if (ext === "toml" || ext === "yaml" || ext === "yml") return Settings;
  if (ext === "sh" || ext === "bash") return Terminal;
  if (ext === "ts" || ext === "tsx" || ext === "js" || ext === "jsx" || ext === "py" || ext === "rs" || ext === "go")
    return FileCode;
  return FileText;
}
function FileGrid({
  files,
  layout,
  activeRelPath,
  mainRelPath,
  nested = true,
  currentDir = "",
  onDirChange,
  onSelect,
  onExpand
}) {
  const items = reactExports.useMemo(
    () => buildItems(files, currentDir, nested, mainRelPath),
    [files, currentDir, nested, mainRelPath]
  );
  const measureRef = reactExports.useRef(null);
  const [maxFit, setMaxFit] = reactExports.useState(items.length);
  const upReserve = nested && !!currentDir && !!onDirChange ? 44 + GAP : 0;
  reactExports.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (layout !== "line") return;
    const node = measureRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const compute = () => {
      const w = node.clientWidth;
      if (w <= 0) return;
      const avail = Math.max(0, w - upReserve);
      const fitsAll = items.length * SLOT - GAP <= avail;
      if (fitsAll) {
        setMaxFit(items.length);
        return;
      }
      const usable = Math.max(0, avail - SHOW_MORE_RESERVE);
      setMaxFit(Math.max(1, Math.floor((usable + GAP) / SLOT)));
    };
    compute();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(compute);
    ro.observe(node);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [items.length, layout, upReserve]);
  const visible = layout === "line" ? items.slice(0, maxFit) : items;
  const hidden = items.length - visible.length;
  const containerCls = layout === "line" ? "flex items-stretch gap-1.5" : "grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(76px,1fr))] gap-1.5";
  const showUp = nested && !!currentDir && !!onDirChange;
  const navigateUp = () => {
    if (!onDirChange) return;
    const segs = currentDir.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    segs.pop();
    onDirChange(segs.join("/"));
  };
  return /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsxs("div", { ref: measureRef, className: containerCls, children: [
    showUp && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(UpFolderTile, { onClick: navigateUp }),
    visible.map(
      (item) => item.type === "file" ? /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        FileTile,
        {
          file: item.file,
          active: item.file.relPath === activeRelPath,
          main: item.file.relPath === mainRelPath,
          onClick: () => onSelect(item.file)
        },
        item.file.absPath
      ) : /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(
        FolderTile,
        {
          folder: item,
          onClick: () => onDirChange?.(item.path),
          disabled: !onDirChange
        },
        item.path
      )
    ),
    layout === "line" && hidden > 0 && onExpand && /* @__PURE__ */ jsxRuntimeExports.jsx(ShowMoreTile, { count: hidden, onClick: onExpand })
  ] });
}
function buildItems(files, currentDir, nested, mainRelPath) {
  if (!nested) {
    const ordered = mainRelPath ? sortMainFirst(files, mainRelPath) : files;
    return ordered.map((f) => ({ type: "file", file: f }));
  }
  const prefix = currentDir ? currentDir + "/" : "";
  const inScope = files.filter((f) => f.relPath.startsWith(prefix));
  const folderMap = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const fileItems = [];
  for (const f of inScope) {
    const rest = f.relPath.slice(prefix.length);
    const slashIdx = rest.indexOf("/");
    if (slashIdx === -1) {
      fileItems.push({ type: "file", file: f });
      continue;
    }
    const folderName = rest.slice(0, slashIdx);
    const folderPath = prefix + folderName;
    const existing = folderMap.get(folderName);
    if (existing) {
      existing.fileCount++;
      existing.tokens += f.tokens ?? 0;
    } else {
      folderMap.set(folderName, {
        type: "folder",
        name: folderName,
        path: folderPath,
        fileCount: 1,
        tokens: f.tokens ?? 0
      });
    }
  }
  const folders = Array.from(folderMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  fileItems.sort((a, b) => basename$1(a.file.relPath).localeCompare(basename$1(b.file.relPath)));
  const items = [...folders, ...fileItems];
  if (mainRelPath && !currentDir) {
    const mainIdx = items.findIndex((i) => i.type === "file" && i.file.relPath === mainRelPath);
    if (mainIdx > 0) {
      const [main] = items.splice(mainIdx, 1);
      items.unshift(main);
    }
  }
  return items;
}
function sortMainFirst(files, mainRelPath) {
  const idx = files.findIndex((f) => f.relPath === mainRelPath);
  if (idx <= 0) return files;
  const copy = files.slice();
  const [main] = copy.splice(idx, 1);
  copy.unshift(main);
  return copy;
}

      type: "button",
      onClick,

function basename(p) {
  return p.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() || p;
}

function compareProjects(left, right) {
  return (right.lastActivityTs ?? 0) - (left.lastActivityTs ?? 0) || left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
}
function reconcileProjectOrder(previousOrder, projects) {
  const currentIds = new Set(projects.map((project) => project.id));
  const retained = previousOrder.filter((projectId) => currentIds.has(projectId));
  const retainedIds = new Set(retained);
  const added = projects.filter((project) => !retainedIds.has(project.id)).sort(compareProjects).map((project) => project.id);
  return [...retained, ...added];
}
function projectSetupStatus(setupSummary, qualifier = "local") {
  const artifactCount = setupSummary?.totalEntries ?? 0;
  const hasSetup = artifactCount > 0;
  const scanned = setupSummary != null;
  const prefix = qualifier ? `${qualifier} ` : "";
  const label = hasSetup ? `${artifactCount} ${prefix}${artifactCount === 1 ? "artifact" : "artifacts"}` : scanned ? `No ${prefix}artifacts` : "Not scanned yet";
  return { artifactCount, hasSetup, scanned, label };
}
function formatProjectAge(ms) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1e3));
  if (seconds < 60) return "now";
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
  return `${Math.floor(hours / 24)}d`;
}

}

function orderedHarnesses(harnesses) {
  const order = new Map(SOURCES.map((source, index) => [source, index]));
  return [...harnesses].sort(
    (left, right) => (order.get(left.harnessId) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (order.get(right.harnessId) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) || left.harnessId.localeCompare(right.harnessId)
  );
}
