<file path="scripts/install-macos-dmg.mjs">
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { createWriteStream, existsSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { basename, join } from 'node:path'
import { Readable } from 'node:stream'
import { pipeline } from 'node:stream/promises'

const APP_NAMES = ['Blume Canary.app', 'Blume.app']
const APPLICATIONS_DIR = '/Applications'

function escapeRegExp(value) {
  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
}

function backupAppNamePattern(appName) {
  return new RegExp(
    `^${escapeRegExp(appName)}\\.(?:previous|backup|pre|broken)-[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`
  )
}

function usage() {
  console.log(`Usage: pnpm --filter @blume/desktop internal:install-macos-dmg -- <dmg-path-or-url> [--launch]

Internal operator recovery tool. Installs Blume.app or Blume Canary.app from a macOS DMG.

For installed canaries, prefer the built-in updater for normal canary-to-canary
updates. Use this only for first canary install, local testing, or recovery when
the updater path is already broken.

This intentionally deletes the old app for the same channel instead of moving
it to a backup app bundle. Stable and canary have separate names and bundle ids,
so installing one leaves the other running installation untouched.`)
}

function run(command, args, options = {}) {
  const result = spawnSync(command, args, {
    encoding: 'utf8',
    stdio: options.capture ? ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] : 'inherit'
  })
  if (result.error && !options.allowFailure) {
    throw new Error(`${command} ${args.join(' ')} failed: ${result.error.message}`)
  }
  if (result.status !== 0 && !options.allowFailure) {
    const details = [result.stdout, result.stderr].filter(Boolean).join('\n').trim()
    throw new Error(`${command} ${args.join(' ')} failed${details ? `:\n${details}` : ''}`)
  }
  return result
}

function isUrl(value) {
  return /^https?:\/\//.test(value)
}

async function downloadDmg(url) {
  const response = await fetch(url)
  if (!response.ok || !response.body) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to download ${url}: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`)
  }
  const outputPath = join(tmpdir(), basename(new URL(url).pathname) || 'Blume.dmg')
  await pipeline(Readable.fromWeb(response.body), createWriteStream(outputPath))
  return outputPath
}

function removeStaleBackupApps(appName) {
  const backupPattern = backupAppNamePattern(appName)
  const roots = Array.from(new Set([APPLICATIONS_DIR, '/private/tmp', tmpdir()]))
  for (const root of roots) {
    if (!existsSync(root)) continue
    for (const name of readdirSync(root)) {
      if (!backupPattern.test(name)) continue
      const candidate = join(root, name)
      if (!statSync(candidate).isDirectory()) continue
      rmSync(candidate, { recursive: true, force: true })
      console.log(`Removed stale Blume backup app: ${candidate}`)
    }
  }
}

function waitForProcessExit(processName, attempts = 50, delaySeconds = '0.1') {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < attempts; attempt += 1) {
    const result = spawnSync('pgrep', ['-x', processName], { stdio: 'ignore' })
    if (result.status !== 0) return
    spawnSync('sleep', [delaySeconds], { stdio: 'ignore' })
  }
  throw new Error(`${processName} did not exit after ${attempts} checks`)
}

function refreshLaunchServices(installPath) {
  const lsregister = '/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister'
  if (existsSync(lsregister)) run(lsregister, ['-f', installPath], { allowFailure: true })
}

function findAppInMountedDmg(mountPath) {
  for (const appName of APP_NAMES) {
    const direct = join(mountPath, appName)
    if (existsSync(direct)) return direct
  }

  for (const name of readdirSync(mountPath)) {
    for (const appName of APP_NAMES) {
      const candidate = join(mountPath, name, appName)
      if (existsSync(candidate)) return candidate
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`Could not find ${APP_NAMES.join(' or ')} in mounted DMG at ${mountPath}`)
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2)
  if (args.includes('--help') || args.length === 0) {
    usage()
    process.exit(args.length === 0 ? 1 : 0)
  }
  if (process.platform !== 'darwin') {
    throw new Error('install-macos-dmg is macOS-only.')
  }

  const launch = args.includes('--launch')
  const input = args.find((arg) => !arg.startsWith('--'))
  if (!input) {
    usage()
    process.exit(1)
  }

  const dmgPath = isUrl(input) ? await downloadDmg(input) : input
  if (!existsSync(dmgPath)) throw new Error(`DMG not found: ${dmgPath}`)

  const mountPath = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-dmg-'))
  let mounted = false
  try {
    run('hdiutil', ['attach', dmgPath, '-nobrowse', '-readonly', '-quiet', '-mountpoint', mountPath])
    mounted = true
    const sourceApp = findAppInMountedDmg(mountPath)
    const appName = basename(sourceApp)
    const productName = appName.replace(/\.app$/, '')
    const installPath = join(APPLICATIONS_DIR, appName)

    run('pkill', ['-x', productName], { allowFailure: true })
    waitForProcessExit(productName)
    removeStaleBackupApps(appName)

    rmSync(installPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
    run('ditto', [sourceApp, installPath])
    removeStaleBackupApps(appName)
    refreshLaunchServices(installPath)

    const version = run(
      'plutil',
      ['-extract', 'CFBundleShortVersionString', 'raw', '-o', '-', join(installPath, 'Contents', 'Info.plist')],
      { capture: true }
    ).stdout.trim()
    console.log(`Installed ${installPath} ${version}`)

    if (launch) run('open', [installPath])
  } finally {
    if (mounted) run('hdiutil', ['detach', mountPath, '-quiet'], { allowFailure: true })
    rmSync(mountPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
  process.exit(1)
})
</file>

<file path="scripts/perf-navigation.mjs">
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */
/**
 * Repeatable navigation benchmark over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. No dependencies (Node 22+
 * global WebSocket and fetch).
 *
 * It attaches to a running app page, clicks through the rail (Deliveries, Projects, Improve,
 * Tests, Plugin), opens the first delivery (and a conversation when given), for several rounds,
 * with real (trusted) mouse input. Per step it prints:
 *   frame    input → the new page's first frame: double rAF after the first DOM change that
 *            follows the URL change (≤100 ms budget); matches the in-app route timing
 *   content  input → the last DOM change before the page went quiet (async data, lazy chunks)
 *   long     renderer long-task time inside the step
 *   inp      slowest Event Timing entry of the click (input → next paint; blank when under 16 ms)
 * and, in Electron, main's IPC handler table and event-loop stalls from perf:snapshot.
 *
 * Electron (dev, sandboxed user data):
 *   pnpm --filter @blume/desktop dev:e2e -- --remoteDebuggingPort 9334
 *   node apps/desktop/scripts/perf-navigation.mjs --cdp 9334
 * Web Lab: start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9334, open Web Lab, then
 *   node apps/desktop/scripts/perf-navigation.mjs --cdp 9334 --target localhost:5174
 *
 * Options: --rounds N (default 5), --warmup N (rounds excluded from stats, default 1),
 *   --target <url substring>, --conversation <ref> (open #/agents/<ref> each round),
 *   --quiet-ms N (DOM quiet window, default 150), --timeout-ms N (per step, default 8000),
 *   --pause-ms N (between steps, default 250), --no-reset (keep main's perf counters),
 *   --json <file> (write raw samples). Keep the window visible: hidden pages throttle frames.
 */

import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const RAIL = ['Deliveries', 'Projects', 'Improve', 'Tests', 'Plugin']
const VIEW_SWITCH_BUDGET_MS = 100
const DELIVERY_ROW = '#hybrid-content button[data-list-interaction]'

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const options = {
    cdp: null,
    rounds: 5,
    warmup: 1,
    target: null,
    conversation: null,
    quietMs: 150,
    timeoutMs: 8_000,
    pauseMs: 250,
    reset: true,
    json: null
  }
  const numeric = {
    '--cdp': 'cdp',
    '--rounds': 'rounds',
    '--warmup': 'warmup',
    '--quiet-ms': 'quietMs',
    '--timeout-ms': 'timeoutMs',
    '--pause-ms': 'pauseMs'
  }
  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 1) {
    const arg = argv[index]
    if (arg === '--help' || arg === '-h') {
      options.help = true
    } else if (arg === '--no-reset') {
      options.reset = false
    } else if (numeric[arg]) {
      const value = Number(argv[++index])
      if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) throw new Error(`${arg} needs a number`)
      options[numeric[arg]] = value
    } else if (arg === '--target' || arg === '--conversation' || arg === '--json') {
      const value = argv[++index]
      if (!value) throw new Error(`${arg} needs a value`)
      options[arg.slice(2)] = value
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${arg}`)
    }
  }
  return options
}

class CdpSession {
  #ws
  #nextId = 1
  #pending = new Map()

  static async connect(url) {
    const session = new CdpSession()
    session.#ws = new WebSocket(url)
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      session.#ws.addEventListener('open', resolve, { once: true })
      session.#ws.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error(`Cannot connect to ${url}`)), {
        once: true
      })
    })
    session.#ws.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
      const message = JSON.parse(String(event.data))
      const pending = message.id && session.#pending.get(message.id)
      if (!pending) return
      session.#pending.delete(message.id)
      if (message.error) pending.reject(new Error(`${pending.method}: ${message.error.message}`))
      else pending.resolve(message.result)
    })
    session.#ws.addEventListener('close', () => {
      for (const pending of session.#pending.values()) pending.reject(new Error('CDP closed'))
      session.#pending.clear()
    })
    return session
  }

  send(method, params = {}) {
    const id = this.#nextId++
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.#pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, method })
      this.#ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }))
    })
  }

  async evaluate(expression) {
    const result = await this.send('Runtime.evaluate', {
      expression,
      awaitPromise: true,
      returnByValue: true,
      userGesture: true
    })
    if (result.exceptionDetails) {
      const detail = result.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? result.exceptionDetails.text
      throw new Error(`Page evaluation failed: ${detail}`)
    }
    return result.result.value
  }

  close() {
    this.#ws.close()
  }
}

async function findPageTarget(port, filter) {
  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/list`)
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`CDP /json/list returned ${response.status}`)
  const targets = (await response.json()).filter(
    (target) =>
      target.type === 'page' &&
      target.webSocketDebuggerUrl &&
      !target.url.startsWith('devtools://') &&
      // The menu-bar popover is a data: URL page.
      !target.url.startsWith('data:') &&
      (!filter || target.url.includes(filter))
  )
  if (targets.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`No page target on port ${port}${filter ? ` matching "${filter}"` : ''}`)
  }
  return targets.find((target) => target.url.includes('#/')) ?? targets[0]
}

// Installed once per page. Bounded buffers; history is patched only to timestamp route changes.
// A route switch is painted at the double rAF after the first DOM change that follows the URL
// change: React may hold the old page (transitions, lazy chunks, data) well past the URL change.
const PAGE_HELPER = String.raw`(() => {
  if (window.__blumeNavBench?.version === 2) return true
  const longTasks = []
  const events = []
  const keep = (list, item) => { list.push(item); if (list.length > 500) list.shift() }
  try {
    new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
      for (const e of list.getEntries()) keep(longTasks, { start: e.startTime, ms: e.duration })
    }).observe({ type: 'longtask', buffered: true })
  } catch {}
  try {
    new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
      for (const e of list.getEntries()) {
        if (e.interactionId) keep(events, { start: e.startTime, ms: e.duration, name: e.name })
      }
    }).observe({ type: 'event', durationThreshold: 16, buffered: true })
  } catch {}
  let step = null
  let lastMutationAt = performance.now()
  new MutationObserver(() => {
    lastMutationAt = performance.now()
    if (!step || step.urlAt === null || step.commitAt !== null) return
    step.commitAt = lastMutationAt
    afterNextFrame(() => { if (step && step.routeFrameAt === null) step.routeFrameAt = performance.now() })
  }).observe(document.documentElement, {
    subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true
  })
  const afterNextFrame = (callback) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(callback))
  const markInput = (at) => {
    if (!step || step.inputAt !== null) return
    step.inputAt = at
    afterNextFrame(() => { if (step && step.inputFrameAt === null) step.inputFrameAt = performance.now() })
  }
  const markRoute = () => {
    if (!step || step.urlAt !== null || location.href === step.href) return
    step.urlAt = performance.now()
  }
  addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { if (event.isTrusted) markInput(event.timeStamp) }, true)
  addEventListener('hashchange', markRoute, true)
  addEventListener('popstate', markRoute, true)
  for (const method of ['pushState', 'replaceState']) {
    const original = history[method]
    history[method] = function (...args) {
      const result = original.apply(this, args)
      markRoute()
      return result
    }
  }
  const sum = (list, from, to) => list.reduce((acc, item) => acc + Math.max(0, Math.min(item.start + item.ms, to) - Math.max(item.start, from)), 0)
  window.__blumeNavBench = {
    version: 2,
    arm() {
      step = { href: location.href, inputAt: null, inputFrameAt: null, urlAt: null, commitAt: null, routeFrameAt: null }
    },
    hashNavigate(hash) {
      this.arm()
      markInput(performance.now())
      location.hash = hash
    },
    rectOf(selector, label) {
      const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)].filter((el) => {
        if (label && el.getAttribute('aria-label') !== label) return false
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0
      })
      const el = candidates[0]
      if (!el) return null
      el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'nearest' })
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
      return { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 }
    },
    settle(quietMs, timeoutMs) {
      const started = performance.now()
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const poll = () => {
          const now = performance.now()
          const s = step
          const frameAt = s.urlAt !== null ? s.routeFrameAt : s.inputFrameAt
          const timedOut = now - started > timeoutMs
          // After a URL change, quiet only counts once the new page has started to render.
          const quiet = now - lastMutationAt >= quietMs && (s.urlAt === null || s.commitAt !== null)
          if (!timedOut && (s.inputAt === null || frameAt === null || !quiet)) {
            setTimeout(poll, 16)
            return
          }
          const inputAt = s.inputAt ?? started
          const contentAt = quiet ? Math.max(lastMutationAt, frameAt ?? s.urlAt ?? inputAt) : null
          const end = Math.max(frameAt ?? now, contentAt ?? now)
          const clickEvents = events.filter((e) => e.start >= inputAt - 1 && e.start <= end)
          resolve({
            route: location.hash || location.pathname,
            navigated: s.urlAt !== null,
            frameMs: frameAt === null ? null : frameAt - inputAt,
            contentMs: contentAt === null ? null : contentAt - inputAt,
            longTaskMs: sum(longTasks, inputAt, end),
            longTaskCount: longTasks.filter((t) => t.start + t.ms > inputAt && t.start < end).length,
            inpMs: clickEvents.length ? Math.max(...clickEvents.map((e) => e.ms)) : null,
            hidden: document.hidden
          })
          step = null
        }
        poll()
      })
    }
  }
  return true
})()`

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

async function click(session, point) {
  const base = { x: point.x, y: point.y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 }
  await session.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseMoved', x: point.x, y: point.y })
  await session.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mousePressed', ...base })
  await session.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseReleased', ...base })
}

/** Clicks the first visible match and measures until the page settles; null when absent. */
async function clickStep(session, options, selector, label) {
  const point = await session.evaluate(
    `window.__blumeNavBench.rectOf(${JSON.stringify(selector)}, ${JSON.stringify(label ?? null)})`
  )
  if (!point) return null
  // Let scrollIntoView land before the input.
  await sleep(50)
  await session.evaluate('window.__blumeNavBench.arm()')
  await click(session, point)
  return session.evaluate(`window.__blumeNavBench.settle(${options.quietMs}, ${options.timeoutMs})`)
}

async function hashStep(session, options, hash) {
  await session.evaluate(`window.__blumeNavBench.hashNavigate(${JSON.stringify(hash)})`)
  return session.evaluate(`window.__blumeNavBench.settle(${options.quietMs}, ${options.timeoutMs})`)
}

function percentile(values, p) {
  if (values.length === 0) return null
  const sorted = values.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b)
  return sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil((p / 100) * sorted.length) - 1))]
}

const ms = (value) => (value === null || value === undefined ? '—' : `${Math.round(value)}`)

function printTable(headers, rows) {
  const widths = headers.map((header, column) =>
    Math.max(header.length, ...rows.map((row) => String(row[column]).length))
  )
  const line = (cells) =>
    cells
      .map((cell, column) =>
        column === 0 ? String(cell).padEnd(widths[column]) : String(cell).padStart(widths[column])
      )
      .join('  ')
  console.log(line(headers))
  console.log(widths.map((width) => '-'.repeat(width)).join('  '))
  for (const row of rows) console.log(line(row))
}

function summarize(samples) {
  const byStep = new Map()
  for (const sample of samples) {
    const list = byStep.get(sample.step) ?? []
    list.push(sample)
    byStep.set(sample.step, list)
  }
  const rows = []
  for (const [step, list] of byStep) {
    const frames = list.map((s) => s.frameMs).filter((v) => v !== null)
    const contents = list.map((s) => s.contentMs).filter((v) => v !== null)
    const inps = list.map((s) => s.inpMs).filter((v) => v !== null)
    const frameP95 = percentile(frames, 95)
    rows.push([
      `${frameP95 !== null && frameP95 > VIEW_SWITCH_BUDGET_MS ? '! ' : '  '}${step}`,
      list.length,
      ms(percentile(frames, 50)),
      ms(frameP95),
      ms(frames.length ? Math.max(...frames) : null),
      ms(percentile(contents, 50)),
      ms(percentile(contents, 95)),
      ms(list.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.longTaskMs, 0)),
      list.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.longTaskCount, 0),
      ms(percentile(inps, 95)),
      list.filter((s) => s.contentMs === null).length
    ])
  }
  printTable(
    [
      'step',
      'n',
      'frame p50',
      'p95',
      'max',
      'content p50',
      'p95',
      'long ms',
      'long n',
      'inp p95',
      'busy'
    ],
    rows
  )
}

function printMainStats(snapshot) {
  const channels = Object.entries(snapshot.ipcHandlers?.channels ?? {})
  console.log(
    `\nElectron main: IPC handlers (top 15 by p95, budget ${snapshot.ipcHandlers?.budgetMs ?? 50} ms)`
  )
  if (channels.length === 0) console.log('  no IPC calls recorded')
  else {
    printTable(
      ['channel', 'n', 'p50', 'p95', 'max', 'sync max', 'over'],
      channels
        .sort((a, b) => b[1].p95Ms - a[1].p95Ms)
        .slice(0, 15)
        .map(([channel, s]) => [
          `  ${channel}`,
          s.count,
          s.p50Ms.toFixed(1),
          ms(s.p95Ms),
          ms(s.maxMs),
          ms(s.maxSyncMs),
          s.overBudget
        ])
    )
  }
  for (const call of (snapshot.ipcHandlers?.slowCalls ?? []).slice(0, 5)) {
    console.log(`  slow: ${call.channel} ${ms(call.ms)} ms (sync ${ms(call.syncMs)} ms)`)
  }
  const loop = snapshot.eventLoop
  if (!loop?.enabled) {
    console.log('\nElectron main event loop: monitor not running')
    return
  }
  const windows = loop.windows ?? []
  console.log(
    `\nElectron main event loop (${loop.windowMs / 1000}s windows, budget ${loop.budgetMs} ms): ` +
      `${loop.stallCount} stalls, worst ${ms(loop.worstMs)} ms, ` +
      `window max p95 ${ms(
        percentile(
          windows.map((w) => w.maxMs),
          95
        )
      )} ms`
  )
  if (loop.lastStall) {
    console.log(
      `  last stall: ${ms(loop.lastStall.maxMs)} ms` +
        (loop.lastStall.culprit
          ? ` · longest sync block ${loop.lastStall.culprit} ${ms(loop.lastStall.culpritMs)} ms`
          : '')
    )
  }
}

async function main() {
  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
  if (options.help || options.cdp === null) {
    console.log('Usage: node apps/desktop/scripts/perf-navigation.mjs --cdp <port> [options]')
    console.log('See the header comment of this file for options.')
    process.exit(options.help ? 0 : 1)
  }
  const target = await findPageTarget(options.cdp, options.target)
  console.log(`Attached to ${target.url}`)
  const session = await CdpSession.connect(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl)
  try {
    await session.send('Page.bringToFront').catch(() => undefined)
    await session.evaluate(PAGE_HELPER)
    const electron = await session.evaluate('typeof window.api?.getPerfSnapshot === "function"')
    if (electron && options.reset) {
      await session.evaluate('window.api.resetPerf()')
      // The first snapshot also starts main's loop monitor in builds where it is off by default.
      await session.evaluate('window.api.getPerfSnapshot().then(() => true)')
    }
    if (await session.evaluate('document.hidden')) {
      // Hidden or fully covered windows produce no frames, so nothing below would settle.
      throw new Error('The app window is hidden or covered; bring it to the front and rerun.')
    }

    const samples = []
    let missingDelivery = false
    let reloads = 0
    const record = async (round, step, run) => {
      let result
      try {
        result = await run()
      } catch (error) {
        // A dev-server reload (HMR full reload) drops the page helper; re-install and move on.
        if (!/navigated or closed|Cannot find context/i.test(String(error?.message))) throw error
        reloads += 1
        console.warn(`Page reloaded during ${step}; sample skipped`)
        await sleep(2_000)
        await session.evaluate(PAGE_HELPER)
        return { skipped: true }
      }
      if (result) {
        if (round >= options.warmup) samples.push({ round, step, ...result })
        if (result.hidden) console.warn(`Warning: page hidden during ${step}; frames paused`)
      }
      await sleep(options.pauseMs)
      return result
    }
    const total = options.warmup + options.rounds
    for (let round = 0; round < total; round += 1) {
      process.stdout.write(
        `round ${round + 1}/${total}${round < options.warmup ? ' (warm-up)' : ''}\r`
      )
      for (const label of RAIL) {
        const result = await record(round, `rail ${label}`, () =>
          clickStep(session, options, 'nav[role="tablist"] [role="tab"]', label)
        )
        if (!result) throw new Error(`Rail tab "${label}" not found; is the app on a rail page?`)
      }
      await record(round, 'rail Deliveries', () =>
        clickStep(session, options, 'nav[role="tablist"] [role="tab"]', 'Deliveries')
      )
      const opened = await record(round, 'open delivery', () =>
        clickStep(session, options, DELIVERY_ROW)
      )
      if (!opened) missingDelivery = true
      if (!options.conversation) continue
      await record(round, 'open conversation', () =>
        hashStep(session, options, `#/agents/${encodeURIComponent(options.conversation)}`)
      )
    }
    process.stdout.write('\n')
    if (missingDelivery) console.log('Note: no delivery row was found to open on some rounds.')
    if (reloads)
      console.log(`Note: the page reloaded ${reloads}× (dev server); those steps are skipped.`)

    console.log(
      `\nRenderer (${options.rounds} rounds after ${options.warmup} warm-up; ms; ` +
        `"!" = frame p95 over the ${VIEW_SWITCH_BUDGET_MS} ms view-switch budget; ` +
        'busy = DOM never went quiet)'
    )
    summarize(samples)

    let mainSnapshot = null
    if (electron) {
      mainSnapshot = await session.evaluate('window.api.getPerfSnapshot()')
      printMainStats(mainSnapshot)
    }
    if (options.json) {
      writeFileSync(
        options.json,
        JSON.stringify(
          {
            capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            target: target.url,
            options,
            samples,
            main: mainSnapshot
          },
          null,
          2
        )
      )
      console.log(`\nWrote ${options.json}`)
    }
  } finally {
    session.close()
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error)
  process.exit(1)
})
</file>

<file path="scripts/postinstall.mjs">
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Downloads Electron and rebuilds native dependencies (better-sqlite3, node-pty) for its ABI.
//
// BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_POSTINSTALL=1 skips both. Only CI jobs that never run, test or package
// Electron may set it: Product PR Preview deploys Workers, the Web Lab and the VPS runner, none
// of which load the desktop app's Electron binary or its Electron-ABI native modules (the
// runner installs its own dependencies on the VPS). The same holds for release web-service
// jobs and promotion of already-built artifacts. Every job that runs/tests/packages Electron
// keeps the default, and `pnpm dev` re-runs `electron-builder install-app-deps` itself.
//
// BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_NATIVE_REBUILD=1 still downloads Electron but leaves the native rebuild to
// the caller. Only the release build sets it: it restores its cached Electron-ABI builds first
// and then runs `electron-builder install-app-deps` itself (see native-module-cache.mjs).
import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'

if (process.env.BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_POSTINSTALL === '1') {
  console.log(
    'Skipping Electron download and native rebuild (BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_POSTINSTALL=1; this install never runs Electron).'
  )
} else {
  execSync('install-electron', { stdio: 'inherit' })
  if (process.env.BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_NATIVE_REBUILD === '1') {
    console.log(
      'Skipping the native rebuild (BLUME_SKIP_ELECTRON_NATIVE_REBUILD=1; the caller runs electron-builder install-app-deps).'
    )
  } else {
    execSync('electron-builder install-app-deps', { stdio: 'inherit' })
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const scriptDir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const desktopDir = resolve(scriptDir, '..')
const repoRoot = resolve(desktopDir, '..', '..')
const manifestPath = join(repoRoot, 'crates', 'harness-parser', 'Cargo.toml')

// HARNESS_PARSER_TARGET (a Rust target triple, e.g. x86_64-pc-windows-gnu) cross-builds
// the parser for a packaging platform other than the host. Without it, a macOS host
// stages a Mach-O binary that a Windows package cannot run — the win32 resolver looks
// for harness-parser.exe and conversation ingestion dies. See resolveHarnessParserBinaryPath.
const target = process.env.HARNESS_PARSER_TARGET
const forWindows = target ? target.includes('windows') : process.platform === 'win32'
const binaryName = forWindows ? 'harness-parser.exe' : 'harness-parser'
const releaseDir = target
  ? join(repoRoot, 'crates', 'harness-parser', 'target', target, 'release')
  : join(repoRoot, 'crates', 'harness-parser', 'target', 'release')
const sourcePath = join(releaseDir, binaryName)
const outputDir = join(desktopDir, 'resources', 'harness-parser')
const outputPath = join(outputDir, binaryName)

const cargoArgs = ['build', '--release', '--manifest-path', manifestPath]
const cargoEnv = { ...process.env }
if (target) {
  cargoArgs.push('--target', target)
  if (target === 'x86_64-pc-windows-gnu' && !cargoEnv.CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_GNU_LINKER) {
    cargoEnv.CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_GNU_LINKER = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc'
  }
}

execFileSync('cargo', cargoArgs, {
  cwd: repoRoot,
  stdio: 'inherit',
  env: cargoEnv
})

if (!existsSync(sourcePath)) {
  throw new Error(`Expected built harness parser at ${sourcePath}`)
}

mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true })
copyFileSync(sourcePath, outputPath)
if (!forWindows) chmodSync(outputPath, 0o755)

console.log(
  `[desktop] harness parser prepared: ${outputPath}${target ? ` (target ${target})` : ''}`
)

<file path="scripts/previewEnvironment.mjs">
// Backend selection for `pnpm dev` (apps/desktop/scripts/dev.mjs).
//
// A checkout on a PR branch runs against that PR's Product PR Preview deployment set for its exact
// HEAD SHA and fails closed without it: no guessed account, no production fallback. The manifest
// replaces every product backend URL, including the hosted Deliveries runtime the delivery worker
// talks to (BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT) and the same-PR Auth issuer. On `main` a missing main
// candidate manifest keeps the configured defaults. BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS=1 is the explicit
// escape hatch and then needs the Deliveries runtime and Auth as explicit HTTPS origins.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'

import {
  PREVIEW_FRONT_HOST_SUFFIX,
  previewFrontOrigin,
  previewWorkerOrigin,
  validatePreviewDeploymentSetEnvelope
} from '@blume/insights-control'

const PRODUCTION_REGISTRY = 'https://blume-insights-control.agentic-cms-olav.workers.dev'
const HINT =
  'Or set BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS=1 with explicit HTTPS BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT and BLUME_AUTH_URL.'

function run(command, args, cwd) {
  return execFileSync(command, args, {
    cwd,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'],
    timeout: 5_000
  }).trim()
}

export function currentSourceSha(cwd) {
  try {
    return run('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd)
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export function currentBranchName(cwd) {
  try {
    return run('git', ['branch', '--show-current'], cwd)
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export function currentPullRequestNumber(cwd) {
  try {
    const result = JSON.parse(run('gh', ['pr', 'view', '--json', 'number'], cwd))
    return Number.isSafeInteger(result.number) && result.number > 0 ? result.number : null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/** The PR's labels, or null when `gh` cannot read them. Used only to explain a missing preview. */
export function currentPullRequestLabels(cwd) {
  try {
    const result = JSON.parse(run('gh', ['pr', 'view', '--json', 'labels'], cwd))
    return Array.isArray(result.labels) ? result.labels.map((label) => label?.name) : null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export const PREVIEW_ASLEEP_LABEL = 'preview-asleep'

export function previewWakeCommand(pr) {
  return `gh workflow run preview-wake.yml -f pr=${pr}`
}

function explicitHttpsOrigin(env, key) {
  const value = env[key]?.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '')
  if (
    !value ||
    !URL.canParse(value) ||
    new URL(value).protocol !== 'https:' ||
    new URL(value).origin !== value
  )
    throw new Error(`BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS=1 needs ${key} as an explicit HTTPS origin.`)
  return value
}

/** Environment the desktop main process and its build receive from a validated preview set. */
export function previewBackendEnvironment(preview, sourceSha) {
  const services = preview.manifest.services
  return {
    BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: services.deliveriesRuntime.url,
    BLUME_AUTH_URL: services.auth.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_AUTH_URL: services.auth.url,
    BLUME_FEEDBACK_BOARD_URL: services.feedback.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_FEEDBACK_BOARD_URL: services.feedback.url,
    BLUME_USER_ANALYTICS_URL: services.userAnalytics.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_USER_ANALYTICS_URL: services.userAnalytics.url,
    BLUME_REFERRALS_URL: services.referrals.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_REFERRALS_URL: services.referrals.url,
    BLUME_INSIGHTS_CONTROL_URL: services.insights.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_INSIGHTS_CONTROL_URL: services.insights.url,
    BLUME_LLM_SERVICE_URL: services.llm.url,
    MAIN_VITE_LLM_SERVICE_URL: services.llm.url,
    BLUME_ROUTER_URL: services.router.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_ROUTER_URL: services.router.url,
    BLUME_ARTIFACT_SYNC_URL: services.artifactSync.url,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_ARTIFACT_SYNC_URL: services.artifactSync.url,
    BLUME_WEB_LAB_URL: services.webLab.url,
    BLUME_CLOUD_OWNER_URL: services.webLab.url,
    // The VPS runner is optional in a PR preview (manifest.omittedServices.runner says why).
    BLUME_RUNNER_URL: services.runner?.url ?? '',
    BLUME_RELEASE_CHANNEL: 'preview',
    BLUME_RELEASE_BUNDLE: preview.bundleId,
    BLUME_RELEASE_SHA: sourceSha,
    BLUME_BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_ID: '',
    BLUME_BACKEND_BUNDLE_ID: '',
    BLUME_BACKEND_MANIFEST_URL: '',
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_RELEASE_CHANNEL: '',
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_RELEASE_VERSION: '',
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_RELEASE_SHA: sourceSha,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_RELEASE_BUNDLE: preview.bundleId,
    MAIN_VITE_BLUME_DEPLOYMENT_REGISTRY_URL: ''
  }
}

/**
 * Selects the backends for a development launch and writes them into `env`.
 * Returns `{ mode: 'explicit' | 'preview' | 'defaults', ... }`; throws with the missing
 * prerequisite when a PR checkout cannot use its exact preview.
 */
export async function applyPullRequestPreviewEnvironment(
  env,
  {
    cwd,
    sourceSha = () => currentSourceSha(cwd),
    branchName = () => currentBranchName(cwd),
    pullRequestNumber = () => currentPullRequestNumber(cwd),
    pullRequestLabels = () => currentPullRequestLabels(cwd),
    fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch,
    log = console.log
  } = {}
) {
  if (env.BLUME_USE_PRODUCTION_BACKENDS === '1') {
    const endpoint = explicitHttpsOrigin(env, 'BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT')
    const auth = explicitHttpsOrigin(env, 'BLUME_AUTH_URL')
    Object.assign(env, { BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: endpoint, BLUME_AUTH_URL: auth })
    log(`[pre-dev] backend environment: explicit production override · Deliveries ${endpoint}`)
    return { mode: 'explicit', endpoint }
  }
  const branch = branchName()
  const requirePreview = branch !== 'main'
  const sha = sourceSha()
  if (!sha || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(sha)) {
    if (requirePreview)
      throw new Error(
        `Unable to resolve the exact HEAD commit, so no PR preview can be selected. ${HINT}`
      )
    return { mode: 'defaults' }
  }
  const pr = pullRequestNumber()
  if (requirePreview && !pr)
    throw new Error(
      `Branch ${branch || '(detached HEAD)'} has no resolvable PR preview. Open a draft PR, opt it in to previews with \`gh workflow run preview-wake.yml -f pr=<N>\`, and wait for Product PR Preview. ${HINT}`
    )
  const workersSubdomain = env.CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN?.trim() ?? ''
  // A PR's registry is its own Insights: in its Workers Preview behind the petal-preview.com
  // front, or (for a set deployed before step 5) its own workers.dev Worker.
  let expectedRegistries = []
  if (pr) {
    try {
      expectedRegistries = [
        previewFrontOrigin(`blume-insights-control-pr-${pr}`),
        previewWorkerOrigin(`blume-insights-control-pr-${pr}`, workersSubdomain)
      ]
    } catch {
      throw new Error(
        `PR #${pr}: set CLOUDFLARE_WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN to the configured preview account DNS label. ${HINT}`
      )
    }
  }
  const configured = env.BLUME_DEPLOYMENT_REGISTRY_URL?.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '')
  if (configured && expectedRegistries.length && !expectedRegistries.includes(configured))
    throw new Error(
      "Preview registry must be this exact PR's preview front or its configured workers.dev account."
    )
  const registries = configured
    ? [configured]
    : expectedRegistries.length
      ? expectedRegistries
      : [PRODUCTION_REGISTRY]
  const label = pr ? `PR #${pr}` : 'main'
  const request = async (url, what) => {
    try {
      return await fetchImpl(url, {
        headers: { 'cache-control': 'no-cache' },
        redirect: 'error',
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000)
      })
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(
        `${label}: ${what} is unreachable (${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}). ${HINT}`
      )
    }
  }
  // The PR's own Insights answers an unknown SHA with JSON; anything else means no set there.
  const absent = (candidate) =>
    candidate.status === 404 &&
    !(candidate.headers?.get?.('content-type') ?? '').includes('application/json')
  let response
  let registry = registries[0]
  for (const [index, candidate] of registries.entries()) {
    const last = index === registries.length - 1
    registry = candidate
    try {
      response = await request(`${candidate}/v1/preview-manifests/${sha}`, 'preview registry')
    } catch (error) {
      if (!last) continue
      if (requirePreview) throw error
      return { mode: 'defaults' }
    }
    if (last || !absent(response)) break
  }
  if (response.status === 404) {
    if (!requirePreview) return { mode: 'defaults' }
    // The PR's own Insights Worker answers an unknown SHA with JSON. Any other 404 means that
    // Worker does not exist: the preview is asleep (or was never deployed). Fail closed and say
    // how to wake it; never fall back to production.
    const contentType = response.headers?.get?.('content-type') ?? null
    if (pr && contentType !== null && !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
      const asleep = pullRequestLabels()?.includes(PREVIEW_ASLEEP_LABEL) ?? false
      throw new Error(
        asleep
          ? `${label}'s Product PR Preview is asleep or was never requested: previews are opt-in, an idle preview sleeps (after 24 hours, or 2 if nobody opted in), and an opted-in PR that changes no deployable path does not deploy. Wake it with \`${previewWakeCommand(pr)}\`, wait for Product PR Preview to finish (about 8 minutes), then run pnpm dev again.`
          : `${label} has no deployed Product PR Preview (it is asleep or not deployed yet). Wake or deploy it with \`${previewWakeCommand(pr)}\`, wait for Product PR Preview to finish, then run pnpm dev again.`
      )
    }
    throw new Error(
      `${label} has no ready Product PR Preview for ${sha.slice(0, 8)}. Push this exact commit and wait for the preview workflow. ${HINT}`
    )
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    if (!requirePreview) return { mode: 'defaults' }
    throw new Error(`${label}: preview lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`)
  }
  const preview = validatePreviewDeploymentSetEnvelope(await response.json(), {
    workersSubdomain,
    ...(pr ? { pullRequestNumber: pr } : {}),
    sourceSha: sha
  })
  // A set served behind the front comes from the front's registry, and the reverse.
  if (pr && (preview.hosting === 'front') !== registry.endsWith(`.${PREVIEW_FRONT_HOST_SUFFIX}`))
    throw new Error(`${label}: the preview registry and its manifest disagree about hosting.`)
  const { auth, deliveriesRuntime } = preview.manifest.services
  if (!deliveriesRuntime?.url)
    throw new Error(`${label}: the preview set has no hosted Deliveries runtime.`)
  if (pr) {
    // The manifest is immutable, but the live runtime must still be this exact build.
    const health = await request(`${deliveriesRuntime.url}/health`, 'Deliveries runtime')
    const identity = health.ok ? await health.json().catch(() => null) : null
    const release = identity?.release
    if (
      identity?.ok !== true ||
      identity.component !== 'deliveriesRuntime' ||
      Object.keys(release ?? {})
        .sort()
        .join(',') !== 'bundleId,channel,sourceSha' ||
      release.channel !== 'preview' ||
      release.bundleId !== preview.bundleId ||
      release.sourceSha !== sha
    )
      throw new Error(`${label}: the Deliveries runtime does not report ${preview.bundleId}.`)
  }
  for (const [key, value] of [
    ['BLUME_AUTH_URL', auth.url],
    ['BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT', deliveriesRuntime.url]
  ])
    if (env[key] && env[key].trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') !== value)
      throw new Error(`${key} conflicts with ${label}'s preview. Unset it.`)
  Object.assign(env, previewBackendEnvironment(preview, sha))
  log(`[pre-dev] backend environment: ${label} · ${preview.bundleId}`)
  return { mode: 'preview', pullRequestNumber: pr ?? null, bundleId: preview.bundleId }
}
</file>

<file path="scripts/recordedLedgerEnvironment.mjs">
import { isAbsolute } from 'node:path'
import { readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'

/** Local inspection of an exported test ledger; never a hosted integration test. */
export function configureRecordedLedger(env, args, userDataDir = env.ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR) {
  const path = env.BLUME_DEV_LEDGER_RECORDING
  if (!path) return false
  if (
    !isAbsolute(path) ||
    args.runtimeProfile !== 'ui' ||
    !args.signedOut ||
    args.runnerMode === 'static' ||
    env.BLUME_E2E_MODE !== '1' ||
    !userDataDir ||
    !isAbsolute(userDataDir)
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'A ledger recording needs an absolute file, --profile ui --signed-out, BLUME_E2E_MODE=1 and isolated ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR (HMR mode).'
    )
  }
  readRecordedLedger(path)
  // No production/preview account or ledger participates in this viewer.
  for (const key of Object.keys(env)) {
    if (/^(MAIN_VITE_|VITE_)?BLUME_.*(URL|ENDPOINT)$/.test(key)) env[key] = 'http://127.0.0.1:9'
  }
  for (const key of ['BLUME_AUTH_URL', 'BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT'])
    env[key] = 'http://127.0.0.1:9'
  env.VITE_POSTHOG_KEY = ''
  env.MAIN_VITE_BLUME_RELEASE_CHANNEL = ''
  env.VITE_BLUME_DELIVERIES_MOCK = '1'
  return true
}

export function readRecordedLedger(path) {
  if (statSync(path).size > 20 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Ledger recording exceeds 20 MiB')
  const value = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'))
  if (value.reset !== true || !Array.isArray(value.deliveries) || !Array.isArray(value.projects))
    throw new Error('Expected a complete /control/changes ledger recording')
  return value
}

<file path="scripts/recordedLedgerEnvironment.test.mjs">
import { test } from 'vitest'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { configureRecordedLedger } from './recordedLedgerEnvironment.mjs'

test('recordings require an isolated signed-out UI launch and do not retain remote backends', () => {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-recording-'))
  try {
    const file = join(root, 'ledger.json')
    writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ reset: true, deliveries: [], projects: [] }))
    const args = { runtimeProfile: 'ui', signedOut: true, runnerMode: 'hmr' }
    const env = {
      BLUME_DEV_LEDGER_RECORDING: file,
      BLUME_E2E_MODE: '1',
      ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR: join(root, 'user-data'),
      BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://account.example',
      MAIN_VITE_BLUME_AUTH_URL: 'https://account.example',
      BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT: 'https://ledger.example'
    }
    assert.equal(configureRecordedLedger({}, args), false)
    for (const change of [
      { runtimeProfile: 'full' },
      { signedOut: false },
      { runnerMode: 'static' }
    ])
      assert.throws(() => configureRecordedLedger({ ...env }, { ...args, ...change }))
    assert.throws(() => configureRecordedLedger({ ...env, BLUME_E2E_MODE: '0' }, args))
    assert.throws(() => configureRecordedLedger({ ...env, ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR: '' }, args))
    // .env files must not authorize a recording if the child receives the default profile.
    assert.throws(() => configureRecordedLedger({ ...env }, args, ''))
    assert.throws(() => configureRecordedLedger({ ...env }, args, 'relative-profile'))
    assert.equal(configureRecordedLedger(env, args), true)
    assert.equal(env.BLUME_AUTH_URL, 'http://127.0.0.1:9')
    assert.equal(env.MAIN_VITE_BLUME_AUTH_URL, 'http://127.0.0.1:9')
    assert.equal(env.BLUME_CONTROL_REMOTE_ENDPOINT, 'http://127.0.0.1:9')
    assert.equal(env.VITE_BLUME_DELIVERIES_MOCK, '1')
  } finally {
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})
</file>

import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
const executable = process.env.BLUME_TEST_ELECTRON_BINARY || require('electron')
const fixture = fileURLToPath(
  new URL('../__test/fixtures/account-image-startup.cjs', import.meta.url)
)
for (const late of [true, false]) {
  const home = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-account-startup-'))
  try {
    const env = {
      ...process.env,
      HOME: home,
      ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR: home,
      BLUME_TEST_LATE_SCHEME: late ? '1' : '0'
    }
    delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE
    const result = spawnSync(executable, [fixture], {
      env,
      encoding: 'utf8',
      timeout: 30_000,
      killSignal: 'SIGKILL'
    })
    const output = `${result.stdout}\n${result.stderr}`
    assert.ifError(result.error)
    if (late) {
      assert.equal(result.status, 1, output)
      assert.match(output, /registerSchemesAsPrivileged should be called before app is ready/)
      console.log('PASS: reproduces 2.0 stable late-registration failure')
    } else {
      assert.equal(result.status, 0, output)
      assert.match(output, /PASS: delayed stable startup and authenticated avatar proxy/)
      console.log('PASS: early registration survives delayed stable setup and serves avatar bytes')
    }
  } finally {
    rmSync(home, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
}

<file path="scripts/test-evidence-image-cache.mjs">
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { build } from 'esbuild'

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'blume-evidence-electron-'))
try {
  for (const name of ['evidence-image-cache', 'evidence-image-cache-worker']) {
    await build({
      entryPoints: [fileURLToPath(new URL(`../__test/fixtures/${name}.ts`, import.meta.url))],
      outfile: join(root, `${name}.cjs`),
      bundle: true,
      platform: 'node',
      format: 'cjs',
      external: ['electron']
    })
  }
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    BLUME_CACHE_TEST_ROOT: root,
    BLUME_CACHE_TEST_WORKER: join(root, 'evidence-image-cache-worker.cjs'),
    BLUME_CACHE_TEST_HTML: fileURLToPath(new URL('../src/renderer/index.html', import.meta.url))
  }
  delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE
  const child = spawn(require('electron'), [join(root, 'evidence-image-cache.cjs')], {
    env,
    stdio: 'inherit'
  })
  const deadline = setTimeout(() => child.kill('SIGKILL'), 30_000)
  const code = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    child.on('exit', resolve)
    child.on('error', reject)
  }).finally(() => clearTimeout(deadline))
  assert.equal(code, 0, 'Electron evidence cache regression failed')
} finally {
  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
}

<file path="scripts/upload-sentry-sourcemaps.mjs">
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type */
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const desktopRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')
const repoRoot = resolve(desktopRoot, '../..')
const outDir = resolve(desktopRoot, 'out')
const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(desktopRoot, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))

const org = process.env.SENTRY_ORG ?? 'blume-0d'
const project = process.env.SENTRY_PROJECT ?? 'electron'
const release = `blume-desktop@${pkg.version}`
const pnpmCommand = 'pnpm'

if (!process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN) {
  console.error('Missing SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN. Cannot upload Sentry source maps.')
  process.exit(1)
}

if (!existsSync(outDir)) {
  console.error(`Missing build output directory: ${outDir}`)
  process.exit(1)
}

function run(args, options = {}) {
  const result = spawnSync(pnpmCommand, ['exec', 'sentry-cli', ...args], {
    cwd: repoRoot,
    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
    stdio: 'inherit',
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      SENTRY_ORG: org,
      SENTRY_PROJECT: project
    }
  })

  if (result.status === 0) return
  if (result.error) {
    console.error(`Failed to run ${pnpmCommand}: ${result.error.message}`)
  }
  if (options.optional) {
    console.warn(`sentry-cli ${args.join(' ')} failed; continuing.`)
    return
  }
  process.exit(result.status ?? 1)
}

console.log(`Uploading Sentry source maps for ${release}`)
run(['releases', 'new', release], { optional: true })
run(['releases', 'set-commits', release, '--auto', '--ignore-missing'], { optional: true })
run(['sourcemaps', 'upload', '--release', release, outDir])
</file>

<file path="vitest.config.ts">
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

import { configDefaults, defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'

// Tests run under plain Node (no Electron runtime), so any main-process module
// that transitively imports Electron-only packages would crash
// at load — `electron` is a CJS module whose named exports (`BrowserWindow`,
// `app`, ...) aren't importable as ESM, and `@electron-toolkit/utils` reads
// `app.isPackaged` at module load. Better Auth's Electron client additionally
// initializes native protocol/session APIs. Alias these to local stubs in
// `__test/stubs/` (the same ones the standalone `__test/loader.mjs` uses) so
// these modules are importable in tests. Only modules that import them are
// affected; electron-free tests are untouched.
const stub = (rel: string): string => fileURLToPath(new URL(rel, import.meta.url))

export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    // This native Electron journey runs only through its Playwright release-check command.
    exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, '__test/release-onboarding/**'],
    server: { deps: { inline: [/@better-auth\/electron/] } },
    alias: {
      electron: stub('./__test/stubs/electron.mjs'),
      '@electron-toolkit/utils': stub('./__test/stubs/electron-toolkit-utils.mjs'),
      '@better-auth/electron/client': stub('./__test/stubs/better-auth-electron-client.mjs')
    }
  }
})
</file>
